Và xảy đến after this, that the king of the children of Ammon chết, Và Hanun his son reigned in his stead.
Then nói Đa-vít, I will shew kindness unto Hanun con trai of Nahash, as his father đã bày tỏ kindness unto me. And Đa-vít sent to comfort him by tay of his servants for his father. Và Đa-vít's các đầy tớ đến into the land of the children of Ammon.
Và the princes of the children of Ammon nói unto Hanun their lord, Thinkest ngươi that Đa-vít doth honour thy father, that he hath sent comforters unto ngươi? hath not Đa-vít rather sent his servants unto ngươi, to search thành, Và to spy it out, Và to overthrow it? Thinkest…: Heb. In thine eyes doth Đa-vít
Wherefore Hanun took Đa-vít's các đầy tớ, Và shaved off the one half of their beards, Và cut off their garments in the middle, even to their buttocks, Và sent them away.
When they told it unto Đa-vít, he sent to meet them, because the men were greatly ashamed: và vua nói, Tarry at Giê-ri-cô until your beards be grown, and Rồi return.
Và when the children of Ammon nhìn thấy that they stank before Đa-vít, con cái of Ammon sent Và hired the Syrians of Beth–rehob, Và the Syrians of Zoba, hai mươi ngàn footmen, Và of king Maacah một ngàn men, Và of Ish–tob mười hai ngàn men. Ish–tob: or, the men of Tob
Và when Đa-vít nghe of it, he sent Joab, Và all the host of the mighty men.
Và the children of Ammon came out, Và put the battle in array at the entering in of cổng: Và the Syrians of Zoba, Và of Rehob, Và Ish–tob, Và Maacah, were by themselves in the field.
When Joab nhìn thấy that the front of the battle was against him before Và behind, he chose of all the choice men của I-sơ-ra-ên, and put họ in array against the Syrians:
Và the rest của dân sự he delivered into tay of Abishai his brother, that he might put họ in array against con cái of Ammon.
Và he nói, If the Syrians be too strong for me, then ngươi shalt help me: but if the children of Ammon be too strong for ngươi, then I will come Và help ngươi.
Be of good courage, Và let us play the men for our people, Và for the cities of our God: Và the CHÚA do that which seemeth him good.
Và Joab drew nigh, Và the people that were with him, unto the battle against the Syrians: Và they fled before him.
Và when the children of Ammon nhìn thấy that the Syrians were fled, then fled they also before Abishai, Và entered into the city. So Joab returned from the children of Ammon, Và came to Giê-ru-sa-lem.
Và when the Syrians nhìn thấy that they were smitten before I-sơ-ra-ên, they gathered themselves together.
Và Hadarezer sent, Và brought out the Syrians that were bên kia the river: Và they came to Helam; Và Shobach the captain of the host of Hadarezer went before them. the river: that is, Euphrates Shobach: or, Shophach
Và when it was told Đa-vít, he gathered all I-sơ-ra-ên together, Và passed over Giô-đanh, Và came to Helam. Và the Syrians set themselves in array against Đa-vít, Và fought with him.
Và the Syrians fled before I-sơ-ra-ên; Và Đa-vít giết the men of bảy trăm chariots of the Syrians, Và forty ngàn horsemen, Và smote Shobach the captain of their host, who died there. horsemen: also called, footmen
Và when tất cả các vua that were các đầy tớ to Hadarezer nhìn thấy that they were smitten before I-sơ-ra-ên, they made peace with I-sơ-ra-ên, Và served them. So the Syrians feared to help con cái of Ammon any more.

CHAPTER 11.
Và xảy đến, after the year was expired, at the time when kings go forth to battle, that Đa-vít sent Joab, Và his servants with him, and all I-sơ-ra-ên; Và they destroyed con cái of Ammon, Và besieged Rabbah. But Đa-vít tarried still at Giê-ru-sa-lem. after…: Heb. at the return of the year, or, in the spring
Và xảy đến in an eveningtide, that Đa-vít arose from off his bed, Và walked upon the roof of the king's nhà: Và from the roof he saw một người đờn bà washing herself; and the woman was very beautiful to look upon.
Và Đa-vít sent Và enquired after the woman. And one nói, Is not this Bath–sheba, con gái of Eliam, the wife of Uriah the Hittite? Bath–sheba: or, Bath–shuah Eliam: or Ammiel
Và Đa-vít sent messengers, Và took her; and she came in unto him, and he lay with her; for she was purified from her ô uế: Và she returned unto her house. for she…: or, and when she had purified herself, etc, she returned
Và the woman conceived, Và sent Và told Đa-vít, và nói, I là with child.
Và Đa-vít sent to Joab, nói [rằng], Send me Uriah the Hittite. Và Joab sent Uriah to Đa-vít.
Và when Uriah was come unto him, Đa-vít demanded of him how Joab did, Và how the people did, Và how the war prospered. how Joab…: Heb. of the peace of, etc
Và Đa-vít nói to Uriah, Go down to thy house, Và wash thy feet. Và Uriah departed out of the king's nhà, Và there followed him a mess of meat from the king. followed…: Heb. went out after him
But Uriah slept at the door of the king's nhà with all the servants of his lord, Và went not down to his house.
Và when they had told Đa-vít, nói [rằng], Uriah went not down unto his house, Đa-vít nói unto Uriah, Camest ngươi not from thy hành trình? why Rồi didst ngươi not go down unto thine house?
Và Uriah nói unto Đa-vít, The ark, Và I-sơ-ra-ên, Và Giu-đa, abide in tents; Và my lord Joab, Và the servants of my lord, are encamped in the open fields; shall I then go into mine house, to eat Và to drink, Và to lie with my wife? as ngươi livest, and as thy soul liveth, I will not do this thing.
Và Đa-vít nói to Uriah, Tarry here to day also, and to morrow I will let ngươi depart. So Uriah abode in Giê-ru-sa-lem that day, Và the morrow.
Và when Đa-vít had called him, he did eat và uống before him; and he made him drunk: Và at even he went out to lie on his bed with the servants of his lord, but went not down to his house.
Và xảy đến in buổi sáng, that Đa-vít viết a letter to Joab, Và sent it by tay of Uriah.
Và he wrote in the letter, nói [rằng], Set ye Uriah in the forefront of the hottest battle, Và retire ye from him, that he may be smitten, Và die. hottest: Heb. strong from him: Heb. from after him
Và xảy đến, when Joab observed thành, that he assigned Uriah unto một chỗ where he knew that valiant men were.
Và the men of the city went out, Và fought with Joab: Và there fell some của dân sự of the servants của Đa-vít; Và Uriah the Hittite chết also.
Then Joab sent Và told Đa-vít all the things concerning the war;
Và charged the messenger, nói [rằng], When ngươi hast made an end of telling the matters of the war unto the king,
Và if so be that the king's wrath Hãy chổi dậy, Và he say unto ngươi, Wherefore approached ye so nigh unto the city when ye did fight? knew ye not that they would shoot from the wall?
Who smote Abimelech con trai of Jerubbesheth? did not một người đờn bà cast a piece of a millstone upon him from the wall, that he died in Thebez? why went ye nigh the wall? then say thou, Thy servant Uriah the Hittite is dead also. Jerubbesheth: also called, Jerubbaal
So the messenger went, Và came Và shewed Đa-vít all that Joab had sent him for.
Và the messenger nói unto Đa-vít, Surely the men prevailed against us, and came out unto us into the field, Và we were upon them even unto the entering of cổng.
Và the shooters shot from off the wall upon thy servants; and some of the king's các đầy tớ be dead, Và thy servant Uriah the Hittite is dead also.
Then Đa-vít nói unto the messenger, Thus shalt ngươi say unto Joab, Let not this thing displease ngươi, for thanh gươm devoureth one as well as another: make thy battle more strong against the city, Và overthrow it: and encourage ngươi him. displease…: Heb. be evil in thine eyes one…: Heb. so and such
Và when the wife of Uriah nghe that Uriah her husband was dead, she mourned for her husband.
Và when the than khóc was past, Đa-vít sent Và fetched her to his house, Và she became his wife, Và bare him một con trai. But the thing that Đa-vít had done displeased the CHÚA. displeased: Heb. was evil in the eyes of

CHAPTER 12.
Và the CHÚA sent Nathan unto Đa-vít. Và he came unto him, and nói unto him, There were two men in one city; the one rich, Và the other poor.
The rich man had exceeding many flocks Và herds:
But the poor man had nothing, save one little ewe lamb, which he had bought Và nourished up: Và it grew up together with him, and with his children; it did eat of his own meat, Và drank of his own cup, Và lay in his bosom, Và was unto him as a daughter. meat: Heb. morsel
Và there came a traveller unto the rich man, Và he spared to take of his own flock Và of his own herd, to dress for the wayfaring man that was come unto him; but took người nghèo man's lamb, Và dressed it for the man that was come to him.
Và Đa-vít's anger was greatly kindled against the man; Và he nói to Nathan, As the CHÚA liveth, the man that hath done this thing shall surely chết: shall…: or, is worthy to die, or, is một con trai of death
Và he shall restore Chiên Con gấp tư, vì he did this thing, Và because he had no pity.
Và Nathan nói to Đa-vít, Thou art the man. Thus nói the CHÚA ĐCT của I-sơ-ra-ên, I anointed ngươi king over I-sơ-ra-ên, Và I delivered ngươi out of tay of Sau-lơ;
Và I gave ngươi thy master's nhà, Và thy master's wives into thy bosom, Và gave ngươi nhà của I-sơ-ra-ên Và của Giu-đa; and if that had been too little, I would moreover have given unto ngươi such Và such things.
Wherefore hast ngươi despised the commandment of the CHÚA, to do evil in his sight? ngươi hast killed Uriah the Hittite with thanh gươm, Và hast taken vợ ông to be thy wife, Và hast slain him with thanh gươm of the children of Ammon.
Now therefore thanh gươm shall never depart from thine house; vì ngươi hast despised me, and hast taken the wife of Uriah the Hittite to be thy wife.
Thus nói the CHÚA, kìa, I will raise up evil against ngươi out of thine own house, Và I will take thy wives before thine eyes, Và give họ unto thy neighbour, Và he shall lie with thy wives in the sight of this sun.
For ngươi didst it secretly: but I will do this thing before all I-sơ-ra-ên, Và before mặt trời.
Và Đa-vít nói unto Nathan, I have sinned against the CHÚA. Và Nathan nói unto Đa-vít, The CHÚA also hath put away thy sin; ngươi shalt not die.
Howbeit, because by this deed ngươi hast given great occasion to the enemies of the CHÚA to blaspheme, the child also that is born unto ngươi shall surely chết.
Và Nathan departed unto his house. Và the CHÚA struck the child that Uriah's vợ bare unto Đa-vít, Và it was very sick.
Đa-vít therefore besought ĐCT for the child; Và Đa-vít fasted, Và went in, Và lay all night trên đất. fasted: Heb. fasted a fast
Và các trưởng lão of his house arose, Và went to him, to raise him up from đất: but he would not, neither did he eat bánh with them.
Và xảy đến on the seventh ngày, that the child chết. Và the servants của Đa-vít feared to tell him that the child was dead: for họ nói, kìa, while the child was yet alive, we spake unto him, and he would not hearken unto our voice: how will he then vex himself, if we tell him that the child is dead? vex: Heb. do hurt
But when Đa-vít nhìn thấy that his servants whispered, Đa-vít perceived that the child was dead: therefore Đa-vít nói unto his servants, Is the child dead? Và họ nói, He is dead.
Then Đa-vít arose from đất, Và washed, Và anointed himself, Và changed his apparel, Và came inđến nhà of the CHÚA, Và worshipped: then he came to his own house; Và when he required, they set bánh before him, and he did eat.
Then nói his servants unto him, What thing is this that ngươi hast done? ngươi didst fast Và weep for the child, while it was alive; but when the child was dead, ngươi didst rise Và eat bánh.
Và he nói, While the child was yet alive, I fasted Và khóc: for tôi nói, Who can tell hoặc
God will be gracious to me, that the child may live?
But now he is dead, wherefore should I fast? can I bring him back again? I shall go to him, but he shall not return to me.
Và Đa-vít comforted Bath–sheba vợ ông, Và went in unto her, and lay with her: and she bare một con trai, Và he called his name Sa-lô-môn: Và the CHÚA loved him.
Và he sent by tay of Nathan tiên tri; Và he called his name Jedidiah, vì cớ the CHÚA. Jedidiah: that is, Beloved of the CHÚA
Và Joab fought against Rabbah of the children of Ammon, Và took the royal city.
Và Joab sent messengers to Đa-vít, và nói, I have fought against Rabbah, Và have taken thành of waters.
Now therefore gather the rest của dân sự together, Và encamp against the city, Và take it: lest I take thành, Và it be called after my name. it be called…: Heb. my name be called upon it
Và Đa-vít gathered tất cả mọi người together, Và went to Rabbah, Và fought against it, and took it.
Và he took their king's crown from off his head, the weight whereof was a talent of gold with the precious stones: and it was set on Đa-vít's đầu. Và he brought forth the spoil of the city in great abundance. in great…: Heb. very great
Và he brought forth the people that were therein, and put họ under saws, Và under harrows of sắt, Và under axes of sắt, Và made them pass through the brickkiln: Và thus did he unto all the cities of the children of Ammon. So Đa-vít Và all the people returned unto Giê-ru-sa-lem.

CHAPTER 13.
Và xảy đến after this, that Absalom con trai của Đa-vít had a fair sister, whose name was Tamar; Và Amnon con trai của Đa-vít loved her.
Và Amnon was so vexed, that he fell sick for his sister Tamar; for she was một trinh nữ; Và Amnon thought it hard for him to do any thing to her. Amnon thought…: Heb. it was marvellous, or, hidden in the eyes of Amnon
But Amnon had a friend, whose name was Jonadab, con trai of Shimeah Đa-vít's brother: Và Jonadab was a very subtil man.
Và he nói unto him, Tại sao art thou, being the king's son, lean from day to day? wilt ngươi not tell me? And Amnon nói unto him, I love Tamar, my brother Absalom's sister. lean: Heb. thin from day…: Heb. morning by morning
Và Jonadab nói unto him, Lay ngươi down on thy bed, Và make thyself sick: Và when thy father đến để xemngươi, say unto him, I pray ngươi, let my sister Tamar đến, Và give me meat, Và dress the meat in my sight, that I may see it, Và eat it at her hand.
So Amnon lay down, Và made himself sick: Và when the king was come để xemhim, Amnon nói unto the king, I pray ngươi, let Tamar my sister đến, Và make me a couple of cakes in my sight, that I may eat at her hand.
Then Đa-vít sent home to Tamar, nói [rằng], đi now to thy brother Amnon's nhà, Và dress him meat.
So Tamar went to her brother Amnon's nhà; Và he was laid down. Và she took flour, Và kneaded it, Và made cakes in his sight, Và did bake the cakes. flour: or, paste
Và she took a pan, and poured họ out before him; but he refused to eat. Và Amnon nói, Have out all men from me. And they went out every man from him.
Và Amnon nói unto Tamar, Bring the meat into the chamber, that I may eat of thine hand. Và Tamar took the cakes which she had made, Và brought họ into the chamber to Amnon her brother.
Và when she had brought họ unto him to eat, he took hold of her, and nói unto her, Come lie with me, my sister.
Và she trả lời him, Nay, my brother, do not force me; for no such thing ought to be done in I-sơ-ra-ên: do not ngươi this folly. force…: Heb. humble me no such…: Heb. it ought not so to be done
Và I, whither shall I cause my shame to go? Và as for ngươi, ngươi shalt be as one of the fools in I-sơ-ra-ên. Now therefore, I pray ngươi, speak unto the king; for he will not withhold me from ngươi.
Howbeit he would not hearken unto her voice: but, being stronger than she, forced her, and lay with her.
Then Amnon ghét her exceedingly; so that the thù oán wherewith he hated her was lớn hơn than tình yêu wherewith he had loved her. And Amnon nói unto her, Arise, be gone. exceedingly: Heb. with great thù oán greatly
Và she nói unto him, There is no cause: this evil in sending me away is lớn hơn than the other that ngươi didst unto me. But he would not hearken unto her.
Then he called his servant that ministered unto him, and nói, Put now this woman out from me, and bolt the door after her.
Và she had a garment of divers colours upon her: for with such robes were the king's daughters that were virgins apparelled. Then his servant brought her out, Và bolted the door after her.
Và Tamar put ashes on her head, Và rent her garment of divers colours that was on her, and laid her hand on her head, Và went on crying.
Và Absalom her brother nói unto her, Hath Amnon thy brother been with ngươi? but hold now thy peace, my sister: he is thy brother; regard not this thing. So Tamar remained desolate in her brother Absalom's nhà. Amnon: Heb. Aminon regard…: Heb. set not thy heart desolate: Heb. and desolate
But when king Đa-vít nghe of all these things, he was very wroth.
Và Absalom nói unto his brother Amnon neither good nor bad: for Absalom ghét Amnon, vì he had forced his sister Tamar.
Và xảy đến after two full năm, that Absalom had sheepshearers in Baal–hazor, which is beside Ephraim: Và Absalom invited all the king's sons.
Và Absalom đến to the king, và nói, kìa now, thy servant hath sheepshearers; let vua, tôi nài khuyên ngươi, and his servants đi with thy servant.
và vua nói to Absalom, Nay, my son, let us not all now go, lest we be chargeable unto ngươi. And he pressed him: howbeit he would not go, but blessed him.
Then nói Absalom, If not, I pray ngươi, let my brother Amnon đi with us. And the king nói unto him, Tại sao should he go with ngươi?
But Absalom pressed him, that he let Amnon Và all the king's sons đi with him.
Now Absalom had commanded his servants, nói [rằng], Mác ye now when Amnon's heart is merry with wine, Và when I say cùng các ngươi, Smite Amnon; then kill him, fear not: have not I commanded you? be courageous, Và be valiant. have…: or, will you not, since I have commanded you?
valiant: Heb. sons of valour
Và the servants of Absalom did unto Amnon as Absalom had commanded. Then all the king's sons arose, và mãi mãiy man gat him up upon his mule, Và fled. gat…: Heb. rode
Và xảy đến, while they were in the way, that tidings đến to Đa-vít, nói [rằng], Absalom hath slain all the king's sons, Và there is not one of them left.
Then the king arose, Và tare his garments, Và lay on đất; Và all his servants đứng by with their clothes rent.
Và Jonadab, con trai of Shimeah Đa-vít's brother, trả lời và nói, Let not my lord suppose that they have slain all the young men the king's sons; for Amnon only is dead: for by the appointment of Absalom this hath been determined from the day that he forced his sister Tamar. appointment: Heb. mouth determined: or, settled
Now therefore let not my lord vua take the thing to his heart, to think that all the king's sons are dead: for Amnon only is dead.
But Absalom fled. Và the young man that kept the watch lifted up his eyes, Và looked, and, kìa, there came much people by the way of the hill side behind him.
Và Jonadab nói unto the king, kìa, the king's sons đến: as thy servant nói, so it is. as thy…: Heb. according to the word of thy servant
Và xảy đến, as soon as he had made an end of speaking, that, kìa, the king's sons đến, Và lifted up their voice Và khóc: và vua also and all his servants khóc very sore. very…: Heb. with a great weeping greatly
But Absalom fled, Và went to Talmai, con trai of Ammihud, vua of Geshur. And Đa-vít mourned for his son every day. Ammihud: or, Ammihur
So Absalom fled, Và went to Geshur, Và was there three năm.
Và the soul of vua Đa-vít longed to go forth unto Absalom: for he was comforted concerning Amnon, seeing he was dead. longed: or, was consumed

CHAPTER 14.
Now Joab con trai of Zeruiah perceived that the king's heart was toward Absalom.
Và Joab sent to Tekoah, Và fetched thence a wise woman, và nói unto her, I pray ngươi, feign thyself to be a mourner, Và put on now than khóc apparel, Và anoint not thyself with oil, but be as một người đờn bà that had a long time mourned for kẻ chết:
Và come to the king, Và speak on this manner unto him. So Joab put những lời in her mouth.
Và when the woman of Tekoah nói to the king, she fell on her face to the ground, Và did obeisance, và nói, Help, O king. Help: Heb. Save
và vua nói unto her, What aileth ngươi? And she trả lời, I là indeed a widow woman, Và mine husband is dead.
Và thy handmaid had two sons, Và they two strove together in the field, and there was none to part them, but the one smote the other, Và slew him. none…: Heb. no deliverer between them
And, kìa, the whole gia đình is risen against thine handmaid, Và họ nói, Deliver him that smote his brother, that we may kill him, for the sự sống of his brother whom he slew; Và we will destroy the heir also: and so they shall quench my coal which is left, Và shall not leave to my husband neither name nor remainder trên đất. upon…: Heb. upon mặt đất
và vua nói với người đàn bà, đi to thine house, Và I will give charge concerning ngươi.
Và the woman of Tekoah nói unto the king, My lord, O king, the iniquity be on me, and on my father's nhà: và vua Và his throne be guiltless.
và vua nói, Whosoever nói ought unto ngươi, bring him to me, and he shall not touch ngươi any more.
Then nói she, I pray ngươi, let the king nhớ the CHÚA thy God, that ngươi wouldest not suffer the revengers of blood to destroy any more, lest they destroy my son. Và he nói, As the CHÚA liveth, there shall not one hair of thy son fall to đất. that…: Heb. that the revenger of blood do not multiply to destroy
Then the woman nói, Let thine handmaid, I pray ngươi, speak one word unto my lord vua. Và he nói, Say on.
Và the woman nói, Wherefore then hast ngươi thought such a thing against the people của ĐCT? for the king doth speak this thing as one which is faulty, in that the king doth not fetch home again his banished.
For we must needs chết, and are as water spilt on the ground, which cannot be gathered up again; neither doth God respect any person: yet doth he devise means, that his banished be not expelled from him. neither…: or, because God hath not taken away his sự sống, he hath also devised means, etc
Now therefore that I am come to speak of this thing unto my lord vua, it is because the people have made me afraid: Và thy handmaid nói, I will now speak unto the king; it may be that the king will perform the request of his handmaid.
For the king will hear, to deliver his handmaid out of tay of the man that would destroy me and my son together out of the inheritance của ĐCT.
Then thine handmaid nói, lời of my lord vua shall now be comfortable: for as một thiên sứ của ĐCT, so is chúa tôi vua to discern tốt Và bad: therefore the CHÚA thy God will be with ngươi. comfortable: Heb. for rest to discern: Heb. to hear
Then the king trả lời và nói với người đàn bà, Hide not from me, I pray ngươi, the thing that I shall ask ngươi. And the woman nói, Let my lord vua now speak.
và vua nói, Is not tay of Joab with ngươi in all this? And the woman trả lời và nói, As thy soul liveth, chúa tôi vua, none can turn to the tay phải or to the left from ought that my lord vua hath spoken: for thy servant Joab, he bade me, and he put all these words in the mouth of thine handmaid:
To fetch about this form of speech hath thy servant Joab done this thing: Và my lord is khôn ngoan, according to the wisdom of một thiên sứ của ĐCT, to know all things that are in đất.
và vua nói unto Joab, kìa now, I have done this thing: đi therefore, bring the young man Absalom again.
Và Joab rơi to the ground on his face, Và bowed himself, and thanked vua: Và Joab nói, To day thy servant biết that I have found ân-điển in thy sight, chúa tôi, O king, in that the king hath fulfilled the request of his servant. thanked: Heb. blessed his servant: or, thy servant
So Joab arose Và went to Geshur, Và brought Absalom to Giê-ru-sa-lem.
và vua nói, Let him turn to his own house, Và let him not see my face. So Absalom returned to his own house, Và saw not the king's mặt.
But in all I-sơ-ra-ên there was none to be so much praised as Absalom for his beauty: from the sole of his foot even to the crown of his head there was no blemish in him. But…: Heb. And as Absalom there was not a beautiful man in all I-sơ-ra-ên to praise greatly
Và when he polled his head, ( for it was at every year's end that he polled it: because the hair was heavy on him, therefore he polled it:) he weighed the hair of his head at two hundred shekels after the king's weight.
Và unto Absalom there were born ba sons, Và one con gái, whose name was Tamar: she was một người đờn bà of a fair countenance.
So Absalom dwelt two full năm in Giê-ru-sa-lem, Và saw not the king's mặt.
Therefore Absalom sent for Joab, to have sent him to the king; but he would not come to him: and when he sent again the second time, he would not come.
Therefore he nói unto his servants, thấy, Joab's field is near mine, Và he hath barley there; go Và set it on fire. Và Absalom's các đầy tớ set cánh đồng on fire. near…: Heb. near my place
Then Joab arose, Và came to Absalom unto his nhà, và nói unto him, Wherefore have thy servants set my field on fire?
Và Absalom trả lời Joab, kìa, I sent unto ngươi, saying, đến hither, that I may send ngươi to the king, to say, Wherefore am I come from Geshur? it had been tốt for me to have been there still: now therefore let me see the king's mặt; Và if there be any iniquity in me, let him kill me.
So Joab đến to the king, Và told him: and when he had called for Absalom, he came to the king, Và bowed himself on his face to the ground before vua: và vua hôn Absalom.

CHAPTER 15.
Và xảy đến after this, that Absalom đã chuẩn bị him chariots Và horses, Và fifty men to run before him.
Và Absalom rose up early, Và stood beside đường of cổng: and it was so, that when any man that had a controversy đến to the king for judgment, then Absalom called unto him, and nói, Of what city art thou? And he nói, Thy servant is of one of the tribes của I-sơ-ra-ên. came: Heb. to come
Và Absalom nói unto him, See, thy matters are tốt Và right; but there is không ai deputed of the king to hear ngươi. there…: or, none will hear ngươi from the king downward
Absalom nói moreover, Oh that I được dựng nên judge in the land, that every man which hath any suit or cause might come unto me, and I would do him justice! Và it was so, that when any man came nigh to him to do him obeisance, he put forth his hand, Và took him, and kissed him.
Và on this manner did Absalom to all I-sơ-ra-ên that came to the king for judgment: so Absalom stole the hearts of the men của I-sơ-ra-ên.
Và xảy đến after bốn mươi năm, that Absalom nói unto the king, I pray ngươi, let me go Và pay my vow, which I have vowed unto the CHÚA, in Hebron.
For thy servant vowed a vow while I abode at Geshur in Si-ri, nói [rằng], If the CHÚA shall bring me again indeed to Giê-ru-sa-lem, then I will serve the CHÚA.
và vua nói unto him, Go trong bình an. So he arose, Và went to Hebron.
But Absalom sent spies throughout all the tribes của I-sơ-ra-ên, nói [rằng], As soon as ye hear tiếng of the trumpet, then ngươi sẽ say, Absalom reigneth in Hebron.
Và with Absalom went hai trăm men out of Giê-ru-sa-lem, that were called; Và they went in their simplicity, Và they knew not any thing.
Và Absalom sent for Ahithophel the Gilonite, Đa-vít's counsellor, from his city, even from Giloh, while he offered sacrifices. Và the conspiracy was strong; for the people increased continually with Absalom.
Và there came a messenger to Đa-vít, nói [rằng], The hearts of the men của I-sơ-ra-ên are after Absalom.
Và Đa-vít nói unto all his servants that were with him at Giê-ru-sa-lem, Hãy chổi dậy, Và let us flee; for we shall not else escape từ Absalom: make speed to depart, lest he overtake us bất chợt, Và bring evil upon us, and smite thành with the edge of thanh gươm. bring: Heb. thrust
Và the king's các đầy tớ nói unto the king, kìa, thy servants are ready to do bất cứ điều chi my lord vua shall appoint. appoint: Heb. choose
và vua went forth, Và all his household after him. And the king left mười women, which were concubines, to keep nhà. after…: Heb. at his feet
và vua went forth, Và all the people after him, and tarried in một chỗ that was far off.
Và all his servants passed on beside him; and all the Cherethites, Và all the Pelethites, Và all the Gittites, sáu trăm men which came after him from Gath, passed on before vua.
Then nói vua to Ittai the Gittite, Wherefore goest ngươi also with us? return to thy place, Và abide with the king: for thou art a stranger, Và also an exile.
Whereas ngươi camest but hôm qua, should I this day make ngươi go up and down with us? seeing I go whither I may, return thou, and take back thy brethren: mercy Và truth be with ngươi. go up…: Heb. wander in going
Và Ittai trả lời vua, và nói, As the CHÚA liveth, and as chúa tôi vua liveth, surely in what place chúa tôi vua shall be, whether in death or sự sống, even there also will thy servant be.
Và Đa-vít nói to Ittai, đi Và pass over. Và Ittai the Gittite passed over, Và all his men, Và all the little ones that were with him.
Và all the country khóc with a loud tiếng, Và all the people passed over: vua also himself passed over the brook Kidron, Và all the people passed over, toward đường of the wilderness. Kidron: Gr. Cedron
Và lo Zadok also, and all the Levites were with him, bearing the ark of the covenant của ĐCT: Và they set down the ark của ĐCT; Và Abiathar đi lên, until all the people had done passing out of the city.
và vua nói unto Zadok, Carry back the ark của ĐCT into the city: if I shall find favour in the eyes of the CHÚA, he will bring me again, Và shew me both it, and his habitation:
But if he thus say, I have no delight in ngươi; kìa, here am I, let him do to me as seemeth tốt unto him.
The king nói also unto Zadok thầy tế lễ, Art not ngươi a seer? return into the city trong bình an, Và your two sons with you, Ahimaaz thy son, Và Jonathan con trai of Abiathar.
thấy, I will tarry in the plain of the wilderness, until there come word from you to certify me.
Zadok therefore and Abiathar carried the ark của ĐCT again to Giê-ru-sa-lem: Và they tarried there.
Và Đa-vít đi lên by the ascent of mount Olivet, Và khóc as he went up, Và had his head covered, Và he went barefoot: Và all the people that was with him covered every man his head, Và they went up, khóc lóc as they went up. Và khóc…: Heb. going up and weeping
Và one told Đa-vít, nói [rằng], Ahithophel is among the conspirators with Absalom. Và Đa-vít nói, O CHÚA, I pray ngươi, turn the counsel of Ahithophel into foolishness.
Và xảy đến, that khi Đa-vít was come to the top of the mount, where he worshipped ĐCT, kìa, Hushai the Archite came to meet him with his coat rent, Và đất upon his head:
Unto whom Đa-vít nói, If ngươi passest on with me, then ngươi shalt be a burden unto me:
But if ngươi return to the city, Và say unto Absalom, I will be thy servant, O king; as I have been thy father's đầy tớ hitherto, so will I now also be thy servant: then mayest ngươi for me defeat the counsel of Ahithophel.
Và hast thou not there with ngươi Zadok Và Abiathar những thầy tế lễ? therefore it shall be, that what thing soever ngươi shalt hear out of the king's nhà, ngươi shalt tell it to Zadok Và Abiathar những thầy tế lễ.
kìa, they have there with them their two sons, Ahimaaz Zadok's son, Và Jonathan Abiathar's son; Và by them ngươi sẽ send unto me every thing that ye can hear.
So Hushai Đa-vít's friend đến into the city, Và Absalom đến into Giê-ru-sa-lem.

CHAPTER 16.
Và when Đa-vít was a little past the top of the hill, kìa, Ziba the servant of Mephibosheth met him, with a couple of asses saddled, Và upon them two hundred ổ bánh of bread, Và an hundred bunches of raisins, Và an hundred of summer fruits, Và a bottle of wine.
và vua nói unto Ziba, What meanest ngươi by these? And Ziba nói, The asses be for the king's gia đình to ride on; Và the bread Và summer fruit for the young men to eat; Và the wine, that such as be faint in the wilderness may drink.
và vua nói, And where is thy master's son? Và Ziba nói unto the king, kìa, he abideth at Giê-ru-sa-lem: for he nói, To day shall nhà của I-sơ-ra-ên phục hồi me the kingdom of my father.
Then nói vua to Ziba, kìa, thine are all that pertained unto Mephibosheth. Và Ziba nói, I humbly beseech ngươi that I may find ân-điển in thy sight, chúa tôi, O king. I humbly…: Heb. I do obeisance
Và when king Đa-vít đến to Bahurim, kìa, thence came out một người of the gia đình của nhà of Sau-lơ, whose name was Shimei, con trai of Gera: he came forth, Và cursed still as he came. he came forth…: or, he still came forth and cursed
Và he cast stones at Đa-vít, Và at all the servants của vua Đa-vít: Và all the people Và all the mighty men were on his tay phải Và on his left.
Và thus nói Shimei when he cursed, Come out, come out, ngươi bloody man, Và ngươi man of Belial: bloody…: Heb. man of blood
The CHÚA hath returned upon ngươi all the blood của nhà of Sau-lơ, in whose stead ngươi hast reigned; Và the CHÚA hath delivered the kingdom into tay of Absalom thy son: and, kìa, thou art taken in thy mischief, because thou art a bloody man. kìa…: Heb. kìa ngươi in thy evil
Then nói Abishai con trai of Zeruiah unto the king, Tại sao should this dead dog curse chúa tôi vua? let me go over, I pray ngươi, and take off his head.
và vua nói, What have I to do with you, ye sons of Zeruiah? so let him curse, because the CHÚA hath nói unto him, Curse Đa-vít. Who shall then say, Wherefore hast ngươi done so?
Và Đa-vít nói to Abishai, Và to all his servants, kìa, my son, which came forth of my bowels, seeketh my sự sống: how much more now may this Benjamite do it? let him alone, Và let him curse; for the CHÚA hath bidden him.
It may be that the CHÚA will look on mine affliction, Và that the CHÚA will requite me good for his cursing this day. affliction: or, tears: Heb. eye
Và as Đa-vít Và his men went by the way, Shimei went along on the hill's side đối diện him, and cursed as he went, Và threw stones at him, and cast dust. cast…: Heb. dusted him with dust
và vua, Và all the people that were with him, came weary, Và refreshed themselves there.
Và Absalom, Và all the people the men của I-sơ-ra-ên, đến to Giê-ru-sa-lem, Và Ahithophel with him.
Và xảy đến, when Hushai the Archite, Đa-vít's friend, was come unto Absalom, that Hushai nói unto Absalom, God save vua, God save vua. God…: Heb. Let the king live
Và Absalom nói to Hushai, Is this thy kindness to thy friend? why wentest ngươi not with thy friend?
Và Hushai nói unto Absalom, Nay; but whom the CHÚA, Và this people, Và all the men của I-sơ-ra-ên, choose, his will I be, and with him will I abide.
Và again, whom should I serve? should I not serve in the presence of his son? as I have served in thy father's presence, so will I be in thy presence.
Then nói Absalom to Ahithophel, Give counsel among you what we shall do.
Và Ahithophel nói unto Absalom, Go in unto thy father's concubines, which he hath left to keep nhà; Và all I-sơ-ra-ên shall hear that ngươi art abhorred of thy father: then shall tays of all that are with ngươi be strong.
So they spread Absalom a tent upon the top of nhà; Và Absalom went in unto his father's concubines in the sight of all I-sơ-ra-ên.
Và the counsel of Ahithophel, which he counselled in those days, was as if a man had enquired at the oracle của ĐCT: so was all the counsel of Ahithophel both with Đa-vít Và with Absalom. oracle: Heb. word

CHAPTER 17.
Moreover Ahithophel nói unto Absalom, Let me now choose out mười hai ngàn men, Và I will arise Và pursue after Đa-vít this night:
Và I will come upon him while he is weary Và weak handed, Và will make him afraid: Và all the people that are with him shall flee; Và Ta sẽ đánh vua only:
Và I will bring back tất cả mọi người unto ngươi: the man whom ngươi seekest is as if all returned: so tất cả mọi người shall be trong bình an.
Và the saying pleased Absalom well, Và all các trưởng lão của I-sơ-ra-ên. pleased…: Heb. was right in the eyes of, etc
Then nói Absalom, Call now Hushai the Archite also, and let us hear cũng như vậy what he nói. what…: Heb. what is in his mouth
Và when Hushai was come to Absalom, Absalom nói unto him, saying, Ahithophel hath spoken after this manner: shall we do after his saying? if not; speak thou. his saying: Heb. his word
Và Hushai nói unto Absalom, The counsel that Ahithophel hath given is không tốt at this time. given: Heb. counselled
For, nói Hushai, ngươi knowest thy father Và his men, that they be mighty men, and they be chafed in their minds, as a bear robbed of her whelps in the field: Và thy father is một người of war, Và will not lodge with the people. chafed…: Heb. bitter of soul
kìa, he is hid now in some pit, or in some other place: Và it will come to pass, when some of them be overthrown at the first, that whosoever nghe it will say, There is a slaughter among the people that follow Absalom. overthrown: Heb. fallen
Và he also that is valiant, whose heart is as the heart of a lion, shall utterly melt: for all I-sơ-ra-ên biết that thy father is a mighty man, and they which be with him are valiant men.
Therefore I counsel that all I-sơ-ra-ên be generally gathered unto ngươi, from Dan even to Beer–sheba, as the sand that is by biển for multitude; Và that ngươi go to battle in thine own person. that thou…: Heb. that thy face, or, presence go, etc
So shall we come upon him in some place where he shall be found, Và we will light upon him as the dew falleth on the ground: Và of him and of all the men that are with him there shall not be left so much as một.
Moreover, if he be gotten into a city, then shall all I-sơ-ra-ên bring ropes to that city, Và we will draw it into the river, until there be not one small stone found there.
Và Absalom Và all the men của I-sơ-ra-ên nói, The counsel of Hushai the Archite is better than the counsel of Ahithophel. For the CHÚA had appointed to defeat the good counsel of Ahithophel, to the intent that the CHÚA might bring evil upon Absalom. appointed: Heb. commanded
Then nói Hushai unto Zadok Và to Abiathar những thầy tế lễ, Thus and thus did Ahithophel counsel Absalom Và các trưởng lão của I-sơ-ra-ên; Và thus and thus have I counselled.
Now therefore send quickly, Và tell Đa-vít, nói [rằng], Lodge not this night in the plains of the wilderness, but speedily pass over; lest the king be swallowed up, Và all the people that are with him.
Now Jonathan Và Ahimaaz stayed by En–rogel; for they might not be seen to come into the city: Và a wench went Và told them; and they went Và told vua Đa-vít.
Nevertheless a lad nhìn thấy them, and told Absalom: but they went both of them away quickly, Và came to a man's nhà in Bahurim, which had a well in his court; whither they went down.
Và the woman took Và spread a covering over the well's miệng, Và spread ground corn thereon; and the thing was not known.
Và when Absalom's các đầy tớ đến to the woman đến nhà, họ nói, Where is Ahimaaz Và Jonathan? Và the woman nói với họ, They be gone over the brook of water. Và when they had sought Và could not find họ, they returned to Giê-ru-sa-lem.
Và xảy đến, after they were departed, that they came up out of the well, Và went Và told vua Đa-vít, và nói unto Đa-vít, Hãy chổi dậy, Và pass quickly over nước: for thus hath Ahithophel counselled against you.
Then Đa-vít arose, Và all the people that were with him, and they passed over Giô-đanh: by buổi sáng light there lacked not one of them that was not gone over Giô-đanh.
Và when Ahithophel nhìn thấy that his counsel was not followed, he saddled his ass, Và arose, Và gat him home to his house, to his city, Và put his household in order, Và hanged himself, and died, Và was buried in phần mộ of his father. followed: Heb. done put his…: Heb. gave charge concerning his house
Then Đa-vít đến to Mahanaim. Và Absalom passed over Giô-đanh, he and all the men của I-sơ-ra-ên with him.
Và Absalom made Amasa captain of the host instead of Joab: which Amasa was a man's son, whose name was Ithra an I-sơ-ra-ên, that went in to Abigail con gái of Nahash, sister to Zeruiah Joab's mẹ. Ithra an I-sơ-ra-ên: or, Jether an Ích-ma-ênite Abigail: Heb. Abigal Nahash: or, Gie-sê
So I-sơ-ra-ên Và Absalom pitched in the land of Gilead.
Và xảy đến, when Đa-vít was come to Mahanaim, that Shobi con trai of Nahash of Rabbah of the children of Ammon, Và Machir con trai of Ammiel of Lo–debar, Và Barzillai the Gileadite of Rogelim,
Brought beds, Và basons, Và earthen vessels, Và wheat, Và barley, Và flour, Và parched bắp, Và beans, Và lentiles, Và parched pulse,basons: or, cups
Và honey, Và butter, Và sheep, Và cheese of kine, for Đa-vít, Và for the people that were with him, to eat: for họ nói, The people is hungry, Và weary, Và thirsty, in the wilderness.

CHAPTER 18.
Và Đa-vít numbered the people that were with him, and set captains of thousands Và captains of hundreds over them.
Và Đa-vít sent forth a third part của dân sự under tay of Joab, Và a third part under tay of Abishai con trai of Zeruiah, Joab's brother, Và a third part under tay of Ittai the Gittite. và vua nói unto the people, I will surely go forth with you myself also.
But the people trả lời, ngươi shalt not go forth: for if we flee away, they will not care for us; neither if half of us die, will they care for us: but now ngươi art worth mười ngàn of us: therefore now it is better that ngươi succour us out of the city. care…: Heb. set their heart on us worth…: Heb. as ten thousand of us succour: Heb. be to succour or help
và vua nói với họ, What seemeth you best I will do. và vua đứng by cổng side, Và all the people came out by hundreds Và by thousands.
và vua truyền lệnh Joab Và Abishai Và Ittai, nói [rằng], Deal gently for my sake with the young man, even with Absalom. Và all the people nghe when the king gave all the captains charge concerning Absalom.
So the people went out into the field against I-sơ-ra-ên: Và the battle was in the wood of Ephraim;
Where the people của I-sơ-ra-ên were slain before the servants của Đa-vít, Và there was there a great slaughter that day of hai mươi ngàn men.
For the battle was there scattered over mặt of all the country: Và the wood devoured more people that day than thanh gươm devoured. devoured: Heb. multiplied to devour
Và Absalom met the servants của Đa-vít. Và Absalom rode upon a mule, Và the mule went under the thick boughs of a great oak, Và his head caught hold of the oak, Và he was taken up between the heaven Và đất; Và the mule that was under him went away.
Và a certain man nhìn thấy it, Và told Joab, và nói, kìa, I saw Absalom hanged in an oak.
Và Joab nói unto the man that told him, And, kìa, ngươi sawest him, Và why didst ngươi not smite him there to the ground? Và I would have given ngươi ten shekels of silver, Và a girdle.
Và the man nói unto Joab, Though I should receive một ngàn shekels of silver in mine hand, yet would I not put forth mine hand against the king's son: for in our hearing vua charged ngươi and Abishai Và Ittai, nói [rằng], Hãy coi chừng that none touch the young man Absalom. receive: Heb. weigh upon mine hand Beware…: Heb. Hãy coi chừng whosoever ye be of, etc
Otherwise I should have wrought falsehood against mine own sự sống: for there is no matter hid from the king, Và ngươi thyself wouldest have set thyself against me.
Then nói Joab, I may not tarry thus with ngươi. Và he took ba darts in his hand, Và thrust them through the heart of Absalom, while he was yet alive in the midst of the oak. with…: Heb. before ngươi midst: Heb. heart
và mười young men that bare Joab's armour compassed about Và smote Absalom, Và slew him.
Và Joab blew the trumpet, Và the people returned from pursuing after I-sơ-ra-ên: for Joab held back the people.
Và they took Absalom, Và cast him into a great pit in the wood, Và laid a very great heap of stones upon him: and all I-sơ-ra-ên fled every one to his tent.
Now Absalom in his sự sốngtime had taken Và reared up for himself a pillar, which is in the king's dale: for he nói, I have no son to keep my name in remembrance: Và he called the pillar after his own name: Và it is called unto this day, Absalom's place.
Then nói Ahimaaz con trai of Zadok, Let me now run, Và bear vua tidings, how that the CHÚA hath avenged him of his enemies. avenged…: Heb. judged him from tay, etc
Và Joab nói unto him, Thou shalt not bear tidings this day, but ngươi shalt bear tidings another ngày: but this day ngươi shalt bear no tidings, because the king's son is dead. bear tidings this: Heb. be a man of tidings, etc
Then nói Joab to Cushi, đi tell vua what ngươi hast seen. Và Cushi bowed himself unto Joab, Và ran.
Then nói Ahimaaz con trai of Zadok yet again to Joab, But howsoever, let me, I pray ngươi, also run after Cushi. Và Joab nói, Wherefore wilt ngươi run, my son, seeing that ngươi hast no tidings ready? howsoever: Heb. be what may ready: or, convenient
But howsoever, nói he, let me run. Và he nói unto him, Run. Then Ahimaaz ran by the way of the plain, Và overran Cushi.
Và Đa-vít sat between the two gates: Và the watchman đi lên to the roof over cổng unto the wall, Và lifted up his eyes, Và looked, Và kìa a man running alone.
Và the watchman cried, Và told vua. và vua nói, If he be alone, there is tidings in his mouth. Và he came apace, Và drew near.
Và the watchman nhìn thấy another man running: Và the watchman called unto the porter, và nói, kìa another man running alone. And the king nói, He also bringeth tidings.
Và the watchman nói, Me thinketh the running of the foremost is like the running of Ahimaaz con trai of Zadok. và vua nói, He is a good man, Và cometh with good tidings. Me…: Heb. I see the running
Và Ahimaaz called, và nói unto the king, All is well. Và he fell down to đất upon his face before the king, và nói, phước be the CHÚA thy God, which hath delivered up the men that lifted up their hand against my lord vua. All…: or, Peace be to ngươi: Heb. Peace delivered…: Heb. shut up
và vua nói, Is the young man Absalom safe? Và Ahimaaz trả lời, When Joab sent the king's đầy tớ, and me thy servant, I saw a great tumult, but I knew not what it was. Is…: Heb. Is there peace?
và vua nói unto him, Turn aside, Và stand here. Và he turned aside, Và stood still.
And, kìa, Cushi đến; Và Cushi nói, Tidings, chúa tôi vua: for the CHÚA hath avenged ngươi this day of all them that rose up against ngươi. Tidings: Heb. Tidings is brought
và vua nói unto Cushi, Is the young man Absalom safe? Và Cushi trả lời, The enemies of my lord vua, Và all that rise against ngươi to do ngươi hurt, be as that young man is.
và vua was much moved, Và went up to the chamber over cổng, Và khóc: Và as he went, thus he nói, O my son Absalom, my son, my son Absalom! would God I had died for ngươi, O Absalom, my son, my son!

CHAPTER 19.
Và it was told Joab, kìa, the king weepeth Và mourneth for Absalom.
Và sự chiến thắng that day was turned into than khóc unto all the people: for the people nghe say that day how the king was grieved for his son. victory: Heb. salvation, or, deliverance
Và the people gat them by stealth that day into the city, as people being ashamed steal away when they flee in battle.
But the king covered his face, và vua cried with a loud tiếng, O my son Absalom, O Absalom, my son, my son!
Và Joab đến inđến nhà to the king, và nói, ngươi hast shamed this day mặts of all thy servants, which this day have saved thy sự sống, Và the lives of thy sons Và of thy daughters, Và the lives of thy wives, Và the lives of thy concubines;
In that ngươi lovest thine enemies, Và hatest thy friends. For ngươi hast declared this day, that ngươi regardest neither princes nor servants: for this day I perceive, that if Absalom had lived, Và all we had died this day, then it had pleased ngươi well. In…: Heb. By loving, etc that ngươi regardest…: Heb. that princes or servants are not to ngươi
Now therefore arise, go forth, Và speak comfortably unto thy servants: for I swear by the CHÚA, if ngươi go not forth, there will not tarry một with ngươi this night: Và that will be worse unto ngươi than all the evil that befell ngươi from thy youth until now. comfortably…: Heb. to the heart of thy servants
Then the king arose, Và sat in cổng. Và they told unto all the people, nói [rằng], kìa, the king doth sit in cổng. Và all the people đến before vua: for I-sơ-ra-ên had fled every man to his tent.
Và all the people were at strife throughout all the tribes của I-sơ-ra-ên, nói [rằng], The king saved us out of tay of our enemies, Và he delivered us out of tay of the Philistines; Và now he is fled out of the land for Absalom.
Và Absalom, whom we anointed over us, is dead in battle. Now therefore why speak ye not a word of bringing vua back? speak…: Heb. are ye silent?
Và king Đa-vít sent to Zadok Và to Abiathar những thầy tế lễ, nói [rằng], nói với các trưởng lão của Giu-đa, nói [rằng], Tại sao are ye cuối cùng to bring vua back to his house? seeing the speech of all I-sơ-ra-ên is come to the king, even to his house.
Ye are my brethren, ye are my bones Và my flesh: wherefore then are ye cuối cùng to bring back vua?
Và say ye to Amasa, Art ngươi not of my bone, Và of my flesh? ĐCT do so to me, and more also, if ngươi be not captain of the host before me continually in the room of Joab.
Và he bowed the heart of all the men của Giu-đa, even as the heart of một man; so that they sent this word unto the king, Return thou, and all thy servants.
So the king returned, Và came to Giô-đanh. Và Giu-đa đến to Gilgal, to go to meet vua, to conduct vua over Giô-đanh.
Và Shimei con trai of Gera, a Benjamite, which was of Bahurim, hasted Và came down with the men của Giu-đa to meet vua Đa-vít.
Và there were một ngàn men of Bên-gia-min with him, and Ziba the servant của nhà of Sau-lơ, Và his fifteen sons Và his hai mươi các đầy tớ with him; and they went over Giô-đanh before vua.
Và there went over a ferry boat to carry over the king's gia đình, Và to do what he thought tốt. Và Shimei con trai of Gera fell down before vua, as he was come over Giô-đanh; what…: Heb. the good in his eyes
và nói unto the king, Let not my lord impute iniquity unto me, neither do ngươi remember that which thy servant did perversely ngày that my lord vua went out of Giê-ru-sa-lem, that the king should take it to his heart.
For thy servant doth know that I have sinned: therefore, kìa, I am come the first this day of all nhà of Giô-sép to go down to meet chúa tôi vua.
But Abishai con trai of Zeruiah trả lời và nói, Shall not Shimei be put to death for this, because he cursed the Lord's anointed?
Và Đa-vít nói, What have I to do with you, ye sons of Zeruiah, that ye should this day be adversaries unto me? shall there any man be put to death this day in I-sơ-ra-ên? for do not I know that I là this day vua over I-sơ-ra-ên?
Therefore the king nói unto Shimei, ngươi shalt not die. và vua sware unto him.
Và Mephibosheth con trai of Sau-lơ came down to meet vua, Và had neither dressed his feet, nor trimmed his beard, nor washed his clothes, from the day vua departed until the day he came again trong bình an.
Và xảy đến, when he was come to Giê-ru-sa-lem to meet vua, that the king nói unto him, Wherefore wentest not ngươi with me, Mephibosheth?
Và he trả lời, My lord, O king, my servant deceived me: for thy servant nói, I will saddle me một con lừa, that I may ride thereon, and go to the king; because thy servant is lame.
Và he hath slandered thy servant unto my lord vua; but my lord vua is as một thiên sứ của ĐCT: do therefore what is tốt in thine eyes.
For all of my father's nhà were but dead men before my lord vua: yet didst ngươi set thy servant among them that did eat at thine own table. What right therefore have I yet to cry any more unto the king? dead…: Heb. men of death
và vua nói unto him, Tại sao speakest ngươi any more of thy matters? I have nói, ngươi and Ziba divide the land.
Và Mephibosheth nói unto the king, Yea, let him take all, forasmuch as chúa tôi vua is come again trong bình an unto his own house.
Và Barzillai the Gileadite came down from Rogelim, Và went over Giô-đanh with the king, to conduct him over Giô-đanh.
Now Barzillai was a very aged man, even fourscore năm old: Và he had provided the king of sustenance while he lay at Mahanaim; for he was a very great man.
và vua nói unto Barzillai, Come ngươi over with me, and I will feed ngươi with me in Giê-ru-sa-lem.
Và Barzillai nói unto the king, How long have I to live, that I should go up with the king unto Giê-ru-sa-lem? How…: Heb. How many days are the years of my sự sống
I là this day fourscore năm old: Và can I discern between good Và evil? can thy servant taste what I eat or what I drink? can I hear any more the voice of singing men Và singing women? wherefore then should thy servant be yet a burden unto my lord vua?
Thy servant will go a little way over Giô-đanh with the king: Và why should the king recompense it me with such a reward?
Let thy servant, I pray ngươi, turn back again, that I may die in mine own city, Và be buried by the grave of my father Và of my mother. But kìa thy servant Chimham; let him go over with my lord vua; Và do to him what sẽ thấym good unto ngươi.
và vua trả lời, Chimham shall go over with me, and I will do to him that which sẽ thấym good unto ngươi: and bất cứ điều chi ngươi shalt require of me, that will I do for ngươi. require: Heb. choose
Và all the people went over Giô-đanh. Và when the king was come over, vua hôn Barzillai, Và blessed him; and he returned unto his own place.
Then the king went on to Gilgal, Và Chimham went on with him: and all the people của Giu-đa conducted vua, Và also half the people của I-sơ-ra-ên. Chimham: Heb. Chimhan
And, kìa, all the men của I-sơ-ra-ên đến to the king, và nói unto the king, Tại sao have our brethren the men của Giu-đa stolen ngươi away, Và have brought vua, Và his household, Và all Đa-vít's men with him, over Giô-đanh?
Và all the men của Giu-đa trả lời the men của I-sơ-ra-ên, Because the king is near of kin to us: wherefore then be ye angry for this matter? have we eaten at all of the king's cost? or hath he given us any gift?
Và the men của I-sơ-ra-ên trả lời the men của Giu-đa, và nói, We have ten parts in the king, Và we have also more right in Đa-vít than ye: why then did ye despise us, that our advice should not be first had in bringing back our king? Và the words of the men của Giu-đa were fiercer than the words of the men của I-sơ-ra-ên. despise…: Heb. set us at light

CHAPTER 20.
Và there happened to be there a man of Belial, whose name was Sheba, con trai of Bichri, a Benjamite: Và he blew a trumpet, và nói, We have no part in Đa-vít, neither have we inheritance in the son của Gie-sê: mỗi man to his tents, O I-sơ-ra-ên.
So every man của I-sơ-ra-ên đi lên from after Đa-vít, Và followed Sheba con trai of Bichri: but the men của Giu-đa clave unto their king, from Giô-đanh even to Giê-ru-sa-lem.
Và Đa-vít đến to his house at Giê-ru-sa-lem; và vua took the ten women his concubines, whom he had left to keep nhà, Và put them in ward, Và fed them, but went not in với họ. So they were shut up unto the day of their death, living in widowhood. ward: Heb. một căn nhà of ward shut…: Heb. bound living…: Heb. in widowhood của sự sống
Then nói vua to Amasa, Assemble me the men của Giu-đa within three ngày, Và be ngươi here present. Assemble: Heb. Call
So Amasa went to assemble the men of Giu-đa: but he tarried longer than the set time which he had appointed him. Assemble: Heb. Call
Và Đa-vít nói to Abishai, Now shall Sheba con trai of Bichri do us more harm than did Absalom: take ngươi thy lord's các đầy tớ, Và pursue after him, lest he get him fenced các thành, Và escape us. escape…: Heb. deliver himself from our eyes
Và there went out after him Joab's men, Và the Cherethites, Và the Pelethites, Và all the mighty men: Và they went out of Giê-ru-sa-lem, to pursue after Sheba con trai of Bichri.
When they were at the great stone which is in Gibeon, Amasa went before them. And Joab's garment that he had put on was girded unto him, and upon it a girdle với a thanh gươm fastened upon his loins in the sheath thereof; and as he went forth it fell out.
Và Joab nói to Amasa, Art ngươi in health, my brother? Và Joab took Amasa by the beard with the right tay to kiss him.
But Amasa took no heed to thanh gươm that was in Joab's tay: so he smote him therewith in the fifth rib, Và shed out his bowels to the ground, Và struck him not again; Và he died. So Joab Và Abishai his brother pursued after Sheba con trai of Bichri. struck…: Heb. doubled not his stroke
Và one of Joab's men đứng by him, and nói, He that favoureth Joab, and he that is for Đa-vít, let him go after Joab.
Và Amasa wallowed in blood in the midst of the highway. Và when the man nhìn thấy that all the people stood still, he removed Amasa out of the highway into the field, Và cast a cloth upon him, when he saw that every one that came by him stood still.
When he was removed out of the highway, tất cả mọi người went on after Joab, to pursue after Sheba con trai of Bichri.
Và he went through all the tribes của I-sơ-ra-ên unto Abel, Và to Beth–maachah, Và all the Berites: Và they were gathered together, Và went also after him.
Và they came Và besieged him in Abel of Beth–maachah, Và they cast up a bank against the city, Và it stood in the trench: Và all the people that were with Joab battered the wall, to throw it down. in the trench: or, against the outmost wall battered: Heb. marred to throw down
Then cried a wise woman out of the city, nghe, nghe; say, I pray you, unto Joab, Come near hither, that I may speak with ngươi.
Và when he was come near unto her, the woman nói, Art ngươi Joab? Và he trả lời, I am he. Then she nói unto him, Hear những lời of thine handmaid. Và he trả lời, I do hear.
Then she spake, nói [rằng], They were wont to speak in old time, nói [rằng], They shall surely ask counsel at Abel: Và so they ended the matter. They were…: or, They plainly spake in the beginning, saying, Surely they will ask of Abel, and so make an end
I am one of them that are peaceable Và trung tín in I-sơ-ra-ên: ngươi seekest to destroy a city Và a mother in I-sơ-ra-ên: why wilt ngươi swallow up the inheritance of the CHÚA?
Và Joab trả lời và nói, Far be it, far be it from me, that I should swallow up or destroy.
The matter is not so: but a man of mount Ép-ra-im, Sheba con trai of Bichri by name, hath lifted up his hand against the king, even against Đa-vít: deliver him only, and I will depart from the city. Và the woman nói unto Joab, kìa, his head shall be thrown to ngươi over the wall. by name: Heb. by his name
Then the woman went unto all the people in her wisdom. Và they cut off the head of Sheba con trai of Bichri, Và cast it out to Joab. Và he blew a trumpet, Và they retired from the city, every man to his tent. Và Joab returned to Giê-ru-sa-lem unto the king. retired: Heb. were scattered
Now Joab was over all the host của I-sơ-ra-ên: Và Benaiah con trai of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites Và over the Pelethites:
Và Adoram was over the tribute: Và Jehoshaphat con trai of Ahilud was recorder: recorder: or, remembrancer
Và Sheva was scribe: Và Zadok Và Abiathar were những thầy tế lễ:
Và Ira also the Jairite was a chief ruler about Đa-vít. a chief…: or, a prince

CHAPTER 21.
Then there was a famine trong những ngày của Đa-vít ba năm, năm after năm; Và Đa-vít enquired of the CHÚA. Và the CHÚA trả lời, It is for Sau-lơ, and for his bloody nhà, because he slew the Gibeonites. enquired…: Heb. sought mặt, etc
và vua called the Gibeonites, và nói với họ; (now the Gibeonites were not of the children của I-sơ-ra-ên, but of the remnant of the Amorites; Và the children của I-sơ-ra-ên had sworn với họ: and Sau-lơ sought to slay them in his zeal to the children của I-sơ-ra-ên Và Giu-đa.)
Wherefore Đa-vít nói unto the Gibeonites, What shall I do for you? and wherewith shall I make the atonement, that ye may bless the inheritance of the CHÚA?
Và the Gibeonites nói unto him, We will have no silver nor gold of Sau-lơ, nor of his house; neither for us shalt ngươi kill any man in I-sơ-ra-ên. Và he nói, What ngươi sẽ say, that will I do for you. We will…: or, It is not silver nor gold that we have to do with Sau-lơ or his house, neither pertains it to us to kill, etc
Và Họ trả lời vua, The man that consumed us, and that devised against us that we should be destroyed from remaining in any of the coasts của I-sơ-ra-ên,devised…: or, cut us off
Let bảy men of his sons be delivered unto us, and we will hang them up unto the CHÚA in Gibeah of Sau-lơ, whom the CHÚA did choose. và vua nói, I will give họ. whom…: or, chosen of the CHÚA
But the king spared Mephibosheth, con trai của Giô-nathan con trai of Sau-lơ, vì cớ the Lord's oath that was between them, between Đa-vít Và Jonathan con trai of Sau-lơ.
But the king took the two sons of Rizpah con gái of Aiah, whom she bare unto Sau-lơ, Armoni Và Mephibosheth; Và the five sons of Michal con gái of Sau-lơ, whom she brought up for Adriel con trai of Barzillai the Meholathite: Michal: or, Michal's sister brought…: Heb. bear to Adriel
Và he delivered them into tays of the Gibeonites, Và they hanged them in the hill before the CHÚA: Và they fell all bảy together, Và were put to death trong những ngày of harvest, in the first ngày, in the beginning of barley harvest.
Và Rizpah con gái of Aiah took vải bố, Và spread it for her upon the rock, từ ban đầu of harvest until water dropped upon them out of heaven, Và suffered neither the birds trên trời to rest on them by day, nor the beasts of the field by night.
Và it was told Đa-vít what Rizpah con gái of Aiah, the concubine of Sau-lơ, had done.
Và Đa-vít went Và took the bones of Sau-lơ Và the bones của Giô-nathan his son from the men of Jabesh–gilead, which had stolen them from the street of Beth–shan, where the Philistines had hanged them, when the Philistines had slain Sau-lơ in Gilboa:
Và he brought up from thence the bones of Sau-lơ Và the bones của Giô-nathan his son; Và they gathered the bones of them that were hanged.
Và the bones of Sau-lơ Và Jonathan his son buried they in the country of Bên-gia-min in Zelah, in phần mộ of Kish his father: Và they performed all that the king truyền lệnh. Và after that God was intreated for the land.
Moreover the Philistines had yet war again with I-sơ-ra-ên; Và Đa-vít đi xuống, Và his servants with him, and fought against the Philistines: Và Đa-vít waxed faint.
Và Ishbi–benob, which was của các con of the giant, the weight of whose spear weighed ba trăm shekels of brass in weight, he being girded with a new thanh gươm, thought to have slain Đa-vít. the giant: or, Rapha spear: Heb. the staff, or, the head
But Abishai con trai of Zeruiah succoured him, and smote the Philistine, Và killed him. Then the men của Đa-vít sware unto him, saying, ngươi shalt go no more out with us to battle, that ngươi quench not the light của I-sơ-ra-ên. light: Heb. candle, or, lamp
Và xảy đến after this, that there was again a battle with the Philistines at Gob: then Sibbechai the Hushathite giết Saph, which was của các con of the giant. the giant: or, Rapha Saph: or, Sippai
Và there was again a battle in Gob with the Philistines, where Elhanan con trai of Jaare–oregim, a Bết-lê-hemite, giết the brother of Goliath the Gittite, the staff of whose spear was like a weaver's beam. Jaare–oregim: or, Jair
Và there was yet a battle in Gath, where was a man of great stature, that had on every hand sáu fingers, Và on every foot sáu toes, bốn Và hai mươi in number; Và he also was born to the giant. the giant: or, Rapha
Và when he defied I-sơ-ra-ên, Jonathan con trai of Shimea the brother của Đa-vít giết him. defied: or, reproached Shimea: also called, Shammah
These four were born to the giant in Gath, Và fell by tay của Đa-vít, Và by tay of his servants.

CHAPTER 22.
Và Đa-vít nói unto the CHÚA những lời of this song trong ngày that the CHÚA had delivered him out of tay of all his enemies, Và out of tay of Sau-lơ:
Và he nói, The CHÚA is my rock, Và my fortress, Và my deliverer;
The God of my rock; in him will I trust: he is my shield, Và the horn of my salvation, my high tower, Và my refuge, my saviour; ngươi savest me from violence.
I will call on the CHÚA, who is worthy to be praised: so shall I được cứu from mine enemies.
When the waves of death compassed me, the floods of ungodly men made me afraid; waves: or, pangs ungodly…: Heb. Belial
The sorrows of hell compassed me about; the snares of death prevented me;sorrows: or, cords
In my distress I called upon the CHÚA, Và cried to my God: Và he did hear my voice out of his temple, Và my cry did enter into his ears.
Then đất shook Và trembled; the foundations of heaven moved Và shook, because he nổi giận.
There went up a smoke out of his nostrils, Và fire out of his mouth devoured: coals were kindled by it. out of his nostrils: Heb. by, etc
He bowed các tầng trời also, and came down; Và darkness was under his feet.
Và he rode upon a cherub, Và did fly: Và he was seen upon the wings of the wind.
Và he made tối tăm pavilions round about him, dark waters, Và thick clouds of the skies. dark…: Heb. binding of waters
Through the brightness before him were coals lửa kindled.
The CHÚA thundered from heaven, Và the most High uttered his voice.
Và he sent out arrows, Và scattered them; lightning, Và discomfited them.
Và the channels of biển appeared, the foundations of the world were discovered, at the rebuking of the CHÚA, at the blast of the breath of his nostrils.
He sent from above, he took me; he drew me out of many waters; many: or, great
He delivered me from my strong kẻ thù, Và from them that hated me: for they were too strong for me.
They prevented me trong ngày of my calamity: but the CHÚA was my stay.
He brought me forth also into a large place: he delivered me, because he delighted in me.
The CHÚA rewarded me according to my righteousness: according to the cleanness of my hands hath he recompensed me.
For I have kept the ways of the CHÚA, Và have not wickedly departed from my God.
For all his judgments were before me: and as for his statutes, I did not depart from them.
I was also upright before him, and have kept myself from mine iniquity. before: Heb. to
Therefore the CHÚA hath recompensed me according to my righteousness; according to my cleanness in his eye sight. in…: Heb. before his eyes
With the merciful ngươi wilt shew thyself merciful, Và with the upright man ngươi wilt shew thyself upright.
With the pure ngươi wilt shew thyself pure; Và with the froward ngươi wilt shew thyself unsavoury. shew thyself unsavoury: or, wrestle
Và the afflicted people ngươi wilt save: but thine eyes are upon the haughty, that ngươi mayest bring họ down.
For thou art my lamp, O CHÚA: Và the CHÚA will lighten my darkness. lamp: or, candle
For by ngươi I have run through a troop: by my God have I leaped over a wall. run: or, broken
As for ĐCT, his way is trọn vẹn; lời of the CHÚA is tried: he is a buckler to all them that trust in him. tried: or, refined
For who is ĐCT, save the CHÚA? and who is a rock, save ĐCT chúng tôi?
ĐCT is my strength Và power: Và he maketh my way trọn vẹn. maketh: Heb. riddeth, or, looseth
He maketh my feet like hinds' chân: Và setteth me upon my high places. maketh: Heb. equalleth
He teacheth my hands to war; so that a bow of steel is broken by mine arms. to war: Heb. for the war
ngươi hast also given me the shield of sự cứu rỗi của Ngài: Và thy gentleness hath made me great. made…: Heb. multiplied me
ngươi hast enlarged my steps under me; so that my feet did not slip. feet: Heb. ankles
I have pursued mine enemies, Và destroyed them; and turned not again until I had consumed them.
Và I have consumed them, and wounded them, that they could not arise: yea, they are fallen under my feet.
For ngươi hast girded me with strength to battle: them that rose up against me hast ngươi subdued under me. subdued: Heb. caused to bow
ngươi hast also given me the necks of mine enemies, that I might destroy them that hate me.
They looked, but there was none to save; even unto the CHÚA, but he trả lời them not.
Then did I beat them as small as the dust đất, I did stamp them as the mire of the street, Và did spread them abroad.
ngươi also hast delivered me from the strivings of my people, ngươi hast kept me to be đầu of the heathen: a people which I knew not shall serve me.
Strangers shall submit themselves unto me: as soon as they hear, they shall be obedient unto me. Strangers: Heb. Sons of the stranger submit…: or, yield feigned obedience: Heb. lie
Strangers shall fade away, Và they shall be afraid out of their close places.
The CHÚA liveth; Và blessed be my rock; Và exalted be ĐCT of the rock of my salvation.
It is ĐCT that avengeth me, and that bringeth down the people under me,avengeth: Heb. giveth avengement for
Và that bringeth me forth from mine enemies: ngươi also hast lifted me up on high above them that rose up against me: ngươi hast delivered me from the violent man.
Therefore I will give thanks unto ngươi, O CHÚA, among the heathen, Và I will sing praises unto Danh Ngài.
He is the tower của sự cứu rỗi for his king: Và sheweth mercy to his anointed, unto Đa-vít, Và to his seed for evermore.

CHAPTER 23.
Now these be cuối cùng những lời của Đa-vít. Đa-vít con trai của Gie-sê nói, Và the man who was raised up on high, the anointed of ĐCT of Gia-cốp, Và the sweet psalmist của I-sơ-ra-ên, nói,
The Spirit of the CHÚA nói by me, and his word was in my tongue.
The God của I-sơ-ra-ên nói, the Rock của I-sơ-ra-ên nói to me, He that ruleth over men must be just, ruling in the fear của ĐCT. He…: or, Be ngươi ruler, etc
Và he shall be as the light of buổi sáng, khi mặt trời riseth, even a morning without clouds; as the tender grass springing out đất by clear shining after rain.
Although my house be not so with God; yet he hath made with me an đời đời covenant, ordered in all things, Và sure: for this is all my salvation, and all my desire, although he make it not to grow.
But the sons of Belial shall be all of them as thorns thrust away, because they cannot be taken with hands:
But the man that shall touch them must be fenced with sắt Và the staff of a spear; Và they shall be utterly burned bằng lửa in the same place. fenced: Heb. filled
These be tên of the mighty men whom Đa-vít had: The Tachmonite that sat in biểnt, chief among the captains; the same was Adino the Eznite: he lift up his spear against eight trăm, whom he slew at one time. The Tachmonite…: or, Joshebbassebet the Tachmonite, head of the three whom he…: Heb. slain 1ch 11:11 he lift…: from whom he…: Heb. slain
Và after him was Eleazar con trai of Dodo the Ahohite, one of the three mighty men with Đa-vít, when they defied the Philistines that were there gathered together to battle, Và the men của I-sơ-ra-ên were gone away:
He arose, Và smote the Philistines until his hand was weary, Và his hand clave unto thanh gươm: Và the CHÚA wrought a great victory that day; Và the people returned after him only to spoil.
Và after him was Shammah con trai of Agee the Hararite. Và the Philistines were gathered together into a troop, where was a piece of ground full of lentiles: Và the people fled từ the Philistines. into…: or, for foraging
But he stood in the midst of the ground, Và defended it, and slew the Philistines: Và the CHÚA wrought a great victory.
Và three of the ba mươi chief đi xuống, Và came to Đa-vít in mùa gặt time unto the cave of Adullam: Và the troop of the Philistines pitched in the valley of Rephaim. three…: or, the three captains over the ba mươi
Và Đa-vít was then in an hold, Và the garrison of the Philistines was then trong Bết-lê-hem.
Và Đa-vít longed, và nói, Oh that one would give me drink of the water of the well of Bết-lê-hem, which is by cổng!
Và the three mighty men brake through the host of the Philistines, Và drew nước out of the well of Bết-lê-hem, that was by cổng, Và took it, Và brought it to Đa-vít: nevertheless he would not drink thereof, but poured it out unto the CHÚA.
Và he nói, Be it far from me, O CHÚA, that I should do this: is not this the blood of the men that went in jeopardy of their lives? therefore he would not drink it. These things did these three mighty men.
Và Abishai, the brother of Joab, con trai of Zeruiah, was chief among three. Và he lifted up his spear against three trăm, Và giết họ, Và had Tên among three. Và slew them: Heb. slain
Was he not most honourable of three? therefore he was their captain: howbeit he attained not unto the first ba.
Và Benaiah con trai of Jehoiada, con trai of a valiant man, of Kabzeel, who had done many acts, he slew hai lionlike men of Mô-áp: he went down also and slew a lion in the midst of a pit in time of snow: who…: Heb. great of acts lionlike…: Heb. lion của ĐCT
Và he slew an Ai-Cậpian, a goodly man: Và the Ai-Cậpian had a spear in his hand; but he went down to him with a staff, Và plucked the spear out of the Ai-Cậpian's tay, Và slew him with his own spear. a goodly…: Heb. a man of countenance, or, sight: also called, a man of great stature
These things did Benaiah con trai of Jehoiada, Và had Tên among three mighty men.
He was more honourable than the ba mươi, but he attained not to the first ba. Và Đa-vít set him over his guard. more…: or, honourable among the ba mươi guard: or, council: Heb. at his command
Asahel the brother of Joab was one of the ba mươi; Elhanan con trai of Dodo of Bết-lê-hem,
Shammah the Harodite, Elika the Harodite,
Helez the Paltite, Ira con trai of Ikkesh the Tekoite,
Abiezer the Anethothite, Mebunnai the Hushathite,
Zalmon the Ahohite, Maharai the Netophathite,
Heleb con trai of Baanah, a Netophathite, Ittai con trai of Ribai out of Gibeah of the children of Bên-gia-min,
Benaiah the Pirathonite, Hiddai of the brooks of Gaash,brooks: or, valleys
Abi–albon the Arbathite, Azmaveth the Barhumite,
Eliahba the Shaalbonite, của các con of Jashen, Jonathan,
Shammah the Hararite, Ahiam con trai of Sharar the Hararite,
Eliphelet con trai of Ahasbai, con trai of the Maachathite, Eliam con trai of Ahithophel the Gilonite,
Hezrai the Carmelite, Paarai the Arbite,
Igal con trai of Nathan of Zobah, Bani the Gadite,
Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Beerothite, armourbearer to Joab con trai of Zeruiah,
Ira an Ithrite, Gareb an Ithrite,
Uriah the Hittite: ba mươi Và bảy in all.

CHAPTER 24.
Và again the anger of the CHÚA was kindled against I-sơ-ra-ên, Và he moved Đa-vít against them to say, đi, number I-sơ-ra-ên Và Giu-đa.
For the king nói to Joab the captain of the host, which was with him, Go now through all the tribes của I-sơ-ra-ên, from Dan even to Beer–sheba, Và number ye the people, that I may know the number của dân sự. Go: or, Compass
Và Joab nói unto the king, Now the CHÚA thy God add unto the people, how many soever they be, an hundredfold, Và that the eyes of my lord vua may see it: but why doth my lord vua delight in this thing?
Notwithstanding the king's word prevailed against Joab, Và against the captains of the host. Và Joab Và the captains of the host went out from the presence of the king, to number the people của I-sơ-ra-ên.
Và they passed over Giô-đanh, Và pitched in Aroer, on the right side of the city that lieth in the midst of the river of Gad, Và toward Jazer: river: or, valley
Then they came to Gilead, Và to the land of Tahtim–hodshi; Và they came to Dan–jaan, Và about to Zidon,land of Tahtim–hodshi: or, nether land newly inhabited
Và came to the strong hold of Ti-rơ, Và to all the cities of the Hivites, Và của người Ca-na-an: Và they went out to the south của Giu-đa, even to Beer–sheba.
So when they had gone through all the land, they came to Giê-ru-sa-lem at the end of nine months Và hai mươi ngày.
Và Joab gave up the sum of the number của dân sự unto the king: Và there were in I-sơ-ra-ên tám trăm ngàn valiant men that drew thanh gươm; Và the men của Giu-đa were năm trăm ngàn men.
Và Đa-vít's heart smote him after that he had numbered the people. Và Đa-vít nói unto the CHÚA, I have sinned greatly in that I have done: Và now, tôi nài khuyên ngươi, O CHÚA, take away the iniquity of thy servant; for I have done very foolishly.
For when Đa-vít was up in buổi sáng, lời of the CHÚA came unto the prophet Gad, Đa-vít's seer, nói [rằng],
đi Và say unto Đa-vít, Thus nói the CHÚA, I offer ngươi three things; choose ngươi one of them, that I may do it cho ngươi.
So Gad đến to Đa-vít, Và told him, and nói unto him, Shall bảy năm of famine đến unto ngươi in thy land? or wilt ngươi flee ba months before thine enemies, while they pursue ngươi? or that there be three days' pestilence in thy land? now advise, Và see what answer I shall return to him that sent me.
Và Đa-vít nói unto Gad, I am in a great strait: let us fall now into tay of the CHÚA; for his mercies are great: Và let me not fall into tay of man. are great: or, are many
So the CHÚA sent a pestilence upon I-sơ-ra-ên from buổi sáng even to the time appointed: Và there died của dân sự from Dan even to Beer–sheba bảy mươi ngàn men.
Và when thiên sứ stretched out his hand upon Giê-ru-sa-lem to destroy it, the CHÚA repented him of the evil, và nói to thiên sứ that destroyed the people, It is enough: stay now thine hand. Và thiên sứ of the CHÚA was by the threshingplace of Araunah the Jebusite. Araunah: also called, Ornan
Và Đa-vít nói unto the CHÚA when he saw thiên sứ that smote the people, và nói, Lo, I have sinned, Và I have done wickedly: but these sheep, what have they done? let thine hand, I pray ngươi, be against me, and against my father's nhà.
Và Gad đến that day to Đa-vít, và nói unto him, Go up, rear an altar unto the CHÚA in the threshingfloor of Araunah the Jebusite. Araunah: Heb. Araniah
Và Đa-vít, according to the saying of Gad, đi lên as the CHÚA truyền lệnh.
Và Araunah looked, Và saw vua Và his servants coming on toward him: and Araunah went out, Và bowed himself before the king on his face upon the ground.
Và Araunah nói, Wherefore is my lord vua đến to his servant? Và Đa-vít nói, To buy the threshingfloor of ngươi, to build an altar unto the CHÚA, that the plague may be stayed from the people.
Và Araunah nói unto Đa-vít, Let my lord vua take Và offer up what seemeth tốt unto him: kìa, here be oxen for burnt sacrifice, Và threshing instruments and other instruments of the oxen for wood.
All these things did Araunah, as a king, give unto the king. Và Araunah nói unto the king, The CHÚA thy God accept ngươi.
và vua nói unto Araunah, Nay; but I will surely buy it of ngươi at a price: neither will I offer burnt offerings unto the CHÚA my God of that which doth cost me nothing. So Đa-vít bought the threshingfloor Và the oxen for fifty shekels of silver.
Và Đa-vít built there an altar unto the CHÚA, Và offered burnt offerings Và peace offerings. So the CHÚA was intreated for the land, Và the plague was stayed from I-sơ-ra-ên.

div.title: THE FIRST BOOK OF THE KINGS COMMONLY CALLED THE THIRD BOOK OF các vua
div.chapter:
CHAPTER 1.
Now king Đa-vít was old Và stricken in years; Và they covered him with clothes, but he gat no heat. stricken…: Heb. entered into days
Wherefore his servants nói unto him, Let there be sought for my lord vua a young virgin: Và let her stand before vua, Và let her cherish him, and let her lie in thy bosom, that my lord vua may get heat. Let there…: Heb. Let them seek a young…: Heb. a damsel, một trinh nữ cherish…: Heb. be a cherisher unto him
So they sought for a fair damsel throughout all the coasts của I-sơ-ra-ên, Và found Abishag a Shunammite, Và brought her to the king.
Và the damsel was very fair, Và cherished vua, Và ministered to him: but the king knew her not.
Then Adonijah con trai of Haggith được tôn cao himself, saying, I will be king: Và he prepared him chariots Và horsemen, Và fifty men to run before him. be king: Heb. reign
Và his father had not displeased him at any time in saying, Tại sao hast ngươi done so? and he also was a very goodly man; and his mother bare him after Absalom. at any…: Heb. from his days
