I even weighed unto their hand sáu trăm Và fifty ta-lâng of silver, và bạc vessels một trăm ta-lâng, Và of gold một trăm ta-lâng;
Also hai mươi basons of gold, of a thousand drams; Và two vessels of fine copper, precious as gold. fine…: Heb. yellow, or, shining brass precious: Heb. desirable
Và tôi nói với họ, Ye are thánh unto the CHÚA; the vessels are thánh also; and the silver Và the gold are a freewill offering unto the CHÚA ĐCT of your fathers.
Watch ye, and keep họ, until ye weigh họ before the chief of the priests Và the Levites, Và chief of chas của I-sơ-ra-ên, at Giê-ru-sa-lem, in the chambers của nhà of the CHÚA.
So took những thầy tế lễ Và the Levites the weight of the silver, Và the gold, Và the vessels, to bring họ to Giê-ru-sa-lem unđến nhà of our God.
Then we departed from the river of Ahava on the twelfth ngày of the first month, to go unto Giê-ru-sa-lem: Và tay of our God was upon us, and he delivered us from tay of the enemy, Và of such as lay in wait by the way.
Và we came to Giê-ru-sa-lem, Và abode there three ngày.
Now on the fourth ngày was the silver Và the gold Và the vessels weighed in nhà of our God by tay of Meremoth con trai of Uriah thầy tế lễ; and with him was Eleazar con trai of Phinehas; and with them was Jozabad con trai of Jeshua, Và Noadiah con trai of Binnui, người Lê-vi;
By number Và by weight of every one: and all the weight was written at that time.
Also con cái of those that had been carried away, which were come out of the captivity, offered burnt offerings unto ĐCT của I-sơ-ra-ên, mười hai bullocks for all I-sơ-ra-ên, ninety Và six rams, bảy mươi Và bảy lambs, mười hai he goats for a sin offering: all this was a burnt offering unto the CHÚA.
Và they delivered the king's commissions unto the king's lieutenants, Và to the governors on this side the river: Và they furthered the people, Và nhà của ĐCT.

CHAPTER 9.
Now when these things were done, the princes đến to me, saying, The people của I-sơ-ra-ên, Và the priests, Và the Levites, have not separated themselves from the people of the lands, doing according to their abominations, even của người Ca-na-an, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Jebusites, the Ammonites, the Mô-ápites, người Ê-díp-tô, Và the Amorites.
For they have taken of their daughters for themselves, and for their sons: so that the holy hạt giống have mingled themselves with the people of those lands: yea, tay of the princes Và rulers hath been chief in this trespass.
Và when I heard this thing, I rent my garment Và my mantle, Và plucked off the hair of my head Và of my beard, Và ngồi xuống astonied.
Then were assembled unto me every one that trembled at the words of ĐCT của I-sơ-ra-ên, vì cớ the transgression of those that had been carried away; Và I sat astonied until buổi chiều sacrifice.
Và at buổi chiều sacrifice I arose up from my heaviness; Và having rent my garment Và my mantle, I fell upon my knees, Và spread out my hands unto the CHÚA my God,heaviness: or, affliction
và nói, Hỡi ĐCT tôi, I am ashamed Và blush to lift up my face to ngươi, my God: for our iniquities are increased over our đầu, Và our trespass is grown up unto the heavens. trespass: or, guiltiness
Since the days of our fathers have we been in a great trespass unto this day; Và for our iniquities have we, our kings, Và our priests, been delivered into tay of các vua of the lands, to thanh gươm, to captivity, Và to a spoil, Và to confusion of face, as it is this day.
Và now for a little space ân-điển hath been đã bày tỏ from the CHÚA ĐCT chúng tôi, to leave us a remnant to escape, Và để cho us a nail in his holy place, that our God may lighten our eyes, Và give us a little reviving in our bondage. space: Heb. moment a nail: or, a pin: that is, a constant and sure abode
For we were bondmen; yet our God hath not forsaken us in our bondage, but hath extended mercy unto us in the sight of các vua of Persia, để cho us a reviving, to set up nhà of our God, Và to repair the desolations thereof, and để cho us a wall in Giu-đa Và in Giê-ru-sa-lem. to repair: Heb. to set up
Và now, O our God, what shall we say after this? for we have forsaken thy commandments,
Which ngươi hast commanded by thy servants các tiên tri, nói [rằng], The land, unto which ye go to possess it, is an unclean land with the filthiness của dân sự of the lands, with their abominations, which have filled it from one end to another with their ô uế. by: Heb. by tay of from…: Heb. from mouth to mouth
Now therefore give not your daughters unto their sons, neither take their daughters cùng các ngươir sons, nor seek their peace or their wealth for ever: that ye may be strong, Và eat the good of the land, and leave it for một cơ nghiệp to your children đến đời đời.
Và after all that is come upon us for our evil deeds, Và for our great trespass, seeing that ngươi our God hast punished us less than our iniquities deserve, Và hast given us such deliverance as this;hast punished…: Heb. hast withheld beneath our iniquities
Should we again break thy commandments, Và join in affinity with the people of these abominations? wouldest not ngươi be angry with us till ngươi hadst consumed us, so that there should be no remnant nor escaping?
O CHÚA ĐCT của I-sơ-ra-ên, thou art công chính: for we remain yet escaped, as it is this day: kìa, we are before ngươi in our trespasses: for we cannot stand before ngươi vì cớ this.

CHAPTER 10.
Now when Ezra had cầu nguyện, Và when he had confessed, khóc lóc Và casting himself down before nhà của ĐCT, there assembled unto him out của I-sơ-ra-ên a very great congregation of men Và women Và children: for the people khóc very sore. khóc…: Heb. khóc a great weeping
Và Shechaniah con trai of Jehiel, one của các con of Elam, trả lời và nói unto Ezra, We have trespassed against our God, Và have taken strange wives của dân sự of the land: yet now there is hy vọng in I-sơ-ra-ên concerning this thing.
Now therefore let us make a covenant with our God to put away all the wives, Và such as are born of them, according to the counsel of my lord, Và of those that tremble at the commandment of our God; Và let it be done according luật pháp. to put…: Heb. to bring forth
Hãy chổi dậy; for này matter belongeth unto ngươi: we also will be with ngươi: be of good courage, Và do it.
Then arose Ezra, Và made the chief priests, the Levites, Và all I-sơ-ra-ên, to swear that they should do according to this word. Và they sware.
Then Ezra rose up from before nhà của ĐCT, Và went into the chamber of Johanan con trai of Eliashib: and khi he came thither, he did eat no bread, nor drink nước: for he mourned vì cớ the transgression of them that had been carried away.
Và they made proclamation throughout Giu-đa Và Giê-ru-sa-lem unto all the children of the captivity, that they should gather themselves together unto Giê-ru-sa-lem;
Và that whosoever would not come within three ngày, according to the counsel of the princes Và các trưởng lão, all his substance should be forfeited, Và himself separated from the congregation of those that had been carried away. forfeited: Heb. devoted
Then all the men của Giu-đa Và Bên-gia-min gathered themselves together unto Giê-ru-sa-lem within three ngày. It was thứ chín month, on the twentieth ngày của tháng; Và all the people sat in the street của nhà của ĐCT, trembling vì cớ này matter, Và for the great rain. the great…: Heb. the showers
Và Ezra thầy tế lễ stood up, và nói với họ, Ye have transgressed, Và have taken strange wives, to increase the trespass của I-sơ-ra-ên. have taken: Heb. have caused to ở, or, have brought back
Now therefore make confession unto the CHÚA ĐCT of your fathers, Và do his pleasure: Và separate yourselves from the people of the land, Và from the strange wives.
Then all the congregation trả lời và nói with a loud tiếng, As ngươi hast nói, so must we do.
Nhưng the people are many, and it is a time of much rain, Và we are not able to stand without, neither is this a work of one ngày or two: for we are many that have transgressed in this thing. we are many…: or, we have greatly offended in this thing
Let now our rulers of all the congregation stand, Và let all them which have taken strange wives in our cities đến at appointed times, Và with them các trưởng lão of every city, Và the judges thereof, until the fierce wrath of our God for this matter be turned from us. for this…: or, till this matter be dispatched
Only Jonathan con trai of Asahel Và Jahaziah con trai of Tikvah were employed about this matter: Và Meshullam Và Shabbethai the Levite helped them. were…: Heb. stood
Và the children of the captivity did so. Và Ezra thầy tế lễ, với certain chief of chas, after nhà of their fathers, and all of them by their names, were separated, Và ngồi xuống in the first ngày of the tenth month to examine the matter.
Và they made an end with all the men that had taken strange wives by the first ngày of the first month.
Và among the sons of the priests there were found that had taken strange wives: namely, của các con of Jeshua con trai of Jozadak, Và anh em người; Maaseiah, Và Eliezer, Và Jarib, Và Gedaliah.
Và they gave their hands that they would put away their wives; and being guilty, they offered a ram of the flock for their trespass.
Và của Cons of Immer; Hanani, Và Zebadiah.
Và của Cons of Harim; Maaseiah, Và Elijah, Và Shemaiah, Và Jehiel, Và Uzziah.
Và của Cons of Pashur; Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ích-ma-ên, Nethaneel, Jozabad, Và Elasah.
Also of the Levites; Jozabad, Và Shimei, Và Kelaiah, (the same is Kelita,) Pethahiah, Giu-đa, Và Eliezer.
Of the singers also; Eliashib: Và of the porters; Shallum, Và Telem, Và Uri.
Moreover của I-sơ-ra-ên: của các con of Parosh; Ramiah, Và Jeziah, Và Malchiah, Và Miamin, Và Eleazar, Và Malchijah, Và Benaiah.
Và của Cons of Elam; Mattaniah, Zechariah, Và Jehiel, Và Abdi, Và Jeremoth, Và Eliah.
Và của Cons of Zattu; Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, Và Jeremoth, Và Zabad, Và Aziza.
của các con also of Bebai; Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai, Và Athlai.
Và của Cons of Bani; Meshullam, Malluch, Và Adaiah, Jashub, Và Sheal, Và Ramoth.
Và của Cons of Pahath–moab; Adna, Và Chelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezaleel, Và Binnui, Và Manasseh.
Và of the sons of Harim; Eliezer, Ishijah, Malchiah, Shemaiah, Shimeon,
Bên-gia-min, Malluch, Và Shemariah.
của các con of Hashum; Mattenai, Mattathah, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jeremai, Manasseh, Và Shimei.
của các con of Bani; Maadai, Amram, Và Uel,
Benaiah, Bedeiah, Chelluh,
Vaniah, Meremoth, Eliashib,
Mattaniah, Mattenai, Và Jaasau,
Và Bani, Và Binnui, Shimei,
Và Shelemiah, Và Nathan, Và Adaiah,
Machnadebai, Shashai, Sharai,Machnadebai: or, Mabnadebai, according to some copies
Azareel, Và Shelemiah, Shemariah,
Shallum, Amariah, Và Giô-sép.
của các con of Nebo; Jeiel, Mattithiah, Zabad, Zebina, Jadau, Và Joel, Benaiah.
All these had taken strange wives: and some of them had wives by whom they had children.

div.title: THE BOOK OF NEHEMIAH
div.chapter:
CHAPTER 1.
những lời of Nehemiah con trai of Hachaliah. Và xảy đến in the month Chisleu, in the twentieth năm, as I was in Shushan the palace,
That Hanani, một of my brethren, đến, he and certain men của Giu-đa; Và I asked them concerning the Jews that had escaped, which were left of the captivity, Và concerning Giê-ru-sa-lem.
Và họ nói unto me, The remnant that are left of the captivity there in the province are in great affliction Và reproach: the wall of Giê-ru-sa-lem also is broken down, Và the gates thereof are burned bằng lửa.
Và xảy đến, when I heard these words, that I ngồi xuống Và khóc, Và mourned certain ngày, Và fasted, Và cầu nguyện before ĐCT of heaven,
và nói, tôi nài khuyên ngươi, O CHÚA ĐCT of heaven, the great Và terrible ĐCT, that keepeth covenant Và mercy for them that love him and observe his commandments:
Let thine ear now be attentive, Và thine eyes open, that ngươi mayest hear the prayer of thy servant, which I pray before ngươi now, ngày Và night, for the children của I-sơ-ra-ên thy servants, Và confess the tội lỗi of the children của I-sơ-ra-ên, which we have sinned against ngươi: both I and my father's nhà have sinned.
We have dealt very corruptly against ngươi, and have not kept the commandments, nor the statutes, nor the judgments, which ngươi commandedst thy servant Môi-se.
nhớ, tôi nài khuyên ngươi, the word that ngươi commandedst thy servant Môi-se, nói [rằng], nếu ye transgress, I will scatter you abroad among the nations:
But nếu ye turn unto me, and keep my commandments, Và do them; though there were of you cast out unto the uttermost part of the heaven, yet will I gather them from thence, and will bring them unto the place that I have chosen to set my name there.
Now these are thy servants Và thy people, whom ngươi hast redeemed by thy great power, Và by thy strong tay.
O Lord, tôi nài khuyên ngươi, let now thine ear be attentive to the prayer of thy servant, Và to the prayer of thy servants, who desire to fear Danh Ngài: Và prosper, I pray ngươi, thy servant this day, Và grant him mercy in the sight of this man. For I was the king's cupbearer.

CHAPTER 2.
Và xảy đến in the month Nisan, in the twentieth năm of Artaxerxes vua, that rượu nho was before him: and I took up the wine, Và gave it unto the king. Now I had not been beforetime sad in his presence.
Wherefore the king nói unto me, Tại sao is thy countenance sad, seeing thou art not sick? this is nothing else but sorrow of heart. Then I was very sore afraid,
và nói unto the king, Let the king live đến đời đời: why should not my countenance be sad, when the city, the place of my fathers' sepulchres, lieth waste, Và the gates thereof are consumed bằng lửa?
Then the king nói unto me, For what dost ngươi make request? So I cầu nguyện to ĐCT of heaven.
Và tôi nói unto the king, If it please vua, Và if thy servant have found favour in thy sight, that ngươi wouldest send me unto Giu-đa, unto the city of my fathers' sepulchres, that I may build it.
và vua nói unto me, (Nữ hoàng also sitting by him,) For how long shall thy journey be? and when wilt ngươi return? So it pleased vua to send me; and I set him a time. queen: Heb. wife
Moreover tôi nói unto the king, If it please vua, let letters be given me to the governors bên kia the river, that they may convey me over till I come into Giu-đa;
Và a letter unto A-sáp the keeper of the king's forest, that he may give me timber to make beams for the gates of the palace which appertained đến nhà, Và for the wall of the city, Và for nhà that I shall enter into. và vua granted me, according to the good tay of my God upon me.
Then I came to the governors bên kia the river, Và gave them the king's letters. Now the king had sent captains of the army Và horsemen with me.
When Sanballat the Horonite, Và Tobiah the servant, the Ammonite, nghe of it, it grieved them exceedingly that there was come một người to seek the welfare of the children của I-sơ-ra-ên.
So I came to Giê-ru-sa-lem, Và was there three ngày.
Và I arose in the night, I and some few men with me; neither told I any man what my God had put in my heart to do at Giê-ru-sa-lem: neither was there any beast with me, save the beast that I rode upon.
Và I went out by night by cổng of the valley, even before the dragon well, Và to the dung port, Và viewed the walls of Giê-ru-sa-lem, which were broken down, Và the gates thereof were consumed bằng lửa.
Then I went on to cổng of the fountain, Và to the king's pool: but there was no place for the beast that was under me to pass.
Then went I up in the night by the brook, Và viewed the wall, Và turned back, Và entered by cổng of the valley, and so returned.
Và the rulers knew not whither I went, or what I did; neither had I as yet told it to the Jews, nor to the priests, nor to the nobles, nor to the rulers, nor to the rest that did the work.
Then nói I với họ, Ye see the distress that we are in, how Giê-ru-sa-lem lieth waste, Và the gates thereof are burned bằng lửa: đến, Và let us build up the wall of Giê-ru-sa-lem, that we be no more a reproach.
Then I told them of tay of my God which was good upon me; as also the king's những lời that he had spoken unto me. And họ nói, Let us rise up Và build. So they strengthened their hands for này tốt work.
But when Sanballat the Horonite, Và Tobiah the servant, the Ammonite, Và Geshem the Arabian, nghe it, they laughed us to scorn, Và despised us, and nói, What is this thing that ye do? will ye rebel against the king?
Then trả lời I them, and nói với họ, The God of heaven, he will prosper us; therefore we his servants will arise Và build: but ye have no portion, nor right, nor memorial, in Giê-ru-sa-lem.

CHAPTER 3.
Then Eliashib the high priest rose up with anh em người những thầy tế lễ, Và they builded the sheep gate; they sanctified it, and set up the doors of it; even unto the tower of Meah they sanctified it, unto the tower of Hananeel.
Và next unto him builded the men of Giê-ri-cô. Và next to them builded Zaccur con trai of Imri. next unto…: Heb. at his hand
But the fish gate did the sons of Hassenaah build, who also laid the beams thereof, and set up the doors thereof, the locks thereof, and the bars thereof.
Và next với họ repaired Meremoth con trai of Urijah, con trai of Koz. Và next với họ repaired Meshullam con trai of Berechiah, con trai of Meshezabeel. Và next với họ repaired Zadok con trai of Baana.
Và next với họ the Tekoites repaired; but their nobles put not their necks to the work of their Lord.
Moreover the old gate repaired Jehoiada con trai of Paseah, Và Meshullam con trai of Besodeiah; they laid the beams thereof, and set up the doors thereof, and the locks thereof, and the bars thereof.
Và next với họ repaired Melatiah the Gibeonite, Và Jadon the Meronothite, the men of Gibeon, Và of Mizpah, unto the throne of thống đốc on this side the river.
Next unto him repaired Uzziel con trai of Harhaiah, of the goldsmiths. Next unto him also repaired Hananiah con trai of one of the apothecaries, Và they fortified Giê-ru-sa-lem unto the broad wall. fortified…: or, left Giê-ru-sa-lem unto the broad wall
Và next với họ repaired Rephaiah con trai of Hur, the ruler of the half part of Giê-ru-sa-lem.
Và next với họ repaired Jedaiah con trai of Harumaph, even over against his house. Và next unto him repaired Hattush con trai of Hashabniah.
Malchijah con trai of Harim, Và Hashub con trai of Pahath–moab, repaired the other piece, Và the tower of the furnaces. other…: Heb. second measure
Và next unto him repaired Shallum con trai of Halohesh, the ruler of the half part of Giê-ru-sa-lem, he and his daughters.
The valley gate repaired Hanun, Và the inhabitants of Zanoah; they built it, and set up the doors thereof, the locks thereof, and the bars thereof, and a thousand cubits on the wall unto the dung gate.
But the dung gate repaired Malchiah con trai of Rechab, the ruler of part of Beth–haccerem; he built it, and set up the doors thereof, the locks thereof, and the bars thereof.
But cổng of the fountain repaired Shallun con trai of Col–hozeh, the ruler of part of Mizpah; he built it, and covered it, and set up the doors thereof, the locks thereof, and the bars thereof, and the wall of the pool of Siloah by the king's garden, Và unto the stairs that go down from the city của Đa-vít.
After him repaired Nehemiah con trai of Azbuk, the ruler of the half part of Beth–zur, unto the place over against phần mộs của Đa-vít, Và to the pool that was made, Và unđến nhà of the mighty.
After him repaired the Levites, Rehum con trai of Bani. Next unto him repaired Hashabiah, the ruler of the half part of Keilah, in his part.
After him repaired their brethren, Bavai con trai of Henadad, the ruler of the half part of Keilah.
Và next to him repaired Ezer con trai of Jeshua, the ruler of Mizpah, another piece over against the going up to the armoury at the turning of the wall.
After him Baruch con trai of Zabbai earnestly repaired the other piece, from the turning of the wall unto the door của nhà of Eliashib the high priest. Zabbai: also called, Zaccai
After him repaired Meremoth con trai of Urijah con trai of Koz another piece, from the door của nhà of Eliashib even to the end của nhà of Eliashib.
Và after him repaired những thầy tế lễ, the men of the plain.
After him repaired Bên-gia-min Và Hashub over against their house. After him repaired Azariah con trai of Maaseiah con trai of Ananiah by his house.
After him repaired Binnui con trai of Henadad another piece, from nhà of Azariah unto the turning of the wall, even unto the corner.
Palal con trai of Uzai, over against the turning of the wall, Và the tower which lieth out from the king's high nhà, that was by the court of the prison. After him Pedaiah con trai of Parosh.
Moreover the Nethinims dwelt in Ophel, unto the place over against the water gate toward the east, Và the tower that lieth out. dwelt…: or, which dwelt in Ophel, repaired unto Ophel: or, tower
After them the Tekoites repaired another piece, over against the great tower that lieth out, even unto the wall of Ophel.
From above the horse gate repaired những thầy tế lễ, every one đối diện his house.
After them repaired Zadok con trai of Immer over against his house. After him repaired also Shemaiah con trai of Shechaniah, the keeper of the east gate.
After him repaired Hananiah con trai of Shelemiah, Và Hanun thứ sáu son of Zalaph, another piece. After him repaired Meshullam con trai of Berechiah over against his chamber.
After him repaired Malchiah the goldsmith's son unto the place of the Nethinims, Và of the merchants, over against cổng Miphkad, Và to the going up of the corner. going…: or, corner chamber
Và between the going up of the corner unto the sheep gate repaired the goldsmiths Và the merchants. going…: or, corner chamber

CHAPTER 4.
But xảy đến, that when Sanballat nghe that we builded the wall, he nổi giận, Và took great indignation, Và mocked những người Do Thái.
Và he spake before anh em người Và the army of Sa-ma-ri, và nói, What do these feeble Jews? will they fortify themselves? will they sacrifice? will they make an end in a day? will they revive the stones out of the heaps of the rubbish which are burned? fortify…: Heb. leave to themselves
Now Tobiah the Ammonite was by him, Và he nói, Even that which they build, if a fox go up, he shall even break down their stone wall.
nghe, O our God; for we are despised: Và turn their reproach upon their own head, Và give them for a prey in the land of captivity: despised: Heb. despite
Và cover not their iniquity, Và let not their sin be blotted out from before ngươi: for they have provoked ngươi to anger before the builders.
So built we the wall; Và all the wall was joined together unto the half thereof: for the people had a mind to work.
But xảy đến, that when Sanballat, Và Tobiah, Và the Arabians, Và the Ammonites, Và the Ashdodites, nghe that the walls of Giê-ru-sa-lem được dựng nên up, Và that the breaches bắt đầu to be stopped, then they were very wroth,được dựng nên up: Heb. ascended
Và conspired all of them together to come Và to fight against Giê-ru-sa-lem, Và to hinder it. to hinder…: Heb. to make an error to it
Nevertheless we made our prayer unto our God, Và set a watch against them day Và night, vì of them.
Và Giu-đa nói, The strength of the bearers of burdens is decayed, and there is much rubbish; so that we are not able to build the wall.
Và our adversaries nói, They shall not know, neither see, till we come in the midst among them, and slay them, and cause the work to cease.
Và xảy đến, that when the Jews which dwelt by them đến, họ nói unto us ten times, From all places whence ngươi sẽ return unto us they will be upon you. From all…: or, That from all places ye must return to us
Therefore set I in the lower places behind the wall, Và on the higher places, I even set the people after their families with their những thanh gươm, their spears, Và their bows. in the…: Heb. from the lower parts of the place, etc
Và I looked, Và rose up, và nói unto the nobles, Và to the rulers, Và to the rest của dân sự, Be not ye afraid of them: nhớ Chúa, which is great Và terrible, Và fight for your brethren, your sons, Và your daughters, your wives, Và your houses.
Và xảy đến, when our enemies nghe that it was known unto us, and God had brought their counsel to nought, that we returned all of us to the wall, every one unto his work.
Và xảy đến from that time forth, that phân nửa of my servants wrought in the work, Và the other half of them held both the spears, the shields, Và the bows, Và the habergeons; Và the rulers were behind all nhà của Giu-đa.
They which builded on the wall, Và they that bare burdens, with those that laded, every one with one of his hands wrought in the work, Và with the other tay held a weapon.
For the builders, every one had his thanh gươm girded by his side, and so builded. Và he that sounded the trumpet was by me. by his side: Heb. on his loins
Và tôi nói unto the nobles, Và to the rulers, Và to the rest của dân sự, The work is great Và large, Và we are separated upon the wall, một far from another.
In what place Vậy ye hear tiếng of the trumpet, resort ye thither unto us: our God shall fight for us.
So we laboured in the work: Và half of them held the spears from the rising of buổi sáng till ngôi saos appeared.
cũng như vậy at the same time nói I unto the people, Let every one with his servant lodge within Giê-ru-sa-lem, that in the night they may be a guard to us, and labour on the day.
So neither I, nor my brethren, nor my servants, nor the men of the guard which followed me, none of us put off our clothes, saving that every one put them off for washing. saving…: or, every one went with his weapon for water

CHAPTER 5.
Và there was a great cry của dân sự Và of their wives against their brethren những người Do Thái.
For there were that nói, We, our sons, Và our daughters, are many: therefore we take up bắp for them, that we may eat, Và live.
Some also there were that nói, We have mortgaged our lands, vườn nhos, Và houses, that we might buy bắp, vì cớ the dearth.
There were also that nói, We have borrowed tiền for the king's tribute, Và that upon our lands Và vườn nhos.
Yet now our flesh is as xác thịt of our brethren, our children as their children: and, lo, we bring into bondage our sons Và our daughters to be servants, and some of our daughters are brought unto bondage already: neither is it in our power to redeem them; for other men have our lands Và vườn nhos.
Và I was very angry when I heard their cry Và these words.
Then I consulted with myself, Và I rebuked the nobles, Và the rulers, và nói với họ, Ye exact usury, every one of his brother. Và I set a great assembly against them. I consulted…: Heb. my heart consulted in me
Và tôi nói với họ, We after our ability have redeemed our brethren những người Do Thái, which were sold unto the heathen; Và will ye even sell your brethren? or shall they be sold unto us? Then held they their peace, Và found nothing to answer.
Also tôi nói, It is không tốt that ye do: ought ye not to walk in the fear of our God vì cớ the reproach of the heathen our enemies?
I cũng như vậy, Và my brethren, Và my servants, might exact of them money Và corn: I pray you, let us leave off this usury.
phục hồi, I pray you, to them, even this day, their lands, their vườn nhos, their oliveyards, Và their houses, also the hundredth part of the money, Và of the corn, the wine, Và the oil, that ye exact of them.
Then nói they, We will restore họ, Và will require nothing of them; so will we do as ngươi sayest. Then I called những thầy tế lễ, Và took an oath of them, that they should do according to this promise.
Also I shook my lap, và nói, So God shake out every man from his house, Và from his labour, that performeth not this promise, even thus be he shaken out, Và emptied. Và all the congregation nói, Amen, Và praised the CHÚA. Và the people did according to this promise. emptied: Heb. empty, or, void
Moreover from the time that I was appointed to be their governor in the land của Giu-đa, from the twentieth năm even unto the two Và thirtieth năm of Artaxerxes vua, that is, mười hai năm, I and my brethren have not eaten the bread of thống đốc.
But the former governors that had been before me were chargeable unto the people, Và had taken of them bread Và wine, beside bốn mươi shekels of silver; yea, even their servants bare rule over the people: but so did not I, because of the fear của ĐCT.
Yea, also I continued in the work of this wall, neither bought we any land: Và all my servants were gathered thither unto the work.
Moreover there were at my table một trăm Và fifty of the Jews Và rulers, beside those that came unto us from among the heathen that are about us.
Now that which was prepared for me hằng ngày was một ox Và sáu choice chiên; also fowls were prepared for me, and once in ten ngày store of all sorts of wine: yet for all this required not I the bread of thống đốc, because the bondage was heavy upon this people.
Think upon me, my God, for good, according to all that I have done for this people.

CHAPTER 6.
Now xảy đến, when Sanballat, Và Tobiah, Và Geshem the Arabian, Và the rest of our enemies, nghe that I had builded the wall, and that there was no breach left therein; (though at that time I had not set up the doors upon the gates;)
That Sanballat Và Geshem sent unto me, saying, đến, let us meet together in some one of làngs in the plain of Ono. But they thought to do me mischief.
Và I sent messengers với họ, saying, I là doing a great work, so that I cannot come down: why should the work cease, whilst I leave it, and come down to you?
Yet they sent unto me four times after this sort; Và I trả lời them after the same manner.
Then sent Sanballat his servant unto me in like manner the fifth time with an open letter in his hand;
Wherein was written, It is reported among the heathen, Và Gashmu nói it, that ngươi and the Jews think to rebel: for which cause ngươi buildest the wall, that ngươi mayest be their king, according to these words. Gashmu: also called, Geshem
Và ngươi hast also appointed các tiên tri to preach of ngươi at Giê-ru-sa-lem, nói [rằng], There is a king in Giu-đa: Và now shall it be reported to the king according to these words. đến now therefore, and let us take counsel together.
Then I sent unto him, saying, There are no such things done as ngươi sayest, but ngươi feignest them out of thine own heart.
For they all made us afraid, nói [rằng], Their hands shall be weakened from the work, that it be not done. Now therefore, Hỡi ĐCT, strengthen my hands.
Afterward I came unđến nhà of Shemaiah con trai of Delaiah con trai of Mehetabeel, who was shut up; Và he nói, Let us meet together in nhà của ĐCT, within đền thờ, Và let us shut the doors of đền thờ: for they will come to slay ngươi; yea, in the night will they come to slay ngươi.
Và tôi nói, Should such một người as I flee? and who is there, that, being as I là, would go into đền thờ to save his sự sống? I will not go in.
And, lo, I perceived that God had not sent him; but that he pronounced this prophecy against me: for Tobiah Và Sanballat had hired him.
Therefore was he hired, that I should be afraid, Và do so, Và sin, and that they might have matter for an evil report, that they might reproach me.
My God, think ngươi upon Tobiah Và Sanballat according to these their works, Và on the prophetess Noadiah, Và the rest of các tiên tri, that would have put me in fear.
So the wall was finished in the hai mươi Và fifth ngày of the month Elul, in fifty Và two ngày.
Và xảy đến, that when all our enemies nghe thereof, Và all the heathen that were about us nhìn thấy these things, they were much cast down in their own eyes: for they perceived that this work was wrought of our God.
Moreover in those days the nobles của Giu-đa sent many letters unto Tobiah, and the letters of Tobiah đến với họ. sent…: Heb. multiplied their letters passing to Tobiah
For there were many in Giu-đa sworn unto him, because he was the son in law of Shechaniah con trai of Arah; Và his son Johanan had taken con gái of Meshullam con trai of Berechiah.
Also they reported his good deeds before me, and uttered my words to him. Và Tobiah sent letters to put me in fear. words: or, matters

CHAPTER 7.
Now xảy đến, when the wall was built, Và I had set up the doors, Và the porters Và the singers Và the Levites were appointed,
That I gave my brother Hanani, Và Hananiah the ruler of the palace, charge over Giê-ru-sa-lem: for he was a faithful man, Và feared ĐCT above many.
Và tôi nói với họ, Let not the gates of Giê-ru-sa-lem be opened until mặt trời be hot; Và while they stand by, let them shut the doors, Và bar họ: Và appoint watches of the inhabitants of Giê-ru-sa-lem, every one in his watch, và mãi mãiy one to be over against his house.
Now the city was large Và great: but the people were few therein, Và nhàs were not builded. large: Heb. broad in spaces
Và my God put into mine heart to gather together the nobles, Và the rulers, Và the people, that they might be reckoned by genealogy. Và I found a register of the genealogy of them which came up at the first, Và found written therein,
These are con cái of the province, that went up out of the captivity, of those that had been carried away, whom Nebuchadnezzar vua of Ba-by-lôn had carried away, Và came again to Giê-ru-sa-lem Và to Giu-đa, every one unto his city;
Who came with Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Azariah, Raamiah, Nahamani, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispereth, Bigvai, Nehum, Baanah. The number, I say, of the men của dân sự của I-sơ-ra-ên was this; Azariah: also called, Seraiah

con cái of Azgad, hai ngàn ba trăm hai mươi Và two.
con cái of Adonikam, sáu trăm sáu mươi Và bảy.
con cái of Bigvai, two thousand sáu mươi Và bảy.

con cái of Harim, một ngàn Và seventeen.

con cái of Jaala, con cái of Darkon, con cái of Giddel,
con cái of Shephatiah, con cái of Hattil, con cái of Pochereth of Zebaim, con cái of Amon. Amon: also called, Ami
All the Nethinims, Và the children of Sa-lô-môn's các đầy tớ, were ba trăm ninety Và two.
Và these were they which went up also from Tel–melah, Tel–haresha, Cherub, Addon, Và Immer: but they could not shew their father's nhà, nor their seed, whether they were của I-sơ-ra-ên. seed: or, pedigree
con cái of Delaiah, con cái of Tobiah, con cái of Nekoda, sáu trăm bốn mươi Và two.
Và of the priests: con cái of Habaiah, con cái of Koz, con cái of Barzillai, which took one of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite to wife, Và was called after their name.
These sought their register among those that were reckoned by genealogy, but it was not found: therefore were they, as polluted, put from the priesthood.
Và the Tirshatha nói với họ, that they should not eat of the most holy things, till there stood up một thầy tế lễ with Urim Và Thummim. the Tirshatha: or, thống đốc
The whole congregation together was bốn mươi Và two thousand ba trăm Và sáu mươi,
Beside their manservants Và their những tớ gái, of whom there were bảy ngàn ba trăm ba mươi Và bảy: Và they had two hundred bốn mươi Và five singing men Và singing women.
Their horses, bảy trăm ba mươi Và six: their mules, hai trăm bốn mươi Và five:
Their lạc đà, bốn trăm ba mươi Và five: sáu ngàn bảy trăm Và hai mươi asses.
Và some of the chief of chas gave unto the work. The Tirshatha gave to the treasure một ngàn drams of gold, 50 basons, năm trăm Và ba mươi priests' garments. some: Heb. part.
The Tirshatha: or, thống đốc
Và some of the chief of chas gave to the treasure of the work hai mươi ngàn drams of gold, Và two thousand Và two hundred pound of silver.
Và that which the rest của dân sự gave was hai mươi ngàn drams of gold, Và two thousand pound of silver, Và sáu mươi Và bảy priests' garments.
So the priests, Và the Levites, Và the porters, Và the singers, and some của dân sự, Và the Nethinims, Và all I-sơ-ra-ên, dwelt in their cities; Và when the seventh month đến, con cái của I-sơ-ra-ên were in their cities.

CHAPTER 8.
Và all the people gathered themselves together as one man into the street that was before nước gate; Và they spake unto Ezra thầy chép luật to bring quyển sách of the law of Môi-se, which the CHÚA had commanded to I-sơ-ra-ên.
Và Ezra thầy tế lễ brought luật pháp before the congregation both of men Và women, Và all that could hear with understanding, upon the first ngày of the seventh month. that…: Heb. that understood in hearing
Và he read therein before the street that was before nước gate from buổi sáng until midday, before the men Và những người đàn bà, Và those that could understand; Và the ears of all the people were attentive unto the book of the law. from…: Heb. from the light
Và Ezra thầy chép luật đứng upon a pulpit of wood, which they had made for the purpose; Và beside him stood Mattithiah, Và Shema, Và Anaiah, Và Urijah, Và Hilkiah, Và Maaseiah, on his tay phải; Và on his tay trái, Pedaiah, Và Mishael, Và Malchiah, Và Hashum, Và Hashbadana, Zechariah, Và Meshullam. pulpit…: Heb. tower of wood
Và Ezra mở quyển sách in the sight of all the people; (for he was above all the people;) Và when he opened it, all the people stood up: sight: Heb. eyes
Và Ezra phước the CHÚA, the great ĐCT. Và all the people trả lời, Amen, Amen, with lifting up their hands: Và they bowed their heads, and worshipped the CHÚA with their faces to the ground.
Also Jeshua, Và Bani, Và Sherebiah, Jamin, Akkub, Shabbethai, Hodijah, Maaseiah, Kelita, Azariah, Jozabad, Hanan, Pelaiah, Và the Levites, caused the people to understand luật pháp: Và the people đứng in their place.
So they read in the book in the law của ĐCT distinctly, Và gave the sense, and caused họ to understand the reading.
Và Nehemiah, which is the Tirshatha, Và Ezra thầy tế lễ thầy chép luật, Và the Levites that taught the people, nói unto all the people, This day is thánh unto the CHÚA your God; than khóc not, nor weep. For all the people khóc, khi họ nghe những lời of the law. the Tirshatha: or, thống đốc
Then he nói với họ, Go your way, ăn the fat, và uống the sweet, Và send portions với họ for whom nothing is prepared: for này ngày is thánh unto our Lord: neither be ye sorry; for sự vui mừng of the CHÚA is your strength.
So the Levites stilled tất cả mọi người, nói [rằng], Hold your peace, for the day is thánh; neither be ye grieved.
Và all the people went their way to eat, Và to drink, Và to send portions, Và to make great mirth, because they had understood những lời that were declared với họ.
Và on the second ngày were gathered together the chief of chas of all the people, những thầy tế lễ, Và the Levites, unto Ezra thầy chép luật, even to understand những lời of the law. to understand…: or, that they might instruct in the words of the law
Và they found written in the law which the CHÚA had commanded by Môi-se, that the children của I-sơ-ra-ên should ở in booths in the feast of the seventh month: by: Heb. by tay of
Và that they should publish Và proclaim in all their cities, Và in Giê-ru-sa-lem, nói [rằng], Go forth unto the mount, Và fetch olive branches, Và pine branches, Và myrtle branches, Và palm branches, Và branches of thick trees, to make booths, as it is written.
So the people went forth, Và brought họ, Và made themselves booths, every one upon the roof of his house, Và in their courts, Và in the courts của nhà của ĐCT, Và in the street of the water gate, Và in the street of cổng of Ephraim.
Và all the congregation of them that were come again out of the captivity made booths, Và sat under the booths: for since the days of Jeshua con trai of Nun unto that day had not the children của I-sơ-ra-ên done so. Và there was very great gladness.
Also day by day, from the first ngày unto cuối cùng ngày, he read in the book of the law của ĐCT. Và they kept the feast bảy ngày; Và on the eighth ngày was a solemn assembly, according unto the manner. a solemn…: Heb. a restraint

CHAPTER 9.
Now in the hai mươi Và fourth ngày of this month con cái của I-sơ-ra-ên were assembled with fasting, Và with vải bốes, Và đất upon them.
Và the seed của I-sơ-ra-ên separated themselves from all strangers, Và stood Và confessed their tội lỗi, Và the iniquities of their fathers. strangers: Heb. strange children
Và they stood up in their place, Và read in the book of the law of the CHÚA their God one fourth part of the day; and another fourth part they confessed, Và worshipped the CHÚA their God.
Then stood up upon the stairs, of the Levites, Jeshua, Và Bani, Kadmiel, Shebaniah, Bunni, Sherebiah, Bani, Và Chenani, Và cried with a loud tiếng unto the CHÚA their God. stairs: or, scaffold
Then the Levites, Jeshua, Và Kadmiel, Bani, Hashabniah, Sherebiah, Hodijah, Shebaniah, Và Pethahiah, nói, Stand up Và bless the CHÚA your God đến đời đời và mãi mãi: Và blessed be thy glorious name, which is exalted above all blessing Và praise.
Thou, even thou, art
CHÚA alone; ngươi hast made trời, the heaven of heavens, with all their host, đất, and all things that are therein, biểns, and all that is therein, and ngươi preservest them all; and the host of heaven worshippeth ngươi.
Thou art the CHÚA ĐCT, who didst choose Abram, Và broughtest him forth out of Ur of the Chaldees, Và gavest him Tên of Áp-ra-ham;
Và foundest his heart trung tín before ngươi, and madest a covenant with him để cho the land của người Ca-na-an, the Hittites, the Amorites, Và the Perizzites, Và the Jebusites, Và the Girgashites, để cho it, I say, to his seed, Và hast performed thy words; for thou art công chính:
Và didst see the affliction of our fathers in Ai-Cập, Và heardest their cry by the Red sea;
Và shewedst signs Và wonders upon Pha-ra-ôn, Và on all his servants, Và on all the people of his land: for ngươi knewest that they dealt proudly against them. So didst ngươi get ngươi a name, as it is this day.
Và ngươi didst divide biển before them, so that they went through the midst of biển on the đất khô; Và their persecutors ngươi threwest into the deeps, as a stone into the mighty waters.
Moreover ngươi leddest them trong ngày by a cloudy pillar; Và in the night by a pillar lửa, để cho them light in the way wherein they should go.
ngươi camest down also upon mount Sinai, Và spakest with them from heaven, Và gavest them right judgments, Và true laws, tốt statutes Và commandments: true…: Heb. laws of truth
Và madest known với họ thy holy sabbath, Và commandedst them precepts, statutes, Và laws, by tay of Môi-se thy servant:
Và gavest them bread from heaven for their hunger, Và broughtest forth nước for them out of the rock for their thirst, Và promisedst them that they should go in to possess the land which ngươi hadst sworn để cho them. which…: Heb. which ngươi hadst lift up thine hand để cho them
But they and our fathers dealt proudly, Và hardened their necks, Và hearkened not to thy commandments,
Và refused to obey, neither were mindful of thy wonders that ngươi didst among them; but hardened their necks, Và in their rebellion appointed a captain to return to their bondage: but thou art a God ready to pardon, gracious Và merciful, slow to anger, Và of great kindness, Và forsookest them not. a God…: Heb. a God of pardons
Yea, when they had made them a molten calf, và nói, This is thy God that brought ngươi up out of Ai-Cập, Và had wrought great provocations;
Yet ngươi in thy manifold mercies forsookest them not in the wilderness: the pillar of đám mây departed not from them by day, to lead them in the way; neither the pillar lửa by night, to shew them light, Và the way wherein they should go.
ngươi gavest also thy good spirit to instruct them, and withheldest not thy manna from their mouth, Và gavest them water for their thirst.
Yea, forty năm didst ngươi sustain them in the wilderness, đến đổi they lacked nothing; their clothes waxed not old, Và their feet swelled not.
Moreover ngươi gavest them kingdoms Và nations, Và didst divide them into corners: so they possessed the land of Sihon, Và the land of the king of Heshbon, Và the land of Og vua of Bashan.
Their children also multipliedst ngươi as ngôi saos of heaven, Và broughtest them into the land, concerning which ngươi hadst promised to their fathers, that they should go in to possess it.
So the children went in Và possessed the land, Và ngươi subduedst before them the inhabitants of the land, người Ca-na-an, Và gavest them into their hands, with their kings, Và the people of the land, that they might do with them as they would. as they…: Heb. according to their will

Nevertheless they were disobedient, Và rebelled against ngươi, and cast thy law behind their backs, Và slew thy các tiên tri which testified against them to turn them to ngươi, and they wrought great provocations.
Therefore ngươi deliveredst them into tay of their enemies, who vexed them: and in the time of their trouble, when they cried unto ngươi, ngươi heardest họ from heaven; Và according to thy manifold mercies ngươi gavest them saviours, who saved them out of tay of their enemies.
But after they had rest, they did evil again before ngươi: therefore leftest ngươi them in tay of their enemies, so that they had the dominion over them: yet when they returned, Và cried unto ngươi, ngươi heardest họ from heaven; Và many times didst ngươi deliver them according to thy mercies; they did…: Heb. they returned to do evil
Và testifiedst against them, that ngươi mightest bring them again unto thy law: yet they dealt proudly, Và hearkened not unto thy commandments, but sinned against thy judgments, ( which if a man do, he shall live in them;) and withdrew the shoulder, Và hardened their neck, Và would not hear. withdrew…: Heb. they gave a withdrawing shoulder
Yet many năm didst ngươi forbear them, and testifiedst against them by thy spirit trong thy các tiên tri: yet would they not give ear: therefore gavest ngươi them into tay của dân sự of the lands. forbear…: Heb. protract over them in thy…: Heb. in tay of thy các tiên tri

Và I commanded the Levites that they should cleanse themselves, and that they should come Và keep the gates, to sanctify ngày Sa-bát ngày. nhớ me, Hỡi ĐCT tôi, concerning this also, and spare me according to the greatness of thy mercy. greatness: or, multitude
In those days also saw I Jews that had married wives of Ashdod, of Ammon, Và of Mô-áp: had…: Heb. had made to ở with them
Và their children nói half in the speech of Ashdod, Và could not speak in the Jews' language, but according to the language of each people. could…: Heb. they discerned not to speak of each…: Heb. of people and people
Và I contended with them, and cursed them, and smote certain of them, and plucked off their hair, Và made them swear by God, nói [rằng], ngươi sẽ not give your daughters unto their sons, nor take their daughters cùng các ngươir sons, or for yourselves. cursed: or, reviled
Did not Sa-lô-môn vua của I-sơ-ra-ên tội lỗi by these things? yet among many nations was there no king like him, who was beloved of his God, Và ĐCT made him king over all I-sơ-ra-ên: nevertheless even him did outlandish women cause to sin.
Shall we then hearken cùng các ngươi to do all this great evil, to transgress against our God in marrying strange wives?
Và one của các con of Joiada, con trai of Eliashib the high priest, was son in law to Sanballat the Horonite: therefore I chased him from me.
nhớ them, Hỡi ĐCT tôi, because they have làm dơ dáyd the priesthood, Và the covenant of the priesthood, Và of the Levites. because…: Heb. for the defilings
Thus cleansed I them from all strangers, Và appointed the wards of the priests Và the Levites, every one in his business;
Và for the wood offering, at times appointed, Và for the firstfruits. nhớ me, Hỡi ĐCT tôi, for good.

div.title: THE BOOK OF ESTHER
div.chapter:
CHAPTER 1.
Now xảy đến trong những ngày of Ahasuerus, (this is Ahasuerus which reigned, from India even unto Ethiopia, over một trăm Và bảy Và hai mươi provinces:)
That in those days, when the king Ahasuerus sat on the throne of his kingdom, which was in Shushan the palace,
In the third năm of his reign, he made a feast unto all his princes Và his servants; quyền năng of Persia Và Media, the nobles Và princes of the provinces, being before him:
When he shewed the riches of his glorious kingdom Và the honour of his excellent majesty many ngày, even một trăm Và fourscore ngày.
Và when these days were expired, vua made a feast unto all the people that were present in Shushan the palace, both unto great Và small, bảy ngày, in the court of vườn of the king's palace; present: Heb. found
Where were trắng, green, Và blue, hangings, fastened with cords of fine linen Và purple to silver rings Và pillars of marble: the beds were of gold và bạc, upon a pavement of red, Và blue, Và white, Và black, marble. blue, hangings: or, violet, etc of red…: or, of porphyre, and marble and alabaster, and stone of blue colour
Và they gave họ uống in vessels of gold, ( the vessels being diverse one from another,) Và royal rượu nho in abundance, according to the state of the king. royal…: Heb. wine of the kingdom state: Heb. hand
Và the drinking was according luật pháp; none did compel: for so the king had appointed to all the officers of his house, that they should do according to every man's pleasure.
Also Vashti Nữ hoàng made a feast for những người đàn bà trong the royal nhà which belonged to king Ahasuerus.
On the seventh ngày, when the heart of the king was merry with wine, he commanded Mehuman, Biztha, Harbona, Bigtha, Và Abagtha, Zethar, Và Carcas, the bảy chamberlains that served in the presence of Ahasuerus vua,chamberlains: or, eunuchs
To bring Vashti Nữ hoàng before vua with the crown royal, to shew the people Và the princes her beauty: for she was fair to look on. fair…: Heb. good of countenance
But Nữ hoàng Vashti refused to come at the king's mạng lệnh by his chamberlains: therefore was the king very wroth, Và his anger burned in him. by his…: Heb. which was by tay of his eunuchs
Then the king nói to the wise men, which knew the times, (for so was the king's manner toward all that knew law Và judgment:
Và the next unto him was Carshena, Shethar, Admatha, Tarshish, Meres, Marsena, Và Memucan, the bảy princes of Persia Và Media, which saw the king's mặt, Và which sat the first in the kingdom;)
What shall we do unto Nữ hoàng Vashti according to law, because she hath not performed the commandment of the king Ahasuerus by the chamberlains? What…: Heb. What to do
Và Memucan trả lời before vua Và the princes, Vashti Nữ hoàng hath not done wrong to the king only, but also to all the princes, Và to all the people that are in all the provinces of the king Ahasuerus.
For này deed of Nữ hoàng shall come abroad unto all women, so that they shall despise their husbands in their eyes, when it shall be reported, The king Ahasuerus truyền lệnh Vashti Nữ hoàng to be brought in before him, but she came not.
cũng như vậy shall the ladies of Persia Và Media say this day unto all the king's princes, which have heard of the deed of Nữ hoàng. Thus shall there arise too much contempt Và wrath.
If it please vua, let there go a royal mạng lệnh from him, Và let it be written among the laws of the Persians Và the Medes, that it be not altered, That Vashti đến no more before vua Ahasuerus; Và let the king give her royal estate unto another that is better than she. If it…: Heb. If it be good with the king unto…: Heb. unto her companion from him: Heb. from before him be not…: Heb. pass not away
Và when the king's decree which he shall make shall be published throughout all his empire, ( for it is great,) all the wives shall give to their husbands honour, both to great Và small.
Và the saying pleased vua Và the princes; và vua did according to the word of Memucan: pleased…: Heb. was good in the eyes of the king
For he sent letters into all the king's provinces, into every province according to the writing thereof, and to every people after their language, that every man should bear rule in his own house, and that it should be published according to the language of every people. that it…: Heb. that one should publish it according to the language of his people

CHAPTER 2.
After these things, when cơn thịnh nộ của vua Ahasuerus was appeased, he nhớ lại Vashti, Và what she had done, Và what was decreed against her.
Then nói the king's các đầy tớ that ministered unto him, Let there be fair young virgins sought for the king:
Và let the king appoint officers in all the provinces of his kingdom, that they may gather together all the fair young virgins unto Shushan the palace, đến nhà of những người đàn bà, unto the custody of Hege the king's chamberlain, keeper of những người đàn bà; Và let their things for purification be given họ: unto the…: Heb. unto tay Hege: also called, Hegai
Và let the maiden which pleaseth vua be queen instead of Vashti. Và the thing pleased vua; Và he did so.
bây giờ in Shushan the palace there was a certain người Giu-đa, whose name was Mordecai, con trai of Jair, con trai of Shimei, con trai of Kish, a Benjamite;
Who had been carried away from Giê-ru-sa-lem with the captivity which had been carried away with Jeconiah vua của Giu-đa, whom Nebuchadnezzar vua of Ba-by-lôn had carried away. Jeconiah: also called, Jehoiachin
Và he brought up Hadassah, that is, Esther, his uncle's con gái: for she had neither father nor mother, Và the maid was fair Và beautiful; whom Mordecai, when her father Và mother were dead, took for his own daughter. brought…: Heb. nourished fair…: Heb. fair of form, and good of countenance
So xảy đến, when the king's mạng lệnh Và his decree was heard, Và when many maidens were gathered together unto Shushan the palace, to the custody of Hegai, that Esther was brought also unto the king's nhà, to the custody of Hegai, keeper of những người đàn bà.
Và the maiden pleased him, and she obtained kindness of him; Và he speedily gave her her things for purification, with such things as belonged to her, and bảy maidens, which were meet to be given her, out of the king's nhà: Và he preferred her and her maids unto the best place của nhà of những người đàn bà. such…: Heb. her portions preferred: Heb. changed
Esther had not shewed her people nor her kindred: for Mordecai had charged her that she should not shew it.
Và Mordecai walked every day before the court of những người đàn bà's nhà, to know how Esther did, Và what should become of her. to know…: Heb. to know the peace
Now when every maid's turn was come to go in to king Ahasuerus, after that she had been mười hai months, according to the manner of những người đàn bà, ( for so were the days of their purifications accomplished, to wit, sáu months with oil of myrrh, Và six months with sweet odours, and with other things for the purifying of những người đàn bà;)
Then thus came mỗi maiden unto the king; bất cứ điều chi she desired was given her to go with her out of nhà of những người đàn bà unto the king's nhà.
In buổi chiều she went, Và on the morrow she returned into the second nhà of những người đàn bà, to the custody of Shaashgaz, the king's chamberlain, which kept the concubines: she came in unto the king no more, except the king delighted in her, and that she were called by name.
Now when the turn of Esther, con gái of Abihail the uncle of Mordecai, who had taken her for his daughter, was come to go in unto the king, she required nothing but what Hegai the king's chamberlain, the keeper of những người đàn bà, appointed. Và Esther obtained favour in the sight of all them that looked upon her.
So Esther was taken unto king Ahasuerus into his house royal in the tenth month, which is the month Tebeth, in the seventh năm of his reign.
và vua loved Esther above all những người đàn bà, Và she obtained ân-điển Và favour in his sight more than all the virgins; so that he set the royal crown upon her head, Và made her queen instead of Vashti. favour: or, kindness in his…: Heb. before him
Then the king made a great feast unto all his princes Và his servants, even Esther's feast; Và he made a release to the provinces, Và gave gifts, according to the state of the king. release: Heb. rest
Và when the virgins were gathered together the second time, then Mordecai sat in the king's gate.
Esther had not yet đã bày tỏ her kindred nor her people; as Mordecai had charged her: for Esther did the commandment of Mordecai, like as when she was brought up with him.
In those days, while Mordecai sat in the king's gate, hai of the king's chamberlains, Bigthan Và Teresh, of those which kept the door, were wroth, Và sought to lay tay on the king Ahasuerus. Bigthan: also called, Bigthana the door: Heb. the threshold
Và the thing was known to Mordecai, who told it unto Esther Nữ hoàng; Và Esther certified vua thereof in Mordecai's name.
Và when inquisition was made of the matter, it was found out; therefore they were both hanged on a tree: Và it was written in the book of the chronicles before vua.

CHAPTER 3.
After these things did king Ahasuerus promote Haman con trai of Hammedatha the Agagite, Và advanced him, and set his seat above all the princes that were with him.
Và all the king's các đầy tớ, that were in the king's gate, bowed, Và reverenced Haman: for the king had so commanded concerning him. But Mordecai bowed not, nor did him reverence.
Then the king's các đầy tớ, which were in the king's gate, nói unto Mordecai, Tại sao transgressest ngươi the king's mạng lệnh?
Now xảy đến, when they spake hằng ngày unto him, and he hearkened not với họ, that they told Haman, để xemwhether Mordecai's matters would stand: for he had told them that he was a Jew.
Và when Haman nhìn thấy that Mordecai bowed not, nor did him reverence, then was Haman full of wrath.
Và he thought scorn to lay hands on Mordecai alone; for they had shewed him the people of Mordecai: wherefore Haman sought to destroy all the Jews that were throughout the whole kingdom of Ahasuerus, even the people of Mordecai.
In the first month, that is, the month Nisan, in the twelfth năm của vua Ahasuerus, they cast Pur, that is, the lot, before Haman from day to day, Và from month to month, to the twelfth month, that is, the month Adar.
Và Haman nói unto king Ahasuerus, There is kia people scattered abroad Và dispersed among the people in all the provinces of thy kingdom; Và their laws are diverse from all people; neither keep they the king's laws: therefore it is not for the king's profit to suffer them. for the…: Heb. meet or, equal, etc
If it please vua, let it be written that they may be destroyed: Và I will pay mười ngàn ta-lâng of silver to tays of those that have the charge of the business, to bring it into the king's treasuries. that they…: Heb. to destroy them pay: Heb. weigh
và vua took his ring from his hand, Và gave it unto Haman con trai of Hammedatha the Agagite, the Jews' kẻ thù. enemy: or, oppressor
và vua nói unto Haman, The silver is given to ngươi, the people also, to do with them as it seemeth tốt to ngươi.
Then were the king's những thầy chép luật called on the thirteenth ngày of the first month, Và there was written according to all that Haman had commanded unto the king's lieutenants, Và to the governors that were over every province, Và to the rulers of every people of every province according to the writing thereof, and to every people after their language; in Tên của vua Ahasuerus was it written, Và sealed with the king's ring. scribes: or, secretaries
Và the letters were sent by posts into all the king's provinces, to destroy, để giết, Và to cause to perish, all Jews, both young Và old, little children Và women, in one ngày, even upon the thirteenth ngày of the twelfth month, which is the month Adar, and to take the spoil of them for a prey.
The copy of the writing for a commandment to be given in every province was published unto all people, that they should be ready against that day.
The posts went out, being hastened by the king's mạng lệnh, Và the decree was given in Shushan the palace. và vua Và Haman ngồi xuống để uống; but the city Shushan was perplexed.

CHAPTER 4.
When Mordecai perceived all that was done, Mordecai rent his clothes, Và put on vải bố with ashes, Và went out into the midst of the city, Và cried with a loud Và a bitter cry;
Và came even before the king's gate: for none might enter into the king's gate mặc with vải bố.
Và in every province, whithersoever the king's mạng lệnh Và his decree đến, there was great than khóc among the Jews, Và fasting, Và weeping, Và khóc lóc; Và many lay in vải bố Và ashes. many…: Heb. vải bố and ashes were laid under many
So Esther's maids Và her chamberlains đến Và told it her. Then was Nữ hoàng exceedingly grieved; Và she sent raiment to clothe Mordecai, Và to take away his vải bố from him: but he received it not. chamberlains: Heb. eunuchs
Then called Esther for Hatach, one of the king's chamberlains, whom he had appointed to attend upon her, and gave him a commandment to Mordecai, to know what it was, and why it was. appointed…: Heb. set before her
So Hatach went forth to Mordecai unto the street of the city, which was before the king's gate.
Và Mordecai told him of all that had happened unto him, and of the sum of the money that Haman had promised to pay to the king's treasuries for the Jews, to destroy them.
Also he gave him the copy of the writing of the decree that was given at Shushan to destroy them, to shew it unto Esther, Và to declare it unto her, and to charge her that she should go in unto the king, to make supplication unto him, and to make request before him for her people.
Và Hatach đến Và told Esther những lời of Mordecai.
Again Esther nói unto Hatach, Và gave him commandment unto Mordecai;
All the king's các đầy tớ, Và the people of the king's provinces, do know, that whosoever, whether man or woman, shall come unto the king into the inner court, who is not called, there is một law of his to put him to death, except such to whom the king shall hold out the golden sceptre, that he may live: but I have not been called to come in unto the king these ba mươi ngày.
Và they told to Mordecai Esther's những lời.
Then Mordecai truyền lệnh to answer Esther, Think not with thyself that ngươi shalt escape in the king's nhà, more than all the Jews.
For if ngươi altogether holdest thy peace at this time, Rồi shall there enlargement Và deliverance Hãy chổi dậy to the Jews from another place; but ngươi and thy father's nhà sẽ bị hủy diệt: Và who knoweth whether ngươi art come to the kingdom for such a time as this? enlargement: Heb. respiration
Then Esther bade họ return Mordecai this answer,
đi, gather together all the Jews that are present in Shushan, Và fast ye for me, and neither eat nor drink ba ngày, đêm or day: I also and my maidens will fast cũng như vậy; and so will I go in unto the king, which is not according luật pháp: Và if I perish, I perish. present: Heb. found
So Mordecai went his way, Và did according to all that Esther had commanded him. went…: Heb. passed

CHAPTER 5.
Now xảy đến on the third ngày, that Esther put on her royal apparel, Và stood in the inner court of the king's nhà, đối diện the king's nhà: và vua sat upon his royal throne in the royal nhà, đối diện cổng của nhà.
Và it was so, when the king nhìn thấy Esther Nữ hoàng standing in the court, that she obtained favour in his sight: và vua held out to Esther the golden sceptre that was in his hand. So Esther drew near, Và touched the top of the sceptre.
Then nói vua unto her, What wilt thou, queen Esther? and what is thy request? it shall be even given ngươi to the half of the kingdom.
Và Esther trả lời, If it seem tốt unto the king, let the king Và Haman đến this day unto the banquet that I have prepared for him.
Then the king nói, Cause Haman to make haste, that he may do as Esther hath nói. So the king Và Haman đến to the banquet that Esther had prepared.
và vua nói unto Esther at the banquet of wine, What is điều cầu xin của ngươi? Và it shall be granted ngươi: and what is thy request? even to the half of the kingdom it shall be performed.
Then trả lời Esther, và nói, My petition Và my request is;
If I have found favour in the sight of the king, Và if it please vua to grant my petition, Và to perform my request, let the king Và Haman đến to the banquet that I shall prepare for them, and I will do ngày mai as the king hath nói. perform: Heb. do
Then went Haman forth that day joyful Và with a glad heart: but when Haman nhìn thấy Mordecai in the king's gate, that he stood not up, nor moved for him, he was full of indignation against Mordecai.
Nevertheless Haman refrained himself: and when he came home, he sent Và called for his friends, Và Zeresh vợ ông. called…: Heb. caused to come
Và Haman told them of sự vinh hiển of his riches, Và đám đông of his children, and all the things wherein the king had promoted him, and how he had advanced him above the princes Và servants of the king.
Haman nói moreover, Yea, Esther Nữ hoàng did let không ai come in with the king unto the banquet that she had prepared but myself; and to morrow am I invited unto her also with the king.
Yet all this availeth me nothing, so long as I see Mordecai the Jew sitting at the king's gate.
Then nói Zeresh vợ ông Và all his friends unto him, Let a gallows be made of fifty cubits high, Và to morrow nói ngươi unto the king that Mordecai may be hanged thereon: then go ngươi in merrily with the king unto the banquet. Và the thing pleased Haman; Và he caused the gallows to be made. gallows: Heb. tree

CHAPTER 6.
On that night could not vua sleep, Và he commanded to bring quyển sách of records of the chronicles; Và they were read before vua. could…: Heb. the king's sleep fled away
Và it was found written, that Mordecai had told of Bigthana Và Teresh, hai of the king's chamberlains, the keepers of the door, who sought to lay tay on the king Ahasuerus. Bigthana: also called, Bigthan door: Heb. threshold
và vua nói, What honour Và dignity hath been done to Mordecai for this? Then nói the king's các đầy tớ that ministered unto him, There is nothing done for him.
và vua nói, Who is in the court? Now Haman was come into the outward court of the king's nhà, to speak unto the king to hang Mordecai on the gallows that he had prepared for him.
Và the king's các đầy tớ nói unto him, kìa, Haman standeth in the court. và vua nói, Let him come in.
So Haman came in. và vua nói unto him, What shall be done unto the man whom the king delighteth to honour? Now Haman thought in his heart, To whom would the king delight to do honour more than to myself? whom the king…: Heb. in whose honour the king delighteth
Và Haman trả lời vua, For the man whom the king delighteth to honour,whom the king…: Heb. in whose honour the king delighteth
Let the royal apparel be brought which the king useth to wear, Và the horse that the king rideth upon, and the crown royal which is set upon his head: Let…: Heb. Let them bring the royal apparel which the king…: Heb. wherewith the king clotheth himself
Và let this apparel Và horse be delivered to tay of one of the king's most noble princes, that they may array the man withal whom the king delighteth to honour, Và bring him on horseback through the street of the city, Và proclaim before him, Thus shall it be done to the man whom the king delighteth to honour. bring…: Heb. cause him to ride
Then the king nói to Haman, Make haste, Và take the apparel Và the horse, as ngươi hast nói, Và do even so to Mordecai the Jew, that sitteth at the king's gate: let nothing fail of all that ngươi hast spoken. let…: Heb. suffer not a whit to fall
Then took Haman the apparel Và the horse, Và arrayed Mordecai, Và brought him on horseback through the street of the city, Và proclaimed before him, Thus shall it be done unto the man whom the king delighteth to honour.
Và Mordecai came again to the king's gate. But Haman hasted to his house than khóc, Và having his head covered.
Và Haman told Zeresh vợ ông Và all his friends every thing that had befallen him. Then nói his wise men Và Zeresh vợ ông unto him, If Mordecai be of the seed of the Jews, before whom ngươi hast begun to fall, ngươi shalt not prevail against him, but shalt surely fall before him.
Và while they were yet talking with him, came the king's chamberlains, Và hasted to bring Haman unto the banquet that Esther had prepared.

CHAPTER 7.
So the king Và Haman đến to banquet with Esther Nữ hoàng. to banquet: Heb. to drink
và vua nói again unto Esther on the second ngày at the banquet of wine, What is điều cầu xin của ngươi, queen Esther? Và it shall be granted ngươi: and what is thy request? Và it shall be performed, even to the half of the kingdom.
Then Esther Nữ hoàng trả lời và nói, If I have found favour in thy sight, O king, Và if it please vua, let my sự sống be given me at my petition, Và my people at my request:
For we are sold, I and my people, to be destroyed, to be slain, Và to perish. But if we had been sold for bondmen Và bondwomen, I had held my tongue, although the enemy could not countervail the king's damage. to be destroyed…: Heb. that they should destroy, and kill, and cause to perish
Then the king Ahasuerus trả lời và nói unto Esther Nữ hoàng, Who is he, and where is he, that durst presume in his heart to do so? that…: Heb. whose heart hath filled him
Và Esther nói, The adversary Và enemy is this wicked Haman. Then Haman was afraid before vua Và Nữ hoàng. The adversary: Heb. The man adversary before: or, at the presence of
và vua arising from the banquet of wine in his wrath went into the palace garden: Và Haman stood up to make request for his sự sống to Esther Nữ hoàng; for he saw that there was evil determined against him by the king.
Then the king returned out of the palace garden into the place of the banquet of wine; Và Haman was fallen upon the bed whereon Esther was. Then nói vua, Will he force Nữ hoàng also before me in nhà? As the word went out of the king's miệng, they covered Haman's mặt. before me: Heb. with me
Và Harbonah, một of the chamberlains, nói before vua, kìa also, the gallows 50 cubits high, which Haman had made for Mordecai, who had spoken tốt for the king, standeth in nhà of Haman. Then the king nói, Hang him thereon. gallows: Heb. tree
So they hanged Haman on the gallows that he had prepared for Mordecai. Then was the king's wrath pacified.

CHAPTER 8.
On that day did the king Ahasuerus give nhà of Haman the Jews' kẻ thù unto Esther Nữ hoàng. Và Mordecai đến before vua; for Esther had told what he was unto her.
và vua took off his ring, which he had taken from Haman, Và gave it unto Mordecai. Và Esther set Mordecai over nhà of Haman.
Và Esther nói yet again before vua, Và fell down at his feet, Và besought him với nước mắt to put away the mischief of Haman the Agagite, Và his device that he had devised against the Jews. Và besought…: Heb. and she khóc, and besought him
Then the king held out the golden sceptre toward Esther. So Esther arose, Và stood before vua,
và nói, If it please vua, Và if I have found favour in his sight, Và the thing seem right before vua, and I be pleasing in his eyes, let it be written to reverse the letters devised by Haman con trai of Hammedatha the Agagite, which he wrote to destroy những người Do Thái which are in all the king's provinces: devised: Heb. the device which he…: or, who wrote
For how can I endure to see the evil that shall come unto my people? or how can I endure to see the destruction of my kindred? endure…: Heb. be able that I may see
Then the king Ahasuerus nói unto Esther Nữ hoàng Và to Mordecai the Jew, kìa, I have given Esther nhà of Haman, Và him they have hanged upon the gallows, because he laid his hand upon the Jews.
Write ye also for the Jews, as it liketh you, in the king's name, Và seal it with the king's ring: for the writing which is written in the king's name, Và sealed with the king's ring, may không ai reverse.
Then were the king's những thầy chép luật called at that time in the third month, that is, the month Sivan, on the three Và twentieth ngày thereof; and it was written according to all that Mordecai truyền lệnh unto the Jews, Và to the lieutenants, Và the deputies Và rulers of the provinces which are from India unto Ethiopia, một trăm hai mươi Và bảy provinces, unto every province according to the writing thereof, and unto every people after their language, Và to the Jews according to their writing, Và according to their language.
Và he wrote in the king Ahasuerus' name, Và sealed it with the king's ring, Và sent letters by posts on horseback, Và riders on mules, lạc đà, Và young dRô-madaries:
Wherein the king granted những người Do Thái which were in every city to gather themselves together, Và to stand for their sự sống, to destroy, to slay, Và to cause to perish, all quyền năng của dân sự Và province that would asSau-lơt them, both little ones Và women, and to take the spoil of them for a prey,
Upon one ngày in all the provinces của vua Ahasuerus, namely, upon the thirteenth ngày of the twelfth month, which is the month Adar.
The copy of the writing for a commandment to be given in every province was published unto all people, Và that the Jews should be ready against that day to avenge themselves on their enemies. published: Heb. revealed
So the posts that rode upon mules Và lạc đà went out, being hastened Và pressed on by the king's mạng lệnh. Và the decree was given at Shushan the palace.
Và Mordecai went out from the presence of the king in royal apparel of blue Và white, Và with a great crown of gold, Và with a garment of fine linen Và purple: Và the city of Shushan rejoiced Và was glad. blue: or, violet
những người Do Thái had light, Và gladness, Và joy, Và honour.
Và in every province, Và in every city, whithersoever the king's mạng lệnh Và his decree đến, những người Do Thái had joy Và gladness, a feast Và a good ngày. Và many của dân sự of the land became Jews; for the fear of the Jews rơi upon them.

CHAPTER 9.
Now in the twelfth month, that is, the month Adar, on the thirteenth ngày of the same, when the king's mạng lệnh Và his decree drew near to be put in execution, trong ngày that the enemies of the Jews hy vọngd to have power over them, (though it was turned to the contrary, that the Jews had rule over them that hated them;)
những người Do Thái gathered themselves together in their cities throughout all the provinces of the king Ahasuerus, to lay tay on such as sought their hurt: Và không ai could withstand họ; for the fear of them fell upon all people.
Và all the rulers of the provinces, Và the lieutenants, Và the deputies, Và officers of the king, helped những người Do Thái; because the fear of Mordecai rơi upon them. officers…: Heb. those which did the business that belonged to the king
For Mordecai was great in the king's nhà, Và his fame went out throughout all the provinces: for this man Mordecai waxed greater and greater.
Thus the Jews smote all their enemies with the stroke of thanh gươm, Và slaughter, Và destruction, Và did what they would unto those that hated them. what…: Heb. according to their will
Và in Shushan the palace những người Do Thái giết Và destroyed năm trăm men.
Và Parshandatha, Và Dalphon, Và Aspatha,
Và Poratha, Và Adalia, Và Aridatha,
Và Parmashta, Và Arisai, Và Aridai, Và Vajezatha,
The ten sons of Haman con trai of Hammedatha, the enemy of the Jews, giết they; but on the spoil laid they not their hand.
On that day the number of those that were slain in Shushan the palace was brought before vua. was…: Heb. came
và vua nói unto Esther Nữ hoàng, những người Do Thái have slain Và destroyed năm trăm men in Shushan the palace, Và the ten sons of Haman; what have they done in the rest of the king's provinces? now what is điều cầu xin của ngươi? Và it shall be granted ngươi: or what is thy request further? Và it shall be done.
Then nói Esther, If it please vua, let it be granted to the Jews which are in Shushan to do ngày mai also according unto this day's decree, Và let Haman's mười sons be hanged upon the gallows. let Haman's…: Heb. let men hang, etc
và vua truyền lệnh it so to be done: Và the decree was given at Shushan; Và they hanged Haman's mười sons.
For the Jews that were in Shushan gathered themselves together on the mười bốn ngày also của tháng Adar, Và slew ba trăm men at Shushan; but on the prey they laid not their hand.
But the other Jews that were in the king's provinces gathered themselves together, Và stood for their lives, Và had rest from their enemies, Và slew of their foes bảy mươi Và five ngàn, but they laid not their hands on the prey,
On the thirteenth ngày của tháng Adar; Và on the mười bốn day of the same rested they, and made it a day of feasting Và gladness. of the same: Heb. in it
But the Jews that were at Shushan assembled together on the thirteenth ngày thereof, and on the mười bốn thereof; and on the fifteenth ngày of the same they rested, Và made it a day of feasting Và gladness.
Therefore the Jews of làngs, that dwelt in the unwalled towns, made the mười bốn ngày của tháng Adar a day of gladness Và feasting, Và a good ngày, Và of sending portions một to another.
Và Mordecai viết these things, Và sent letters unto all the Jews that were in all the provinces of the king Ahasuerus, both nigh Và far,
To stablish này among them, that they should keep the mười bốn ngày của tháng Adar, Và the fifteenth ngày of the same, yearly,
As the days wherein the Jews rested from their enemies, Và the month which was turned với họ from sorrow to joy, Và from than khóc into a good ngày: that they should make them days of feasting Và joy, Và of sending portions một to another, Và gifts to the poor.
Và the Jews undertook to do as they had begun, Và as Mordecai had written với họ;
Because Haman con trai of Hammedatha, the Agagite, the enemy of all the Jews, had devised against the Jews to destroy them, and had cast Pur, that is, the lot, to consume them, and to destroy them;consume: Heb. crush
But when Esther đến before vua, he commanded by letters that his wicked device, which he devised against the Jews, should return upon his own head, Và that he and his sons should be hanged on the gallows. when…: Heb. when she came
Wherefore they called these days Purim after Tên of Pur. Therefore for all the words of this letter, and of that which they had seen concerning this matter, Và which had come với họ,Pur: that is, Lot
những người Do Thái ordained, Và took upon them, and upon their seed, Và upon all such as joined themselves với họ, so as it should not fail, that they would keep these two ngày according to their writing, and according to their appointed time every year; fail: Heb. pass
Và that these days should be nhớ lại Và kept throughout every generation, every gia đình, every province, và mãi mãiy city; and that these days of Purim should not fail from among những người Do Thái, nor the memorial of them perish from their seed. fail: Heb. pass perish: Heb. be ended
Then Esther Nữ hoàng, con gái of Abihail, Và Mordecai the Jew, viết with all authority, to confirm this second letter of Purim. authority: Heb. strength
Và he sent the letters unto all the Jews, to the hundred hai mươi Và bảy provinces of the kingdom of Ahasuerus, với những lời of peace Và truth,
To confirm these days of Purim in their times appointed, according as Mordecai the Jew Và Esther Nữ hoàng had enjoined them, and as they had decreed for themselves Và for their seed, the matters of the fastings Và their cry. themselves: Heb. their souls
Và the decree of Esther confirmed these matters of Purim; Và it was written in the book.

CHAPTER 10.
và vua Ahasuerus laid a tribute upon the land, and trên the isles of biển.
Và all the acts of his power Và of his might, Và the declaration of the greatness of Mordecai, whereunto the king advanced him, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of các vua of Media Và Persia? advanced…: Heb. made him great
For Mordecai the Jew was next unto king Ahasuerus, Và great among the Jews, Và accepted of đám đông of anh em người, seeking the wealth of his people, Và speaking peace to all his seed.
