div.title: THE BOOK OF JOB
div.chapter:
CHAPTER 1.
There was a man in the land of Uz, whose name was Gióp; Và that man was perfect Và upright, Và one that feared ĐCT, Và eschewed evil.
Và there were born unto him bảy sons Và three daughters.
His substance also was bảy ngàn chiên, Và three ngàn lạc đà, Và five trăm ách of oxen, Và five trăm she asses, Và a very great gia đình; so that this man was the greatest of all the men of the east. substance: or, cattle household: or, husbandry men: Heb. sons
Và his sons went Và feasted in their houses, every one his day; Và sent Và called for their three sisters to eat Và to drink with them.
Và it was so, when the days of their feasting were gone about, that Job sent Và sanctified them, and rose up early in buổi sáng, Và offered burnt offerings according to the number of them all: for Job nói, It may be that my sons have sinned, Và cursed ĐCT in their hearts. Thus did Gióp continually. continually: Heb. all the days
Now there was a day when the sons của ĐCT đến to present themselves before the CHÚA, Và Satan đến also among them. Satan: Heb. the adversary among: Heb. in the midst of
Và the CHÚA nói unto Satan, Whence comest thou? Then Satan trả lời the CHÚA, và nói, From going to and fro in đất, Và from walking up and down in it.
Và the CHÚA nói unto Satan, Hast ngươi considered my servant Gióp, that there is none like him in đất, a perfect Và an upright man, one that feareth ĐCT, Và escheweth evil? considered: Heb. set thy heart on
Then Satan trả lời the CHÚA, và nói, Doth Job fear ĐCT for nought?
Hast not ngươi made an hedge about him, and about his house, Và about all that he hath on every side? ngươi hast blessed the work of his hands, Và his substance is increased in the land. substance: or, cattle
Nhưng put forth thine hand now, and touch all that he hath, and he will curse ngươi to thy face. Và he…: Heb. if he curse ngươi not to thy face
Và the CHÚA nói unto Satan, kìa, all that he hath is in thy power; only upon himself put not forth thine hand. So Satan went forth from the presence of the CHÚA. power: Heb. hand
Và there was a day when his sons Và his daughters were eating Và drinking rượu nho in their eldest brother's nhà:
Và there came a messenger unto Job, và nói, The oxen were plowing, Và the asses feeding beside them:
Và the Sabeans rơi upon them, Và took them away; yea, they have slain the servants with the edge of thanh gươm; Và I only am escaped alone to tell ngươi.
While he was yet speaking, there came also another, and nói, lửa của ĐCT is fallen from heaven, Và hath burned up the sheep, Và the servants, Và consumed them; and I only am escaped alone to tell ngươi. The fire…: or, A great fire
While he was yet speaking, there came also another, and nói, The Chaldeans made out ba bands, Và fell upon the lạc đà, Và have carried them away, yea, and slain the servants with the edge of thanh gươm; Và I only am escaped alone to tell ngươi. fell: Heb. rushed
While he was yet speaking, there came also another, and nói, Thy sons Và thy daughters were eating Và drinking rượu nho in their eldest brother's nhà:
And, kìa, there came a great wind từ đồng vắng, Và smote the four corners của nhà, Và it fell upon the young men, Và they are dead; Và I only am escaped alone to tell ngươi. from…: Heb. from aside, etc
Then Job arose, Và rent his mantle, Và shaved his head, Và fell down upon the ground, Và worshipped,mantle: or, robe
và nói, Naked came I out of my mother's womb, Và naked shall I return thither: the CHÚA gave, Và the CHÚA hath taken away; phước be Tên of the CHÚA.
In all this Job sinned not, nor charged ĐCT foolishly. charged…: or, attributed folly to God

CHAPTER 2.
Again there was a day when the sons của ĐCT đến to present themselves before the CHÚA, Và Satan đến also among them to present himself before the CHÚA.
Và the CHÚA nói unto Satan, From whence comest thou? And Satan trả lời the CHÚA, và nói, From going to and fro in đất, Và from walking up and down in it.
Và the CHÚA nói unto Satan, Hast thou considered my servant Gióp, that there is none like him in đất, a perfect Và an upright man, one that feareth ĐCT, Và escheweth evil? Và still he holdeth fast his integrity, although ngươi movedst me against him, to destroy him without cause. to destroy…: Heb. to swallow him up
Và Satan trả lời the CHÚA, và nói, Skin for skin, yea, all that a man hath will he give for his sự sống.
Nhưng put forth thine hand now, and touch his bone Và his flesh, Và he will curse ngươi to thy face.
Và the CHÚA nói unto Satan, kìa, he is in thine hand; but save his sự sống. but: or, only
So went Satan forth from the presence of the CHÚA, Và smote Gióp with sore boils from the sole of his foot unto his crown.
Và he took him a potsherd to scrape himself withal; and he ngồi xuống among the ashes.
Then nói vợ ông unto him, Dost ngươi still retain thine integrity? curse ĐCT, Và die.
But he nói unto her, ngươi speakest as one of the foolish women speaketh. What? shall we receive tốt at tay của ĐCT, Và shall we not receive evil? In all this did not Job tội lỗi with his lips.
Now when Job's ba friends nghe of all this evil that was come upon him, they came every one from his own place; Eliphaz the Temanite, Và Bildad the Shuhite, Và Zophar the Naamathite: for they had made an appointment together to come to mourn with him and to comfort him.
Và when they lifted up their eyes afar off, Và knew him not, they lifted up their voice, Và khóc; Và they rent every one his mantle, Và sprinkled dust upon their heads toward heaven.
So they ngồi xuống with him upon the ground bảy ngày Và bảy nights, Và none spake a word unto him: for they saw that his grief was very great.

CHAPTER 3.
After this opened Gióp his mouth, Và cursed his day.
Và Job nói, và nói,spake: Heb. trả lời
Let the day perish wherein I was born, Và the night in which it was nói, There is a man child conceived.
Let that day be darkness; let not God regard it from above, neither let the light shine upon it.
Let darkness Và the shadow of death stain it; let a cloud ở upon it; let the blackness of the day terrify it. stain: or, challenge let the…: or, let them terrify it, as those who have a bitter day
As for that night, let darkness seize upon it; let it not be joined unto the days of the year, let it not come into the number của thángs. let it not be…: or, let it not rejoice among the days
Lo, let that night be solitary, let no joyful voice đến therein.
Let them curse it that curse ngày, who are ready to raise up their than khóc. their…: or, leviathan
Let ngôi saos of the twilight thereof be dark; let it look for light, but have none; neither let it see the dawning of the day: the dawning…: Heb. the eyelids of buổi sáng
Because it shut not up the doors of my mother's womb, nor hid sorrow from mine eyes.
Tại sao died I not from the womb? why did I không give up the ghost when I came out of the belly?
Tại sao did the knees prevent me? or why the breasts that I should suck?
For now should I have lain still Và been quiet, I should have slept: then had I been at rest,
With kings Và counsellors đất, which built desolate places for themselves;
Or with princes that had gold, who filled their houses with silver:
Or as an hidden untimely birth I had not been; as infants which never saw light.
There the wicked cease từ troubling; Và there the weary be at rest. weary: Heb. wearied in strength
There the prisoners rest together; they hear not the voice of the oppressor.
The small Và great are there; and the servant is free from his master.
Wherefore is light given to him that is in misery, Và sự sống unto the bitter trong soul;
Which long for death, but it đến not; and dig for it more than for hid treasures; long: Heb. wait
Which rejoice exceedingly, Và are glad, when they can find the grave?
Tại sao is light given to a man whose way is hid, Và whom God hath hedged in?
For my sighing đến before I eat, Và my roarings are poured out like the waters. I eat: Heb. my meat
For the thing which I greatly feared is come upon me, and that which I was afraid of is come unto me. the thing…: Heb. I feared a fear, and it came upon me
I was not in safety, neither had I rest, neither was I quiet; yet trouble đến.

CHAPTER 4.
Then Eliphaz the Temanite trả lời và nói,
nếu we assay to commune with ngươi, wilt ngươi be grieved? but who can withhold himself from speaking? to…: Heb. a word withhold…: Heb. refrain from words?
kìa, ngươi hast instructed many, Và ngươi hast strengthened the weak hands.
Thy words have upholden him that was falling, Và ngươi hast strengthened the feeble knees.
But now it is come upon ngươi, and ngươi faintest; it toucheth ngươi, and ngươi art troubled.
Is not này thy fear, thy confidence, thy hy vọng, Và the uprightness of thy ways?
nhớ, I pray ngươi, who ever perished, being innocent? or where were the righteous cut off?
Even as I have seen, they that plow iniquity, Và sow wickedness, reap the same.
By the blast của ĐCT they perish, Và by the breath of his nostrils are they consumed. by the breath…: that is, by his anger
The roaring of the lion, Và the voice of the fierce lion, Và the teeth of the young lions, are broken.
The old lion perisheth for lack of prey, Và the stout lion's whelps are scattered abroad.
Now a thing was secretly brought to me, and mine ear nhận a little thereof. secretly: Heb. by stealth
In thoughts from the visions of the night, when deep sleep falleth on men,
Fear đến upon me, and trembling, which made all my bones to shake. came…: Heb. met all: Heb. đám đông of
Then a spirit passed before my face; the hair of my flesh stood up:
It stood still, but I could not discern the form thereof: an image was before mine eyes, there was silence, Và I heard a voice, nói [rằng],there…: or, I heard a still voice
Shall mortal man be more just than God? shall a man be more pure than his maker?
kìa, he put no trust in his servants; Và his angels he charged with folly: Và his…: or, nor in his angels, in whom he put light
How much less trong them that ở in houses of clay, whose foundation is in the dust, which are crushed before the moth?
They are destroyed from morning to evening: they perish đến đời đời without any regarding it. destroyed: Heb. beaten in pieces
Doth not their excellency which is in them go away? they die, even without wisdom.

CHAPTER 5.
Call now, if there be any that will answer ngươi; and to which of the saints wilt ngươi turn? turn: or, look?
For wrath killeth the foolish man, Và envy slayeth the silly one. envy: or, indignation
I have seen the foolish taking root: but bất chợt I cursed his habitation.
His children are far from safety, Và they are crushed in cổng, neither is there any to deliver họ.
Whose harvest the hungry eateth up, Và taketh it even out of the thorns, Và the robber swalloweth up their substance.
Although affliction cometh not forth of the dust, neither doth trouble spring out of the ground; affliction: or, iniquity
Yet man is born unto trouble, as the sparks fly upward. trouble: or, labour sparks…: Heb. the sons of the burning coal lift up to fly
I would seek unto God, Và unto God would I commit my cause:
Which doeth great things Và unsearchable; marvellous things without number: unsearchable: Heb. there is no search without…: Heb. till there be no number
Who giveth mưa trên đất, Và sendeth waters trên the fields: fields: Heb. outplaces
To set up on high those that be low; that those which mourn may be exalted to safety.
He disappointeth the devices of the crafty, so that their hands cannot perform their enterprise. their enterprise: or, any thing
He taketh the wise in their own craftiness: Và the counsel of the froward is carried headlong.
They meet with darkness trong ngàytime, Và grope in the noonday as in the night. meet…: or, run into
But he saveth người nghèo from thanh gươm, from their mouth, Và from tay of the mighty.
So the poor hath hy vọng, Và iniquity stoppeth her mouth.
kìa, happy is the man whom God correcteth: therefore despise not ngươi the chastening of the Almighty:
For he maketh sore, Và bindeth up: he woundeth, Và his hands make whole.
He shall deliver ngươi in six troubles: yea, in bảy there shall no evil touch ngươi.
In famine he shall redeem ngươi from death: Và in war from quyền năng of thanh gươm. power: Heb. hands
ngươi shalt be hid from the scourge of the tongue: neither shalt ngươi be afraid of destruction when it cometh. from…: or, when the tongue scourgeth
At destruction Và famine ngươi shalt laugh: neither shalt ngươi be afraid of the beasts đất.
For ngươi shalt be in league with the stones of the field: Và the beasts of the field shall be at peace with ngươi.
Và ngươi shalt know that thy tabernacle shall be trong bình an; Và ngươi shalt visit thy habitation, Và shalt not sin. thy tabernacle…: or, peace is thy tabernacle sin: or, err
ngươi shalt know also that thy seed shall be great, Và thine offspring as the grass đất. great: or, much
ngươi shalt come to thy grave in a full age, like as a shock of corn cometh in in his season. cometh in: Heb. ascendeth
Lo this, we have searched it, so it is; nghe it, and know thou it for thy good. for…: Heb. for thyself

CHAPTER 6.
But Job trả lời và nói,
Oh that my grief were throughly weighed, Và my calamity laid in the balances together!laid: Heb. lifted up
For now it would be heavier than the sand of biển: therefore my words are swallowed up. my words…: that is, I want words to express my grief
For the arrows of the Almighty are within me, the poison whereof uống up my spirit: the terrors của ĐCT do set themselves in array against me.
Doth the wild ass bray when he hath grass? or loweth the ox over his fodder? when he…: Heb. at grass?
Can that which is unsavoury be eaten without salt? or is there any taste in the white of an egg?
The things that my soul refused to touch are as my sorrowful meat.
Oh that I might have my request; Và that God would grant me the thing that I long for!the thing…: Heb. my expectation
Even that it would please ĐCT to destroy me; that he would let loose his hand, Và cut me off!
Then should I yet have comfort; yea, I would harden myself in sorrow: let him not spare; for I have not concealed những lời of the Holy One.
What is my strength, that I should hy vọng? and what is mine end, that I should prolong my sự sống?
Is my strength the strength of stones? or is my flesh of brass? of brass: Heb. brasen?
Is not cứu cánh tôi in me? and is wisdom driven quite from me?
To him that is afflicted pity should be shewed from his friend; but he forsaketh the fear of the Almighty. is afflicted: Heb. melteth
My brethren have dealt deceitfully as a brook, Và as the stream of brooks they pass away;
Which are blackish by reason of the ice, Và wherein the snow is hid:
What time they wax warm, they vanish: when it is hot, they are consumed out of their place. vanish: Heb. are cut off when…: Heb. in the heat thereof consumed: Heb. extinguished
The paths of their way are turned aside; they go to nothing, Và perish.
The troops of Tema looked, the companies of Sheba waited for them.
They were confounded because they had hy vọngd; they came thither, and were ashamed.
For now ye are nothing; ye see my casting down, Và are afraid. ye are…: or, ye are like to them: Heb. to it nothing: Heb. not
Did I say, Bring unto me? or, Give a reward for me of your substance?
Or, Deliver me from the enemy's tay? or, Redeem me from tay of the mighty?
Teach me, and I will hold my tongue: Và cause me to understand wherein I have erred.
How forcible are right những lời! but what doth your arguing reprove?
Do ye imagine to reprove những lời, Và the speeches of one that is desperate, which are as wind?
Yea, ye overwhelm chaless, Và ye dig a pit for your friend. ye overwhelm: Heb. ye cause to fall upon
Now therefore be content, look upon me; for it is evident cùng các ngươi if I lie. evident…: Heb. before your face
Return, I pray you, let it not be iniquity; yea, return again, my righteousness is in it. in it: that is, in this matter
Is there iniquity in my tongue? cannot my taste discern perverse things? my taste: Heb. my palate

CHAPTER 7.
Is there not an appointed time to man trên đất? are not his days also like the days of an hireling? an appointed…: or, a warfare
As a servant earnestly desireth the shadow, Và as an hireling looketh for the reward of his work: earnestly…: Heb. gapeth after
So am I made to possess months of vanity, Và wearisome nights are appointed to me.
When I lie down, I say, When shall I arise, Và the night be gone? Và I am full of tossings to and fro unto the dawning of the day. the night…: Heb. buổi chiều be measured?
My flesh is clothed with worms Và clods of dust; my skin is broken, Và become loathsome.
My days are swifter than a weaver's shuttle, Và are spent without hy vọng.
O remember that my sự sống is wind: mine eye shall no more thấy tốt. shall…: Heb. shall not return see: to see, that is, to enjoy
The eye of him that hath seen me sẽ thấy me no more: thine eyes are upon me, and I là not. I am…: that is, I can live no longer
As đám mây is consumed Và vanisheth away: so he that goeth down to the grave shall come up no more.
He shall return no more to his house, neither shall his place biết him any more.
Therefore I will not refrain my mouth; I will speak in the anguish of my spirit; I will complain in the bitterness of my soul.
là I a sea, or a whale, that ngươi settest a watch over me?
When I say, My bed shall comfort me, my couch shall ease my complaint;
Then ngươi scarest me with dreams, Và terrifiest me through visions:
So that my soul chooseth strangling, Và sự chết rather than my sự sống. sự sống: Heb. bones
I loathe it; I would not live alway: let me alone; for my days are vanity.
What is man, that ngươi shouldest magnify him? and that ngươi shouldest set thine heart upon him?
Và that ngươi shouldest visit him every morning, Và try him every moment?
How long wilt ngươi not depart from me, nor let me alone till I swallow down my spittle?
I have sinned; what shall I do unto ngươi, O ngươi preserver of men? why hast ngươi set me as a Mác against ngươi, so that I am a burden to myself?
Và why dost ngươi not pardon my transgression, Và take away mine iniquity? for now shall I sleep in the dust; Và ngươi shalt seek me in buổi sáng, but I shall not be.

CHAPTER 8.
Then trả lời Bildad the Shuhite, và nói,
How long wilt ngươi speak these things? and how long shall những lời of thy mouth be like a strong wind?
Doth God pervert judgment? or doth the Almighty pervert justice?
If thy children have sinned against him, and he have cast them away for their transgression; for…: Heb. in tay of their transgression
If ngươi wouldest seek unto God betimes, Và make thy supplication to the Almighty;
If thou wert pure Và upright; surely now he would awake for ngươi, and make the habitation of sự công chính của Ngài prosperous.
Though thy beginning was small, yet thy latter end should greatly increase.
For enquire, I pray ngươi, of the former age, Và prepare thyself to biểnrch of their fathers:
(For we are but of hôm qua, Và know nothing, because our days trên đất are a shadow:)nothing: Heb. not
Shall not they teach ngươi, Và tell ngươi, and utter những lời out of their heart?
Can the rush grow up without mire? can the flag grow without nước?
Whilst it is yet in his greenness, Và not cut down, it withereth before any other herb.
So are the paths of all that forget ĐCT; Và the hypocrite's hy vọng shall perish:
Whose hy vọng shall be cut off, Và whose trust shall be a spider's web. web: Heb. house
He shall lean upon his house, but it shall not stand: he shall hold it fast, but it shall not endure.
He is green before mặt trời, Và his branch shooteth forth in his garden.
His roots are wrapped about the heap, Và seeth the place of stones.
If he destroy him from his place, then it shall deny him, nói [rằng], I have not seen ngươi.
kìa, this is sự vui mừng of his way, Và out đất shall others grow.
kìa, God will not cast away a perfect man, neither will he help the evil doers: help…: Heb. take the ungodly by tay come: Heb. shall not be
Till he fill thy mouth with laughing, Và thy lips with rejoicing. rejoicing: Heb. shouting for joy
They that hate ngươi shall be clothed with shame; Và the ởing place of the wicked shall come to nought. shall come…: Heb. shall not be

CHAPTER 9.
Then Job trả lời và nói,
I know it is so of a truth: but how should man be just with God? with God: or, before God?
If he will contend with him, he cannot answer him one of a thousand.
He is khôn ngoan in heart, Và mighty in strength: who hath hardened himself against him, and hath prospered?
Which removeth núis, Và they know not: which overturneth them in his anger.
Which shaketh đất out of her place, Và the pillars thereof tremble.
Which commandeth mặt trời, Và it riseth not; and sealeth up ngôi saos.
Which alone spreadeth out các tầng trời, Và treadeth upon the waves of biển. waves: Heb. heights
Which maketh Arcturus, Orion, Và Pleiades, Và the chambers of the south. Arcturus…: Heb. Ash, Cesil, and Cimah
Which doeth great things past finding out; yea, and wonders without number.
Lo, he goeth by me, and I see him not: he passeth on also, but I perceive him not.
kìa, he taketh away, who can hinder him? who will say unto him, What doest thou? hinder…: Heb. turn him away?
nếu ĐCT will not withdraw his anger, the proud helpers do stoop under him. proud…: Heb. helpers of pride, or, strength
How much less shall I answer him, Và choose out my words to reason with him?
Whom, though I were righteous, yet would I not answer, but I would make supplication to my judge.
If I had called, Và he had trả lời me; yet would I not believe that he had hearkened unto my voice.
For he breaketh me with a tempest, Và multiplieth my wounds without cause.
He will not suffer me to take my breath, but filleth me with bitterness.
If I speak of strength, lo, he is strong: Và if of judgment, who shall set me a time to plead?
If I justify myself, mine own mouth shall kết án me: if I say, I là trọn vẹn, it shall also prove me perverse.
Though I were trọn vẹn, yet would I not know my soul: I would despise my sự sống.
This is một thing, Vậy tôi nói it, He destroyeth the perfect Và the wicked.
If the scourge slay bất chợt, he will laugh at the trial of the innocent.
đất is given into tay of the wicked: he covereth mặts of the judges thereof; if not, where, Và who is he?
Now my days are swifter than a post: they flee away, họ thấy no good.
They are passed away as the swift ships: as the eagle that hasteth to the prey. swift…: or, ships of Ebeh: Heb. ships of desire
If I say, I will forget my complaint, I will leave off my heaviness, Và comfort myself:
I am afraid of all my sorrows, I know that ngươi wilt not hold me innocent.
nếu I be wicked, why then labour I vô ích?
If I wash myself with snow water, Và make my hands never so clean;
Yet shalt ngươi plunge me in the ditch, Và mine own clothes shall abhor me. abhor…: or, make me to be abhorred
For he is not a man, as I am, that I should answer him, Và we should come together in judgment.
Neither is there any daysman betwixt us, that might lay his hand upon us both. any…: Heb. one that should argue daysman: or, umpire
Let him take his rod away from me, and let not his fear terrify me:
Rồi would I speak, Và not fear him; but it is not so with me. it is…: Heb. I am not so with myself

CHAPTER 10.
My soul is weary of my sự sống; I will leave my complaint upon myself; I will speak in the bitterness of my soul. weary…: or, cut off while I live
I will say unto God, Do not kết án me; shew me wherefore ngươi contendest with me.
Is it tốt unto ngươi that ngươi shouldest oppress, that ngươi shouldest despise the work of thine hands, Và shine upon the counsel of the wicked? work: Heb. labour
Hast ngươi eyes of flesh? or seest ngươi as man seeth?
Are thy days as the days of man? are thy years as man's ngày,
That ngươi enquirest after mine iniquity, Và searchest after my sin?
ngươi knowest that I am not wicked; and there is none that can deliver out of thine hand. Thou…: Heb. It is upon thy knowledge
Thine hands have made me and fashioned me together round about; yet ngươi dost destroy me. have…: Heb. took pains about me
nhớ, tôi nài khuyên ngươi, that ngươi hast made me as the clay; Và wilt ngươi bring me into dust again?
Hast ngươi not poured me out as milk, Và curdled me like cheese?
ngươi hast clothed me with skin Và flesh, Và hast fenced me with bones Và sinews. fenced: Heb. hedged
ngươi hast granted me sự sống Và favour, Và thy visitation hath preserved my spirit.
Và these things hast ngươi hid in thine heart: I know that this is with ngươi.
If I sin, then ngươi markest me, and ngươi wilt not acquit me from mine iniquity.
If I be wicked, khốn thay unto me; and nếu I be righteous, yet will I not lift up my head. I am full of confusion; therefore see ngươi mine affliction;
For it increaseth. ngươi huntest me as a fierce lion: Và again ngươi shewest thyself marvellous upon me.
ngươi renewest thy witnesses against me, and increasest thine indignation upon me; changes Và war are against me. witnesses: that is, plagues
Wherefore then hast ngươi brought me forth out of the womb? Oh that I had given up the ghost, Và no eye had seen me!
I should have been as though I had not been; I should have been carried from the womb to the grave.
Are not my days few? cease then, and let me alone, that I may take comfort a little,
Before I go whence I shall not return, even to the land của sự tối tăm Và the shadow of death;
A land của sự tối tăm, as darkness itself; and of the shadow of death, without any order, and where the light is as darkness.

CHAPTER 11.
Then trả lời Zophar the Naamathite, và nói,
Should not đám đông of words be trả lời? Và should a man full of talk be justified? full…: Heb. of lips
Should thy lies make men hold their peace? Và when ngươi mockest, shall không ai make ngươi ashamed? lies: or, devices
For ngươi hast nói, My doctrine is pure, Và I am clean in thine eyes.
Nhưng oh that ĐCT would speak, Và open his lips against ngươi;
Và that he would shew ngươi the secrets of wisdom, that họ là double to that which is! biết therefore that God exacteth of ngươi less than thine iniquity deserveth.
Canst ngươi by searching find out ĐCT? canst ngươi find out the Almighty unto perfection?
It is as high as heaven; what canst ngươi do? deeper than hell; what canst ngươi know? as high…: Heb. the heights of heaven
The measure thereof is longer than đất, Và broader than biển.
If he cut off, Và shut up, or gather together, then who can hinder him? cut…: or, make a change hinder…: Heb. turn him away?
For he knoweth vain men: he seeth wickedness also; will he not then consider it?
For vain man would be wise, though man be born like a wild ass's colt. vain: Heb. empty
If ngươi prepare thine heart, Và stretch out thine hands toward him;
If iniquity be in thine hand, put it far away, Và let not wickedness ở in thy tabernacles.
For then shalt ngươi lift up thy face without spot; yea, ngươi shalt be stedfast, Và shalt not fear:
Because ngươi shalt forget thy misery, Và nhớ it as waters that pass away:
Và thine age shall be clearer than the noonday; ngươi shalt shine forth, ngươi shalt be as buổi sáng. be clearer…: Heb. arise above
Và ngươi shalt be secure, because there is hy vọng; yea, ngươi shalt dig about ngươi, and ngươi shalt take thy rest in safety.
Also ngươi shalt lie down, and none shall make ngươi afraid; yea, many shall make suit cho ngươi. make suit…: Heb. intreat thy face
But the eyes of the wicked shall fail, Và they shall not escape, Và their hy vọng shall be as the giving up of the ghost. they shall…: Heb. flight shall perish from them the giving…: or, a puff of breath

CHAPTER 12.
Và Job trả lời và nói,
No doubt but ye are the people, Và wisdom sẽ chết with you.
Nhưng I have understanding as well as you; I là not inferior to you: yea, who knoweth not such things as these? understanding: Heb. an heart I am…: Heb. I fall not lower than you who…: Heb. with whom are not such as these?
I am as one mocked of his neighbour, who calleth upon God, Và he answereth him: the just upright man is laughed to scorn.
He that is ready to slip with his chân is as a lamp despised in the thought of him that is at ease.
đền tạms of robbers prosper, Và they that provoke ĐCT are secure; into whose hand ĐCT bringeth abundantly.
Nhưng ask now the beasts, Và they shall teach ngươi; and the fowls trên trời, Và they shall tell ngươi:
Or speak to đất, Và it shall teach ngươi: and the fishes of biển shall declare unto ngươi.
Who knoweth not in all these that tay of the CHÚA hath wrought this?
In whose hand is the soul of every living thing, Và the breath of all mankind. soul: or, sự sống all…: Heb. all flesh of man
Doth not the ear try những lời? Và the mouth taste his meat? mouth: Heb. palate
With the ancient is sự khôn ngoan; Và in length of days understanding.
With him is sự khôn ngoan Và strength, he hath counsel Và understanding. With…: that is, With God
kìa, he breaketh down, Và it cannot be built again: he shutteth up một người, Và there can be no opening. up: Heb. upon
kìa, he withholdeth the waters, Và they dry up: also he sendeth them out, Và they overturn đất.
With him is strength Và wisdom: the deceived Và the deceiver are his.
He leadeth counsellors away spoiled, Và maketh the judges fools.
He looseth the bond of kings, Và girdeth their loins with a girdle.
He leadeth princes away spoiled, Và overthroweth the mighty.
He removeth away the speech of the trusty, Và taketh away the understanding of the aged. speech…: Heb. lip of the faithful
He poureth contempt upon princes, Và weakeneth the strength of the mighty. weakeneth…: or, looseth the girdle of the strong
He discovereth deep things out of darkness, Và bringeth out to light the shadow of death.
He increaseth the nations, Và destroyeth them: he enlargeth the nations, Và straiteneth them again. straiteneth: Heb. leadeth in
He taketh away the heart of the chief của dân sự đất, Và causeth them to wander in a wilderness where there is no way.
They grope in the dark without light, Và he maketh them to stagger like a drunken man. stagger: Heb. wander

CHAPTER 13.
Lo, mine eye hath seen all này, mine ear hath heard Và understood it.
What ye know, the same do I know also: I là not inferior cùng các ngươi.
Surely I would speak to the Almighty, Và I desire to reason with God.
Nhưng ye are forgers of lies, ye are all physicians of no value.
O that ye would altogether hold your peace! Và it should be your wisdom.
nghe now my reasoning, Và hearken to the pleadings of my lips.
Will ye speak wickedly for God? Và talk deceitfully for him?
Will ye accept his person? will ye contend for God?
Is it good that he should search you out? or as one man mocketh another, do ye so mock him?
He will surely reprove you, if ye do secretly accept persons.
Shall not his excellency make you afraid? Và his dread fall upon you?
Your remembrances are like unto ashes, your bodies to bodies of clay.
Hold your peace, let me alone, that I may speak, Và let come on me what will. Hold…: Heb. Be silent from me
Wherefore do I take my flesh in my teeth, Và put my sự sống in mine hand?
Though he slay me, yet will I trust in him: but I will maintain mine own ways before him. maintain: Heb. prove, or, argue
He also shall be my salvation: for an hypocrite shall not come before him.
nghe diligently my speech, Và my declaration with your ears.
kìa now, I have ordered my cause; I know that I shall be justified.
Who is he that will plead with me? for now, if I hold my tongue, I shall give up the ghost.
Only do not two things unto me: then will I not hide myself from ngươi.
Withdraw thine hand far from me: and let not thy dread make me afraid.
Then call thou, and I will answer: or let me speak, Và answer ngươi me.
How many are mine iniquities Và tội lỗi? make me to know my transgression Và my sin.
Wherefore hidest ngươi thy face, Và holdest me for thine enemy?
Wilt ngươi break a leaf driven to and fro? Và wilt ngươi pursue the dry stubble?
For ngươi writest bitter things against me, and makest me to possess the iniquities of my youth.
ngươi puttest my feet also in the stocks, Và lookest narrowly unto all my paths; ngươi settest a print upon the heels of my feet. lookest…: Heb. observest heels: Heb. roots
Và he, as a rotten thing, consumeth, as a garment that is moth eaten.

CHAPTER 14.
Man that is born of một người đờn bà is of few ngày, Và full of trouble. few…: Heb. short of days
He cometh forth like a flower, Và is cut down: he fleeth also as a shadow, Và continueth not.
Và dost ngươi open thine eyes upon such an one, Và bringest me into judgment with ngươi?
Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean? not one. can…: Heb. will give
nhìn thấy his days are determined, the number of his months are with ngươi, ngươi hast appointed his bounds that he cannot pass;
Turn from him, that he may rest, till he shall accomplish, as an hireling, his day. rest: Heb. cease
For there is hy vọng of a tree, if it be cut down, that it will sprout again, Và that the tender branch thereof will not cease.
Though the root thereof wax old in đất, Và the stock thereof die in the ground;
Yet through the scent of water it will bud, Và bring forth boughs like a plant.
But man dieth, Và wasteth away: yea, man giveth up the ghost, and where is he? wasteth…: Heb. is weakened, or, cut off
As the waters fail from biển, Và the flood decayeth Và drieth up:
So man lieth down, Và riseth not: till the heavens be no more, they shall not awake, nor be raised out of their sleep.
O that ngươi wouldest hide me in the grave, that ngươi wouldest keep me secret, until thy wrath be past, that ngươi wouldest appoint me a set time, Và remember me!
If a man chết, shall he live again? all the days of my appointed time will I wait, till my change đến.
ngươi shalt call, Và I will answer ngươi: ngươi wilt have a desire to the work of thine hands.
For now ngươi numberest my steps: dost ngươi not watch over my sin?
My transgression is sealed up in a bag, Và ngươi sewest up mine iniquity.
Và surely núi falling cometh to nought, Và the rock is removed out of his place. cometh…: Heb. fadeth
The waters wear the stones: ngươi washest away the things which grow out of the dust đất; Và ngươi destroyest the hy vọng of man. washest…: Heb. overflowest
ngươi prevailest đến đời đời against him, and he passeth: ngươi changest his countenance, Và sendest him away.
His sons come to honour, Và he knoweth it not; and they are brought low, but he perceiveth it not of them.
But his flesh upon him shall have pain, Và his soul within him shall mourn.

CHAPTER 15.
Then trả lời Eliphaz the Temanite, và nói,
Should a wise man utter vain sự hiểu biết, Và fill his belly with the east wind? vain…: Heb. knowledge of wind
Should he reason with unprofitable talk? or with speeches wherewith he can do no good?
Yea, ngươi castest off fear, Và restrainest prayer before ĐCT. castest…: Heb. makest void prayer: or, speech
For thy mouth uttereth thine iniquity, Và ngươi choosest lưỡi of the crafty. uttereth: Heb. teacheth
Thine own mouth kết áneth ngươi, and not I: yea, thine own lips testify against ngươi.
Art ngươi the first man that was born? or wast ngươi made before the hills?
Hast ngươi heard the secret của ĐCT? Và dost ngươi restrain sự khôn ngoan to thyself?
What knowest thou, that we know not? what understandest thou, which is not in us?
With us are both the grayheaded Và very aged men, much elder than thy father.
Are the consolations của ĐCT small with ngươi? is there any secret thing with ngươi?
Tại sao doth thine heart carry ngươi away? Và what do thy eyes wink at,
That ngươi turnest thy spirit against God, and lettest such những lời go out of thy mouth?
What is man, that he should be clean? and he which is born of một người đờn bà, that he should be righteous?
kìa, he putteth no trust in his saints; yea, the heavens are not clean in his sight.
How much more abominable Và filthy is man, which uống iniquity like water?
I will shew ngươi, hear me; and that which I have seen I will declare;
Which wise men have told from their fathers, Và have not hid it:
Unto whom alone đất was given, Và no stranger passed among them.
The wicked man travaileth with pain all his ngày, Và the number of years is hidden to the oppressor.
A dreadful sound is in his ears: in prosperity the destroyer shall come upon him. A dreadful…: Heb. A sound of fears
He believeth not that he shall return out of darkness, Và he is waited for of thanh gươm.
He wandereth abroad for bread, nói [rằng], Where is it? he knoweth that the day của sự tối tăm is ready at his hand.
Trouble Và anguish shall make him afraid; they shall prevail against him, as a king ready to the battle.
For he stretcheth out his hand against God, Và strengtheneth himself against the Almighty.
He runneth upon him, even on his cổ, upon the thick bosses of his bucklers:
Because he covereth his face with his fatness, Và maketh collops of fat on his flanks.
Và he ởeth in desolate các thành, Và in houses which không ai inhabiteth, which are ready to become heaps.
He shall not be rich, neither shall his substance continue, neither shall he prolong the perfection thereof trên đất.
He shall not depart out of darkness; the flame shall dry up his branches, Và by the breath of his mouth shall he go away.
Let not him that is deceived trust in vanity: for vanity shall be his recompence.
It shall be accomplished before his time, Và his branch shall not be green. accomplished: or, cut off
He shall shake off his unripe grape as the vine, Và shall cast off his flower as the olive.
For the congregation of hypocrites shall be desolate, Và fire shall consume đền tạms of bribery.
They conceive mischief, Và bring forth vanity, Và their belly prepareth deceit. vanity: or, iniquity

CHAPTER 16.
Then Job trả lời và nói,
I have heard many such things: miserable comforters are ye all. miserable: or, troublesome
Shall vain những lời have an end? or what emboldeneth ngươi that ngươi answerest? vain…: Heb. words of wind
I also could speak as ye do: nếu your soul were in my soul's stead, I could heap up những lời against you, and shake mine head at you.
But I would strengthen you with my mouth, Và the moving of my lips should asswage your grief.
Though I speak, my grief is not asswaged: and though I forbear, what am I eased? what…: Heb. what goeth from me?
But now he hath made me weary: ngươi hast made desolate all my company.
Và ngươi hast filled me with wrinkles, which is một nhân chứng against me: Và my leanness rising up in me beareth witness to my face.
He teareth me in his wrath, who hateth me: he gnasheth upon me with his teeth; mine enemy sharpeneth his eyes upon me.
They have gaped upon me with their mouth; they have smitten me upon the cheek reproachfully; they have gathered themselves together against me.
ĐCT hath delivered me to the ungodly, Và turned me over into tays of the wicked. hath…: Heb. hath shut me up
I was at ease, but he hath broken me asunder: he hath also taken me by my neck, Và shaken me to pieces, Và set me up for his Mác.
His archers compass me round about, he cleaveth my reins asunder, Và doth not spare; he poureth out my gall upon the ground.
He breaketh me with breach trên breach, he runneth upon me like a giant.
I have sewed vải bố upon my skin, Và làm dơ dáyd my horn in the dust.
My face is foul with weeping, Và on my eyelids is the shadow of death;
Not for any injustice in mine hands: also my prayer is pure.
O đất, cover not ngươi my blood, Và let my cry have no place.
Also now, kìa, my witness is in heaven, Và my record is on high. on high: Heb. in the high places
My friends scorn me: but mine eye poureth out tears unto God. scorn me: Heb. are my scorners
O that one might plead for a man with God, as a man pleadeth for his neighbour!neighbour: or, friend
When a few năm are come, then I shall go đường whence I shall not return. a few…: Heb. years of number

CHAPTER 17.
My breath is corrupt, my days are extinct, the graves are ready for me. breath…: or, spirit is spent
Are there not mockers with me? and doth not mine eye continue in their provocation? continue: Heb. lodge
Lay down now, put me in a surety with ngươi; who is he that will strike hands with me?
For ngươi hast hid their heart from understanding: therefore shalt ngươi not exalt họ.
He that speaketh flattery to his friends, even the eyes of his children shall fail.
He hath made me also a byword của dân sự; Và aforetime I was as a tabret. aforetime: or, before them
Mine eye also is dim by reason of sorrow, Và all my members are as a shadow. my members: or, my thoughts
Upright men shall be astonied at this, and the innocent shall stir up himself against the hypocrite.
The righteous also shall hold on his way, Và he that hath clean hands shall be stronger and stronger. be…: Heb. add strength
Nhưng as for you all, do ye return, Và come now: for I cannot find one khôn ngoan man among you.
My days are past, my purposes are broken off, even the thoughts of my heart. the thoughts: Heb. the possessions
They change the night into day: the light is short vì của sự tối tăm. short: Heb. near
If I wait, the grave is mine house: I have made my bed in the darkness.
I have nói to corruption, Thou art my father: to the worm, ngươi art my mother, Và my sister. nói: Heb. cried, or, called
Và where is bây giờ my hy vọng? as for my hy vọng, who sẽ thấy it?
They shall go down to the bars of the pit, when our rest together is in the dust.

CHAPTER 18.
Then trả lời Bildad the Shuhite, và nói,
How long will it be ere ye make an end of words? Mác, Và afterwards we will speak.
Wherefore are we counted as beasts, Và reputed vile in your sight?
He teareth himself in his anger: shall đất be forsaken for ngươi? and shall the rock be removed out of his place? himself: Heb. his soul
Yea, the light of the wicked shall be put out, Và the spark of his fire shall not shine.
The light shall be dark in his tabernacle, Và his candle shall be put out with him. candle: or, lamp
The steps of his strength shall be straitened, Và his own counsel shall cast him down.
For he is cast into a net by his own feet, Và he walketh upon a snare.
The gin shall take him by the heel, Và the robber shall prevail against him.
The snare is laid for him in the ground, Và a trap for him in the way. laid: Heb. hidden
Terrors shall make him afraid on every side, Và shall drive him to his feet. drive: Heb. scatter
His strength shall be hungerbitten, Và destruction shall be ready at his side.
It shall devour the strength of his skin: even the firstborn of death shall devour his strength. strength: Heb. bars
His confidence shall be rooted out of his tabernacle, Và it shall bring him to the king of terrors.
It shall ở in his tabernacle, because it is none of his: brimstone shall be scattered upon his habitation.
His roots shall be dried up beneath, and above shall his branch be cut off.
His remembrance shall perish from đất, Và he shall have no name in the street.
He shall be driven from light into darkness, Và chased out of the world. He…: Heb. They shall drive him
He shall neither have son nor nephew among his people, nor any remaining in his ởings.
They that come after him shall be astonied at his day, as they that went before were affrighted. went…: or, lived with him were…: Heb. laid hold on horror
Surely such are the ởings of the wicked, and this is the place of him that biết not God.

CHAPTER 19.
Then Job trả lời và nói,
How long will ye vex my soul, Và break me in pieces with words?
These ten times have ye reproached me: ye are not ashamed that ye make yourselves strange to me. make…: or, harden yourselves against me
Và be it indeed that I have erred, mine error remaineth with myself.
If indeed ye will magnify yourselves against me, and plead against me my reproach:
biết bây giờ that God hath overthrown me, and hath compassed me with his net.
kìa, I cry out of wrong, but I am not heard: I cry aloud, but there is no judgment. wrong: or, violence
He hath fenced up my way that I cannot pass, Và he hath set tối tăm in my paths.
He hath stripped me of my glory, Và taken the crown từ my head.
He hath destroyed me on every side, Và I am gone: Và mine hy vọng hath he removed like a tree.
He hath also kindled his wrath against me, and he counteth me unto him as one of his enemies.
His troops đến together, Và raise up their way against me, and encamp round about my tabernacle.
He hath put my brethren far from me, and mine acquaintance are Quả thật estranged from me.
My kinsfolk have failed, Và my familiar friends have forgotten me.
They that ở in mine house, Và my maids, count me for a stranger: I am an alien in their sight.
I called my servant, and he gave me no answer; I intreated him with my mouth.
My breath is strange to my wife, though I intreated for the children's sake of mine own body. mine…: Heb. my belly
Yea, young children despised me; I arose, Và they spake against me. young…: or, the wicked
All my inward friends abhorred me: and they whom I loved are turned against me. my…: Heb. the men of my secret
My bone cleaveth to my skin Và to my flesh, Và I am escaped with the skin of my teeth. Và to: or, as to
Have pity upon me, have pity upon me, O ye my friends; for tay của ĐCT hath touched me.
Tại sao do ye persecute me as God, Và are not satisfied with my flesh?
Oh that my words were now written! oh that they were printed in a book!Oh…: Heb. Who will give, etc
That they were graven with an sắt pen Và lead in the rock đến đời đời!
Vì tôi biết that my redeemer liveth, and that he shall stand at the latter ngày trên đất:
Và though after my skin worms destroy this body, yet in my flesh shall I see ĐCT: And…: or, After I shall awake, though this body be destroyed, yet out of my flesh
Whom I sẽ thấy for myself, and mine eyes shall kìa, Và not another; though my reins be consumed within me. another: Heb. a stranger though…: or, my reins within me are consumed with earnest desire (for that day) within…: Heb. in my bosom
But ye should say, Tại sao persecute we him, seeing the root of the matter is found in me? seeing…: or, and what root of matter is found in me?
Be ye afraid of thanh gươm: for wrath bringeth the punishments of thanh gươm, that ye may know there is a judgment.

CHAPTER 20.
Then trả lời Zophar the Naamathite, và nói,
Therefore do my thoughts cause me to answer, and for này I make haste. I make…: Heb. my haste is in me
I have heard the check of my reproach, Và the spirit of my understanding causeth me to answer.
Knowest thou không this of old, since man was placed trên đất,
That the triumphing of the wicked is short, Và sự vui mừng of the hypocrite but for a moment? short: Heb. from near
Though his excellency mount up to the heavens, Và his head reach unto đám mâys; clouds: Heb. cloud
Yet he shall perish đến đời đời like his own dung: they which have seen him shall say, Where is he?
He shall fly away as a dream, Và shall not be found: yea, he shall be chased away as a vision of the night.
The eye also which nhìn thấy him shall see him no more; neither shall his place any more kìa him.
His children sẽ thấy to please người nghèo, Và his hands shall restore their goods. His children…: or, The poor shall oppress his children
His bones are full of the sin of his youth, which shall lie down with him in the dust.
Though wickedness be sweet in his mouth, though he hide it under his tongue;
Though he spare it, and forsake it not; but keep it still within his mouth: within…: Heb. in the midst of his palate
Yet his meat in his bowels is turned, it is the gall of asps within him.
He hath swallowed down riches, Và he shall vomit them up again: ĐCT shall cast them out of his belly.
He shall suck the poison of asps: the viper's lưỡi shall slay him.
He shall not see the rivers, the floods, the brooks of honey Và butter. the floods…: or, streaming brooks
That which he laboured for shall he restore, and shall not swallow it down: according to his substance shall the restitution be, Và he shall not rejoice therein. his…: Heb. the substance of his exchange
Because he hath oppressed Và hath forsaken người nghèo; vì he hath violently taken away một căn nhà which he builded not;oppressed: Heb. crushed
Surely he shall not feel quietness in his belly, he shall not save of that which he desired. feel: Heb. know
There shall none of his meat be left; therefore shall không ai look for his goods. none…: or, be none left for his meat
In the fulness of his sufficiency he shall be in straits: every hand of the wicked shall come upon him. wicked: or, troublesome
khi he is about to fill his belly, God shall cast the fury of his wrath upon him, and shall rain it upon him while he is eating.
He shall flee from the sắt weapon, Và the bow of steel shall strike him through.
It is drawn, Và cometh out khỏi xác; yea, the glittering thanh gươm cometh out of his gall: terrors are upon him.
All darkness shall be hid in his secret places: a fire not blown shall consume him; it shall go ill with him that is left in his tabernacle.
The heaven shall reveal his iniquity; Và đất sẽ chổi dậy against him.
The increase of his house shall depart, Và his goods shall flow away trong ngày of his wrath.
This is the portion of a wicked man from God, Và the heritage appointed unto him by God. appointed…: Heb. of his decree from God

CHAPTER 21.
But Job trả lời và nói,
nghe diligently my speech, Và let this be your consolations.
Suffer me that I may speak; Và after that I have spoken, mock on.
As for me, is my complaint to man? and if it were so, why should not my spirit be troubled? troubled: Heb. shortened?
Mác me, and be astonished, Và lay your tay upon your miệng. Mark…: Heb. Look unto me
Even when I remember I am afraid, Và trembling taketh hold on my flesh.
Wherefore do the wicked live, become old, yea, are mighty in power?
Their seed is established in their sight with them, and their offspring before their eyes.
Their houses are safe from fear, neither is the rod của ĐCT upon them. safe…: Heb. peace from
Their bull gendereth, Và faileth not; their cow calveth, Và casteth not her calf.
They send forth their little ones like a flock, Và their children dance.
They take the timbrel Và harp, Và rejoice at the sound of the organ.
They spend their days in wealth, Và in a moment go down to the grave. in wealth: or, in mirth
Therefore they say unto God, Depart from us; for we desire not the knowledge of thy ways.
What is the Almighty, that we should serve him? and what profit should we have, if we pray unto him?
Lo, their good is not in their hand: the counsel of the wicked is far from me.
How oft is the candle of the wicked put out! and how oft đến their destruction upon them! God distributeth sorrows in his anger. candle: or, lamp
They are as stubble before gió, Và as chaff that the storm carrieth away. carrieth: Heb. stealeth
ĐCT layeth up his iniquity for his children: he rewardeth him, and he shall know it. his iniquity: that is, the punishment of his iniquity
His eyes sẽ thấy his destruction, Và he shall drink of cơn thịnh nộ of the Almighty.
For what pleasure hath he in his house after him, when the number of his months is cut off in the midst?
Shall any teach ĐCT sự hiểu biết? seeing he judgeth those that are high.
One dieth in his full strength, being wholly at ease Và quiet. his…: Heb. his very, or, the strength of, his perfection
His breasts are full of milk, Và his bones are moistened with marrow. breasts: or, milk pails
Và another dieth in the bitterness of his soul, Và never eateth with pleasure.
They shall lie down alike in the dust, Và the worms shall cover them.
kìa, I know your thoughts, Và the devices which ye wrongfully imagine against me.
For ye say, Where is nhà of the prince? and where are the ởing places of the wicked? the ởing…: Heb. the tent of đền tạms
Have ye not asked them that go by the way? Và do ye not know their tokens,
That the wicked is reserved to the day of destruction? they shall be brought forth to the day of wrath. wrath: Heb. wraths
Who shall declare his way to his face? Và who shall repay him what he hath done?
Yet shall he be brought to the grave, Và shall remain in the tomb. grave: Heb. graves remain…: Heb. watch in the heap
The clods of the valley shall be sweet unto him, and every man shall draw after him, as there are innumerable before him.
How then comfort ye me vô ích, seeing in your answers there remaineth falsehood? falsehood: Heb. transgression?

CHAPTER 22.
Then Eliphaz the Temanite trả lời và nói,
Can a man be profitable unto God, as he that is wise may be profitable unto himself? as he…: or, if he may be profitable, doth his good success depend thereon?
Is it any pleasure to the Almighty, that ngươi art righteous? or is it gain to him, that ngươi makest thy ways trọn vẹn?
Will he reprove ngươi for fear of ngươi? will he enter with ngươi into judgment?
Is not thy wickedness great? Và thine iniquities infinite?
For ngươi hast taken a pledge from thy brother for nought, Và stripped the naked of their clothing. the naked…: Heb. the clothes of the naked
ngươi hast not given water to the weary để uống, Và ngươi hast withholden bánh from the hungry.
But as for the mighty man, he had đất; Và the honourable man dwelt in it. mighty…: Heb. man of arm honourable…: Heb. eminent, or, accepted for countenance
ngươi hast sent widows away empty, Và the arms of chaless have been broken.
Therefore snares are round about ngươi, and sudden fear troubleth ngươi;
Or darkness, that ngươi canst not see; Và abundance of waters cover ngươi.
Is not God in the height of heaven? Và kìa the height of ngôi saos, how high they are!height of ngôi saos: Heb. head of ngôi saos
Và ngươi sayest, How doth God biết? can he judge through the dark cloud? How: or, What
Thick clouds are a covering to him, that he seeth not; and he walketh in the circuit of heaven.
Hast ngươi marked the old way which wicked men have trodden?
Which were cut down out of time, whose foundation was overflown with a flood: whose…: Heb. a flood was poured upon their foundation
Which nói unto God, Depart from us: and what can the Almighty do for them? for: or, to
Yet he filled their houses with good things: but the counsel of the wicked is far from me.
The righteous thấy it, Và are glad: Và the innocent laugh them to scorn.
Whereas our substance is not cut down, but the remnant of them the fire consumeth. substance: or, estate the remnant…: or, their excellency
Acquaint now thyself with him, and be at peace: thereby good shall come unto ngươi. him: that is, God
nhận, I pray ngươi, the law from his mouth, Và lay up his words in thine heart.
If ngươi return to the Almighty, ngươi shalt be built up, ngươi shalt put away iniquity far from thy tabernacles.
Then shalt ngươi lay up gold as dust, and the gold of Ophir as the stones of the brooks. as dust: or, on the dust
Yea, the Almighty shall be thy defence, Và ngươi shalt have plenty of silver. defence: or, gold plenty…: Heb. silver of strength
For then shalt ngươi have thy delight in the Almighty, Và shalt lift up thy face unto God.
ngươi shalt make thy prayer unto him, and he shall hear ngươi, and ngươi shalt pay thy vows.
ngươi shalt also decree a thing, Và it shall be established unto ngươi: and the light shall shine upon thy ways.
When men are cast down, then ngươi shalt say, There is lifting up; Và he shall save the humble person. the humble…: Heb. him that hath low eyes
He shall deliver the island of the innocent: Và it is delivered by the pureness of thine hands. He shall…: or, The innocent shall deliver the island

CHAPTER 23.
Then Job trả lời và nói,
Even to day is my complaint bitter: my stroke is heavier than my groaning. stroke: Heb. hand
Oh that I knew where I might find him! that I might come even to his seat!
I would order my cause before him, and fill my mouth with arguments.
I would know những lời which he would answer me, and understand what he would say unto me.
Will he plead against me with his great power? No; but he would put strength in me.
There the righteous might dispute with him; so should I be delivered đến đời đời from my judge.
kìa, I go forward, but he is not there; Và backward, but I cannot perceive him:
On the tay trái, where he doth work, but I cannot kìa him: he hideth himself on the tay phải, that I cannot see him:
But he knoweth đường that I take: khi he hath tried me, I shall come forth as gold. that…: Heb. that is with me
My foot hath held his steps, his way have I kept, Và not declined.
Neither have I gone back from the commandment of his lips; I have esteemed những lời of his mouth more than my necessary food. esteemed: Heb. hid, or, laid up my…: or, my appointed portion
But he is in one mind, Và who can turn him? and what his soul desireth, even that he doeth.
For he performeth the thing that is appointed for me: and many such things are with him.
Therefore am I troubled at his presence: when I consider, I am afraid of him.
For God maketh my heart soft, Và the Almighty troubleth me:
Because I was not cut off before the darkness, neither hath he covered the darkness from my face.

CHAPTER 24.
Tại sao, seeing times are not hidden from the Almighty, do they that know him not see his days?
Some remove the landmarks; they violently take away flocks, Và feed thereof. feed…: or, feed them
They drive away the ass of chaless, they take the widow's ox for a pledge.
They turn the needy out of the way: người nghèo đất hide themselves together.
kìa, as wild asses in the desert, go they forth to their work; rising betimes for a prey: đồng vắng yieldeth food for them Và for their children.
They reap every one his corn in the field: Và they gather the vintage of the wicked. corn: Heb. mingled corn, or, dredge they gather…: Heb. the wicked gather the vintage
They cause the naked to lodge without clothing, that they have no covering in the cold.
They are wet with the showers of núis, Và embrace the rock for want of a shelter.
They pluck chaless from the breast, Và take a pledge of the poor.
They cause him to go lỏa lồ without clothing, Và they take away the sheaf từ the hungry;
Which make oil within their walls, Và tread their winepresses, Và suffer thirst.
Men groan from out of the city, Và the soul of the wounded crieth out: yet God layeth not folly to them.
They are of those that rebel against the light; they know not the ways thereof, nor abide in the paths thereof.
The murderer rising with the light killeth người nghèo Và needy, Và in the night is as a thief.
The eye also of the adulterer waiteth for the twilight, nói [rằng], No eye sẽ thấy me: and disguiseth his mặt. disguiseth…: Heb. setteth his face in secret
In the dark they dig through houses, which they had marked for themselves trong ngàytime: they know not the light.
For buổi sáng is to them even as the shadow of death: if one biết them, they are in the terrors of the shadow of death.
He is swift as the waters; their portion is cursed in đất: he kìaeth not the way of the vườn nhos.
Drought Và heat consume the snow waters: so doth the grave those which have sinned. consume: Heb. violently take
The womb shall forget him; the worm shall feed sweetly on him; he shall be no more nhớ lại; Và wickedness shall be broken as a tree.
He evil entreateth the barren that beareth not: and doeth not good to the widow.
He draweth also the mighty with his power: he riseth up, and no man is sure của sự sống. no…: or, he trusteth not his own sự sống
Though it be given him to be in safety, whereon he resteth; yet his eyes are upon their ways.
They are exalted for ít lâu, but are gone and brought low; they are taken out of the way as all other, Và cut off as the tops of the ears of corn. are gone: Heb. are not taken…: Heb. closed up
Và if it be not so bây giờ, who will make me a liar, Và make my speech nothing worth?

CHAPTER 25.
Then trả lời Bildad the Shuhite, và nói,
Dominion Và fear are with him, he maketh peace in his high places.
Is there any number of his armies? Và upon whom doth not his light Hãy chổi dậy?
How then can man be justified with God? or how can he be clean that is born of một người đờn bà?
kìa even to the moon, Và it shineth not; yea, ngôi saos are not pure in his sight.
How much less man, that is a worm? Và the son of man, which is a worm?

CHAPTER 26.
But Job trả lời và nói,
How hast ngươi helped him that is without power? how savest ngươi the arm that hath no strength?
How hast ngươi counselled him that hath no sự khôn ngoan? and how hast ngươi plentifully declared the thing as it is?
To whom hast ngươi uttered những lời? Và whose spirit đến from ngươi?
Dead things are formed from under the waters, Và the inhabitants thereof. Và the…: or, with the inhabitants
Hell is lỏa lồ before him, and destruction hath no covering.
He stretcheth out the north over the empty place, Và hangeth đất upon nothing.
He bindeth up the waters in his thick clouds; Và đám mây is not rent under them.
He holdeth back mặt of his throne, Và spreadeth his cloud upon it.
He hath compassed the waters with bounds, until the day Và night come to an end. until…: Heb. until the end of light with darkness
The pillars of heaven tremble Và are astonished at his reproof.
He divideth biển with his power, Và by his understanding he smiteth through the proud. the proud: Heb. pride
By his spirit he hath garnished các tầng trời; his hand hath formed the crooked con rắn.
Lo, these are parts of his ways: but how little a portion is heard of him? but the thunder of his power who can understand?

CHAPTER 27.
Moreover Job continued his parable, và nói,continued: Heb. added to take up
As ĐCT liveth, ai hath taken away my judgment; Và the Almighty, ai hath vexed my soul; vexed…: Heb. made my soul bitter
All the while my breath is in me, and the spirit của ĐCT is in my nostrils; the spirit…: that is, the breath which God gave him
My lips shall not speak wickedness, nor my tongue utter deceit.
không hề vậy that I should justify you: till I die I will not remove mine integrity from me.
My righteousness I hold fast, and will not let it go: my heart shall not reproach me so long as I live. so long…: Heb. from my days
Let mine enemy be as the wicked, Và he that riseth up against me as the unrighteous.
For what is the hy vọng of the hypocrite, though he hath gained, when God taketh away his soul?
Will God nghe his cry when trouble đến upon him?
Will he delight himself in the Almighty? will he always call upon God?
I will teach you by tay của ĐCT: that which is with the Almighty will I not conceal. by…: or, being in tay, etc
kìa, all ye yourselves have seen it; why then are ye thus altogether vain?
This is the portion of a wicked man with God, Và the heritage of oppressors, which they shall receive of the Almighty.
If his children be multiplied, it is for thanh gươm: Và his offspring shall not be satisfied with bread.
Those that remain of him shall be buried in death: Và his widows shall not weep.
Though he heap up silver as the dust, Và prepare raiment as the clay;
He may prepare it, but the just shall put it on, Và the innocent shall divide the silver.
He buildeth his house as a moth, Và as a booth that the keeper maketh.
The rich man shall lie down, but he shall not be gathered: he openeth his eyes, and he is not.
Terrors take hold on him as waters, a tempest stealeth him away in the night.
The east wind carrieth him away, Và he departeth: Và as a storm hurleth him out of his place.
For God shall cast upon him, and not spare: he would fain flee out of his hand. he…: Heb. in fleeing he would flee
Men shall clap their hands at him, and shall hiss him out of his place.

CHAPTER 28.
Surely there is a vein for the silver, Và một chỗ for gold where they fine it. vein: or, mine
sắt is taken out đất, Và brass is molten out of Hòn đá. đất: or, dust
He setteth an end to darkness, Và searcheth out all perfection: the stones của sự tối tăm, Và the shadow of death.
The flood breaketh out from the inhabitant; even the waters forgotten of the foot: they are dried up, they are gone away from men.
As for đất, out of it cometh bánh: Và under it is turned up as it were fire.
The stones of it are the place of sapphires: Và it hath dust of gold. dust…: or, gold ore
There is a path which no fowl biết, Và which the vulture's mắt hath not seen:
The lion's whelps have not trodden it, nor the fierce lion passed by it.
He putteth forth his hand upon the rock; he overturneth núis by the roots. rock: or, flint
He cutteth out rivers among the rocks; Và his eye seeth every precious thing.
He bindeth the floods from overflowing; and the thing that is hid bringeth he forth to light. overflowing: Heb. weeping
But where shall wisdom be found? and where is the place of understanding?
Man biết not the price thereof; neither is it found in the land of the living.
The depth nói, It is not in me: and biển nói, It is not with me.
It cannot be gotten for gold, neither shall silver be weighed for the price thereof. It…: Heb. Fine gold shall not be given for it
It cannot be valued with the gold of Ophir, with the precious onyx, or the sapphire.
vàng Và the crystal cannot equal it: and the exchange of it shall not be for jewels of fine gold. jewels…: or, vessels of
No mention shall be made of coral, or of pearls: for the price of wisdom is above rubies. coral: or, Ramoth
The topaz of Ethiopia shall not equal it, neither shall it be valued with pure gold.
Whence then cometh sự khôn ngoan? and where is the place of understanding?
Seeing it is hid from the eyes of all living, Và kept close from the fowls trên trời. air: or, heaven
Destruction Và death say, We have heard the fame thereof with our ears.
ĐCT understandeth đường thereof, and he knoweth the place thereof.
For he looketh to the ends đất, Và seeth under the whole heaven;
To make the weight for gió; Và he weigheth the waters by measure.
When he made a decree for the rain, Và a way for the lightning of the thunder:
Then did he see it, and declare it; he prepared it, yea, and searched it out. declare…: or, number it
Và unto man he nói, kìa, the fear của ĐCT, that is sự khôn ngoan; Và to depart from evil is understanding.

CHAPTER 29.
Moreover Job continued his parable, và nói,continued: Heb. added to take up
Oh that I were as trong months past, as trong the days khi ĐCT preserved me;
When his candle shined upon my head, Và when by his light I walked through tối tăm; candle: or, lamp
As I was trong những ngày of my youth, when the secret của ĐCT was upon my tabernacle;
When the Almighty was yet with me, khi my children were about me;
When I washed my steps with butter, Và the rock poured me out rivers of oil; me: Heb. with me
When I went out to cổng through the city, khi I prepared my seat in the street!
The young men nhìn thấy me, and hid themselves: and the aged arose, Và stood up.
The princes refrained talking, Và laid their tay on their mouth.
The nobles held their peace, Và their tongue cleaved to the roof of their mouth. The nobles…: Heb. The voice of the nobles was hid
When the ear nghe me, then it blessed me; and when the eye nhìn thấy me, it gave witness to me:
Because I delivered người nghèo that cried, Và chaless, and him that had none to help him.
The blessing of him that was ready to perish đến upon me: and I caused the widow's heart to sing for joy.
I put on righteousness, Và it clothed me: my judgment was as a robe Và a diadem.
I was eyes to the blind, Và feet was I to the lame.
I was a father to the poor: Và the cause which I knew not I searched out.
Và I brake the jaws of the wicked, Và plucked the spoil out of his teeth. the jaws: Heb. the jawteeth, or, the grinders plucked: Heb. cast
Then tôi nói, I shall die in my nest, Và I shall multiply my ngày as the sand.
My root was spread out by the waters, Và the dew lay all night upon my branch. spread…: Heb. opened
My glory was fresh in me, Và my bow was renewed in my hand. fresh: Heb. new renewed: Heb. changed
Unto me men gave ear, Và waited, Và kept silence at my counsel.
After my words they spake not again; Và my speech dropped upon them.
Và they waited for me as for the rain; Và they opened their mouth wide as for the latter rain.
nếu I laughed on them, they believed it not; and the light of my countenance they cast not down.
I chose out their way, Và sat chief, Và dwelt as a king in the army, as one that comforteth the mourners.

CHAPTER 30.
But now they that are younger than I have me in derision, whose fathers I would have disdained to have set with the dogs of my flock. younger…: Heb. of fewer days than I
Yea, whereto might the strength of their hands profit me, in whom old age was perished?
For want Và famine they were solitary; fleeing into the wilderness in former time desolate Và waste. solitary: or, dark as the night in…: Heb. yesternight
Who cut up mallows by the bushes, Và juniper roots for their meat.
They were driven forth from among men, ( they cried after them as after a thief;)
To ở in the clifts of the valleys, trong caves đất, and trong the rocks. caves: Heb. holes
Among the bushes they brayed; under the nettles they were gathered together.
They were children of fools, yea, children of base men: they were viler than đất. base…: Heb. men of no name
Và now am I their song, yea, I am their byword.
They abhor me, they flee far from me, and spare not to spit in my face. and…: Heb. and withhold not spittle from
Because he hath loosed my cord, Và afflicted me, they have also let loose the bridle before me.
Upon my right tay rise the youth; they push away my feet, Và they raise up against me the ways of their destruction.
They mar my path, they set forward my calamity, they have no helper.
They came upon me as a wide breaking in of waters: trong the desolation they rolled themselves upon me.
Terrors are turned upon me: they pursue my soul as the wind: Và my welfare passeth away as a cloud. my soul: Heb. my principal one
Và now my soul is poured out upon me; the days of affliction have taken hold upon me.
My bones are pierced in me in the night season: Và my sinews take no rest.
By the great force of my disease is my garment changed: it bindeth me about as the collar of my coat.
He hath cast me into the mire, Và I am become like dust Và ashes.
I cry unto ngươi, and ngươi dost not hear me: I stand up, Và ngươi regardest me không.
ngươi art become cruel to me: with thy strong tay ngươi opposest thyself against me. become…: Heb. turned to be cruel thy…: Heb. the strength of thy hand
ngươi liftest me up to the wind; ngươi causest me to ride upon it, Và dissolvest my substance. substance: or, wisdom
Vì tôi biết that ngươi wilt bring me to sự chết, and to nhà appointed for all living.
Howbeit he will not stretch out his tay to the grave, though they cry in his destruction. grave: Heb. heap
Did not I weep for him that was in trouble? was không my soul grieved for the poor? in trouble: Heb. hard of day?
When I looked for good, then evil đến unto me: Và when I waited for light, there came tối tăm.
My bowels boiled, Và rested not: the days of affliction prevented me.
I went than khóc without mặt trời: I stood up, Và I cried in the congregation.
I am a brother to dragons, Và a companion to owls. owls: or, ostriches
My skin is black upon me, and my bones are burned with heat.
My harp also is turned to than khóc, Và my organ into the voice of them that weep.

CHAPTER 31.
I made a covenant with mine eyes; why then should I think upon a maid?
For what portion của ĐCT is there from above? and what inheritance of the Almighty from on high?
Is not destruction to the wicked? Và a strange punishment to the workers of iniquity?
Doth not he see my ways, Và count all my steps?
If I have walked with vanity, or if my foot hath hasted to deceit;
Let me be weighed in an even balance, that God may know mine integrity. Let…: Heb. Let him weigh me in balances of justice
If my step hath turned out of the way, Và mine heart walked after mine eyes, Và if any blot hath cleaved to mine hands;
Rồi let me sow, Và let another ăn; yea, let my offspring be rooted out.
If mine heart have been deceived by một người đờn bà, or nếu I have laid wait at my neighbour's cửa;
Rồi let my wife grind unto another, Và let others bow down upon her.
For this is an heinous crime; yea, it is an iniquity to be punished by the judges.
For it is a fire that consumeth to destruction, Và would root out all mine increase.
If I did despise the cause of my manservant or of my maidservant, when they contended with me;
What then shall I do when God riseth up? Và when he visiteth, what shall I answer him?
Did not he that made me in the womb make him? and did not one fashion us in the womb? did not one…: or, did he not fashion us in one womb?
If I have withheld người nghèo from their desire, or have caused the eyes of the widow to fail;
Or have eaten my morsel myself alone, and chaless hath not eaten thereof; (For from my youth he was brought up with me, as với a father, Và I have guided her from my mother's womb;)her: that is, the widow
If I have seen any perish for want of clothing, or any poor without covering;
If his loins have not blessed me, and nếu he were không warmed with the fleece of my sheep;
If I have lifted up my hand against chaless, when I saw cứu cánh tôi in cổng:
Rồi let mine arm fall from my shoulder blade, Và mine arm be broken from the bone. bone: or, chanelbone
For destruction từ ĐCT was a terror to me, and by reason of his highness I could not endure.
If I have made gold my hy vọng, or have nói to the fine gold, ngươi art my confidence;
If I rejoiced because my wealth was great, Và because mine hand had gotten much; gotten…: Heb. found much
If I beheld mặt trời when it shined, or the moon walking trong brightness; sun: Heb. light in…: Heb. bright
Và my heart hath been secretly enticed, or my mouth hath kissed my hand: my mouth…: Heb. my hand hath kissed my mouth
This also were an iniquity to be punished by the judge: for I should have denied ĐCT that is above.
If I rejoiced at the destruction of him that hated me, or lifted up myself when evil found him:
Neither have I suffered my mouth to sin by wishing a curse to his soul. mouth: Heb. palate
If the men of my tabernacle nói not, Oh that we had of his flesh! we cannot be satisfied.
The stranger did not lodge in the street: but I opened my doors to the traveller. traveller: or, way
If I covered my transgressions as Adam, by hiding mine iniquity in my bosom: as Adam: or, after the manner of men
Did I fear a great multitude, or did the contempt of families terrify me, that I kept silence, Và went not out of the door?
Oh that one would hear me! kìa, my desire is, that the Almighty would answer me, and that mine adversary had written a book. my…: or, my sign is that the Almighty will
Surely I would take it upon my shoulder, Và cột it as a crown to me.
I would declare unto him the number of my steps; as a prince would I go near unto him.
If my land cry against me, or that the furrows cũng như vậy thereof complain; complain: Heb. weep
If I have eaten the fruits thereof without money, or have caused the owners thereof to lose their sự sống: fruits: Heb. strength the owners…: Heb. the soul of the owners thereof to expire, or, breathe out
Let thistles grow instead of wheat, Và cockle instead of barley. những lời of Job are ended. cockle: or, noisome weeds

CHAPTER 32.
So these three men ceased to answer Gióp, because he was công chính in his own eyes. to…: Heb. from answering
Then was kindled cơn thịnh nộ of Elihu con trai of Barachel the Buzite, of the kindred of Ram: against Job was his wrath kindled, because he justified himself rather than God. himself: Heb. his soul
Also against his three friends was his wrath kindled, because they had found no answer, and yet had kết án Gióp.
Now Elihu had waited till Job had spoken, because they were elder than he. waited…: Heb. expected Job in words elder: Heb. elder for days
When Elihu nhìn thấy that there was no answer in the mouth of these ba men, then his wrath was kindled.
Và Elihu con trai of Barachel the Buzite trả lời và nói, I là young, and ye are very old; wherefore I was afraid, Và durst not shew you mine opinion. young: Heb. few of days durst…: Heb. feared
tôi nói, ngày should speak, Và multitude of years should teach sự khôn ngoan.
Nhưng there is a spirit in man: Và the inspiration of the Almighty giveth them understanding.
Great men are not always khôn ngoan: neither do the aged understand judgment.
Vậy tôi nói, Hearken to me; I also will shew mine opinion.
kìa, I waited for your words; I gave ear to your reasons, whilst ye searched out what to say. reasons: Heb. understandings what…: Heb. words
Yea, I attended cùng các ngươi, and, kìa, there was none of you that convinced Gióp, or that trả lời his words:
Lest ye should say, We have found out sự khôn ngoan: ĐCT thrusteth him down, not man.
Now he hath not directed his những lời against me: neither will I answer him with your speeches. directed: or, ordered
They were amazed, Họ trả lời no more: they left off speaking. left…: Heb. removed speeches from themselves
When I had waited, ( for they spake not, but stood still, Và trả lời no more;)
tôi nói, I will answer also my part, I also will shew mine opinion.
For I am full of matter, the spirit within me constraineth me. matter: Heb. words spirit…: Heb. spirit of my belly
kìa, my belly is as wine which hath no vent; it is ready to burst like new bottles. hath…: Heb. is not opened
I will speak, that I may be refreshed: I will open my lips Và answer. be…: Heb. breathe
Let me not, I pray you, accept any man's person, neither let me give flattering titles unto man.
Vì tôi biết not để cho flattering titles; in so doing my maker would soon take me away.

CHAPTER 33.
Wherefore, Gióp, I pray ngươi, hear my speeches, Và hearken to all my words.
kìa, now I have opened my mouth, my tongue hath spoken in my mouth. in my mouth: Heb. in my palate
My words shall be of the uprightness of my heart: Và my lips shall utter sự hiểu biết clearly.
The Spirit của ĐCT hath made me, and the breath of the Almighty hath given me sự sống.
If ngươi canst answer me, set thy words in order before me, stand up.
kìa, I là according to thy wish in God's stead: I also am formed out of the clay. wish: Heb. mouth formed: Heb. cut
kìa, my terror shall not make ngươi afraid, neither shall my hand be heavy upon ngươi.
Surely ngươi hast spoken in mine hearing, Và I have heard tiếng of thy những lời, nói [rằng],hearing: Heb. ears
I am clean without transgression, I là innocent; neither is there iniquity in me.
kìa, he tìm occasions against me, he counteth me for his enemy,
He putteth my feet in the stocks, he marketh all my paths.
kìa, trong this ngươi art not just: I will answer ngươi, that God is greater than man.
Tại sao dost ngươi strive against him? for he giveth not account of any of his matters. he giveth…: Heb. he answereth not
For God speaketh once, yea twice, yet man perceiveth it not.
In a dream, in a vision of the night, when deep sleep falleth upon men, in slumberings upon the bed;
Then he openeth the ears of men, Và sealeth their instruction,he…: Heb. he revealeth, or, uncovereth
That he may withdraw man from his purpose, Và hide pride from man. purpose: Heb. work
He keepeth back his soul from the pit, Và his sự sống from perishing by thanh gươm. from perishing: Heb. from passing
He is chastened also with pain upon his bed, Và đám đông of his bones with strong pain:
So that his sự sống abhorreth bánh, Và his soul dainty meat. dainty…: Heb. meat of desire
His flesh is consumed away, that it cannot be seen; Và his bones that were not seen stick out.
Yea, his soul draweth near unto the grave, Và his sự sống to the destroyers.
If there be a messenger with him, an interpreter, một among a thousand, to shew unto man his uprightness:
