Then he is gracious unto him, and nói, Deliver him from going down to the pit: I have found a ransom. a ransom: or, an atonement
His flesh shall be fresher than a child's: he shall return to the days of his youth: a child's: Heb. childhood
He shall pray unto God, Và he will be favourable unto him: and he sẽ thấy his face with joy: for he will render unto man his righteousness.
He looketh upon men, and if any say, I have sinned, Và perverted that which was right, Và it profited me not;He…: or, He shall look upon men, and say
He will deliver his soul from going into the pit, Và his sự sống sẽ thấy the light. He…: or, He hath delivered my soul, etc, and my sự sống
Lo, all these things worketh ĐCT oftentimes with man,oftentimes: Heb. twice and thrice
To bring back his soul from the pit, to be enlightened with the light of the living.
Mark well, O Job, hearken unto me: hold thy peace, Và I will speak.
If ngươi hast any thing to say, answer me: speak, for I desire to justify ngươi.
If not, hearken unto me: hold thy peace, Và I shall teach ngươi wisdom.

CHAPTER 34.
Furthermore Elihu trả lời và nói,
nghe my words, O ye wise men; Và give ear unto me, ye that have knowledge.
For the ear trieth những lời, as the mouth tasteth meat. mouth: Heb. palate
Let us choose to us judgment: let us know among ourselves what is tốt.
For Job hath nói, I am righteous: Và ĐCT hath taken away my judgment.
Should I lie against my right? my wound is incurable without transgression. my wound: Heb. mine arrow
What man is like Job, ai uống up scorning like water?
Which goeth in company with the workers of iniquity, Và walketh with wicked men.
For he hath nói, It profiteth một người nothing that he should delight himself with God.
Therefore hearken unto me, ye men of understanding: far be it from God, that he should do wickedness; and từ the Almighty, that he should commit iniquity. men…: Heb. men of heart
For the work of a man shall he render unto him, and cause every man to find according to his ways.
Yea, surely ĐCT will not do wickedly, neither will the Almighty pervert judgment.
Who hath given him a charge over đất? or who hath disposed the whole world? the whole: Heb. all of it?
If he set his heart upon man, nếu he gather unto himself his spirit Và his breath; man: Heb. him
All flesh shall perish together, Và man shall turn again unto dust.
If now ngươi hast understanding, nghe this: hearken to the voice of my words.
Shall even he that hateth right govern? Và wilt ngươi kết án him that is most just? govern: Heb. bind?
Is it fit to say to a king, ngươi art gian ác? Và to princes, Ye are ungodly?
How much less to him that accepteth not the persons of princes, nor regardeth the rich more than người nghèo? for they all are the work of his hands.
In a moment shall they die, Và the people shall be troubled at midnight, Và pass away: Và the mighty shall be taken away without hand. the mighty…: Heb. they shall take away the mighty
For his eyes are upon the ways of man, Và he seeth all his goings.
There is no darkness, nor shadow of death, where the workers of iniquity may hide themselves.
For he will not lay upon man more than right; that he should enter into judgment with God. enter: Heb. go
He shall break in pieces mighty men without number, Và set Những người khác in their stead. number: Heb. searching out
Therefore he knoweth their works, Và he overturneth họ in the night, so that they are destroyed. destroyed: Heb. crushed
He striketh them as những người gian ác in the open sight of others;open…: Heb. place of kìaers
Because they turned back from him, Và would not consider any of his ways: him: Heb. after him
So that they cause the cry of the poor to come unto him, and he nghe the cry of the afflicted.
When he giveth quietness, who then can make trouble? Và when he hideth his mặt, who then can kìa him? whether it be done against a nation, or against a man only:
That the hypocrite reign not, lest the people be ensnared.
Surely it is meet to be nói unto God, I have borne chastisement, I will not offend any more:
That which I see không teach ngươi me: if I have done iniquity, I will do no more.
Should it be according to thy mind? he will recompense it, whether ngươi refuse, or whether ngươi choose; Và not I: therefore speak what ngươi knowest. according…: Heb. from with ngươi?
Let men of understanding tell me, and let a wise man hearken unto me. of…: Heb. of heart
Gióp hath spoken without knowledge, Và his words were without wisdom.
My desire is that Gióp may be tried unto the end vì cớ his answers for wicked men. My…: or, My father, let Job be tried
For he addeth rebellion unto his sin, he clappeth his hands among us, and multiplieth his words against God.

CHAPTER 35.
Elihu nói moreover, and nói,
Thinkest ngươi this to be right, that ngươi nóist, My righteousness is more than God's?
For ngươi nóist, What advantage will it be unto ngươi? Và, What profit shall I have, if I be cleansed from my sin? if…: or, by it more than by my sin
I will answer ngươi, and thy companions with ngươi. answer…: Heb. return to ngươi words
Look unto the heavens, Và see; Và kìa đám mâys which are higher than thou.
If ngươi sinnest, what doest ngươi against him? or nếu thy transgressions be multiplied, what doest ngươi unto him?
If ngươi be righteous, what givest ngươi him? or what nhận he of thine hand?
Thy wickedness may hurt một người as thou art; Và sự công chính của Ngài may profit con trai of man.
By reason of đám đông of oppressions they make the oppressed to cry: they cry out by reason of the arm of the mighty.
But none nói, Where is ĐCT my maker, who giveth songs in the night;
Who teacheth us more than the beasts đất, Và maketh us wiser than the fowls of heaven?
There they cry, but none giveth answer, vì of the pride of evil men.
Surely God will not hear vanity, neither will the Almighty regard it.
Although ngươi sayest ngươi shalt not see him, yet judgment is before him; therefore trust ngươi in him.
But now, because it is not so, he hath visited in his anger; yet he knoweth it not in great extremity: he hath: that is, God hath he knoweth: that is, Job knoweth
Therefore doth Job open his mouth vô ích; he multiplieth những lời without sự hiểu biết.

CHAPTER 36.
Elihu also proceeded, và nói,
Suffer me a little, Và I will shew ngươi that I have yet to speak on God's behalf. I have…: Heb. there are yet words for God
I will fetch my knowledge from afar, Và will ascribe righteousness to my Maker.
For truly my words shall not be false: he that is perfect in knowledge is with ngươi.
kìa, God is mighty, Và despiseth not any: he is mighty in strength Và sự khôn ngoan. wisdom: Heb. heart
He preserveth not the sự sống of the wicked: but giveth right to the poor. poor: or, afflicted
He withdraweth not his eyes from the righteous: but with kings are they on the throne; yea, he doth establish them đến đời đời, Và they are exalted.
Và if they be bound in fetters, Và be holden in cords of affliction;
Then he sheweth them their work, Và their transgressions that they have exceeded.
He openeth also their ear to discipline, Và commandeth that they return from iniquity.
If they obey Và serve him, they shall spend their days in prosperity, Và their years in pleasures.
But if they obey not, they shall perish by thanh gươm, Và they shall die without knowledge. perish: Heb. pass away
But the hypocrites in heart heap up wrath: they cry not when he bindeth them.
They chết in youth, Và their sự sống is among the unclean. They…: Heb. Their soul dieth unclean: or, Sô-đômites
He delivereth người nghèo in his affliction, Và openeth their ears in oppression. poor: or, afflicted
Even so would he have removed ngươi out of the strait into a broad place, where there is no straitness; Và that which should be set on thy table should be full of fatness. that…: Heb. the rest of thy table
But ngươi hast fulfilled the judgment of the wicked: judgment Và justice take hold on ngươi. take…: or, should uphold ngươi
Because there is wrath, Hãy coi chừng lest he take ngươi away with his stroke: then a great ransom cannot deliver ngươi. deliver…: Heb. turn ngươi aside
Will he esteem thy riches? no, not gold, nor all the forces of strength.
Desire not the night, when people are cut off in their place.
Take heed, regard not iniquity: for this hast ngươi chosen rather than affliction.
kìa, God exalteth by his power: who teacheth like him?
Who hath enjoined him his way? or who can say, ngươi hast wrought iniquity?
nhớ that ngươi magnify his work, which men kìa.
Every man may see it; man may kìa it afar off.
kìa, God is great, Và we know him not, neither can the number of his years be searched out.
For he maketh small the drops of water: they pour down mưa according to the vapour thereof:
Which đám mâys do drop Và distil upon man abundantly.
Also can any understand the spreadings of đám mâys, or the noise of his tabernacle?
kìa, he spreadeth his light upon it, and covereth the bottom of biển. bottom: Heb. roots
For by them judgeth he the people; he giveth meat in abundance.
With clouds he covereth the light; Và commandeth it not to shine by đám mây that cometh betwixt.
The noise thereof sheweth concerning it, the cattle also concerning the vapour. the vapour: Heb. that which goeth up

CHAPTER 37.
At this also my heart trembleth, Và is moved out of his place.
nghe attentively the noise of his voice, Và the sound that goeth out of his mouth. Hear…: Heb. Hear in hearing
He directeth it under the whole heaven, Và his lightning unto the ends đất. lightning: Heb. light ends: Heb. wings
After it a voice roareth: he thundereth with the voice of his excellency; Và he will not stay them when his voice is heard.
ĐCT thundereth marvellously with his voice; great things làm he, which we cannot comprehend.
For he nói to the snow, Be thou on đất; cũng như vậy to the small mưa, Và to the great mưa of his strength. cũng như vậy…: Heb. and to the shower of rain, and to the showers of rain of his strength
He sealeth up tay of every man; that all men may know his work.
Then the beasts đi into dens, Và remain in their places.
Out of the south đến the whirlwind: Và cold out of the north. south: Heb. chamber north: Heb. scattering winds
By the breath của ĐCT frost is given: Và the breadth of the waters is straitened.
Also by watering he wearieth the thick cloud: he scattereth his bright cloud: his…: Heb. đám mây of his light
Và it is turned round about by his counsels: that they may do bất cứ điều chi he commandeth them upon mặt of the world in đất.
He causeth it to come, whether for correction, or for his land, or for mercy. correction: Heb. a rod
Hearken unto this, O Job: stand still, Và consider the wondrous works của ĐCT.
Dost ngươi know when God disposed them, and caused the light of his cloud to shine?
Dost ngươi know the balancings of đám mâys, the wondrous works of him which is perfect in knowledge?
How thy garments are warm, when he quieteth đất by the south wind?
Hast ngươi with him spread out the sky, which is strong, Và as a molten looking glass?
Teach us what we shall say unto him; for we cannot order our speech by reason của sự tối tăm.
Shall it be told him that I speak? if a man nói, surely he shall be swallowed up.
Và now men thấy not the bright light which is in đám mâys: but the wind passeth, Và cleanseth them.
Fair weather đến out of the north: with God is terrible majesty. Fair…: Heb. Gold
Touching the Almighty, we cannot find him out: he is excellent in power, Và in judgment, Và in plenty of justice: he will not afflict.
Men do therefore fear him: he respecteth not any that are khôn ngoan of heart.

CHAPTER 38.
Then the CHÚA trả lời Gióp out of the whirlwind, và nói,
Who is this that darkeneth counsel by words without knowledge?
Gird up now thy loins like a man; for I will demand of ngươi, and answer ngươi me. answer…: Heb. make me know
Where wast ngươi when I laid the foundations đất? declare, if ngươi hast understanding. hast…: Heb. knowest understanding
Who hath laid the measures thereof, if ngươi knowest? or who hath stretched the line upon it?
Whereupon are the foundations thereof fastened? or who laid the corner stone thereof;foundations: Heb. sockets fastened: Heb. made to sink?
When buổi sáng stars sang together, Và all the sons của ĐCT shouted for joy?
Or ai shut up biển with doors, when it brake forth, as if it had issued out of the womb?
When I made đám mây the garment thereof, and thick darkness a swaddlingband for it,
Và brake up for it my decreed place, Và set bars Và doors,brake…: or, established my decree upon it
và nói, Hitherto shalt ngươi come, but no further: Và here shall thy proud waves be stayed? thy…: Heb. the pride of thy waves
Hast ngươi commanded buổi sáng since thy days; Và caused the dayspring to know his place;
That it might take hold of the ends đất, that the wicked might be shaken out of it? ends: Heb. wings
It is turned as clay to biểnl; Và they stand as a garment.
Và from the wicked their light is withholden, Và the high arm shall be broken.
Hast ngươi entered into the springs of biển? or hast ngươi walked in biểnrch of the depth?
Have the gates of death been opened unto ngươi? or hast ngươi seen the doors of the shadow of death?
Hast ngươi perceived the breadth đất? declare if ngươi knowest it all.
Where is đường where light ởeth? and as for tối tăm, where is the place thereof,
That ngươi shouldest take it to the bound thereof, and that ngươi shouldest know the paths to nhà thereof? to the bound: or, at, etc
Knowest thou it, because ngươi wast then born? or vì the number of thy days is great?
Hast ngươi entered into the treasures of the snow? or hast ngươi seen the treasures of the hail,
Which I have reserved against the time of trouble, against the day of battle Và war?
By what way is the light parted, which scattereth the east wind trên đất?
Who hath divided a watercourse for the overflowing of waters, or a way for the lightning of thunder;
To cause it to rain on đất, where không ai is; on đồng vắng, wherein there is không ai;
To satisfy the desolate Và waste ground; Và to cause the bud of the tender herb to spring forth?
Hath mưa a father? or who hath begotten the drops of dew?
Out of whose womb đến the ice? Và the hoary frost of heaven, who hath gendered it?
The waters are hid as với a stone, Và mặt of the deep is frozen. is…: Heb. is taken
Canst ngươi bind the sweet influences of Pleiades, or loose the bands of Orion? Pleiades: or, the bảy stars: Heb. Cimah Orion: Heb. Cesil?
Canst ngươi bring forth Mazzaroth in his season? or canst ngươi guide Arcturus with his sons? Mazzaroth: or, mười hai signs guide: Heb. guide them
Knowest ngươi the ordinances of heaven? canst ngươi set the dominion thereof in đất?
Canst ngươi lift up thy voice to đám mâys, that abundance of waters may cover ngươi?
Canst ngươi send lightnings, that they may go, Và say unto ngươi, Here we are? Here…: Heb. kìa us?
Who hath put sự khôn ngoan in the inward parts? or who hath given understanding to the heart?
Who can number đám mâys in wisdom? or who can stay the bottles of heaven,stay: Heb. cause to lie down
When the dust groweth into hardness, Và the clods cleave fast together? groweth…: or, is turned into mire: Heb. is poured
Wilt ngươi hunt the prey for the lion? or fill the appetite of the young lions,the appetite: Heb. the sự sống
When they couch in their dens, Và abide in the covert to lie in wait?
Who provideth for the raven his food? when his young ones cry unto God, they wander for lack of meat.

CHAPTER 39.
Knowest ngươi the time when the wild goats of the rock bring forth? or canst ngươi Mác when the hinds do calve?
Canst ngươi number the months that they fulfil? or knowest ngươi the time when they bring forth?
They bow themselves, they bring forth their young ones, they cast out their sorrows.
Their young ones are in good liking, they grow up with corn; they go forth, Và return not với họ.
Who hath sent out the wild ass free? or who hath loosed the bands of the wild ass?
Whose house I have made đồng vắng, Và the barren land his ởings. barren…: Heb. salt places
He scorneth đám đông of the city, neither regardeth he the crying of the driver. of the driver: Heb. of the exactor
The range of núis is his pasture, Và he searcheth after every green thing.
Will the unicorn be willing to serve ngươi, or abide by thy crib?
Canst ngươi bind the unicorn with his band in the furrow? or will he harrow the valleys after ngươi?
Wilt ngươi trust him, because his strength is great? or wilt ngươi leave thy labour to him?
Wilt ngươi believe him, that he will bring home thy seed, Và gather it into thy barn?
Gavest thou the goodly wings unto the peacocks? or wings Và feathers unto the ostrich? wings and…: or, the feathers of the stork and ostrich
Which leaveth her eggs in đất, Và warmeth them in dust,
Và forgetteth that the foot may crush them, or that the wild beast may break them.
She is hardened against her young ones, as though they were không hers: her labour is vô ích without fear;
Because God hath deprived her of wisdom, neither hath he imparted to her understanding.
What time she lifteth up herself on high, she scorneth the horse Và his rider.
Hast ngươi given the horse strength? hast ngươi clothed his neck with thunder?
Canst ngươi make him afraid as a grasshopper? sự vinh hiển of his nostrils is terrible. terrible: Heb. terror
He paweth in the valley, Và mừng vui in his strength: he goeth on to meet the armed men. He paweth: or, His feet dig the armed…: Heb. the armour
He mocketh at fear, Và is not affrighted; neither turneth he back từ thanh gươm.
The quiver rattleth against him, the glittering spear Và the shield.
He swalloweth đất with fierceness Và rage: neither believeth he that it is tiếng of the trumpet.
He nói among the trumpets, Ha, ha; Và he smelleth the battle afar off, the thunder of the captains, Và the shouting.
Doth the hawk fly by thy wisdom, Và stretch her wings toward the south?
Doth the eagle mount up at thy command, Và make her nest on high? at…: Heb. by thy mouth
She ởeth Và abideth on the rock, upon the crag of the rock, Và the strong place.
From thence she seeketh the prey, Và her eyes kìa afar off.
Her young ones also suck up huyết: Và where the slain are, there is she.

CHAPTER 40.
Moreover the CHÚA trả lời Gióp, và nói,
Shall he that contendeth with the Almighty instruct him? he that reproveth ĐCT, let him answer it.
Then Job trả lời the CHÚA, và nói,
kìa, I am vile; what shall I answer ngươi? I will lay mine hand trên my mouth.
Once have I spoken; but I will not answer: yea, twice; but I will proceed no further.
Then trả lời the CHÚA unto Job out of the whirlwind, và nói,
Gird up thy loins now like a man: I will demand of ngươi, and declare ngươi unto me.
Wilt ngươi also disannul my judgment? wilt ngươi kết án me, that ngươi mayest be righteous?
Hast ngươi an arm like God? or canst ngươi thunder with a voice like him?
Deck thyself now với majesty Và excellency; Và array thyself with glory Và beauty.
Cast abroad the rage of thy wrath: Và kìa every one that is proud, Và abase him.
Look on every one that is proud, Và bring him low; Và tread down the wicked in their place.
Hide them in the dust together; Và cột their faces in secret.
Then will I also confess unto ngươi that thine own tay phải can save ngươi.
kìa now behemoth, which I made with ngươi; he eateth cỏ as một con bò. behemoth: probably an extinct animal of some kind
Lo now, his strength is in his loins, Và his force is in the navel of his belly.
He moveth his tail like a cedar: the sinews of his stones are wrapped together. He…: or, He setteth up
His bones are as strong pieces of brass; his bones are like bars of sắt.
He is the chief of the ways của ĐCT: he that made him can make his thanh gươm to approach unto him.
Surely núis bring him forth food, where all the beasts of the field play.
He lieth under the shady trees, in the covert of the reed, Và fens.
The shady trees cover him với their shadow; the willows of the brook compass him about.
kìa, he uống up a river, Và hasteth not: he trusteth that he can draw up Giô-đanh into his mouth. he uống up: Heb. he oppresseth
He taketh it with his eyes: his nose pierceth through snares. He…: or, Will any take him in his sight, or, bore his nose with a gin?

CHAPTER 41.
Canst ngươi draw out leviathan with an hook? or his tongue with a cord which ngươi lettest down? leviathan: probably an extinct animal of some kind which…: Heb. which ngươi drownest?
Canst ngươi put an hook into his nose? or bore his jaw through with a thorn?
Will he make many supplications unto ngươi? will he speak soft những lời unto ngươi?
Will he make a covenant with ngươi? wilt ngươi take him for a servant đến đời đời?
Wilt ngươi play with him as với a bird? or wilt ngươi bind him for thy maidens?
Shall the companions make a banquet of him? shall they part him among the merchants?
Canst ngươi fill his skin with barbed irons? or his head with fish spears?
Lay thine hand upon him, remember the battle, do no more.
kìa, the hy vọng of him is vô ích: shall not one be cast down even at the sight of him?
None is so fierce that dare stir him up: who then is able to stand before me?
Who hath prevented me, that I should repay him? bất cứ điều chi is under the whole heaven is mine.
I will not conceal his parts, nor his power, nor his comely proportion.
Who can discover mặt of his garment? or who can come to him with his double bridle? with: or, within
Who can open the doors of his face? his teeth are terrible round about.
His scales are his pride, shut up together as with a close seal. scales: Heb. strong pieces of shields
một is so near to another, that no air can come between them.
They are joined một to another, they stick together, that they cannot be sundered.
By his neesings a light doth shine, Và his eyes are like the eyelids of buổi sáng.
Out of his mouth đi burning lamps, Và sparks lửa leap out.
Out of his nostrils goeth smoke, as out of a seething pot or caldron.
His breath kindleth coals, Và a flame goeth out of his mouth.
In his neck remaineth strength, Và sorrow is turned into joy before him. is turned into joy: Heb. mừng vui
The flakes of his flesh are joined together: they are firm in themselves; they cannot be moved. flakes: Heb. fallings
His heart is as firm as a stone; yea, as hard as a piece of the nether cái cối.
When he raiseth up himself, the mighty are afraid: by reason of breakings they purify themselves.
The thanh gươm of him that layeth at him cannot hold: the spear, the dart, nor the habergeon. habergeon: or, breastplate
He esteemeth sắt as straw, Và brass as rotten wood.
The arrow cannot make him flee: slingstones are turned with him into stubble.
Darts are counted as stubble: he laugheth at the shaking of a spear.
Sharp stones are under him: he spreadeth sharp pointed things upon the mire. Sharp stones: Heb. Sharp pieces of potsherd
He maketh the deep to boil like a pot: he maketh biển like a pot of ointment.
He maketh a path to shine after him; one would think the deep to be hoary.
trên đất there is not his like, who is made without fear. is made without fear: or, behave themselves without fear
He kìaeth all high things: he is a king over all the children of pride.

CHAPTER 42.
Then Job trả lời the CHÚA, và nói,
I know that ngươi canst do every thing, and that no thought can be withholden from ngươi. no thought can be…: or, no thought of thine can be hindered
Who is he that hideth counsel without knowledge? therefore have I uttered that I understood not; things too wonderful for me, which I knew not.
nghe, tôi nài khuyên ngươi, and I will speak: I will demand of ngươi, and declare ngươi unto me.
I have heard of ngươi by the hearing of the ear: but now mine eye seeth ngươi.
Wherefore I abhor myself, Và repent in dust Và ashes.
Và it was so, that after the CHÚA had spoken these words unto Job, the CHÚA nói to Eliphaz the Temanite, My wrath is kindled against ngươi, and against thy two friends: for ye have not spoken of me the thing that is right, as my servant Gióp hath.
Therefore take cùng các ngươi now bảy bullocks Và bảy rams, và đi to my servant Gióp, Và offer up for yourselves a burnt offering; Và my servant Gióp shall pray for you: for him will I accept: lest I deal with you after your folly, in that ye have not spoken of me the thing which is right, like my servant Gióp. him: Heb. his face, or, person
So Eliphaz the Temanite Và Bildad the Shuhite Và Zophar the Naamathite went, Và did according as the CHÚA truyền lệnh them: the CHÚA also accepted Gióp. Job: Heb. mặt of Job
Và the CHÚA turned the captivity of Job, when he cầu nguyện for his friends: also the CHÚA gave Gióp twice as much as he had before. gave…: Heb. added all that had been to Job unto the double
Then came there unto him all anh em người, Và all his sisters, Và all they that had been of his acquaintance before, Và did eat bánh with him in his house: Và they bemoaned him, and comforted him over all the evil that the CHÚA had brought upon him: every man also gave him a piece of money, và mãi mãiy one an earring of gold.
So the CHÚA phước the latter end of Job more than his beginning: for he had mười bốn ngàn chiên, Và six ngàn lạc đà, Và a thousand ách of oxen, Và a thousand she asses.
He had also bảy sons Và three daughters.
Và he called Tên of the first, Jemima; Và Tên of the second, Kezia; Và Tên of the third, Keren–happuch.
Và in all the land were no women found so fair as the daughters of Job: Và their father gave them inheritance among their brethren.
After this lived Gióp một trăm Và forty năm, Và saw his sons, Và his sons' sons, even bốn generations.
So Job chết, being old Và full of days.

div.title: THE BOOK OF PSALMS
div.chapter:
PSALM 1.
phước is the man that walketh not in the counsel of the ungodly, nor standeth in the way of sinners, nor sitteth in biểnt of the scornful. ungodly: or, wicked
But his delight is in the law of the CHÚA; Và in his law doth he meditate ngày Và night.
Và he shall be like a tree trồng by the rivers of water, that bringeth forth his fruit in his season; his leaf also shall not wither; Và bất cứ điều chi he doeth shall prosper. wither: Heb. fade
The ungodly are not so: but are like the chaff which the wind driveth away.
Therefore the ungodly shall not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous.
For the CHÚA biết đường of the righteous: but the way of the ungodly shall perish.

PSALM 2.
Tại sao do the heathen rage, Và the people imagine a vain thing? rage: or, tumultuously assemble imagine: Heb. meditate
các vua đất set themselves, and the rulers take counsel together, against the CHÚA, Và against his anointed, nói [rằng],
Let us break their bands asunder, Và cast away their cords from us.
He that sitteth in the heavens shall laugh: Chúa shall have them in derision.
Then shall he speak với họ in his wrath, Và vex them in his sore displeasure. vex: or, trouble
Yet have I set my king upon my holy đồi of Si-ôn. set: Heb. anointed upon…: Heb. upon Si-ôn, the hill of my holiness
I will declare the decree: the CHÚA hath nói unto me, Thou art my Son; this day have I begotten ngươi. the decree: or, for a decree
Ask of me, and I shall give ngươi the heathen for thine inheritance, Và the uttermost parts đất for thy possession.
ngươi shalt break them with a rod of sắt; ngươi shalt dash them in pieces like a potter's vessel.
Be wise now therefore, O ye kings: be instructed, ye judges đất.
Serve the CHÚA with fear, Và rejoice with trembling.
Kiss Con, lest he be angry, Và ye perish từ đường, when his wrath is kindled but a little. phước are all they that put their trust in him.

PSALM 3.
Thơ vịnh của Đa-vít, when he fled từ Absalom his son.
CHÚA, how are they increased that trouble me! many are they that rise up against me.
Many there be which say of my soul, There is no help for him in God. Selah.
But thou, O CHÚA, art a shield for me; my glory, Và the lifter up of mine head. for: or, about
I cried unto the CHÚA with my voice, Và he heard me out of his holy đồi. Selah.
I laid me down Và slept; I awaked; for the CHÚA sustained me.
I will not be afraid of ten thousands of people, that have set themselves against me round about.
Hãy chổi dậy, O CHÚA; save me, Hỡi ĐCT tôi: for ngươi hast smitten all mine enemies trên the cheek bone; ngươi hast broken the teeth of the ungodly.
sự cứu rỗi belongeth unto the CHÚA: thy blessing is upon thy people. Selah.

PSALM 4.
To the chief Musician on Neginoth, Thơ vịnh của Đa-vít.
nghe me when I call, Hỡi ĐCT of my righteousness: ngươi hast enlarged me when I was in distress; have mercy upon me, and hear my prayer. chief…: or, overseer have…: or, be gracious unto me
O ye sons of men, how long will ye turn my glory into shame? how long will ye love vanity, Và seek after leasing? Selah.
But know that the CHÚA hath set apart him that is godly for himself: the CHÚA will hear when I call unto him.
Stand in awe, Và sin not: commune with your own heart upon your bed, Và be still. Selah.
Offer the sacrifices of righteousness, Và put your trust in the CHÚA.
There be many that say, Who will shew us any tốt?
CHÚA, lift ngươi up the light of thy countenance upon us.
ngươi hast put gladness in my heart, more than in the time that their corn Và their wine increased.
I will both lay me down trong bình an, Và sleep: for thou, CHÚA, only makest me ở in safety.

PSALM 5.
To the chief Musician upon Nehiloth, Thơ vịnh của Đa-vít.
Give ear to my words, O CHÚA, consider my meditation.
Hearken unto the voice of my cry, my King, Và my God: for unto ngươi will I pray.
My voice shalt ngươi hear in buổi sáng, O CHÚA; in buổi sáng will I direct my prayer unto ngươi, and will look up.
For thou art not a God that hath pleasure in wickedness: neither shall evil ở with ngươi.
The foolish shall not stand in thy sight: ngươi hatest all workers of iniquity. in…: Heb. before thine eyes
ngươi shalt destroy them that speak leasing: the CHÚA will abhor the bloody Và deceitful man. bloody…: Heb. man of bloods and deceit
But as for me, I will come into thy house in đám đông of thy mercy: Và in thy fear will I worship toward thy holy đền thờ. thy holy…: Heb. đền thờ of thy holiness
Lead me, O CHÚA, in sự công chính của Ngài vì cớ mine enemies; make thy way thẳng before my face. mine…: Heb. those which observe me
For there is no faithfulness in their mouth; their inward part is very wickedness; their throat is an open sepulchre; they flatter with their tongue. faithfulness: or, stedfastness their mouth: Heb. his mouth, that is, the mouth of any of them very…: Heb. wickednesses
Destroy ngươi them, Hỡi ĐCT; let them fall by their own counsels; cast them out in đám đông of their transgressions; for they have rebelled against ngươi. Destroy…: or, Make them guilty by…: or, from their counsels
But let all those that put their trust in ngươi rejoice: let them ever shout for joy, because ngươi defendest them: let them also that love Danh Ngài be joyful in ngươi. defendest…: Heb. coverest over, or, protectest them
For thou, CHÚA, wilt bless the righteous; with favour wilt ngươi compass him as với a shield. compass: Heb. crown

PSALM 6.
To the chief Musician on Neginoth upon Sheminith, Thơ vịnh của Đa-vít.
O CHÚA, rebuke me not in thine anger, neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure. chief…: or, overseer Sheminith: or, the eighth
Have mercy upon me, O CHÚA; for I là weak: O CHÚA, heal me; for my bones are vexed.
My soul is also sore vexed: but thou, O CHÚA, how long?
Return, O CHÚA, deliver my soul: oh save me for thy mercies' sake.
For in death there is no remembrance of ngươi: in the grave who shall give ngươi thanks?
I am weary with my groaning; all the night make I my bed to swim; I water my couch with my tears. all…: or, every night
Mine eye is consumed vì cớ grief; it waxeth old vì cớ all mine enemies.
Depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity; for the CHÚA hath heard tiếng of my weeping.
The CHÚA hath heard my supplication; the CHÚA will receive my prayer.
Let all mine enemies bị hổ thẹn Và sore vexed: let them return Và bị hổ thẹn bất chợt.

PSALM 7.
Shiggaion của Đa-vít, which he sang unto the CHÚA, concerning the words of Cush the Benjamite.
O CHÚA my God, in ngươi do I put my trust: save me from all them that persecute me, and deliver me: words: or, business
Lest he tear my soul like a lion, rending it in pieces, while there is none to deliver. none…: Heb. not a deliverer
O CHÚA my God, if I have done this; if there be iniquity in my hands;
If I have rewarded evil unto him that was at peace with me; (yea, I have delivered him that without cause is mine enemy:)
Let the enemy bắt bớ my soul, Và take it; yea, let him tread down my sự sống trên đất, Và lay mine honour in the dust. Selah.
Hãy chổi dậy, O CHÚA, in thine anger, lift up thyself vì cớ the rage of mine enemies: Và awake for me to the judgment that ngươi hast commanded.
So shall the congregation của dân sự compass ngươi about: for their sakes therefore return ngươi on high.
The CHÚA shall judge the people: judge me, O CHÚA, according to my righteousness, Và according to mine integrity that is in me.
Oh let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end; but establish the just: for the righteous ĐCT trieth the hearts Và reins.
My defence is của ĐCT, which saveth the upright in heart. My…: Heb. My buckler is upon God
ĐCT judgeth the righteous, Và ĐCT is angry with the wicked every day. judgeth…: or, is a righteous judge
If he turn not, he will whet his thanh gươm; he hath bent his bow, Và made it ready.
He hath also prepared for him the instruments of death; he ordaineth his arrows against the persecutors.
kìa, he travaileth with iniquity, Và hath conceived mischief, Và brought forth falsehood.
He made a pit, Và digged it, and is fallen into the ditch which he made. He made a pit: Heb. He hath digged a pit
His mischief shall return upon his own head, Và his violent dealing shall come down upon his own pate.
I will praise the CHÚA according to his righteousness: Và will sing praise to Tên of the CHÚA most high.

PSALM 8.
To the chief Musician upon Gittith, Thơ vịnh của Đa-vít.
O CHÚA our Lord, how excellent is Danh Ngài in all đất! who hast set thy glory above the heavens.
Out of the mouth of babes Và sucklings hast ngươi ordained strength vì cớ thine enemies, that ngươi mightest still the enemy Và the avenger. ordained: Heb. founded
When I consider thy heavens, the work of thy fingers, mặt trăng Và ngôi saos, which ngươi hast ordained;
What is man, that ngươi art mindful of him? and the son of man, that ngươi visitest him?
For ngươi hast made him a little lower than các thiên sứ, Và hast crowned him with glory Và honour.
ngươi madest him to have dominion over the works of thy hands; ngươi hast put all things under his feet:
All sheep Và oxen, yea, and the beasts of the field; All…: Heb. Flocks and oxen all of them
The fowl trên trời, Và the fish of biển, Và bất cứ điều chi passeth through the paths of biểns.
O CHÚA our Lord, how excellent is Danh Ngài in all đất!

PSALM 9.
To the chief Musician upon Muthlabben, Thơ vịnh của Đa-vít.
I will praise ngươi, O CHÚA, with my whole heart; I will shew forth all thy marvellous works.
I will be glad Và rejoice in ngươi: I will sing praise to Danh Ngài, O ngươi most High.
When mine enemies are turned back, they shall fall Và perish at thy presence.
For ngươi hast maintained my right Và my cause; ngươi satest in the throne judging right. maintained…: Heb. made my judgment judging right: Heb. judging in righteousness
ngươi hast rebuked the heathen, ngươi hast destroyed the wicked, ngươi hast put out their name đến đời đời và mãi mãi.
O ngươi enemy, destructions are come to a perpetual end: Và ngươi hast destroyed các thành; their memorial is perished with them. O thou…: or, The destructions of the enemy are come to a perpetual end: and their cities hast ngươi destroyed, etc
But the CHÚA shall endure đến đời đời: he hath prepared his throne for judgment.
Và he shall judge thế gian in righteousness, he shall minister judgment to the people in uprightness.
The CHÚA also will be a refuge for the oppressed, a refuge in times of trouble. a refuge: Heb. an high place
Và they that know Danh Ngài will put their trust in ngươi: for thou, CHÚA, hast not forsaken them that seek ngươi.
Sing praises to the CHÚA, which ởeth in Si-ôn: declare among the people his doings.
When he maketh inquisition for blood, he remembereth them: he forgetteth not the cry of the humble. humble: or, afflicted
Have mercy upon me, O CHÚA; consider my trouble which I suffer of them that hate me, ngươi that liftest me up from the gates of death:
That I may shew forth all thy praise in the gates of con gái of Si-ôn: I will rejoice in sự cứu rỗi của Ngài.
The heathen are sunk down in the pit that they made: in the net which they hid is their own foot taken.
The CHÚA is known by the judgment which he executeth: the wicked is snared in the work of his own hands. Higgaion. Selah. Higgaion: that is, Meditation
The wicked shall be turned into hell, Và all the nations that forget ĐCT.
For the needy shall not alway be forgotten: the expectation of the poor shall không perish đến đời đời.
Hãy chổi dậy, O CHÚA; let not man prevail: let the heathen be judged in thy sight.
Put them in fear, O CHÚA: that the nations may know themselves to be but men. Selah.

PSALM 10.
Tại sao standest ngươi afar off, O CHÚA? why hidest thou thyself in times of trouble?
The wicked in his pride doth persecute người nghèo: let them be taken in the devices that they have imagined. The wicked…: Heb. In the pride of the wicked he doth persecute
For the wicked boasteth of his heart's desire, Và blesseth the covetous, whom the CHÚA abhorreth. heart's: Heb. soul's blesseth…: or, the covetous blesseth himself, he abhorreth the CHÚA
The wicked, through the pride of his countenance, will not seek after God: ĐCT is not in all his thoughts. God is…: or, all his thoughts are, There is no God
His ways are always grievous; thy judgments are far above out of his sight: as for all his enemies, he puffeth at them.
He hath nói in his heart, I shall not be moved: for I shall never be in adversity. never: Heb. unto generation and generation
His mouth is full of cursing Và deceit Và fraud: under his tongue is mischief Và vanity. deceit: Heb. deceits vanity: or, iniquity
He sitteth in the lurking places of làngs: in the secret places doth he murder the innocent: his eyes are privily set against the poor. are…: Heb. hide themselves
He lieth in wait secretly as a lion in his den: he lieth in wait to catch người nghèo: he doth catch người nghèo, when he draweth him into his net. secretly: Heb. in the secret places
He croucheth, Và humbleth himself, that the poor may fall by his strong ones. He…: Heb. He breaketh himself by…: or, into his strong parts
He hath nói in his heart, ĐCT hath forgotten: he hideth his face; he will never thấy it.
Hãy chổi dậy, O CHÚA; Hỡi ĐCT, lift up thine hand: forget not the humble. humble: or, afflicted
Wherefore doth the wicked contemn ĐCT? he hath nói in his heart, ngươi wilt not require it.
ngươi hast seen it; for ngươi kìaest mischief Và spite, to requite it with thy hand: người nghèo committeth himself unto ngươi; ngươi art the helper of chaless. committeth: Heb. leaveth
Break ngươi the arm of the wicked Và the evil man: seek out his wickedness till ngươi find none.
The CHÚA is vua đến đời đời và mãi mãi: the heathen are perished out of his land.
CHÚA, ngươi hast heard the desire of the humble: ngươi wilt prepare their heart, ngươi wilt cause thine ear to hear: prepare: or, establish
To judge chaless Và the oppressed, that the man đất may no more oppress. oppress: or, terrify

PSALM 11.
To the chief Musician, Thơ vịnh của Đa-vít.
In the CHÚA put I my trust: how say ye to my soul, Flee as a bird to your mountain?
For, lo, the wicked bend their bow, they make ready their arrow upon the string, that they may privily shoot at the upright in heart. privily: Heb. in darkness
If the foundations be destroyed, what can the righteous do?
The CHÚA is in his holy đền thờ, the Lord's throne is in heaven: his eyes kìa, his eyelids try, con cái loài người.
The CHÚA trieth the righteous: but the wicked Và him that loveth violence his soul hateth.
Upon the wicked he shall rain snares, lửa Và brimstone, Và an horrible tempest: this shall be the portion of their cup. an horrible…: or, a burning tempest
For the righteous
CHÚA loveth righteousness; his countenance doth kìa the upright.

PSALM 12.
To the chief Musician upon Sheminith, Thơ vịnh của Đa-vít.
Help,
CHÚA; for the godly man ceaseth; for the faithful fail from among the children of men. upon…: or, upon the eighth Help: or, Save
They speak vanity every one with his neighbour: với flattering lips Và with a double heart do they speak. a double…: Heb. an heart and an heart
The CHÚA shall cut off all flattering lips, Và lưỡi nói [lời] kiêu ngạo: proud: Heb. great
Who have nói, With our tongue will we prevail; our lips are our own: who is lord over us? are…: Heb. are with us
For the oppression of the poor, for the sighing of the needy, now will I arise, nói the CHÚA; I will set him in safety from him that puffeth at him. puffeth…: or, would ensnare him
những lời of the CHÚA are pure những lời: as silver tried in a furnace đất, purified bảy lần.
ngươi shalt keep them, O CHÚA, ngươi shalt preserve them from this dòng dõi đến đời đời. them from: Heb. him, etc: that is, every one of them, etc
The wicked walk on every side, when the vilest men are exalted. men: Heb. của Cons of the men

PSALM 13.
To the chief Musician, Bài thi ca của Đa-vít.
How long wilt ngươi forget me, O CHÚA? đến đời đời? how long wilt ngươi hide thy face from me? chief…: or, overseer
How long shall I take counsel in my soul, having sorrow in my heart hằng ngày? how long shall mine enemy be exalted over me?
Consider Và nghe me, O CHÚA my God: lighten mine eyes, lest I sleep the sleep of sự chết;
Lest mine enemy say, I have prevailed against him; Và those that trouble me rejoice when I am moved.
But I have trusted in thy mercy; my heart shall rejoice in sự cứu rỗi của Ngài.
I will sing unto the CHÚA, because he hath dealt bountifully with me.

PSALM 14.
To the chief Musician, Thơ vịnh của Đa-vít.
The fool hath nói in his heart, There is no God. They are corrupt, they have done abominable việc làm, there is none that doeth tốt.
The CHÚA looked down from heaven upon the children of men, để xemif there were any that did understand, Và seek ĐCT.
They are all gone aside, they are all together become filthy: there is none that doeth tốt, no, not one. filthy: Heb. stinking
Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge? who eat up my people as they eat bánh, Và call not upon the CHÚA.
There were they in great fear: for God is in the generation of the righteous. were…: Heb. they feared a fear
Ye have shamed the counsel of the poor, because the CHÚA is his refuge.
Oh that the salvation của I-sơ-ra-ên were come out of Si-ôn! when the CHÚA bringeth back the captivity of his people, Gia-cốp shall rejoice, Và I-sơ-ra-ên shall be glad. Oh…: Heb. Who will give

PSALM 15.
Thơ vịnh của Đa-vít.
CHÚA, who shall abide in thy tabernacle? who shall ở in thy holy đồi? abide: Heb. sojourn
He that walketh uprightly, Và worketh righteousness, Và speaketh lẽ thật in his heart.
He that backbiteth not with his tongue, nor doeth evil to his neighbour, nor taketh up a reproach against his neighbour. taketh…: or, nhận, or, endureth
In whose eyes a vile person is contemned; but he honoureth them that fear the CHÚA. He that sweareth to his own hurt, Và changeth not.
He that putteth not out his money to usury, nor taketh phần thưởng against the innocent. He that doeth these things shall never be moved.

PSALM 16.
Michtam của Đa-vít.
Preserve me, Hỡi ĐCT: for in ngươi do I put my trust. Michtam: or, A golden Psalm
O my soul, ngươi hast nói unto the CHÚA, Thou art my Lord: my goodness extendeth not to ngươi;
But to the saints that are in đất, and to the excellent, in whom is all my delight.
Their sorrows shall be multiplied that hasten after another god: their uốngferings of blood will I not offer, cũng không take up their names into my lips. hasten…: or, give gifts to another
The CHÚA is the portion of mine inheritance Và of my cup: ngươi maintainest my lot. of mine…: Heb. of my part
The lines are fallen unto me in pleasant places; yea, I have a goodly heritage.
I will bless the CHÚA, who hath given me counsel: my reins also instruct me in the night seasons.
I have set the CHÚA always before me: because he is at my tay phải, I shall not be moved.
Therefore my heart is glad, Và my glory mừng vui: my flesh also shall rest in hy vọng. rest…: Heb. ở confidently
For ngươi wilt not leave my soul in hell; neither wilt ngươi suffer thine Holy One để xemsự hư nát.
ngươi wilt shew me the path của sự sống: in thy presence is fulness of joy; at thy tay phải there are pleasures for evermore.

PSALM 17.
A Prayer của Đa-vít.
nghe the right, O CHÚA, attend unto my cry, give ear unto my prayer, that goeth không out of feigned lips. the right: Heb. justice not…: Heb. without lips of deceit
Let my sentence come forth from thy presence; let thine eyes kìa the things that are equal.
ngươi hast proved mine heart; ngươi hast visited me in the night; ngươi hast tried me, Và shalt find nothing; I am purposed that my mouth shall not transgress.
Concerning the works of men, by the word of thy lips I have kept me from the paths of the destroyer.
Hold up my goings in thy paths, that my footsteps slip not. slip…: Heb. be not moved
I have called upon ngươi, for ngươi wilt hear me, Hỡi ĐCT: incline thine ear unto me,
Và hear my speech.
Shew thy marvellous lovingkindness, O ngươi that savest by thy tay phải them which put their trust in ngươi from those that rise up against them. by thy…: or, them which trust in ngươi from those that rise up against thy tay phải
Keep me as the apple of the eye, hide me under the shadow of thy wings,
From the wicked that oppress me, từ my deadly enemies, ai compass me about. oppress: Heb. waste my…: Heb. my enemies against the soul
They are inclosed in their own fat: with their mouth they speak proudly.
They have now compassed us in our steps: they have set their eyes bowing down to đất;
Like as a lion that is greedy of his prey, Và as it were a young lion lurking in secret places. Like…: Heb. The likeness of him (that is, of every one of them) is as a lion that desireth to ravin lurking: Heb. sitting
Hãy chổi dậy, O CHÚA, disappoint him, cast him down: deliver my soul from the wicked, which is thy thanh gươm: disappoint…: Heb. prevent his face which is: or, by
From men which are thy hand, O CHÚA, from men of the world, which have their portion in này sự sống, Và whose belly ngươi fillest with thy hid treasure: they are full of children, Và leave the rest of their substance to their babes. which are: or, by they…: or, their children are full
As for me, I will kìa thy face in righteousness: I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with thy likeness.

PSALM 18.
To the chief Musician, Thơ vịnh của Đa-vít, the servant of the CHÚA, who spake unto the CHÚA những lời of this song trong ngày that the CHÚA delivered him from tay of all his enemies, Và from tay of Sau-lơ: Và he nói,
I will love ngươi, O CHÚA, my strength.
The CHÚA is my rock, Và my fortress, Và my deliverer; my God, my strength, in whom I will trust; my buckler, Và the horn of my salvation, Và my high tower. my strength: Heb. my rock
I will call upon the CHÚA, who is worthy to be praised: so shall I được cứu from mine enemies.
The sorrows of death compassed me, and the floods of ungodly men made me afraid. ungodly men: Heb. Belial
The sorrows of hell compassed me about: the snares of death prevented me. sorrows: or, cords
In my distress I called upon the CHÚA, Và cried unto my God: he heard my voice out of his temple, Và my cry đến before him, even into his ears.
Then đất shook Và trembled; the foundations also of the hills moved Và were shaken, because he nổi giận.
There went up a smoke out of his nostrils, Và fire out of his mouth devoured: coals were kindled by it. out of his nostrils: Heb. by his, etc
He bowed các tầng trời also, and came down: Và darkness was under his feet.
Và he rode upon a cherub, Và did fly: yea, he did fly upon the wings of the wind.
He made tối tăm his secret place; his pavilion round about him were dark waters Và thick clouds of the skies.
At the brightness that was before him his thick clouds passed, hail stones Và coals lửa.
The CHÚA also thundered in the heavens, Và the Highest gave his voice; hail stones Và coals lửa.
Yea, he sent out his arrows, Và scattered them; and he shot out lightnings, Và discomfited them.
Then the channels of waters were seen, Và the foundations of the world were discovered at thy rebuke, O CHÚA, at the blast of the breath of thy nostrils.
He sent from above, he took me, he drew me out of many waters. many: or, great
He delivered me from my strong kẻ thù, Và from them which hated me: for they were too strong for me.
They prevented me trong ngày of my calamity: but the CHÚA was my stay.
He brought me forth also into a large place; he delivered me, because he delighted in me.
The CHÚA rewarded me according to my righteousness; according to the cleanness of my hands hath he recompensed me.
For I have kept the ways of the CHÚA, Và have not wickedly departed from my God.
For all his judgments were before me, and I did not put away his statutes from me.
I was also upright before him, and I kept myself from mine iniquity. before: Heb. with
Therefore hath the CHÚA recompensed me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in his eyesight. in…: Heb. before his eyes
With the merciful ngươi wilt shew thyself merciful; with an upright man ngươi wilt shew thyself upright;
With the pure ngươi wilt shew thyself pure; Và with the froward ngươi wilt shew thyself froward. shew thyself froward: or, wrestle
For ngươi wilt save the afflicted people; but wilt bring down high looks.
For ngươi wilt light my candle: the CHÚA my God will enlighten my darkness. candle: or, lamp
For by ngươi I have run through a troop; Và by my God have I leaped over a wall. run…: or, broken
As for ĐCT, his way is trọn vẹn: lời of the CHÚA is tried: he is a buckler to all those that trust in him. tried: or, refined
For who is ĐCT save the CHÚA? or who is a rock save ĐCT chúng tôi?
It is ĐCT that girdeth me with strength, Và maketh my way trọn vẹn.
He maketh my feet like hinds' chân, Và setteth me upon my high places.
He teacheth my hands to war, so that a bow of steel is broken by mine arms.
ngươi hast also given me the shield of sự cứu rỗi của Ngài: Và thy tay phải hath holden me up, Và thy gentleness hath made me great. thy gentleness…: or, with thy meekness ngươi hast multiplied me
ngươi hast enlarged my steps under me, that my feet did not slip. my feet: Heb. mine ankles
I have pursued mine enemies, Và overtaken them: neither did I turn again till they were consumed.
I have wounded them that they were not able to rise: they are fallen under my feet.
For ngươi hast girded me with strength unto the battle: ngươi hast subdued under me those that rose up against me. subdued: Heb. caused to bow
ngươi hast also given me the necks of mine enemies; that I might destroy them that hate me.
They cried, but there was none to save them: even unto the CHÚA, but he trả lời them not.
Then did I beat them small as the dust before gió: I did cast them out as the dirt in the streets.
ngươi hast delivered me from the strivings của dân sự; Và ngươi hast made me the head of the heathen: a people whom I have not known shall serve me.
As soon as they hear of me, they shall obey me: the strangers shall submit themselves unto me. As soon…: Heb. At the hearing of the ear submit…: or, yield feigned obedience strangers: Heb. sons of the stranger
The strangers shall fade away, Và be afraid out of their close places. strangers: Heb. sons of the stranger
The CHÚA liveth; Và blessed be my rock; Và let ĐCT of my salvation be exalted.
It is ĐCT that avengeth me, and subdueth the people under me. avengeth: Heb. giveth avengements for subdueth: or, destroyeth
He delivereth me from mine enemies: yea, ngươi liftest me up above those that rise up against me: ngươi hast delivered me from the violent man. violent…: Heb. man of violence
Therefore will I give thanks unto ngươi, O CHÚA, among the heathen, Và sing praises unto Danh Ngài. give…: or, confess
Great deliverance giveth he to his king; Và sheweth mercy to his anointed, to Đa-vít, Và to his seed for evermore.

PSALM 19.
To the chief Musician, Thơ vịnh của Đa-vít.
các tầng trời declare sự vinh hiển của ĐCT; Và the firmament sheweth his handywork.
ngày unto day uttereth speech, Và night unto night sheweth sự hiểu biết.
There is no speech nor language, where their voice is not heard. where…: or, without these their voice is heard: Heb. without their voice heard
Their line is gone out through all đất, Và their words to the end of the world. In them hath he set a tabernacle for mặt trời,line: or, rule, or, direction
Which is as a bridegroom coming out of his chamber, Và mừng vui as a strong man to run a race.
His going forth is from the end of the heaven, Và his circuit unto the ends of it: and there is nothing hid from the heat thereof.
luật pháp of the CHÚA is trọn vẹn, converting the soul: the testimony of the CHÚA is sure, making wise the simple. law: or, doctrine converting: or, restoring
The statutes of the CHÚA are right, rejoicing the heart: the commandment of the CHÚA is pure, enlightening mắt.
The fear of the CHÚA is clean, enduring đến đời đời: the judgments of the CHÚA are true Và công chính altogether. true: Heb. truth
More to be desired are they than gold, yea, than much fine gold: sweeter also than honey Và the honeycomb. the honeycomb: Heb. the dropping of honeycombs
Moreover by them is thy servant warned: Và in keeping of them there is great phần thưởng.
Who can understand his errors? cleanse ngươi me from secret faults.
Keep back thy servant also from presumptuous tội lỗi; let them not have dominion over me: then shall I be upright, Và I shall be innocent from the great transgression. the great: or, much
Let the words of my mouth, Và the meditation of my heart, be acceptable in thy sight, O CHÚA, my strength, Và my redeemer. strength: Heb. rock

PSALM 20.
To the chief Musician, Thơ vịnh của Đa-vít.
The CHÚA nghe ngươi trong ngày of trouble; Tên of ĐCT of Gia-cốp defend ngươi;defend…: Heb. set ngươi on an high place
Send ngươi help from the sanctuary, Và strengthen ngươi out of Si-ôn; ngươi help: Heb. thy help strengthen: Heb. support
nhớ all thy offerings, Và accept thy burnt sacrifice; Selah. accept: Heb. turn to ashes: or, make fat
Grant ngươi according to thine own heart, Và fulfil all thy counsel.
We will rejoice in sự cứu rỗi của Ngài, Và in Tên of our God we will set up our banners: the CHÚA fulfil all điều cầu xin của ngươis.
Now know I that the CHÚA saveth his anointed; he will hear him from his holy trời with the saving strength of his tay phải. his holy…: Heb. the heaven of his holiness with…: Heb. by the strength of the salvation of
Some trust in chariots, Và some in horses: but we will remember Tên of the CHÚA ĐCT chúng tôi.
They are brought down Và fallen: but we are risen, Và stand upright.
Save,
CHÚA: let the king nghe us when we call.

PSALM 21.
To the chief Musician, Thơ vịnh của Đa-vít.
The king shall joy in thy strength, O CHÚA; Và in sự cứu rỗi của Ngài how greatly shall he rejoice!
ngươi hast given him his heart's desire, Và hast not withholden the request of his lips. Selah.
For ngươi preventest him with the blessings of goodness: ngươi settest a crown of pure gold on his head.
He asked sự sống of ngươi, Và ngươi gavest it him, even length of days đến đời đời và mãi mãi.
His glory is great in sự cứu rỗi của Ngài: honour Và majesty hast ngươi laid upon him.
For ngươi hast made him most blessed đến đời đời: ngươi hast made him exceeding glad with thy countenance. made him most…: Heb. set him to be blessings made him exceeding…: Heb. make him glad with joy
For the king trusteth in the CHÚA, Và through the mercy of the most High he shall not be moved.
Thine hand shall find out all thine enemies: thy tay phải shall find out those that hate ngươi.
ngươi shalt make them as a fiery oven in the time of thine anger: the CHÚA shall swallow them up in his wrath, Và the fire shall devour them.
Their fruit shalt ngươi destroy from đất, Và their seed from among the children of men.
For they intended evil against ngươi: they imagined a mischievous device, which they are not able to perform.
Therefore shalt ngươi make them turn their back, khi ngươi shalt make ready thine arrows upon thy strings against mặt of them. shalt thou…: or, ngươi shalt set them as a butt back: Heb. shoulder
Be ngươi exalted,
CHÚA, in thine own strength: so will we sing Và praise thy power.

PSALM 22.
To the chief Musician upon Aijeleth Shahar, Thơ vịnh của Đa-vít.
My God, my God, why hast ngươi forsaken me? why art ngươi so far from helping me, Và from những lời of my roaring? Aijeleth…: or, the hind of buổi sáng helping…: Heb. my salvation
Hỡi ĐCT tôi, I cry trong ngàytime, but ngươi hearest not; and in the night season, Và am not silent. am…: Heb. there is no silence to me
But thou art thánh, O thou that inhabitest the praises của I-sơ-ra-ên.
Our fathers trusted in ngươi: they trusted, Và ngươi didst deliver them.
They cried unto ngươi, and were delivered: they trusted in ngươi, and were not confounded.
But I là a worm, Và không ai; a reproach of men, Và despised của dân sự.
All they that see me laugh me to scorn: they shoot out the lip, they shake the head, nói [rằng],shoot…: Heb. open
He trusted on the CHÚA that he would deliver him: let him deliver him, seeing he delighted in him. He trusted…: Heb. He rolled himself on seeing…: or, if he delight in
But thou art he that took me out of the womb: ngươi didst make me hy vọng when I was upon my mother's breasts. didst…: or, kept me in safety
I was cast upon ngươi from the womb: thou art my God from my mother's bụng.
Be not far from me; for trouble is gần; for there is none to help. none…: Heb. not a helper
Many bulls have compassed me: strong bulls of Bashan have beset me round.
They gaped upon me với their mouths, as a ravening Và a roaring con sư tử. gaped…: Heb. opened their mouths against me
I am poured out like water, Và all my bones are out of joint: my heart is like wax; it is melted in the midst of my bowels. out of…: or, sundered
My strength is dried up like a potsherd; Và my tongue cleaveth to my jaws; Và ngươi hast brought me into the dust of death.
For dogs have compassed me: the assembly of the wicked have inclosed me: they pierced my hands Và my feet.
I may tell all my bones: they look Và stare upon me.
They part my garments among them, and cast lots upon my vesture.
But be not ngươi far from me, O CHÚA: O my strength, haste ngươi to help me.
Deliver my soul from thanh gươm; my darling from quyền năng of the dog. my darling: Heb. my only one power: Heb. hand
Save me from the lion's miệng: for ngươi hast heard me from the horns of the unicorns.
I will declare Danh Ngài unto my brethren: in the midst of the congregation will I praise ngươi.
Ye that fear the CHÚA, praise him; all ye the seed of Gia-cốp, glorify him; and fear him, all ye the seed của I-sơ-ra-ên.
For he hath not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted; neither hath he hid his face from him; but when he cried unto him, he heard.
My praise shall be of ngươi in the great congregation: I will pay my vows before them that fear him.
The meek shall eat Và be satisfied: they shall praise the CHÚA that seek him: your heart sẽ sống đến đời đời.
All the ends of the world shall remember Và turn unto the CHÚA: Và all the kindreds of the nations shall worship before ngươi.
For the kingdom is the Lord's: and he is thống đốc among the nations.
All they that be fat trên đất shall eat Và worship: all they that go down to the dust shall bow before him: and none can keep alive his own soul.
A seed shall serve him; it shall be accounted to the Lord for a generation.
They shall come, Và shall declare his righteousness unto a people that shall be born, that he hath done này.

PSALM 23.
Thơ vịnh của Đa-vít.
The CHÚA is my shepherd; I shall not want.
He maketh me to lie down in green pastures: he leadeth me beside the still waters. green…: Heb. pastures of tender grass still…: Heb. waters of quietness
He restoreth my soul: he leadeth me in the paths of righteousness for his name's sake.
Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil: for thou art with me; thy rod Và thy staff they comfort me.
ngươi preparest a table before me in the presence of mine enemies: ngươi anointest my head with oil; my cup runneth over. anointest: Heb. makest fat
Surely goodness Và mercy shall follow me all the days of my sự sống: Và I will ở in nhà of the CHÚA đến đời đời. đến đời đời: Heb. to length of days

PSALM 24.
Thơ vịnh của Đa-vít.
đất is the Lord's, Và the fulness thereof; the world, Và they that ở therein.
For he hath founded it upon biểns, Và established it upon the floods.
Who shall ascend into the hill of the CHÚA? or who shall stand in his holy place?
He that hath clean hands, Và a pure heart; who hath not lifted up his soul unto vanity, nor sworn deceitfully. He…: Heb. The clean of hands
He shall receive the blessing from the CHÚA, Và righteousness from ĐCT of his salvation.
This is the generation of them that seek him, that seek thy face, O Gia-cốp. Selah. O Gia-cốp: or, Hỡi ĐCT of Gia-cốp
Lift up your heads, O ye gates; Và be ye lift up, ye đời đời doors; và vua of glory shall come in.
Who is this King of glory? The CHÚA strong Và mighty, the CHÚA mighty in battle.
Lift up your heads, O ye gates; even lift họ up, ye đời đời doors; và vua of glory shall come in.
Who is this King of glory? The CHÚA vạn quân, he is the King of glory. Selah.

PSALM 25.
Thơ vịnh của Đa-vít.
Unto ngươi, O CHÚA, do I lift up linh hồn tôi.
Hỡi ĐCT tôi, tôi tin cậy in ngươi: let me not be ashamed, let not mine enemies triumph over me.
Yea, let none that wait on ngươi be ashamed: let them be ashamed which transgress without cause.
Xin bày tỏ cho tôi đường lối của Ngài, O CHÚA; xin dạy tôi các nẻo của Ngài.
Xin dẫn tôi vào lẽ thật của Ngài, Và dạy me: for thou art ĐCT of my salvation; on ngươi do I wait all the day.
nhớ, O CHÚA, thy tender mercies Và thy lovingkindnesses; for they have been ever of old. tender…: Heb. bowels
nhớ not the tội lỗi of my youth, nor my transgressions: according to thy mercy nhớ ngươi me for thy goodness' sake, O CHÚA.
tốt Và upright is the CHÚA: therefore will he teach những tội nhân in the way.
The meek will he guide in judgment: Và the meek will he teach his way.
All the paths of the CHÚA are mercy Và truth unto such as keep his covenant Và his testimonies.
For Danh Ngài's sake, O CHÚA, pardon mine iniquity; for it is great.
What man is he that feareth the CHÚA? him shall he teach in the way that he shall choose.
His soul shall ở at ease; Và his seed shall inherit đất. ở…: Heb. lodge in goodness
The secret of the CHÚA is with them that fear him; and he will shew them his covenant. and…: or, and his covenant to make them know it
Mine eyes are ever toward the CHÚA; for he shall pluck my feet out of the net. pluck: Heb. bring forth
Turn ngươi unto me, and have mercy upon me; for I là desolate Và afflicted.
The troubles of my heart are enlarged: O bring ngươi me out of my distresses.
Look upon mine affliction Và my pain; Và forgive all my tội lỗi.
Consider mine enemies; for they are many; Và they hate me with cruel thù oán. cruel…: Heb. thù oán of violence
O keep my soul, Và deliver me: let me not be ashamed; for I put my trust in ngươi.
Let integrity Và uprightness preserve me; for I wait on ngươi.
Redeem I-sơ-ra-ên, Hỡi ĐCT, out of all his troubles.

PSALM 26.
Thơ vịnh của Đa-vít.
Judge me, O CHÚA; for I have walked in mine integrity: I have trusted also in the CHÚA; Vậy I shall not slide.
Examine me, O CHÚA, Và prove me; try my reins Và my heart.
For thy lovingkindness is before mine eyes: Và I have walked in thy truth.
I have not sat with vain persons, neither will I go in with dissemblers.
I have hated the congregation of evil doers; Và will not sit with the wicked.
I will wash mine hands in innocency: so will I compass thine altar, O CHÚA:
That I may publish with the voice of thanksgiving, Và tell of all thy wondrous works.
CHÚA, I have loved the habitation of thy house, Và the place where thine honour ởeth. where…: Heb. of đền tạm of thy honour
Gather not my soul with sinners, nor my sự sống with bloody men: Gather…: or, Take not away bloody…: Heb. men of blood
In whose hands is mischief, Và their tay phải is full of bribes. full…: Heb. filled with
But as for me, I will walk in mine integrity: redeem me, and be merciful unto me.
My foot standeth in an even place: in the congregations will I bless the CHÚA.

PSALM 27.
Thơ vịnh của Đa-vít.
The CHÚA is my light Và my salvation; whom shall I fear? the CHÚA is the strength of my sự sống; of whom shall I be afraid?
When the wicked, even mine enemies Và my foes, đến upon me to eat up my flesh, they stumbled Và fell. came…: Heb. approached against me
Though an host should encamp against me, my heart shall not fear: though war should rise against me, in this will I be confident.
một thing have I desired of the CHÚA, that will I seek after; that I may ở in nhà of the CHÚA all the days of my sự sống, to kìa the beauty of the CHÚA, Và to enquire in his temple. the beauty: or, the delight
For in the time of trouble he shall hide me in his pavilion: in the secret of his tabernacle shall he hide me; he shall set me up upon a rock.
Và now shall mine head bị treo lên above mine enemies round about me: therefore will I offer in his tabernacle sacrifices of joy; I will sing, yea, I will sing praises unto the CHÚA. joy: Heb. shouting
nghe, O CHÚA, khi I cry with my voice: have mercy also upon me, and answer me.
When ngươi nóist, Seek ye my face; my heart nói unto ngươi, Thy face,
CHÚA, will I seek. When…: or, My heart nói unto ngươi, Let my face seek thy face, etc
Hide not thy face far from me; put not thy servant away in anger: ngươi hast been cứu cánh tôi; leave me not, neither forsake me, Hỡi ĐCT of my salvation.
When my father Và my mother forsake me, then the CHÚA will take me up. take…: Heb. gather me
Teach me thy way, O CHÚA, Và lead me in a plain path, vì cớ mine enemies. a plain…: Heb. a way of plainness mine…: Heb. those which observe me
Deliver me not over unto the will of mine enemies: for false witnesses are risen up against me, and such as breathe out cruelty.
I had fainted, unless I had believed để xemthe goodness of the CHÚA in the land of the living.
Wait on the CHÚA: be of good courage, Và he shall strengthen thine heart: wait, I say, on the CHÚA.

PSALM 28.
Thơ vịnh của Đa-vít.
Unto ngươi will I cry, O CHÚA my rock; be not silent to me: lest, nếu ngươi be silent to me, I become like them that go down into the pit. to me: Heb. from me
nghe tiếng of my supplications, when I cry unto ngươi, when I lift up my hands toward thy holy oracle. thy…: or, the oracle of thy sanctuary
Draw me not away with the wicked, Và with the workers of iniquity, which speak peace to their neighbours, but mischief is in their hearts.
Give them according to their deeds, Và according to the wickedness of their endeavours: give them after the work of their hands; render to them their desert.
Because they regard not the works of the CHÚA, nor the operation of his hands, he shall destroy them, and not build them up.
phước be the CHÚA, because he hath heard tiếng of my supplications.
The CHÚA is my strength Và my shield; my heart trusted in him, and I am helped: therefore my heart greatly mừng vui; Và with my song will I praise him.
The CHÚA is their strength, and he is the saving strength of his anointed. their: or, his saving…: Heb. strength của sự cứu rỗis
Save thy people, Và bless thine inheritance: feed them also, and lift them up đến đời đời. feed: or, rule

PSALM 29.
Thơ vịnh của Đa-vít.
Give unto the CHÚA, O ye mighty, give unto the CHÚA glory Và strength. ye mighty: Heb. ye sons of the mighty
Give unto the CHÚA sự vinh hiển due unto his name; worship the CHÚA in the beauty of holiness. sự vinh hiển…: Heb. the honour of his name in…: or, in his glorious sanctuary
tiếng of the CHÚA is upon the waters: ĐCT of glory thundereth: the CHÚA is upon many waters. many: or, great
tiếng of the CHÚA is powerful; tiếng of the CHÚA is full of majesty. powerful: Heb. in power full…: Heb. in majesty
tiếng of the CHÚA breaketh the cedars; yea, the CHÚA breaketh the cedars of Lebanon.
He maketh them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon Và Sirion like a young unicorn.
tiếng of the CHÚA divideth the flames lửa. divideth: Heb. cutteth out
tiếng of the CHÚA shaketh đồng vắng; the CHÚA shaketh đồng vắng of Kadesh.
tiếng of the CHÚA maketh the hinds to calve, Và discovereth the forests: Và in his temple doth every one speak of his glory. to calve: or, to be in pain doth…: or, every whit of it uttereth, etc
The CHÚA sitteth upon the flood; yea, the CHÚA sitteth vua đến đời đời.
The CHÚA sẽ cho strength unto his people; the CHÚA will bless his people with peace.

PSALM 30.
Thơ vịnh Và Song at the dedication của nhà của Đa-vít.
I will extol ngươi, O CHÚA; for ngươi hast lifted me up, Và hast not made my foes to rejoice over me.
O CHÚA my God, I cried unto ngươi, and ngươi hast healed me.
O CHÚA, ngươi hast brought up my soul from the grave: ngươi hast kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.
Sing unto the CHÚA, O ye saints of his, and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness. at…: or, to the memorial
For his anger endureth but a moment; in his favour is sự sống: khóc lóc may endure for a night, but joy đến in buổi sáng. his anger…: Heb. there is but a moment in his anger for a night: Heb. in buổi chiều joy: Heb. singing
Và in my prosperity tôi nói, I shall never be moved.
CHÚA, by thy favour ngươi hast made my mountain to stand strong: ngươi didst hide thy face, Và I was troubled. made…: Heb. settled strength for my mountain
I cried to ngươi, O CHÚA; Và unto the CHÚA I made supplication.
What profit is there in my blood, when I go down to the pit? Shall the dust praise ngươi? shall it declare thy truth?
nghe, O CHÚA, Và have mercy upon me: CHÚA, be ngươi cứu cánh tôier.
ngươi hast turned for me my than khóc into dancing: ngươi hast put off my vải bố, Và girded me with gladness;
To the end that my glory may sing praise to ngươi, and not be silent. O CHÚA my God, I will give thanks unto ngươi đến đời đời. my glory: that is, my tongue, or, my soul

PSALM 31.
To the chief Musician, Thơ vịnh của Đa-vít.
In ngươi, O CHÚA, do I put my trust; let me never bị hổ thẹn: deliver me in sự công chính của Ngài.
Bow down thine ear to me; deliver me speedily: be ngươi my strong rock, for một căn nhà of defence to save me. my…: Heb. to me for a rock of strength
For thou art my rock Và my fortress; therefore for Danh Ngài's sake lead me, and guide me.
Pull me out of the net that they have laid privily for me: for thou art my strength.
Into thine hand I commit my spirit: ngươi hast redeemed me, O CHÚA ĐCT of truth.
I have hated them that regard lying vanities: but I trust in the CHÚA.
I will be glad Và rejoice in thy mercy: for ngươi hast considered my trouble; ngươi hast known my soul in adversities;
Và hast not shut me up into tay of the enemy: ngươi hast set my feet in a large room.
Have mercy upon me, O CHÚA, for I am in trouble: mine eye is consumed with grief, yea, my soul Và my belly.
For my sự sống is spent with grief, Và my years with sighing: my strength faileth vì cớ mine iniquity, Và my bones are consumed.
I was a reproach among all mine enemies, but especially among my neighbours, Và a fear to mine acquaintance: they that did see me without fled from me.
I am forgotten as a dead man out of mind: I am like a broken vessel. a broken…: Heb. a vessel that perisheth
For I have heard the slander of many: fear was on every side: while they took counsel together against me, they devised to take away my sự sống.
But I trusted in ngươi, O CHÚA: tôi nói, Thou art my God.
My times are in thy hand: deliver me from tay of mine enemies, Và from them that persecute me.
Make thy face to shine upon thy servant: save me for thy mercies' sake.
Let me not be ashamed, O CHÚA; for I have called upon ngươi: let the wicked bị hổ thẹn, Và let them be silent in the grave. silent…: or, cut off for
Let the lying lips be put to silence; which speak grievous things proudly Và contemptuously against the righteous. grievous…: Heb. a hard thing
Oh how great is thy goodness, which ngươi hast laid up for them that fear ngươi; which ngươi hast wrought for them that trust in ngươi before the sons of men!
ngươi shalt hide them in the secret of thy presence from the pride of man: ngươi shalt keep them secretly in a pavilion from the strife of tongues.
phước be the CHÚA: for he hath shewed me his marvellous kindness in a strong city. strong: or, fenced
For tôi nói in my haste, I am cut off from before thine eyes: nevertheless ngươi heardest tiếng of my supplications when I cried unto ngươi.
O love the CHÚA, all ye his saints: for the CHÚA preserveth the faithful, Và plentifully rewardeth the proud doer.
Be of good courage, Và he shall strengthen your heart, all ye that hy vọng in the CHÚA.

PSALM 32.
Thơ vịnh của Đa-vít, Maschil.
phước is he whose transgression is forgiven, whose tội lỗi is covered. Thơ vịnh…: or, Thơ vịnh của Đa-vít giving instruction
phước is the man unto whom the CHÚA imputeth not iniquity, Và in whose spirit there is no guile.
When I kept silence, my bones waxed old through my roaring all the day long.
For day Và night thy hand was heavy upon me: my moisture is turned into the drought of summer. Selah.
I acknowledged my sin unto ngươi, and mine iniquity have I not hid. tôi nói, I will confess my transgressions unto the CHÚA; Và ngươi forgavest the iniquity of my sin. Selah.
For this shall every one that is godly cầu nguyện unto ngươi in a time when ngươi mayest be found: surely in the floods of great waters they shall not come nigh unto him. when…: Heb. of finding
Thou art my hiding place; ngươi shalt preserve me from trouble; ngươi shalt compass me about with songs of deliverance. Selah.
I will instruct ngươi and teach ngươi in the way which ngươi shalt go: I will guide ngươi with mine eye. guide…: Heb. counsel ngươi, mine engươi sẽ be upon ngươi
Be ye not as the horse, or as the mule, which have no understanding: whose mouth must be held in with bit Và bridle, lest they come near unto ngươi.
Many sorrows shall be to the wicked: but he that trusteth in the CHÚA, mercy shall compass him about.
Be glad in the CHÚA, Và rejoice, ye righteous: Và shout for joy, all ye that are upright in heart.

PSALM 33.
Rejoice in the CHÚA, O ye righteous: for praise is comely for the upright.
Praise the CHÚA with harp: sing unto him with the psaltery Và an instrument of ten strings.
Sing unto him a new song; play skilfully with a loud noise.
For the word of the CHÚA is right; Và all his works are done in truth.
He loveth righteousness Và judgment: đất is full of the goodness of the CHÚA. goodness: or, mercy
By the word of the CHÚA were the heavens made; Và all the host of them by the breath of his mouth.
He gathereth the waters of biển together as an heap: he layeth up the depth in storehouses.
Let all đất fear the CHÚA: let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.
For he spake, and it was done; he commanded, Và it stood fast.
The CHÚA bringeth the counsel of the heathen to nought: he maketh the devices của dân sự of none effect. bringeth: Heb. maketh frustrate
The counsel of the CHÚA standeth đến đời đời, the thoughts of his heart to all generations. to all…: Heb. to generation and generation
phước is the nation whose God is the CHÚA; Và the people whom he hath chosen for his own inheritance.
The CHÚA looketh from heaven; he kìaeth all the sons of men.
From the place of his habitation he looketh upon all the inhabitants đất.
He fashioneth their hearts alike; he considereth all their works.
There is no king saved by đám đông of an host: a mighty man is not delivered by much strength.
An horse is a vain thing for safety: neither shall he deliver any by his great strength.
kìa, the eye of the CHÚA is upon them that fear him, upon them that hy vọng in his mercy;
To deliver their soul from death, Và to keep them alive in famine.
Our soul waiteth for the CHÚA: he is our help Và our shield.
For our heart shall rejoice in him, because we have trusted in his holy name.
Let thy mercy, O CHÚA, be upon us, according as we hy vọng in ngươi.

PSALM 34.
Thơ vịnh của Đa-vít, when he changed his behaviour before Abimelech; who drove him away, Và he departed.
I will bless the CHÚA at all times: his praise shall continually be in my mouth. Abimelech: or, Achish
My soul shall make her boast in the CHÚA: the humble shall hear thereof, Và be glad.
O magnify the CHÚA with me, and let us exalt his name together.
I sought the CHÚA, Và he heard me, and delivered me from all my fears.
They looked unto him, and were lightened: Và their faces were not ashamed. were lightened: or, they flowed unto him
This poor man cried, Và the CHÚA nghe him, Và saved him out of all his troubles.
thiên sứ of the CHÚA encampeth round about them that fear him, and delivereth them.
O taste Và see that the CHÚA is tốt: phước is the man that trusteth in him.
O fear the CHÚA, ye his saints: for there is no want to them that fear him.
The young lions do lack, Và suffer hunger: but they that seek the CHÚA shall not want any good thing.
đến, ye children, hearken unto me: I will teach you the fear of the CHÚA.
What man is he that desireth sự sống, Và loveth many ngày, that he may see tốt?
Keep thy tongue from evil, Và thy lips from speaking guile.
Depart from evil, Và do tốt; seek peace, Và pursue it.
mắt of the CHÚA are upon the righteous, Và his ears are open unto their cry.
mặt of the CHÚA is against them that do evil, to cut off the remembrance of them from đất.
The righteous cry, Và the CHÚA nghe, Và delivereth them out of all their troubles.
The CHÚA is nigh với họ that are of a broken heart; Và saveth such as be of a contrite spirit. unto…: Heb. to the broken of heart of a contrite…: Heb. contrite of spirit
Many are the afflictions of the righteous: but the CHÚA delivereth him out of them all.
He keepeth all his bones: not one of them is broken.
Evil shall slay the wicked: Và they that hate the righteous shall be desolate. desolate: or, guilty
The CHÚA redeemeth the soul of his servants: Và none of them that trust in him shall be desolate. desolate: or, guilty

PSALM 35.
Thơ vịnh của Đa-vít.
Plead my cause, O CHÚA, with them that strive with me: fight against them that fight against me.
Take hold of shield Và buckler, Và stand up for mine help.
Draw out also the spear, Và stop đường against them that persecute me: say unto my soul, I là sự cứu rỗi của Ngài.
Let them be confounded Và put to shame that seek after my soul: let them be turned back Và brought to confusion that devise my hurt.
Let them be as chaff before gió: Và let thiên sứ of the CHÚA chase họ.
Let their way be dark Và slippery: Và let thiên sứ of the CHÚA bắt bớ them. dark…: Heb. darkness and slipperiness
For without cause have they hid for me their net trong a pit, which without cause they have digged for my soul.
Let destruction đến upon him at unawares; Và let his net that he hath hid catch himself: into that very destruction let him fall. at…: Heb. which he knoweth not of
Và my soul shall be joyful in the CHÚA: it shall rejoice in his salvation.
