All my bones shall say,
CHÚA, who is like unto ngươi, which deliverest người nghèo from him that is too strong for him, yea, the poor Và the needy from him that spoileth him?
False witnesses did rise up; they laid to my charge things that I knew not. False…: Heb. Witnesses of wrong they…: Heb. they asked me
They rewarded me evil for good to the spoiling of my soul. spoiling: Heb. depriving
But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing was vải bố: I humbled my soul with fasting; Và my prayer returned into mine own bosom. humbled: or, afflicted
I behaved myself as though he had been my friend or brother: I bowed down heavily, as one that mourneth for his mẹ. behaved myself: Heb. walked as though…: Heb. as a friend, as a brother to me
But in mine adversity they rejoiced, Và gathered themselves together: yea, the abjects gathered themselves together against me, and I knew it not; they did tear me, Và ceased not: adversity: Heb. halting
With hypocritical mockers in feasts, they gnashed upon me with their teeth.
Lord, how long wilt ngươi look on? rescue my soul from their destructions, my darling from the lions. darling: Heb. only one
I will give ngươi thanks in the great congregation: I will praise ngươi among much people. much: Heb. strong
Let not them that are mine enemies wrongfully rejoice over me: neither let them wink with the eye that hate me without a cause. wrongfully: Heb. falsely
For they speak not peace: but they devise deceitful matters against them that are quiet in the land.
Yea, they opened their mouth wide against me, Và nói, Aha, aha, our eye hath seen it.
này ngươi hast seen, O CHÚA: keep not silence: O Lord, be not far from me.
Stir up thyself, and awake to my judgment, even unto my cause, my God Và my Lord.
Judge me, O CHÚA my God, according to sự công chính của Ngài; Và let them not rejoice over me.
Let them not say in their hearts, Ah, so would we have it: let them not say, We have swallowed him up. Ah…: Heb. Ah, ah, our soul
Let them be ashamed Và brought to confusion together that rejoice at mine hurt: let them be clothed with shame Và dishonour that magnify themselves against me.
Let them shout for joy, Và be glad, that favour my righteous cause: yea, let them say continually, Let the CHÚA be magnified, which hath pleasure in the prosperity of his servant. righteous…: Heb. righteousness
Và my tongue shall speak of sự công chính của Ngài Và of thy praise all the day long.

PSALM 36.
To the chief Musician, Thơ vịnh của Đa-vít the servant of the CHÚA.
The transgression of the wicked nói within my heart, that there is no fear của ĐCT before his eyes.
For he flattereth himself in his own eyes, until his iniquity be found to be hateful. until…: Heb. to find his iniquity to hate
những lời of his mouth are iniquity Và deceit: he hath left off to be wise, Và to do good.
He deviseth mischief upon his bed; he setteth himself in a way that is không tốt; he abhorreth not evil. mischief: or, vanity
Thy mercy, O CHÚA, is in the heavens; Và thy faithfulness reacheth unto đám mâys.
Thy righteousness is like the great mountains; thy judgments are a great deep: O CHÚA, ngươi preservest man Và beast. the…: Heb. núis của ĐCT
How excellent is thy lovingkindness, Hỡi ĐCT! therefore the children of men put their trust under the shadow of thy wings. excellent: Heb. precious
They shall be abundantly satisfied with the fatness of thy house; Và ngươi shalt make them drink of the river of thy pleasures. abundantly…: Heb. watered
For with ngươi is the fountain của sự sống: in thy light shall we see light.
O continue thy lovingkindness với họ that know ngươi; and sự công chính của Ngài to the upright in heart. continue: Heb. draw out at length
Let not the foot of pride đến against me, and let not tay of the wicked remove me.
There are the workers of iniquity fallen: they are cast down, Và shall not be able to rise.

PSALM 37.
Thơ vịnh của Đa-vít.
Fret not thyself vì cớ evildoers, neither be ngươi envious against the workers of iniquity.
For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, Và wither as the green herb.
Trust in the CHÚA, Và do tốt; so shalt ngươi ở in the land, Và Quả thật ngươi shalt be fed. Quả thật: Heb. in truth, or, stableness
Delight thyself also in the CHÚA; Và he shall give ngươi the desires of thine heart.
Commit thy way unto the CHÚA; trust also in him; and he shall bring it to pass. Commit…: Heb. Roll thy way upon
Và he shall bring forth sự công chính của Ngài as the light, Và thy judgment as the noonday.
Rest in the CHÚA, Và wait patiently for him: fret not thyself vì cớ him who prospereth in his way, vì cớ the man who bringeth wicked devices to pass. Rest in: Heb. Be silent to
Cease from anger, Và forsake wrath: fret not thyself in any wise to do evil.
For evildoers shall be cut off: but those that wait upon the CHÚA, they shall inherit đất.
For yet ít lâu, Và the wicked shall not be: yea, ngươi shalt diligently consider his place, and it shall not be.
But the meek shall inherit đất; Và shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.
The wicked plotteth against the just, Và gnasheth upon him with his teeth. plotteth: or, practiseth
Chúa shall laugh at him: for he seeth that his day is coming.
The wicked have drawn out thanh gươm, Và have bent their bow, to cast down người nghèo Và needy, Và to slay such as be of upright conversation. such…: Heb. the upright of way
Their thanh gươm shall enter into their own heart, Và their bows shall be broken.
A little that a righteous man hath is better than the riches of many gian ác.
For the arms of the wicked shall be broken: but the CHÚA upholdeth the righteous.
The CHÚA biết the days of the upright: Và their inheritance shall be đến đời đời.
They shall not be ashamed in the evil time: Và trong những ngày of famine they shall be satisfied.
But the wicked shall perish, Và the enemies of the CHÚA shall be as the fat of lambs: they shall consume; into smoke shall they consume away. the fat: Heb. the preciousness
The wicked borroweth, Và payeth not again: but the righteous sheweth mercy, Và giveth.
For such as be phước of him shall inherit đất; and they that be cursed of him shall be cut off.
The steps of a tốt man are ordered by the CHÚA: Và he delighteth in his way. ordered: or, established
Though he fall, he shall not be utterly cast down: for the CHÚA upholdeth him with his hand.
I have been young, and bây giờ am old; yet have I not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his seed begging bánh.
He is ever merciful, Và lendeth; Và his seed is phước. ever: Heb. all the day
Depart from evil, Và do tốt; và ở for evermore.
For the CHÚA loveth judgment, Và forsaketh not his saints; they are preserved đến đời đời: but the seed of the wicked shall be cut off.
Người công chính sẽ hưởng [được] đất, và ở trong đó đến đời đời.
The mouth of the righteous speaketh sự khôn ngoan, Và his tongue talketh of judgment.
luật pháp of his God is in his heart; none of his steps shall slide. steps: or, goings
The wicked watcheth the righteous, Và seeketh để giết him.
The CHÚA will not leave him in his hand, nor kết án him when he is judged.
Trông đợi nơi CHÚA, Và keep his way, Và he shall exalt ngươi to inherit the land: when the wicked are cut off, ngươi shalt see it.
I have seen the wicked in great power, Và spreading himself like a green bay tree. a green…: or, a green tree that groweth in his own soil
Yet he passed away, and, lo, he was not: yea, I sought him, but he could not be found.
Mác the perfect man, Và kìa the upright: for the end of that man is peace.
But the transgressors sẽ bị hủy diệt together: the end of the wicked shall be cut off.
But the salvation of the righteous is of the CHÚA: he is their strength in the time of trouble.
Và the CHÚA shall help them, and deliver them: he shall deliver them from the wicked, Và save them, because they trust in him.

PSALM 38.
Thơ vịnh của Đa-vít, to bring to remembrance.
O CHÚA, rebuke me not in thy wrath: neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.
For thine arrows stick fast in me, and thy hand presseth me sore.
There is no soundness in my flesh vì of thine anger; neither is there any rest in my bones vì of my sin. rest: Heb. peace, or, health
For mine iniquities are gone over mine head: as an heavy burden they are too heavy for me.
My wounds stink Và are corrupt vì of my foolishness.
I am troubled; I am bowed down greatly; I go than khóc all the day long. troubled: Heb. wried
For my loins are filled with a loathsome disease: and there is no soundness in my flesh.
I am feeble Và sore broken: I have roared by reason of the disquietness of my heart.
Lord, all my desire is before ngươi; and my groaning is not hid from ngươi.
My heart panteth, my strength faileth me: as for the light of mine eyes, it also is gone from me. is gone…: Heb. is not with me
My lovers Và my friends stand aloof from my sore; Và my kinsmen stand afar off. sore: Heb. stroke my kinsmen: or, my neighbours
They also that seek after my sự sống lay snares for me: Và they that seek my hurt nói mischievous things, Và imagine deceits all the day long.
But I, as a deaf man, nghe not; and I was as a dumb man that openeth not his mouth.
Thus I was as a man that nghe not, and in whose mouth are no reproofs.
For in ngươi, O CHÚA, do I hy vọng: ngươi wilt hear, O Lord my God. in…: or, ngươi do I wait for hear: or, answer
For tôi nói, Hear me, lest otherwise they should rejoice over me: when my foot slippeth, they magnify themselves against me.
For I là ready to halt, Và my sorrow is continually before me. to halt: Heb. for halting
For I will declare mine iniquity; I will be sorry for my sin.
But mine enemies are lively, Và they are strong: Và they that hate me wrongfully are multiplied. are lively…: Heb. being living, are strong
They also that render evil for good are mine adversaries; because I follow the thing that tốt is.
Forsake me not, O CHÚA: Hỡi ĐCT tôi, be not far from me.
Make haste to help me, O Lord my salvation. to…: Heb. for cứu cánh tôi

PSALM 39.
To the chief Musician, even to Jeduthun, Thơ vịnh của Đa-vít.
tôi nói, I will take heed to my ways, that I sin not with my tongue: I will keep my mouth with a bridle, while the wicked is before me. my mouth…: Heb. a bridle, or, muzzle for my mouth
I was dumb with silence, I held my peace, even from good; Và my sorrow was stirred. stirred: Heb. troubled
My heart was hot within me, while I was musing lửa burned:
Rồi nói I with my tongue,
CHÚA, make me to know mine end, Và the measure of my days, what it is; that I may know how frail I là. how…: or, what time I have here
kìa, ngươi hast made my days as an handbreadth; Và mine age is as nothing before ngươi: Quả thật every man at his best state is altogether vanity. Selah. at…: Heb. settled
Surely every man walketh in a vain shew: surely they are disquieted vô ích: he heapeth up riches, Và knoweth not who shall gather them. a vain…: Heb. an image
Và now, Lord, what wait I for? my hy vọng is in ngươi.
Deliver me from all my transgressions: make me not the reproach of the foolish.
I was dumb, I opened not my mouth; because ngươi didst it.
Remove thy stroke away from me: I am consumed by the blow of thine hand. blow: Heb. conflict
When ngươi with rebukes dost correct man for iniquity, ngươi makest his beauty to consume away like a moth: surely every man is vanity. Selah. his…: Heb. that which is to be desired in him to melt away
nghe my prayer, O CHÚA, Và give ear unto my cry; hold not thy peace at my tears: for I là a stranger with ngươi, Và a sojourner, as all my fathers were.
O spare me, that I may recover strength, before I go hence, and be no more.

PSALM 40.
To the chief Musician, Thơ vịnh của Đa-vít.
I waited patiently for the CHÚA; Và he inclined unto me, and heard my cry. I waited…: Heb. In waiting I waited
He brought me up also out of an horrible pit, out of the miry clay, Và set my feet upon a rock, Và established my goings. an…: Heb. a pit of noise
Và he hath put a new song in my mouth, even praise unto our God: many sẽ thấy it, Và fear, Và shall trust in the CHÚA.
phước is that man that maketh the CHÚA his trust, Và respecteth not the proud, nor such as turn aside to lies.
Many, O CHÚA my God, are thy wonderful works which ngươi hast done, Và thy thoughts which are to us-ward: they cannot be reckoned up in order unto ngươi: nếu I would declare Và speak of them, they are more than can be numbered. they cannot…: or, none can order them unto ngươi
Sacrifice Và offering ngươi didst not desire; mine ears hast ngươi opened: burnt offering Và sin offering hast ngươi not required. opened: Heb. digged
Then nói I, Lo, I come: in the volume of the book it is written of me,
I delight to do thy will, Hỡi ĐCT tôi: yea, thy law is within my heart. within…: Heb. in the midst of my bowels
I have preached righteousness in the great congregation: lo, I have not refrained my lips, O CHÚA, ngươi knowest.
I have not hid sự công chính của Ngài within my heart; I have declared thy faithfulness Và sự cứu rỗi của Ngài: I have not concealed thy lovingkindness Và thy truth from the great congregation.
Withhold not ngươi thy tender mercies from me, O CHÚA: let thy lovingkindness Và thy truth continually preserve me.
For innumerable evils have compassed me about: mine iniquities have taken hold upon me, so that I am not able to look up; they are more than the hairs of mine head: therefore my heart faileth me. faileth: Heb. forsaketh
Be pleased, O CHÚA, to deliver me: O CHÚA, make haste to help me.
Let them be ashamed Và confounded together that seek after my soul to destroy it; let them be driven backward Và put to shame that wish me evil.
Let them be desolate for a reward of their shame that say unto me, Aha, aha.
Let all those that seek ngươi rejoice Và be glad in ngươi: let such as love sự cứu rỗi của Ngài say continually, The CHÚA be magnified.
But I là poor Và needy; yet Chúa thinketh upon me: thou art cứu cánh tôi Và my deliverer; make no tarrying, Hỡi ĐCT tôi.

PSALM 41.
To the chief Musician, Thơ vịnh của Đa-vít.
phước is he that considereth người nghèo: the CHÚA will deliver him in time of trouble. the poor: or, the weak, or, sick in time…: Heb. trong ngày of evil
The CHÚA will preserve him, and keep him alive; Và he shall be blessed trên đất: Và ngươi wilt not deliver him unto the will of his enemies. thou…: or, do not ngươi deliver
The CHÚA will strengthen him upon the bed of languishing: ngươi wilt make all his bed in his sickness. make: Heb. turn
tôi nói,
CHÚA, be merciful unto me: heal my soul; for I have sinned against ngươi.
Mine enemies nói evil of me, When shall he die, Và his name perish?
Và if he come để xemme, he speaketh vanity: his heart gathereth iniquity to itself; khi he goeth abroad, he telleth it.
All that hate me whisper together against me: against me do they devise my hurt. my…: Heb. evil to me
An evil disease, họ nói, cleaveth fast unto him: and bây giờ that he lieth he sẽ chổi dậy no more. An…: Heb. A thing of Belial
Yea, mine own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, which did eat of my bread, hath lifted up his heel against me. mine…: Heb. the man of my peace lifted…: Heb. magnified
But thou, O CHÚA, be merciful unto me, and raise me up, that I may requite them.
By this I know that ngươi favourest me, because mine enemy doth not triumph over me.
Và as for me, ngươi upholdest me in mine integrity, Và settest me before thy face đến đời đời.
phước be the CHÚA ĐCT của I-sơ-ra-ên from đời đời, Và to đời đời. Amen, Và Amen.

PSALM 42.
To the chief Musician, Maschil, for the sons of Korah.
As the hart panteth after the water brooks, so panteth my soul after ngươi, Hỡi ĐCT. Maschil…: or, Thơ vịnh giving instruction của Cons, etc panteth: Heb. brayeth
My soul thirsteth for God, for the living ĐCT: when shall I come Và appear before ĐCT?
My tears have been my meat ngày Và night, while they continually say unto me, Where is thy God?
When I remember these things, I pour out my soul in me: for I had gone with đám đông, I went with them đến nhà của ĐCT, with the voice of joy Và praise, with a multitude that kept holyday.
Tại sao art ngươi cast down, O my soul? and why art ngươi disquieted in me? hy vọng ngươi in God: for I shall yet praise him for the help of his countenance. cast: Heb. bowed praise: or, give thanks for the…: or, his presence is salvation
Hỡi ĐCT tôi, my soul is cast down within me: therefore will I remember ngươi from the land of Giô-đanh, Và of the Hermonites, from the hill Mizar. the hill…: or, the little hill
Deep calleth unto deep at the noise of thy waterspouts: all thy waves Và thy billows are gone over me.
Yet the CHÚA will command his lovingkindness trong ngàytime, Và in the night his song shall be with me, Và my prayer unto ĐCT of my sự sống.
I will say unto God my rock, Tại sao hast ngươi forgotten me? why go I than khóc vì cớ the oppression of the enemy?
As with a thanh gươm in my bones, mine enemies reproach me; while they say hằng ngày unto me, Where is thy God? thanh gươm: or, killing
Tại sao art ngươi cast down, O my soul? Và why art ngươi disquieted within me? hy vọng ngươi in God: for I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance, Và my God.

PSALM 43.
Judge me, Hỡi ĐCT, Và plead my cause against an ungodly nation: O deliver me from the deceitful Và unjust man. ungodly: or, unmerciful the deceitful…: Heb. a man of deceit and iniquity
For thou art ĐCT of my strength: why dost ngươi cast me off? why go I than khóc vì cớ the oppression of the enemy?
O send out thy light Và thy truth: let them lead me; let them bring me unto thy holy đồi, Và to thy tabernacles.
Then will I go unto the altar của ĐCT, unto God my exceeding joy: yea, upon the harp will I praise ngươi, Hỡi ĐCT my God. my exceeding…: Heb. the gladness of my joy
Tại sao art ngươi cast down, O my soul? Và why art ngươi disquieted within me? hy vọng in God: for I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance, Và my God.

PSALM 44.
To the chief Musician for the sons of Korah, Maschil.
We have heard with our ears, Hỡi ĐCT, our fathers have told us, what work ngươi didst in their days, in the times of old. Maschil: or, of instruction
How ngươi didst drive out the heathen with thy hand, Và plantedst them; how ngươi didst afflict the people, Và cast them out.
For they got not the land in possession by their own thanh gươm, neither did their own arm save them: but thy tay phải, Và thine arm, Và the light of thy countenance, because ngươi hadst a favour với họ.
ngươi art my King, Hỡi ĐCT: command deliverances for Gia-cốp.
Through ngươi will we push down our enemies: through Danh Ngài will we tread them under that rise up against us.
For I will not trust in my bow, neither shall my thanh gươm save me.
But ngươi hast saved us from our enemies, Và hast put them to shame that hated us.
In God we boast all the day long, and praise Danh Ngài đến đời đời. Selah.
Nhưng ngươi hast cast off, Và put us to shame; Và goest not forth with our armies.
ngươi makest us to turn back from the enemy: Và they which hate us spoil for themselves.
ngươi hast given us like sheep appointed for meat; Và hast scattered us among the heathen. like…: Heb. as sheep of meat
ngươi sellest thy people for nought, Và dost not increase thy wealth by their price. for…: Heb. without riches
ngươi makest us a reproach to our neighbours, a scorn Và a derision to them that are round about us.
ngươi makest us a byword among the heathen, a shaking of the head among the people.
My confusion is continually before me, and the shame of my face hath covered me,
For the voice of him that reproacheth Và blasphemeth; by reason of the enemy Và avenger.
All this is come upon us; yet have we not forgotten ngươi, neither have we dealt falsely in thy covenant.
Our heart is not turned back, neither have our steps declined from thy way; steps: or, goings
Though ngươi hast sore broken us in the place of dragons, Và covered us with the shadow of death.
If we have forgotten Tên of our God, or stretched out our hands to a strange ĐCT;
Shall not God search this out? for he knoweth the secrets of the heart.
Yea, for thy sake are we killed all the day long; we are counted as sheep for the slaughter.
Awake, why sleepest thou, O Lord? Hãy chổi dậy, cast us not off đến đời đời.
Wherefore hidest ngươi thy face, Và forgettest our affliction Và our oppression?
For our soul is bowed down to the dust: our belly cleaveth unto đất.
Hãy chổi dậy for our help, Và redeem us for thy mercies' sake. for our…: Heb. a help for us

PSALM 45.
To the chief Musician upon Shoshannim, for the sons of Korah, Maschil, Bài hát of loves.
My heart is inditing a good matter: I speak of the things which I have made touching the king: my tongue is the pen of a ready writer. Maschil: or, of instruction is inditing: Heb. boileth, or, bubbleth up
ngươi art fairer than the children of men: ân-điển is poured into thy lips: therefore God đã ban phước ngươi đến đời đời.
Gird thy thanh gươm upon thy thigh, O most mighty, with thy glory Và thy majesty.
Và in thy majesty ride prosperously vì of truth Và meekness Và righteousness; Và thy tay phải shall teach ngươi terrible things. ride…: Heb. prosper thou, ride thou
Thine arrows are sharp in the heart of the king's enemies; whereby the people fall under ngươi.
Thy throne, Hỡi ĐCT, is đến đời đời và mãi mãi: the sceptre of thy kingdom is a right sceptre.
ngươi lovest righteousness, Và hatest wickedness: therefore God, thy God, hath anointed ngươi with the oil of gladness above thy fellows.
All thy garments smell of myrrh, Và aloes, Và cassia, out of the ivory palaces, whereby they have made ngươi glad.
Kings' daughters were among thy honourable women: upon thy tay phải did stand Nữ hoàng in gold of Ophir.
Hearken, O daughter, Và consider, Và incline thine ear; forget also thine own people, Và thy father's nhà;
So shall the king greatly desire thy beauty: for he is thy Lord; Và worship ngươi him.
Và con gái of Ti-rơ shall be there with a gift; even the rich among the people shall intreat thy favour. favour: Heb. face
The king's con gái is all glorious within: her clothing is of wrought gold.
She shall be brought unto the king in raiment of needlework: the virgins her companions that follow her shall be brought unto ngươi.
With gladness Và rejoicing shall they be brought: they shall enter into the king's palace.
Instead of thy fathers shall be thy children, whom ngươi mayest make princes in all đất.
I will make Danh Ngài to be nhớ lại in all generations: therefore shall the people praise ngươi đến đời đời và mãi mãi.

PSALM 46.
To the chief Musician for the sons of Korah, Bài hát upon Alamoth.
ĐCT is our refuge Và strength, a very present help in trouble. for: or, of
Therefore will not we fear, though đất be removed, Và though núis be carried into the midst of biển; midst…: Heb. heart of biểns
Though the waters thereof roar Và be troubled, though núis shake with the swelling thereof. Selah.
There is a river, the streams whereof shall make glad thành của ĐCT, the holy place of đền tạms of the most High.
ĐCT is in the midst of her; she shall not be moved: ĐCT shall help her, Và that right early. and…: Heb. when buổi sáng appeareth
The heathen raged, the kingdoms were moved: he uttered his voice, đất melted.
The CHÚA vạn quân is with us; ĐCT of Gia-cốp is our refuge. Selah. our…: Heb. an high place for us
đến, kìa những công việc of the CHÚA, what desolations he hath made in đất.
He maketh wars to cease unto the end đất; he breaketh the bow, Và cutteth the spear in sunder; he burneth the chariot in the fire.
Be still, Và know that I là ĐCT: I will be exalted among the heathen, I will be exalted in đất.
The CHÚA vạn quân is with us; ĐCT of Gia-cốp is our refuge. Selah.

PSALM 47.
To the chief Musician, Thơ vịnh for the sons of Korah.
O clap your hands, all ye people; shout unto God with the voice of triumph. for: or, of
For the CHÚA most high is terrible; he is a great vua over all đất.
He shall subdue the people under us, and the nations under our feet.
He shall choose our inheritance for us, the excellency of Gia-cốp whom he loved. Selah.
ĐCT is gone up with a shout, the CHÚA with the sound of a trumpet.
Sing praises to God, sing praises: sing praises unto our King, sing praises.
For God is the King of all đất: sing ye praises with understanding. with: or, every one that hath
ĐCT reigneth over the heathen: ĐCT sitteth upon the throne of his holiness.
The princes của dân sự are gathered together, even the people of ĐCT of Áp-ra-ham: for the shields đất belong unto God: he is greatly được tôn cao. princes…: or, voluntary của dân sự are gathered unto the people of the God of Áp-ra-ham

PSALM 48.
Bài hát Và Psalm for the sons of Korah.
Great is the CHÚA, Và greatly to be praised in the city of our God, trong núi of his holiness. for: or, of
Beautiful for situation, sự vui mừng of the whole đất, is mount Si-ôn, on the sides of the north, thành of the great vua.
ĐCT is known in her palaces for a refuge.
For, lo, các vua were assembled, they passed by together.
They saw it, and so they ngạc nhiên; they were troubled, Và hasted away.
Fear took hold upon them there, Và pain, as of một người đờn bà in travail.
ngươi breakest the ships of Tarshish with an east wind.
As we have heard, so have we seen in the city of the CHÚA vạn quân, in the city of our God: ĐCT will establish it for ever. Selah.
We have thought of thy lovingkindness, Hỡi ĐCT, in the midst of thy temple.
According to Danh Ngài, Hỡi ĐCT, so is thy praise unto the ends đất: thy tay phải is full of righteousness.
Let mount Si-ôn rejoice, let the daughters của Giu-đa be glad, vì cớ thy judgments.
Walk about Si-ôn, Và go round about her: tell the towers thereof.
Mác ye well her bulwarks, consider her palaces; that ye may tell it to the generation following. Mark…: Heb. Set your heart to consider: or, raise up
For this God is ĐCT chúng tôi đến đời đời và mãi mãi: he will be our guide even unto death.

PSALM 49.
To the chief Musician, Thơ vịnh for the sons of Korah.
nghe this, all ye people; give ear, all ye inhabitants of the world: for: or, of
Both low Và high, rich Và poor, together.
My mouth shall speak of wisdom; Và the meditation of my heart shall be of understanding.
I will incline mine ear to a parable: I will open my dark saying upon the harp.
Wherefore should I fear trong những ngày of evil, khi the iniquity of my heels shall compass me about?
They that trust in their wealth, Và boast themselves in đám đông of their riches;
None of them can by any means redeem his brother, nor give to God a ransom for him:
(For the redemption of their soul is precious, Và it ceaseth đến đời đời:)
That he should still live đến đời đời, Và not see sự hư nát.
For he seeth that wise men chết, cũng như vậy the fool Và the brutish person perish, Và leave their wealth to others.
Their inward thought is, that their houses shall continue đến đời đời, Và their ởing places to all generations; they call their lands after their own names. all…: Heb. generation and generation
Nevertheless man being in honour abideth not: he is like the beasts that perish.
This their way is their folly: yet their posterity approve their sayings. Selah. approve…: Heb. delight in their mouth
Like sheep they are laid in the grave; sự chết shall feed on them; and the upright shall have dominion over them in buổi sáng; Và their beauty shall consume in the grave from their ởing. beauty: or, strength in the grave from…: or, the grave being an habitation to every one of them
But God will redeem my soul from quyền năng of the grave: for he shall receive me. Selah. power: Heb. hand the grave: or, hell
Be not ngươi afraid when one is made rich, when sự vinh hiển of his house is increased;
For when he dieth he shall carry nothing away: sự vinh hiển Ngài shall not descend after him.
Though while he lived he blessed his soul: and men will praise ngươi, when ngươi doest well to thyself. while…: Heb. in his sự sống
He shall go to the generation of his fathers; they shall never thấy light. He…: Heb. The soul shall
Man that is in honour, Và understandeth not, is like the beasts that perish.

PSALM 50.
Thơ vịnh của A-sáp.
The mighty ĐCT, even the CHÚA, hath spoken, Và called đất from the rising of mặt trời unto the going down thereof. of…: or, for A-sáp
Out of Si-ôn, the perfection of beauty, ĐCT hath shined.
ĐCT chúng tôi shall come, Và shall not keep silence: a fire shall devour before him, and it shall be very tempestuous round about him.
He shall call to the heavens from above, Và to đất, that he may judge his people.
Gather my saints together unto me; those that have made a covenant with me by sacrifice.
Và the heavens shall declare his righteousness: for God is judge himself. Selah.
nghe, O my people, Và I will speak; O I-sơ-ra-ên, Và I will testify against ngươi: I là ĐCT, even thy God.
I will not reprove ngươi for thy sacrifices or thy burnt offerings, to have been continually before me.
I will take no bullock out of thy house, cũng không he goats out of thy folds.
for every beast of the forest is mine, Và the cattle upon a thousand hills.
I know all the fowls of núis: Và the wild beasts of the field are mine. mine: Heb. with me
If I were hungry, I would not tell ngươi: for the world is mine, and the fulness thereof.
Will I eat xác thịt of bulls, or drink the blood of goats?
Offer unto God thanksgiving; Và pay thy vows unto the most High:
Và call upon me trong ngày of trouble: I will deliver ngươi, and ngươi shalt glorify me.
But unto the wicked ĐCT nói, What hast ngươi to do to declare my statutes, or that ngươi shouldest take my covenant in thy mouth?
Seeing ngươi hatest instruction, Và castest my words behind ngươi.
When ngươi sawest a thief, then ngươi consentedst with him, and hast been partaker with adulterers. hast…: Heb. thy portion was with
ngươi givest thy mouth to evil, Và thy tongue frameth deceit. givest: Heb. sendest
ngươi sittest Và speakest against thy brother; thou slanderest thine own mother's son.
These things hast ngươi done, Và I kept silence; ngươi thoughtest that I was altogether such an one as thyself: but I will reprove ngươi, and set họ in order before thine eyes.
Now consider this, ye that forget ĐCT, lest I tear you in pieces, and there be none to deliver.
Whoso offereth praise glorifieth me: and to him that ordereth his conversation aright will I shew the salvation của ĐCT. that…: Heb. that disposeth his way

PSALM 51.
To the chief Musician, Thơ vịnh của Đa-vít, when Nathan tiên tri đến unto him, after he had gone in to Bath–sheba.
Have mercy upon me, Hỡi ĐCT, according to thy lovingkindness: according unto đám đông of thy tender mercies blot out my transgressions.
rửa me throughly from mine iniquity, Và cleanse me from my sin.
For I acknowledge my transgressions: Và my sin is ever before me.
Against ngươi, ngươi only, have I sinned, Và done này evil in thy sight: that ngươi mightest be justified when ngươi speakest, Và be clear when ngươi judgest.
kìa, I was shapen in iniquity; Và in sin did my mother conceive me. conceive…: Heb. warm me
kìa, ngươi desirest truth in the inward parts: Và in the hidden part ngươi shalt make me to know sự khôn ngoan.
Purge me with hyssop, Và I shall be clean: rửa me, and I shall be whiter than snow.
Make me to hear joy Và gladness; that the bones which ngươi hast broken may rejoice.
Hide thy face from my tội lỗi, Và blot out all mine iniquities.
Create in me a clean heart, Hỡi ĐCT; Và renew a right spirit within me. right: or, constant
Cast me not away from thy presence; Và take not thy holy spirit from me.
phục hồi unto me sự vui mừng of sự cứu rỗi của Ngài; Và uphold me with thy free spirit.
Rồi will I teach transgressors thy ways; Và sinners shall be converted unto ngươi.
Deliver me from bloodguiltiness, Hỡi ĐCT, ngươi God of my salvation: Và my tongue shall sing aloud of sự công chính của Ngài. bloodguiltiness: Heb. bloods
O Lord, open ngươi my lips; Và my mouth shall shew forth thy praise.
For ngươi desirest not sacrifice; else would I give it: ngươi delightest not in burnt offering. else…: or, that I should
The sacrifices của ĐCT are a broken spirit: a broken Và a contrite heart, Hỡi ĐCT, ngươi wilt not despise.
Do good in thy good pleasure unto Si-ôn: build ngươi the walls of Giê-ru-sa-lem.
Then shalt ngươi be pleased with the sacrifices of righteousness, with burnt offering Và whole burnt offering: then shall they offer bullocks upon thine altar.

PSALM 52.
To the chief Musician, Maschil, Thơ vịnh của Đa-vít, when Doeg the Edomite đến Và told Sau-lơ, và nói unto him, Đa-vít is come đến nhà of Ahimelech.
Tại sao boastest ngươi thyself in mischief, O mighty man? the goodness của ĐCT endureth continually. Maschil: or, of instruction
Thy tongue deviseth mischiefs; like a sharp razor, working deceitfully.
ngươi lovest evil more than good; Và lying rather than to speak righteousness. Selah.
ngươi lovest all devouring những lời, O thou deceitful lưỡi. O thou…: or, and the deceitful tongue
ĐCT shall cũng như vậy destroy ngươi đến đời đời, he shall take ngươi away, Và pluck ngươi out of thy ởing place, Và root ngươi out of the land of the living. Selah. destroy…: Heb. beat ngươi down
The righteous also sẽ thấy, Và fear, Và shall laugh at him:
Lo, this is the man that made not God his strength; but trusted in the abundance of his riches, Và strengthened himself in his wickedness. wickedness: or, substance
But I là like a green olive tree in nhà của ĐCT: I trust in the mercy của ĐCT đến đời đời và mãi mãi.
I will praise ngươi đến đời đời, because ngươi hast done it: Và I will wait on Danh Ngài; for it is tốt before thy saints.

PSALM 53.
To the chief Musician upon Mahalath, Maschil, Thơ vịnh của Đa-vít.
The fool hath nói in his heart, There is no God. Corrupt are they, and have done abominable iniquity: there is none that doeth tốt. Maschil: or, of instruction
ĐCT looked down from heaven upon the children of men, để xemif there were any that did understand, that did seek ĐCT.
Every one of them is gone back: they are altogether become filthy; there is none that doeth tốt, no, not one.
Have the workers of iniquity no knowledge? who eat up my people as they eat bánh: they have not called upon God.
There were they in great fear, where no fear was: for God hath scattered the bones of him that encampeth against ngươi: ngươi hast put họ to shame, because God hath despised them. were…: Heb. they feared a fear
Oh that the salvation của I-sơ-ra-ên were come out of Si-ôn! When God bringeth back the captivity of his people, Gia-cốp shall rejoice, Và I-sơ-ra-ên shall be glad. Oh that…: Heb. Who will give salvation, etc

PSALM 54.
To the chief Musician on Neginoth, Maschil, Thơ vịnh của Đa-vít, when the Ziphims đến và nói to Sau-lơ, Doth not Đa-vít hide himself with us?
Save me, Hỡi ĐCT, by Danh Ngài, Và judge me by thy strength. chief…: or, overseer Maschil: or, of instruction
nghe my prayer, Hỡi ĐCT; give ear to the words of my mouth.
For strangers are risen up against me, and oppressors seek after my soul: they have not set ĐCT before them. Selah.
kìa, God is mine helper: Chúa is with them that uphold my soul.
He shall reward evil unto mine enemies: cut them off in thy truth. mine…: Heb. those that observe me
I will freely sacrifice unto ngươi: I will praise Danh Ngài, O CHÚA; for it is tốt.
For he hath delivered me out of all trouble: Và mine eye hath seen his desire upon mine enemies.

PSALM 55.
To the chief Musician on Neginoth, Maschil, Thơ vịnh của Đa-vít.
Give ear to my prayer, Hỡi ĐCT; Và hide not thyself from my supplication. chief…: or, overseer Maschil: or, of instruction
Attend unto me, and hear me: I mourn in my complaint, Và make a noise;
Vì cớ the voice of the enemy, vì of the oppression of the wicked: for they cast iniquity upon me, and in wrath they hate me.
My heart is sore pained within me: and the terrors of death are fallen upon me.
Fearfulness Và trembling are come upon me, and horror hath overwhelmed me. overwhelmed: Heb. covered
Và tôi nói, Oh that I had wings like a dove! for then would I fly away, Và be at rest.
Lo, Rồi would I wander far off, Và remain in the wilderness. Selah.
I would hasten my escape from the windy storm Và tempest.
Destroy, O Lord, Và divide their tongues: for I have seen violence Và strife in the city.
ngày Và night they go about it upon the walls thereof: mischief also and sorrow are in the midst of it.
Wickedness is in the midst thereof: deceit Và guile depart not from her streets.
For it was not an enemy that reproached me; then I could have borne it: neither was it he that hated me that did magnify himself against me; then I would have hid myself from him:
But it was thou, a man mine equal, my guide, Và mine acquaintance. mine equal: Heb. according to my rank
We took sweet counsel together, Và walked unđến nhà của ĐCT in company. We…: Heb. Who sweetened counsel
Let death seize upon them, Và let them go down quick into hell: for wickedness is in their ởings, Và among them. hell: or, the grave
As for me, I will call upon God; Và the CHÚA shall save me.
Evening, Và morning, Và at noon, will I pray, Và cry aloud: Và he shall hear my voice.
He hath delivered my soul trong bình an from the battle that was against me: for there were many with me.
ĐCT shall hear, Và afflict them, even he that abideth of old. Selah. Because they have no changes, therefore they fear not God. Because…: or, With whom also there be no changes, yet they
He hath put forth his hands against such as be at peace with him: he hath broken his covenant. broken: Heb. profaned
những lời of his mouth were smoother than butter, but war was in his heart: his words were softer than oil, yet were they drawn những thanh gươm.
Cast thy burden upon the CHÚA, Và he shall sustain ngươi: he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved. burden: or, gift
But thou, Hỡi ĐCT, shalt bring them down into the pit of destruction: bloody Và deceitful men shall not live out half their days; but I will trust in ngươi. bloody…: Heb. men of bloods and deceit shall…: Heb. shall not half their days

PSALM 56.
To the chief Musician upon Jonath–elem–rechokim, Michtam của Đa-vít, when the Philistines took him in Gath.
Be merciful unto me, Hỡi ĐCT: for man would swallow me up; he fighting hằng ngày oppresseth me. Michtam…: or, A golden Psalm của Đa-vít
Mine enemies would daily swallow me up: for they be many that fight against me, O ngươi most High. enemies: Heb. observers
What time I am afraid, I will trust in ngươi.
In God I will praise his word, in God I have put my trust; I will not fear what flesh can do unto me.
Every day they wrest my words: all their thoughts are against me for evil.
They gather themselves together, they hide themselves, they Mác my steps, when they wait for my soul.
Shall they escape by iniquity? in thine anger cast down the people, Hỡi ĐCT.
ngươi tellest my wanderings: put ngươi my tears into thy bottle: are they not in thy book?
khi I cry cho ngươi, then shall mine enemies turn back: this I know; for God is for me.
In God will I praise his word: in the CHÚA will I praise his word.
In God have I put my trust: I will not be afraid what man can do unto me.
Thy vows are upon me, Hỡi ĐCT: I will render praises unto ngươi.
For ngươi hast delivered my soul from death: wilt not ngươi deliver my feet from falling, that I may walk before ĐCT in the light of the living?

PSALM 57.
To the chief Musician, Al–taschith, Michtam của Đa-vít, when he fled từ Sau-lơ in the cave.
Be merciful unto me, Hỡi ĐCT, be merciful unto me: for my soul trusteth in ngươi: yea, in the shadow of thy wings will I make my refuge, until these calamities be overpast. Al–taschith: or, Destroy not Michtam: or, A golden Psalm
I will cry unto God most high; unto God that performeth all things for me.
He shall send from heaven, Và save me từ the reproach of him that would swallow me up. Selah. ĐCT shall send forth his mercy Và his truth. from the…: or, he reproacheth him that
My soul is among lions: Và I lie even among them that are set on fire, even the sons of men, whose teeth are spears Và arrows, Và their tongue a sharp thanh gươm.
Be ngươi exalted, Hỡi ĐCT, above the heavens; let thy glory be above all đất.
They have prepared a net for my steps; my soul is bowed down: they have digged a pit before me, into the midst whereof they are fallen themselves. Selah.
My heart is fixed, Hỡi ĐCT, my heart is fixed: I will sing Và give praise. fixed: or, prepared
Awake up, my glory; awake, psaltery Và harp: I myself will awake early.
I will praise ngươi, O Lord, among the people: I will sing unto ngươi among the nations.
For thy mercy is great unto the heavens, Và thy truth unto đám mâys.
Be ngươi exalted, Hỡi ĐCT, above the heavens: let thy glory be above all đất.

PSALM 58.
To the chief Musician, Al–taschith, Michtam của Đa-vít.
Do ye indeed nói righteousness, O congregation? do ye judge uprightly, O ye sons of men? Al–taschith…: or, Destroy not Michtam: or, A golden Psalm
Yea, in heart ye work wickedness; ye weigh the violence of your hands in đất.
The wicked are estranged from the womb: they go astray as soon as they be born, speaking lies. as soon…: Heb. from the belly
Their poison is like the poison of a serpent: họ là like the deaf adder that stoppeth her ear; like the poison: Heb. according to the likeness, etc adder: or, asp
Which will not hearken to the voice of charmers, charming never so wisely. charming…: or, be the charmer never so cunning
Break their teeth, Hỡi ĐCT, in their mouth: break out the great teeth of the young lions, O CHÚA.
Let them melt away as waters which run continually: khi he bendeth his bow to shoot his arrows, let them be as cut in pieces.
As a snail which melteth, let every one of them pass away: like the untimely birth of một người đờn bà, that they may not see mặt trời.
Before your pots can feel the thorns, he shall take them away as with a whirlwind, both living, and in his wrath. both…: Heb. as living as wrath
The righteous shall rejoice when he seeth the vengeance: he shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked.
So that a man shall say, Quả thật there is a reward for the righteous: Quả thật he is a God that judgeth in đất. a reward…: Heb. fruit of the, etc

PSALM 59.
To the chief Musician, Al–taschith, Michtam của Đa-vít; when Sau-lơ sent, Và they watched nhà to kill him.
Deliver me from mine enemies, Hỡi ĐCT tôi: defend me from them that rise up against me. Al–taschith…: or, Destroy not Michtam: or, A golden Psalm defend…: Heb. set me on high
Deliver me from the workers of iniquity, Và save me from bloody men.
For, lo, they lie in wait for my soul: the mighty are gathered against me; not for my transgression, nor for my sin, O CHÚA.
They run Và prepare themselves without my fault: awake to help me, and kìa. help: Heb. meet
ngươi therefore, O CHÚA ĐCT vạn quân, ĐCT của I-sơ-ra-ên, awake to visit all the heathen: be not merciful to any wicked transgressors. Selah.
They return at evening: they make a noise like a dog, Và go round about thành.
kìa, they belch out with their mouth: những thanh gươm are in their lips: for who, họ nói, doth hear?
But thou, O CHÚA, shalt laugh at them; ngươi shalt have all the heathen in derision.
Vì cớ his strength will I wait upon ngươi: for God is my defence. defence: Heb. high place
The God of my mercy shall prevent me: God shall let me see my desire upon mine enemies. enemies: Heb. observers
Slay them not, lest my people forget: scatter them by thy power; Và bring them down, O Lord our shield.
For the sin of their mouth Và những lời of their lips let them even be taken in their pride: Và for cursing Và lying which they speak.
Consume họ in wrath, consume họ, that they may not be: Và let them know that God ruleth in Gia-cốp unto the ends đất. Selah.
Và at evening let them return; Và let them make a noise like a dog, Và go round about thành.
Let them wander up and down for meat, Và grudge if they be not satisfied. for meat: Heb. to eat Và grudge…: or, if they be not satisfied, then they will stay all night
But I will sing of thy power; yea, I will sing aloud of thy mercy in buổi sáng: for ngươi hast been my defence Và refuge trong ngày of my trouble.
Unto ngươi, O my strength, will I sing: for God is my defence, Và ĐCT of my mercy.

PSALM 60.
To the chief Musician upon Shushan–eduth, Michtam của Đa-vít, to teach; when he strove with Aram–naharaim Và with Aram–zobah, when Joab returned, Và smote of Edom in the valley of salt mười hai ngàn.
Hỡi ĐCT, ngươi hast cast us off, ngươi hast scattered us, ngươi hast been displeased; O turn thyself to us again. Michtam: or, A golden Psalm scattered: Heb. broken
ngươi hast made đất to tremble; ngươi hast broken it: heal the breaches thereof; for it shaketh.
ngươi hast shewed thy people hard things: ngươi hast made us to drink the wine of astonishment.
ngươi hast given a banner to them that fear ngươi, that it may be displayed vì of the truth. Selah.
That thy beloved may be delivered; save với thy tay phải, Và hear me.
ĐCT hath spoken in his holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem, Và mete out the valley of Succoth.
Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the strength of mine head; Giu-đa is my lawgiver;
Mô-áp is my washpot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe: Philistia, triumph ngươi vì cớ me. triumph…: or, triumph ngươi over me: (by an irony)
Who will bring me into the strong city? who will lead me into Edom? strong…: Heb. city of strength?
Wilt not thou, Hỡi ĐCT, which hadst cast us off? and thou, Hỡi ĐCT, which didst not go out with our armies?
Give us help from trouble: for vain is the help of man. help of man: Heb. salvation, etc
Through God we shall do valiantly: for he it is that shall tread down our enemies.

PSALM 61.
To the chief Musician upon Neginah, Thơ vịnh của Đa-vít.
nghe my cry, Hỡi ĐCT; attend unto my prayer.
From the end đất will I cry unto ngươi, when my heart is overwhelmed: lead me to the rock that is higher than I.
For ngươi hast been a shelter for me, Và a strong tower từ the enemy.
I will abide in thy tabernacle đến đời đời: I will trust in the covert of thy wings. Selah. trust: or, make my refuge
For thou, Hỡi ĐCT, hast heard my vows: ngươi hast given me the heritage of those that fear Danh Ngài.
ngươi wilt prolong the king's sự sống: Và his years as many generations. Thou…: Heb. ngươi shalt add days to the days of the king as…: Heb. as generation and generation
He shall abide before ĐCT đến đời đời: O prepare mercy Và truth, which may preserve him.
So will I sing praise unto Danh Ngài đến đời đời, that I may daily perform my vows.

PSALM 62.
To the chief Musician, to Jeduthun, Thơ vịnh của Đa-vít.
Truly my soul waiteth upon God: from him đến my salvation. Truly: or, Only waiteth: Heb. is silent
He only is my rock Và my salvation; he is my defence; I shall not be greatly moved. defence: Heb. high place
How long will ye imagine mischief against a man? ngươi sẽ be slain all of you: as a bowing wall shall ye be, and as a tottering fence.
They only consult to cast him down from his excellency: they delight in lies: they bless with their mouth, but they curse bề trong. Selah. inwardly: Heb. in their inward parts
My soul, wait ngươi only upon God; for my expectation is from him.
He only is my rock Và my salvation: he is my defence; I shall not be moved.
In God is my salvation Và my glory: the rock of my strength, Và my refuge, is in God.
Trust in him at all times; ye people, pour out your heart before him: God is a refuge for us. Selah.
Surely men of low degree are vanity, Và men of high degree are a lie: to be laid in the balance, they are altogether lighter than vanity. altogether: or, alike
Trust not in oppression, Và become not vain in robbery: if riches increase, set not your heart upon them.
ĐCT hath spoken once; twice have I heard này; that power belongeth unto God. power: or, strength
Also unto ngươi, O Lord, belongeth mercy: for ngươi renderest to every man according to his work.

PSALM 63.
Thơ vịnh của Đa-vít, when he was in the wilderness của Giu-đa.
Hỡi ĐCT, thou art my God; early will I seek ngươi: my soul thirsteth for ngươi, my flesh longeth for ngươi in a dry Và thirsty land, where no nước is;thirsty: Heb. weary where…: without water
để xemthy power Và thy glory, so as I have seen ngươi in the sanctuary.
Because thy lovingkindness is better than sự sống, my lips shall praise ngươi.
Thus will I bless ngươi while I live: I will lift up my hands in Danh Ngài.
My soul shall be satisfied as với marrow Và fatness; Và my mouth shall praise ngươi with joyful lips: marrow: Heb. fatness
When I remember ngươi upon my bed, Và meditate on ngươi in the đêm watches.
Because ngươi hast been cứu cánh tôi, therefore in the shadow of thy wings will I rejoice.
My soul followeth hard after ngươi: thy tay phải upholdeth me.
But those that seek my soul, to destroy it, shall go into the lower parts đất.
They shall fall by thanh gươm: they shall be a portion for foxes. They shall fall…: Heb. They shall make him run out like water by tays of
But the king shall rejoice in God; every one that sweareth by him shall glory: but the mouth of them that speak lies shall be stopped.

PSALM 64.
To the chief Musician, Thơ vịnh của Đa-vít.
nghe my voice, Hỡi ĐCT, in my prayer: preserve my sự sống from fear of the enemy.
Hide me from the secret counsel of the wicked; from the insurrection of the workers of iniquity:
Who whet their tongue like a thanh gươm, Và bend their bows to shoot their arrows, even bitter những lời:
That they may shoot in secret at the perfect: bất chợt do they shoot at him, and fear not.
They encourage themselves trong an evil matter: they commune of laying snares privily; they say, Who sẽ thấy them? matter: or, speech of…: Heb. to hide his snares
They search out iniquities; they accomplish a diligent search: both the inward thought of every one of them, Và the heart, is deep. they…: or, we are consumed by that which they have throughly searched a diligent…: Heb. a search searched
But God shall shoot at them với an arrow; bất chợt shall they be wounded. shall they…: Heb. their wound shall be
So they shall make their own tongue to fall upon themselves: all that see them shall flee away.
Và all men shall fear, Và shall declare the work của ĐCT; for they shall wisely consider of his doing.
The righteous shall be glad in the CHÚA, Và shall trust in him; and all the upright in heart shall glory.

PSALM 65.
To the chief Musician, Thơ vịnh Và Song của Đa-vít.
Praise waiteth for ngươi, Hỡi ĐCT, in Sion: Và unto ngươi shall the vow be performed. waiteth: Heb. is silent
O ngươi that hearest prayer, unto ngươi shall all flesh đến.
Iniquities prevail against me: as for our transgressions, ngươi shalt purge them away. Iniquities: Heb. Words, or, Matters of iniquities
phước is the man whom ngươi choosest, Và causest to approach unto ngươi, that he may ở in thy courts: we shall be satisfied with the goodness of thy house, even of thy holy đền thờ.
By terrible things in righteousness wilt ngươi answer us, Hỡi ĐCT of our salvation; who art the confidence of all the ends đất, Và of them that are afar off trên biển:
Which by his strength setteth fast núis; being girded with power:
Which stilleth the noise of biểns, the noise of their waves, Và the tumult của dân sự.
They also that ở in the uttermost parts are afraid at thy tokens: ngươi makest the outgoings of buổi sáng Và evening to rejoice. rejoice: or, sing
ngươi visitest đất, Và waterest it: ngươi greatly enrichest it with the river của ĐCT, which is full of water: ngươi preparest them corn, when ngươi hast so provided for it. and…: or, after ngươi hadst made it to desire rain
ngươi waterest the ridges thereof abundantly: ngươi settlest the furrows thereof: ngươi makest it soft with showers: ngươi blessest the springing thereof. settlest: or, causest rain to descend into makest…: Heb. dissolvest it
ngươi crownest the year with thy goodness; Và thy paths drop fatness. with: Heb. of
They drop trên the pastures of the wilderness: Và the little hills rejoice on every side. rejoice…: Heb. are girded with joy
The pastures are clothed with flocks; the valleys also are covered over with corn; they shout for joy, they also sing.

PSALM 66.
To the chief Musician, Bài hát or Psalm.
Make a joyful noise unto God, all ye lands: all…: Heb. all đất
Sing forth the honour of his name: make his praise glorious.
Say unto God, How terrible art ngươi in thy works! through the greatness of thy power shall thine enemies submit themselves unto ngươi. submit…: or, yield feigned obedience: Heb. lie
All đất shall worship ngươi, and shall sing unto ngươi; they shall sing to Danh Ngài. Selah.
đến Và see những công việc của ĐCT: he is terrible in his doing toward the children of men.
He turned biển into dry land: they went through the flood on foot: there did we rejoice in him.
He ruleth by his power đến đời đời; his eyes kìa the nations: let not the rebellious exalt themselves. Selah.
O bless ĐCT chúng tôi, ye people, Và make the voice of his praise to be heard:
Which holdeth our soul in sự sống, Và suffereth not our feet to be moved. holdeth: Heb. putteth
For thou, Hỡi ĐCT, hast proved us: ngươi hast tried us, as silver is tried.
ngươi broughtest us into the net; ngươi laidst affliction upon our loins.
ngươi hast caused men to ride over our heads; we went through fire Và through water: but ngươi broughtest us out into a wealthy place. wealthy: Heb. moist
I will go into thy house with burnt offerings: I will pay ngươi my vows,
Which my lips have uttered, Và my mouth hath spoken, when I was in trouble. uttered: Heb. opened
I will offer unto ngươi burnt sacrifices of fatlings, with the incense of rams; I will offer bullocks with goats. Selah. fatlings: Heb. marrow
đến Và nghe, all ye that fear ĐCT, Và I will declare what he hath done for my soul.
I cried unto him with my mouth, Và he was extolled với my tongue.
If I regard iniquity in my heart, Chúa will not hear me:
But Quả thật ĐCT hath heard me; he hath attended to the voice of my prayer.
phước be ĐCT, which hath not turned away my prayer, nor his mercy from me.

PSALM 67.
To the chief Musician on Neginoth, Thơ vịnh or Song.
ĐCT be merciful unto us, and bless us; Và cause his face to shine upon us; Selah. chief…: or, overseer upon: Heb. with
That thy way may be known trên đất, thy saving health among all nations.
Let the people praise ngươi, Hỡi ĐCT; let all the people praise ngươi.
O let the nations be glad Và sing for joy: for ngươi shalt judge the people righteously, Và govern the nations trên đất. Selah. govern: Heb. lead
Let the people praise ngươi, Hỡi ĐCT; let all the people praise ngươi.
Rồi shall đất yield her increase; Và ĐCT, even our own God, shall bless us.
ĐCT shall bless us; and all the ends đất shall fear him.

PSALM 68.
To the chief Musician, Thơ vịnh or Song của Đa-vít.
Let God Hãy chổi dậy, let his enemies be scattered: let them also that hate him flee before him. before…: Heb. from his face
As smoke is driven away, so drive họ away: as wax melteth before lửa, so let the wicked perish at the presence của ĐCT.
But let the righteous be glad; let them rejoice before ĐCT: yea, let them exceedingly rejoice. exceedingly…: Heb. rejoice with gladness
Sing unto God, sing praises to his name: extol him that rideth upon the heavens by his name
Jah, Và rejoice before him.
A father of chaless, Và a judge of the widows, is ĐCT in his holy habitation.
ĐCT setteth the solitary in families: he bringeth out those which are bound with chains: but the rebellious ở in a dry land. in families: Heb. in a house
Hỡi ĐCT, when ngươi wentest forth before thy people, when ngươi didst march through the wilderness; Selah:
đất shook, các tầng trời also dropped at the presence của ĐCT: even Sinai itself was moved at the presence của ĐCT, ĐCT của I-sơ-ra-ên.
Thou, Hỡi ĐCT, didst send a plentiful mưa, whereby ngươi didst confirm thine inheritance, when it was weary. send: Heb. shake out confirm: Heb. confirm it
Thy congregation hath dwelt therein: thou, Hỡi ĐCT, hast prepared of thy goodness for the poor.
Chúa gave lời: great was the company of those that published it. company: Heb. army
các vua of armies did flee apace: Và she that tarried at home divided the spoil. did…: Heb. did flee, did flee
Though ye have lien among the pots, yet shall ye be as the wings of a dove covered with silver, Và her feathers with yellow gold.
When the Almighty scattered các vua in it, it was trắng as snow in Sanh-môn. in it…: or, for her, she
The hill của ĐCT is as the hill of Bashan; an high đồi as the hill of Bashan.
Tại sao leap ye, ye high hills? this is the hill which ĐCT desireth to ở in; yea, the CHÚA will ở in it đến đời đời.
The chariots của ĐCT are hai mươi thousand, even thousands of angels: Chúa is among them, as in Sinai, in the holy place. even…: or, even many thousands
ngươi hast ascended on high, ngươi hast led captivity captive: ngươi hast received gifts for men; yea, for the rebellious also, that the CHÚA ĐCT might ở among them. for men: Heb. in the man
phước be Chúa, ai hằng ngày loadeth us with benefits, even ĐCT of our salvation. Selah.
He that is ĐCT chúng tôi is ĐCT của sự cứu rỗi; Và unto God Chúa belong the issues from death.
But God shall wound the head of his enemies, Và the hairy scalp of such an one as goeth on still in his trespasses.
Chúa nói, I will bring again from Bashan, I will bring my people again from the depths of biển:
That thy foot may be dipped in the blood of thine enemies, Và lưỡi of thy dogs in the same. dipped: or, red
They have seen thy goings, Hỡi ĐCT; even the goings of my God, my King, in the sanctuary.
The singers went before, the players on instruments followed after; among them were the damsels playing with timbrels.
Bless ye God in the congregations, even Chúa, from the fountain của I-sơ-ra-ên. from…: or, ye that are of the fountain của I-sơ-ra-ên
There is little Bên-gia-min với their ruler, the princes của Giu-đa Và their council, the princes of Zebulun, Và the princes of Naphtali. Và their…: or, with their company
Thy God hath commanded thy strength: strengthen, Hỡi ĐCT, that which ngươi hast wrought for us.
Vì cớ thy temple at Giê-ru-sa-lem shall kings bring presents unto ngươi.
Rebuke the company of spearmen, đám đông of the bulls, with the calves của dân sự, till every one submit himself with pieces of silver: scatter ngươi the people that delight in war. the company…: or, the beasts of the reeds scatter…: or, he scattereth
Princes shall come out of Ai-Cập; Ethiopia shall soon stretch out her hands unto God.
Sing unto God, ye kingdoms đất; O sing praises unto the Lord; Selah:
To him that rideth upon the heavens of heavens, which were of old; lo, he doth send out his voice, Và that a mighty tiếng. send…: Heb. give
Ascribe ye strength unto God: his excellency is over I-sơ-ra-ên, Và his strength is in đám mâys. clouds: or, heavens
Hỡi ĐCT, ngươi art terrible out of thy holy places: ĐCT của I-sơ-ra-ên is he that giveth strength Và power unto his people. phước be ĐCT.

PSALM 69.
To the chief Musician upon Shoshannim, Thơ vịnh của Đa-vít.
Save me, Hỡi ĐCT; for the waters are come in unto my soul.
I sink in deep mire, where there is no standing: I am come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me. deep mire: Heb. the mire of depth deep waters: Heb. depth of waters
I am weary of my crying: my throat is dried: mine eyes fail while I wait for my God.
They that hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of mine head: they that would destroy me, being mine enemies wrongfully, are mighty: then I restored that which I took not away.
Hỡi ĐCT, ngươi knowest my foolishness; Và my tội lỗi are not hid from ngươi. tội lỗi: Heb. guiltiness
Let not them that wait on ngươi, O Lord
God vạn quân, bị hổ thẹn for my sake: let not those that seek ngươi be confounded for my sake, Hỡi ĐCT của I-sơ-ra-ên.
Because for thy sake I have borne reproach; shame hath covered my face.
I am become a stranger unto my brethren, Và an alien unto my mother's children.
For the zeal of thine house hath eaten me up; Và the reproaches of them that reproached ngươi are fallen upon me.
When I khóc, Và chastened my soul with fasting, that was to my reproach.
I made vải bố also my garment; Và I became a proverb to them.
They that sit in cổng nói against me; and I was the song of the drunkards. drunkards: Heb. drinkers of strong drink
But as for me, my prayer is unto ngươi, O CHÚA, trong an acceptable time: Hỡi ĐCT, in đám đông of thy mercy nghe me, in the truth of sự cứu rỗi của Ngài.
Deliver me out of the mire, Và let me not sink: let me be delivered from them that hate me, and out of the deep waters.
Let not the waterflood overflow me, neither let the deep swallow me up, Và let not the pit shut her mouth upon me.
nghe me, O CHÚA; for thy lovingkindness is tốt: turn unto me according to đám đông of thy tender mercies.
Và hide not thy face from thy servant; for I am in trouble: nghe me speedily. hear…: Heb. make haste to hear me
Draw nigh unto my soul, Và redeem it: deliver me vì cớ mine enemies.
ngươi hast known my reproach, Và my shame, Và my dishonour: mine adversaries are all before ngươi.
Reproach hath broken my heart; Và I am full of heaviness: Và I looked for some to take pity, but there was none; and for comforters, but I found none. to take…: Heb. to lament with me
They gave me also gall for my meat; Và in my thirst they gave me vinegar để uống.
Let their table become a snare before them: and that which should have been for their welfare, let it become a trap.
Let their eyes be darkened, that họ thấy not; and make their loins continually to shake.
Pour out thine indignation upon them, and let thy wrathful anger take hold of them.
Let their habitation be desolate; Và let none ở in their tents. their habitation: Heb. their palace let none…: Heb. let there not be a ởer
For they persecute him whom ngươi hast smitten; Và they talk to the grief of those whom ngươi hast wounded. those…: Heb. thy wounded
Add iniquity unto their iniquity: Và let them not come into sự công chính của Ngài. iniquity unto…: or, punishment of iniquity, etc
Let them be blotted out of the book of the living, Và not be written with the righteous.
But I là poor Và sorrowful: let sự cứu rỗi của Ngài, Hỡi ĐCT, set me up on high.
I will praise Tên của ĐCT with Bài hát, Và will magnify him with thanksgiving.
này also shall please the CHÚA better than một con bò or bullock that hath horns Và hoofs.
The humble sẽ thấy this, and be glad: Và your heart sẽ sống that seek ĐCT. humble: or, meek
For the CHÚA nghe người nghèo, Và despiseth not his prisoners.
Let the heaven Và đất praise him, biểns, và mãi mãiy thing that moveth therein. moveth: Heb. creepeth
For God will save Si-ôn, Và will build the cities của Giu-đa: that they may ở there, and have it in possession.
The seed also of his servants shall inherit it: and they that love his name shall ở therein.

PSALM 70.
To the chief Musician, Thơ vịnh của Đa-vít, to bring to remembrance.
Make haste, Hỡi ĐCT, to deliver me; make haste to help me, hỡi CHÚA. to help…: Heb. to cứu cánh tôi
Let them be ashamed Và confounded that seek after my soul: let them be turned backward, Và put to confusion, that desire my hurt.
Let them be turned back for a reward of their shame that say, Aha, aha.
Let all those that seek ngươi rejoice Và be glad in ngươi: and let such as love sự cứu rỗi của Ngài say continually, Let God be magnified.
But I là poor Và needy: make haste unto me, Hỡi ĐCT: thou art cứu cánh tôi Và my deliverer; O CHÚA, xin đừng chậm trễ.

PSALM 71.
Trong ngươi, hỡi CHÚA, do I put my trust: let me never be put to confusion.
Deliver tôi trong sự công chính của Ngài, và giải thoát tôi: incline thine ear unto me, and save me.
Be ngươi my strong habitation, whereunto I may continually resort: Ngài đã ban lệnh để cứu tôi; for thou art my rock Và my fortress. Be…: Heb. Be ngươi to me for a rock of habitation
Deliver me, Hỡi ĐCT tôi, out of tay of the wicked, out of tay of the unrighteous Và người hung ác.
For thou art niềm hy vọng của tôi, Hỡi Chúa
ĐCT: Ngài art my trust from my youth.
By Ngài have I been holden up from the womb: Ngài art he that took me out of my mother's bowels: my praise shall be continually of Ngài.
I am as a wonder unto many; but Ngài art my strong refuge.
Let my mouth be filled với thy praise Và with thy honour all the day.
Cast me not off in the time of old age; forsake me not when my strength faileth.
For mine enemies nói against me; and they that lay wait for my soul take counsel together,lay…: Heb. watch, or, observe
nói [rằng], ĐCT hath forsaken him: persecute Và take him; for there is none to deliver him.
Hỡi ĐCT, be not far from me: Hỡi ĐCT tôi, make haste for cứu cánh tôi.
Let them be confounded Và consumed that are adversaries to my soul; let them be covered với reproach Và dishonour that seek my hurt.
But I will hy vọng continually, Và will yet praise Ngài more Và more.
My mouth shall shew forth vveef sự công chính của Ngài Và sự cứu rỗi của Ngài all the day; vì tôi biết not the numbers thereof.
Tôi sẽ đi trong sức mạnh của ĐCT
God: Tôi sẽ nhắc về sự công chính của Ngài, even of thine only.
Hỡi ĐCT, Ngài đã dạy từ thủa thơ ấu tôi: Và hitherto have I declared thy wondrous works.
giờ đến già và đầu bạc, Hỡi ĐCT, forsake me not; until I have shewed thy strength unto này dòng dõi, Và thy power to every one that is to come. when…: Heb. unto old age and gray hairs thy strength: Heb. thine arm
Sự công chính của also, Hỡi ĐCT, is very high, who hast done great things: Hỡi ĐCT, who is sánh được như Ngài!
Thou, which hast shewed me great Và sore troubles, shalt quicken me again, Và shalt bring me up again từ những nơi sâu thẩm của đất.
Ngài shalt increase my greatness, Và comfort me on every side.
I will also praise Ngài with the psaltery, even thy truth, Hỡi ĐCT tôi: unto Ngài will I sing with the harp, O Ngài Holy One của I-sơ-ra-ên. the psaltery: Heb. the instrument of psaltery
Môi tôi shall greatly rejoice when I sing unto Ngài; and my soul, which Ngài hast redeemed.
My tongue also shall talk of sự công chính của Ngài all the day long: for they are confounded, for they are brought unto shame, that seek my hurt.

PSALM 72.
Thơ vịnh for Sa-lô-môn.
Give vua thy judgments, Hỡi ĐCT, Và sự công chính của Ngài unto the king's son. for: or, of
He shall judge thy people with righteousness, Và thy poor with judgment.
núis shall bring peace to the people, Và the little hills, by righteousness.
He shall judge người nghèo của dân sự, he shall save con cái of the needy, Và shall break in pieces the oppressor.
They shall fear ngươi as long as mặt trời Và moon endure, throughout all generations.
He shall come down like rain upon the mown grass: as showers that nước đất.
In his days shall the righteous flourish; Và abundance of peace so long as the moon endureth. so long…: Heb. till there be no moon
Ngài sẽ tể trị từ biển đến biển, và từ sông đến đầu cùng của đất.
They that ở in the wilderness shall bow before him; and his enemies shall lick the dust.
Các vua của Tarshish Và of the isles shall bring presents: các vua của Sheba Và Seba shall offer gifts.
Yea, all kings shall fall down before him: all nations shall serve him.
For he shall deliver the needy when he crieth; người nghèo also, and him that hath no helper.
He shall spare người nghèo Và needy, Và shall save the souls of the needy.
He shall redeem their soul from deceit Và violence: Và precious shall their blood be in his sight.
Và he shall live, Và to him shall be given of the gold of Sheba: prayer also shall be made for him continually; Và hằng ngày shall he be praised. shall be given: Heb. one shall give
There shall be an handful of corn in đất upon the top của các núi; the fruit thereof shall shake like Lebanon: and they of the city shall flourish như cỏ đất.
Danh Ngài sẽ còn đến đời đời: his name shall be continued as long as mặt trời: and men shall be blessed in him: all nations shall call him blessed. endure: Heb. be his name shall be…: Heb. shall be as một con trai to continue his father's name đến đời đời
phước be the CHÚA ĐCT, ĐCT của I-sơ-ra-ên, who only doeth wondrous things.
Và blessed be Danh vinh hiển của Ngài cho đến đời đời: Và let the whole đất be filled với sự vinh hiển Ngài; Amen, Và Amen.
The prayers của Đa-vít con trai của Gie-sê are ended.

PSALM 73.
Thơ vịnh của A-sáp.
Truly God is tốt to I-sơ-ra-ên, even to such as are of a clean heart. of: or, for Truly: or, Yet of…: Heb. clean of heart
But as for me, my feet were almost gone; my steps had well nigh slipped.
For I was envious at the foolish, khi Tôi thấy sự giàu sung túc của kẻ ác.
For there are no bands trong cái chết của họ: but their strength is firm. firm: Heb. fat
They are not in trouble as other men; neither are they plagued như những người khác. in…: Heb. in the trouble of other men like: Heb. with
Therefore pride compasseth them about as a chain; violence covereth them as a garment.
Mắt của họ stand out with fatness: they have more than heart could wish. have…: Heb. pass the thoughts of the heart
They are corrupt, Và nói wickedly concerning oppression: họ nói loftily.
They set miệng họ against the heavens, và lưỡi họ walketh through đất.
Therefore his people return hither: Và waters of a full cup are wrung out to them.
Và họ nói, sao Chúa biết [được]? Và có sự hiểu biết [gì] trong Đấng chí cao?
kìa, these are the ungodly, who prosper in the world; they increase trong riches.
Quả thật I have cleansed my heart trong vain, Và washed my hands in innocency.
For all the day long have I been plagued, Và chastened mỗi buổi sáng. chastened: Heb. my chastisement was
If I say, I will speak thus; kìa, I should offend against the generation of thy children.
When I thought to know this, it was too painful for me; too…: Heb. labour in mine eyes
Until I went into the sanctuary của ĐCT; Rồi hiểu I their end.
Surely ngươi didst set them in slippery places: ngươi castedst them down into destruction.
How are they brought into desolation, as in a moment! they are utterly consumed with terrors.
As a dream when one awaketh; so, O Lord, when ngươi awakest, ngươi shalt despise their image.
Thus my heart was grieved, Và I was pricked in my reins.
So foolish was I, and ignorant: I was as a beast before ngươi. ignorant: Heb. I knew not before: Heb. with
Nevertheless I là continually with ngươi: ngươi hast holden me by my right tay.
ngươi shalt guide me with thy counsel, Và afterward nhận me to glory.
Whom have I in heaven but ngươi? and there is none trên đất that I desire beside ngươi.
My flesh Và my heart faileth: but ĐCT is the strength of my heart, Và my portion đến đời đời. strength: Heb. rock
For, lo, they that are far from ngươi shall perish: ngươi hast destroyed all them that go a whoring from ngươi.
Nhưng it is tốt for me to draw near to God: I have put my trust in the Lord
God, that I may declare all thy works.

PSALM 74.
Maschil của A-sáp.
Hỡi ĐCT, why hast ngươi cast us off đến đời đời? why doth thine anger smoke against the sheep of thy pasture? Maschil…: or, Thơ vịnh for A-sáp để cho instruction
nhớ thy congregation, which ngươi hast purchased of old; the rod of thine inheritance, which ngươi hast redeemed; this mount Si-ôn, wherein ngươi hast dwelt. rod: or, tribe
Lift up thy feet unto the perpetual desolations; even all that the enemy hath done wickedly in the sanctuary.
Thine enemies roar in the midst of thy congregations; they set up their ensigns for signs.
một người was famous according as he had lifted up axes upon the thick trees.
But now they break down the carved work thereof at once with axes Và hammers.
They have cast lửa into thy sanctuary, they have làm dơ dáyd by casting down the ởing place of Danh Ngài to the ground. They have cast…: Heb. They have sent thy sanctuary unto the fire
họ nói in their hearts, Let us destroy them together: they have burned up all các nhà hội của ĐCT in the land. destroy: Heb. break
We see not our signs: there is no more any prophet: neither is there among us any that knoweth how long.
Hỡi ĐCT, how long shall the adversary reproach? shall the enemy blaspheme Danh Ngài đến đời đời?
Tại sao withdrawest ngươi thy hand, even thy tay phải? pluck it out of thy bosom.
For God is my King of old, working sự cứu rỗi in the midst đất.
ngươi didst divide biển by thy strength: ngươi brakest the heads of the dragons in the waters. divide: Heb. break dragons: or, whales
ngươi brakest the heads of leviathan in pieces, Và gavest him to be meat to the people inhabiting the wilderness.
ngươi didst cleave the fountain Và the flood: ngươi driedst up mighty rivers. mighty…: Heb. rivers of strength
ngày is thine, the night also is thine: ngươi hast prepared the light Và mặt trời.
ngươi hast set all the borders đất: ngươi hast made summer Và winter. made: Heb. made them
nhớ this, that the enemy hath reproached, O CHÚA, and that the foolish people have blasphemed Danh Ngài.
O deliver not the soul of thy turtledove unto đám đông of the wicked: forget not the congregation of thy poor đến đời đời.
Have respect unto the covenant: for the dark places đất are full of the habitations of cruelty.
O let not the oppressed return ashamed: let the poor Và needy praise Danh Ngài.
Hãy chổi dậy, Hỡi ĐCT, plead thine own cause: nhớ how the foolish man reproacheth ngươi daily.
Forget not the voice of thine enemies: the tumult of those that rise up against ngươi increaseth continually. increaseth: Heb. ascendeth

PSALM 75.
To the chief Musician, Al–taschith, Thơ vịnh or Song của A-sáp.
Unto ngươi, Hỡi ĐCT, do we give thanks, cho ngươi do we give thanks: for that Danh Ngài is near thy wondrous works declare. Al–taschith: or, Destroy not of: or, for
When I shall receive the congregation I will judge uprightly. receive…: or, take a set time
đất Và all the inhabitants thereof are dissolved: I bear up the pillars of it. Selah.
tôi nói unto the fools, Deal not foolishly: Và to the wicked, Lift not up the horn:
Lift not up your horn on high: nói not with a stiff cổ.
For promotion đến neither from the east, nor from phương tây, nor from the south. south: Heb. desert
But God is the judge: he putteth down one, and setteth up another.
For in tay of the CHÚA there is a cup, Và the wine is red; it is full of mixture; Và he poureth out of the same: but the dregs thereof, all the wicked đất shall wring họ out, Và uống họ.
But I will declare đến đời đời; I will sing praises to ĐCT of Gia-cốp.
All the horns of the wicked also will I cut off; but the horns of the righteous shall be exalted.

PSALM 76.
To the chief Musician on Neginoth, Thơ vịnh or Song của A-sáp.
In Giu-đa is ĐCT known: his name is great in I-sơ-ra-ên. chief…: or, overseer of: or, for
In Salem also is his tabernacle, Và his ởing place in Si-ôn.
There brake he the arrows of the bow, the shield, Và thanh gươm, Và the battle. Selah.
Thou art more glorious Và excellent than núis of prey.
The stouthearted are spoiled, they have slept their sleep: Và none of the men of might have found their hands.
At thy rebuke, Hỡi ĐCT of Gia-cốp, both the chariot Và horse are cast into a dead sleep.
Thou, even thou, art to be feared: Và who may stand in thy sight khi once ngươi art angry?
ngươi didst cause judgment to be heard from heaven; đất feared, Và was still,
When God arose to judgment, to save all the meek đất. Selah.
Surely cơn thịnh nộ of man shall praise ngươi: the remainder of wrath shalt ngươi restrain.
Vow, Và pay unto the CHÚA your God: let all that be round about him bring presents unto him that ought to be feared. unto him…: Heb. to fear
He shall cut off the spirit of princes: he is terrible to các vua đất.

PSALM 77.
To the chief Musician, to Jeduthun, Thơ vịnh của A-sáp.
I cried unto God with my voice, even unto God with my voice; Và he gave ear unto me. of: or, for
trong ngày of my trouble I sought Chúa: my sore ran in the night, Và ceased not: my soul refused to được yên ủi. sore: Heb. hand
I nhớ lại ĐCT, Và was troubled: I complained, Và my spirit was overwhelmed. Selah.
ngươi holdest mine eyes waking: I am so troubled that I cannot speak.
I have considered the days of old, the years of ancient times.
I call to remembrance my song in the night: I commune with mine own heart: Và my spirit made diligent search.
Will the Lord cast off đến đời đời? Và will he be favourable no more?
Is his mercy clean gone đến đời đời? doth his promise fail for evermore? for evermore: Heb. to generation and generation?
Hath God forgotten to be gracious? hath he in anger shut up his tender mercies? Selah.
Và tôi nói, This is my infirmity: but I will remember the years of the tay phải of the most High.
I will remember những công việc of the CHÚA: surely I will remember thy wonders of old.
I will meditate also of all thy work, Và talk of thy doings.
Thy way, Hỡi ĐCT, is in the sanctuary: who is so great a God as our ĐCT?
Thou art ĐCT that doest wonders: ngươi hast declared thy strength among the people.
ngươi hast with thine arm redeemed thy people, the sons of Gia-cốp Và Giô-sép. Selah.
The waters nhìn thấy ngươi, Hỡi ĐCT, the waters nhìn thấy ngươi; they were afraid: the depths also were troubled.
đám mâys poured out nước: the skies sent out a sound: thine arrows also went abroad. poured…: Heb. were poured forth with water
tiếng of thy thunder was in the heaven: the lightnings lightened thế gian: đất trembled Và shook.
Thy way is in biển, Và thy path in the great waters, Và thy footsteps are not known.
ngươi leddest thy people like a flock by tay of Môi-se Và A-rôn.

PSALM 78.
Maschil của A-sáp.
Give ear, O my people, to my law: incline your ears to the words of my mouth. Maschil…: or, Thơ vịnh for A-sáp để cho instruction
I will open my mouth in a parable: I will utter dark sayings of old:
Which we have heard Và known, Và our fathers have told us.
We will not hide họ from their children, shewing to the generation to come the praises of the CHÚA, Và his strength, Và his wonderful works that he hath done.
For he established a testimony in Gia-cốp, Và appointed a law in I-sơ-ra-ên, which he commanded our fathers, that they should make them known to their children:
That the generation to come might know them, even con cái which should be born; ai should arise Và declare họ to their children:
That they might set their hy vọng in God, Và not forget những công việc của ĐCT, but keep his commandments:
Và might not be as their fathers, a stubborn Và rebellious dòng dõi; a generation that set not their heart aright, Và whose spirit was not stedfast with God. that…: Heb. that prepared not their heart
con cái of Ephraim, being armed, Và carrying bows, turned back trong ngày of battle. carrying: Heb. throwing forth
They kept not the covenant của ĐCT, Và refused to walk in his law;
Và forgat his works, Và his wonders that he had shewed them.
Marvellous things did he in the sight of their fathers, in the land of Ai-Cập, trong cánh đồng of Zoan.
He divided biển, Và caused them to pass through; Và he made the waters to stand as an heap.
trong ngàytime also he led them with a cloud, Và all the night with a light lửa.
He clave the rocks in the wilderness, and gave họ uống as out of the great depths.
He brought streams also out of the rock, Và caused waters to run down like rivers.
Và they sinned yet more against him by provoking the most High in the wilderness.
Và they tempted ĐCT in their heart by asking meat for their lust.
Yea, they spake against God; họ nói, Can ĐCT furnish a table in the wilderness? furnish: Heb. order
kìa, he smote the rock, that the waters gushed out, Và the streams overflowed; can he give bánh also? can he provide flesh for his people?
Therefore the CHÚA nghe này, Và nổi giận: so a fire was kindled against Gia-cốp, Và anger also came up against I-sơ-ra-ên;
Because they believed not in God, Và trusted not in his salvation:
Though he had commanded đám mâys from above, Và opened the doors of heaven,
Và had rained down manna upon them to eat, Và had given them of the corn of heaven.
