Man did eat angels' food: he sent them meat to the full. Man…: or, Every one did eat the bread of the mighty
He caused an east wind to blow in the heaven: Và by his power he brought in the south wind. to blow: Heb. to go
He rained flesh also upon them as dust, Và feathered fowls like as the sand of biển: feathered…: Heb. fowl of wing
Và he let it fall in the midst of their camp, round about their habitations.
So they did eat, Và were well filled: for he gave them their own desire;
They were not estranged from their lust. But while their meat was yet in their mouths,
cơn thịnh nộ của ĐCT đến upon them, and slew the fattest of them, and smote down the chosen men của I-sơ-ra-ên. smote…: Heb. made to bow chosen…: or, young men
For all this they sinned still, and believed not for his wondrous works.
Therefore their days did he consume in vanity, Và their years in trouble.
When he slew them, then they sought him: and they returned Và enquired early after God.
Và they nhớ lại that God was their rock, Và the high ĐCT their redeemer.
Nevertheless they did flatter him with their mouth, Và they lied unto him with their tongues.
For their heart was not right with him, neither were they stedfast in his covenant.
But he, being full of compassion, forgave their iniquity, Và destroyed họ not: yea, many a time turned he his anger away, Và did not stir up all his wrath.
For he nhớ lại that they were but flesh; a wind that passeth away, Và cometh not again.
How oft did they provoke him in the wilderness, Và grieve him in the desert!provoke: or, rebel against
Yea, they turned back Và tempted ĐCT, Và limited the Holy One của I-sơ-ra-ên.
They nhớ lại not his hand, cũng không ngày when he delivered them from the enemy. from…: or, from affliction
How he had wrought his signs in Ai-Cập, Và his wonders in the field of Zoan: wrought: Heb. set
Và had turned their rivers into blood; Và their floods, that they could not drink.
He sent divers sorts of flies among them, which devoured them; and frogs, which destroyed them.
He gave also their increase unto the caterpiller, Và their labour unto the locust.
He destroyed their vines with hail, Và their sycomore trees with frost. destroyed: Heb. killed frost: or, great hailstones
He gave up their cattle also to the hail, Và their flocks to hot thunderbolts. gave…: Heb. shut up hot…: or, lightnings
He cast upon them the fierceness of his anger, wrath, Và indignation, Và trouble, by sending evil các thiên sứ among them.
He made a way to his anger; he spared not their soul from death, but gave their sự sống over to the pestilence; He made…: Heb. He weighed a path sự sống…: or, beasts to the murrain
Và smote all the firstborn in Ai-Cập; the chief of their strength in đền tạms of Ham:
But made his own people to go forth like sheep, Và guided them in the wilderness like a flock.
Và he led them on safely, so that they feared not: but biển overwhelmed their enemies. overwhelmed: Heb. covered
Và he brought them to the border of his sanctuary, even to this mountain, which his tay phải had purchased.
He cast out the heathen also before them, and divided them một cơ nghiệp by line, Và made the tribes của I-sơ-ra-ên to ở in their tents.
Yet they tempted Và provoked the most high ĐCT, Và kept not his testimonies:
But turned back, Và dealt unfaithfully like their fathers: they were turned aside like a deceitful bow.
For they provoked him to anger with their high places, Và moved him to jealousy with their graven images.
When God nghe này, he nổi giận, Và greatly abhorred I-sơ-ra-ên:
So that he forsook đền tạm of Shiloh, the tent which he placed among men;
Và delivered his strength into captivity, Và his glory into the enemy's tay.
He gave his people over also unto thanh gươm; Và nổi giận with his inheritance.
lửa consumed their young men; Và their maidens were not given to marriage. given…: Heb. praised
Their priests rơi by thanh gươm; Và their widows made no ca thương.
Then the Lord awaked as one out of sleep, Và like a mighty man that shouteth by reason of wine.
Và he smote his enemies in the hinder parts: he put them to a perpetual reproach.
Moreover he refused đền tạm of Giô-sép, Và chose not the tribe of Ephraim:
But chose chi phái của Giu-đa, the mount Si-ôn which he loved.
Và he built his sanctuary like high palaces, like đất which he hath established đến đời đời. established: Heb. founded
He chose Đa-vít also his servant, Và took him from the sheepfolds:
From following the ewes great with young he brought him to feed Gia-cốp his people, Và I-sơ-ra-ên his inheritance. following: Heb. after
So he fed them according to the integrity of his heart; Và guided them by the skilfulness of his hands.

PSALM 79.
Thơ vịnh của A-sáp.
Hỡi ĐCT, the heathen are come into thine inheritance; thy holy đền thờ have they làm dơ dáyd; they have laid Giê-ru-sa-lem on heaps. of: or, for
kẻ chết bodies of thy servants have they given to be meat unto the fowls of the heaven, xác thịt of thy saints unto the beasts đất.
Their blood have they shed like water round about Giê-ru-sa-lem; and there was none to bury họ.
We are become a reproach to our neighbours, a scorn Và derision to them that are round about us.
How long, CHÚA? wilt ngươi be angry đến đời đời? shall thy jealousy đốt like fire?
Pour out thy wrath upon the heathen that have not known ngươi, and upon the kingdoms that have not called upon Danh Ngài.
For they have devoured Gia-cốp, Và laid waste his ởing place.
O remember not against us former iniquities: let thy tender mercies speedily prevent us: for we are brought very low. former…: or, the iniquities of them that were before us
Help us, Hỡi ĐCT of our salvation, for sự vinh hiển of Danh Ngài: Và deliver us, and purge away our tội lỗi, for Danh Ngài's sake.
Wherefore should the heathen say, Where is their God? let him be known among the heathen in our sight by the revenging of the blood of thy servants which is shed. revenging: Heb. vengeance
Let the sighing of the prisoner đến before ngươi; according to the greatness of thy power preserve ngươi those that are appointed to die; thy…: Heb. thine arm preserve…: Heb. reserve the children of death
Và render unto our neighbours sevenfold into their bosom their reproach, wherewith they have reproached ngươi, O Lord.
So we thy people Và sheep of thy pasture will give ngươi thanks đến đời đời: we will shew forth thy praise to all generations. to all…: Heb. to generation and generation

PSALM 80.
To the chief Musician upon Shoshannim–eduth, Thơ vịnh của A-sáp.
Give ear, O Shepherd của I-sơ-ra-ên, ngươi that leadest Giô-sép like a flock; ngươi that ởest between the cherubims, shine forth. of: or, for
Before Ép-ra-im Và Bên-gia-min Và Manasseh stir up thy strength, Và come Và save us. come…: Heb. come for salvation to us
Turn us again, Hỡi ĐCT, Và cause thy face to shine; Và we shall được cứu.
O CHÚA ĐCT vạn quân, how long wilt ngươi be angry against the prayer of thy people? be…: Heb. smoke
ngươi feedest them with the bread of tears; Và givest them tears để uống in great measure.
ngươi makest us a strife unto our neighbours: Và our enemies laugh among themselves.
Turn us again, Hỡi ĐCT vạn quân, Và cause thy face to shine; Và we shall được cứu.
ngươi hast brought a vine out of Ai-Cập: ngươi hast cast out the heathen, Và planted it.
ngươi preparedst room before it, and didst cause it to take deep root, Và it filled the land.
The hills were covered with the shadow of it, and the boughs thereof were like the goodly cedars. goodly…: Heb. cedars của ĐCT
She sent out her boughs unto biển, Và her branches unto the river.
Tại sao hast thou Rồi broken down her hedges, so that all they which pass by the way do pluck her?
The boar out of the wood doth waste it, and the wild beast of the field doth devour it.
Return, we beseech ngươi, Hỡi ĐCT vạn quân: look down from heaven, Và kìa, Và visit this vine;
Và the vườn nho which thy tay phải hath planted, Và the branch that ngươi madest strong for thyself.
It is burned bằng lửa, it is cut down: they perish at the rebuke of thy countenance.
Let thy hand be upon the man of thy tay phải, upon the son of man whom ngươi madest strong for thyself.
So will not we go back from ngươi: quicken us, and we will call upon Danh Ngài.
Turn us again, O CHÚA ĐCT vạn quân, cause thy face to shine; Và we shall được cứu.

PSALM 81.
To the chief Musician upon Gittith, Thơ vịnh của A-sáp.
Sing aloud unto God our strength: make a joyful noise unto ĐCT of Gia-cốp. của A-sáp: or, for A-sáp
Take a psalm, Và bring hither the timbrel, the pleasant harp with the psaltery.
Blow up the trumpet in the new moon, in the time appointed, on our solemn feast ngày.
For this was a statute for I-sơ-ra-ên, Và a law of ĐCT of Gia-cốp.
This he ordained in Giô-sép for a testimony, when he went out through the land of Ai-Cập: where I heard a language that I understood not. through: or, against
I removed his shoulder from the burden: his hands were delivered from the pots. were…: Heb. passed away
ngươi calledst in trouble, Và I delivered ngươi; I trả lời ngươi in the secret place of thunder: I proved ngươi at the waters of Meribah. Selah. Meribah: or, Strife
nghe, O my people, Và I will testify unto ngươi: O I-sơ-ra-ên, if ngươi wilt hearken unto me;
There shall no strange ĐCT be in ngươi; neither shalt ngươi worship any strange ĐCT.
I là the CHÚA thy God, which brought ngươi out of the land of Ai-Cập: open thy mouth wide, Và I will fill it.
But my people would not hearken to my voice; Và I-sơ-ra-ên would none of me.
So I gave them up unto their own hearts' lust: Và they walked in their own counsels. unto…: or, to the hardness of their hearts, or, imagination
Oh that my people had hearkened unto me, Và I-sơ-ra-ên had walked in my ways!
I should soon have subdued their enemies, Và turned my hand against their adversaries.
The haters of the CHÚA should have submitted themselves unto him: but their time should have endured đến đời đời. submitted…: or, yielded feigned obedience: Heb. lied
He should have fed them also with the finest of the wheat: Và with honey out of the rock should I have satisfied ngươi. finest…: Heb. fat of wheat

PSALM 82.
Thơ vịnh của A-sáp.
ĐCT standeth in the congregation of the mighty; he judgeth among the gods. của A-sáp: or, for A-sáp
How long will ye judge unjustly, Và accept the persons of the wicked? Selah.
Defend người nghèo Và fatherless: do justice to the afflicted Và needy. Defend: Heb. Judge
Deliver người nghèo Và needy: rid họ out of tay of the wicked.
They know not, neither will they understand; they walk on in darkness: all the foundations đất are out of course. out…: Heb. moved
I have nói, Ye are gods; and all of you are children of the most High.
Nhưng ngươi sẽ chết like men, Và fall like one of the princes.
Hãy chổi dậy, Hỡi ĐCT, judge đất: for ngươi shalt inherit all nations.

PSALM 83.
Bài hát or Psalm của A-sáp.
Keep not ngươi silence, Hỡi ĐCT: hold not thy peace, Và be not still, Hỡi ĐCT. của A-sáp: or, for A-sáp
For, lo, thine enemies make a tumult: Và they that hate ngươi have lifted up the head.
They have taken crafty counsel against thy people, Và consulted against thy hidden ones.
They have nói, đến, Và let us cut them off from being a nation; that Tên của I-sơ-ra-ên may be no more in remembrance.
For they have consulted together with one consent: họ là confederate against ngươi: consent: Heb. heart
đền tạms of Edom, Và the Ích-ma-ênites; of Mô-áp, Và the Hagarenes;
Gebal, Và Ammon, Và Amalek; the Philistines with the inhabitants of Ti-rơ;
Assur also is joined with them: they have holpen con cái of Lot. Selah. holpen: Heb. been an arm to
Do với họ as unto the Midianites; as to Sisera, as to Jabin, at the brook of Kison:
Which perished at Endor: they became as dung for đất.
Make their nobles like Oreb, Và like Zeeb: yea, all their princes as Zebah, Và as Zalmunna:
Who nói, Let us take to ourselves nhàs của ĐCT in possession.
Hỡi ĐCT tôi, make them like a wheel; as the stubble before gió.
As the fire burneth a wood, Và as the flame setteth núis on fire;
So persecute them with thy tempest, Và make them afraid with thy storm.
Fill their faces with shame; that they may seek Danh Ngài, O CHÚA.
Let them be confounded Và troubled đến đời đời; yea, let them be put to shame, Và perish:
That men may know that thou, whose name alone is
Jehovah, art the most high over all đất.

PSALM 84.
To the chief Musician upon Gittith, Thơ vịnh for the sons of Korah.
How amiable are thy tabernacles, O CHÚA vạn quân!for the sons: or, của Cons
My soul longeth, yea, even fainteth for the courts of the CHÚA: my heart Và my flesh crieth out for the living ĐCT.
Yea, the sparrow hath found một căn nhà, Và the swallow a nest for herself, where she may lay her young, even thine altars, O CHÚA vạn quân, my King, Và my God.
phước are they that ở in thy house: they will be still praising ngươi. Selah.
phước is the man whose strength is in ngươi; in whose heart are the ways of them.
ai passing through the valley of Baca make it a well; mưa also filleth the pools. Baca…: or, mulberry trees make him a well, etc filleth: Heb. covereth
They go from strength to strength, every one of them in Si-ôn hiện ra before God. strength to…: or, company to company
O CHÚA ĐCT vạn quân, nghe my prayer: give ear, Hỡi ĐCT of Gia-cốp. Selah.
kìa, Hỡi ĐCT our shield, Và look upon mặt of thine anointed.
For a day in thy courts is better than a thousand. I had rather be a doorkeeper in nhà of my God, than to ở in the tents of wickedness. I had…: Heb. I would choose rather to sit at the threshold
For the CHÚA ĐCT is a sun Và shield: the CHÚA sẽ cho ân-điển Và glory: no good thing will he withhold from them that walk uprightly.
O CHÚA vạn quân, phước is the man that trusteth in ngươi.

PSALM 85.
To the chief Musician, Thơ vịnh for the sons of Korah.
CHÚA, ngươi hast been favourable unto thy land: ngươi hast brought back the captivity of Gia-cốp. for the sons: or, của Cons favourable: or, well pleased
ngươi hast forgiven the iniquity of thy people, ngươi hast covered all their sin. Selah.
ngươi hast taken away all thy wrath: ngươi hast turned thyself from the fierceness of thine anger. thyself…: or, thine anger from waxing hot
Turn us, Hỡi ĐCT of our salvation, Và cause thine anger toward us to cease.
Wilt ngươi be angry with us đến đời đời? wilt ngươi draw out thine anger to all generations?
Wilt ngươi not revive us again: that thy people may rejoice in ngươi?
Shew us thy mercy, O CHÚA, Và grant us sự cứu rỗi của Ngài.
I will hear what God the CHÚA will speak: for he will speak peace unto his people, Và to his saints: but let them not turn again to folly.
Surely his salvation is nigh them that fear him; that glory may ở in our land.
Mercy Và truth are met together; righteousness Và peace have kissed each other.
Truth shall spring out đất; Và righteousness shall look down from heaven.
Yea, the CHÚA shall give that which is tốt; Và our land shall yield her increase.
Righteousness shall go before him; and shall set us in the way of his steps.

PSALM 86.
A Prayer của Đa-vít.
Bow down thine ear, O CHÚA, nghe me: for I là poor Và needy. A Prayer…: or, A Prayer, being a Psalm của Đa-vít
Preserve my soul; for I là thánh: O ngươi my God, save thy servant that trusteth in ngươi. holy: or, one whom ngươi favourest
Be merciful unto me, O Lord: for I cry unto ngươi daily. daily: or, all the day
Rejoice the soul of thy servant: for unto ngươi, O Lord, do I lift up my soul.
For thou, Lord, art tốt, Và ready to forgive; Và plenteous in mercy unto all them that call upon ngươi.
Give ear, O CHÚA, unto my prayer; Và attend to the voice of my supplications.
trong ngày of my trouble I will call upon ngươi: for ngươi wilt answer me.
Among the gods there is none like unto ngươi, O Lord; neither are there any works like unto thy works.
All nations whom ngươi hast made shall come Và worship before ngươi, O Lord; Và shall glorify Danh Ngài.
For thou art great, Và doest wondrous things: thou art ĐCT alone.
Teach me thy way, O CHÚA; I will walk in thy truth: unite my heart to fear Danh Ngài.
I will praise ngươi, O Lord my God, with all my heart: Và I will glorify Danh Ngài for evermore.
For great is thy mercy toward me: and ngươi hast delivered my soul from the lowest hell. hell: or, grave
Hỡi ĐCT, the proud are risen against me, and the assemblies of violent men have sought after my soul; Và have not set ngươi before them. violent: Heb. terrible
But thou, O Lord, art a God full of compassion, Và gracious, longsuffering, Và plenteous in mercy Và truth.
O turn unto me, and have mercy upon me; give thy strength unto thy servant, Và save con trai of thine handmaid.
Shew me a token for good; that they which hate me may see it, Và be ashamed: because thou, CHÚA, hast holpen me, and comforted me.

PSALM 87.
Thơ vịnh or Song for the sons of Korah.
His foundation is in the holy mountains. for the sons: or, của Cons
The CHÚA loveth the gates of Si-ôn more than all the ởings of Gia-cốp.
Glorious things are spoken of ngươi, O city của ĐCT. Selah.
I will make mention of Rahab Và Ba-by-lôn to them that know me: kìa Philistia, Và Ti-rơ, with Ethiopia; this man was born there.
Và of Si-ôn it shall be nói, This and that man was born in her: and the highest himself shall establish her.
The CHÚA shall count, when he writeth up the people, that this man was born there. Selah.
As well the singers as the players on instruments shall be there: all my springs are in ngươi.

PSALM 88.
Bài hát or Psalm for the sons of Korah, to the chief Musician upon Mahalath Leannoth, Maschil of Heman the Ezrahite.
O CHÚA ĐCT of my salvation, I have cried ngày Và đêm before ngươi: for the sons: or, của Cons Maschil…: or, Thơ vịnh of Heman the Ezrahite, giving instruction
Let my prayer đến before ngươi: incline thine ear unto my cry;
For my soul is full of troubles: Và my sự sống draweth nigh unto the grave.
I am counted with them that go down into the pit: I am as a man that hath no strength:
Free among kẻ chết, like the slain that lie in the grave, whom ngươi rememberest no more: and they are cut off from thy hand. from: or, by
ngươi hast laid me in the lowest pit, in darkness, in the deeps.
Thy wrath lieth hard upon me, and ngươi hast afflicted me with all thy waves. Selah.
ngươi hast put away mine acquaintance far from me; ngươi hast made me an abomination với họ: I am shut up, Và I cannot come forth.
Mine eye mourneth by reason of affliction:
CHÚA, I have called hằng ngày upon ngươi, I have stretched out my hands unto ngươi.
Wilt ngươi shew wonders to kẻ chết? shall kẻ chết Hãy chổi dậy Và praise ngươi? Selah.
Shall thy lovingkindness be declared in the grave? or thy faithfulness in destruction?
Shall thy wonders be known in the dark? Và sự công chính của Ngài in the land of forgetfulness?
But unto ngươi have I cried, O CHÚA; Và in buổi sáng shall my prayer prevent ngươi.
CHÚA, why castest ngươi off my soul? why hidest ngươi thy face from me?
I là afflicted Và ready to die from my youth up: while I suffer thy terrors I am distracted.
Thy fierce wrath goeth over me; thy terrors have cut me off.
They came round about me daily like water; they compassed me about together. daily: or, all the day
Lover Và friend hast ngươi put far from me, Và mine acquaintance into darkness.

PSALM 89.
Maschil of Ethan the Ezrahite.
I will sing of sự thương xót of the CHÚA đến đời đời: with my mouth will I make known thy faithfulness to all generations. Maschil…: or, Thơ vịnh for Ethan the Ezrahite, để cho instruction to all…: Heb. to generation and generation
For I have nói, Mercy shall be built up đến đời đời: thy faithfulness shalt ngươi establish in the very heavens.
I have made a covenant with my chosen, I have sworn unto Đa-vít my servant,
Thy seed will I establish for ever, Và build up thy throne to all generations. Selah.
Và the heavens shall praise thy wonders, O CHÚA: thy faithfulness also in the congregation of the saints.
For who in the heaven can be compared unto the CHÚA? ai among the sons of the mighty can be likened unto the CHÚA?
ĐCT is greatly to be feared in the assembly of the saints, Và to be had in reverence of all them that are about him.
O CHÚA ĐCT vạn quân, who is a strong
CHÚA like unto ngươi? or to thy faithfulness round about ngươi?
ngươi rulest the raging of biển: when the waves thereof arise, ngươi stillest them.
ngươi hast broken Rahab in pieces, as one that is slain; ngươi hast scattered thine enemies with thy strong arm. Rahab: or, Ai-Cập thy…: Heb. the arm of thy strength
các tầng trời are thine, đất also is thine: as for thế gian Và the fulness thereof, ngươi hast founded them. the fulness…: or, all it containeth
The north Và the south ngươi hast created them: Tabor Và Hermon shall rejoice in Danh Ngài.
ngươi hast a mighty arm: strong is thy hand, Và high is thy tay phải. a…: Heb. an arm with might
Justice Và judgment are the habitation of thy throne: mercy Và truth shall go before thy face. habitation: or, establishment
phước is the people that know sự vui mừngful sound: they shall walk, O CHÚA, in the light of thy countenance.
In Danh Ngài shall they rejoice all the day: Và in sự công chính của Ngài shall they be exalted.
For thou art sự vinh hiển of their strength: Và in thy favour our horn shall be exalted.
For the CHÚA is our defence; Và the Holy One của I-sơ-ra-ên is our king. the CHÚA…: or, our shield is of the CHÚA, and our king is of the Holy One của I-sơ-ra-ên
Then ngươi spakest in vision to thy holy one, Và nóist, I have laid help upon one that is mighty; I have exalted one chosen out của dân sự.
I have found Đa-vít my servant; with my holy oil have I anointed him:
With whom my hand shall be established: mine arm also shall strengthen him.
The enemy shall not exact upon him; nor the son of wickedness afflict him.
Và I will beat down his foes before his face, Và plague them that hate him.
But my faithfulness Và my mercy shall be with him: and in my name shall his horn be exalted.
I will set his hand also in biển, Và his tay phải in the rivers.
He shall cry unto me, Thou art my father, my God, Và the rock of my salvation.
Also I will make him my firstborn, higher than các vua đất.
My mercy will I keep for him for evermore, Và my covenant shall stand fast with him.
His seed also will I make to endure đến đời đời, Và his throne as the days of heaven.
If his children forsake my law, Và walk not in my judgments;
If they break my statutes, Và keep not my commandments; break: Heb. profane
Then will I visit their transgression with the rod, Và their iniquity with stripes.
Nevertheless my lovingkindness will I not utterly take from him, nor suffer my faithfulness to fail. will…: Heb. I will not make void from him to fail: Heb. to lie
My covenant will I not break, nor alter the thing that is gone out of my lips.
Once have I sworn by my holiness that I will not lie unto Đa-vít. that…: Heb. if I lie
His seed shall endure đến đời đời, Và his throne as mặt trời before me.
It shall be established đến đời đời as the moon, and as a faithful witness in heaven. Selah.
But ngươi hast cast off Và abhorred, ngươi hast been wroth with thine anointed.
ngươi hast made void giao ước of thy servant: ngươi hast profaned his crown by casting it to the ground.
ngươi hast broken down all his hedges; ngươi hast brought his strong holds to ruin.
All that pass by đường spoil him: he is a reproach to his neighbours.
ngươi hast set up the tay phải of his adversaries; ngươi hast made all his enemies to rejoice.
ngươi hast also turned the edge of his thanh gươm, Và hast not made him to stand in the battle.
ngươi hast made his glory to cease, Và cast his throne down to the ground. glory: Heb. brightness
The days of his youth hast ngươi shortened: ngươi hast covered him with shame. Selah.
How long, CHÚA? wilt ngươi hide thyself đến đời đời? shall thy wrath đốt like fire?
nhớ how short my time is: wherefore hast ngươi made all men vô ích?
What man is he that liveth, Và shall not see sự chết? shall he deliver his soul from tay of the grave? Selah.
Lord, where are thy former lovingkindnesses, which ngươi swarest unto Đa-vít in thy truth?
nhớ, Lord, the reproach of thy servants; how I do bear in my bosom the reproach of all the mighty people;
Wherewith thine enemies have reproached, O CHÚA; wherewith they have reproached the footsteps of thine anointed.
phước be the CHÚA for evermore. Amen, Và Amen.

PSALM 90.
A Prayer of Môi-se the man của ĐCT.
Lord, ngươi hast been our ởing place in all generations. A Prayer…: or, A Prayer, being a Psalm of Môi-se in…: Heb. in generation and generation
Before núis were brought forth, or ever ngươi hadst formed đất Và the world, even from đời đời to đời đời, thou art ĐCT.
ngươi turnest man to destruction; Và sayest, Return, ye children of men.
For a thousand năm in thy sight are but as hôm qua when it is past, and as a watch in the night. when…: or, when he hath passed them
ngươi carriest them away as with a flood; they are as a sleep: in buổi sáng họ là như cỏ which groweth up. groweth…: or, is changed
In buổi sáng it flourisheth, Và groweth up; in buổi chiều it is cut down, Và withereth.
For we are consumed by thine anger, Và by thy wrath are we troubled.
ngươi hast set our iniquities before ngươi, our secret tội lỗi in the light of thy countenance.
For all our days are passed away in thy wrath: we spend our years as a tale that is told. passed…: Heb. turned away as a…: or, as a meditation
The days of our years are sáu mươi năm và mười; Và if by reason of strength they be fourscore năm, yet is their strength labour Và sorrow; for it is soon cut off, Và we fly away. The days…: Heb. As for the days of our years, in them are bảy mươi years
Who knoweth quyền năng of thine anger? even according to thy fear, so is thy wrath.
So teach us to number our days, that we may apply our hearts unto wisdom. apply: Heb. cause to come
Return, O CHÚA, how long? and let it repent ngươi concerning thy servants.
O satisfy us early with thy mercy; that we may rejoice Và be glad all our days.
Make us glad according to the days wherein ngươi hast afflicted us, Và the years wherein we have seen evil.
Let thy work appear unto thy servants, Và thy glory unto their children.
Và let the beauty of the CHÚA ĐCT chúng tôi be upon us: and establish ngươi the work of our hands upon us; yea, the work of our hands establish ngươi it.

PSALM 91.
He that ởeth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty. abide: Heb. lodge
I will say of the CHÚA, He is my refuge Và my fortress: my God; in him will I trust.
Surely he shall deliver ngươi from the snare of the fowler, Và from the noisome pestilence.
He shall cover ngươi with his feathers, Và under his wings shalt ngươi trust: his truth shall be thy shield Và buckler.
ngươi shalt not be afraid for the terror by night; cũng không for the arrow that flieth by day;
cũng không for the pestilence that walketh in darkness; cũng không for the destruction that wasteth at noonday.
một ngàn shall fall at thy side, và mười thousand at thy tay phải; but it shall not come nigh ngươi.
Only with thine eyes shalt ngươi kìa Và see the reward of the wicked.
Because ngươi hast made the CHÚA, which is my refuge, even the most High, thy habitation;
There shall no evil befall ngươi, neither shall any plague come nigh thy ởing.
For he shall give his angels charge over ngươi, to keep ngươi in all thy ways.
They shall bear ngươi up in their hands, lest ngươi dash thy foot against a stone.
ngươi shalt tread upon the lion Và adder: the young lion Và the dragon shalt ngươi trample under feet. adder: or, asp
Because he hath set his love upon me, therefore will I deliver him: I will set him on high, because he hath known my name.
He shall call upon me, and I will answer him: I will be with him in trouble; I will deliver him, and honour him.
With long sự sống will I satisfy him, and shew him my salvation. long…: Heb. length of days

PSALM 92.
Thơ vịnh or Song for ngày Sa-bát ngày.
It is a tốt thing để cho thanks unto the CHÚA, Và to sing praises unto Danh Ngài, O most High:
To shew forth thy lovingkindness in buổi sáng, Và thy faithfulness every night,every…: Heb. in the nights
Upon an instrument of ten strings, Và upon the psaltery; upon the harp with a solemn sound. the harp…: or, the solemn sound with the harp a solemn…: Heb. Higgaion
For thou, CHÚA, hast made me glad through thy work: I will triumph in the works of thy hands.
O CHÚA, how great are thy works! Và thy thoughts are very deep.
A brutish man biết not; neither doth a fool understand this.
When the wicked spring as the grass, Và when all the workers of iniquity do flourish; it is that they shall be destroyed đến đời đời:
But thou, CHÚA, art most high for evermore.
For, lo, thine enemies, O CHÚA, for, lo, thine enemies shall perish; all the workers of iniquity shall be scattered.
But my horn shalt ngươi exalt like the horn of an unicorn: I shall be anointed with fresh oil.
Mine eye also sẽ thấy my desire on mine enemies, Và mine ears shall hear my desire of the wicked that rise up against me.
The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree: he shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon.
Those that be planted in nhà of the CHÚA shall flourish in the courts of our God.
They shall still kết quả in old age; they shall be fat Và flourishing; flourishing: Heb. green
To shew that the CHÚA is upright: he is my rock, and there is no unrighteousness in him.

PSALM 93.
The CHÚA reigneth, he is clothed with majesty; the CHÚA is clothed with strength, wherewith he hath girded himself: the world also is stablished, that it cannot be moved.
Thy throne is established of old: thou art from đời đời. of old: Heb. from then
The floods have lifted up, O CHÚA, the floods have lifted up their voice; the floods lift up their waves.
The CHÚA on high is mightier than the noise of many waters, yea, than the mighty waves of biển.
Thy testimonies are very sure: holiness becometh thine house, O CHÚA, đến đời đời. đến đời đời: Heb. to length of days

PSALM 94.
O CHÚA ĐCT, to whom vengeance belongeth; Hỡi ĐCT, to whom vengeance belongeth, shew thyself. God…: Heb. God of revenges shew…: Heb. shine forth
Lift up thyself, ngươi judge đất: render a reward to the proud.
CHÚA, how long shall the wicked, how long shall the wicked triumph?
How long shall they utter Và nói hard things? Và all the workers of iniquity boast themselves?
They break in pieces thy people, O CHÚA, Và afflict thine heritage.
They slay the widow Và the stranger, Và murder chaless.
Yet they say, The CHÚA shall not see, neither shall ĐCT of Gia-cốp regard it.
Understand, ye brutish among the people: and ye fools, when will ye be wise?
He that planted the ear, shall he not hear? he that formed the eye, shall he not see?
He that chastiseth the heathen, shall not he correct? he that teacheth man sự hiểu biết, shall not he know?
The CHÚA biết the thoughts of man, that they are vanity.
phước is the man whom ngươi chastenest, O CHÚA, Và teachest him out of thy law;
That ngươi mayest give him rest from the days of adversity, until the pit be digged for the wicked.
For the CHÚA will not cast off his people, neither will he forsake his inheritance.
But judgment shall return unto righteousness: Và all the upright in heart shall follow it. shall follow…: Heb. shall be after it
Who will rise up for me against the evildoers? or who will stand up for me against the workers of iniquity?
Unless the CHÚA had been cứu cánh tôi, my soul had almost dwelt in silence. almost: or, quickly
When tôi nói, My foot slippeth; thy mercy, O CHÚA, held me up.
In đám đông of my thoughts within me thy comforts delight my soul.
Shall the throne of iniquity have fellowship with ngươi, which frameth mischief by a law?
They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, Và kết án the innocent huyết.
But the CHÚA is my defence; Và my God is the rock of my refuge.
Và he shall bring upon them their own iniquity, Và shall cut them off in their own wickedness; yea, the CHÚA ĐCT chúng tôi shall cut them off.

PSALM 95.
O come, let us sing unto the CHÚA: let us make a joyful noise to the rock of our salvation.
Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving, Và make a joyful noise unto him with psalms. come…: Heb. prevent his face
For the CHÚA is a great ĐCT, Và a great vua above all gods.
In his hand are the deep places đất: the strength of the hills is his also. In…: Heb. In whose the strength…: or, the heights of the hills are his
biển is his, and he made it: and his hands formed the dry land. biển…: Heb. Whose biển is
O come, let us worship Và bow down: let us kneel before the CHÚA our maker.
For he is ĐCT chúng tôi; and we are the people of his pasture, Và the sheep of his hand. To day if ye will hear his voice,
Harden not your heart, as in the provocation, Và as trong ngày of temptation in the wilderness: provocation: Heb. contention
When your fathers tempted me, proved me, and saw my work.
bốn mươi năm long was I grieved with này dòng dõi, và nói, It is a people that do err in their heart, Và they have not known my ways:
Unto whom I sware in my wrath that they should not enter into my rest. that…: Heb. if they enter into my rest

PSALM 96.
O sing unto the CHÚA a new song: sing unto the CHÚA, all đất.
Sing unto the CHÚA, bless his name; shew forth his salvation from day to day.
Declare sự vinh hiển Ngài among the heathen, his wonders among all people.
For the CHÚA is great, Và greatly to be praised: he is to be feared above all gods.
For all the gods of the nations are idols: but the CHÚA made các tầng trời.
Honour Và majesty are before him: strength Và beauty are in his sanctuary.
Give unto the CHÚA, O ye kindreds của dân sự, give unto the CHÚA glory Và strength.
Give unto the CHÚA sự vinh hiển due unto his name: bring an offering, Và come into his courts. due…: Heb. of his name
O worship the CHÚA in the beauty of holiness: fear before him, all đất. in the…: or, in the glorious sanctuary
Say among the heathen that the CHÚA reigneth: thế gian also shall be established that it shall not be moved: he shall judge the people righteously.
Let the heavens rejoice, Và let đất be glad; let biển roar, Và the fulness thereof. the fulness…: or, all it containeth
Let the field be joyful, and all that is therein: then shall all the trees of the wood rejoice
Before the CHÚA: for he cometh, for he cometh to judge đất: he shall judge thế gian with righteousness, Và the people with his truth.

PSALM 97.
The CHÚA reigneth; let đất rejoice; let đám đông of isles be glad thereof. multitude…: Heb. many, or, great isles
Clouds Và darkness are round about him: righteousness Và judgment are the habitation of his throne. habitation: or, establishment
A fire goeth before him, and burneth up his enemies round about.
His lightnings enlightened thế gian: đất nhìn thấy, Và trembled.
The hills melted like wax at the presence of the CHÚA, at the presence của ĐCT of the whole đất.
các tầng trời declare his righteousness, Và all the people thấy sự vinh hiển Ngài.
Confounded be all they that serve graven images, that boast themselves of idols: worship him, all ye gods.
Si-ôn nghe, Và was glad; Và the daughters của Giu-đa rejoiced vì cớ thy judgments, O CHÚA.
For thou, CHÚA, art high above all đất: ngươi art exalted far above all gods.
Ye that love the CHÚA, ghét evil: he preserveth the souls of his saints; he delivereth them out of tay of the wicked.
Light is sown for the righteous, Và gladness for the upright in heart.
Rejoice in the CHÚA, ye righteous; Và give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness. at…: or, to the memorial

PSALM 98.
Thơ vịnh.
O sing unto the CHÚA a new song; for he hath done marvellous things: his tay phải, Và his holy arm, hath gotten him sự chiến thắng.
The CHÚA hath made known his salvation: his righteousness hath he openly shewed in the sight of the heathen. openly…: or, revealed
He hath nhớ lại his mercy Và his truth toward nhà của I-sơ-ra-ên: all the ends đất have seen the salvation of our God.
Make a joyful noise unto the CHÚA, all đất: make a loud noise, Và rejoice, Và sing praise.
Sing unto the CHÚA with the harp; with the harp, Và the voice of a psalm.
With trumpets Và sound of cornet make a joyful noise before the CHÚA, the King.
Let biển roar, Và the fulness thereof; the world, Và they that ở therein. the fulness…: or, all it containeth
Let the floods clap their hands: let the hills be joyful together
Before the CHÚA; for he cometh to judge đất: with righteousness shall he judge thế gian, Và the people with equity.

PSALM 99.
The CHÚA reigneth; let the people tremble: he sitteth between the cherubims; let đất be moved. be moved: Heb. stagger
The CHÚA is great in Si-ôn; and he is high above all the people.
Let them praise thy great Và terrible name; for it is thánh.
The king's strength also loveth judgment; ngươi dost establish equity, ngươi executest judgment Và righteousness in Gia-cốp.
Exalt ye the CHÚA ĐCT chúng tôi, Và worship at his footstool; for he is thánh. he is…: or, it is holy
Môi-se Và A-rôn among his priests, Và Samuel among them that call upon his name; they called upon the CHÚA, Và he trả lời them.
He spake với họ in đám mâyy pillar: they kept his testimonies, Và the ordinance that he gave them.
ngươi trả lờist them, O CHÚA ĐCT chúng tôi: ngươi wast a God that forgavest them, though ngươi tookest vengeance of their inventions.
Exalt the CHÚA ĐCT chúng tôi, Và worship at his holy đồi; for the CHÚA ĐCT chúng tôi is thánh.

PSALM 100.
Thơ vịnh of praise.
Make a joyful noise unto the CHÚA, all ye lands. praise: or, thanksgiving all…: Heb. all đất
Serve the CHÚA with gladness: đến before his presence with singing.
biết ye that the CHÚA he is ĐCT: it is he that hath made us, and not we ourselves; we are his people, Và the sheep of his pasture. Và not…: or, and his we are
Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, Và into his courts with praise: be thankful unto him, Và bless his name.
For the CHÚA is tốt; his mercy is đời đời; Và his truth endureth to all generations. to all…: Heb. to generation and generation

PSALM 101.
Thơ vịnh của Đa-vít.
I will sing of mercy Và judgment: unto ngươi, O CHÚA, will I sing.
I will behave myself wisely in a perfect way. O when wilt ngươi come unto me? I will walk within my house with a perfect heart.
I will set no wicked thing before mine eyes: I hate the work of them that turn aside; it shall not cleave to me. wicked…: Heb. thing of Belial
A froward heart shall depart from me: I will not know a wicked person.
Whoso privily slandereth his neighbour, him will I cut off: him that hath an high look Và a proud heart will not I suffer.
Mine eyes shall be upon the faithful of the land, that they may ở with me: he that walketh in a perfect way, he shall serve me. in a…: or, perfect in the way
He that worketh deceit shall not ở within my house: he that telleth lies shall not tarry in my sight. shall not tarry: Heb. shall not be established
I will early destroy all the wicked of the land; that I may cut off all wicked doers from the city of the CHÚA.

PSALM 102.
A Prayer of the afflicted, when he is overwhelmed, Và poureth out his complaint before the CHÚA.
nghe my prayer, O CHÚA, Và let my cry đến unto ngươi. of: or, for
Hide not thy face from me trong ngày khi I am in trouble; incline thine ear unto me: trong ngày khi I call answer me speedily.
For my days are consumed like smoke, Và my bones are burned as an hearth. like…: or, (as some read) into smoke
My heart is smitten, Và withered như cỏ; so that I forget to eat my bread.
By reason of the voice of my groaning my bones cleave to my skin. skin: or, flesh
I am like a pelican of the wilderness: I am like an owl of the desert.
I watch, Và am as a sparrow alone upon nhà top.
Mine enemies reproach me all the day; Và they that are mad against me are sworn against me.
For I have eaten ashes like bread, Và mingled my drink with weeping,
Bởi vì of thine indignation Và thy wrath: for ngươi hast lifted me up, Và cast me down.
My days are like a shadow that declineth; Và I am withered như cỏ.
But thou, O CHÚA, shalt endure đến đời đời; Và thy remembrance unto all generations.
ngươi shalt arise, Và have mercy upon Si-ôn: for the time to favour her, yea, the set time, is come.
For thy servants take pleasure in her stones, Và favour the dust thereof.
So the heathen shall fear Tên of the CHÚA, Và tất cả các vua đất thy glory.
When the CHÚA shall build up Si-ôn, he shall appear in his glory.
He will regard the prayer of the destitute, Và not despise their prayer.
This shall be written for the generation to come: Và the people which shall be created shall praise the CHÚA.
For he hath looked down from the height of his sanctuary; from heaven did the CHÚA kìa đất;
To hear the groaning of the prisoner; to loose those that are appointed to death; those…: Heb. the children of death
To declare Tên of the CHÚA in Si-ôn, Và his praise in Giê-ru-sa-lem;
When the people are gathered together, Và the kingdoms, to serve the CHÚA.
He weakened my strength in the way; he shortened my days. weakened: Heb. afflicted
tôi nói, Hỡi ĐCT tôi, take me not away in the midst of my days: thy years are throughout all generations.
Of old hast ngươi laid the foundation đất: Và the heavens are the work of thy hands.
They shall perish, but ngươi shalt endure: yea, all of them shall wax old like a garment; as a vesture shalt ngươi change them, and they shall be changed: endure: Heb. stand
But thou art the same, and thy years shall have no end.
con cái of thy servants shall continue, Và their seed shall be established before ngươi.

PSALM 103.
Thơ vịnh của Đa-vít.
Bless the CHÚA, O my soul: Và all that is within me, bless his holy name.
Bless the CHÚA, O my soul, Và forget not all his benefits:
Who forgiveth all thine iniquities; who healeth all thy diseases;
Who redeemeth thy sự sống from destruction; who crowneth ngươi with lovingkindness và mườider mercies;
Who satisfieth thy mouth with good things; so that thy youth is renewed like the eagle's.
The CHÚA executeth righteousness Và judgment for all that are oppressed.
He made known his ways unto Môi-se, his acts unto the children của I-sơ-ra-ên.
The CHÚA is merciful Và gracious, slow to anger, Và plenteous in mercy. plenteous…: Heb. great in mercy
He will not always chide: neither will he keep his anger đến đời đời.
He hath not dealt with us after our tội lỗi; nor rewarded us according to our iniquities.
For as the heaven is high above đất, so great is his mercy toward them that fear him. as…: Heb. according to the height of the heaven
As far as the east is from phương tây, so far hath he removed our transgressions from us.
Like as a father pitieth his children, so the CHÚA pitieth them that fear him.
For he knoweth our frame; he remembereth that we are dust.
As for man, his days are as grass: as a flower of the field, so he flourisheth.
For the wind passeth over it, and it is gone; and the place thereof shall know it no more. it is…: Heb. it is not
But the mercy of the CHÚA is from đời đời to đời đời upon them that fear him, and his righteousness unto children's children;
To such as keep his covenant, Và to those that remember his commandments to do them.
The CHÚA hath prepared his throne in the heavens; Và his kingdom ruleth over all.
Bless the CHÚA, ye his angels, that excel in strength, that do his commandments, hearkening unto the voice of his word. that excel…: Heb. mighty in strength
Bless ye the CHÚA, all ye his hosts; ye ministers of his, that do his pleasure.
Bless the CHÚA, all his works in all places of his dominion: bless the CHÚA, O my soul.

PSALM 104.
Bless the CHÚA, O my soul. O CHÚA my God, ngươi art very great; ngươi art clothed with honour Và majesty.
Who coverest thyself with light as với a garment: who stretchest out các tầng trời like a curtain:
Who layeth the beams of his chambers in the waters: who maketh đám mâys his chariot: who walketh upon the wings of the wind:
Who maketh his angels spirits; his ministers a flaming lửa:
ai laid the foundations đất, that it should not be removed đến đời đời. Who…: Heb. He hath founded đất upon her bases
ngươi coveredst it with the deep as với a garment: the waters đứng above núis.
At thy rebuke they fled; at the voice of thy thunder they hasted away.
They go up by núis; they go down by the valleys unto the place which ngươi hast founded for them. They go up…: or, núis ascend, the valleys descend
ngươi hast set a bound that they may not pass over; that they turn not again to cover đất.
He sendeth the springs into the valleys, which run among the hills. He: Heb. Who run: Heb. walk
They give drink to every beast of the field: the wild asses quench their thirst. quench: Heb. break
By them shall the fowls of the heaven have their habitation, which sing among the branches. sing: Heb. give a voice
He watereth the hills from his chambers: đất is satisfied with the fruit of thy works.
He causeth the grass to grow for the cattle, Và herb for the service of man: that he may bring forth food out đất;
Và wine that maketh glad the heart of man, Và oil to make his mặt to shine, Và bread which strengtheneth man's heart. oil…: Heb. to make his face shine with oil, or, more than oil
The trees of the CHÚA are full of sap; the cedars of Lebanon, which he hath planted;
Where the birds make their nests: as for the stork, the fir trees are her house.
The high hills are a refuge for the wild goats; Và the rocks for the conies.
He appointed mặt trăng for seasons: mặt trời biết his going down.
ngươi makest tối tăm, Và it is night: wherein all the beasts of the forest do creep forth. beasts…: Heb. beasts thereof do trample on the forest
The young lions roar after their prey, Và seek their meat from God.
mặt trời ariseth, they gather themselves together, Và lay them down in their dens.
Man goeth forth unto his work Và to his labour until buổi chiều.
O CHÚA, how manifold are thy works! in wisdom hast ngươi made them all: đất is full of thy riches.
So is this great Và wide sea, wherein are things creeping innumerable, both small Và great beasts.
There go the ships: there is that leviathan, whom ngươi hast made to play therein. made: Heb. formed
These wait all upon ngươi; that ngươi mayest give họ their meat in due season.
That ngươi givest them they gather: ngươi openest thine hand, they are filled with good.
ngươi hidest thy face, they are troubled: ngươi takest away their breath, they die, Và return to their dust.
ngươi sendest forth thy spirit, they are created: Và ngươi renewest mặt đất.
The glory of the CHÚA shall endure đến đời đời: the CHÚA shall rejoice in his works. endure: Heb. be
He looketh on đất, Và it trembleth: he toucheth the hills, Và they smoke.
I will sing unto the CHÚA as long as I live: I will sing praise to my God while I have my being.
My meditation of him shall be sweet: I will be glad in the CHÚA.
Let the sinners be consumed out đất, Và let the wicked be no more. Bless ngươi the CHÚA, O my soul. Praise ye the CHÚA.

PSALM 105.
O give thanks unto the CHÚA; call upon his name: make known his deeds among the people.
Sing unto him, sing psalms unto him: talk ye of all his wondrous works.
Glory ye in his holy name: let the heart of them rejoice that seek the CHÚA.
Seek the CHÚA, Và his strength: seek his face evermore.
nhớ his marvellous works that he hath done; his wonders, Và the judgments of his mouth;
O ye seed of Áp-ra-ham his servant, ye children of Gia-cốp his chosen.
He is the CHÚA ĐCT chúng tôi: his judgments are in all đất.
He hath nhớ lại his covenant đến đời đời, lời which he commanded to a thousand generations.
Which covenant he made with Áp-ra-ham, Và his oath unto Y-sác;
Và confirmed the same unto Gia-cốp for a law, Và to I-sơ-ra-ên for an đời đời covenant:
nói [rằng], Unto ngươi will I give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance: lot: Heb. cord
When they were but a few men in number; yea, very few, Và strangers in it.
When they went from one nation to another, from one kingdom to another people;
He suffered không ai to do them wrong: yea, he reproved các vua for their sakes;
nói [rằng], Touch not mine anointed, Và do my các tiên tri no harm.
Moreover he called for a famine upon the land: he brake the whole staff of bread.
He sent một người before them, even Giô-sép, ai was sold for a servant:
Whose feet they hurt with fetters: he was laid in sắt: he…: Heb. his soul came into sắt
Until the time that his word đến: lời of the CHÚA tried him.
The king sent Và loosed him; even the ruler của dân sự, Và let him go free.
He made him lord of his house, Và ruler of all his substance: substance: Heb. possession
To bind his princes at his pleasure; Và teach his senators sự khôn ngoan.
I-sơ-ra-ên also came into Ai-Cập; Và Gia-cốp sojourned in the land of Ham.
Và he increased his people greatly; Và made them stronger than their enemies.
He turned their heart to hate his people, to deal subtilly with his servants.
He sent Môi-se his servant; Và A-rôn whom he had chosen.
They shewed his signs among them, and wonders in the land of Ham. his…: Heb. words of his signs
He sent tối tăm, Và made it dark; Và they rebelled not against his word.
He turned their waters into blood, Và slew their fish.
Their land brought forth frogs in abundance, in the chambers of their kings.
He spake, Và there came divers sorts of flies, Và lice in all their coasts.
He gave them hail for rain, Và flaming lửa in their land. them…: Heb. their rain hail
He smote their vines also and their cây vảs; Và brake the trees of their coasts.
He spake, Và the châu chấu đến, Và caterpillers, Và that without number,
Và did eat up all the herbs in their land, Và devoured the fruit of their ground.
He smote also all the firstborn in their land, the chief of all their strength.
He brought them forth also with silver và vàng: and there was not one feeble person among their tribes.
Ai-Cập was glad when they departed: for the fear of them fell upon them.
He spread a cloud for a covering; Và fire để cho light in the night.
The people asked, Và he brought quails, Và satisfied them with the bread of heaven.
He opened the rock, Và the waters gushed out; they ran in the dry places like a river.
For he nhớ lại his holy promise, Và Áp-ra-ham his servant.
Và he brought forth his people with joy, Và his chosen with gladness: gladness: Heb. singing
Và gave them the lands of the heathen: Và they inherited the labour của dân sự;
That they might observe his statutes, Và keep his laws. Praise ye the CHÚA. Praise…: Heb. Hallelujah

PSALM 106.
Praise ye the CHÚA. O give thanks unto the CHÚA; for he is tốt: for his mercy endureth đến đời đời. Praise…: Heb. Hallelujah
Who can utter the mighty acts of the CHÚA? ai can shew forth all his praise?
phước are they that keep judgment, Và he that doeth righteousness at all times.
nhớ me, O CHÚA, with the favour that ngươi bearest unto thy people: O visit me with sự cứu rỗi của Ngài;
That I may see the good of thy chosen, that I may rejoice in the gladness of thy nation, that I may glory with thine inheritance.
We have sinned with our fathers, we have committed iniquity, we have done wickedly.
Our fathers hiểu not thy wonders in Ai-Cập; they nhớ lại not đám đông of thy mercies; but provoked him at biển, even at the Red sea.
Nevertheless he saved them for his name's sake, that he might make his mighty power to be known.
He rebuked the Red sea also, and it was dried up: so he led them through the depths, as through the wilderness.
Và he saved them from tay of him that hated họ, Và redeemed them from tay of the enemy.
Và the waters covered their enemies: there was not one of them left.
Then believed they his words; they sang his praise.
They soon forgat his works; they waited not for his counsel: They soon…: Heb. They made haste, they forgat
But lusted exceedingly in the wilderness, Và tempted ĐCT in the desert. lusted…: Heb. lusted a lust
Và he gave them their request; but sent leanness into their soul.
They envied Môi-se also in the camp, Và A-rôn the saint of the CHÚA.
đất mở Và swallowed up Dathan, Và covered the company of Abiram.
Và a fire was kindled in their company; the flame burned up the wicked.
They made a calf in Horeb, Và worshipped the molten image.
Thus they changed their glory into the similitude of một con bò that eateth cỏ.
They forgat ĐCT their saviour, which had done great things in Ai-Cập;
Wondrous works in the land of Ham, Và terrible things by the Red sea.
Therefore he nói that he would destroy them, had not Môi-se his chosen đứng before him in the breach, to turn away his wrath, lest he should destroy họ.
Yea, they despised the pleasant land, they believed not his word: the pleasant…: Heb. a land of desire
But murmured in their tents, Và hearkened not unto the voice of the CHÚA.
Therefore he lifted up his hand against them, to overthrow them in the wilderness: to overthrow: Heb. to make them fall
To overthrow their seed also among the nations, Và to scatter them in the lands. To overthrow: Heb. To make them fall
They joined themselves also unto Baal–peor, Và ate the sacrifices của kẻ chết.
Thus they provoked him to anger with their inventions: Và the plague brake in upon them.
Then stood up Phinehas, Và executed judgment: and so the plague was stayed.
Và that was counted unto him for righteousness unto all generations for evermore.
They angered him also at the waters of strife, so that it went ill with Môi-se for their sakes:
Because they provoked his spirit, so that he spake unadvisedly with his lips.
They did not destroy the nations, concerning whom the CHÚA truyền lệnh them:
But were mingled among the heathen, Và learned their works.
Và they served their idols: which were a snare với họ.
Yea, they sacrificed their sons Và their daughters unto devils,
Và shed innocent huyết, even the blood of their sons Và of their daughters, whom they sacrificed unto the idols of Canaan: Và the land was polluted with blood.
Thus were they làm dơ dáyd with their own works, Và went a whoring with their own inventions.
Therefore was cơn thịnh nộ of the CHÚA kindled against his people, đến nổi he abhorred his own inheritance.
Và he gave them into tay of the heathen; Và they that hated them ruled over them.
Their enemies also oppressed them, and they were brought into subjection under their hand.
Many times did he deliver them; but they provoked him with their counsel, Và were brought low for their iniquity. brought…: or, impoverished, or, weakened
Nevertheless he regarded their affliction, when he heard their cry:
Và he nhớ lại for them his covenant, Và repented according to đám đông of his mercies.
He made them also to be pitied of all those that carried them captives.
Save us, O CHÚA ĐCT chúng tôi, Và gather us from among the heathen, để cho thanks unto thy holy name, Và to triumph in thy praise.
phước be the CHÚA ĐCT của I-sơ-ra-ên from đời đời to đời đời: Và let all the people say, Amen. Praise ye the CHÚA. Praise…: Heb. Hallelujah

PSALM 107.
O give thanks unto the CHÚA, for he is tốt: for his mercy endureth đến đời đời.
Let the redeemed of the CHÚA say so, whom he hath redeemed from tay of the enemy;
Và gathered them out of the lands, from the east, Và from phương tây, from the north, Và from the south. south: Heb. sea
They wandered in the wilderness in a solitary way; they found no city to ở in.
Hungry Và thirsty, their soul fainted in them.
Then they cried unto the CHÚA in their trouble, Và he delivered them out of their distresses.
Và he led them forth by the right way, that they might go to a city of habitation.
Oh that men would praise the CHÚA for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!
For he satisfieth the longing soul, Và filleth the hungry soul with goodness.
Such as sit in darkness Và in the shadow of death, being bound in affliction Và sắt;
Because they rebelled against the words của ĐCT, Và contemned the counsel of the most High:
Therefore he brought down their heart with labour; they fell down, and there was none to help.
Then they cried unto the CHÚA in their trouble, Và he saved them out of their distresses.
He brought them out của sự tối tăm Và the shadow of death, Và brake their bands in sunder.
Oh that men would praise the CHÚA for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!
For he hath broken the gates of brass, Và cut the bars of sắt in sunder.
Fools vì of their transgression, Và vì cớ their iniquities, are afflicted.
Their soul abhorreth all manner of meat; Và they draw near unto the gates of death.
Then they cry unto the CHÚA in their trouble, Và he saveth them out of their distresses.
He sent his word, Và healed them, and delivered họ from their destructions.
Oh that men would praise the CHÚA for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!
Và let them sacrifice the sacrifices of thanksgiving, Và declare his works with rejoicing. rejoicing: Heb. singing
They that go down to biển in ships, that do business in great waters;
These see những công việc of the CHÚA, Và his wonders in the deep.
For he commandeth, Và raiseth the stormy wind, which lifteth up the waves thereof. raiseth: Heb. maketh to stand
They mount up to the heaven, they go down again to the depths: their soul is melted vì cớ trouble.
They reel to and fro, Và stagger like a drunken man, Và are at their wits' end. are…: Heb. all their wisdom is swallowed up
Then they cry unto the CHÚA in their trouble, Và he bringeth them out of their distresses.
He maketh the storm a calm, so that the waves thereof are still.
Then are they glad because they be quiet; so he bringeth them unto their desired haven.
Oh that men would praise the CHÚA for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!
Let them exalt him also in the congregation của dân sự, Và praise him in the assembly of các trưởng lão.
He turneth rivers into a wilderness, Và the watersprings into dry ground;
A fruitful land into barrenness, for the wickedness of them that ở therein. barrenness: Heb. saltiness
He turneth đồng vắng into a standing nước, Và dry ground into watersprings.
Và there he maketh the hungry to ở, that they may prepare a city for habitation;
Và sow the fields, Và plant vườn nhos, which may yield fruits of increase.
He blesseth them also, so that they are multiplied greatly; Và suffereth not their cattle to decrease.
Again, they are minished Và brought low through oppression, affliction, Và sorrow.
He poureth contempt upon princes, Và causeth them to wander in the wilderness, where there is no way. wilderness: or, void place
Yet setteth he the poor on high from affliction, Và làm [cho] gia quyến like a flock. from: or, after
Người ngay thẳng sẽ thấy [điều ấy], và vui mừng: Và all iniquity shall stop her mouth.
Whoso is khôn ngoan, Và will observe these things, even they shall understand the lovingkindness of the CHÚA.

PSALM 108.
Bài hát or Psalm của Đa-vít.
Hỡi ĐCT, my heart is fixed; I will sing Và give praise, even with my glory.
Awake, psaltery Và harp: I myself will awake early.
I will praise ngươi, O CHÚA, among the people: Và I will sing praises unto ngươi among the nations.
For thy mercy is great above the heavens: Và thy truth reacheth unto đám mâys. clouds: or, skies
Be ngươi exalted, Hỡi ĐCT, above the heavens: Và thy glory above all đất;
That thy beloved may be delivered: save với thy tay phải, Và answer me.
ĐCT hath spoken in his holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem, Và mete out the valley of Succoth.
Gilead is mine; Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the strength of mine head; Giu-đa is my lawgiver;
Mô-áp is my washpot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe; over Philistia will I triumph.
Who will bring me into the strong city? who will lead me into Edom?
Wilt not thou, Hỡi ĐCT, ai hast cast us off? Và wilt not thou, Hỡi ĐCT, go forth with our hosts?
Give us help from trouble: for vain is the help of man.
Through God we shall do valiantly: for he it is that shall tread down our enemies.

PSALM 109.
To the chief Musician, Thơ vịnh của Đa-vít.
Hold not thy peace, Hỡi ĐCT of my praise;
For the mouth of the wicked Và the mouth of the deceitful are opened against me: they have spoken against me with a lying lưỡi. of the deceitful: Heb. of deceit are opened: Heb. have opened themselves
They compassed me about also with words of thù oán; Và fought against me without a cause.
For my love they are my adversaries: but I give myself unto prayer.
Và they have rewarded me evil for good, Và thù oán for my love.
Set ngươi a wicked man over him: and let Satan stand at his tay phải. Satan: or, an adversary
When he shall be judged, let him be kết án: Và let his prayer become sin. be kết án: Heb. go out guilty, or, wicked
Let his days be few; Và let another take his office. office: or, charge
Let his children be fatherless, Và his wife a widow.
Let his children be continually vagabonds, Và beg: let them seek their bread also out of their desolate places.
Let the extortioner catch all that he hath; and let the strangers spoil his labour.
Let there be none to extend mercy unto him: neither let there be any to favour his fatherless children.
Let his posterity be cut off; Và in the generation following let their name be blotted out.
Let the iniquity of his fathers be nhớ lại with the CHÚA; Và let not the sin of his mother be blotted out.
Let them be before the CHÚA continually, that he may cut off the memory of them from đất.
Because that he nhớ lại not to shew mercy, but persecuted người nghèo Và needy man, that he might even slay the broken in heart.
As he loved cursing, so let it come unto him: as he delighted not in blessing, so let it be far from him.
As he clothed himself with cursing like as with his garment, so let it come into his bowels like water, Và like oil into his bones. into his bowels: Heb. within him
Let it be unto him as the garment which covereth him, and for a girdle wherewith he is girded continually.
Let this be the reward of mine adversaries from the CHÚA, Và of them that speak evil against my soul.
But do ngươi for me, O God Chúa, for Danh Ngài's sake: because thy mercy is tốt, deliver ngươi me.
For I là poor Và needy, Và my heart is wounded within me.
I am gone like the shadow when it declineth: I am tossed up and down as the locust.
My knees are weak through fasting; Và my flesh faileth of fatness.
I became also a reproach với họ: khi they looked upon me they shaked their heads.
Help me, O CHÚA my God: O save me according to thy mercy:
That they may know that this is thy hand; that thou, CHÚA, hast done it.
Let them curse, but bless thou: when they arise, let them be ashamed; but let thy servant rejoice.
Let mine adversaries be clothed with shame, Và let them cover themselves with their own confusion, as with a mantle.
I will greatly praise the CHÚA with my mouth; yea, I will praise him among đám đông.
For he shall stand at the tay phải of the poor, to save him from those that kết án his soul. those…: Heb. the judges of

PSALM 110.
Thơ vịnh của Đa-vít.
The CHÚA nói unto my Lord, Sit ngươi at my tay phải, until I make thine enemies thy footstool.
The CHÚA shall send the rod of thy strength out of Si-ôn: rule ngươi in the midst of thine enemies.
Thy people shall be willing trong ngày of thy power, in the beauties of holiness from the womb of buổi sáng: ngươi hast the dew of thy youth. from…: or, more than the womb of buổi sáng: ngươi shalt have, etc
The CHÚA hath sworn, Và will not repent, Thou art một thầy tế lễ đến đời đời after the order of Melchizedek.
Chúa at thy tay phải shall strike through kings trong ngày of his wrath.
He shall judge among the heathen, he shall fill the places with kẻ chết bodies; he shall wound the heads over many countries. many: or, great
He shall drink of the brook in the way: therefore shall he lift up the head.

PSALM 111.
Praise ye the CHÚA. I will praise the CHÚA with my whole heart, in the assembly of the upright, and trong the congregation. Praise ye…: Heb. Hallelujah
những công việc of the CHÚA are great, sought out of all them that have pleasure therein.
His work is honourable Và glorious: Và his righteousness endureth đến đời đời.
He hath made his wonderful works to be nhớ lại: the CHÚA is gracious Và full of compassion.
He hath given meat với họ that fear him: he will ever be mindful of his covenant. meat: Heb. prey
He hath shewed his people quyền năng of his works, that he may give them the heritage of the heathen.
những công việc of his hands are verity Và judgment; all his commandments are sure.
They stand fast đến đời đời và mãi mãi, Và are done in truth Và uprightness. stand…: Heb. are established
He sent redemption unto his people: he hath commanded his covenant đến đời đời: thánh Và reverend is his name.
The fear of the CHÚA is ban đầu of wisdom: a good understanding have all they that do his commandments: his praise endureth đến đời đời. a good…: or, good success his commandments: Heb. them

PSALM 112.
Praise ye the CHÚA. phước is the man that feareth the CHÚA, that delighteth greatly in his commandments. Praise…: Heb. Hallelujah
His seed shall be mighty trên đất: the generation of the upright shall be blessed.
Wealth Và riches shall be in his house: Và his righteousness endureth đến đời đời.
Unto the upright there ariseth light in the darkness: he is gracious, Và full of compassion, Và righteous.
A good man sheweth favour, Và lendeth: he will guide his affairs with discretion. discretion: Heb. judgment
Surely he shall not be moved đến đời đời: the righteous shall be in đời đời remembrance.
He shall not be afraid of evil tidings: his heart is fixed, trusting in the CHÚA.
His heart is established, he shall not be afraid, until he see his desire upon his enemies.
He hath dispersed, he hath given to the poor; his righteousness endureth đến đời đời; his horn shall be exalted with honour.
The wicked sẽ thấy it, Và be grieved; he shall gnash with his teeth, Và melt away: the desire of the wicked shall perish.

PSALM 113.
Hãy ngợi khen
CHÚA. Hãy ngợi khen, hỡi các đầy tớ của CHÚA, Hãy ngợi khen Danh CHÚA. Hallelujah - Hãy ngợi khen CHÚA
Danh CHÚA đáng được ca tụng từ nay cho đến đời đời.
Từ lúc mọc mặt trời đến khi lặn [nguyện] Danh CHÚA được ngợi khen.
CHÚA trổi cao trên mọi dân tộc [và] sự vinh hiển Ngài vượt trên các tầng trời.
[Có] ai như CHÚA ĐCT chúng tôi, Đấng ngự trên cao, Heb. exalteth himself to ở
Who humbleth himself to kìa the things that are trên trời, và dưới đất!
He raiseth up người nghèo out of the dust, Và lifteth the needy out of the dunghill;
That he may set him with princes, even with the princes of his people.
He maketh the barren woman to keep nhà, Và to be a joyful mẹ of children. Praise ye the CHÚA. to keep…: Heb. to ở in một căn nhà

PSALM 114.
When I-sơ-ra-ên went out of Ai-Cập, nhà of Gia-cốp from a people of strange language;
Giu-đa was his sanctuary, Và I-sơ-ra-ên his dominion.
biển nhìn thấy it, Và fled: Giô-đanh was driven back.
núis skipped like rams, Và the little hills like lambs.
What ailed ngươi, hỡi sea, that ngươi fleddest? hỡi Giô-đanh, that ngươi wast driven back?
hỡi các núi, that ye skipped like rams; Và ye little hills, like lambs?
Trước mặt ĐCT, hỡi đất, hãy run sợ, trước mặt ĐCT của Gia-cốp;
Đấng hóa đá [trở nên] a standing nước, the flint into a fountain of waters.

PSALM 115.
Not unto us, O CHÚA, not unto us, but unto Danh Ngài give glory, for thy mercy, Và for thy truth's sake.
Wherefore should the heathen say, Where is now their God?
Nhưng ĐCT của chúng ta [Đấng ở] trên trời làm mọi điều [chi] Ngài muốn.
Thần tượng của chúng nó [bằng] bạc và vàng, công việc [bằng] tay của loài người.
They have mouths, but they speak not: eyes have they, but họ thấy not:
They have ears, but they hear not: noses have they, but they smell not:
They have hands, but they handle not: feet have they, but they walk not: neither speak they through their throat.
They that make them are like với họ; so is every one that trusteth in them.
O I-sơ-ra-ên, trust ngươi in the CHÚA: he is their help Và their shield.
O house of A-rôn, trust in the CHÚA: he is their help Và their shield.
Ye that fear the CHÚA, trust in the CHÚA: he is their help Và their shield.
The CHÚA hath been mindful of us: he will bless us; he will bless nhà của I-sơ-ra-ên; he will bless nhà of A-rôn.
He will bless them that fear the CHÚA, both small Và great. and: Heb. with
The CHÚA shall increase you more and more, you and your children.
Ye are phước of the CHÚA which made trời Và đất.
The heaven, even các tầng trời, are the Lord's: but đất hath he given to the children of men.
kẻ chết praise not the CHÚA, neither any that go down into silence.
But we will bless the CHÚA from this time forth and for evermore. Praise the CHÚA.

PSALM 116.
I love the CHÚA, because he hath heard my voice Và my supplications.
Because he hath inclined his ear unto me, therefore will I call upon him as long as I live. as long…: Heb. in my days
The sorrows of death compassed me, and the pains of hell gat hold upon me: I found trouble Và sorrow. gat…: Heb. found me
Then called I upon Tên of the CHÚA; O CHÚA, tôi nài khuyên ngươi, deliver my soul.
Gracious is the CHÚA, Và righteous; yea, our God is merciful.
The CHÚA preserveth the simple: I was brought low, Và he helped me.
Return unto thy rest, O my soul; for the CHÚA hath dealt bountifully with ngươi.
For ngươi hast delivered my soul from death, mine eyes from tears, Và my feet from falling.
I will walk before the CHÚA in the land of the living.
I believed, therefore have I spoken: I was greatly afflicted:
tôi nói in my haste, All men are liars.
What shall I render unto the CHÚA for all his benefits toward me?
I will take the cup của sự cứu rỗi, Và call upon Tên of the CHÚA.
I will pay my vows unto the CHÚA now in the presence of all his people.
Precious in the sight of the CHÚA is the death of his saints.
O CHÚA, truly I là thy servant; I là thy servant, Và con trai of thine handmaid: ngươi hast loosed my bonds.
I will offer to ngươi the sacrifice of thanksgiving, Và will call upon Tên of the CHÚA.
I will pay my vows unto the CHÚA now in the presence of all his people,
In the courts of the Lord's nhà, in the midst of ngươi, O Giê-ru-sa-lem. Praise ye the CHÚA.

PSALM 117.
O praise the CHÚA, all ye nations: praise him, all ye people.
For his merciful kindness is great toward us: and the truth of the CHÚA endureth đến đời đời. Praise ye the CHÚA.

PSALM 118.
O give thanks unto the CHÚA; for he is tốt: because his mercy endureth đến đời đời.
Let I-sơ-ra-ên now say, that his mercy endureth đến đời đời.
Let nhà of A-rôn now say, that his mercy endureth đến đời đời.
Let them now that fear the CHÚA say, that his mercy endureth đến đời đời.
I called upon the CHÚA in distress: the CHÚA trả lời me, Và set me in a large place. in distress: Heb. out of distress
The CHÚA is on my side; I will not fear: what can man do unto me? on…: Heb. for me
The CHÚA taketh my part with them that help me: therefore shall I see my desire upon them that hate me.
It is better to trust in the CHÚA than to put confidence in man.
It is better to trust in the CHÚA than to put confidence in princes.
All nations compassed me about: but in Tên of the CHÚA will I destroy them. destroy…: Heb. cut them off
They compassed me about; yea, they compassed me about: but in Tên of the CHÚA I will destroy them.
They compassed me about like bees; they are quenched as the fire of thorns: for in Tên of the CHÚA I will destroy them. destroy: Heb. cut down
ngươi hast thrust sore at me that I might fall: but the CHÚA helped me.
The CHÚA is my strength Và song, Và is become my salvation.
tiếng of rejoicing Và salvation is in đền tạms of the righteous: the tay phải of the CHÚA làm valiantly.
The tay phải of the CHÚA is exalted: the tay phải of the CHÚA làm valiantly.
I shall not die, but live, Và declare những công việc of the CHÚA.
The CHÚA hath chastened me sore: but he hath not given me over unto death.
Open to me the gates of righteousness: I will go into them, Và I will praise the CHÚA:
This gate of the CHÚA, into which the righteous shall enter.
I will praise ngươi: for ngươi hast heard me, and art become my salvation.
Hòn đá which the builders refused is become the head stone of the corner.
This is the Lord's doing; it is marvellous in our eyes. the Lord's…: Heb. from the CHÚA
This is ngày which the CHÚA hath made; we will rejoice Và be glad in it.
Save now, tôi nài khuyên ngươi, O CHÚA: O CHÚA, tôi nài khuyên ngươi, send now prosperity.
phước be he that cometh in Tên of the CHÚA: we have blessed you out of nhà of the CHÚA.
ĐCT is the CHÚA, which hath shewed us light: cột the sacrifice with cords, even unto the horns of the altar.
Thou art my God, Và I will praise ngươi: ngươi art my God, I will exalt ngươi.
O give thanks unto the CHÚA; for he is tốt: for his mercy endureth đến đời đời.

PSALM 119.
ALEPH.
phước are the không ô uế in the way, who walk in the law of the CHÚA. không ô uế: or, perfect, or, sincere
phước are they that keep his testimonies, Và that seek him with the whole heart.
They also do no iniquity: they walk in his ways.
ngươi hast commanded us to keep thy precepts diligently.
O that my ways were directed to keep thy statutes!
Then shall I not be ashamed, when I have respect unto all thy commandments.
I will praise ngươi with uprightness of heart, when I shall have learned thy righteous judgments. thy…: Heb. judgments of sự công chính của Ngài
I will keep thy statutes: O forsake me not utterly.
BETH.
Wherewithal shall a young man cleanse his way? by taking heed thereto according to thy word.
With my whole heart have I sought ngươi: O let me not wander from thy commandments.
Thy word have I hid in mine heart, that I might not sin against ngươi.
phước art thou, O CHÚA: teach me thy statutes.
With my lips have I declared all the judgments of thy mouth.
I have rejoiced in the way of thy testimonies, as much as trong all riches.
I will meditate in thy precepts, Và have respect unto thy ways.
I will delight myself in thy statutes: I will not forget thy word.
GIMEL.
Deal bountifully with thy servant, that I may live, Và keep thy word.
Open ngươi mine eyes, that I may kìa wondrous things out of thy law. Open: Heb. Reveal
I là a stranger in đất: hide not thy commandments from me.
My soul breaketh for the longing that it hath unto thy judgments at all times.
ngươi hast rebuked the proud that are cursed, which do err from thy commandments.
Remove from me reproach Và contempt; for I have kept thy testimonies.
Princes also did sit Và nói against me: but thy servant did meditate in thy statutes.
Thy testimonies also are my delight Và my counsellors. my counsellors: Heb. men of my counsel
DALETH.
My soul cleaveth unto the dust: quicken ngươi me according to thy word.
I have declared my ways, Và ngươi heardest me: teach me thy statutes.
Make me to understand đường of thy precepts: so shall I talk of thy wondrous works.
My soul melteth for heaviness: strengthen ngươi me according unto thy word. melteth: Heb. droppeth
Remove from me the way of lying: Và grant me thy law graciously.
I have chosen đường of truth: thy judgments have I laid before me.
I have stuck unto thy testimonies: O CHÚA, put me not to shame.
I will run đường of thy commandments, when ngươi shalt enlarge my heart.
HE.
Teach me, O CHÚA, đường of thy statutes; Và I shall keep it unto the end.
Give me understanding, Và I shall keep thy law; yea, I shall observe it with my whole heart.
Make me to go in the path of thy commandments; for therein do I delight.
Incline my heart unto thy testimonies, Và not to covetousness.
Turn away mine eyes from beholding vanity; Và quicken ngươi me in thy way. Turn…: Heb. Make to pass
Stablish thy word unto thy servant, who is devoted to thy fear.
Turn away my reproach which I fear: for thy judgments are tốt.
kìa, I have longed after thy precepts: quicken me in sự công chính của Ngài.
VAU.
Let thy mercies đến also unto me, O CHÚA, even sự cứu rỗi của Ngài, according to thy word.
So shall I have wherewith to answer him that reproacheth me: for I trust in thy word. So…: or, So shall I answer him that reproveth me in a thing
Và take not the word of truth utterly out of my mouth; for I have hy vọngd in thy judgments.
So shall I keep thy law continually đến đời đời và mãi mãi.
Và I will walk at liberty: for I seek thy precepts. at liberty: Heb. at large
I will speak of thy testimonies also before kings, Và will not be ashamed.
Và I will delight myself in thy commandments, which I have loved.
My hands also will I lift up unto thy commandments, which I have loved; Và I will meditate in thy statutes.
ZAIN.
nhớ lời unto thy servant, upon which ngươi hast caused me to hy vọng.
This is my comfort in my affliction: for thy word hath quickened me.
The proud have had me greatly in derision: yet have I not declined from thy law.
I nhớ lại thy judgments of old, O CHÚA; Và have comforted myself.
Horror hath taken hold upon me vì cớ the wicked that forsake thy law.
Thy statutes have been my songs in nhà of my pilgrimage.
I have nhớ lại Danh Ngài, O CHÚA, in the night, Và have kept thy law.
This I had, because I kept thy precepts.
CHETH.
ngươi art my portion, O CHÚA: I have nói that I would keep thy words.
I intreated thy favour with my whole heart: be merciful unto me according to thy word. favour: Heb. face
I thought on my ways, Và turned my feet unto thy testimonies.
I made haste, Và delayed not to keep thy commandments.
The bands of the wicked have robbed me: but I have not forgotten thy law. bands: or, companies
At midnight I will rise để cho thanks unto ngươi vì cớ thy righteous judgments.
I là a companion of all họ that fear ngươi, and of them that keep thy precepts.
đất, O CHÚA, is full of thy mercy: teach me thy statutes.
TETH.
ngươi hast dealt well with thy servant, O CHÚA, according unto thy word.
Teach me good judgment Và knowledge: for I have believed thy commandments.
Before I was afflicted I went astray: but now have I kept thy word.
Thou art tốt, Và doest good; teach me thy statutes.
The proud have forged a lie against me: but I will keep thy precepts with my whole heart.
Their heart is as fat as grease; but I delight in thy law.
It is tốt for me that I have been afflicted; that I might learn thy statutes.
luật pháp of thy mouth is better unto me than thousands of gold và bạc.
JOD.
Thy hands have made me and fashioned me: give me understanding, that I may learn thy commandments.
They that fear ngươi will be glad when họ thấy me; because I have hy vọngd in thy word.
I know, O CHÚA, that thy judgments are right, and that ngươi in faithfulness hast afflicted me. right: Heb. righteousness
Let, I pray ngươi, thy merciful kindness be for my comfort, according to thy word unto thy servant. for…: Heb. to comfort me
Let thy tender mercies đến unto me, that I may live: for thy law is my delight.
Let the proud bị hổ thẹn; for they dealt perversely with me without a cause: but I will meditate in thy precepts.
Let those that fear ngươi turn unto me, and those that have known thy testimonies.
Let my heart be sound in thy statutes; that I be not ashamed.
CAPH.
My soul fainteth for sự cứu rỗi của Ngài: but I hy vọng in thy word.
Mine eyes fail for thy word, nói [rằng], When wilt ngươi comfort me?
For I am become like a bottle in the smoke; yet do I not forget thy statutes.
How many are the days of thy servant? when wilt ngươi execute judgment on them that persecute me?
The proud have digged pits for me, which are not after thy law.
All thy commandments are trung tín: they persecute me wrongfully; help ngươi me. faithful: Heb. faithfulness
They had almost consumed me trên đất; but I forsook not thy precepts.
Quicken me after thy lovingkindness; so shall I keep the testimony of thy mouth.
LAMED.
đến đời đời, O CHÚA, thy word is settled in heaven.
Thy faithfulness is unto all generations: ngươi hast established đất, Và it abideth. unto…: Heb. to generation and generation abideth: Heb. standeth
