They continue this day according to thine ordinances: for all are thy servants.
Unless thy law had been my delights, I should then have perished in mine affliction.
I will never forget thy precepts: for with them ngươi hast quickened me.
I là thine, save me; for I have sought thy precepts.
The wicked have waited for me to destroy me: but I will consider thy testimonies.
I have seen an end of all perfection: but thy commandment is exceeding broad.
MEM.
O how love I thy law! it is my meditation all the day.
ngươi through thy commandments hast made me wiser than mine enemies: for they are ever with me. they…: Heb. it is ever with me
I have more understanding than all my teachers: for thy testimonies are my meditation.
I understand more than the ancients, because I keep thy precepts.
I have refrained my feet from every evil way, that I might keep thy word.
I have not departed from thy judgments: for ngươi hast taught me.
How sweet are thy words unto my taste! yea, sweeter than honey to my mouth!taste: Heb. palate
Through thy precepts I get understanding: therefore I hate every false way.
NUN.
Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, Và a light unto my path. lamp: or, candle
I have sworn, Và I will perform it, that I will keep thy righteous judgments.
I am afflicted very much: quicken me, O CHÚA, according unto thy word.
Accept, tôi nài khuyên ngươi, the freewill offerings of my mouth, O CHÚA, Và teach me thy judgments.
My soul is continually in my hand: yet do I not forget thy law.
The wicked have laid a snare for me: yet I erred not from thy precepts.
Thy testimonies have I taken as an heritage đến đời đời: for they are the rejoicing of my heart.
I have inclined mine heart to perform thy statutes alway, even unto the end. to perform: Heb. to do
SAMECH.
I hate vain thoughts: but thy law do I love.
Thou art my hiding place Và my shield: I hy vọng in thy word.
Depart from me, ye evildoers: for I will keep the commandments of my God.
Uphold me according unto thy word, that I may live: Và let me not be ashamed of my hy vọng.
Hold ngươi me up, Và I shall be safe: Và I will have respect unto thy statutes continually.
ngươi hast trodden down all them that err from thy statutes: for their deceit is falsehood.
ngươi puttest away all the wicked đất like dross: therefore I love thy testimonies. puttest…: Heb. causest to cease
My flesh trembleth for fear of ngươi; and I am afraid of thy judgments.
AIN.
I have done judgment Và justice: leave me not to mine oppressors.
Be surety for thy servant for good: let not the proud oppress me.
Mine eyes fail for sự cứu rỗi của Ngài, Và for the word of sự công chính của Ngài.
Deal with thy servant according unto thy mercy, Và teach me thy statutes.
I là thy servant; give me understanding, that I may know thy testimonies.
It is time for ngươi,
CHÚA, to work: for they have made void thy law.
Therefore I love thy commandments above gold; yea, above fine gold.
Therefore I esteem all thy precepts concerning all things to be right; Và I hate every false way.
PE.
Thy testimonies are wonderful: therefore doth my soul keep them.
The entrance of thy words giveth light; it giveth understanding unto the simple.
I opened my mouth, Và panted: for I longed for thy commandments.
Look ngươi upon me, and be merciful unto me, as ngươi usest to do unto those that love Danh Ngài. as thou…: Heb. according to the custom toward those, etc
Order my steps in thy word: Và let not any iniquity have dominion over me.
Deliver me from the oppression of man: so will I keep thy precepts.
Make thy face to shine upon thy servant; Và teach me thy statutes.
Rivers of waters run down mine eyes, because they keep not thy law.
TZADDI.
công chính art thou, O CHÚA, Và upright are thy judgments.
Thy testimonies that ngươi hast commanded are công chính Và very trung tín. righteous: Heb. righteousness faithful: Heb. faithfulness
My zeal hath consumed me, because mine enemies have forgotten thy words. consumed…: Heb. cut me off
Thy word is very pure: therefore thy servant loveth it. pure: Heb. tried, or, refined
I là small Và despised: yet do not I forget thy precepts.
Thy righteousness is an đời đời righteousness, Và thy law is lẽ thật.
Trouble Và anguish have taken hold on me: yet thy commandments are my delights. taken…: Heb. found me
The righteousness of thy testimonies is đời đời: give me understanding, Và I shall live.
KOPH.
I cried with my whole heart; nghe me, O CHÚA: I will keep thy statutes.
I cried unto ngươi; save me, and I shall keep thy testimonies. Và I…: or, that I may keep
I prevented the dawning of buổi sáng, Và cried: I hy vọngd in thy word.
Mine eyes prevent the đêm watches, that I might meditate in thy word.
nghe my voice according unto thy lovingkindness: O CHÚA, quicken me according to thy judgment.
They draw nigh that follow after mischief: they are far from thy law.
Thou art gần, O CHÚA; Và all thy commandments are truth.
Concerning thy testimonies, I have known of old that ngươi hast founded them đến đời đời.
RESH.
Consider mine affliction, Và deliver me: for I do not forget thy law.
Plead my cause, Và deliver me: quicken me according to thy word.
sự cứu rỗi is far from the wicked: for họ thấyk not thy statutes.
Great are thy tender mercies, O CHÚA: quicken me according to thy judgments. Great: or, Many
Many are my persecutors Và mine enemies; yet do I not decline from thy testimonies.
I beheld the transgressors, Và was grieved; because they kept not thy word.
Consider how I love thy precepts: quicken me, O CHÚA, according to thy lovingkindness.
Thy word is true từ ban đầu: và mãi mãiy one of thy righteous judgments endureth đến đời đời. Thy word…: Heb. The beginning of thy word is true
SCHIN.
Princes have persecuted me without a cause: but my heart standeth in awe of thy word.
I rejoice at thy word, as one that tìm great spoil.
I hate Và abhor lying: but thy law do I love.
bảy lần a day do I praise ngươi vì cớ thy righteous judgments.
Great peace have they which love thy law: Và nothing shall offend them. nothing…: Heb. they shall have no stumblingblock
CHÚA, I have hy vọngd for sự cứu rỗi của Ngài, Và done thy commandments.
My soul hath kept thy testimonies; Và I love them exceedingly.
I have kept thy precepts Và thy testimonies: for all my ways are before ngươi.
TAU.
Let my cry come near before ngươi, O CHÚA: give me understanding according to thy word.
Let my supplication đến before ngươi: deliver me according to thy word.
My lips shall utter praise, when ngươi hast taught me thy statutes.
My tongue shall speak of thy word: for all thy commandments are righteousness.
Let thine hand help me; for I have chosen thy precepts.
I have longed for sự cứu rỗi của Ngài, O CHÚA; Và thy law is my delight.
Let my soul live, Và it shall praise ngươi; and let thy judgments help me.
I have gone astray like a lost chiên; seek thy servant; for I do not forget thy commandments.

PSALM 120.
Bài hát nâng cấp.
In my distress I cried unto the CHÚA, Và he heard me.
Deliver my soul, O CHÚA, from lying lips, Và from a deceitful lưỡi.
What shall be given unto ngươi? or what shall be done unto ngươi, ngươi false lưỡi? What shall be given…: or, What shall the deceitful tongue give unto ngươi? or, what shall is profit ngươi?
done: Heb. added
Sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals of juniper. Sharp…: or, It is as the sharp arrows of the mighty man, with coals of juniper
Khốn thay is me, that I sojourn in Mesech, that I ở in the tents of Kedar!
My soul hath long dwelt with him that hateth peace.
I am for peace: but when I speak, they are for war. for peace: or, a man of peace

PSALM 121.
Bài ca từng nấc lên -
Tôi sẽ ngước mắt tôi lên những ngọn đồi, từ đâu đến cứu cánh tôi. I will…: or, Shall I lift up mine eyes to the hills? whence should cứu cánh tôi come?
Cứu cánh tôi đến từ CHÚA, Đấng tạo nên trời và đất.
Ngài sẽ không để cho chân ngươi vấp té. Đấng gìn giữ ngươi will not slumber.
kìa, Đấng gìn giữ I-sơ-ra-ên shall neither slumber nor sleep.
The CHÚA is thy keeper:
CHÚA is thy shade upon thy right tay.
mặt trời shall not smite ngươi by day, nor the moon by night.
CHÚA shall preserve ngươi from all evil: he shall preserve thy soul.
CHÚA shall preserve thy going out Và thy coming in from this time forth, and even for evermore.

PSALM 122.
Bài hát nâng cấp của Đa-vít.
I was glad when họ nói unto me, Let us go inđến nhà of the CHÚA.
Our feet shall stand within thy gates, O Giê-ru-sa-lem.
Giê-ru-sa-lem is builded as a city that is compact together:
Whither the tribes go up, the tribes của CHÚA, unto the testimony của I-sơ-ra-ên, để cho thanks unto Tên của CHÚA.
For there are set thrones of judgment, the thrones của nhà Đa-vít. are…: Heb. do sit
cầu nguyện for the peace of Giê-ru-sa-lem: they shall prosper that love ngươi.
Peace be within thy walls, Và prosperity within thy palaces.
For my brethren Và companions' sakes, I will now say, Peace be within ngươi.
Vì cớ nhà
CHÚA ĐCT chúng ta I will seek thy good.

PSALM 123.
Bài hát nâng cấp.
Unto ngươi lift I up mine eyes, O ngươi that ởest in the heavens.
kìa, như mắt của các tôi trai [trông chờ] nơi tay chủ chúng nó, và như mắt của đứa tớ gái nơi tay bà chủ nó; mắt của chúng tôi [trông đợi] đến CHÚA ĐCT chúng tôi, Ngài thương xót chúng tôi.
Xin Ngài thương xót chúng tôi hỡi CHÚA, Xin Ngài thương xót chúng tôi vì quá chúng tôi đầy dẫy sự vi phạm.
Linh hồn chúng tôi is exceedingly filled with the scorning of those that are at ease, Và with the contempt of the proud.

PSALM 124.
Bài hát nâng cấp của Đa-vít.
nếu it had not been the CHÚA who was on our side, now may I-sơ-ra-ên say;
nếu it had not been the CHÚA who was on our side, when men rose up against us:
Rồi they had swallowed us up quick, when their wrath was kindled against us:
Rồi the waters had overwhelmed us, the stream had gone over linh hồn chúng tôi:
Rồi the proud waters had gone over linh hồn chúng tôi.
phước be the CHÚA, who hath not given us as a prey to their teeth.
Linh hồn chúng tôi is escaped as a bird out of the snare of the fowlers: the snare is broken, Và we are escaped.
Our help is in Tên of the CHÚA, who made trời Và đất.

PSALM 125.
Bài hát nâng cấp.
They that trust in the CHÚA shall be as mount Si-ôn, which cannot be removed, but abideth đến đời đời.
As núis are round about Giê-ru-sa-lem, so the CHÚA is round about his people from henceforth even for ever.
For the rod of the wicked shall not rest upon the lot of the righteous; lest the righteous put forth their hands unto iniquity. the wicked: Heb. wickedness
Do good, O CHÚA, unto those that be tốt, and to them that are upright in their hearts.
As for such as turn aside unto their crooked ways, the CHÚA shall lead them forth with the workers of iniquity: but peace shall be upon I-sơ-ra-ên.

PSALM 126.
Bài hát nâng cấp.
When the CHÚA turned again the captivity of Si-ôn, we were like them that dream. turned…: Heb. returned the returning
Then was our mouth filled with laughter, Và our tongue with singing: then nói they among the heathen, The CHÚA hath done great things for them. hath…: Heb. hath magnified to do with them
The CHÚA hath done great things for us; whereof we are glad.
Turn again our captivity, O CHÚA, as the streams in the south.
They that sow in tears shall reap in joy. joy: or, singing
He that goeth forth Và weepeth, bearing precious hạt giống, shall doubtless đến again with rejoicing, bringing his sheaves with him. precious…: or, seed basket

PSALM 127.
Bài hát nâng cấp for Sa-lô-môn.
Except the CHÚA build nhà, they labour vô ích that build it: except the CHÚA keep thành, the watchman waketh but vô ích. for…: or, of Sa-lô-môn that…: Heb. that are builders of it in it
It is vain for you to rise up early, to sit up late, to eat the bread of sorrows: for so he giveth his beloved sleep.
Lo, children are an heritage of the CHÚA: Và the fruit of the womb is his phần thưởng.
As arrows are in tay of a mighty man; so are children of the youth.
Happy is the man that hath his quiver full of them: they shall not be ashamed, but they shall speak with the enemies in cổng. his…: Heb. filled his quiver with them speak…: or, subdue, or, destroy

PSALM 128.
Bài hát nâng cấp.
phước is every one that feareth the CHÚA; that walketh in his ways.
For ngươi shalt eat the labour of thine hands: happy shalt thou be, and it shall be well with ngươi.
Thy wife shall be as a fruitful vine by the sides of thine house: thy children like olive plants round about thy table.
kìa, that thus shall the man be blessed that feareth the CHÚA.
The CHÚA shall bless ngươi out of Si-ôn: Và ngươi shalt see the good of Giê-ru-sa-lem all the days of thy sự sống.
Yea, ngươi shalt see thy children's children, Và peace upon I-sơ-ra-ên.

PSALM 129.
Bài hát nâng cấp.
Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth, may I-sơ-ra-ên now say: Many…: or, Much
Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth: yet they have not prevailed against me. Many…: or, Much
The plowers plowed upon my back: they made long their furrows.
The CHÚA is công chính: he hath cut asunder the cords of the wicked.
Let them all be confounded Và turned back that hate Si-ôn.
Let them be as the grass trên mái nhà, which withereth afore it groweth up:
Wherewith the mower filleth not his hand; nor he that bindeth sheaves his bosom.
Neither do they which go by say, The blessing of the CHÚA be upon you: we bless you in Tên of the CHÚA.

PSALM 130.
Bài hát nâng cấp.
Out of the depths have I cried unto ngươi, O CHÚA.
Lord, nghe my voice: let thine ears be attentive to the voice of my supplications.
If thou, CHÚA, shouldest Mác iniquities, O Lord, who shall stand?
But there is forgiveness with ngươi, that ngươi mayest be feared.
I wait for the CHÚA, my soul doth wait, Và in his word do I hy vọng.
My soul waiteth for the Lord more than they that watch for buổi sáng: I say, more than they that watch for buổi sáng. I say…: or, which watch unto
Let I-sơ-ra-ên hy vọng in the CHÚA: for with the CHÚA there is mercy, and with him is plenteous redemption.
Và he shall redeem I-sơ-ra-ên from all his iniquities.

PSALM 131.
Bài hát nâng cấp của Đa-vít.
CHÚA, my heart is not haughty, nor mine eyes lofty: neither do I exercise myself in great matters, or in things too high for me. exercise…: Heb. walk high: Heb. wonderful
Surely I have behaved Và quieted myself, as a child that is weaned of his mother: my soul is even as a weaned child. myself: Heb. my soul
Let I-sơ-ra-ên hy vọng in the CHÚA from henceforth and for ever. henceforth: Heb. now

PSALM 132.
Bài hát nâng cấp.
CHÚA, nhớ Đa-vít, Và all his afflictions:
How he sware unto the CHÚA, Và vowed unto the mighty God of Gia-cốp;
Surely I will not come into đền tạm of my house, nor go up into my bed;
I will not give sleep to mine eyes, or slumber to mine eyelids,
Until I find out một chỗ for the CHÚA, an habitation for the mighty God of Gia-cốp. an habitation: Heb. habitations
Lo, we heard of it at Ép-ra-ta: we found it in the fields of the wood.
We will go into his tabernacles: we will worship at his footstool.
Hãy chổi dậy, O CHÚA, into thy rest; thou, and the ark of thy strength.
Let thy priests be clothed with righteousness; Và let thy saints shout for joy.
For thy servant Đa-vít's sake turn not away mặt of thine anointed.
The CHÚA hath sworn trong truth unto Đa-vít; he will not turn from it; Of the fruit of thy body will I set upon thy throne. body: Heb. belly
If thy children will keep my covenant Và my testimony that I shall teach them, their children shall also sit upon thy throne for evermore.
For the CHÚA hath chosen Si-ôn; he hath desired it for his habitation.
This is my rest đến đời đời: here will I ở; for I have desired it.
I will abundantly bless her provision: I will satisfy her poor with bread. abundantly: or, surely
I will also clothe her priests with salvation: Và her saints shall shout aloud for joy.
There will I make the horn của Đa-vít to bud: I have ordained a lamp for mine anointed. lamp: or, candle
His enemies will I clothe with shame: but upon himself shall his crown flourish.

PSALM 133.
Bài hát nâng cấp của Đa-vít.
kìa, how good Và how pleasant it is for brethren to ở together in unity!together…: Heb. even together
It is like the precious ointment upon the head, that ran down upon the beard, even A-rôn's beard: that went down to the skirts of his garments;
As the dew of Hermon, Và as the dew that descended upon núis of Si-ôn: for there the CHÚA truyền lệnh the blessing, even sự sống for evermore.

PSALM 134.
Bài hát nâng cấp.
kìa, bless ye the CHÚA, all ye các đầy tớ of the CHÚA, which by night stand in nhà of the CHÚA.
Lift up your hands trong the sanctuary, Và bless the CHÚA. the sanctuary: or, holiness
The CHÚA that made trời Và đất bless ngươi out of Si-ôn.

PSALM 135.
Praise ye the CHÚA. Praise ye Tên of the CHÚA; praise him, O ye servants of the CHÚA.
Ye that stand in nhà of the CHÚA, in the courts của nhà of our God,
Praise the CHÚA; for the CHÚA is tốt: sing praises unto his name; for it is pleasant.
For the CHÚA hath chosen Gia-cốp unto himself, Và I-sơ-ra-ên for his peculiar treasure.
Vì tôi biết that the CHÚA is great, and that our Lord is above all gods.
bất cứ điều chi the CHÚA pleased, that did he in heaven, Và in đất, in biểns, Và all deep places.
He causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends đất; he maketh lightnings for the rain; he bringeth gió out of his treasuries.
Who smote the firstborn of Ai-Cập, both of man Và beast. both…: Heb. from man unto beast
ai sent tokens Và wonders into the midst of ngươi, O Ai-Cập, upon Pha-ra-ôn, Và upon all his servants.
Who smote great nations, Và slew mighty các vua;
Sihon vua of the Amorites, Và Og vua of Bashan, Và all the kingdoms of Canaan:
Và gave their land for an heritage, an heritage unto I-sơ-ra-ên his people.
Danh Ngài, O CHÚA, endureth đến đời đời; Và thy memorial, O CHÚA, throughout all generations. throughout…: Heb. to generation and generation
For the CHÚA will judge his people, Và he will repent himself concerning his servants.
The idols of the heathen are silver và vàng, the work of men's hands.
They have mouths, but they speak not; eyes have they, but họ thấy not;
They have ears, but they hear not; neither is there any breath in their mouths.
They that make them are like với họ: so is every one that trusteth in them.
Bless the CHÚA, O house của I-sơ-ra-ên: bless the CHÚA, O house of A-rôn:
Bless the CHÚA, O house of Levi: ye that fear the CHÚA, bless the CHÚA.
phước be the CHÚA out of Si-ôn, which ởeth at Giê-ru-sa-lem. Praise ye the CHÚA.

PSALM 136.
O give thanks unto the CHÚA; for he is tốt: for his mercy endureth đến đời đời.
O give thanks unto ĐCT of gods: for his mercy endureth đến đời đời.
O give thanks to the Lord of lords: for his mercy endureth đến đời đời.
To him who alone doeth great wonders: for his mercy endureth đến đời đời.
To him that by wisdom made các tầng trời: for his mercy endureth đến đời đời.
To him that stretched out đất above the waters: for his mercy endureth đến đời đời.
To him that made great lights: for his mercy endureth đến đời đời:
mặt trời to rule by day: for his mercy endureth đến đời đời: to rule…: Heb. for the rulings by day
Mặt trăng Và stars to rule by night: for his mercy endureth đến đời đời.
To him that smote Ai-Cập in their firstborn: for his mercy endureth đến đời đời:
Và brought out I-sơ-ra-ên from among them: for his mercy endureth đến đời đời:
With a strong tay, Và with a stretched out arm: for his mercy endureth đến đời đời.
To him which divided the Red sea into parts: for his mercy endureth đến đời đời:
Và made I-sơ-ra-ên to pass through the midst of it: for his mercy endureth đến đời đời:
But overthrew Pha-ra-ôn Và his host in the Red sea: for his mercy endureth đến đời đời. overthrew: Heb. shaked off
To him which led his people through the wilderness: for his mercy endureth đến đời đời.
To him which smote great các vua: for his mercy endureth đến đời đời:
Và slew famous các vua: for his mercy endureth đến đời đời:
Sihon vua of the Amorites: for his mercy endureth đến đời đời:
Và Og vua of Bashan: for his mercy endureth đến đời đời:
Và gave their land for an heritage: for his mercy endureth đến đời đời:
Even an heritage unto I-sơ-ra-ên his servant: for his mercy endureth đến đời đời.
Who nhớ lại us in our low estate: for his mercy endureth đến đời đời:
Và hath redeemed us from our enemies: for his mercy endureth đến đời đời.
Who giveth food to all flesh: for his mercy endureth đến đời đời.
O give thanks unto ĐCT of heaven: for his mercy endureth đến đời đời.

PSALM 137.
By the rivers of Ba-by-lôn, there we ngồi xuống, yea, we khóc, when we nhớ lại Si-ôn.
We hanged our harps upon the willows in the midst thereof.
For there they that carried us away captive required of us Bài hát; Và they that wasted us required of us mirth, nói [rằng], Sing us one của Congs of Si-ôn. Bài hát: Heb. the words of Bài hát wasted…: Heb. laid us on heaps
How shall we sing the Lord's song in a strange land? strange…: Heb. land of a stranger?
If I forget ngươi, O Giê-ru-sa-lem, let my tay phải forget her cunning.
If I do not remember ngươi, let my tongue cleave to the roof of my mouth; if I prefer not Giê-ru-sa-lem above my chief joy. my chief…: Heb. the head of my joy
nhớ, O CHÚA, con cái of Edom trong ngày of Giê-ru-sa-lem; who nói, Rase it, rase it, even to the foundation thereof. Rase it: Heb. Make bare
O daughter of Ba-by-lôn, who art to be destroyed; happy shall he be, that rewardeth ngươi as ngươi hast served us. destroyed: Heb. wasted rewardeth…: Heb. recompenseth unto ngươi thy deed which ngươi didst to us
Happy shall he be, that taketh Và dasheth thy little ones against the stones. the stones: Heb. the rock

PSALM 138.
Thơ vịnh của Đa-vít.
I will praise ngươi with my whole heart: before the gods will I sing praise unto ngươi.
I will worship toward thy holy đền thờ, Và praise Danh Ngài for thy lovingkindness Và for thy truth: for ngươi hast magnified thy word above all Danh Ngài.
trong ngày when I cried ngươi trả lờist me, Và strengthenedst me với strength in my soul.
tất cả các vua đất shall praise ngươi, O CHÚA, when they hear những lời of thy mouth.
Yea, they shall sing in the ways of the CHÚA: for great is sự vinh hiển of the CHÚA.
Though the CHÚA be high, yet hath he respect unto the lowly: but the proud he knoweth afar off.
Though I walk in the midst of trouble, ngươi wilt revive me: ngươi shalt stretch forth thine hand against cơn thịnh nộ of mine enemies, Và thy tay phải shall save me.
The CHÚA will perfect that which concerneth me: thy mercy, O CHÚA, endureth đến đời đời: forsake not the works of thine own hands.

PSALM 139.
To the chief Musician, Thơ vịnh của Đa-vít.
O CHÚA, ngươi hast searched me, and known me.
ngươi knowest my downsitting Và mine uprising, ngươi understandest my thought afar off.
ngươi compassest my path Và my lying down, Và art acquainted với all my ways. compassest: or, winnowest
For there is not a word in my tongue, but, lo, O CHÚA, ngươi knowest it altogether.
ngươi hast beset me behind Và before, Và laid thine hand upon me.
Such sự hiểu biết is too wonderful for me; it is high, I cannot attain unto it.
Whither shall I go from thy spirit? or whither shall I flee from thy presence?
If I ascend up into heaven, thou art there: if I make my bed in hell, kìa, thou art there.
nếu I take the wings of buổi sáng, Và ở in the uttermost parts of biển;
Even there shall thy hand lead me, and thy tay phải shall hold me.
If I say, Surely the darkness shall cover me; even the night shall be light about me.
Yea, the darkness hideth not from ngươi; but the night shineth as the day: the darkness Và the light are both alike to ngươi. hideth…: Heb. darkeneth not the darkness and…: Heb. as is the darkness, so is the light
For ngươi hast possessed my reins: ngươi hast covered me in my mother's womb.
I will praise ngươi; for I am fearfully Và wonderfully made: marvellous are thy works; and that my soul biết right well. right…: Heb. greatly
My substance was not hid from ngươi, when I was made in secret, Và curiously wrought in the lowest parts đất. substance: or, strength, or, body
Thine eyes did see my substance, yet being unperfect; Và in thy book all my members were written, which in continuance were fashioned, when as yet there was none of them. all…: Heb. all of them which…: or, what days they should be fashioned
How precious also are thy thoughts unto me, Hỡi ĐCT! how great is the sum of them!
nếu I should count them, they are more in number than the sand: when I awake, I am still with ngươi.
Surely ngươi wilt slay the wicked, Hỡi ĐCT: depart from me therefore, ye bloody men.
For they speak against ngươi wickedly, Và thine enemies take Danh Ngài vô ích.
Do not I hate them, O CHÚA, that hate ngươi? and am not I grieved with those that rise up against ngươi?
I hate them with perfect thù oán: I count them mine enemies.
Search me, Hỡi ĐCT, Và know my heart: try me, and know my thoughts:
Và see if there be any gian ác way in me, and lead me in the way đời đời. wicked…: Heb. way of pain, or, grief

PSALM 140.
To the chief Musician, Thơ vịnh của Đa-vít.
Deliver me, O CHÚA, from the evil man: preserve me from the violent man; violent…: Heb. man of violences
Which imagine mischiefs in their heart; continually are they gathered together for war.
They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent; adders' chất độc is under their lips. Selah.
Keep me, O CHÚA, from tays of the wicked; preserve me from the violent man; who have purposed to overthrow my goings.
The proud have hid a snare for me, and cords; they have spread a net by the wayside; they have set gins for me. Selah.
tôi nói unto the CHÚA, Thou art my God: nghe tiếng of my supplications, O CHÚA.
O God Chúa, the strength of my salvation, ngươi hast covered my head trong ngày of battle.
Grant not, O CHÚA, the desires of the wicked: further not his wicked device; lest they exalt themselves. Selah. lest…: or, let them not be exalted
As for the head of those that compass me about, let the mischief of their own lips cover them.
Let burning coals fall upon them: let them be cast into the fire; into deep pits, that they rise not up again.
Let not an evil speaker be established in đất: evil shall hunt the violent man to overthrow him. an…: or, an evil speaker (Heb. a man of tongue), a wicked man of violence, be established in đất: let him be hunted to his overthrow
I know that the CHÚA will maintain the cause of the afflicted, Và the right of the poor.
Surely the righteous shall give thanks unto Danh Ngài: the upright shall ở in thy presence.

PSALM 141.
Thơ vịnh của Đa-vít.
CHÚA, I cry unto ngươi: make haste unto me; give ear unto my voice, when I cry unto ngươi.
Let my prayer be set forth before ngươi as incense; Và the lifting up of my hands as buổi chiều sacrifice. set…: Heb. directed
Set a watch, O CHÚA, before my mouth; keep the door of my lips.
Incline not my heart to any evil thing, to practise gian ác việc làm with men that work iniquity: Và let me not eat of their dainties.
Let the righteous smite me; it shall be a kindness: Và let him reprove me; it shall be an excellent oil, which shall not break my head: for yet my prayer also shall be in their calamities. me; it shall be a…: or, me kindly, and reprove me; let not their precious oil break, etc
When their judges are overthrown in stony places, they shall hear my words; for they are sweet.
Our bones are scattered at the grave's miệng, as when one cutteth Và cleaveth wood trên đất.
But mine eyes are unto ngươi, O God Chúa: in ngươi is my trust; leave not my soul destitute. leave…: Heb. make not my soul bare
Keep me from the snares which they have laid for me, and the gins of the workers of iniquity.
Let the wicked fall into their own nets, whilst that I withal escape. escape: Heb. pass over

PSALM 142.
Maschil của Đa-vít; A Prayer when he was in the cave.
I cried unto the CHÚA with my voice; with my voice unto the CHÚA did I make my supplication. Maschil…: or, Thơ vịnh của Đa-vít, giving instruction
I poured out my complaint before him; I shewed before him my trouble.
When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, then ngươi knewest my path. In the way wherein I walked have they privily laid a snare for me.
I looked on my tay phải, Và beheld, but there was không ai that would know me: refuge failed me; không ai cared for my soul. I looked…: or, Look on the tay phải, and see failed…: Heb. perished from me cared…: Heb. sought after
I cried unto ngươi, O CHÚA: tôi nói, Thou art my refuge Và my portion in the land of the living.
Attend unto my cry; for I am brought very low: deliver me from my persecutors; for they are stronger than I.
Bring my soul out of prison, that I may praise Danh Ngài: the righteous shall compass me about; for ngươi shalt deal bountifully with me.

PSALM 143.
Thơ vịnh của Đa-vít.
nghe my prayer, O CHÚA, give ear to my supplications: in thy faithfulness answer me, Và in sự công chính của Ngài.
Và enter not into judgment with thy servant: for in thy sight shall không ai living be justified.
For the enemy hath persecuted my soul; he hath smitten my sự sống down to the ground; he hath made me to ở in darkness, as those that have been long dead.
Therefore is my spirit overwhelmed within me; my heart within me is desolate.
I remember the days of old; I meditate on all thy works; I muse on the work of thy hands.
I stretch forth my hands unto ngươi: my soul thirsteth after ngươi, as a thirsty land. Selah.
nghe me speedily, O CHÚA: my spirit faileth: hide not thy face from me, lest I be like với họ that go down into the pit. lest…: or, for I am become like, etc
Cause me to hear thy lovingkindness in buổi sáng; for in ngươi do I trust: cause me to know đường wherein I should walk; for I lift up my soul unto ngươi.
Deliver me, O CHÚA, from mine enemies: I flee unto ngươi to hide me. flee…: Heb. hide me with ngươi
Teach me to do thy will; for thou art my God: thy spirit is tốt; lead me into the land of uprightness.
Quicken me, O CHÚA, for Danh Ngài's sake: for sự công chính của Ngài' sake bring my soul out of trouble.
Và of thy mercy cut off mine enemies, Và destroy all them that afflict my soul: for I là thy servant.

PSALM 144.
Thơ vịnh của Đa-vít.
phước be the CHÚA my strength, which teacheth my hands to war, Và my fingers to fight: strength: Heb. rock to war…: Heb. to the war, etc
My goodness, Và my fortress; my high tower, Và my deliverer; my shield, and he in whom I trust; who subdueth my people under me. My goodness: or, My mercy
CHÚA, what is man, that ngươi takest knowledge of him! or con trai of man, that ngươi makest account of him!
Man is like to vanity: his days are as a shadow that passeth away.
Bow thy heavens, O CHÚA, Và come down: touch núis, Và they shall smoke.
Cast forth lightning, Và scatter them: shoot out thine arrows, Và destroy them.
Send thine hand from above; rid me, and deliver me out of great waters, from tay of strange children; hand from: Heb. hands from
Whose mouth speaketh vanity, Và their tay phải is a tay phải of falsehood.
I will sing a new song unto ngươi, Hỡi ĐCT: upon a psaltery Và an instrument of ten strings will I sing praises unto ngươi.
It is he that giveth sự cứu rỗi unto kings: who delivereth Đa-vít his servant from the hurtful thanh gươm. salvation: or, victory
Rid me, and deliver me from tay of strange children, whose mouth speaketh vanity, Và their tay phải is a tay phải of falsehood:
That our sons may be as plants grown up in their youth; that our daughters may be as corner stones, polished after the similitude of a palace: polished: Heb. cut
That our garners may be full, affording all manner of store: that our sheep may bring forth thousands và mười thousands in our streets: all…: Heb. from kind to kind
That our oxen may be strong to labour; that there be no breaking in, nor going out; that there be no complaining in our streets. strong…: Heb. able to bear burdens, or, loaden with flesh
Happy is that people, that is in such a case: yea, happy is that people, whose God is the CHÚA.

PSALM 145.
Đa-vít's Psalm of praise.
Tôi sẽ ton vinh Ngài ĐCT tôi, Hỡi Vua; và I tôi sẽ chúa tụng Danh Ngài đến đời đời và mãi mãi.
Hằng ngày will I bless ngươi; and I will praise Danh Ngài đến đời đời và mãi mãi.
Great is the CHÚA, Và greatly to be praised; Và his greatness is không thể dò được. Và his…: Heb. and of his greatness there is no search
một dòng dõi shall praise thy works to another, and shall declare thy mighty acts.
I will speak of the glorious honour of thy majesty, Và of thy wondrous việc làm. works: Heb. things, or, words
Và men shall speak of the might of thy terrible acts: Và I will declare thy greatness. declare: Heb. declare it
They shall abundantly utter the memory of thy great goodness, Và shall sing of sự công chính của Ngài.
The CHÚA is gracious, Và full of compassion; slow to anger, Và of great mercy. of great…: Heb. great in mercy
The CHÚA is tốt to all: and his tender mercies are over all his works.
All thy works shall praise ngươi, O CHÚA; Và thy saints shall bless ngươi.
They shall speak of sự vinh hiển of thy kingdom, Và talk of thy power;
To make known to the sons of men his mighty acts, Và the glorious majesty of his kingdom.
Thy kingdom is an đời đời kingdom, Và thy dominion endureth throughout all generations. an…: Heb. a kingdom of all ages
The CHÚA upholdeth all that fall, Và raiseth up all those that be bowed down.
mắt of all wait upon ngươi; and ngươi givest them their meat in due season. wait…: or, look unto
ngươi openest thine hand, Và satisfiest the desire of every living thing.
The CHÚA is công chính in all his ways, Và holy in all his works. holy: or, merciful, or, bountiful
The CHÚA is nigh unto all them that call upon him, to all that call upon him in truth.
He will fulfil the desire of them that fear him: he also will hear their cry, Và will save them.
The CHÚA preserveth all them that love him: but all the wicked will he destroy.
My mouth shall speak the praise of the CHÚA: Và let all flesh bless his holy name đến đời đời và mãi mãi.

PSALM 146.
Praise ye the CHÚA. Praise the CHÚA, O my soul. Praise ye…: Heb. Hallelujah
While I live will I praise the CHÚA: I will sing praises unto my God while I have any being.
Put not your trust in princes, cũng không in the son of man, in whom there is no help. help: or, salvation
His breath goeth forth, he returneth to his đất; in that very day his thoughts perish.
Happy is he that hath ĐCT of Gia-cốp for his help, whose hy vọng is in the CHÚA his God:
Which made trời, Và đất, biển, and all that therein is: which keepeth truth đến đời đời:
Which executeth judgment for the oppressed: which giveth food to the hungry. The CHÚA looseth the prisoners:
The CHÚA openeth the eyes of the blind: the CHÚA raiseth them that are bowed down: the CHÚA loveth the righteous:
The CHÚA preserveth the strangers; he relieveth chaless Và widow: but the way of the wicked he turneth upside down.
The CHÚA shall reign đến đời đời, even thy God, O Si-ôn, unto all generations. Praise ye the CHÚA.

PSALM 147.
Praise ye the CHÚA: for it is tốt to sing praises unto our God; for it is pleasant; Và praise is comely.
The CHÚA doth build up Giê-ru-sa-lem: he gathereth together the outcasts của I-sơ-ra-ên.
He healeth the broken in heart, Và bindeth up their wounds. wounds: Heb. griefs
He telleth the number of ngôi saos; he calleth them all by their names.
Great is our Lord, Và of great power: his understanding is infinite. his…: Heb. of his understanding there is no number
The CHÚA lifteth up the meek: he casteth the wicked down to the ground.
Sing unto the CHÚA with thanksgiving; sing praise upon the harp unto our God:
Who covereth the heaven with clouds, who prepareth mưa for đất, who maketh grass to grow upon núis.
He giveth to the beast his food, Và to the young ravens which cry.
He delighteth not in the strength of the horse: he taketh not pleasure in the legs of a man.
The CHÚA taketh pleasure in them that fear him, in those that hy vọng in his mercy.
Praise the CHÚA, O Giê-ru-sa-lem; praise thy God, O Si-ôn.
For he hath strengthened the bars of thy gates; he đã ban phước thy children within ngươi.
He maketh peace trong thy borders, Và filleth ngươi with the finest of the wheat. He…: Heb. Who maketh thy border peace finest…: Heb. fat of wheat
He sendeth forth his commandment trên đất: his word runneth very swiftly.
He giveth snow like wool: he scattereth the hoarfrost like ashes.
He casteth forth his ice like morsels: who can stand before his cold?
He sendeth out his word, Và melteth them: he causeth his wind to blow, Và the waters flow.
He sheweth his word unto Gia-cốp, his statutes Và his judgments unto I-sơ-ra-ên. his word: Heb. his words
He hath not dealt so with any nation: and as for his judgments, they have not known them. Praise ye the CHÚA.

PSALM 148.
Praise ye the CHÚA. Praise ye the CHÚA from the heavens: praise him in the heights. Praise ye the CHÚA. Praise: Heb. Hallelujah, etc
Praise ye him, all his angels: praise ye him, all his hosts.
Praise ye him, sun Và moon: praise him, all ye stars của sự sáng.
Praise him, ye heavens of heavens, Và ye waters that be above the heavens.
Let them praise Tên of the CHÚA: for he commanded, Và they were created.
He hath also stablished them đến đời đời và mãi mãi: he hath made a decree which shall not pass.
Praise the CHÚA from đất, ye dragons, Và all deeps:
lửa, Và hail; snow, Và vapour; stormy wind fulfilling his word:
Mountains, Và all hills; fruitful trees, Và all cedars:
Beasts, Và all cattle; creeping things, Và flying fowl: flying…: Heb. birds of wing
các vua đất, Và all people; princes, Và all judges đất:
Both young men, Và maidens; old men, Và children:
Let them praise Tên of the CHÚA: for his name alone is excellent; sự vinh hiển Ngài is above đất Và heaven. excellent: Heb. exalted
He also exalteth the horn of his people, the praise of all his saints; even of the children của I-sơ-ra-ên, a people gần unto him. Praise ye the CHÚA.

PSALM 149.
Praise ye the CHÚA. Sing unto the CHÚA a new song, Và his praise in the congregation of saints. Praise…: Heb. Hallelujah
Let I-sơ-ra-ên rejoice in him that made him: let the children of Si-ôn be joyful in their King. in him…: Heb. in his Makers
Let them praise his name in the dance: let them sing praises unto him with the timbrel Và harp. in…: or, with the pipe
For the CHÚA taketh pleasure in his people: he will beautify the meek with salvation.
Let the saints be joyful in glory: let them sing aloud upon their beds.
Let the high praises của ĐCT be in their mouth, Và a twoedged thanh gươm in their hand; mouth: Heb. throat
To execute vengeance upon the heathen, Và punishments upon the people;
To bind their kings with chains, Và their nobles with fetters of sắt;
To execute upon them the judgment written: this honour have all his saints. Praise ye the CHÚA.

PSALM 150.
Praise ye the CHÚA. Praise ĐCT in his sanctuary: praise him in the firmament of his power. Praise ye…: Heb. Hallelujah
Praise him for his mighty acts: praise him according to his excellent greatness.
Praise him with the sound of the trumpet: praise him with the psaltery Và harp. trumpet: or, cornet
Praise him with the timbrel Và dance: praise him with stringed instruments Và organs. dance: or, pipe
Praise him upon the loud cymbals: praise him upon the high sounding cymbals.
Let every thing that hath breath praise the CHÚA. Praise ye the CHÚA.

div.title: THE PROVERBS
div.chapter:
CHAPTER 1.
The proverbs of Sa-lô-môn con trai của Đa-vít, vua của I-sơ-ra-ên;
để biết sự khôn ngoan và lời khuyên dạy; to perceive những lời of understanding;
To receive the instruction of wisdom, justice, Và judgment, Và equity; equity: Heb. equities
để cho người đơn sơ sự sáng suốt, cho người trai trẻ sự hiểu biết Và discretion. discretion: or, advisement
Một [người] khôn ngoan sẽ lắng nghe, và sẽ tăng thêm học thức; Và a man of understanding shall attain unto wise counsels:
To understand a proverb, Và the interpretation; những lời của người khôn ngoan, và những lời sâu sắc của họ. the interpretation: or, an eloquent speech
Sự kính sợ CHÚA là sự khởi đầu sự tri thức: nhưng những kẻ ngu dại khinh ghét sự khôn ngoan và lời khuyên dạy. the beginning: or, the principal part
Hỡi con trai ta, hãy nghe lời khuyên dạy của cha ngươi, Và chớ - bỏ qua khuôn phép của mẹ con.
For they shall be an ornament of grace unto thy head, Và chains about thy neck. an…: Heb. an adding
Hỡi con trai ta, if sinners entice ngươi, consent ngươi not.
Nếu chúng nó nói, [nào] hãyđến with us, let us lay wait for blood, let us lurk privily for the innocent without cause:
Let us swallow them up alive as the grave; Và whole, as those that go down into the pit:
We shall find all precious substance, we shall fill our houses with spoil:
Cast in thy lot among us; let us all have one purse:
Hỡi con trai ta, walk not ngươi in the way with them; refrain thy foot from their path:
For their feet run to evil, Và make haste để đổ huyết.
Surely vô ích the net is spread in the sight of any bird. in the…: Heb. in the eyes of every thing that hath a wing
Và they lay wait for their own huyết; they lurk privily for their own lives.
So are the ways of every one that is greedy of gain; which taketh away sự sống of the owners thereof.
sự khôn ngoan crieth without; she uttereth her voice in the streets: Wisdom: Heb. Wisdoms, that is, Excellent wisdom
She crieth in the chief place of concourse, in the openings of the gates: in the city she uttereth her words, nói [rằng],
How long, ye simple ones, will ye love simplicity? Và the scorners delight in their scorning, Và fools ghét sự hiểu biết?
Turn you at my reproof: kìa, I will pour out my spirit cùng các ngươi, I will make known my words cùng các ngươi.
Because I have called, Và ye refused; I have stretched out my hand, Và không ai regarded;
But ye have set at nought all my counsel, Và would none of my reproof:
I also will laugh at your calamity; I will mock when your fear đến;
When your fear đến as desolation, Và your destruction đến as a whirlwind; when distress Và anguish đến upon you.
Then shall they call upon me, but I will not answer; they sẽ thấy me early, but they shall not find me:
For that they hated sự hiểu biết, Và did not choose the fear of the CHÚA:
They would none of my counsel: they despised all my reproof.
Therefore shall they eat of the fruit of their own way, Và be filled with their own devices.
For the turning away of the simple shall slay them, and the prosperity of fools shall destroy them. turning…: or, ease of the simple
But whoso hearkeneth unto me shall ở safely, Và shall be quiet from fear of evil.

CHAPTER 3.
Hỡi con trai ta, forget not my law; but let thine heart keep my commandments:
For length of days, Và long sự sống, Và peace, shall they add to ngươi. long…: Heb. years của sự sống
Let not mercy Và truth forsake ngươi: bind them about thy neck; write them upon the table of thine heart:
So shalt ngươi find favour Và good understanding in the sight của ĐCT Và man. good…: or, good success
Trust in the CHÚA with all thine heart; Và lean not unto thine own understanding.
In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.
Be not wise in thine own eyes: fear the CHÚA, Và depart from evil.
It shall be health to thy navel, Và marrow to thy bones. health: Heb. medicine marrow: Heb. watering, or, moistening
Honour the CHÚA with thy substance, Và with the firstfruits of all thine increase:
So shall thy barns be filled with plenty, Và thy presses shall burst out with new wine.
Hỡi con trai ta, despise not the chastening of the CHÚA; neither be weary of his correction:
For whom the CHÚA loveth he correcteth; even as a father con trai in whom he delighteth.
Happy is the man that tìm sự khôn ngoan, Và the man that getteth understanding. that getteth…: Heb. that draweth out understanding
For the merchandise of it is better than the merchandise of silver, Và the gain thereof than fine gold.
She is more precious than rubies: Và all the things ngươi canst desire are not to be compared unto her.
Length of days is in her tay phải; Và in her tay trái riches Và honour.
Her ways are ways of pleasantness, Và all her paths are peace.
She is a tree của sự sống to them that lay hold upon her: and happy is every one that retaineth her.
The CHÚA by wisdom hath founded đất; by understanding hath he established các tầng trời. established: or, prepared
By his knowledge the depths are broken up, Và đám mâys drop down the dew.
Hỡi con trai ta, let not them depart from thine eyes: keep sound wisdom Và discretion:
So shall they be sự sống unto thy soul, Và grace to thy neck.
Then shalt ngươi walk in thy way safely, Và thy foot shall not stumble.
When ngươi liest down, ngươi shalt not be afraid: yea, ngươi shalt lie down, Và thy sleep shall be sweet.
Be not afraid of sudden fear, neither of the desolation of the wicked, when it cometh.
For the CHÚA shall be thy confidence, Và shall keep thy foot from being taken.
Withhold không tốt from them to whom it is due, when it is in quyền năng of thine hand to do it. them…: Heb. the owners thereof
Say not unto thy neighbour, đi, Và come again, Và to morrow I will give; when ngươi hast it by ngươi.
Devise not evil against thy neighbour, seeing he ởeth securely by ngươi. Devise…: or, Practise no evil
Strive not with a man without cause, if he have done ngươi no harm.
Envy ngươi not the oppressor, Và choose none of his ways. the oppressor: Heb. a man of violence
For the froward is abomination to the CHÚA: but his secret is with the righteous.
The curse of the CHÚA is in nhà of the wicked: but he blesseth the habitation of the just.
Surely he scorneth the scorners: but he giveth ân-điển unto the lowly.
The wise shall inherit glory: but shame shall be the promotion of fools. shall be…: Heb. exalteth the fools

CHAPTER 4.
nghe, ye children, the instruction of a father, Và attend to know understanding.
For I give you good doctrine, forsake ye not my law.
For I was my father's son, tender Và only beloved in the sight of my mother.
He taught me also, and nói unto me, Let thine heart retain my words: keep my commandments, Và live.
Get sự khôn ngoan, get understanding: forget it not; neither decline from the words of my mouth.
Forsake her not, and she shall preserve ngươi: love her, and she shall keep ngươi.
sự khôn ngoan is the principal thing; Vậy get sự khôn ngoan: Và with all thy getting get understanding.
Exalt her, and she shall promote ngươi: she shall bring ngươi to honour, when ngươi dost embrace her.
She shall give to thine head an ornament of grace: a crown of glory shall she deliver to ngươi. a crown…: or, she shall compass ngươi with a crown of glory
nghe, O my son, Và receive my sayings; Và the years of thy sự sống shall be many.
I have taught ngươi in the way of wisdom; I have led ngươi in right paths.
When ngươi goest, thy steps shall not be straitened; Và when ngươi runnest, ngươi shalt not stumble.
Take fast hold of instruction; let her not go: keep her; for she is thy sự sống.
Enter not into the path of the wicked, và đi not in the way of evil men.
Avoid it, pass not by it, turn from it, and pass away.
For they sleep not, except they have done mischief; Và their sleep is taken away, unless they cause some to fall.
For they eat the bread of wickedness, và uống the wine of violence.
But the path of the just is as the shining light, that shineth more Và more unto the perfect ngày.
đường of the wicked is as darkness: they know not at what they stumble.
Hỡi con trai ta, attend to my words; incline thine ear unto my sayings.
Let them not depart from thine eyes; keep them in the midst of thine heart.
For they are sự sống unto those that find them, and health to all their flesh. health: Heb. medicine
Keep thy heart with all diligence; for out of it are the issues của sự sống. with…: Heb. above all keeping
Put away from ngươi a froward miệng, Và perverse lips put far from ngươi. a froward…: Heb. frowardness of mouth and perverseness of lips
Let thine eyes look right on, Và let thine eyelids look straight before ngươi.
Ponder the path of thy feet, Và let all thy ways be established. let…: or, all thy ways shall be ordered aright
Turn not to the tay phải nor to the left: remove thy foot from evil.

CHAPTER 5.
Hỡi con trai ta, attend unto my wisdom, Và bow thine ear to my understanding:
That ngươi mayest regard discretion, and that thy lips may keep sự hiểu biết.
For the lips of a strange woman drop as an honeycomb, Và her mouth is smoother than oil: mouth: Heb. palate
But her end is bitter as wormwood, sharp as a twoedged thanh gươm.
Her feet go down to death; her steps take hold on hell.
Lest ngươi shouldest ponder the path của sự sống, her ways are moveable, that ngươi canst not know họ.
nghe me now therefore, O ye children, Và depart not from the words of my mouth.
Remove thy way far from her, and come not nigh the door of her house:
Lest ngươi give thine honour unto others, Và thy years unto the cruel:
Lest strangers be filled with thy wealth; Và thy labours be in nhà of a stranger; thy wealth: Heb. thy strength
Và ngươi mourn at cuối cùng, when thy flesh Và thy body are consumed,
Và say, How have I hated instruction, Và my heart despised reproof;
Và have not obeyed tiếng of my teachers, nor inclined mine ear to them that instructed me!
I was almost in all evil in the midst of the congregation Và assembly.
uống waters out of thine own cistern, Và running waters out of thine own well.
Let thy fountains be dispersed abroad, Và rivers of waters in the streets.
Let them be only thine own, and not strangers' with ngươi.
Let thy fountain be blessed: Và rejoice with the wife of thy youth.
Let her be as the loving hind Và pleasant roe; let her breasts satisfy ngươi at all times; Và be ngươi ravished always with her love. satisfy…: Heb. water ngươi be thou…: Heb. err ngươi always in her love
Và why wilt thou, my son, be ravished with a strange woman, Và embrace the bosom of a stranger?
For the ways of man are before mắt of the CHÚA, Và he pondereth all his goings.
His own iniquities shall take the wicked himself, and he shall be holden with the cords of his tội lỗi. tội lỗi: Heb. sin
He shall die without instruction; Và in the greatness of his folly he shall go astray.

CHAPTER 6.
Hỡi con trai ta, if ngươi be surety for thy friend, nếu ngươi hast stricken thy hand with a stranger,
ngươi art snared with the words of thy mouth, ngươi art taken with the words of thy mouth.
Do this now, my son, Và deliver thyself, when ngươi art come into tay of thy friend; đi, humble thyself, and make sure thy friend. Và make…: or, so shalt ngươi prevail with thy friend
Give not sleep to thine eyes, nor slumber to thine eyelids.
Deliver thyself as a roe from tay of the hunter, Và as a bird from tay of the fowler.
đi to the ant, ngươi sluggard; consider her ways, Và be wise:
Which having no guide, overseer, or ruler,
Provideth her meat in the summer, Và gathereth her food in mùa gặt.
How long wilt ngươi sleep, O sluggard? when wilt ngươi arise out of thy sleep?
Yet a little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of tays to sleep:
So shall thy poverty đến as one that travelleth, Và thy want as an armed man.
A naughty person, a wicked man, walketh with a froward miệng.
He winketh with his eyes, he speaketh with his feet, he teacheth with his fingers;
Frowardness is in his heart, he deviseth mischief continually; he soweth discord. soweth: Heb. casteth forth
Therefore shall his calamity đến bất chợt; bất chợt shall he be broken without remedy.
These six things doth the CHÚA ghét: yea, bảy are an abomination unto him: unto…: Heb. of his soul
A proud look, a lying lưỡi, Và hands that shed innocent huyết,A proud…: Heb. Haughty eyes
An heart that deviseth gian ác imaginations, chân that be swift in running to mischief,
A false witness that speaketh lies, Và he that soweth discord among brethren.
Hỡi con trai ta, keep thy father's mạng lệnh, Và forsake not the law of thy mother:
cột them continually upon thine heart, Và tie them about thy neck.
When ngươi goest, it shall lead ngươi; when ngươi sleepest, it shall keep ngươi; and khi ngươi awakest, it shall talk with ngươi.
For the commandment is a lamp; Và the law is light; Và reproofs of instruction are đường của sự sống: lamp: or, candle
To keep ngươi from the evil woman, from the flattery of the tongue of a strange woman. of the…: or, of the strange tongue
Lust not after her beauty in thine heart; neither let her take ngươi with her eyelids.
For by means of a whorish woman a man is brought to a piece of bread: Và the adulteress will hunt for the precious sự sống. the adulteress: Heb. the woman of a man, or, a man's wife
Can a man take lửa in his bosom, Và his clothes not be burned?
Can one đi upon hot coals, Và his feet not be burned?
So he that goeth in to his neighbour's vợ; whosoever toucheth her shall not be innocent.
Men do not despise a thief, if he steal to satisfy his soul when he is hungry;
But nếu he be found, he shall restore sevenfold; he shall give all the substance of his house.
But whoso phạm tội ngoại tình with một người đờn bà lacketh understanding: he that làm it destroyeth his own soul. understanding: Heb. heart
A wound Và dishonour shall he get; Và his reproach shall not be wiped away.
For jealousy is the rage of a man: therefore he will not spare trong ngày of vengeance.
He will not regard any ransom; neither will he rest content, though ngươi givest many gifts. He will…: Heb. He will not accept mặt of any ransom

CHAPTER 7.
Hỡi con trai ta, keep my words, Và lay up my commandments with ngươi.
Keep my commandments, Và live; Và my law as the apple of thine eye.
cột them upon thy fingers, write them upon the table of thine heart.
Say unto wisdom, Thou art my sister; Và call understanding thy kinswoman:
That they may keep ngươi from the strange woman, from the stranger which flattereth with her words.
For at the window of my house I looked through my casement,
Và beheld among the simple ones, I discerned among the youths, a young man void of understanding,the youths: Heb. the sons
Passing through the street gần her corner; Và he went đường to her house,
In the twilight, in buổi chiều, in the black Và dark đêm: in buổi chiều: Heb. in buổi chiều of days
And, kìa, there met him một người đờn bà với the attire of an harlot, Và subtil of heart.
(She is loud Và stubborn; her feet abide not in her house:
bây giờ is she without, bây giờ in the streets, Và lieth in wait at every corner.)
So she caught him, and kissed him, Và with an impudent mặt nói unto him,with…: Heb. she strengthened her face and nói
I have peace offerings with me; this day have I payed my vows. I have…: Heb. Peace offerings are upon me
Therefore came I forth to meet ngươi, diligently to seek thy face, Và I have found ngươi.
I have decked my bed with coverings of tapestry, with carved works, with fine linen of Ai-Cập.
I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes, Và cinnamon.
đến, let us take our fill of love until buổi sáng: let us solace ourselves with loves.
For the goodman is not at home, he is gone a long hành trình:
He hath taken a bag of money with him, Và will come home at the day appointed. with…: Heb. in his hand the day…: or, the new moon
With her much fair speech she caused him to yield, with the flattering of her lips she forced him.
He goeth after her straightway, as một con bò goeth to the slaughter, or as a fool to the correction of the stocks; straightway: Heb. bất chợt
Till a dart strike through his liver; as a bird hasteth to the snare, Và knoweth not that it is for his sự sống.
Hearken unto me now therefore, O ye children, Và attend to the words of my mouth.
Let not thine heart decline to her ways, go not astray in her paths.
For she hath cast down many wounded: yea, many strong men have been slain by her.
Her house is đường to hell, going down to the chambers of death.

CHAPTER 8.
Doth not wisdom cry? Và understanding put forth her voice?
She standeth in the top of high places, by the way in the places of the paths.
She crieth at the gates, at the entry of the city, at the coming in at the doors.
cùng các ngươi, O men, I call; Và my voice is to the sons of man.
O ye simple, understand sự khôn ngoan: and, ye fools, be ye of an understanding heart.
nghe; for I will speak of excellent things; Và the opening of my lips shall be right things.
For my mouth shall speak truth; Và wickedness is an abomination to my lips. an…: Heb. the abomination of my lips
All the words of my mouth are in righteousness; there is nothing froward or perverse in them. froward: Heb. wreathed
They are all plain to him that understandeth, Và right to them that find sự hiểu biết.
nhận my instruction, Và not silver; Và knowledge rather than choice gold.
For wisdom is better than rubies; Và all the things that may be desired are not to be compared to it.
I wisdom ở with prudence, Và find out sự hiểu biết of witty inventions. prudence: or, subtilty
The fear of the CHÚA is to hate evil: pride, Và arrogancy, Và the evil way, Và the froward miệng, do I hate.
Counsel is mine, and sound wisdom: I là understanding; I have strength.
By me kings reign, Và princes decree justice.
By me princes rule, Và nobles, even all the judges đất.
I love them that love me; and those that seek me early shall find me.
Riches Và honour are with me; yea, durable riches Và righteousness.
My fruit is better than gold, yea, than fine gold; Và my revenue than choice silver.
I lead in the way of righteousness, in the midst of the paths of judgment: lead: or, walk
That I may cause those that love me to inherit substance; Và I will fill their treasures.
The CHÚA possessed me in the beginning of his way, before his works of old.
I was set up from đời đời, từ ban đầu, or ever đất was.
When there were no depths, I was brought forth; when there were no fountains abounding with water.
Before núis were settled, before the hills was I brought forth:
While as yet he had not made đất, nor the fields, nor the highest part of the dust of the world. fields: or, open places the highest…: or, the chief part
When he prepared các tầng trời, I was there: when he set a compass upon mặt of the depth: a compass: or, a circle
When he established đám mâys above: when he strengthened the fountains of the deep:
When he gave to biển his decree, that the waters should not pass his commandment: when he appointed the foundations đất:
Then I was by him, as one brought up with him: Và I was daily his delight, rejoicing always before him;
Rejoicing in the habitable part of his đất; Và my delights were with the sons of men.
Now therefore hearken unto me, O ye children: for blessed are they that keep my ways.
nghe instruction, Và be wise, Và refuse it not.
phước is the man that nghe me, watching hằng ngày at my gates, waiting at the posts of my doors.
For whoso tìm me tìm sự sống, Và shall obtain favour of the CHÚA. obtain: Heb. bring forth
But he that sinneth against me wrongeth his own soul: all they that hate me love sự chết.

CHAPTER 9.
sự khôn ngoan hath builded her house, she hath hewn out her bảy pillars:
She hath killed her beasts; she hath mingled her wine; she hath also furnished her table. her beasts: Heb. her killing
She hath sent forth her maidens: she crieth trên the highest places of the city,
Whoso is simple, let him turn in hither: as for him that wanteth understanding, she nói to him,
đến, ăn of my bread, và uống of the wine which I have mingled.
Forsake the foolish, Và live; và đi in the way of understanding.
He that reproveth a scorner getteth to himself shame: Và he that rebuketh a wicked man getteth himself a blot.
Reprove not a scorner, lest he hate ngươi: rebuke a wise man, Và he will love ngươi.
Give instruction to a wise man, Và he will be yet wiser: teach a just man, Và he will increase in learning.
The fear of the CHÚA is ban đầu of wisdom: Và the knowledge of the holy is understanding.
For by me thy days shall be multiplied, Và the years of thy sự sống shall be increased.
If ngươi be wise, ngươi shalt be wise for thyself: but nếu ngươi scornest, ngươi alone shalt bear it.
A foolish woman is clamorous: she is simple, Và biết nothing.
For she sitteth at the door of her house, on a seat in the high places of the city,
To call passengers who go right on their ways:
Whoso is simple, let him turn in hither: and as for him that wanteth understanding, she nói to him,
Stolen waters are sweet, Và bread eaten in secret is pleasant. eaten…: Heb. of secrecies
But he knoweth not that kẻ chết are there; Và that her guests are in the depths of hell.

CHAPTER 10.
The proverbs of Sa-lô-môn. A wise son maketh a glad cha: but a foolish son is the heaviness of his mother.
của báu of wickedness profit nothing: but righteousness delivereth from death.
The CHÚA will not suffer the soul of the righteous to famish: but he casteth away the substance of the wicked. the substance…: or, the wicked for their wickedness
He becometh poor that dealeth với a slack tay: but tay of the diligent maketh rich.
He that gathereth in summer is a wise son: but he that sleepeth in harvest is một con trai that causeth shame.
Blessings are upon the head of the just: but violence covereth the mouth of the wicked.
The memory of the just is phước: but Tên of the wicked shall rot.
The wise in heart will receive commandments: but a prating fool shall fall. a prating…: Heb. a fool of lips fall: Heb. be beaten
He that walketh uprightly walketh surely: but he that perverteth his ways shall be known.
He that winketh with the eye causeth sorrow: but a prating fool shall fall. fall: Heb. be beaten
The mouth of a righteous man is a well của sự sống: but violence covereth the mouth of the wicked.
thù oán stirreth up strifes: but love covereth all tội lỗi.
In the lips of him that hath understanding sự khôn ngoan is found: but a rod is for the back of him that is void of understanding. of understanding: Heb. of heart
khôn ngoan men lay up sự hiểu biết: but the mouth of the foolish is gần destruction.
The rich man's wealth is his strong city: the destruction of the poor is their poverty.
The labour of the righteous tendeth to sự sống: the fruit of the wicked to sin.
He is in đường của sự sống that keepeth instruction: but he that refuseth reproof erreth. erreth: or, causeth to err
He that hideth thù oán với lying lips, Và he that uttereth a slander, is a fool.
In đám đông of words there wanteth not sin: but he that refraineth his lips is khôn ngoan.
lưỡi of the just is as choice silver: the heart of the wicked is little worth.
The lips of the righteous feed many: but fools chết for want of wisdom. of wisdom: Heb. of heart
The blessing of the CHÚA, it maketh rich, Và he addeth no sorrow with it.
It is as sport to a fool to do mischief: but a man of understanding hath wisdom.
The fear of the wicked, it shall come upon him: but the desire of the righteous shall be granted.
As the whirlwind passeth, so is the wicked no more: but the righteous is an đời đời foundation.
As vinegar to the teeth, Và as smoke to the eyes, so is the sluggard to them that send him.
The fear of the CHÚA prolongeth ngày: but the years of the wicked shall be shortened. prolongeth: Heb. addeth
The hy vọng of the righteous shall be gladness: but the expectation of the wicked shall perish.
đường of the CHÚA is strength to the upright: but destruction shall be to the workers of iniquity.
The righteous shall never be removed: but the wicked shall not inhabit đất.
The mouth of the just bringeth forth sự khôn ngoan: but the froward lưỡi shall be cut out.
The lips of the righteous biết what is acceptable: but the mouth of the wicked speaketh frowardness. frowardness: Heb. frowardnesses

CHAPTER 11.
A false balance is abomination to the CHÚA: but a just weight is his delight. A false…: Heb. Balances of deceit just…: Heb. perfect stone
khi pride đến, then cometh shame: but with the lowly is sự khôn ngoan.
The integrity of the upright shall guide them: but the perverseness of transgressors shall destroy them.
Riches profit not trong ngày of wrath: but righteousness delivereth from death.
The righteousness of the perfect shall direct his way: but the wicked shall fall by his own wickedness. direct: Heb. rectify
The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them: but transgressors shall be taken in their own naughtiness.
When a wicked man dieth, his expectation shall perish: Và the hy vọng of unjust men perisheth.
The righteous is delivered out of trouble, Và the wicked đến in his stead.
An hypocrite with his miệng destroyeth his neighbour: but through knowledge shall the just be delivered.
When it goeth well with the righteous, thành mừng vui: Và when the wicked perish, there is shouting.
By the blessing of the upright thành is exalted: but it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked.
He that is void of wisdom despiseth his neighbour: but a man of understanding holdeth his peace. void…: Heb. destitute of heart
A talebearer revealeth secrets: but he that is of a faithful spirit concealeth the matter. A talebearer: Heb. He that walketh, being a talebearer
Where no counsel is, the people fall: but in đám đông of counsellors there is safety.
He that is surety for a stranger shall smart for it: Và he that hateth suretiship is sure. smart: Heb. be sore broken suretiship: Heb. those that strike hands
A gracious woman retaineth honour: Và strong men retain riches.
The merciful man doeth good to his own soul: but he that is cruel troubleth his own flesh.
The wicked worketh a deceitful work: but to him that soweth righteousness shall be a sure phần thưởng.
As righteousness tendeth to sự sống: so he that pursueth evil pursueth it to his own death.
They that are of a froward heart are abomination to the CHÚA: but such as are upright in their way are his delight.
Though tay join in hand, the wicked shall not be unpunished: but the seed of the righteous shall be delivered.
As a jewel of gold in a swine's snout, so is a fair woman which is without discretion. is without: Heb. departeth from
The desire of the righteous is only good: but the expectation of the wicked is wrath.
There is that scattereth, Và yet increaseth; and there is that withholdeth more than is meet, but it tendeth to poverty.
The liberal soul shall be made fat: Và he that watereth shall be watered also himself. liberal…: Heb. soul of blessing
He that withholdeth bắp, the people shall curse him: but blessing shall be upon the head of him that selleth it.
He that diligently seeketh tốt procureth favour: but he that seeketh mischief, it shall come unto him.
He that trusteth in his riches shall fall: but the righteous shall flourish as a branch.
He that troubleth his own house shall inherit gió: Và the fool shall be đầy tớ to the wise of heart.
The fruit of the righteous is a tree của sự sống; Và he that winneth souls is khôn ngoan. winneth: Heb. taketh
kìa, the righteous shall be recompensed in đất: much more the wicked Và the sinner.

CHAPTER 12.
Whoso loveth instruction loveth sự hiểu biết: but he that hateth reproof is brutish.
A good man obtaineth favour of the CHÚA: but a man of wicked devices will he kết án.
một người shall not be established by wickedness: but the root of the righteous shall not be moved.
A virtuous woman is a crown to her husband: but she that maketh ashamed is as rottenness in his bones.
The thoughts of the righteous are right: but the counsels of the wicked are deceit.
những lời of the wicked are to lie in wait for blood: but the mouth of the upright shall deliver them.
The wicked are overthrown, and are not: but nhà of the righteous shall stand.
một người shall be commended according to his wisdom: but he that is of a perverse heart shall be despised. of a…: Heb. perverse of heart
He that is despised, Và hath a servant, is better than he that honoureth himself, and lacketh bánh.
A righteous man regardeth sự sống of his beast: but the tender mercies of the wicked are cruel. tender…: or, bowels
He that tilleth his land shall be satisfied with bread: but he that followeth vain persons is void of understanding.
The wicked desireth the net of evil men: but the root of the righteous yieldeth fruit. the net: or, the fortress
The wicked is snared by the transgression of his lips: but the just shall come out of trouble. The wicked…: Heb. The snare of the wicked is in the transgression of lips
một người shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his miệng: Và the recompence of a man's hands shall be rendered unto him.
đường of a fool is right in his own eyes: but he that hearkeneth unto counsel is khôn ngoan.
A fool's wrath is presently known: but a prudent man covereth shame. presently: Heb. in that day
He that speaketh truth sheweth forth righteousness: but a false witness deceit.
There is that speaketh like the piercings of a thanh gươm: but the tongue of the wise is health.
The lip of truth shall be established đến đời đời: but a lying lưỡi is but for a moment.
Deceit is in the heart of them that imagine evil: but to the counsellors of peace is joy.
There shall no evil happen to the just: but the wicked shall be filled with mischief.
Lying lips are abomination to the CHÚA: but they that deal truly are his delight.
A prudent man concealeth sự hiểu biết: but the heart of fools proclaimeth foolishness.
The hand of the diligent shall bear rule: but the slothful shall be under tribute. slothful: or, deceitful
Heaviness in the heart of man maketh it stoop: but a good word maketh it glad.
The righteous is more excellent than his neighbour: but the way of the wicked seduceth them. excellent: or, abundant
The slothful man roasteth not that which he took in hunting: but the substance of a diligent man is precious.
In the way of righteousness is sự sống; and trong the pathway thereof there is no death.

CHAPTER 13.
A wise son nghe his father's instruction: but a scorner nghe not rebuke.
một người shall eat tốt by the fruit of his miệng: but the soul of the transgressors shall eat violence.
He that keepeth his mouth keepeth his sự sống: but he that openeth wide his lips shall have destruction.
The soul of the sluggard desireth, and hath nothing: but the soul of the diligent shall be made fat.
A righteous man hateth lying: but a wicked man is loathsome, Và cometh to shame.
Righteousness keepeth him that is upright in the way: but wickedness overthroweth the sinner. the sinner: Heb. sin
There is that maketh himself rich, yet hath nothing: there is that maketh himself poor, yet hath great riches.
The ransom of a man's sự sống are his riches: but the poor nghe not rebuke.
The light of the righteous mừng vui: but the lamp of the wicked shall be put out. lamp: or, candle
Only by pride đến contention: but with the well advised is sự khôn ngoan.
Wealth gotten by vanity shall be diminished: but he that gathereth by labour shall increase. by labour: Heb. with tay
hy vọng deferred maketh the heart sick: but khi the desire đến, it is a tree của sự sống.
Whoso despiseth lời sẽ bị hủy diệt: but he that feareth the commandment shall be rewarded. shall be rewarded: or, shall be trong bình an
luật pháp of the wise is a fountain của sự sống, to depart from the snares of death.
tốt understanding giveth favour: but the way of transgressors is hard.
Every prudent man dealeth with knowledge: but a fool layeth open his folly. layeth…: Heb. spreadeth
A wicked messenger falleth into mischief: but a faithful ambassador is health. a faithful…: Heb. an ambassador of faithfulness
Poverty Và shame shall be to him that refuseth instruction: but he that regardeth reproof shall be honoured.
The desire accomplished is sweet to the soul: but it is abomination to fools to depart from evil.
He that walketh with wise men shall be wise: but a companion of fools sẽ bị hủy diệt. destroyed: Heb. broken
Evil pursueth những tội nhân: but to the righteous tốt shall be repayed.
A good man leaveth một cơ nghiệp to his children's children: Và the wealth of the sinner is laid up for the just.
Much food is in the tillage of the poor: but there is that is destroyed for want of judgment.
He that spareth his rod hateth his son: but he that loveth him chasteneth him betimes.
The righteous eateth to the satisfying of his soul: but the belly of the wicked shall want.

CHAPTER 14.
Every wise woman buildeth her house: but the foolish plucketh it down with her hands.
He that walketh in his uprightness feareth the CHÚA: but he that is perverse in his ways despiseth him.
In the mouth of the foolish is a rod of pride: but the lips of the wise shall preserve them.
Where no oxen are, the crib is clean: but much increase is by the strength of the ox.
A faithful witness will not lie: but a false witness will utter lies.
A scorner seeketh sự khôn ngoan, and tìm it not: but knowledge is easy unto him that understandeth.
đi from the presence of a foolish man, when ngươi perceivest not in him the lips sự tri thức.
sự khôn ngoan of the prudent is to understand his way: but the folly of fools is deceit.
Fools make a mock at sin: but among the righteous there is favour.
The heart biết his own bitterness; Và a stranger doth not intermeddle with his joy. his own…: Heb. the bitterness of his soul
nhà of the wicked shall be overthrown: but đền tạm of the upright shall flourish.
There is a way which seemeth right unto một người, but the end thereof are the ways of death.
Even in laughter the heart is sorrowful; Và the end of that mirth is heaviness.
The backslider in heart shall be filled with his own ways: Và a good man shall be satisfied from himself.
The simple believeth every word: but the prudent man looketh well to his going.
A wise man feareth, Và departeth from evil: but the fool rageth, Và is confident.
He that is soon angry dealeth foolishly: Và a man of wicked devices is hated.
The simple inherit folly: but the prudent are crowned with knowledge.
The evil bow before the good; Và the wicked at the gates of the righteous.
người nghèo is hated even of his own neighbour: but the rich hath many friends. the rich…: Heb. many are the lovers of the rich
He that despiseth his neighbour phạm tội: but he that hath mercy on the poor, happy is he.
Do they not err that devise evil? but mercy Và truth shall be to them that devise tốt.
In all labour there is profit: but the talk of the lips tendeth only to penury.
The crown of the wise is their riches: but the foolishness of fools is folly.
A true witness delivereth souls: but a deceitful witness speaketh lies.
In the fear of the CHÚA is strong confidence: Và his children shall have một chỗ of refuge.
The fear of the CHÚA is a fountain của sự sống, to depart from the snares of death.
In đám đông of people is the king's honour: but in the want of people is the destruction of the prince.
He that is slow to wrath is of great understanding: but he that is hasty of spirit exalteth folly. hasty…: Heb. short of spirit
A sound heart is sự sống of xác thịt: but envy the rottenness of the bones.
He that oppresseth người nghèo reproacheth his Maker: but he that honoureth him hath mercy on the poor.
The wicked is driven away in his wickedness: but the righteous hath hy vọng in his death.
sự khôn ngoan resteth in the heart of him that hath understanding: but that which is in the midst of fools is made known.
Righteousness exalteth a nation: but sin is a reproach to any people. to any…: Heb. to nations
The king's favour is toward a wise đầy tớ: but his wrath is against him that causeth shame.

CHAPTER 15.
A soft answer turneth away wrath: but grievous những lời stir up anger.
lưỡi of the wise useth knowledge aright: but the mouth of fools poureth out foolishness. poureth: Heb. belcheth, or, bubbleth
mắt of the CHÚA are in every place, beholding the evil Và the good.
A wholesome lưỡi is a tree của sự sống: but perverseness therein is a breach in the spirit. A wholesome…: Heb. The healing of the tongue
A fool despiseth his father's instruction: but he that regardeth reproof is prudent.
In nhà of the righteous is much treasure: but in the revenues of the wicked is trouble.
The lips of the wise disperse sự hiểu biết: but the heart of the foolish làm not so.
The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination to the CHÚA: but the prayer of the upright is his delight.
đường of the wicked is an abomination unto the CHÚA: but he loveth him that followeth after righteousness.
Correction is grievous unto him that forsaketh đường: Và he that hateth reproof sẽ chết. Correction: or, Instruction
Hell Và destruction are before the CHÚA: how much more then the hearts of the children of men?
A scorner loveth not one that reproveth him: neither will he go unto the wise.
A merry heart maketh a cheerful countenance: but by sorrow of the heart the spirit is broken.
The heart of him that hath understanding seeketh sự hiểu biết: but the mouth of fools feedeth on foolishness.
All the days of the afflicted are evil: but he that is of a merry heart hath a continual feast.
Better is little with the fear of the CHÚA than great treasure Và trouble therewith.
Better is a dinner of herbs where love is, than a stalled ox Và thù oán therewith.
A wrathful man stirreth up strife: but he that is slow to anger appeaseth strife.
đường of the slothful man is as an hedge of thorns: but the way of the righteous is made plain. is made…: Heb. is raised up as a causey
A wise son maketh a glad cha: but a foolish man despiseth his mother.
Folly is joy to him that is destitute of wisdom: but a man of understanding walketh uprightly. destitute…: Heb. void of heart
Without counsel purposes are disappointed: but in đám đông of counsellors they are established.
một người hath joy by the answer of his mouth: Và a word spoken in due season, how good is it!due…: Heb. his season
đường của sự sống is above to the wise, that he may depart from hell beneath.
The CHÚA will destroy nhà of the proud: but he will establish the border of the widow.
The thoughts of the wicked are an abomination to the CHÚA: but những lời of the pure are pleasant những lời. pleasant…: Heb. words of pleasantness
He that is greedy of gain troubleth his own house; but he that hateth gifts sẽ sống.
The heart of the righteous studieth to answer: but the mouth of the wicked poureth out evil things.
The CHÚA is far from the wicked: but he nghe the prayer of the righteous.
The light of the eyes mừng vui the heart: Và a good report maketh the bones fat.
The ear that nghe the reproof của sự sống abideth among the wise.
He that refuseth instruction despiseth his own soul: but he that nghe reproof getteth understanding. instruction: or, correction nghe: or, obeyeth getteth…: Heb. possesseth an heart
The fear of the CHÚA is the instruction of wisdom; Và before honour is humility.

CHAPTER 16.
The preparations of the heart in man, Và the answer of the tongue, is from the CHÚA. preparations: or, disposings
All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes; but the CHÚA weigheth the spirits.
Commit thy works unto the CHÚA, Và thy thoughts shall be established. Commit: Heb. Roll
The CHÚA hath made all things for himself: yea, even the wicked for the day of evil.
Every one that is proud in heart is an abomination to the CHÚA: though tay join in hand, he shall not be unpunished. unpunished: Heb. held innocent
By mercy Và truth iniquity is purged: Và by the fear of the CHÚA men depart from evil.
When a man's ways please the CHÚA, he maketh even his enemies to be at peace with him.
Better is a little with righteousness than great revenues without right.
A man's heart deviseth his way: but the CHÚA directeth his steps.
A divine sentence is in the lips of the king: his mouth transgresseth not in judgment. A divine…: Heb. Divination
A just weight Và balance are the Lord's: all the weights of the bag are his work. the weights: Heb. the stones
It is an abomination to kings to commit wickedness: for the throne is established by righteousness.
công chính lips are the delight of kings; Và they love him that speaketh right.
