cơn thịnh nộ of a king is as messengers of death: but a wise man will pacify it.
In the light of the king's countenance is sự sống; Và his favour is as a cloud of the latter rain.
How much better is it to get sự khôn ngoan than gold! Và to get understanding rather to be chosen than silver!
The highway of the upright is to depart from evil: he that keepeth his way preserveth his soul.
Pride goeth before destruction, Và an haughty spirit before a fall.
Better it is to be of an humble spirit with the lowly, than to divide the spoil with the proud.
He that handleth a matter wisely shall find tốt: Và whoso trusteth in the CHÚA, happy is he. handleth…: or, understandeth a matter
The wise in heart shall be called prudent: Và the sweetness of the lips increaseth learning.
Understanding is a wellspring của sự sống unto him that hath it: but the instruction of fools is folly.
The heart of the wise teacheth his mouth, Và addeth learning to his lips. teacheth: Heb. maketh wise
Pleasant những lời are as an honeycomb, sweet to the soul, Và health to the bones.
There is a way that seemeth right unto một người, but the end thereof are the ways of death.
He that laboureth laboureth for himself; for his mouth craveth it of him. He…: Heb. The soul of him that craveth…: Heb. boweth unto him
An ungodly man diggeth up evil: Và in his lips there is as a burning lửa. An…: Heb. A man of Belial
A froward man soweth strife: Và a whisperer separateth chief friends. soweth: Heb. sendeth forth
A violent man enticeth his neighbour, Và leadeth him into the way that is không tốt.
He shutteth his eyes to devise froward things: moving his lips he bringeth evil to pass.
The hoary head is a crown of glory, nếu it be found in the way of righteousness.
He that is slow to anger is better than the mighty; Và he that ruleth his spirit than he that taketh a city.
The lot is cast into the lap; but the whole disposing thereof is of the CHÚA.

CHAPTER 17.
Better is a dry morsel, Và quietness therewith, than một căn nhà full of sacrifices với strife. sacrifices: or, good cheer
A wise đầy tớ shall have rule over một con trai that causeth shame, Và shall have part of the inheritance among the brethren.
The fining pot is for silver, Và the furnace for gold: but the CHÚA trieth the hearts.
A wicked doer giveth heed to false lips; Và một người nói dối giveth ear to a naughty lưỡi.
Whoso mocketh người nghèo reproacheth his Maker: Và he that is glad at calamities shall not be unpunished. unpunished: Heb. held innocent
Children's children are the crown of old men; Và sự vinh hiển of children are cha ông của họ.
Excellent speech becometh not a fool: much less do lying lips a prince. Excellent…: Heb. A lip of excellency lying…: Heb. a lip of lying
A gift is as a precious stone in the eyes of him that hath it: whithersoever it turneth, it prospereth. a precious…: Heb. a stone of grace
He that covereth a transgression seeketh love; but he that repeateth a matter separateth very friends. seeketh: or, procureth
A reproof entereth more into a wise man than an hundred stripes into a fool. entereth…: or, aweth more a wise man, than to strike a fool an hundred times
An evil man seeketh only rebellion: therefore a cruel messenger shall be sent against him.
Let a bear robbed of her whelps meet một người, rather than a fool in his folly.
Whoso rewardeth evil for good, evil shall not depart from his house.
ban đầu of strife is as when one letteth out nước: therefore leave off contention, before it be meddled with.
He that justifieth the wicked, Và he that kết áneth the just, even they both are abomination to the CHÚA.
Wherefore is there a price in tay of a fool to get sự khôn ngoan, seeing he hath no heart to it?
A friend loveth at all times, Và a brother is born for adversity.
một người void of understanding striketh hands, Và becometh surety in the presence of his friend. understanding: Heb. heart
He loveth transgression that loveth strife: Và he that exalteth his gate seeketh destruction.
He that hath a froward heart tìm no good: Và he that hath a perverse lưỡi falleth into mischief. He that hath a froward…: Heb. The froward of heart
He that begetteth a fool doeth it to his sorrow: Và cha of a fool hath no joy.
A merry heart doeth good like a medicine: but a broken spirit drieth the bones. like: or, to
A wicked man taketh a gift out of the bosom to pervert the ways of judgment.
sự khôn ngoan is before him that hath understanding; but the eyes of a fool are in the ends đất.
A foolish son is a grief to his father, Và bitterness to her that bare him.
Also to punish the just is không tốt, cũng không to strike princes for equity.
He that hath sự hiểu biết spareth his words: Và một người of understanding is of an excellent spirit. an…: or, a cool
Even a fool, when he holdeth his peace, is counted khôn ngoan: Và he that shutteth his lips is esteemed a man of understanding.

CHAPTER 18.
Through desire a man, having separated himself, seeketh Và intermeddleth with all wisdom. Through…: or, He that separateth himself seeketh according to his desire, and intermeddleth in every business
A fool hath no delight in understanding, but that his heart may discover itself.
When the wicked đến, Rồi đến also contempt, Và with ignominy reproach.
những lời of a man's miệng are as deep waters, Và the wellspring of wisdom as a flowing brook.
It is không tốt to accept the person of the wicked, to overthrow the righteous in judgment.
A fool's lips enter into contention, Và his mouth calleth for strokes.
A fool's miệng is his destruction, Và his lips are the snare of his soul.
những lời of a talebearer are as wounds, Và they go down into the innermost parts of the belly. talebearer: or, whisperer as wounds: or, like as when men are wounded innermost…: Heb. chambers
He also that is slothful in his work is brother to him that is a great waster.
Tên of the CHÚA is a strong tower: the righteous runneth into it, and is safe. safe: Heb. set aloft
The rich man's wealth is his strong city, Và as an high wall in his own conceit.
Before destruction the heart of man is haughty, Và before honour is humility.
He that answereth a matter before he nghe it, it is folly Và shame unto him. answereth…: Heb. returneth a word
The spirit of a man will sustain his infirmity; but a wounded spirit who can bear?
The heart of the prudent getteth sự hiểu biết; Và the ear of the wise seeketh sự hiểu biết.
A man's gift maketh room for him, and bringeth him before great men.
He that is first in his own cause seemeth just; but his neighbour đến Và searcheth him.
The lot causeth contentions to cease, Và parteth between the mighty.
A brother offended is harder to be won than a strong city: and their contentions are like the bars of a castle.
A man's bụng shall be satisfied with the fruit of his mouth; Và with the increase of his lips shall he be filled.
sự chết Và sự sống are in quyền năng of the tongue: Và they that love it shall eat the fruit thereof.
Whoso tìm a wife tìm a good thing, Và obtaineth favour of the CHÚA.
người nghèo useth intreaties; but the rich answereth roughly.
một người that hath friends must shew himself friendly: Và there is a friend that sticketh closer than a brother.

CHAPTER 19.
Better is người nghèo that walketh in his integrity, than he that is perverse in his lips, Và is a fool.
Also, that the soul be without knowledge, it is không tốt; Và he that hasteth with his chân phạm tội.
The foolishness of man perverteth his way: Và his heart fretteth against the CHÚA.
Wealth maketh many friends; but the poor is separated from his neighbour.
A false witness shall not be unpunished, and he that speaketh lies shall not escape. unpunished: Heb. held innocent
Many will intreat the favour of the prince: and every man is a friend to him that giveth gifts. him…: Heb. a man of gifts
All the brethren of the poor do hate him: how much more do his friends go far from him? he pursueth them with những lời, yet they are wanting to him.
He that getteth sự khôn ngoan loveth his own soul: he that keepeth understanding shall find tốt. wisdom: Heb. an heart
A false witness shall not be unpunished, and he that speaketh lies shall perish.
Delight is not seemly for a fool; much less for a servant to have rule over princes.
The discretion of a man deferreth his anger; and it is sự vinh hiển Ngài to pass over a transgression. discretion: or, prudence
The king's wrath is as the roaring of a lion; but his favour is as dew upon the grass.
A foolish son is the calamity of his father: Và the contentions of a wife are a continual dropping.
nhà Và riches are the inheritance of fathers: Và a prudent vợ is from the CHÚA.
Slothfulness casteth into a deep sleep; Và an idle soul shall suffer hunger.
He that keepeth the commandment keepeth his own soul; but he that despiseth his ways sẽ chết.
He that hath pity upon the poor lendeth unto the CHÚA; Và that which he hath given will he pay him again. that which…: or, his deed
Chasten thy son while there is hy vọng, Và let not thy soul spare for his crying. for…: or, to his destruction: or, to cause him to die
một người of great wrath shall suffer punishment: for if ngươi deliver him, yet ngươi must do it again. do: Heb. add
nghe counsel, Và receive instruction, that ngươi mayest be wise in thy latter end.
There are many devices in a man's heart; nevertheless the counsel of the CHÚA, that shall stand.
The desire of a man is his kindness: Và a poor man is better than một người nói dối.

A slothful man hideth his hand in his lòng, Và will not so much as bring it to his mouth again.

rượu nho is a mocker, strong drink is raging: Và whosoever is deceived thereby is not wise.

mắt of the CHÚA preserve sự hiểu biết, Và he overthroweth những lời of the transgressor. the words: or, the matters

Lest ngươi learn his ways, Và get a snare to thy soul.

CHAPTER 23.

Và put a knife to thy throat, if thou be a man given to appetite.
Be not desirous of his dainties: for they are deceitful meat.
Labour not to be rich: cease from thine own wisdom.

nói not in the ears of a fool: for he will despise sự khôn ngoan of thy words.

ngươi shalt beat him with the rod, Và shalt deliver his soul from hell.
