Evil men understand not judgment: but they that seek the CHÚA understand all things.
Better is người nghèo that walketh in his uprightness, than he that is perverse in his ways, though he be rich.
Whoso keepeth luật pháp is a wise son: but he that is a companion of riotous men shameth his father. is a companion…: or, feedeth gluttons
He that by usury Và unjust gain increaseth his substance, he shall gather it for him that will pity người nghèo. unjust…: Heb. by increase
He that turneth away his ear from hearing luật pháp, even his prayer shall be abomination.
Whoso causeth the righteous to go astray in an evil way, he shall fall himself into his own pit: but the upright shall have good things in possession.
The rich man is khôn ngoan in his own conceit; but the poor that hath understanding searcheth him out. own…: Heb. eyes
When righteous men do rejoice, there is great glory: but when the wicked rise, một người is hidden. hidden: or, sought for
He that covereth his tội lỗi shall not prosper: but whoso confesseth Và forsaketh họ shall have mercy.
Happy is the man that feareth alway: but he that hardeneth his heart shall fall into mischief.
As a roaring con sư tử, Và a ranging bear; so is a wicked ruler over the poor people.
The prince that wanteth understanding is also a great oppressor: but he that hateth covetousness shall prolong his ngày.
một người that doeth violence to the blood of any person shall flee to the pit; let không ai stay him.
Whoso walketh uprightly shall được cứu: but he that is perverse in his ways shall fall at once.
He that tilleth his land shall have plenty of bread: but he that followeth after vain persons shall have poverty enough.
A faithful man shall abound with blessings: but he that maketh haste to be rich shall not be innocent. innocent: or, unpunished
To have respect of persons is không tốt: for for a piece of bread that man will transgress.
He that hasteth to be rich hath an evil mắt, Và considereth not that poverty shall come upon him. hasteth…: or, hath and evil eye hasteth to be rich
He that rebuketh một người afterwards shall find more favour than he that flattereth with the tongue.
Whoso robbeth his father or his mother, Và nói, It is no transgression; the same is the companion of a destroyer. a destroyer: Heb. a man destroying
He that is of a proud heart stirreth up strife: but he that putteth his trust in the CHÚA shall be made fat.
He that trusteth in his own heart is a fool: but whoso walketh wisely, he shall be delivered.
He that giveth unto the poor shall not lack: but he that hideth his eyes shall have many a curse.
When the wicked rise, men hide themselves: but when they perish, the righteous increase.

CHAPTER 29.
He, that being often reproved hardeneth his cổ, shall bất chợt be destroyed, Và that without remedy. He…: Heb. A man of reproofs
When the righteous are in authority, the people rejoice: but when the wicked beareth rule, the people than khóc. in…: or, increased
Whoso loveth sự khôn ngoan mừng vui his father: but he that keepeth company with harlots spendeth his substance.
The king by judgment establisheth the land: but he that nhận gifts overthroweth it. he…: Heb. a man of oblations
một người that flattereth his neighbour spreadeth a net for his feet.
In the transgression of an evil man there is a snare: but the righteous doth sing Và rejoice.
The righteous considereth the cause of the poor: but the wicked regardeth not to know it.
Scornful men bring a city into a snare: but wise men turn away wrath. bring…: or, set a city on fire
nếu a wise man contendeth with a foolish man, whether he rage or laugh, there is no rest.
The bloodthirsty ghét the upright: but the just seek his soul. The bloodthirsty: Heb. Men of blood
A fool uttereth all his mind: but a wise man keepeth it in till afterwards.
If a ruler hearken to lies, all his servants are gian ác.
người nghèo Và the deceitful man meet together: the CHÚA lighteneth both their eyes. the deceitful…: or, the usurer
The king that faithfully judgeth người nghèo, his throne shall be established đến đời đời.
The rod Và reproof give sự khôn ngoan: but a child left to himself bringeth his mother to shame.
When the wicked are multiplied, transgression increaseth: but the righteous sẽ thấy their fall.
Correct thy son, Và he shall give ngươi rest; yea, he shall give delight unto thy soul.
Where there is no vision, the people perish: but he that keepeth luật pháp, happy is he. perish: or, is made naked
một đầy tớ will not be corrected by words: for though he understand he will not answer.
Seest ngươi a man that is hasty in his words? there is more hy vọng of a fool than of him. words: or, matters?
He that delicately bringeth up his servant from a child shall have him become his son at the length.
An angry man stirreth up strife, Và a furious man aboundeth in transgression.
A man's pride shall bring him low: but honour shall uphold the humble in spirit.
Whoso is partner with a thief hateth his own soul: he nghe cursing, Và bewrayeth it not.
The fear of man bringeth a snare: but whoso putteth his trust in the CHÚA shall be safe. safe: Heb. set on high
Many seek the ruler's favour; but mỗi man's judgment đến from the CHÚA. the ruler's…: Heb. mặt of a ruler
An unjust man is an abomination to the just: and he that is upright in the way is abomination to the wicked.

CHAPTER 30.
những lời of Agur con trai of Jakeh, even the prophecy: the man nói unto Ithiel, even unto Ithiel Và Ucal,
Surely I là more brutish than any man, Và have not the understanding of a man.
I neither learned sự khôn ngoan, nor have sự hiểu biết of the holy. have: Heb. know
Who hath ascended up into heaven, or descended? who hath gathered gió in his fists? who hath bound the waters in a garment? who hath established all the ends đất? what is his name, and what is his son's name, if ngươi canst tell?
Every word của ĐCT is pure: he is a shield với họ that put their trust in him. pure: Heb. purified
Add ngươi not unto his words, lest he reprove ngươi, and ngươi be found a liar.
hai things have I required of ngươi; deny me họ not before I die: deny…: Heb. withhold not from me
Remove far from me vanity Và lies: give me neither poverty nor riches; feed me with food convenient for me: convenient…: Heb. of my allowance
Lest I be full, Và deny ngươi, Và say, Who is the CHÚA? or lest I be poor, Và steal, Và take Tên of my God vô ích. deny…: Heb. belie ngươi
Accuse not a servant unto his master, lest he curse ngươi, and ngươi be found guilty. Accuse…: Heb. Hurt not with thy tongue
There is a generation that curseth their father, Và doth not bless their mother.
There is a generation that are pure in their own eyes, and yet is not washed from their filthiness.
There is a generation, O how lofty are their eyes! Và their eyelids are lifted up.
There is a generation, whose teeth are as những thanh gươm, Và their jaw teeth as dao, to devour người nghèo from off đất, Và the needy from among men.
The horseleach hath two daughters, crying, Give, give. There are three things that are never satisfied, yea, bốn things say not, It is enough: It is…: Heb. Wealth
The grave; Và the barren womb; đất that is not filled with water; Và the fire that nói not, It is enough.
The eye that mocketh at his cha, Và despiseth to obey his mẹ, the ravens of the valley shall pick it out, Và the young eagles shall eat it. the valley: or, the brook
There be three things which are too wonderful for me, yea, four which I know not:
đường of an eagle in the air; đường of a serpent upon a rock; đường of a ship in the midst of biển; Và the way of a man with a maid. midst: Heb. heart
Such is đường of an ngoại tình woman; she eateth, Và wipeth her mouth, Và nói, I have done no wickedness.
For three things đất is disquieted, Và for four which it cannot bear:
For a servant when he reigneth; Và a fool when he is filled with meat;
For an odious woman when she is married; Và an handmaid that is heir to her mistress.
There be four things which are little trên đất, but they are exceeding khôn ngoan: exceeding…: Heb. wise, made wise
The ants are a people not strong, yet they prepare their meat in the summer;
The conies are but a feeble folk, yet make they their houses in the rocks;
The châu chấu have no king, yet go they forth all of them by bands; by…: Heb. gathered together
The spider taketh hold with her hands, Và is in kings' palaces.
There be three things which go well, yea, four are comely in going:
A lion which is strongest among beasts, Và turneth not away for any;
A greyhound; an he goat also; Và a king, against whom there is no rising up. greyhound: or, horse: Heb. girt in the loins
If ngươi hast done foolishly in lifting up thyself, or if ngươi hast thought evil, lay thine hand upon thy mouth.
Surely the churning of milk bringeth forth butter, Và the wringing of the nose bringeth forth huyết: so the forcing of wrath bringeth forth strife.

CHAPTER 31.
những lời của vua Lemuel, the prophecy that his mother dạy him.
What, my son? Và what, the son of my womb? Và what, the son of my vows?
Give not thy strength unto women, nor thy ways to that which destroyeth các vua.
It is not for kings, O Lemuel, it is not for kings để uống rượu nho; nor for princes strong drink:
Lest they drink, Và forget luật pháp, Và pervert the judgment of any of the afflicted. pervert: Heb. alter of any…: Heb. of all the sons of affliction
Give strong drink unto him that is ready to perish, Và wine unto those that be of heavy hearts. of…: Heb. bitter of soul
Let him drink, Và forget his poverty, Và remember his misery no more.
Open thy mouth for the dumb in the cause of all such as are appointed to destruction. such…: Heb. the sons of destruction
Open thy mouth, judge righteously, Và plead the cause of the poor Và needy.
Who can find a virtuous woman? for her price is far above rubies.
The heart of her husband doth safely trust in her, so that he shall have no need of spoil.
She will do him good Và not evil all the days of her sự sống.
She seeketh wool, Và flax, Và worketh willingly with her hands.
She is like the merchants' ships; she bringeth her food from afar.
She riseth also while it is yet night, Và giveth meat to her household, Và a portion to her maidens.
She considereth a field, Và buyeth it: with the fruit of her hands she planteth a vườn nho. buyeth: Heb. taketh
She girdeth her loins with strength, Và strengtheneth her arms.
She perceiveth that her merchandise is tốt: her candle goeth not out by night. She…: Heb. She tasteth
She layeth her hands to the spindle, Và her hands hold the distaff.
She stretcheth out her hand to the poor; yea, she reacheth forth her hands to the needy. She…: Heb. She spreadeth
She is not afraid of the snow for her household: for all her household are mặc with scarlet. scarlet: or, double garments
She maketh herself coverings of tapestry; her clothing is silk Và purple.
Her husband is known in the gates, when he sitteth among các trưởng lão of the land.
She maketh vải mịn, Và selleth it; Và delivereth girdles unto the merchant.
Strength Và honour are her clothing; Và she shall rejoice in time to come.
She openeth her mouth with wisdom; Và in her tongue is luật pháp of kindness.
She looketh well to the ways of her household, Và eateth not the bread of idleness.
Her children arise up, Và call her blessed; her husband also, Và he praiseth her.
Many daughters have done virtuously, but ngươi excellest them all. have…: or, have gotten riches
Favour is deceitful, Và beauty is vain: but một người đờn bà that feareth the CHÚA, she shall be praised.
Give her of the fruit of her hands; Và let her own works praise her in the gates.

div.title: ECCLESIASTES OR, THE PREACHER
div.chapter:
CHAPTER 1.
những lời of the Preacher, con trai của Đa-vít, vua in Giê-ru-sa-lem.
Vanity of vanities, nói the Preacher, vanity of vanities; all is vanity.
What profit hath a man of all his labour which he taketh under mặt trời?
One dòng dõi passeth away, and another dòng dõi đến: but đất abideth đến đời đời.
mặt trời also ariseth, Và mặt trời goeth down, Và hasteth to his place where he arose. hasteth: Heb. panteth
gió goeth toward the south, Và turneth about unto the north; it whirleth about continually, Và the wind returneth again according to his circuits.
All the rivers run into biển; yet biển is not full; unto the place from whence the rivers đến, thither they return again. return…: Heb. return to go
All things are full of labour; man không thể utter it: the eye is not satisfied with seeing, nor the ear filled with hearing.
The thing that hath been, it is that which shall be; and that which is done is that which shall be done: and there is no new thing under mặt trời.
Is there any thing whereof it may be nói, thấy, this is mới? it hath been already of old time, which was before us.
There is no remembrance of former things; neither shall there be any remembrance of things that are to come with those that shall come after.
I the Preacher was king over I-sơ-ra-ên in Giê-ru-sa-lem.
Và I gave my heart to seek Và search out by wisdom concerning all things that are done under heaven: this sore travail hath God given to the sons of man to be exercised therewith. to be…: or, to afflict them
I have seen all the works that are done under mặt trời; and, kìa, all is vanity Và vexation of spirit.
That which is crooked không thể be made straight: Và that which is wanting không thể be numbered. that which is wanting: Heb. defect
I communed with mine own heart, nói [rằng], Lo, I am come to great estate, Và have gotten more wisdom than all they that have been before me in Giê-ru-sa-lem: yea, my heart had great experience of wisdom Và knowledge. had…: Heb. had seen much
Và I gave my heart to know sự khôn ngoan, Và to know madness Và folly: I perceived that this also is vexation of spirit.
For in much sự khôn ngoan is much grief: Và he that increaseth sự hiểu biết increaseth sorrow.

CHAPTER 2.
Ta nói in mine heart, Go to now, I will prove ngươi with mirth, therefore enjoy pleasure: and, kìa, this also is hư không.
tôi nói of laughter, It is mad: Và of mirth, What làm it?
I sought in mine heart để cho myself unto wine, yet acquainting mine heart with wisdom; Và to lay hold on folly, till I might see what was that good for the sons of men, which they should do under the heaven all the days of their sự sống. để cho…: Heb. to draw my flesh with wine all…: Heb. the number of the days of their sự sống
I made me great works; I builded me houses; I planted me vườn nhos:
I made me gardens Và orchards, Và I planted trees in them of all kind of fruits:
I made me pools of water, to water therewith the wood that bringeth forth trees:
I got me các đầy tớ Và maidens, Và had servants born in my house; also I had great possessions of great Và small cattle above all that were in Giê-ru-sa-lem before me: servants born…: Heb. sons of my house
I gathered me also silver và vàng, Và the peculiar treasure of kings Và of the provinces: I gat me men singers Và women singers, Và the delights của các con of men, as musical instruments, and that of all sorts. musical…: Heb. musical instrument and instruments
So I was great, Và increased more than all that were before me in Giê-ru-sa-lem: also my wisdom remained with me.
Và bất cứ điều chi mine eyes desired I kept not from them, I withheld not my heart from any joy; for my heart rejoiced in all my labour: Và this was my portion of all my labour.
Then I looked on all the works that my hands had wrought, Và on the labour that I had laboured to do: and, kìa, all was hư không Và vexation of spirit, and there was no profit under mặt trời.
Và I turned myself to kìa sự khôn ngoan, Và madness, Và folly: for what can the man do that cometh after vua? even that which hath been already done. even…: or, in those things which have been already done
Then I saw that sự khôn ngoan excelleth folly, as far as light excelleth tối tăm. that…: Heb. that there is an excellency in wisdom more than in folly, etc
The wise man's mắt are in his head; but the fool walketh in darkness: Và I myself perceived also that one event happeneth to them all.
Rồi nói I in my heart, As it happeneth to the fool, so it happeneth even to me; Và why was I then more khôn ngoan? Then tôi nói in my heart, that this also is hư không. happeneth even…: Heb. happeneth to me, even to me
For there is no remembrance of the wise more than of the fool đến đời đời; seeing that which now is trong những ngày to come shall all be forgotten. Và how dieth the wise man? as the fool.
Therefore I hated sự sống; because the work that is wrought under mặt trời is grievous unto me: for all is hư không Và vexation of spirit.
Yea, I hated all my labour which I had taken under mặt trời: because I should leave it unto the man that shall be after me. taken: Heb. laboured
Và who knoweth whether he shall be a wise man or a fool? yet shall he have rule over all my labour wherein I have laboured, Và wherein I have shewed myself wise under mặt trời. This is also hư không.
Therefore I went about to cause my heart to despair of all the labour which I took under mặt trời.
For there is một người whose labour is in wisdom, Và in knowledge, Và in equity; yet to a man that hath not laboured therein shall he leave it for his portion. This also is hư không Và a great evil. leave: Heb. give
For what hath man of all his labour, Và of the vexation of his heart, wherein he hath laboured under mặt trời?
For all his days are sorrows, Và his travail grief; yea, his heart taketh not rest in the night. This is also hư không.
There is nothing better for a man, than that he should eat và uống, and that he should make his soul enjoy tốt in his labour. này also I saw, that it was from tay của ĐCT. should make…: or, delight his senses
For who can eat, or who else can hasten hereunto, more than I?
For God giveth to a man that is tốt in his sight sự khôn ngoan, Và knowledge, Và joy: but to the sinner he giveth travail, to gather Và to heap up, that he may give to him that is tốt before ĐCT. This also is hư không Và vexation of spirit. in his…: Heb. before him

CHAPTER 3.
To every thing there is a season, Và a time to every purpose under the heaven:
A time to be born, Và a time to die; a time to plant, Và a time to pluck up that which is trồng; to be…: Heb. to bear
A time để giết, Và a time to heal; a time to break down, Và a time to build up;
A time to weep, Và a time to laugh; a time to mourn, Và a time to dance;
A time to cast away stones, Và a time to gather stones together; a time to embrace, Và a time to refrain from embracing; to refrain from: Heb. to be far from
A time to get, Và a time to lose; a time to keep, Và a time to cast away; get: or, seek
A time to rend, Và a time to sew; a time to keep silence, Và a time to speak;
A time to love, Và a time to hate; a time of war, Và a time of peace.
What profit hath he that worketh in that wherein he laboureth?
I have seen the travail, which God hath given to the sons of men to be exercised in it.
He hath made every thing beautiful in his time: also he hath set thế gian in their heart, đến đổi không ai can find out the work that God maketh từ ban đầu to the end.
I know that there is no good in them, but for một người to rejoice, Và to do tốt in his sự sống.
Và also that every man should eat và uống, Và enjoy the good of all his labour, it is the gift của ĐCT.
I know that, bất cứ điều chi God làm, it shall be đến đời đời: nothing can be put to it, nor any thing taken from it: and God làm it, that men should fear before him.
That which hath been is now; Và that which is to be hath already been; and God requireth that which is past. that which is past: Heb. that which is driven away
Và moreover I saw under mặt trời the place of judgment, that wickedness was there; and the place of righteousness, that iniquity was there.
tôi nói in mine heart, ĐCT shall judge the righteous Và the wicked: for there is a time there for every purpose Và for every work.
tôi nói in mine heart concerning the estate của các con of men, that God might manifest them, and that they might see that they themselves are beasts. that God…: or, that they might clear God, and see, etc
For that which befalleth the sons of men befalleth beasts; even one thing befalleth them: as the one dieth, so dieth the other; yea, they have all one breath; so that a man hath no preeminence above a beast: for all is hư không.
All go unto one place; all are of the dust, Và all turn to dust again.
Who knoweth the spirit of man that goeth upward, Và the spirit of the beast that goeth downward to đất? of man: Heb. của Cons of man goeth upward: Heb. is ascending, etc
Wherefore I perceive that there is nothing better, than that a man should rejoice in his own works; for that is his portion: for who shall bring him to see what shall be after him?

CHAPTER 4.
So I returned, Và considered all the oppressions that are done under mặt trời: Và kìa the tears of such as were oppressed, Và they had no comforter; Và on the side of their oppressors there was power; but they had no comforter. side: Heb. hand
Wherefore I praised kẻ chết which are already dead more than the living which are yet alive.
Yea, better is he than both they, which hath not yet been, who hath not seen the evil work that is done under mặt trời.
Again, I considered all travail, và mãi mãiy right work, that for this a man is envied of his neighbour. This is also hư không Và vexation of spirit. every…: Heb. all the rightness of work for this…: Heb. this is the envy of a man from his neighbour
The fool foldeth his hands together, Và eateth his own flesh.
Better is an handful với quietness, than both tays full với travail Và vexation of spirit.
Then I returned, Và I saw hư không under mặt trời.
There is một alone, and there is not a second; yea, he hath neither child nor brother: yet is there no end of all his labour; neither is his eye satisfied with riches; neither nói he, For whom do I labour, Và bereave my soul of good? This is also hư không, yea, it is a sore travail.
hai are better than one; because they have a good phần thưởng for their labour.
For if they fall, the one will lift up his fellow: but woe to him that is alone when he falleth; for he hath not another to help him up.
Again, if two lie together, then they have heat: but how can one be warm alone?
Và if one prevail against him, two shall withstand him; and a threefold cord is not quickly broken.
Better is a poor Và a wise child than an old Và foolish vua, who will no more be admonished. who…: Heb. who knoweth not to be admonished
For out of prison he cometh to reign; whereas also he that is born in his kingdom becometh poor.
I considered all the living which walk under mặt trời, with the second child that shall stand up in his stead.
There is no end of all the people, even of all that have been before them: they also that come after shall not rejoice in him. Surely this also is hư không Và vexation of spirit.

CHAPTER 5.
Keep thy foot when ngươi goest đến nhà của ĐCT, Và be more ready to hear, than để cho the sacrifice of fools: for they consider not that they do evil.
Be not rash with thy mouth, Và let not thine heart be hasty to utter any thing before ĐCT: for God is in heaven, Và ngươi trên đất: therefore let thy words be few. thing: or, word
For a dream đến through đám đông of business; Và a fool's tiếng is known by multitude of words.
When ngươi vowest a vow unto God, defer not to pay it; for he hath no pleasure in fools: pay that which ngươi hast vowed.
Better is it that ngươi shouldest not vow, than that ngươi shouldest vow Và not pay.
Suffer not thy mouth to cause thy flesh to sin; neither say ngươi before thiên sứ, that it was an error: wherefore should God be angry at thy voice, Và destroy the work of thine hands?
For in đám đông of dreams Và many những lời there are also divers vanities: but fear ngươi God.
If ngươi seest the oppression of the poor, Và violent perverting of judgment Và justice in a province, marvel not at the matter: for he that is higher than the highest regardeth; and there be higher than they. at the…: Heb. at the will, or, purpose
Moreover the profit đất is for all: the king himself is served by the field.
He that loveth silver shall not be satisfied with silver; nor he that loveth abundance with increase: this is also hư không.
When goods increase, they are increased that eat them: and what good is there to the owners thereof, saving the beholding of them with their eyes?
The sleep of a labouring man is sweet, whether he eat little or much: but the abundance of the rich will not suffer him to sleep.
There is a sore evil which I have seen under mặt trời, namely, riches kept for the owners thereof to their hurt.
But those riches perish by evil travail: Và he begetteth một con trai, and there is nothing in his hand.
As he came forth of his mother's womb, lỏa lồ shall he return to go as he came, Và shall take nothing of his labour, which he may carry away in his hand.
Và this also is a sore evil, that in all points as he came, so shall he go: Và what profit hath he that hath laboured for the wind?
All his days also he eateth in darkness, and he hath much sorrow Và wrath with his sickness.
kìa that which I have seen: it is tốt Và comely for one to eat Và to drink, Và to enjoy the good of all his labour that he taketh under mặt trời all the days of his sự sống, which God giveth him: for it is his portion. it is good…: Heb. there is a good which is comely, etc all the days: Heb. the number of the days
Every man also to whom God hath given riches Và wealth, Và hath given him power to eat thereof, and to take his portion, Và to rejoice in his labour; này is the gift của ĐCT.
For he shall not much nhớ the days of his sự sống; because God answereth him in sự vui mừng of his heart. For…: or, Though he give not much, yet he remembereth, etc

CHAPTER 6.
There is an evil which I have seen under mặt trời, and it is common among men:
một người to whom God hath given riches, wealth, Và honour, so that he wanteth nothing for his soul of all that he desireth, yet God giveth him not power to eat thereof, but a stranger eateth it: this is hư không, and it is an evil disease.
If a man beget một trăm children, Và live many năm, so that the days of his years be many, Và his soul be not filled with good, and also that he have no burial; I say, that an untimely birth is better than he.
For he cometh in with hư không, Và departeth in darkness, Và his name shall be covered with darkness.
Moreover he hath not seen mặt trời, nor known any thing: này hath more rest than the other.
Yea, though he live một ngàn năm twice told, yet hath he seen no good: do not all go to one place?
All the labour of man is for his mouth, Và yet the appetite is not filled. appetite: Heb. soul
For what hath the wise more than the fool? what hath the poor, that knoweth to walk before the living?
Better is the sight of the eyes than the wandering of the desire: this is also hư không Và vexation of spirit. than…: Heb. than the walking of the soul
That which hath been is named already, Và it is known that it is man: neither may he contend with him that is mightier than he.
Seeing there be many things that increase hư không, what is man the better?
For who knoweth what is tốt for man in này sự sống, all the days of his vain sự sống which he spendeth as a shadow? for who can tell một người what shall be after him under mặt trời? all…: Heb. the number of the days of the sự sống of his hư không

CHAPTER 7.
A good name is better than precious ointment; Và the day of death than the day of one's birth.
It is better to go đến nhà of than khóc, than to go đến nhà of feasting: for that is the end of all men; Và the living will lay it to his heart.
Sorrow is better than laughter: for by the sadness of the countenance the heart is made better. Sorrow: or, Anger
The heart of the wise is in nhà of than khóc; but the heart of fools is in nhà of mirth.
It is better to hear the rebuke of the wise, than for a man to hear the song of fools.
For as the crackling of thorns under a pot, so is the laughter of the fool: this also is hư không. crackling: Heb. sound
Surely oppression maketh a wise man mad; Và a gift destroyeth the heart.
Better is the end of a thing than the beginning thereof: Và the patient in spirit is better than the proud in spirit.
Be not hasty in thy spirit to be angry: for anger resteth in the bosom of fools.
Say not thou, What is the cause that the former ngày were better than these? for ngươi dost not enquire wisely concerning this. wisely: Heb. out of wisdom
sự khôn ngoan is tốt with một cơ nghiệp: and by it there is profit to them that see mặt trời. good…: or, as good as một cơ nghiệp, yea, better too
For wisdom is a defence, Và tiền is a defence: but the excellency sự tri thức is, that sự khôn ngoan giveth sự sống to them that have it. defence: Heb. shadow
Consider the work của ĐCT: for who can make that thẳng, which he hath made crooked?
trong ngày of prosperity be joyful, but trong ngày of adversity consider: ĐCT also hath set the one over against the other, to the end that man should find nothing after him. set: Heb. made
All things have I seen trong những ngày of my hư không: there is a just man that perisheth in his righteousness, Và there is a wicked man that prolongeth his sự sống in his wickedness.
Be not righteous over much; neither make thyself over khôn ngoan: why shouldest ngươi destroy thyself? destroy…: Heb. be desolate?
Be not over much gian ác, neither be ngươi foolish: why shouldest ngươi die before thy time? before…: Heb. not in thy time?
It is tốt that ngươi shouldest take hold of this; yea, also from this withdraw not thine hand: for he that feareth ĐCT shall come forth of them all.
sự khôn ngoan strengtheneth the wise more than ten mighty men which are in the city.
For there is not a just man trên đất, that doeth tốt, Và sinneth not.
Also take no heed unto all words that are spoken; lest ngươi hear thy servant curse ngươi: take…: Heb. give not thine heart
For oftentimes also thine own heart biết that ngươi thyself cũng như vậy hast cursed Những người khác.
All this have I proved by wisdom: tôi nói, I will be wise; but it was far from me.
That which is far off, Và exceeding deep, who can find it out?
I applied mine heart to know, Và to search, Và to seek out sự khôn ngoan, Và the reason of things, Và to know the wickedness of folly, even of foolishness Và madness: I applied…: Heb. I and mine heart compassed
Và I find more bitter than death Người đờn bà, whose heart is snares Và nets, Và her hands as bands: whoso pleaseth ĐCT shall escape from her; but the sinner shall be taken by her. whoso…: Heb. he that is good before God
kìa, this have I found, nói the preacher, counting một by one, to find out the account: counting…: or, weighing one thing after another, to find out the reason
Which yet my soul seeketh, but I find not: one man among a thousand have I found; but một người đờn bà among all those have I not found.
Lo, this only have I found, that God hath made man upright; but they have sought out many inventions.

CHAPTER 8.
Who is as the wise man? Và who knoweth the interpretation of a thing? a man's sự khôn ngoan maketh his face to shine, Và the boldness of his face shall be changed. the boldness: Heb. the strength
I counsel ngươi to keep the king's mạng lệnh, and that in regard of the oath của ĐCT.
Be not hasty to go out of his sight: stand not in an evil thing; for he doeth bất cứ điều chi pleaseth him.
Where the word of a king is, there is power: Và who may say unto him, What doest thou?
Whoso keepeth the commandment shall feel no evil thing: Và a wise man's heart discerneth both time Và judgment. shall…: Heb. shall know
Because to every purpose there is time Và judgment, therefore the misery of man is great upon him.
For he knoweth not that which shall be: for who can tell him when it shall be? when…: or, how it shall be?
There is không ai that hath power over the spirit to retain the spirit; neither hath he power trong ngày of death: and there is no discharge in that war; neither shall wickedness deliver those that are given to it. discharge: or, casting off weapons
All this have I seen, Và applied my heart unto every work that is done under mặt trời: there is a time wherein one man ruleth over another to his own hurt.
Và so I saw the wicked buried, who had come Và gone from the place of the holy, Và they were forgotten in the city where they had so done: this is also hư không.
Because sentence against an evil work is not executed speedily, therefore the heart của các con of men is fully set in them to do evil.
Though a sinner do evil an hundred times, and his ngày be prolonged, yet surely I know that it shall be well with them that fear ĐCT, which fear before him:
But it shall not be well with the wicked, neither shall he prolong his ngày, which are as a shadow; because he feareth not before ĐCT.
There is a hư không which is done trên đất; that there be just men, unto whom it happeneth according to the work of the wicked; again, there be gian ác men, to whom it happeneth according to the work of the righteous: tôi nói that this also is hư không.
Then I commended mirth, because a man hath no better thing under mặt trời, than to eat, Và to drink, Và to be merry: for that shall abide with him of his labour the days of his sự sống, which God giveth him under mặt trời.
When I applied mine heart to know sự khôn ngoan, Và to see the business that is done trên đất: (for also there is that neither day nor night seeth sleep with his eyes:)
Then I beheld all the work của ĐCT, that a man không thể find out the work that is done under mặt trời: vì though một người labour to seek it out, yet he shall not find it; yea further; though a wise man think to know it, yet shall he not be able to find it.

CHAPTER 9.
For all this I considered in my heart even to declare all this, that the righteous, Và the wise, Và their works, are in tay của ĐCT: không ai biết either love or thù oán by all that is before them. I considered…: Heb. I gave, or, set to my heart
All things come alike to all: there is một event to the righteous, Và to the wicked; to the good Và to the clean, Và to the unclean; to him that sacrificeth, Và to him that sacrificeth not: as is the good, so is the sinner; Và he that sweareth, as he that feareth an oath.
This is an evil among all things that are done under mặt trời, that there is một event unto all: yea, also the heart của các con of men is full of evil, Và madness is in their heart while they live, Và after that they go to kẻ chết.
For to him that is joined to all the living there is hy vọng: for a living dog is better than a dead con sư tử.
For the living biết that they shall die: but kẻ chết biết not any thing, neither have they any more a reward; for the memory of them is forgotten.
Also their love, Và their thù oán, Và their envy, is now perished; neither have they any more a portion đến đời đời in any thing that is done under mặt trời.
Go thy way, ăn thy bread with joy, và uống thy wine with a merry heart; for God bây giờ accepteth thy works.
Let thy garments be always trắng; Và let thy head lack no ointment.
Live joyfully with the wife whom ngươi lovest all the days of the sự sống of thy hư không, which he hath given ngươi under mặt trời, all the days of thy hư không: for that is thy portion in này sự sống, Và in thy labour which ngươi takest under mặt trời. Live…: Heb. See, or, Enjoy sự sống
bất cứ điều chi thy hand tìm to do, do it with thy might; for there is no work, nor device, nor knowledge, nor wisdom, in the grave, whither ngươi goest.
I returned, Và saw under mặt trời, that the race is not to the swift, nor the battle to the strong, neither yet bread to the wise, nor yet riches to men of understanding, nor yet favour to men of skill; but time Và chance happeneth to them all.
For man also knoweth not his time: as the fishes that are taken in an evil net, Và as the birds that are caught in the snare; so are the sons of men snared in an evil time, when it falleth bất chợt upon them.
này sự khôn ngoan have I seen also under mặt trời, and it seemed great unto me:
There was a little city, Và few men within it; and there came a great vua against it, and besieged it, and built great bulwarks against it:
Now there was found in it a poor khôn ngoan man, Và he by his wisdom delivered thành; yet không ai nhớ lại that same poor man.
Then nói I, Wisdom is better than strength: nevertheless the poor man's sự khôn ngoan is despised, Và his words are not heard.
những lời of wise men are nghe in quiet more than the cry of him that ruleth among fools.
sự khôn ngoan is better than weapons of war: but one sinner destroyeth much tốt.

CHAPTER 10.
Dead flies cause the ointment of the apothecary to send forth a stinking savour: so doth a little folly him that is in reputation for wisdom Và honour. Dead…: Heb. Flies of death
A wise man's heart is at his tay phải; but a fool's heart at his left.
Yea also, when he that is a fool walketh by the way, his wisdom faileth him, Và he nói to every one that he is a fool. his…: Heb. his heart
If the spirit of the ruler rise up against ngươi, leave not thy place; for yielding pacifieth great offences.
There is an evil which I have seen under mặt trời, as an error which proceedeth từ the ruler: from: Heb. from before
Folly is set in great dignity, Và the rich sit in low place. in great…: Heb. in great heights
I have seen các đầy tớ upon horses, Và princes walking as servants trên đất.
He that diggeth a pit shall fall into it; and whoso breaketh an hedge, a serpent shall bite him.
Whoso removeth stones shall be hurt therewith; Và he that cleaveth wood shall be endangered thereby.
If the sắt be blunt, Và he do not whet the edge, then must he put to more strength: but wisdom is profitable to direct.
Surely con rắn will bite without enchantment; Và a babbler is no better. a babbler: Heb. the master of the tongue
những lời of a wise man's miệng are gracious; but the lips of a fool will swallow up himself. gracious: Heb. grace
ban đầu of the words of his mouth is foolishness: Và the end of his talk is mischievous madness. his talk: Heb. his mouth
A fool also is full of words: một người cannot tell what shall be; and what shall be after him, who can tell him? is full…: Heb. multiplieth words
The labour of the foolish wearieth every one of them, because he knoweth not how to go to the city.
Khốn thay to ngươi, O land, when thy king is a child, Và thy princes ăn in buổi sáng!
phước art thou, O land, when thy king is con trai of nobles, Và thy princes ăn in due season, for strength, Và not for drunkenness!
By much slothfulness the building decayeth; Và through idleness of tays nhà droppeth through.
A feast is made for laughter, Và wine maketh merry: but money answereth all things. maketh…: Heb. maketh glad the sự sống
Curse not the king, no not in thy thought; Và curse not the rich in thy bedchamber: for a bird trên trời shall carry tiếng, Và that which hath wings shall tell the matter. thought: or, conscience

CHAPTER 11.
Cast thy bread trên the waters: for ngươi shalt find it after many ngày. upon…: Heb. upon mặt of the waters
Give a portion to bảy, Và also to eight; for ngươi knowest not what evil shall be trên đất.
If đám mâys be full of rain, they empty themselves trên đất: Và if the tree fall toward the south, or toward the north, in the place where the tree falleth, there it shall be.
He that observeth gió shall not sow; Và he that regardeth đám mâys shall not reap.
As ngươi knowest not what is đường of the spirit, cũng không how the bones do grow in the womb of her that is with child: even so ngươi knowest not the works của ĐCT who maketh all.
In buổi sáng sow thy seed, Và in buổi chiều withhold not thine hand: for ngươi knowest not whether shall prosper, either this or that, or whether they both shall be alike tốt. shall prosper: Heb. shall be right
Truly the light is sweet, Và a pleasant thing it is for the eyes to kìa mặt trời:
But if a man live many năm, Và rejoice in them all; yet let him remember the days của sự tối tăm; for they shall be many. All that cometh is hư không.
Rejoice, O young man, in thy youth; Và let thy heart cheer ngươi trong những ngày of thy youth, Và walk in the ways of thine heart, Và in the sight of thine eyes: but know thou, that for all these things ĐCT will bring ngươi into judgment.
Therefore remove sorrow from thy heart, Và put away evil from thy flesh: for childhood Và youth are hư không. sorrow: or, anger

CHAPTER 12.
nhớ now thy Creator trong những ngày of thy youth, while the evil ngày đến not, nor the years draw nigh, when ngươi shalt say, I have no pleasure in them;
While mặt trời, or the light, or the moon, or ngôi saos, be not darkened, nor đám mâys return after mưa:
trong ngày when the keepers của nhà shall tremble, Và the strong men shall bow themselves, and the grinders cease because they are few, Và those that look out of the windows be darkened,the grinders…: or, the grinders fail, because they grind little
Và the doors shall be shut in the streets, when the sound of the grinding is low, Và he sẽ chổi dậy at the voice of the bird, Và all the daughters of musick shall be brought low;
Also khi they shall be afraid of that which is high, Và fears shall be in the way, Và the almond tree shall flourish, Và the grasshopper shall be a burden, Và desire shall fail: because man goeth to his long home, Và the mourners go about the streets:
Or ever the silver cord be loosed, or the golden bowl be broken, or the pitcher be broken at the fountain, or the wheel broken at the cistern.
Then shall the dust return to đất as it was: and the spirit shall return unto God who gave it.
hư không of vanities, nói the preacher; all is hư không.
Và moreover, because the preacher was wise, he still taught the people sự hiểu biết; yea, he gave good heed, Và sought out, Và set in order many proverbs. moreover…: or, the more wise the preacher was, etc
The preacher sought to find out acceptable những lời: and that which was written was upright, even những lời of truth. acceptable…: Heb. words of delight
những lời of the wise are as goads, Và as nails fastened by the masters of assemblies, which are given from one shepherd.
Và further, by these, my son, be admonished: of making many books there is no end; Và much study is a weariness of xác thịt. study: or, reading
Let us hear the conclusion of the whole matter: Fear ĐCT, Và keep his commandments: for this is the whole duty of man. Let…: or, The end of the matter, even all that hath been heard, is
For God shall bring every work into judgment, with every secret thing, whether it be tốt, or whether it be evil.

div.title: THE SONG OF Sa-lô-môn
div.chapter:
CHAPTER 1.
The song of songs, which is Sa-lô-môn's.
Let him kiss me with the kisses of his mouth: for thy love is better than wine. thy…: Heb. thy loves
Vì cớ the savour of thy good ointments Danh Ngài is as ointment poured forth, therefore do the virgins love ngươi.
Draw me, we will run after ngươi: the king hath brought me into his chambers: we will be glad Và rejoice in ngươi, we will remember thy love more than wine: the upright love ngươi. the upright…: or, they love ngươi uprightly
I là đen, but comely, O ye daughters of Giê-ru-sa-lem, as the tents of Kedar, as the curtains of Sa-lô-môn.
Look not upon me, because I là đen, because mặt trời hath looked upon me: my mother's children were angry with me; they made me the keeper of the vườn nhos; but mine own vườn nho have I not kept.
Tell me, O ngươi whom my soul loveth, where ngươi feedest, where ngươi makest thy flock to rest at noon: for why should I be as one that turneth aside by the flocks of thy companions? as one…: or, as one that is veiled
If ngươi know not, O ngươi fairest among women, go thy way forth by the footsteps of the flock, Và feed thy kids beside những người chăn chiên' tents.
I have compared ngươi, O my love, to a company of horses in của Pha-ra-ôn chariots.
Thy cheeks are comely with rows of jewels, thy neck with chains of gold.
We will make ngươi borders of gold with studs of silver.
While the king sitteth at his table, my spikenard sendeth forth the smell thereof.
A bundle of myrrh is my wellbeloved unto me; he shall lie all night betwixt my breasts.
My beloved is unto me as a cluster of camphire in the vườn nhos of En–gedi. camphire: or, cypress
kìa, thou art fair, my love; kìa, thou art fair; thou hast bồ câu' mắt. my love: or, my companion
kìa, thou art fair, my beloved, yea, pleasant: also our bed is green.
The beams of our house are cedar, Và our rafters of fir. rafters: or, galleries

CHAPTER 2.
I là the rose of Sharon, Và the lily of the valleys.
As the lily among thorns, so is my love among the daughters.
As the apple tree among the trees of the wood, so is my beloved among the sons. I sat down under his shadow with great delight, Và his fruit was sweet to my taste. I sat…: Heb. I delighted and ngồi xuống, etc taste: Heb. palate
He brought me to the banqueting nhà, Và his banner over me was love. banqueting…: Heb. house of wine
Stay me with flagons, comfort me with apples: for I là sick of love. comfort…: Heb. straw me with apples
His tay trái is under my head, Và his tay phải doth embrace me.
I charge you, O ye daughters of Giê-ru-sa-lem, by the roes, Và by the hinds of the field, that ye stir not up, nor awake my love, till he please. I charge…: Heb. I adjure you
tiếng of my beloved! kìa, he cometh leaping upon núis, skipping upon the hills.
My beloved is like a roe or a young hart: kìa, he standeth behind our wall, he looketh forth at the windows, shewing himself through the lattice. shewing…: Heb. flourishing
My beloved nói, và nói unto me, Rise up, my love, my fair one, Và come away.
For, lo, the winter is past, mưa is over Và gone;
The flowers appear on đất; the time of the singing of birds is come, Và the voice of the turtle is heard in our land;
cây vả putteth forth her green figs, Và the vines với the tender grape give a tốt smell. Hãy chổi dậy, my love, my fair one, Và come away.
O my dove, that art in the clefts of the rock, in the secret places of the stairs, let me see thy countenance, let me hear thy voice; for sweet is thy voice, Và thy countenance is comely.
Take us the foxes, the little foxes, that spoil the vines: for our vines have tender grapes.
My beloved is mine, and I là his: he feedeth among the lilies.
Until the day break, Và the shadows flee away, turn, my beloved, Và be ngươi like a roe or a young hart upon núis of Bether. of Bether: or, of division

CHAPTER 3.
By night on my bed I sought him whom my soul loveth: I sought him, but I found him not.
I will rise now, and go about thành in the streets, Và in the broad ways I will seek him whom my soul loveth: I sought him, but I found him not.
The watchmen that go about thành found me: to whom tôi nói, nhìn thấy ye him whom my soul loveth?
It was but a little that I passed from them, but I found him whom my soul loveth: I held him, and would not let him go, until I had brought him into my mother's nhà, Và into the chamber of her that conceived me.
I charge you, O ye daughters of Giê-ru-sa-lem, by the roes, Và by the hinds of the field, that ye stir not up, nor awake my love, till he please.
Who is this that cometh out of the wilderness like pillars of smoke, perfumed with myrrh Và trầm hương, with all powders of the merchant?
kìa his bed, which is Sa-lô-môn's; sáu mươi valiant men are about it, of the valiant của I-sơ-ra-ên.
They all hold những thanh gươm, being expert in war: every man hath his thanh gươm upon his thigh vì cớ fear in the night.
vua Sa-lô-môn made himself a chariot of the wood of Lebanon. a chariot: or, a bed
He made the pillars thereof of silver, the bottom thereof of gold, the covering of it of purple, the midst thereof being paved với love, for the daughters of Giê-ru-sa-lem.
Go forth, O ye daughters of Si-ôn, Và kìa vua Sa-lô-môn with the crown wherewith his mother crowned him trong ngày of his espousals, Và trong ngày of the gladness of his heart.

CHAPTER 4.
kìa, thou art fair, my love; kìa, thou art fair; thou hast bồ câu' mắt within thy locks: thy hair is as a flock of goats, that appear from mount Gilead. that…: or, that eat of, etc
Thy teeth are like a flock of sheep that are even shorn, which came up from the washing; whereof every one bear twins, and none is barren among them.
Thy lips are like a thread of scarlet, Và thy speech is comely: thy temples are like a piece of a pomegranate within thy locks.
Thy neck is like the tower của Đa-vít builded for an armoury, whereon there hang một ngàn bucklers, all shields of mighty men.
Thy two breasts are like two young roes that are twins, which feed among the lilies.
Until the day break, Và the shadows flee away, I will get me to núi of myrrh, Và to the hill of trầm hương. break: Heb. breathe
Thou art all fair, my love; there is no spot in ngươi.
đến with me from Lebanon, my spouse, with me from Lebanon: look from the top of Amana, from the top of Shenir Và Hermon, from the lions' dens, from núis of the leopards.
ngươi hast ravished my heart, my sister, my spouse; ngươi hast ravished my heart with one of thine eyes, with one chain of thy neck. ravished: or, taken away
How fair is thy love, my sister, my spouse! how much better is thy love than wine! Và the smell of thine ointments than all spices!
Thy lips, O my spouse, drop as the honeycomb: honey Và milk are under thy tongue; Và the smell of thy garments is like the smell of Lebanon.
một cái vườn inclosed is my sister, my spouse; a spring shut up, a fountain sealed. inclosed: Heb. barred shut up: Heb. barred
Thy plants are an orchard of pomegranates, with pleasant fruits; camphire, with spikenard,camphire: or, cypress
Spikenard Và saffron; calamus Và cinnamon, with all trees of trầm hương; myrrh Và aloes, with all the chief spices:
A fountain of gardens, a well of living waters, Và streams from Lebanon.
Awake, O north wind; Và come, ngươi south; blow upon my garden, that the spices thereof may flow out. Let my beloved đến into his garden, Và eat his pleasant fruits.

CHAPTER 5.
I am come into my garden, my sister, my spouse: I have gathered my myrrh with my spice; I have eaten my honeycomb with my honey; I have drunk my wine with my milk: ăn, O friends; uống, yea, drink abundantly, O beloved. yea…: or, and be drunken with loves
I sleep, but my heart waketh: it is tiếng of my beloved that knocketh, nói [rằng], Open to me, my sister, my love, my dove, my không ô uế: for my head is filled with dew, Và my locks with the drops of the night.
I have put off my coat; how shall I put it on? I have washed my feet; how shall I làm dơ dáy them?
My beloved put in his hand by the hole of the door, Và my bowels were moved for him. for him: or, (as some read) in me
I rose up to open to my beloved; Và my hands dropped với myrrh, Và my fingers với sweet smelling myrrh, upon tayles of the lock. sweet…: Heb. passing, or, running about
I opened to my beloved; but my beloved had withdrawn himself, Và was gone: my soul failed when he spake: I sought him, but I could not find him; I called him, but he gave me no answer.
The watchmen that went about thành found me, they smote me, they wounded me; the keepers of the walls took away my veil from me.
I charge you, O daughters of Giê-ru-sa-lem, if ye find my beloved, that ye tell him, that I là sick of love. that ye: Heb. what, etc
What is thy beloved more than another beloved, O ngươi fairest among women? what is thy beloved more than another beloved, that thou dost so charge us?
My beloved is trắng Và ruddy, the chiefest among ten thousand. the chiefest: Heb. a standard-bearer
His head is as the most fine gold, his locks are bushy, Và đen as a raven. bushy: or, curled
His eyes are as mắt of bồ câu by the rivers of waters, rửa with milk, Và fitly set. fitly…: Heb. sitting in fulness, that is, fitly placed, and set as a precious stone in the foil of a ring
His cheeks are as a bed of spices, as sweet flowers: his lips like lilies, dropping sweet smelling myrrh. sweet flowers: or, towers of perfumes
His hands are as gold rings set with the beryl: his belly is as bright ivory overlaid với sapphires.
His legs are as pillars of marble, set upon sockets of fine gold: his countenance is as Lebanon, excellent as the cedars.
His mouth is most sweet: yea, he is altogether lovely. This is my beloved, and this is my friend, O daughters of Giê-ru-sa-lem. mouth: Heb. palate

CHAPTER 6.
Whither is thy beloved gone, O ngươi fairest among women? whither is thy beloved turned aside? that we may seek him with ngươi.
My beloved is gone down into his garden, to the beds of spices, to feed in vườns, Và to gather lilies.
I là my beloved's, Và my beloved is mine: he feedeth among the lilies.
Thou art beautiful, O my love, as Tirzah, comely as Giê-ru-sa-lem, terrible as an army with banners.
Turn away thine eyes from me, for they have overcome me: thy hair is as a flock of goats that appear from Gilead. overcome…: or, puffed me up
Thy teeth are as a flock of sheep which go up from the washing, whereof every one beareth twins, and there is not one barren among them.
As a piece of a pomegranate are thy temples within thy locks.
There are sáu mươi queens, Và fourscore concubines, Và virgins without number.
My dove, my không ô uế is but một; she is the only một of her mother, she is the choice one of her that bare her. The daughters nhìn thấy her, and blessed her; yea, Nữ hoàngs Và the concubines, Và they praised her.
Who is she that looketh forth as buổi sáng, fair as the moon, clear as mặt trời, Và terrible as an army with banners?
I went down into vườn of nuts để xemthe fruits of the valley, Và để xemwhether the vine flourished, Và the pomegranates budded.
Or ever I was aware, my soul made me like the chariots of Amminadib. Or ever…: Heb. I knew not made…: or, set me on the chariots of my willing people
Return, return, O Shulamite; return, return, that we may look upon ngươi. What will ye see in the Shulamite? As it were the company of two armies. of…: or, of Mahanaim

CHAPTER 7.
How beautiful are thy feet with shoes, O prince's con gái! the joints of thy thighs are like jewels, the work of tays of a cunning workman.
Thy navel is like a round goblet, which wanteth not liquor: thy belly is like an heap of wheat set about with lilies. liquor: Heb. mixture
Thy two breasts are like two young roes that are twins.
Thy neck is as a tower of ivory; thine eyes like the fishpools in Heshbon, by cổng of Bath–rabbim: thy nose is as the tower of Lebanon which looketh toward Đa-mách.
Thine head upon ngươi is like Carmel, Và the hair of thine head like purple; vua is held in the galleries. Carmel: or, crimson held: Heb. bound
How fair Và how pleasant art thou, O love, for delights!
This thy stature is like to a palm tree, Và thy breasts to clusters of grapes.
tôi nói, I will go up to the palm tree, I will take hold of the boughs thereof: now also thy breasts shall be as clusters of the vine, Và the smell of thy nose like apples;
Và the roof of thy mouth like the best rượu nho for my beloved, that goeth down sweetly, causing the lips of those that are asleep to speak. sweetly: Heb. straightly of those…: or, of the ancient
I là my beloved's, Và his desire is toward me.
đến, my beloved, let us go forth into the field; let us lodge in làngs.
Let us get up early to the vườn nhos; let us see if the vine flourish, hoặc the tender grape appear, Và the pomegranates bud forth: there will I give ngươi my loves. appear: Heb. open
The mandrakes give a smell, Và at our gates are all manner of pleasant fruits, mới Và old, which I have laid up for ngươi, O my beloved.

CHAPTER 8.
O that thou wert as my brother, that sucked the breasts of my mother! khi I should find ngươi without, I would kiss ngươi; yea, I should not be despised. I should not…: Heb. they should not despise me
I would lead ngươi, Và bring ngươi into my mother's nhà, ai would instruct me: I would cause ngươi to drink of spiced rượu nho of the juice of my pomegranate.
His tay trái should be under my head, Và his tay phải should embrace me.
I charge you, O daughters of Giê-ru-sa-lem, that ye stir not up, nor awake my love, until he please. that…: Heb. why should ye stir up, or, why, etc
Who is this that cometh up from the wilderness, leaning upon her beloved? I raised ngươi up under the apple tree: there thy mother brought ngươi forth: there she brought ngươi forth that bare ngươi.
Set me as a seal upon thine heart, as a seal upon thine arm: for love is strong as death; jealousy is cruel as the grave: the coals thereof are coals lửa, which hath a most vehement flame. cruel: Heb. hard
Many waters không thể quench love, neither can the floods drown it: if a man would give all the substance of his house for love, it would utterly be contemned.
We have a little sister, Và she hath no breasts: what shall we do for our sister trong ngày when she shall be spoken for?
If she be a wall, we will build upon her a palace of silver: and if she be a door, we will inclose her with boards of cedar.
I là a wall, Và my breasts like towers: then was I in his eyes as one that found favour. favour: Heb. peace
Sa-lô-môn had a vườn nho at Baal–hamon; he let out the vườn nho unto keepers; every one for the fruit thereof was to bring một ngàn pieces of silver.
My vườn nho, which is mine, is before me: thou, O Sa-lô-môn, must have một ngàn, Và those that keep the fruit thereof two hundred.
ngươi that ởest in vườns, the companions hearken to thy voice: cause me to hear it.
Make haste, my beloved, Và be ngươi like to a roe or to a young hart upon núis of spices. Make…: Heb. Flee away

div.title: THE BOOK OF THE PROPHET ISAIAH
div.chapter:
CHAPTER 1.
The vision of Isaiah con trai of Amoz, which he saw concerning Giu-đa Và Giê-ru-sa-lem trong những ngày of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, Và Hezekiah, các vua của Giu-đa.
nghe, O heavens, Và give ear, O đất: for the CHÚA hath spoken, I have nourished Và brought up children, Và they have rebelled against me.
The ox biết his owner, Và the ass his master's crib: but I-sơ-ra-ên doth not know, my people doth not consider.
Ah tội lỗi nation, a people laden with iniquity, a seed of evildoers, children that are corrupters: they have forsaken the CHÚA, they have provoked the Holy One của I-sơ-ra-ên unto anger, they are gone away backward. laden: Heb. of heaviness gone…: Heb. alienated, or, separated
Tại sao should ye be stricken any more? ye will revolt more and more: the whole head is sick, Và the whole heart faint. revolt…: Heb. increase revolt
From the sole of the foot even unto the head there is no soundness in it; but wounds, Và bruises, Và putrifying sores: they have not been closed, neither bound up, neither mollified with ointment. ointment: or, oil
Your country is desolate, your cities are burned bằng lửa: your land, strangers devour it in your presence, and it is desolate, as overthrown by strangers. overthrown…: Heb. the overthrow of
Và con gái of Si-ôn is left as a cottage in a vườn nho, as a lodge in a garden of cucumbers, as a besieged city.
Except the CHÚA vạn quân had left unto us a very small remnant, we should have been as Sô-đôm, Và we should have been like unto Gô-mô-rơ.
nghe lời of the CHÚA, ye rulers of Sô-đôm; give ear unluật pháp of our God, ye people of Gô-mô-rơ.
To what purpose is đám đông of your sacrifices unto me? nói the CHÚA: I am full of the burnt offerings of rams, Và the fat of fed beasts; Và I delight not in the blood of bullocks, or of lambs, or of he goats. he goats: Heb. great he goats
When ye come to appear before me, who hath required this at your hand, to tread my courts? to appear: Heb. to be seen
Bring no more vain oblations; incense is an abomination unto me; the new moons Và sabbaths, the calling of assemblies, I cannot away with; it is iniquity, even the solemn meeting. iniquity: or, grief
Your new moons Và your appointed feasts my soul hateth: they are a trouble unto me; I am weary to bear họ.
Và when ye spread forth your hands, I will hide mine eyes from you: yea, when ye make many prayers, I will not hear: your hands are full of blood. make…: Heb. multiply prayer blood: Heb. bloods
rửa you, make you clean; put away the evil of your doings from before mine eyes; cease to do evil;
Learn to do well; seek judgment, relieve the oppressed, judge chaless, plead for the widow. relieve: or, righten
Come now, Và let us reason together, nói the CHÚA: though your tội lỗi be as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow; though they be red like crimson, they shall be as wool.
If ye be willing Và obedient, ngươi sẽ eat the good of the land:
But if ye refuse Và rebel, ngươi sẽ be devoured with thanh gươm: for the mouth of the CHÚA hath spoken it.
How is the faithful city become an harlot! it was full of judgment; righteousness lodged in it; but now murderers.
Thy silver is become dross, thy wine mixed with water:
Thy princes are rebellious, Và companions of thieves: every one loveth gifts, Và followeth after rewards: they judge not chaless, neither doth the cause of the widow đến với họ.
Therefore nói Chúa, the CHÚA vạn quân, the mighty One của I-sơ-ra-ên, Ah, I will ease me of mine adversaries, Và avenge me of mine enemies:
Và I will turn my hand upon ngươi, and purely purge away thy dross, Và take away all thy tin: purely: Heb. according to pureness
Và I will restore thy judges as at the first, Và thy counsellors as at the beginning: afterward ngươi shalt be called, thành of righteousness, the faithful city.
Si-ôn shall be redeemed with judgment, Và her converts with righteousness. her…: or, they that return of her
Và the destruction of the transgressors Và of the sinners shall be together, Và they that forsake the CHÚA shall be consumed. destruction: Heb. breaking
For they lấy làm hổ thẹn of the oaks which ye have desired, Và ngươi sẽ be confounded for vườns that ye have chosen.
For ngươi sẽ be as an oak whose leaf fadeth, Và as a garden that hath no water.
Và the strong shall be as tow, Và the maker of it as a spark, Và they shall both đốt together, Và none shall quench họ. maker…: or, and his work

CHAPTER 2.
lời that Isaiah con trai of Amoz nhìn thấy concerning Giu-đa Và Giê-ru-sa-lem.
Và it shall come to pass in cuối cùng ngày, that núi of the Lord's nhà shall be established in the top of núis, Và shall be exalted above the hills; Và all nations shall flow unto it. established: or, prepared
Và many people shall go Và say, đến ye, and let us go up to núi of the CHÚA, đến nhà of ĐCT of Gia-cốp; Và he will teach us of his ways, Và we will walk in his paths: for out of Si-ôn shall go forth luật pháp, Và the word of the CHÚA from Giê-ru-sa-lem.
Và he shall judge among the nations, Và shall rebuke many people: Và they shall beat their những thanh gươm into plowshares, Và their spears into pruninghooks: nation shall not lift up thanh gươm against nation, neither shall they learn war any more. pruninghooks: or, scythes
O house of Gia-cốp, đến ye, and let us walk in the light of the CHÚA.
Therefore ngươi hast forsaken thy people nhà of Gia-cốp, because they be replenished from the east, and are soothsayers like the Philistines, Và they please themselves in the children of strangers. from…: or, more than the please…: or, abound with the
Their land also is full of silver và vàng, neither is there any end of their treasures; their land is also full of horses, neither is there any end of their chariots:
Their land also is full of idols; they worship the work of their own hands, that which their own fingers have made:
Và the mean man boweth down, Và the great man humbleth himself: therefore forgive them not.
Enter into the rock, Và hide ngươi in the dust, for fear of the CHÚA, Và for sự vinh hiển of his majesty.
The lofty looks of man shall be humbled, Và the haughtiness of men shall be bowed down, Và the CHÚA alone shall be exalted trong ngày đó.
For the day of the CHÚA vạn quân shall be upon every one that is proud Và lofty, and upon every one that is lifted up; Và he shall be brought low:
Và upon all the cedars of Lebanon, that are high Và lifted up, Và upon all the oaks of Bashan,
Và upon all the high mountains, Và upon all the hills that are lifted up,
Và upon every high tower, Và upon every fenced wall,
Và upon all the ships of Tarshish, Và upon all pleasant pictures. pleasant…: Heb. pictures of desire
Và the loftiness of man shall be bowed down, Và the haughtiness of men shall be made low: Và the CHÚA alone shall be exalted trong ngày đó.
Và the idols he shall utterly abolish. he…: or, shall utterly pass away
Và they shall go into the holes of the rocks, Và into the caves đất, for fear of the CHÚA, Và for sự vinh hiển of his majesty, when he ariseth to shake terribly đất. đất: Heb. of the dust
In that day một người shall cast his idols of silver, Và his idols of gold, which they made each one for himself để thờ phượng, to the moles Và to the bats; his idols of silver…: Heb. the idols of his silver, etc each…: or, for him
To go into the clefts of the rocks, Và into the tops of the ragged rocks, for fear of the CHÚA, Và for sự vinh hiển of his majesty, when he ariseth to shake terribly đất.
Cease ye from man, whose breath is in his nostrils: for wherein is he to be accounted of?

CHAPTER 3.
For, kìa, the Lord, the CHÚA vạn quân, doth take away from Giê-ru-sa-lem Và from Giu-đa the stay Và the staff, the whole stay of bread, Và the whole stay of water,
The mighty man, Và the man of war, the judge, Và the prophet, Và the prudent, Và the ancient,
The captain of fifty, Và the honourable man, Và the counsellor, Và the cunning artificer, Và the eloquent orator. the honourable…: Heb. a man eminent in countenance eloquent…: or, skilful of speech
Và I will give children to be their princes, Và babes shall rule over them.
Và the people shall be oppressed, every one by another, và mãi mãiy one by his neighbour: the child shall behave himself proudly against the ancient, Và the base against the honourable.
When a man shall take hold of his brother của nhà of his father, nói [rằng], ngươi hast clothing, be ngươi our ruler, and let this ruin be under thy hand:
In that day shall he swear, nói [rằng], I will not be an healer; for in my house is neither bread nor clothing: make me not a ruler của dân sự. swear: Heb. lift up tay healer: Heb. binder up
For Giê-ru-sa-lem is ruined, Và Giu-đa is fallen: because their tongue Và their doings are against the CHÚA, to provoke mắt of his glory.
The shew of their countenance doth witness against them; Và they declare their sin as Sô-đôm, they hide it not. Woe unto their soul! for they have rewarded evil với họselves.
Say ye to the righteous, that it shall be well with him: for they shall eat the fruit of their doings.
Khốn thay unto the wicked! it shall be ill with him: for the reward of his hands shall be given him. given…: Heb. done to him
As for my people, children are their oppressors, Và women rule over them. O my people, they which lead ngươi cause ngươi to err, Và destroy đường of thy paths. lead…: or, call ngươi blessed destroy: Heb. swallow up
The CHÚA standeth up to plead, Và standeth to judge the people.
The CHÚA will enter into judgment with the ancients of his people, Và the princes thereof: for ye have eaten up the vườn nho; the spoil of the poor is in your houses. eaten: or, burnt
What mean ye that ye beat my people to pieces, Và grind mặts of the poor? nói Chúa
God vạn quân.
Moreover the CHÚA nói, Bởi vì the daughters of Si-ôn are haughty, Và walk with stretched forth necks Và wanton mắt, walking Và mincing as they go, Và making a tinkling with their feet: wanton…: Heb. deceiving with their eyes mincing: or, tripping nicely
Therefore the Lord will smite with a scab the crown of the head of the daughters of Si-ôn, Và the CHÚA will discover their secret parts. discover: Heb. make naked
In that day Chúa will take away the bravery of their tinkling ornaments about their feet, and their cauls, and their round tires like the moon,cauls: or, networks
The chains, Và the bracelets, Và the mufflers,chains: or, sweet balls mufflers: or, spangled ornaments
The bonnets, Và the ornaments of the legs, Và the headbands, Và the tablets, Và the earrings,tablets: Heb. houses of the soul
The rings, Và nose jewels,
The changeable suits of apparel, Và the mantles, Và the wimples, Và the crisping pins,
The glasses, Và the fine linen, Và the hoods, Và the vails.
Và it shall come to pass, that instead of sweet smell there shall be stink; Và instead of a girdle a rent; Và instead of well set hair baldness; Và instead of a stomacher a girding of vải bố; Và burning instead of beauty.
Thy men shall fall by thanh gươm, Và thy mighty in the war. mighty: Heb. might
Và her gates shall lament Và mourn; and she being desolate shall sit upon the ground. desolate: or, emptied: Heb. cleansed

CHAPTER 4.
Và in that day bảy women shall take hold of one man, nói [rằng], We will eat our own bread, Và wear our own apparel: only let us be called by Danh Ngài, to take away our reproach. let…: Heb. let Danh Ngài be called upon us to take…: or, take ngươi away
In that day shall the branch of the CHÚA be beautiful Và glorious, Và the fruit đất shall be excellent Và comely for them that are escaped của I-sơ-ra-ên. beautiful…: Heb. beauty and glory them…: Heb. the escaping
Và it shall come to pass, that he that is left in Si-ôn, and he that remaineth in Giê-ru-sa-lem, shall be called thánh, even every one that is written among the living in Giê-ru-sa-lem: among…: or, to sự sống
When the Lord shall have washed away the filth of the daughters of Si-ôn, Và shall have purged the blood of Giê-ru-sa-lem from the midst thereof by the spirit of judgment, Và by the spirit of burning.
Và the CHÚA will create upon every ởing place of mount Si-ôn, Và upon her assemblies, a cloud Và smoke by day, Và the shining of a flaming lửa by night: for upon all sự vinh hiển shall be a defence. upon all: or, above all defence: Heb. covering
Và there shall be a tabernacle for a shadow trong ngàytime from the heat, Và for một chỗ of refuge, Và for a covert from storm Và from rain.

CHAPTER 5.
Now will I sing to my wellbeloved Bài hát of my beloved touching his vườn nho. My wellbeloved hath a vườn nho in a very fruitful đồi: a very…: Heb. the horn của Con of oil
Và he fenced it, and gathered out the stones thereof, and planted it with the choicest vine, Và built a tower in the midst of it, and also made a winepress therein: and he looked that it should bring forth grapes, Và it brought forth wild grapes. fenced: or, made a wall about made: Heb. hewed
Và now, O inhabitants of Giê-ru-sa-lem, Và men của Giu-đa, judge, I pray you, betwixt me and my vườn nho.
What could have been done more to my vườn nho, that I have not done in it? wherefore, when I looked that it should bring forth grapes, brought it forth wild grapes?
Và now go to; I will tell you what I will do to my vườn nho: I will take away the hedge thereof, and it shall be eaten up; Và break down the wall thereof, and it shall be trodden down: trodden…: Heb. for a treading
Và I will lay it waste: it shall not be pruned, nor digged; but there shall come up briers Và thorns: I will also command đám mâys that they rain no rain upon it.
For the vườn nho of the CHÚA vạn quân is nhà của I-sơ-ra-ên, Và the men của Giu-đa his pleasant plant: Và he looked for judgment, but kìa oppression; for righteousness, but kìa a cry. his…: Heb. plant of his pleasures oppression: Heb. a scab
Khốn thay với họ that join nhà to house, that lay field to field, till there be no place, that they may be placed alone in the midst đất!they: Heb. ye
In mine ears nói the CHÚA vạn quân, Of a truth many houses shall be desolate, even great Và fair, without inhabitant. In…: or, This is in mine ears, nói the CHÚA, etc Of a…: Heb. If not, etc
Yea, mười acres of vườn nho shall yield một bath, Và the seed of an homer shall yield an ephah.
Khốn thay với họ that rise up early in buổi sáng, that they may follow strong drink; that continue until night, till rượu nho inflame them!inflame: of, pursue
Và the harp, Và the viol, the tabret, Và pipe, Và wine, are in their feasts: but they regard not the work of the CHÚA, neither consider the operation of his hands.
Therefore my people are gone into captivity, because they have no knowledge: Và their honourable men are famished, Và their multitude dried up with thirst. honourable…: Heb. glory are men of famine
Therefore hell hath enlarged herself, Và opened her mouth without measure: Và their glory, Và their multitude, Và their pomp, Và he that mừng vui, shall descend into it.
Và the mean man shall be brought down, Và the mighty man shall be humbled, Và the eyes of the lofty shall be humbled:
But the CHÚA vạn quân shall be exalted in judgment, Và ĐCT that is holy shall be sanctified in righteousness. God…: or, the holy God: Heb. the God the holy
Then shall the lambs feed after their manner, Và the waste places of the fat ones shall strangers ăn.
Khốn thay với họ that draw iniquity with cords of hư không, Và sin as it were with a cart rope:
That say, Let him make speed, Và hasten his work, that we may see it: Và let the counsel of the Holy One của I-sơ-ra-ên draw nigh Và come, that we may know it!
Khốn thay với họ that call evil tốt, Và good evil; that put tối tăm for light, Và light for darkness; that put bitter for sweet, Và sweet for bitter!call…: Heb. say concerning evil, It is good, etc
Khốn thay unto them that are khôn ngoan in their own eyes, Và prudent in their own sight!in their own sight: Heb. before their face
Khốn thay unto them that are mighty để uống rượu nho, Và men of strength to mingle strong drink:
Which justify the wicked for phần thưởng, Và take away the righteousness of the righteous from him!
Therefore as the fire devoureth the stubble, Và the flame consumeth the chaff, so their root shall be as rottenness, Và their blossom shall go up as dust: because they have cast away luật pháp of the CHÚA vạn quân, Và despised lời of the Holy One của I-sơ-ra-ên. fire: Heb. tongue of fire
Therefore is the anger of the CHÚA kindled against his people, Và he hath stretched forth his hand against them, and hath smitten them: and the hills did tremble, Và their carcases were torn in the midst of the streets. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still. torn: or, as dung
Và he will lift up an ensign to the nations from far, Và will hiss với họ from the end đất: and, kìa, they shall come with speed swiftly:
None shall be weary nor stumble among them; none shall slumber nor sleep; neither shall the girdle of their loins be loosed, nor the latchet of their shoes be broken:
Whose arrows are sharp, Và all their bows bent, their horses' hoofs shall be counted like flint, Và their wheels like a whirlwind:
Their roaring shall be like a lion, they shall roar like young lions: yea, they shall roar, Và lay hold of the prey, and shall carry it away safe, Và none shall deliver it.
Và in that day they shall roar against them like the roaring of biển: and if one look unto the land, kìa darkness Và sorrow, Và the light is darkened in the heavens thereof. sorrow: or, distress Và the light…: or, when it is light, it shall be dark in the destructions thereof

CHAPTER 6.
In the year that king Uzziah chết I saw also Chúa sitting upon a throne, high Và lifted up, Và his train filled đền thờ. his…: or, the skirts thereof
Above it stood the seraphims: each one had six wings; with twain he covered his face, Và with twain he covered his feet, Và with twain he did fly.
Và one cried unto another, and nói, thánh, thánh, thánh, is the CHÚA vạn quân: the whole đất is full of his glory. one…: Heb. this cried to this the whole…: Heb. his glory is the fulness of the whole đất
Và the posts of the door moved at the voice of him that cried, Và nhà was filled with smoke. door: Heb. thresholds
Then nói I, Woe is me! for I am undone; because I là một người of unclean lips, Và I ở in the midst of a people of unclean lips: for mine eyes have seen the King, the CHÚA vạn quân. undone: Heb. cut off
Then flew một of the seraphims unto me, having a live coal in his hand, which he had taken with the tongs from off the altar: having…: Heb. and in his hand a live coal
Và he laid it upon my mouth, và nói, Lo, this hath touched thy lips; Và thine iniquity is taken away, Và thy sin purged. laid…: Heb. caused it to touch
Also I heard tiếng của ĐCT, nói [rằng], Whom shall I send, Và who will go for us? Then nói I, Here là I; send me. Here…: Heb. kìa me
