The whole đất is at rest, Và is quiet: they break forth into singing.
Yea, the fir trees rejoice at ngươi, Và the cedars of Lebanon, nói [rằng], Since ngươi art laid down, no feller is come up against us.
Hell from beneath is moved for ngươi to meet ngươi at thy coming: it stirreth up kẻ chết for ngươi, even all the chief ones đất; it hath raised up from their thrones tất cả các vua of the nations. Hell: or, The grave chief…: Heb. leaders, or, great goats
All they shall speak Và say unto ngươi, Art ngươi also become weak as we? art ngươi become like unto us?
Thy pomp is brought down to the grave, Và the noise of thy viols: the worm is spread under ngươi, and the worms cover ngươi.
How art ngươi fallen from heaven, O Lucifer, son of buổi sáng! how art ngươi cut down to the ground, which didst weaken the nations!O Lucifer: or, O day star
For ngươi hast nói in thine heart, I will ascend into heaven, I will exalt my throne above ngôi saos của ĐCT: I will sit also upon the mount of the congregation, in the sides of the north:
I will ascend above the heights of đám mâys; I will be like the most High.
Yet ngươi shalt be brought down to hell, to the sides of the pit.
They that see ngươi shall narrowly look upon ngươi, Và consider ngươi, saying, Is this the man that made đất to tremble, that did shake kingdoms;
That made thế gian as a wilderness, Và destroyed the cities thereof; that mở not nhà of his prisoners? opened…: or, did not let his prisoners loose homeward?
tất cả các vua of the nations, even all of them, lie in glory, every one in his own house.
But ngươi art cast out of thy grave like an abominable branch, Và as the raiment of those that are slain, thrust through with a thanh gươm, that go down to the stones of the pit; as a carcase trodden under feet.
ngươi shalt not be joined with them in burial, because ngươi hast destroyed thy land, Và slain thy people: the seed of evildoers shall never be renowned.
Prepare slaughter for his children for the iniquity of their fathers; that they do not rise, nor possess the land, nor fill mặt of the world with cities.
For I will rise up against them, nói the CHÚA vạn quân, Và cut off from Ba-by-lôn Tên, Và remnant, Và son, Và nephew, nói the CHÚA.
I will also make it a possession for the bittern, Và pools of water: Và I will sweep it with the besom of destruction, nói the CHÚA vạn quân.
The CHÚA vạn quân hath sworn, nói [rằng], Surely as I have thought, so shall it come to pass; and as I have purposed, so shall it stand:
That I will break the Assyrian in my land, Và upon my mountains tread him under foot: then shall his yoke depart from off them, and his burden depart from off their shoulders.
This is the purpose that is purposed upon the whole đất: and this is tay that is stretched out upon all the nations.
For the CHÚA vạn quân hath purposed, Và who shall disannul it? Và his hand is stretched out, Và who shall turn it back?
In the year that king Ahaz chết was this burden.
Rejoice not thou, whole Palestina, because the rod of him that smote ngươi is broken: for out of con rắn's root shall come forth a cockatrice, Và his fruit shall be a fiery flying con rắn. cockatrice: or, adder
Và the firstborn of the poor shall feed, Và the needy shall lie down in safety: Và I will kill thy root with famine, Và he shall slay thy remnant.
Howl, O gate; cry, O city; thou, whole Palestina, art dissolved: for there shall come from the north a smoke, and none shall be alone in his appointed times. none…: or, he shall not be alone appointed…: or, assemblies
What shall one then answer the messengers of the nation? That the CHÚA hath founded Si-ôn, Và the poor of his people shall trust in it. trust…: or, betake themselves unto it

CHAPTER 15.
The burden of Mô-áp. Because in the night Ar of Mô-áp is laid waste, Và brought to silence; because in the night Kir of Mô-áp is laid waste, Và brought to silence; brought…: or, cut off
He is gone up to Bajith, Và to Dibon, the high places, to weep: Mô-áp shall howl over Nebo, Và over Medeba: on all their heads shall be baldness, Và every beard cut off.
In their streets they shall gird themselves with vải bố: on the tops of their houses, and in their streets, every one shall howl, khóc lóc abundantly. weeping…: Heb. descending into weeping, or, coming down with weeping
Và Heshbon shall cry, Và Elealeh: their voice shall be heard even unto Jahaz: therefore the armed soldiers of Mô-áp shall cry out; his sự sống shall be grievous unto him.
My heart shall cry out for Mô-áp; his fugitives shall flee unto Zoar, an heifer of three tuổi: for by the mounting up of Luhith with weeping shall they go it up; for in the way of Horonaim they shall raise up a cry of destruction. his…: or, to the borders thereof, even to Zoar, as an heifer destruction: Heb. breaking
For the waters of Nimrim shall be desolate: for the hay is withered away, the grass faileth, there is no green thing. desolate: Heb. desolations
Therefore the abundance they have gotten, Và that which they have laid up, shall they carry away to the brook of the willows. brook…: or, valley of the Arabians
For the cry is gone round about the borders of Mô-áp; the howling thereof unto Eglaim, Và the howling thereof unto Beer–elim.
For the waters of Dimon shall be full of blood: for I will bring more upon Dimon, lions upon him that escapeth of Mô-áp, Và upon the remnant of the land. more: Heb. additions

CHAPTER 16.
Send ye the lamb to the ruler of the land from Sela to the wilderness, unto the mount of con gái of Si-ôn. Sela: or, Petra: Heb. A rock
For it shall be, that, as a wandering bird cast out of the nest, so the daughters of Mô-áp shall be at the fords of Arnon. cast…: or, a nest forsaken
Take counsel, execute judgment; make thy shadow as the night in the midst of the noonday; hide the outcasts; bewray not him that wandereth. Take: Heb. Bring
Let mine outcasts ở with ngươi, Mô-áp; be ngươi a covert to them from mặt of the spoiler: for the extortioner is at an end, the spoiler ceaseth, the oppressors are consumed out of the land. extortioner: Heb. wringer the oppressors: Heb. the treaders down
Và in mercy shall the throne be established: Và he shall sit upon it in truth in đền tạm của Đa-vít, judging, Và seeking judgment, Và hasting righteousness. established: or, prepared
We have heard of the pride of Mô-áp; he is very proud: even of his haughtiness, Và his pride, Và his wrath: but his lies shall not be so.
Therefore shall Mô-áp howl for Mô-áp, every one shall howl: for the foundations of Kir–hareseth shall ye mourn; surely họ là stricken. mourn: or, mutter
For the fields of Heshbon languish, Và the vine of Sibmah: the lords of the heathen have broken down the principal plants thereof, they are come even unto Jazer, they wandered through đồng vắng: her branches are stretched out, they are gone over biển. stretched…: or, plucked up
Therefore I will bewail with the weeping of Jazer the vine of Sibmah: I will water ngươi with my tears, O Heshbon, Và Elealeh: for the shouting for thy summer fruits Và for thy harvest is fallen. the shouting…: or, the alarm is fallen upon, etc
Và gladness is taken away, Và joy out of the plentiful field; Và in the vườn nhos there shall be no singing, neither shall there be shouting: the treaders shall tread out no wine in their presses; I have made their vintage shouting to cease.
Wherefore my bowels shall sound like an harp for Mô-áp, Và mine inward parts for Kir–haresh.
Và it shall come to pass, when it is seen that Mô-áp is weary on the high place, that he shall come to his sanctuary to pray; but he shall not prevail.
This is lời that the CHÚA hath spoken concerning Mô-áp since that time.
But now the CHÚA hath spoken, nói [rằng], Within three năm, as the years of an hireling, Và sự vinh hiển of Mô-áp shall be contemned, with all that great multitude; Và the remnant shall be very small Và feeble. feeble: or, not many

CHAPTER 17.
The burden of Đa-mách. kìa, Đa-mách is taken away from being a city, Và it shall be a ruinous heap.
The cities of Aroer are forsaken: they shall be for flocks, which shall lie down, and none shall make họ afraid.
The fortress also shall cease from Ephraim, Và the kingdom from Đa-mách, Và the remnant of Si-ri: they shall be as sự vinh hiển of the children của I-sơ-ra-ên, nói the CHÚA vạn quân.
Và in that day it shall come to pass, that sự vinh hiển of Gia-cốp shall be made thin, Và the fatness of his flesh shall wax lean.
Và it shall be as when mùa gặtman gathereth the corn, Và reapeth the ears with his arm; Và it shall be as he that gathereth ears in the valley of Rephaim.
Yet gleaning grapes shall be left in it, as the shaking of an olive tree, hai or ba berries in the top of the uppermost bough, bốn or năm in the outmost fruitful branches thereof, nói the CHÚA ĐCT của I-sơ-ra-ên.
At that day shall a man look to his Maker, Và his eyes shall have respect to the Holy One của I-sơ-ra-ên.
Và he shall not look to the altars, the work of his hands, neither shall respect that which his fingers have made, either the groves, or the images. images: or, sun images
In that day shall his strong các thành be as a forsaken bough, Và an uppermost branch, which they left vì of the children của I-sơ-ra-ên: Và there shall be desolation.
Because ngươi hast forgotten ĐCT of sự cứu rỗi của Ngài, Và hast not been mindful of the rock of thy strength, therefore shalt ngươi plant pleasant plants, Và shalt set it with strange slips:
trong ngày shalt ngươi make thy plant to grow, Và in buổi sáng shalt ngươi make thy seed to flourish: but mùa gặt shall be a heap trong ngày of grief Và of desperate sorrow. a heap…: or, removed trong ngày of inheritance, and there shall be deadly sorrow
Khốn thay to đám đông of many people, which make a noise like the noise of biểns; Và to the rushing of nations, that make a rushing like the rushing of mighty waters!multitude: or, noise mighty: or, many
The nations shall rush like the rushing of many waters: but God shall rebuke them, and they shall flee far off, Và shall be chased as the chaff of núis before gió, Và like a rolling thing before the whirlwind. a rolling…: or, thistledown
Và kìa at eveningtide trouble; Và before buổi sáng he is not. This is the portion of them that spoil us, and the lot of them that rob us.

CHAPTER 18.
Khốn thay to the land shadowing with wings, which is bên kia the rivers of Ethiopia:
That sendeth ambassadors by biển, even in vessels of bulrushes trên the waters, nói [rằng], đi, ye swift messengers, to a nation scattered Và peeled, to a people terrible from their beginning hitherto; a nation meted out Và trodden down, whose land the rivers have spoiled!scattered…: or, outspread and polished meted…: or, that meteth out and treadeth down: Heb. of line, line, and treading under foot have…: or, despise
All ye inhabitants of the world, Và ởers on đất, thấy ye, when he lifteth up an ensign on núis; Và when he bloweth a trumpet, nghe ye.
For so the CHÚA nói unto me, I will take my rest, Và I will consider in my ởing place like a clear heat upon herbs, Và like a cloud of dew in the heat of harvest. consider…: or, regard my set ởing upon…: or, after rain
For afore mùa gặt, when the bud is perfect, Và the sour grape is ripening in the flower, he shall both cut off the sprigs with pruning hooks, Và take away Và cut down the branches.
They shall be left together unto the fowls of núis, Và to the beasts đất: Và the fowls shall summer upon them, and all the beasts đất shall winter upon them.
In that time shall the present be brought unto the CHÚA vạn quân of a people scattered Và peeled, Và from a people terrible from their beginning hitherto; a nation meted out Và trodden under foot, whose land the rivers have spoiled, to the place of Tên of the CHÚA vạn quân, the mount Si-ôn. scattered…: or, outspread and polished

CHAPTER 19.
The burden of Ai-Cập. kìa, the CHÚA rideth upon a swift cloud, Và shall come into Ai-Cập: Và the idols of Ai-Cập shall be moved at his presence, Và the heart of Ai-Cập shall melt in the midst of it.
Và I will set người Ê-díp-tô against người Ê-díp-tô: Và they shall fight every one against his brother, và mãi mãiy one against his neighbour; city against city, Và kingdom against kingdom. set: Heb. mingle
Và the spirit of Ai-Cập shall fail in the midst thereof; and I will destroy the counsel thereof: and they sẽ thấy to the idols, Và to the charmers, Và to them that have familiar spirits, Và to the wizards. fail: Heb. be emptied destroy: Heb. swallow up
Và người Ê-díp-tô will I give over into tay of a cruel lord; Và a fierce vua shall rule over them, nói Chúa, the CHÚA vạn quân. give…: or, shut up
Và the waters shall fail from biển, Và the river shall be wasted Và dried up.
Và they shall turn the rivers far away; Và the brooks of defence shall be emptied Và dried up: the reeds Và flags shall wither.
The paper reeds by the brooks, by the mouth of the brooks, và mãi mãiy thing sown by the brooks, shall wither, be driven away, and be no more. Và be…: Heb. and shall not be
The fishers also shall mourn, Và all they that cast angle into the brooks shall lament, Và they that spread nets trên the waters shall languish.
Moreover they that work in fine flax, Và they that weave networks, shall be confounded. networks: or, white works
Và they shall be broken in the purposes thereof, all that make sluices Và ponds for fish. purposes: Heb. foundations for fish: Heb. of living things
Surely the princes of Zoan are fools, the counsel of the wise counsellors of Pha-ra-ôn is become brutish: how say ye unto Pha-ra-ôn, I là con trai of the wise, con trai of ancient các vua?
Where are they? where are thy wise men? Và let them tell ngươi now, and let them know what the CHÚA vạn quân hath purposed upon Ai-Cập.
The princes of Zoan are become fools, the princes of Noph are deceived; they have also seduced Ai-Cập, even they that are the stay of the tribes thereof. they that…: or, governors: Heb. corners
The CHÚA hath mingled a perverse spirit in the midst thereof: and they have caused Ai-Cập to err in every work thereof, as a drunken man staggereth in his vomit. a perverse…: Heb. a spirit of perversities
Neither shall there be any work for Ai-Cập, which the head or tail, branch or rush, may do.
In that day shall Ai-Cập be like unto women: Và it shall be afraid Và fear vì of the shaking of tay of the CHÚA vạn quân, which he shaketh over it.
Và the land của Giu-đa shall be a terror unto Ai-Cập, every one that maketh mention thereof shall be afraid in himself, because of the counsel of the CHÚA vạn quân, which he hath determined against it.
In that day shall five các thành in the land of Ai-Cập nói the language of Canaan, Và swear to the CHÚA vạn quân; một shall be called, thành of destruction. the language: Heb. the lip of destruction: or, of Heres, or, of mặt trời
In that day shall there be an altar to the CHÚA in the midst of the land of Ai-Cập, Và a pillar at the border thereof to the CHÚA.
Và it shall be for a sign Và for một nhân chứng unto the CHÚA vạn quân in the land of Ai-Cập: for they shall cry unto the CHÚA vì of the oppressors, Và he shall send them a saviour, Và a great one, Và he shall deliver them.
Và the CHÚA shall be known to Ai-Cập, Và người Ê-díp-tô shall know the CHÚA trong ngày đó, Và shall do sacrifice Và oblation; yea, they shall vow a vow unto the CHÚA, Và perform it.
Và the CHÚA shall smite Ai-Cập: he shall smite Và heal it: Và they shall return even to the CHÚA, Và he shall be intreated of them, and shall heal them.
In that day shall there be a highway out of Ai-Cập to A-si-ri, Và the Assyrian shall come into Ai-Cập, Và the Ai-Cậpian into A-si-ri, Và người Ê-díp-tô shall serve with the Assyrians.
In that day shall I-sơ-ra-ên be the third with Ai-Cập Và with A-si-ri, even a blessing in the midst of the land:
Whom the CHÚA vạn quân shall bless, nói [rằng], phước be Ai-Cập my people, Và A-si-ri the work of my hands, Và I-sơ-ra-ên mine inheritance.

CHAPTER 20.
In the year that Tartan đến unto Ashdod, ( when Sargon vua of A-si-ri sent him,) and fought against Ashdod, Và took it;
At the same time nói the CHÚA by Isaiah con trai of Amoz, nói [rằng], đi Và loose the vải bố from off thy loins, Và put off giày của ngươi from thy foot. Và he did so, walking lỏa lồ Và barefoot. by: Heb. by tay of
Và the CHÚA nói, Like as my servant Isaiah hath walked lỏa lồ Và barefoot ba năm for a sign Và wonder upon Ai-Cập Và upon Ethiopia;
So shall the king of A-si-ri lead away người Ê-díp-tô prisoners, Và the Ethiopians captives, young Và old, lỏa lồ Và barefoot, even with their buttocks uncovered, to the shame of Ai-Cập. the Ai-Cậpians…: Heb. the captivity of Ai-Cập shame: Heb. nakedness
Và they shall be afraid Và ashamed of Ethiopia their expectation, Và of Ai-Cập their glory.
Và the inhabitant of this isle shall say trong ngày đó, kìa, such is our expectation, whither we flee for help to be delivered từ vua of A-si-ri: Và how shall we escape? isle: or, country

CHAPTER 21.
The burden of the desert of biển. As whirlwinds in the south pass through; so it cometh from the desert, from a terrible land.
A grievous vision is declared unto me; the treacherous dealer dealeth treacherously, Và the spoiler spoileth. Go up, O Elam: besiege, O Media; all the sighing thereof have I made to cease. grievous: Heb. hard
Therefore are my loins filled with pain: pangs have taken hold upon me, as the pangs of một người đờn bà that travaileth: I was bowed down at the hearing of it; I was dismayed at the seeing of it.
My heart panted, fearfulness affrighted me: the night of my pleasure hath he turned into fear unto me. heart…: or, mind wandered turned: Heb. put
Prepare the table, watch in the watchtower, ăn, uống: Hãy chổi dậy, ye princes, Và anoint the shield.
For thus hath the Lord nói unto me, Go, set a watchman, let him declare what he seeth.
Và he saw a chariot với a couple of horsemen, a chariot of asses, Và a chariot of lạc đà; Và he hearkened diligently with much heed:
Và he cried, A lion: My lord, I stand continually upon the watchtower trong ngàytime, Và I am set in my ward whole nights: he…: or, cried as a lion whole…: or, every night
And, kìa, here cometh a chariot of men, với a couple of horsemen. Và he trả lời và nói, Ba-by-lôn is fallen, is fallen; Và all the graven images of her gods he hath broken unto the ground.
O my threshing, Và the corn of my floor: that which I have heard of the CHÚA vạn quân, ĐCT của I-sơ-ra-ên, have I declared cùng các ngươi. corn: Heb. son
The burden of Dumah. He calleth to me out of Seir, Watchman, what of the night? Watchman, what of the night?
The watchman nói, buổi sáng đến, Và also the night: if ye will enquire, enquire ye: return, đến.
The burden upon Arabia. In the forest in Arabia shall ye lodge, O ye travelling companies of Dedanim.
The inhabitants of the land of Tema brought nước to him that was thirsty, they prevented with their bread him that fled. brought: or, bring ye
For they fled từ những thanh gươm, từ the drawn thanh gươm, Và from the bent bow, Và from the grievousness of war. from những thanh gươm: or, for fear, etc: Heb. from mặt, etc
For thus hath the Lord nói unto me, Within a year, according to the years of an hireling, Và all sự vinh hiển of Kedar shall fail:
Và the residue of the number of archers, the mighty men of the children of Kedar, shall be diminished: for the CHÚA ĐCT của I-sơ-ra-ên hath spoken it. archers: Heb. bows

CHAPTER 22.
The burden of the valley of vision. What aileth ngươi now, that ngươi art wholly gone up to mái nhà?
ngươi that art full of stirs, a tumultuous city, a joyous city: thy slain men are not slain with thanh gươm, nor dead in battle.
All thy rulers are fled together, they are bound by the archers: all that are found in ngươi are bound together, which have fled from far. by…: Heb. of the bow
Therefore nói I, Look away from me; I will weep bitterly, labour not to comfort me, vì cớ the spoiling of con gái of my people. weep…: Heb. be bitter in weeping
For it is a day of trouble, Và of treading down, Và of perplexity by the Lord
God vạn quân in the valley of vision, breaking down the walls, Và of crying to núis.
Và Elam bare the quiver with chariots of men Và horsemen, Và Kir uncovered the shield. uncovered: Heb. made naked
Và it shall come to pass, that thy choicest valleys shall be full of chariots, Và the horsemen shall set themselves in array at cổng. thy…: Heb. the choice of thy valleys at: or, toward
Và he discovered the covering của Giu-đa, Và ngươi didst look trong ngày đó to the armour của nhà of the forest.
Ye have seen also the breaches of the city của Đa-vít, that they are many: Và ye gathered together the waters of the lower pool.
Và ye have numbered nhàs of Giê-ru-sa-lem, Và nhàs have ye broken down to fortify the wall.
Ye made also a ditch between the two walls for the water of the old pool: but ye have not looked unto the maker thereof, neither had respect unto him that fashioned it long ago.
Và in that day did the Lord
God vạn quân call to weeping, Và to than khóc, Và to baldness, Và to girding with vải bố:
Và kìa joy Và gladness, slaying oxen, Và killing chiên, eating flesh, Và drinking rượu nho: let us eat và uống; for to morrow we shall die.
Và it was revealed in mine ears by the CHÚA vạn quân, Surely this iniquity shall not be purged from you till ye die, nói Chúa
God vạn quân.
Thus nói Chúa
God vạn quân, đi, get ngươi unto this treasurer, even unto Shebna, which is over nhà, Và say,
What hast ngươi here? and whom hast ngươi here, that ngươi hast hewed ngươi out a sepulchre here, as he that heweth him out a sepulchre on high, Và that graveth an habitation for himself in a rock? as…: or, O he
kìa, the CHÚA will carry ngươi away with a mighty captivity, Và will surely cover ngươi. will carry…: or, who covered ngươi with an excellent covering, and clothed ngươi gorgeously, (next verse) shall surely, etc a mighty…: Heb. the captivity of a man
He will surely violently turn Và toss ngươi like a ball into a large country: there shalt ngươi die, Và there the chariots of thy glory shall be the shame of thy lord's nhà. large: Heb. large of spaces
Và I will drive ngươi from thy station, Và from thy state shall he pull ngươi down.
Và it shall come to pass in that day, that I will call my servant Eliakim con trai of Hilkiah:
Và I will clothe him with thy robe, Và strengthen him with thy girdle, Và I will commit thy government into his hand: Và he shall be a father to the inhabitants of Giê-ru-sa-lem, Và đến nhà của Giu-đa.
Và the key của nhà của Đa-vít will I lay upon his shoulder; so he shall open, Và none shall shut; Và he shall shut, Và none shall open.
Và I will fasten him as a nail in a sure place; Và he shall be for a glorious throne to his father's nhà.
Và they shall hang upon him all sự vinh hiển of his father's nhà, the offspring Và the issue, all vessels of small quantity, from the vessels of cups, even to all the vessels of flagons. vessels of flagons: or, instruments of viols
In that day, nói the CHÚA vạn quân, shall the nail that is fastened in the sure place be removed, Và be cut down, Và fall; Và the burden that was upon it shall be cut off: for the CHÚA hath spoken it.

CHAPTER 23.
The burden of Ti-rơ. Howl, ye ships of Tarshish; for it is laid waste, so that there is no house, no entering in: from the land of Chittim it is revealed to them.
Be still, ye inhabitants of the isle; ngươi whom the merchants of Zidon, that pass over biển, have replenished. still: Heb. silent
Và by great waters the seed of Sihor, mùa gặt of the river, is her revenue; Và she is a mart of nations.
Be ngươi ashamed, O Zidon: for biển hath spoken, even the strength of biển, nói [rằng], I travail not, nor bring forth children, neither do I nourish up young men, cũng không bring up virgins.
As at the report concerning Ai-Cập, so shall they be sorely pained at the report of Ti-rơ.
Pass ye over to Tarshish; howl, ye inhabitants of the isle.
Is this your joyous city, whose antiquity is of ancient ngày? her own feet shall carry her afar off to sojourn. afar…: Heb. from afar off
Who hath taken this counsel against Ti-rơ, the crowning city, whose merchants are princes, whose traffickers are the honourable đất?
The CHÚA vạn quân hath purposed it, to stain the pride of all glory, Và to bring into contempt all the honourable đất. to stain: Heb. to pollute

CHAPTER 25.
O CHÚA, thou art my God; I will exalt ngươi, I will praise Danh Ngài; for ngươi hast done wonderful things; thy counsels of old are faithfulness Và truth.
For ngươi hast made of a city an heap; of a defenced city a ruin: a palace of strangers to be no city; it shall never be built.
Therefore shall the strong people glorify ngươi, the city of the terrible nations shall fear ngươi.
For ngươi hast been a strength to the poor, a strength to the needy in his distress, a refuge from the storm, a shadow from the heat, when the blast of the terrible ones is as a storm against the wall.
ngươi shalt bring down the noise of strangers, as the heat in a dry place; even the heat with the shadow of a cloud: the branch of the terrible ones shall be brought low.

kìa, Tên of the CHÚA đến from far, burning với his anger, Và the burden thereof is heavy: his lips are full of indignation, Và his tongue as a devouring lửa: burden…: or, grievousness of flame heavy: Heb. heaviness
Và his breath, as an overflowing stream, shall reach to the midst of the neck, to sift the nations with the sieve of hư không: and there shall be a bridle in the jaws của dân sự, causing họ to err.
ngươi sẽ have Bài hát, as in the night khi a holy solemnity is kept; Và gladness of heart, as when one goeth with a pipe to come into núi of the CHÚA, to the mighty One của I-sơ-ra-ên. mighty…: Heb. Rock
Và the CHÚA shall cause his glorious tiếng to be heard, Và shall shew the lighting down of his arm, with the indignation of his anger, and với the flame of a devouring lửa, với scattering, Và tempest, Và hailstones. his glorious…: Heb. sự vinh hiển of his voice
For through the voice of the CHÚA shall the Assyrian be beaten down, which smote with a rod.
Và trong every place where the grounded staff shall pass, which the CHÚA shall lay upon him, it shall be with tabrets Và harps: Và in battles of shaking will he fight with it. in every…: Heb. every passing of the rod founded lay…: Heb. cause to rest upon with it: or, against them
For Tophet is ordained of old; yea, for the king it is prepared; he hath made it deep Và large: the pile thereof is lửa Và much wood; the breath of the CHÚA, like a stream of brimstone, doth kindle it. of old: Heb. from yesterday

CHAPTER 31.
Khốn thay to them that go down to Ai-Cập for help; Và stay on horses, Và trust in chariots, because họ là many; Và in horsemen, because they are very strong; but they look not unto the Holy One của I-sơ-ra-ên, neither seek the CHÚA! Yet he also is khôn ngoan, Và will bring evil, Và will not call back his words: but will arise against nhà of the evildoers, Và against the help of them that work iniquity. call…: Heb. remove
Now người Ê-díp-tô are men, Và not God; Và their horses flesh, Và not spirit. When the CHÚA shall stretch out his hand, both he that helpeth shall fall, Và he that is holpen shall fall down, Và they all shall fail together.
For thus hath the CHÚA spoken unto me, Like as the lion Và the young lion roaring on his prey, when a multitude of shepherds is called forth against him, he will not be afraid of their voice, nor abase himself for the noise of them: so shall the CHÚA vạn quân come down to fight for mount Si-ôn, Và for the hill thereof. noise: or, multitude
As birds flying, so will the CHÚA vạn quân defend Giê-ru-sa-lem; defending also he will deliver it; and passing over he will preserve it.
Turn ye unto him from whom the children của I-sơ-ra-ên have deeply revolted.
For in that day every man shall cast away his idols of silver, Và his idols of gold, which your own hands have made cùng các ngươi for a sin. his idols of gold: Heb. the idols of his gold
Then shall the Assyrian fall with thanh gươm, not of a mighty man; Và thanh gươm, not of a mean man, shall devour him: but he shall flee từ thanh gươm, Và his young men shall be discomfited. from: or, for fear of discomfited: or, tributary: Heb. for melting, or, tribute
Và he shall pass over to his strong hold for fear, Và his princes shall be afraid of the ensign, nói the CHÚA, whose fire is in Si-ôn, Và his furnace in Giê-ru-sa-lem. he…: Heb. his rock shall pass away for fear his strong hold: or, his strength

CHAPTER 32.
kìa, a king shall reign in righteousness, Và princes shall rule in judgment.
Và a man shall be as an hiding place from the wind, Và a covert from the tempest; as rivers of water in a dry place, as the shadow of a great rock in a weary land. great: Heb. heavy
Và the eyes of them that see shall not be dim, Và the ears of them that hear shall hearken.
The heart also of the rash shall understand sự hiểu biết, Và the tongue of the stammerers shall be ready to speak plainly. rash: Heb. hasty plainly: or, elegantly
The vile person shall be no more called liberal, nor the churl nói to be bountiful.
For the vile person will speak villany, Và his heart will work iniquity, to practise sự giả hình, Và to utter error against the CHÚA, to make empty the soul of the hungry, Và he will cause the drink of the thirsty to fail.
The instruments also of the churl are evil: he deviseth wicked devices to destroy người nghèo with lying những lời, even when the needy speaketh right. the needy…: or, he speaketh against the poor in judgment
But the liberal deviseth liberal things; Và by liberal things shall he stand. stand: or, be established
Rise up, ye women that are at ease; nghe my voice, ye careless daughters; give ear unto my speech.
Many days Và years shall ye be troubled, ye careless women: for the vintage shall fail, the gathering shall not come. Many…: Heb. Days above a year
Tremble, ye women that are at ease; be troubled, ye careless ones: strip you, and make you bare, Và gird vải bố upon your loins.
They shall lament for the teats, for the pleasant fields, for the fruitful vine. pleasant…: Heb. fields of desire
Upon the land of my people shall come up thorns Và briers; yea, upon all nhàs of joy trong sự vui mừngous city: yea…: or, burning upon
Because the palaces shall be forsaken; đám đông of the city shall be left; the forts Và towers shall be for dens for ever, a joy of wild asses, a pasture of flocks; forts…: or, clifts and watchtowers
Until the spirit be poured upon us from on high, Và the wilderness be a fruitful field, Và the fruitful field be counted for a forest.
Then judgment shall ở in the wilderness, Và righteousness remain in the fruitful field.
Và the work of righteousness shall be peace; Và the effect of righteousness quietness Và assurance for ever.
Và my people shall ở in a peaceable habitation, Và in sure ởings, Và in quiet resting places;
When it shall hail, coming down on the forest; Và the city shall be low in a low place. low in…: or, utterly abased
phước are ye that sow beside all waters, that send forth thither the feet of the ox Và the ass.

CHAPTER 33.
Khốn thay to ngươi that spoilest, and thou wast not spoiled; Và dealest treacherously, Và they dealt not treacherously with ngươi! when ngươi shalt cease to spoil, ngươi shalt be spoiled; Và when ngươi shalt make an end to deal treacherously, they shall deal treacherously with ngươi.
O CHÚA, be gracious unto us; we have waited for ngươi: be ngươi their arm mỗi buổi sáng, our salvation also in the time of trouble.
At the noise of the tumult the people fled; at the lifting up of thyself the nations were scattered.
Và your spoil shall be gathered like the gathering of the caterpiller: as the running to and fro of châu chấu shall he run upon them.
The CHÚA is exalted; for he ởeth on high: he hath filled Si-ôn with judgment Và righteousness.
Và wisdom Và knowledge shall be the stability of thy times, Và strength của sự cứu rỗi: the fear of the CHÚA is his treasure. salvation: Heb. salvations
kìa, their valiant ones shall cry without: the ambassadors of peace shall weep bitterly. valiant…: or, messengers
The highways lie waste, the wayfaring man ceaseth: he hath broken giao ước, he hath despised the cities, he regardeth không ai.
đất mourneth Và languisheth: Lebanon is ashamed Và hewn down: Sharon is like a wilderness; Và Bashan Và Carmel shake off their fruits. hewn…: or, withered away
Now will I rise, nói the CHÚA; now will I be exalted; now will I lift up myself.
ngươi sẽ conceive chaff, ngươi sẽ bring forth stubble: your breath, as lửa, shall devour you.
Và the people shall be as the burnings of lime: as thorns cut up shall they be burned in the fire.
nghe, ye that are far off, what I have done; and, ye that are gần, acknowledge my might.
The sinners in Si-ôn are afraid; fearfulness hath surprised những kẻ đạo đức giả. Who among us shall ở with the devouring lửa? who among us shall ở with đời đời burnings?
He that walketh righteously, Và speaketh uprightly; he that despiseth the gain of oppressions, that shaketh his hands from holding of bribes, that stoppeth his ears from hearing of blood, Và shutteth his eyes from seeing evil; righteously: Heb. in righteousnesses uprightly: Heb. uprightnesses oppressions: or, deceits blood: Heb. bloods
He shall ở on high: his place of defence shall be the munitions of rocks: bánh shall be given him; his waters shall be sure. high: Heb. heights, or, high places
Thine eyes sẽ thấy vua in his beauty: they shall kìa the land that is very far off. that…: Heb. of far distances
Thine heart shall meditate terror. Where is thầy chép luật? where is the receiver? where is he that counted the towers? receiver: Heb. weigher?
ngươi shalt not see a fierce people, a people of a deeper speech than ngươi canst perceive; of a stammering lưỡi, that ngươi canst not understand. stammering: or, ridiculous
Look upon Si-ôn, thành of our solemnities: thine eyes sẽ thấy Giê-ru-sa-lem a quiet habitation, a tabernacle that shall not be taken down; not one of the stakes thereof shall ever be removed, neither shall any of the cords thereof be broken.
But there the glorious
CHÚA will be unto us một chỗ of broad rivers Và streams; wherein shall go no galley with oars, neither shall gallant ship pass thereby. of…: Heb. broad of spaces, or, hands
For the CHÚA is our judge, the CHÚA is our lawgiver, the CHÚA is our king; he will save us. lawgiver: Heb. statutemaker
Thy tacklings are loosed; they could not well strengthen their mast, they could not spread the sail: then is the prey of a great spoil divided; the lame take the prey. Thy…: or, They have forsaken thy tacklings
Và the inhabitant shall not say, I am sick: the people that ở therein shall be forgiven their iniquity.

CHAPTER 34.
Come near, ye nations, to hear; Và hearken, ye people: let đất nghe, Và all that is therein; thế gian, Và all things that come forth of it. all that…: Heb. the fulness thereof
For the indignation of the CHÚA is upon all nations, and his fury upon all their armies: he hath utterly destroyed them, he hath delivered them to the slaughter.
Their slain also shall be cast out, Và their stink shall come up out of their carcases, Và núis shall be melted with their blood.
Và all the host of heaven shall be dissolved, Và the heavens shall be rolled together as a scroll: Và all their host shall fall down, as the leaf falleth off from the vine, Và as a falling cây vả from cây vả.
For my thanh gươm shall be bathed in heaven: kìa, it shall come down upon Idumea, Và upon the people of my curse, to judgment.
The thanh gươm of the CHÚA is filled with blood, it is made fat with fatness, Và with the blood of lambs Và goats, with the fat of the kidneys of rams: for the CHÚA hath a sacrifice in Bozrah, Và a great slaughter in the land of Idumea.
Và the unicorns shall come down with them, and the bullocks with the bulls; Và their land shall be soaked with blood, Và their dust made fat with fatness. unicorns: or, rhinocerots soaked: or, drunken
For it is ngày of the Lord's vengeance, Và the year of recompences for the controversy of Si-ôn.
Và the streams thereof shall be turned into pitch, Và the dust thereof into brimstone, Và the land thereof shall become burning pitch.
It shall not be quenched đêm nor day; the smoke thereof shall go up đến đời đời: from generation to generation it shall lie waste; none shall pass through it đến đời đời và mãi mãi.
But the cormorant Và the bittern shall possess it; the owl also and the raven shall ở in it: and he shall stretch out upon it the line of confusion, Và the stones of emptiness. cormorant: or, pelican
They shall call the nobles thereof to the kingdom, but none shall be there, and all her princes shall be nothing.
Và thorns shall come up in her palaces, nettles Và brambles in the fortresses thereof: and it shall be an habitation of dragons, Và a court for owls. owls: or, ostriches: Heb. daughters of the owl
The wild beasts of the desert shall also meet with the wild beasts of the island, Và the satyr shall cry to his fellow; the screech owl also shall rest there, and find for herself một chỗ of rest. The wild beasts of the desert: Heb. Ziim the wild beasts of the island: Heb. Ijim screech…: or, night monster
There shall the great owl make her nest, Và lay, Và hatch, Và gather under her shadow: there shall the vultures also be gathered, every one with her mate.
Seek ye out of the book of the CHÚA, Và read: no one of these shall fail, none shall want her mate: for my mouth it hath commanded, Và his spirit it hath gathered them.
Và he hath cast the lot for them, and his hand hath divided it với họ by line: they shall possess it for ever, from generation to generation shall they ở therein.

CHAPTER 35.
đồng vắng Và the solitary place shall be glad for them; and the desert shall rejoice, Và blossom as the rose.
It shall blossom abundantly, Và rejoice even with joy Và singing: sự vinh hiển of Lebanon shall be given unto it, the excellency of Carmel Và Sharon, they sẽ thấy sự vinh hiển of the CHÚA, Và the excellency of our God.
Strengthen ye the weak hands, Và confirm the feeble knees.
Say to them that are of a fearful heart, Be strong, fear not: kìa, your God will come với vengeance, even ĐCT với a recompence; he will come Và save you. fearful: Heb. hasty
Then the eyes of the blind sẽ được mở ra, Và the ears of the deaf shall be unstopped.
Then shall the lame man leap as an hart, Và the tongue of the dumb sing: for in the wilderness shall waters break out, Và streams in the desert.
Và the parched ground shall become a pool, Và the thirsty land springs of water: in the habitation of dragons, where each lay, shall be cỏ with reeds Và rushes. grass…: or, a court for reeds, etc
Và an highway shall be there, and a way, Và it shall be called đường of holiness; the unclean shall not pass over it; but it shall be for those: the wayfaring men, though fools, shall not err therein. but…: or, for he shall be with them
No lion shall be there, nor any ravenous beast shall go up thereon, it shall not be found there; but the redeemed shall walk there:
Và sự cứu chuộc [của] CHÚA sẽ trở lại, Và họ sẽ đến Si-ôn với [lời] ngợi khen và sự mừng rở vô hạn trên đầu [họ]; vui mừng và hớn hở họ sẽ được ngập tràn; và sầu khổ và than thở sẽ tan biến đi.

CHAPTER 36.
Now xảy đến in the mười bốn năm của vua Hezekiah, that Sennacherib vua of A-si-ri came up against all the defenced các thành của Giu-đa, Và took them.
và vua of A-si-ri sent Rabshakeh from Lachish to Giê-ru-sa-lem unto king Hezekiah with a great army. Và he stood by the conduit of the upper pool in the highway of the fuller's field.
Then came forth unto him Eliakim, Hilkiah's son, which was over nhà, Và Shebna thầy chép luật, Và Joah, A-sáp's son, the recorder. scribe: or, secretary
Và Rabshakeh nói với họ, Say ye now to Hezekiah, Thus nói the great vua, vua of A-si-ri, What confidence is this wherein ngươi trustest?
I say, sayest thou, (but they are but vain những lời) I have counsel Và strength for war: now on whom dost ngươi trust, that ngươi rebellest against me? vain…: Heb. a word of lips I have…: or, but counsel and strength are for the war
Lo, ngươi trustest in the staff of this broken reed, on Ai-Cập; whereon if a man lean, it will go into his hand, Và pierce it: so is Pha-ra-ôn vua of Ai-Cập to all that trust in him.
But if ngươi say to me, We trust in the CHÚA ĐCT chúng tôi: is it not he, whose high places Và whose altars Hezekiah hath taken away, và nói to Giu-đa Và to Giê-ru-sa-lem, ngươi sẽ worship before this altar?
Now therefore give pledges, I pray ngươi, to my master vua of A-si-ri, Và I will give ngươi two thousand horses, if ngươi be able on thy part to set riders upon them. pledges: or, hostages
How then wilt ngươi turn away mặt of one captain of the least of my master's các đầy tớ, Và put thy trust on Ai-Cập for chariots Và for horsemen?
Và am I now come up without the CHÚA against this land to destroy it? the CHÚA nói unto me, Go up against this land, Và destroy it.
Then nói Eliakim Và Shebna Và Joah unto Rabshakeh, nói, I pray ngươi, unto thy servants in the Syrian language; for we understand it: Và speak not to us in the Jews' language, in the ears của dân sự that are on the wall.
But Rabshakeh nói, Hath my master sent me to thy master Và to ngươi to speak these words? hath he not sent me to the men that sit upon the wall, that they may eat their own dung, và uống their own piss with you?
Then Rabshakeh đứng, Và cried with a loud tiếng in the Jews' language, và nói, nghe ye the words of the great vua, vua of A-si-ri.
Thus nói vua, Let not Hezekiah deceive you: for he shall not be able to deliver you.
Neither let Hezekiah make you trust in the CHÚA, nói [rằng], The CHÚA will surely deliver us: this city shall not be delivered into tay of the king of A-si-ri.
Hearken not to Hezekiah: for thus nói vua of A-si-ri, Make an agreement with me by a present, Và come out to me: and eat ye every one of his vine, và mãi mãiy one of his cây vả, và uống ye every one the waters of his own cistern; Make…: or, Seek my favour by a present: Heb. Make with me a blessing
Until I come Và take you away to a land like your own land, a land of corn Và wine, a land of bread Và vườn nhos.
Hãy coi chừng lest Hezekiah persuade you, saying, The CHÚA will deliver us. Hath any of the gods of the nations delivered his land out of tay of the king of A-si-ri?
Where are the gods of Hamath Và Arphad? where are the gods of Sepharvaim? Và have they delivered Sa-ma-ri out of my hand?
Who are they among all the gods of these lands, that have delivered their land out of my hand, that the CHÚA should deliver Giê-ru-sa-lem out of my hand?
But they held their peace, Và trả lời him not a word: for the king's mạng lệnh was, saying, Answer him not.
Then came Eliakim, con trai of Hilkiah, that was over nhàhold, Và Shebna thầy chép luật, Và Joah, con trai của A-sáp, the recorder, to Hezekiah with their clothes rent, Và told him the words of Rabshakeh.

CHAPTER 37.
Và xảy đến, when king Hezekiah nghe it, that he rent his clothes, Và covered himself with vải bố, Và went inđến nhà of the CHÚA.
Và he sent Eliakim, who was over nhàhold, Và Shebna thầy chép luật, Và các trưởng lão of the priests covered with vải bố, unto Isaiah tiên tri con trai of Amoz.
Và họ nói unto him, Thus nói Hezekiah, This day is a day of trouble, Và of rebuke, Và of blasphemy: for the children are come to the birth, and there is not strength to bring forth. blasphemy: or, provocation
It may be the CHÚA thy God will hear những lời of Rabshakeh, whom the king of A-si-ri his master hath sent to reproach the living ĐCT, Và will reprove những lời which the CHÚA thy God hath heard: wherefore lift up thy prayer for the remnant that is left. left: Heb. found
So the servants của vua Hezekiah đến to Isaiah.
Và Isaiah nói với họ, Thus shall ye say cùng các ngươir master, Thus nói the CHÚA, Be not afraid of những lời that ngươi hast heard, wherewith the servants of the king of A-si-ri have blasphemed me.
kìa, I will send a blast upon him, and he shall hear a rumour, Và return to his own land; Và I will cause him to fall by thanh gươm in his own land. send…: or, put a spirit into him
So Rabshakeh returned, Và found vua of A-si-ri warring against Libnah: for he had heard that he was departed from Lachish.
Và he heard say concerning Tirhakah vua of Ethiopia, He is come forth to make war with ngươi. And when he heard it, he sent messengers to Hezekiah, nói [rằng],
Thus shall ye speak to Hezekiah vua của Giu-đa, nói [rằng], Let not thy God, in whom ngươi trustest, deceive ngươi, saying, Giê-ru-sa-lem shall not be given into tay of the king of A-si-ri.
kìa, ngươi hast heard what các vua of A-si-ri have done to all lands by destroying them utterly; Và shalt ngươi be delivered?
Have the gods of the nations delivered them which my fathers have destroyed, as Gozan, Và Haran, Và Rezeph, Và the children of Ê-đen which were in Telassar?
Where is vua of Hamath, và vua of Arphad, và vua of the city of Sepharvaim, Hena, Và Ivah?
Và Hezekiah nhận the letter from tay of the messengers, Và read it: and Hezekiah đi lên unđến nhà of the CHÚA, Và spread it before the CHÚA.
Và Hezekiah cầu nguyện unto the CHÚA, nói [rằng],
O CHÚA vạn quân, ĐCT của I-sơ-ra-ên, that ởest between the cherubims, thou art ĐCT, even ngươi alone, of all the kingdoms đất: ngươi hast made trời Và đất.
Incline thine ear, O CHÚA, Và hear; open thine eyes, O CHÚA, Và see: Và hear all the words of Sennacherib, which hath sent to reproach the living ĐCT.
Of a truth,
CHÚA, các vua của A-si-ri have laid waste all the nations, Và their countries,nations: Heb. lands
Và have cast their gods into the fire: for they were no gods, but the work of men's hands, wood Và stone: therefore they have destroyed them. cast: Heb. given
Now therefore, O CHÚA ĐCT chúng tôi, save us from his hand, that all the kingdoms đất may know that thou art the CHÚA, even ngươi only.
Then Isaiah con trai of Amoz sent unto Hezekiah, nói [rằng], Thus nói the CHÚA ĐCT của I-sơ-ra-ên, Whereas ngươi hast cầu nguyện to me against Sennacherib vua of A-si-ri:
This is lời which the CHÚA hath spoken concerning him; The virgin, con gái of Si-ôn, hath despised ngươi, Và laughed ngươi to scorn; con gái of Giê-ru-sa-lem hath shaken her head at ngươi.
Whom hast ngươi reproached Và blasphemed? Và against whom hast ngươi exalted thy tiếng, Và lifted up thine eyes on high? even against the Holy One của I-sơ-ra-ên.
By thy servants hast ngươi reproached Chúa, Và hast nói, By đám đông of my chariots am I come up to the height of núis, to the sides of Lebanon; Và I will cut down the tall cedars thereof, Và the choice fir trees thereof: and I will enter into the height of his border, Và the forest of his Carmel. By thy…: Heb. By tay of thy servants the tall…: Heb. the tallness of the cedars thereof and the choice of the fir trees thereof the forest…: or, the forest and his fruitful field
I have digged, Và drunk nước; Và with the sole of my feet have I dried up all the rivers of the besieged places. besieged: or, fenced and closed
Hast ngươi not heard long ago, how I have done it; Và of ancient times, that I have formed it? now have I brought it to pass, that ngươi shouldest be to lay waste defenced các thành into ruinous heaps. Hast…: or, Hast ngươi not heard how I have made it long ago, and formed it of ancient times? should I now bring it to be laid waste, and defenced cities to be ruinous heaps?
Therefore their inhabitants were of small power, they were dismayed Và confounded: they were as the grass of the field, and as the green herb, as the grass on mái nhà, and as corn blasted before it be grown up. of small…: Heb. short of hand
But I know thy abode, Và thy going out, Và thy coming in, Và thy rage against me. abode: or, sitting
Because thy rage against me, and thy tumult, is come up into mine ears, therefore will I put my hook in thy nose, Và my bridle in thy lips, Và I will turn ngươi back by the way by which ngươi camest.
Và this shall be a sign unto ngươi, ngươi sẽ eat này năm such as groweth of itself; and the second năm that which springeth of the same: and in the third năm sow ye, and reap, Và plant vườn nhos, Và eat the fruit thereof.
Và the remnant that is escaped của nhà của Giu-đa shall again take root downward, Và bear fruit upward: the remnant…: Heb. the escaping of nhà của xứ Giu Đah that remaineth
For out of Giê-ru-sa-lem shall go forth a remnant, Và they that escape out of mount Si-ôn: the zeal of the CHÚA vạn quân shall do this. they…: Heb. the escaping
Therefore thus nói the CHÚA concerning the king of A-si-ri, He shall not come into this city, nor shoot an arrow there, nor come before it with shields, nor cast a bank against it.
By the way that he came, by the same shall he return, Và shall not come into this city, nói the CHÚA.
For I will defend this city to save it for mine own sake, and for my servant Đa-vít's sake.
Then thiên sứ of the CHÚA went forth, Và smote in the camp of the Assyrians a hundred Và fourscore Và five ngàn: Và when they arose early in buổi sáng, kìa, they were all dead corpses.
So Sennacherib vua of A-si-ri departed, Và went Và returned, Và dwelt at Nineveh.
Và xảy đến, as he was worshipping in nhà of Nisroch his god, that Adrammelech Và Sharezer his sons smote him with thanh gươm; Và they escaped into the land of Armenia: Và Esar–haddon his son reigned in his stead. Armenia: Heb. Ararat

CHAPTER 38.
In those days was Hezekiah sick unto death. Và Isaiah tiên tri con trai of Amoz đến unto him, and nói unto him, Thus nói the CHÚA, Set thine house in order: for ngươi shalt die, Và not live. Set…: Heb. Give charge concerning thy house
Then Hezekiah turned his face toward the wall, Và cầu nguyện unto the CHÚA,
và nói, nhớ now, O CHÚA, tôi nài khuyên ngươi, how I have walked before ngươi in truth Và with a perfect heart, Và have done that which is tốt in thy sight. Và Hezekiah khóc sore. sore: Heb. with great weeping
Then came the word of the CHÚA to Isaiah, nói [rằng],
đi, Và say to Hezekiah, Thus nói the CHÚA, ĐCT của Đa-vít thy father, I have heard thy prayer, I have seen thy tears: kìa, I will add unto thy days mười lăm năm.
Và I will deliver ngươi and this city out of tay of the king of A-si-ri: Và I will defend this city.
Và this shall be a sign unto ngươi from the CHÚA, that the CHÚA will do this thing that he hath spoken;
kìa, I will bring again the shadow of the degrees, which is gone down in mặt trời dial of Ahaz, mười degrees backward. So mặt trời returned mười degrees, by which degrees it was gone down. sun dial: Heb. degrees by, or, with mặt trời
The writing of Hezekiah vua của Giu-đa, when he had been sick, Và was recovered of his sickness:
tôi nói in the cutting off of my days, I shall go to the gates of the grave: I am deprived of the residue of my years.
tôi nói, I shall not see the CHÚA, even the CHÚA, in the land of the living: I shall kìa man no more with the inhabitants of the world.
Mine age is departed, Và is removed from me as a shepherd's tent: I have cut off like a weaver my sự sống: he will cut me off with pining sickness: from day even to night wilt ngươi make an end of me. with…: or, from the thrum
tôi nghĩ rằng till morning, that, as a lion, so will he break all my bones: from day even to night wilt ngươi make an end of me.
Like a crane or a swallow, so did I chatter: I did mourn as a dove: mine eyes fail with looking upward: O CHÚA, I am oppressed; undertake for me. undertake…: or, ease me
What shall I say? he hath both spoken unto me, and himself hath done it: I shall go softly all my years in the bitterness of my soul.
O Lord, by these things men live, and in all these things is sự sống of my spirit: so wilt ngươi recover me, and make me to live.
kìa, for peace I had great bitterness: but ngươi hast in love to my soul delivered it from the pit of corruption: for ngươi hast cast all my tội lỗi behind thy back. for peace…: or, on my peace came great bitterness ngươi hast in…: Heb. ngươi hast loved my soul from the pit
For the grave cannot praise ngươi, death can không celebrate ngươi: they that go down into the pit cannot hy vọng for thy truth.
The living, the living, he shall praise ngươi, as I do this day: cha to the children shall make known thy truth.
The CHÚA was ready to save me: therefore we will sing my songs to the stringed instruments all the days of our sự sống in nhà of the CHÚA.
For Isaiah had nói, Let them take a lump of figs, and lay it for a plaister upon the boil, Và he shall recover.
Hezekiah also had nói, What is the sign that I shall go up đến nhà of the CHÚA?

CHAPTER 39.
At that time Merodach–baladan, con trai of Baladan, vua of Ba-by-lôn, sent letters Và a present to Hezekiah: for he had heard that he had been sick, Và was recovered.
Và Hezekiah was glad of them, and shewed them nhà of his precious things, the silver, Và the gold, Và the spices, Và the precious ointment, Và all nhà of his armour, Và all that was found in his treasures: there was nothing in his house, nor in all his dominion, that Hezekiah đã bày tỏ them not. precious things: or, spicery armour: or, jewels: Heb. vessels, or, instruments
Then came Isaiah tiên tri unto king Hezekiah, và nói unto him, What nói these men? Và from whence đến they unto ngươi? And Hezekiah nói, They are come from a far country unto me, even from Ba-by-lôn.
Then nói he, What have họ thấyn in thine house? Và Hezekiah trả lời, All that is in mine house have họ thấyn: there is nothing among my treasures that I have not shewed them.
Then nói Isaiah to Hezekiah, nghe lời of the CHÚA vạn quân:
kìa, the days đến, that all that is in thine house, and that which thy fathers have laid up in store until this day, shall be carried to Ba-by-lôn: nothing shall be left, nói the CHÚA.
Và of thy sons that shall issue from ngươi, which ngươi shalt beget, shall they take away; Và they shall be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Ba-by-lôn.
Then nói Hezekiah to Isaiah, tốt is lời of the CHÚA which ngươi hast spoken. He nói moreover, For there shall be peace Và truth in my days.

CHAPTER 40.
Comfort ye, comfort ye my people, nói your God.
nói ye comfortably to Giê-ru-sa-lem, Và cry unto her, that her warfare is accomplished, that her iniquity is pardoned: for she hath received of the Lord's tay double for all her tội lỗi. comfortably: Heb. to the heart warfare: or, appointed time
tiếng of him that crieth in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the CHÚA, make straight in the desert a highway for our God.
Every valley shall be exalted, và mãi mãiy mountain Và hill shall be made low: Và the crooked shall be made straight, Và the rough places plain: straight: or, a straight place plain: or, a plain place
Và sự vinh hiển of the CHÚA shall be revealed, Và all flesh sẽ thấy it together: for the mouth of the CHÚA hath spoken it.
tiếng nói, Cry. Và he nói, What shall I cry? All flesh is cỏ, Và all the goodliness thereof is as the flower of the field:
The grass withereth, the flower fadeth: because the spirit of the CHÚA bloweth upon it: surely the people is cỏ.
The grass withereth, the flower fadeth: but the word of our God shall stand đến đời đời.
O Si-ôn, that bringest tin mừng, get ngươi up into the high núi; O Giê-ru-sa-lem, that bringest tin mừng, lift up thy voice with strength; lift it up, be not afraid; say unto the cities của Giu-đa, kìa your God!O Si-ôn…: or, O ngươi that tellest tin mừng to Si-ôn O Giê-ru-sa-lem…: or, O ngươi that tellest tin mừng to Giê-ru-sa-lem
kìa, the Lord
God will come with strong tay, Và his arm shall rule for him: kìa, his reward is with him, and his work before him. with strong…: or, against the strong his work: or, recompence for his work
He shall feed his flock like a shepherd: he shall gather the lambs with his arm, Và carry họ in his bosom, Và shall gently lead those that are with young. that…: or, that give suck
Who hath measured the waters in the hollow of his hand, Và meted out trời with the span, Và comprehended the dust đất in a measure, Và weighed núis in scales, Và the hills in a balance? a measure: Heb. a tierce
Who hath directed [Thánh] Linh of the CHÚA, or being his counsellor hath taught him? his…: Heb. man of his counsel
With whom took he counsel, and ai instructed him, and taught him in the path of judgment, Và taught him knowledge, Và shewed to him the way of understanding? instructed…: Heb. made him understand understanding: Heb. understandings?
kìa, the nations are as a drop of a bucket, Và are counted as the small dust of the balance: kìa, he taketh up the isles as a very little thing.
Và Lebanon is không sufficient to burn, nor the beasts thereof sufficient for a burnt offering.
All nations before him are as nothing; and they are counted to him less than nothing, Và hư không.
To whom then will ye liken ĐCT? or what likeness will ye compare unto him?
The workman melteth a graven image, Và the goldsmith spreadeth it over with gold, Và casteth silver chains.
He that is so impoverished that he hath no oblation chooseth a tree that will not rot; he seeketh unto him a cunning workman to prepare a graven image, that shall not be moved. is so…: Heb. is poor of oblation
Have ye not known? have ye not heard? hath it not been told you from the beginning? have ye not understood from the foundations đất?
It is he that sitteth upon the circle đất, Và the inhabitants thereof are as grasshoppers; that stretcheth out các tầng trời as a curtain, Và spreadeth them out as a tent to ở in: It is…: or, Him that
That bringeth the princes to nothing; he maketh the judges đất as hư không.
Yea, they shall not be planted; yea, they shall not be sown: yea, their stock shall not take root in đất: Và he shall also blow upon them, and they shall wither, Và the whirlwind shall take them away as stubble.
To whom then will ye liken me, or shall I be equal? nói the Holy One.
Lift up your eyes on high, Và kìa who hath created these things, that bringeth out their host by number: he calleth them all by names by the greatness of his might, for that he is strong in power; not one faileth.
Tại sao sayest thou, O Gia-cốp, Và speakest, O I-sơ-ra-ên, My way is hid from the CHÚA, Và my judgment is passed over from my God?
Hast ngươi not known? hast ngươi not heard, that the đời đời ĐCT, the CHÚA, the Creator of the ends đất, fainteth not, neither is weary? there is no searching of his understanding.
He giveth power to the faint; and to them that have no might he increaseth strength.
Even the youths shall faint Và be weary, Và the young men shall utterly fall:
But they that wait upon the CHÚA shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, Và not be weary; Và they shall walk, Và not faint. renew: Heb. change

CHAPTER 41.
Keep silence before me, O islands; Và let the people renew their strength: let them come near; then let them speak: let us come near together to judgment.
Who raised up the righteous man from the east, called him to his foot, gave the nations before him, and made him rule over kings? he gave họ as the dust to his thanh gươm, Và as driven stubble to his bow. the righteous…: Heb. righteousness
He pursued them, Và passed safely; even by the way that he had not gone with his feet. safely: Heb. trong bình an
Who hath wrought Và done it, calling dòng dõi từ ban đầu? I the CHÚA, the first, Và with cuối cùng; I là he.
The isles nhìn thấy it, Và feared; the ends đất were afraid, drew near, Và came.
They helped every one his neighbour; and every one nói to his brother, Be of good courage. Be…: Heb. Be strong
So the carpenter encouraged the goldsmith, Và he that smootheth với the hammer him that smote the anvil, nói [rằng], It is ready for the sodering: Và he fastened it with nails, that it should not be moved. goldsmith: or, founder him…: or, the smiting saying…: or, saying of the soder, It is good
But thou, I-sơ-ra-ên, art my servant, Gia-cốp whom I have chosen, the seed of Áp-ra-ham my friend.
Thou whom I have taken from the ends đất, Và called ngươi from the chief men thereof, and nói unto ngươi, Thou art my servant; I have chosen ngươi, and not cast ngươi away.
Fear ngươi not; for I là with ngươi: be not dismayed; for I là thy God: I will strengthen ngươi; yea, I will help ngươi; yea, I will uphold ngươi with the tay phải of my righteousness.
kìa, all they that were incensed against ngươi lấy làm hổ thẹn Và confounded: they shall be as nothing; and they that strive with ngươi shall perish. they that strive…: Heb. the men of thy strife
ngươi shalt seek them, and shalt not find them, even họ that contended with ngươi: they that war against ngươi shall be as nothing, and as a thing of nought. them that…: Heb. the men of thy contention they…: Heb. the men of thy war
For I the CHÚA thy God will hold thy tay phải, nói [rằng] unto ngươi, Fear not; I will help ngươi.
Fear not, ngươi worm Gia-cốp, Và ye men của I-sơ-ra-ên; I will help ngươi, nói the CHÚA, Và thy redeemer, the Holy One của I-sơ-ra-ên. men: or, few men
kìa, I will make ngươi a new sharp threshing instrument having teeth: ngươi shalt thresh núis, and beat họ small, Và shalt make the hills as chaff. teeth: Heb. mouths
ngươi shalt fan them, and the wind shall carry them away, Và the whirlwind shall scatter them: and ngươi shalt rejoice in the CHÚA, Và shalt glory in the Holy One của I-sơ-ra-ên.
khi người nghèo Và needy seek nước, and there is none, Và their tongue faileth for thirst, I the CHÚA will hear them, I ĐCT của I-sơ-ra-ên will not forsake them.
I will open rivers in high places, Và fountains in the midst of the valleys: I will make đồng vắng a pool of water, Và the dry land springs of water.
I will plant in the wilderness the cedar, the shittah tree, Và the myrtle, Và the oil cây; I will set in the desert the fir tree, Và the pine, Và the box tree together:
That they may see, Và know, Và consider, Và understand together, that tay of the CHÚA hath done this, and the Holy One của I-sơ-ra-ên hath created it.
Produce your cause, nói the CHÚA; bring forth your strong reasons, nói the King of Gia-cốp. Produce: Heb. Cause to come near
Let them bring họ forth, Và shew us what shall happen: let them shew the former things, what they be, that we may consider them, and know the latter end of them; or declare us things for to come. consider…: Heb. set our heart upon them
Shew the things that are to come hereafter, that we may know that ye are gods: yea, do good, or do evil, that we may be dismayed, Và kìa it together.
kìa, ye are of nothing, Và your work of nought: an abomination is he that chooseth you. of nothing: or, worse than nothing of nought: or, worse than of a viper
I have raised up one from the north, Và he shall come: from the rising of mặt trời shall he call upon my name: Và he shall come upon princes as trên morter, Và as the potter treadeth clay.
Who hath declared từ ban đầu, that we may know? Và beforetime, that we may say, He is công chính? yea, there is none that sheweth, yea, there is none that declareth, yea, there is none that nghe your words.
The first shall say to Si-ôn, kìa, kìa them: and I will give to Giê-ru-sa-lem one that bringeth tin mừng.
For I beheld, and there was không ai; even among them, and there was no counsellor, that, when I asked of them, could answer a word. answer: Heb. return
kìa, they are all hư không; their works are nothing: their molten images are wind Và confusion.

CHAPTER 42.
kìa my servant, whom I uphold; mine elect, in whom my soul delighteth; I have put my spirit upon him: he shall bring forth judgment to the Gentiles.
He shall not cry, nor lift up, nor cause his voice to be heard in the street.
A bruised reed shall he not break, Và the smoking flax shall he not quench: he shall bring forth judgment unto truth. smoking: or, dimly burning quench: Heb. quench it
He shall not fail nor be discouraged, till he have set judgment in đất: Và the isles shall wait for his law. discouraged: Heb. broken
Thus nói ĐCT the CHÚA, he that created các tầng trời, Và stretched them out; he that spread forth đất, Và that which cometh out of it; he that giveth breath unto the people upon it, and spirit to them that walk therein:
I the CHÚA have called ngươi in righteousness, Và will hold thine hand, Và will keep ngươi, and give ngươi for a covenant của dân sự, for a light của dân ngoại;
To open the blind mắt, to bring out the prisoners from the prison, Và them that sit in darkness out of the prison nhà.
I là the CHÚA: that is my name: Và my glory will I not give to another, neither my praise to graven images.
kìa, the former things are come to pass, Và new things do I declare: before they spring forth I tell you of them.
Sing unto the CHÚA a new song, Và his praise from the end đất, ye that go down to biển, Và all that is therein; the isles, Và the inhabitants thereof. all…: Heb. the fulness thereof
Let the wilderness Và the cities thereof lift up their voice, làngs that Kedar doth inhabit: let the inhabitants of the rock sing, let them shout from the top of núis.
Let them give glory unto the CHÚA, Và declare his praise in the islands.
The CHÚA shall go forth as a mighty man, he shall stir up jealousy like a man of war: he shall cry, yea, roar; he shall prevail against his enemies. prevail: or, behave himself mightily
I have long time holden my peace; I have been still, Và refrained myself: bây giờ will I cry like a travailing woman; I will destroy Và devour at once. devour: Heb. swallow, or, sup up
I will make waste mountains Và hills, Và dry up all their herbs; Và I will make the rivers islands, Và I will dry up the pools.
Và I will bring the blind by a way that they knew not; I will lead them in paths that they have not known: I will make tối tăm light before them, and crooked things thẳng. These things will I do với họ, and not forsake them. straight: Heb. into straightness
They shall be turned back, they shall be greatly ashamed, that trust in graven images, that say to the molten images, Ye are our gods.
nghe, ye deaf; Và look, ye blind, that ye may see.
Who is mù, but my servant? or deaf, as my messenger that I sent? who is mù as he that is trọn vẹn, Và blind as the Lord's đầy tớ?
nhìn thấy many things, but ngươi observest not; opening the ears, but he nghe not.
The CHÚA is well pleased for his righteousness' sake; he will magnify luật pháp, and make it honourable. it: or, him
But this is a people robbed Và spoiled; họ là all of them snared in holes, Và they are hid in prison houses: they are for a prey, Và none delivereth; for a spoil, Và none nói, phục hồi. they are all…: or, in snaring all the young men of them for a spoil: Heb. a treading
Who among you will give ear to this? ai will hearken Và hear for the time to come? for…: Heb. for the after time?
Who gave Gia-cốp for a spoil, Và I-sơ-ra-ên to the robbers? did not the CHÚA, he against whom we have sinned? for they would not walk in his ways, neither were they obedient unto his law.
Therefore he hath poured upon him the fury of his anger, Và the strength of battle: Và it hath set him on fire round about, yet he knew not; and it burned him, yet he laid it not to heart.

CHAPTER 43.
But now thus nói the CHÚA that created ngươi, O Gia-cốp, Và he that formed ngươi, O I-sơ-ra-ên, Fear not: for I have redeemed ngươi, I have called ngươi by Danh Ngài; thou art mine.
When ngươi passest through the waters, I will be with ngươi; and through the rivers, they shall not overflow ngươi: when ngươi walkest through lửa, ngươi shalt not be burned; neither shall the flame kindle upon ngươi.
For I là the CHÚA thy God, the Holy One của I-sơ-ra-ên, thy Saviour: I gave Ai-Cập for thy ransom, Ethiopia Và Seba for ngươi.
Since ngươi wast precious in my sight, ngươi hast been honourable, Và I have loved ngươi: therefore will I give men for ngươi, and people for thy sự sống. sự sống: or, person
Fear not: for I là with ngươi: I will bring thy seed from the east, Và gather ngươi from phương tây;
I will say to the north, Give up; Và to the south, Keep not back: bring my sons from far, Và my daughters from the ends đất;
Even every one that is called by my name: for I have created him for my glory, I have formed him; yea, I have made him.
Bring forth the blind people that have mắt, Và the deaf that have ears.
Let all the nations be gathered together, Và let the people be assembled: who among them can declare this, and shew us former things? let them bring forth their witnesses, that they may be justified: or let them hear, Và say, It is truth.
Ye are my witnesses, nói the CHÚA, Và my servant whom I have chosen: that ye may know Và believe me, and understand that I là he: before me there was no God formed, neither shall there be after me. no…: or, nothing formed của ĐCT
I, even I, là the CHÚA; Và beside me there is no saviour.
I have declared, Và have saved, Và I have shewed, when there was no strange god among you: therefore ye are my witnesses, nói the CHÚA, that I là ĐCT.
Yea, before the day was I là he; and there is none that can deliver out of my hand: I will work, Và who shall let it? let it: Heb. turn it back?
Thus nói the CHÚA, your redeemer, the Holy One của I-sơ-ra-ên; For your sake I have sent to Ba-by-lôn, Và have brought down all their nobles, Và the Chaldeans, whose cry is in the ships. nobles: Heb. bars
I là the CHÚA, your Holy One, the creator của I-sơ-ra-ên, your King.
Thus nói the CHÚA, which maketh a way in biển, Và a path in the mighty waters;
Which bringeth forth the chariot Và horse, the army Và quyền năng; they shall lie down together, they shall not rise: they are extinct, they are quenched as tow.
nhớ ye not the former things, neither consider the things of old.
kìa, I will do a new thing; now it shall spring forth; shall ye not know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, Và rivers in the desert.
The beast of the field shall honour me, the dragons Và the owls: because I give waters in the wilderness, Và rivers in the desert, để cho drink to my people, my chosen. owls: or, ostriches: Heb. daughters of the owl
này people have I formed for myself; they shall shew forth my praise.
But ngươi hast not called upon me, O Gia-cốp; but ngươi hast been weary of me, O I-sơ-ra-ên.
ngươi hast not brought me the small cattle of thy burnt offerings; neither hast ngươi honoured me with thy sacrifices. I have not caused ngươi to serve with an offering, nor wearied ngươi with incense. small…: Heb. lambs, or, kids
ngươi hast bought me no sweet cane with money, neither hast ngươi filled me with the fat of thy sacrifices: but ngươi hast made me to serve with thy tội lỗi, ngươi hast wearied me with thine iniquities. filled…: Heb. made me drunk, or, abundantly moistened
I, even I, là he that blotteth out thy transgressions for mine own sake, and will not remember thy tội lỗi.
Put me in remembrance: let us plead together: declare thou, that ngươi mayest be justified.
Thy first cha hath sinned, Và thy teachers have transgressed against me. teachers: Heb. interpreters
Therefore I have profaned the princes of the sanctuary, Và have given Gia-cốp to the curse, Và I-sơ-ra-ên to reproaches. princes…: or, holy princes

CHAPTER 44.
Yet now hear, O Gia-cốp my servant; Và I-sơ-ra-ên, whom I have chosen:
Thus nói the CHÚA that made ngươi, and formed ngươi from the womb, which will help ngươi; Fear not, O Gia-cốp, my servant; Và thou, Jesurun, whom I have chosen.
For I will pour nước upon him that is thirsty, Và floods upon the dry ground: I will pour my spirit upon thy seed, Và my blessing upon thine offspring:
Và they shall spring up as among the grass, as willows by the water courses.
One shall say, I là the Lord's; Và another shall call himself by Tên of Gia-cốp; Và another shall subscribe với his hand unto the CHÚA, Và surname himself by Tên của I-sơ-ra-ên.
Thus nói the CHÚA the King của I-sơ-ra-ên, Và his redeemer the CHÚA vạn quân; I là the first, and I là cuối cùng; Và beside me there is no God.
Và who, as I, shall call, Và shall declare it, and set it in order for me, since I appointed the ancient people? Và the things that are coming, Và shall come, let them shew với họ.
Fear ye not, neither be afraid: have not I told ngươi from that time, Và have declared it? ye are even my witnesses. Is there a God beside me? yea, there is no God; I know not any. God; I: Heb. rock, etc
They that make a graven image are all of them hư không; Và their delectable things shall not profit; and they are their own witnesses; họ thấy not, nor know; that they may be ashamed. delectable: Heb. desirable
Who hath formed a god, or molten a graven image that is profitable for nothing?
kìa, all his fellows lấy làm hổ thẹn: Và the workmen, they are of men: let them all be gathered together, let them stand up; yet they shall fear, Và they lấy làm hổ thẹn together.
The smith with the tongs both worketh in the coals, Và fashioneth it with hammers, Và worketh it with the strength of his arms: yea, he is hungry, Và his strength faileth: he uống no water, Và is faint. with the tongs: or, with an axe
The carpenter stretcheth out his rule; he marketh it out with a line; he fitteth it with planes, Và he marketh it out with the compass, Và maketh it after the figure of a man, according to the beauty of a man; that it may remain in nhà.
He heweth him down cedars, Và taketh the cypress Và the oak, which he strengtheneth for himself among the trees of the forest: he planteth an ash, Và the rain doth nourish it. strengtheneth: or, taketh courage
Then shall it be for a man to burn: for he will take thereof, and warm himself; yea, he kindleth it, Và baketh bánh; yea, he maketh a god, Và worshippeth it; he maketh it a graven image, Và falleth down thereto.
He burneth part thereof in lửa; with part thereof he eateth flesh; he roasteth roast, Và is satisfied: yea, he warmeth himself, Và nói, Aha, I am warm, I have seen lửa:
Và the residue thereof he maketh a god, even his graven image: he falleth down unto it, and worshippeth it, Và prayeth unto it, and nói, Deliver me; for thou art my god.
They have not known nor understood: for he hath shut their eyes, that they cannot see; Và their hearts, that they cannot understand. shut: Heb. daubed
Và none considereth in his heart, neither is there sự hiểu biết nor understanding to say, I have burned part of it in lửa; yea, also I have baked bánh upon the coals thereof; I have roasted flesh, Và eaten it: Và shall I make the residue thereof an abomination? shall I fall down to the stock of a tree? considereth…: Heb. setteth to his heart the stock…: Heb. that which comes of a tree?
He feedeth on ashes: a deceived heart hath turned him aside, that he cannot deliver his soul, nor say, Is there not a lie in my tay phải?
nhớ these, O Gia-cốp Và I-sơ-ra-ên; for thou art my servant: I have formed ngươi; thou art my servant: O I-sơ-ra-ên, ngươi shalt not be forgotten of me.
I have blotted out, as a thick cloud, thy transgressions, and, as a cloud, thy tội lỗi: return unto me; for I have redeemed ngươi.
Sing, O ye heavens; for the CHÚA hath done it: shout, ye lower parts đất: break forth into singing, ye mountains, O forest, và mãi mãiy tree therein: for the CHÚA hath redeemed Gia-cốp, Và glorified himself in I-sơ-ra-ên.
Thus nói the CHÚA, thy redeemer, Và he that formed ngươi from the womb, I là the CHÚA that maketh all things; that stretcheth forth các tầng trời alone; that spreadeth abroad đất by myself;
That frustrateth the tokens of the liars, Và maketh diviners mad; that turneth khôn ngoan men backward, Và maketh their knowledge foolish;
That confirmeth lời of his servant, Và performeth the counsel of his messengers; that nói to Giê-ru-sa-lem, ngươi shalt be inhabited; Và to the cities của Giu-đa, ngươi sẽ be built, Và I will raise up the decayed places thereof: decayed…: Heb. wastes
That nói to the deep, Be dry, Và I will dry up thy rivers:
That nói of Cyrus, He is my shepherd, Và shall perform all my pleasure: even saying to Giê-ru-sa-lem, ngươi shalt be built; Và to đền thờ, Thy foundation shall be laid.

CHAPTER 45.
Thus nói the CHÚA to his anointed, to Cyrus, whose tay phải I have holden, to subdue nations before him; and I will loose the loins of kings, to open before him the two leaved gates; Và the gates shall not be shut; have…: or, strengthened
I will go before ngươi, and make the crooked places thẳng: I will break in pieces the gates of brass, Và cut in sunder the bars of sắt:
Và I will give ngươi the treasures của sự tối tăm, Và hidden riches of secret places, that ngươi mayest know that I, the CHÚA, which call ngươi by Danh Ngài, là ĐCT của I-sơ-ra-ên.
For Gia-cốp my servant's sake, and I-sơ-ra-ên mine elect, I have even called ngươi by Danh Ngài: I have surnamed ngươi, though ngươi hast not known me.
I là the CHÚA, and there is none else, there is no God beside me: I girded ngươi, though ngươi hast not known me:
That they may know from the rising of mặt trời, Và from phương tây, that there is none beside me. I là the CHÚA, and there is none else.
I form the light, Và create tối tăm: I make peace, Và create evil: I the CHÚA do all these things.
Drop down, ye heavens, from above, Và let the skies pour down righteousness: let đất open, Và let them bring forth sự cứu rỗi, Và let righteousness spring up together; I the CHÚA have created it.
Khốn thay unto him that striveth with his Maker! Let the potsherd strive with the potsherds đất. Shall the clay say to him that fashioneth it, What makest thou? or thy work, He hath no hands?
Khốn thay unto him that nói unto his cha, What begettest thou? or to the woman, What hast ngươi brought forth?
Thus nói the CHÚA, the Holy One của I-sơ-ra-ên, Và his Maker, Ask me of things to come concerning my sons, Và concerning the work of my hands command ye me.
I have made đất, Và created man upon it: I, even my hands, have stretched out các tầng trời, Và all their host have I commanded.
I have raised him up in righteousness, Và I will direct all his ways: he shall build my city, Và he shall let go my captives, not for price nor reward, nói the CHÚA vạn quân. direct: or, make straight
Thus nói the CHÚA, The labour of Ai-Cập, Và merchandise of Ethiopia Và of the Sabeans, men of stature, shall come over unto ngươi, and they shall be thine: they shall come after ngươi; in chains they shall come over, Và they shall fall down unto ngươi, they shall make supplication unto ngươi, nói [rằng], Surely God is in ngươi; and there is none else, there is no ĐCT.
Quả thật thou art a God that hidest thyself, Hỡi ĐCT của I-sơ-ra-ên, the Saviour.
They lấy làm hổ thẹn, Và also confounded, all of them: they shall go to confusion together that are makers of idols.
But I-sơ-ra-ên shall được cứu in the CHÚA with an đời đời sự cứu rỗi: ngươi sẽ not be ashamed nor confounded thế gian without end.
For thus nói the CHÚA that created các tầng trời; ĐCT himself that formed đất Và made it; he hath established it, he created it not vô ích, he formed it to be inhabited: I là the CHÚA; and there is none else.
I have not spoken in secret, in a dark place đất: tôi nói not unto the seed of Gia-cốp, Seek ye me vô ích: I the CHÚA nói righteousness, I declare things that are right.
Assemble yourselves and come; draw near together, ye that are escaped of the nations: they have no knowledge that set up the wood of their graven image, Và pray unto a god that cannot save.
Tell ye, and bring họ gần; yea, let them take counsel together: who hath declared this from ancient time? ai hath told it from that time? have not I the CHÚA? and there is no God else beside me; a just ĐCT Và a Saviour; there is none beside me.
Look unto me, and be ye saved, all the ends đất: for I là ĐCT, and there is none else.
I have sworn by myself, the word is gone out of my mouth trong righteousness, Và shall not return, That unto me every knee shall bow, every tongue shall swear.
