Surely, shall one say, in the CHÚA have I righteousness Và strength: even to him shall men đến; Và all that are incensed against him lấy làm hổ thẹn. Surely…: or, Surely he shall say of me, In the CHÚA is all righteousness and strength righteousness: Heb. righteousnesses
In the CHÚA shall all the seed của I-sơ-ra-ên be justified, Và shall glory.

CHAPTER 46.
Bel boweth down, Nebo stoopeth, their idols were upon the beasts, Và upon the cattle: your carriages were heavy loaden; họ là a burden to the weary beast.
They stoop, they bow down together; they could not deliver the burden, but themselves are gone into captivity. themselves: Heb. their soul
Hearken unto me, O house of Gia-cốp, Và all the remnant của nhà của I-sơ-ra-ên, which are borne by me from the belly, which are carried from the womb:
Và even to your old age I là he; and even to hoar hairs will I carry you: I have made, Và I will bear; even I will carry, Và will deliver you.
To whom will ye liken me, and make me equal, Và compare me, that we may be like?
They lavish gold out of the bag, Và weigh silver in the balance, Và hire a goldsmith; Và he maketh it a god: they fall down, yea, they worship.
They bear him upon the shoulder, they carry him, and set him in his place, Và he standeth; from his place shall he not remove: yea, one shall cry unto him, yet can he not answer, nor save him out of his trouble.
nhớ this, and shew yourselves men: bring it again to mind, O ye transgressors.
nhớ the former things of old: for I là ĐCT, and there is none else; I am ĐCT, and there is none like me,
Declaring the end từ ban đầu, Và from ancient times the things that are not yet done, nói [rằng], My counsel shall stand, Và I will do all my pleasure:
Calling a ravenous bird from the east, the man that executeth my counsel from a far country: yea, I have spoken it, I will also bring it to pass; I have purposed it, I will also do it. that…: Heb. of my counsel
Hearken unto me, ye stouthearted, that are far from righteousness:
I bring near my righteousness; it shall not be far off, Và my salvation shall not tarry: Và I will place sự cứu rỗi in Si-ôn for I-sơ-ra-ên my glory.

CHAPTER 47.
Come down, Và sit in the dust, O virgin con gái of Ba-by-lôn, sit on the ground: there is no throne, O daughter of the Chaldeans: for ngươi shalt no more be called tender Và delicate.
Take the millstones, Và grind meal: uncover thy locks, make bare the leg, uncover the thigh, pass over the rivers.
Thy nakedness shall be uncovered, yea, thy shame shall be seen: I will take vengeance, Và I will not meet ngươi as một người.
As for our redeemer, the CHÚA vạn quân is his name, the Holy One của I-sơ-ra-ên.
Sit ngươi silent, Và get ngươi into darkness, O daughter of the Chaldeans: for ngươi shalt no more be called, The lady of kingdoms.
I nổi giận with my people, I have polluted mine inheritance, Và given them into thine hand: ngươi didst shew them no mercy; upon the ancient hast ngươi very heavily laid thy yoke.
Và ngươi nóist, I shall be a lady đến đời đời: so that ngươi didst not lay these things to thy heart, neither didst remember the latter end of it.
Therefore hear now this, ngươi that art given to pleasures, that ởest carelessly, that sayest in thine heart, I là, Và none else beside me; I shall not sit as a widow, neither shall I know the loss of children:
But these two things shall come to ngươi in a moment in one ngày, the loss of children, Và widowhood: they shall come upon ngươi in their perfection for đám đông of thy sorceries, Và for the great abundance of thine enchantments.
For ngươi hast trusted in thy wickedness: ngươi hast nói, None seeth me. Thy wisdom Và thy knowledge, it hath perverted ngươi; and ngươi hast nói in thine heart, I là, Và none else beside me. perverted…: or, caused ngươi to turn away
Therefore shall evil đến upon ngươi; ngươi shalt not know from whence it riseth: Và mischief shall fall upon ngươi; ngươi shalt not be able to put it off: Và desolation shall come upon ngươi bất chợt, which ngươi shalt not know. from…: Heb. buổi sáng thereof put: Heb. expiate
Stand now with thine enchantments, Và with đám đông of thy sorceries, wherein ngươi hast laboured from thy youth; if so be ngươi shalt be able to profit, if so be ngươi mayest prevail.
ngươi art wearied in đám đông of thy counsels. Let now the astrologers, ngôi saogazers, the monthly prognosticators, stand up, Và save ngươi from these things that shall come upon ngươi. astrologers: Heb. viewers of the heavens the monthly…: Heb. that give knowledge concerning the months
kìa, they shall be as stubble; lửa shall burn them; they shall not deliver themselves from quyền năng of the flame: there shall not be a coal to warm at, cũng không lửa to sit before it. themselves: Heb. their souls
Thus shall they be unto ngươi with whom ngươi hast laboured, even thy merchants, from thy youth: they shall wander every one to his quarter; none shall save ngươi.

CHAPTER 48.
nghe ye this, O house of Gia-cốp, which are called by Tên của I-sơ-ra-ên, Và are come forth out of the waters của Giu-đa, which swear by Tên of the CHÚA, Và make mention of ĐCT của I-sơ-ra-ên, but not in truth, nor in righteousness.
For they call themselves of the holy city, Và stay themselves upon ĐCT của I-sơ-ra-ên; The CHÚA vạn quân is his name.
I have declared the former things từ ban đầu; Và they went forth out of my mouth, Và I shewed them; I did họ bất chợt, Và they came to pass.
Because I knew that thou art obstinate, Và thy neck is an sắt sinew, Và thy brow brass; obstinate: Heb. hard
I have even from the beginning declared it to ngươi; before xảy đến I shewed it ngươi: lest ngươi shouldest say, Mine idol hath done them, and my graven image, Và my molten image, hath commanded them.
ngươi hast heard, thấy all this; and will not ye declare it? I have shewed ngươi new things from this time, even hidden things, Và ngươi didst not know them.
They are created now, and not from the beginning; even before ngày when ngươi heardest them not; lest ngươi shouldest say, kìa, I knew them.
Yea, ngươi heardest not; yea, ngươi knewest not; yea, from that time that thine ear was not opened: for I knew that ngươi wouldest deal very treacherously, Và wast called a transgressor from the womb.
For my name's sake will I defer mine anger, Và for my praise will I refrain for ngươi, that I cut ngươi not off.
kìa, I have refined ngươi, but not with silver; I have chosen ngươi in the furnace of affliction. with…: or, for silver
For mine own sake, even for mine own sake, will I do it: for how should my name be polluted? Và I will not give my glory unto another.
Hearken unto me, O Gia-cốp Và I-sơ-ra-ên, my called; I là he; I là the first, I also là cuối cùng.
Mine hand also hath laid the foundation đất, Và my tay phải hath spanned các tầng trời: khi I call với họ, they stand up together. my…: or, the palm of my tay phải hath spread out
All ye, assemble yourselves, and hear; which among them hath declared these things? The CHÚA hath loved him: he will do his pleasure on Ba-by-lôn, Và his arm shall be on the Chaldeans.
I, even I, have spoken; yea, I have called him: I have brought him, and he shall make his way prosperous.
đến ye near unto me, hear ye this; I have not spoken in secret từ ban đầu; from the time that it was, there là I: and now the Lord
God, Và his Spirit, hath sent me.
Thus nói the CHÚA, thy Redeemer, the Holy One của I-sơ-ra-ên; I là the CHÚA thy God which teacheth ngươi to profit, which leadeth ngươi by the way that ngươi shouldest go.
O that ngươi hadst hearkened to my commandments! then had thy peace been as a river, Và sự công chính của Ngài as the waves of biển:
Thy seed also had been as the sand, Và the offspring of thy bowels like the gravel thereof; his name should not have been cut off nor destroyed from before me.
Go ye forth of Ba-by-lôn, flee ye from the Chaldeans, with a voice of singing declare ye, tell this, utter it even to the end đất; say ye, The CHÚA hath redeemed his servant Gia-cốp.
Và they thirsted not khi he led them through the deserts: he caused the waters to flow out of the rock for them: he clave the rock also, and the waters gushed out.
There is no peace, nói the CHÚA, unto the wicked.

CHAPTER 49.
Listen, O isles, unto me; and hearken, ye people, from far; The CHÚA hath called me from the womb; from the bowels of my mother hath he made mention of my name.
Và he hath made my mouth like a sharp thanh gươm; in the shadow of his hand hath he hid me, and made me a polished shaft; in his quiver hath he hid me;
và nói unto me, Thou art my servant, O I-sơ-ra-ên, in whom I will be glorified.
Then tôi nói, I have laboured vô ích, I have spent my strength for nought, Và vô ích: yet surely my judgment is with the CHÚA, Và my work with my God. my work: or, my reward
Và now, nói the CHÚA that formed me from the womb to be his servant, to bring Gia-cốp again to him, Though I-sơ-ra-ên be not gathered, yet shall I be glorious in the eyes of the CHÚA, Và my God shall be my strength. Though…: or, That I-sơ-ra-ên may be gathered to him, and I may, etc
Và he nói, It is a light thing that ngươi shouldest be my servant to raise up the tribes of Gia-cốp, Và to restore the preserved của I-sơ-ra-ên: I will also give ngươi for a light to the Gentiles, that ngươi mayest be my salvation unto the end đất. It is…: or, Art ngươi lighter than that ngươi shouldest, etc preserved: or, desolations
Thus nói the CHÚA, the Redeemer của I-sơ-ra-ên, Và his Holy One, to him whom man despiseth, to him whom the nation abhorreth, to a servant of rulers, các vua sẽ thấy Và arise, princes also shall worship, vì cớ the CHÚA that is faithful, Và the Holy One của I-sơ-ra-ên, Và he shall choose ngươi. whom man…: or, that is despised in soul
Thus nói the CHÚA, In an acceptable time have I heard ngươi, and in a day của sự cứu rỗi have I helped ngươi: and I will preserve ngươi, and give ngươi for a covenant của dân sự, to establish đất, to cause to inherit the desolate heritages; establish: or, raise up
That ngươi mayest say to the prisoners, Go forth; to them that are in darkness, Shew yourselves. They shall feed in the ways, Và their pastures shall be in all high places.
They shall not hunger nor thirst; neither shall the heat nor sun smite them: for he that hath mercy on them shall lead them, even by the springs of water shall he guide them.
Và I will make all my mountains a way, Và my highways shall be exalted.
kìa, these shall come from far: and, lo, these from the north Và from phương tây; Và these from the land of Sinim.
Sing, O heavens; Và be joyful, O đất; Và break forth into singing, O mountains: for the CHÚA hath comforted his people, Và will have mercy upon his afflicted.
But Si-ôn nói, The CHÚA hath forsaken me, and my Lord hath forgotten me.
Can một người đờn bà forget her sucking child, that she should not have compassion on the son of dạ nàng? yea, they may forget, yet will I not forget ngươi. that…: Heb. from having compassion
kìa, I have graven ngươi upon the palms of my hands; thy walls are continually before me.
Thy children shall make haste; thy destroyers Và they that made ngươi waste shall go forth of ngươi.
Lift up thine eyes round about, Và kìa: all these gather themselves together, Và đến to ngươi. As I live, nói the CHÚA, ngươi shalt surely clothe ngươi with them all, as with an ornament, Và bind them on ngươi, as a bride làm.
For thy waste Và thy desolate places, Và the land of thy destruction, shall even now be too narrow by reason of the inhabitants, Và they that swallowed ngươi up shall be far away.
con cái which ngươi shalt have, after ngươi hast lost the other, shall say again in thine ears, The place is too strait for me: give place to me that I may ở.
Then shalt ngươi say in thine heart, Who hath begotten me these, seeing I have lost my children, Và am desolate, a captive, Và removing to and fro? Và who hath brought up these? kìa, I was left alone; these, where had they been?
Thus nói Chúa
God, kìa, I will lift up mine hand to the Gentiles, Và set up my standard to the people: Và they shall bring thy sons in their arms, Và thy daughters shall be carried upon their shoulders. arms: Heb. bosom
Và kings shall be thy nursing fathers, Và their queens thy nursing mothers: they shall bow down to ngươi with their mặt toward đất, Và lick up the dust of thy feet; Và ngươi shalt know that I là the CHÚA: for they shall not be ashamed that wait for me. nursing fathers: Heb. nourishers queens: Heb. princesses
Shall the prey be taken from the mighty, or the lawful captive delivered? lawful…: Heb. captivity of the just
But thus nói the CHÚA, Even the captives of the mighty shall be taken away, Và the prey of the terrible shall be delivered: for I will contend with him that contendeth with ngươi, and I will save thy children. captives: Heb. captivity
Và I will feed them that oppress ngươi with their own flesh; Và they shall be drunken with their own blood, as with sweet wine: Và all flesh shall know that I the CHÚA là thy Saviour Và thy Redeemer, the mighty One of Gia-cốp. sweet: or, new

CHAPTER 50.
Thus nói the CHÚA, Where is the bill of your mother's divorcement, whom I have put away? or which of my creditors is it to whom I have sold you? kìa, for your iniquities have ye sold yourselves, and for your transgressions is your mother put away.
Wherefore, when I came, was there không ai? when I called, was there none to answer? Is my hand shortened at all, that it cannot redeem? or have I no power to deliver? kìa, at my rebuke I dry up biển, I make the rivers a wilderness: their fish stinketh, because there is no water, Và dieth for thirst.
I clothe các tầng trời with blackness, Và I make vải bố their covering.
Chúa
God hath given me the tongue of the learned, that I should know how to speak a word in season to him that is weary: he wakeneth morning by morning, he wakeneth mine ear to hear as the learned.
Chúa
God hath opened mine ear, Và I was not rebellious, neither turned away back.
I gave my back to the smiters, Và my cheeks to them that plucked off the hair: I hid not my face from shame Và spitting.
For the Lord
God will help me; therefore shall I not be confounded: therefore have I set my face like a flint, Và I know that I shall not be ashamed.
He is gần that justifieth me; who will contend with me? let us stand together: who is mine adversary? let him come near to me. mine…: Heb. the master of my cause?
kìa, the Lord
God will help me; who is he that shall kết án me? lo, they all shall wax old as a garment; the moth shall eat them up.
Who is among you that feareth the CHÚA, that obeyeth tiếng of his servant, that walketh trong tối tăm, Và hath no light? let him trust in Tên of the CHÚA, Và stay upon his God.
kìa, all ye that kindle a fire, that compass yourselves about with sparks: walk in the light of your fire, Và in the sparks that ye have kindled. This shall ye have of mine hand; ngươi sẽ lie down in sorrow.

CHAPTER 51.
Hearken to me, ye that follow after righteousness, ye that seek the CHÚA: look unto the rock whence ye are hewn, Và to the hole of the pit whence ye are digged.
Look unto Áp-ra-ham your father, Và unto Sa-ra that bare you: for I called him alone, Và blessed him, and increased him.
For the CHÚA shall comfort Si-ôn: he will comfort all her waste places; Và he will make her wilderness like Ê-đen, Và her desert like vườn of the CHÚA; joy Và gladness shall be found therein, thanksgiving, Và the voice of melody.
Hearken unto me, my people; Và give ear unto me, O my nation: for a law shall proceed from me, and I will make my judgment to rest for a light của dân sự.
My righteousness is gần; my salvation is gone forth, Và mine arms shall judge the people; the isles shall wait upon me, and on mine arm shall they trust.
Lift up your eyes to the heavens, Và look trên đất beneath: for the heavens shall vanish away like smoke, Và đất shall wax old like a garment, Và they that ở therein shall die in like manner: but my salvation shall be đến đời đời, Và my righteousness shall not be abolished.
Hearken unto me, ye that know righteousness, the people in whose heart is my law; fear ye not the reproach of men, neither be ye afraid of their revilings.
For the moth shall eat them up like a garment, Và the worm shall eat them like wool: but my righteousness shall be đến đời đời, Và my salvation from generation to generation.
Awake, awake, put on strength, O arm of the CHÚA; awake, as in the ancient ngày, in dòng dõi of old. Art ngươi not it that hath cut Rahab, Và wounded the dragon?
Art ngươi not it which hath dried biển, the waters of the great deep; that hath made the depths of biển a way for the ransomed to pass over?
Therefore the redeemed of the CHÚA shall return, Và come with singing unto Si-ôn; Và đời đời joy shall be upon their head: they shall obtain gladness Và joy; Và sorrow Và than khóc shall flee away.
I, even I, là he that comforteth you: who art thou, that ngươi shouldest be afraid of a man that sẽ chết, Và của Con of man which shall be made as cỏ;
Và forgettest the CHÚA thy maker, that hath stretched forth các tầng trời, Và laid the foundations đất; Và hast feared continually every day vì of the fury of the oppressor, as if he were ready to destroy? and where is the fury of the oppressor? were…: or, made himself ready
The captive exile hasteneth that he may be loosed, Và that he should not die in the pit, nor that his bread should fail.
But I là the CHÚA thy God, that divided biển, whose waves roared: The CHÚA vạn quân is his name.
Và I have put my words in thy mouth, Và I have covered ngươi in the shadow of mine hand, that I may plant các tầng trời, Và lay the foundations đất, Và say unto Si-ôn, Thou art my people.
Awake, awake, stand up, O Giê-ru-sa-lem, which hast drunk at tay of the CHÚA the cup of his fury; ngươi hast drunken the dregs of the cup of trembling, Và wrung họ out.
There is none to guide her among all the sons whom she hath brought forth; neither is there any that taketh her by tay of all the sons that she hath brought up.
These two things are come unto ngươi; who shall be sorry for ngươi? desolation, Và destruction, Và the famine, Và thanh gươm: by whom shall I comfort ngươi? are…: Heb. happened destruction: Heb. breaking
Thy sons have fainted, they lie at the head of all the streets, as a wild bull in a net: they are full of the fury of the CHÚA, the rebuke of thy God.
Therefore hear now this, ngươi afflicted, Và drunken, but not with wine:
Thus nói thy Lord the CHÚA, Và thy God that pleadeth the cause of his people, kìa, I have taken out of thine hand the cup of trembling, even the dregs of the cup of my fury; ngươi shalt no more drink it again:
But I will put it into tay of them that afflict ngươi; which have nói to thy soul, Bow down, that we may go over: Và ngươi hast laid thy body as the ground, Và as the street, to them that went over.

CHAPTER 52.
Awake, awake; put on thy strength, O Si-ôn; put on thy beautiful garments, O Giê-ru-sa-lem, the holy city: for henceforth there shall no more đến into ngươi the uncircumcised Và the unclean.
Shake thyself from the dust; Hãy chổi dậy, Và sit down, O Giê-ru-sa-lem: loose thyself from the bands of thy neck, O captive con gái of Si-ôn.
For thus nói the CHÚA, Ye have sold yourselves for nought; Và ngươi sẽ be redeemed without money.
For thus nói Chúa
God, My people đi xuống aforetime into Ai-Cập to sojourn there; and the Assyrian oppressed them without cause.
Now therefore, what have I here, nói the CHÚA, that my people is taken away for nought? they that rule over them make them to howl, nói the CHÚA; Và my name continually every day is blasphemed.
Therefore my people shall know my name: therefore they shall know trong ngày đó that I là he that doth speak: kìa, it is I.
How beautiful upon núis are the feet of him that bringeth tin mừng, that publisheth peace; that bringeth tin mừng of good, that publisheth sự cứu rỗi; that nói unto Si-ôn, Thy God reigneth!
Thy watchmen shall lift up tiếng; with the voice together shall they sing: for they sẽ thấy mắt to eye, when the CHÚA shall bring again Si-ôn.
Break forth into joy, sing together, ye waste places of Giê-ru-sa-lem: for the CHÚA hath comforted his people, he hath redeemed Giê-ru-sa-lem.
The CHÚA hath made bare his holy arm in the eyes of all the nations; Và all the ends đất sẽ thấy the salvation of our God.
Depart ye, depart ye, go ye out from thence, touch no unclean thing; go ye out of the midst of her; be ye clean, that bear the vessels of the CHÚA.
For ngươi sẽ not go out with haste, nor go by flight: for the CHÚA will go before you; and ĐCT của I-sơ-ra-ên will be your rereward. be…: Heb. gather you up
kìa, my servant shall deal prudently, he shall be exalted Và extolled, Và be very high. deal…: or, prosper
As many were astonied at ngươi; his visage was so marred more than any man, Và his form more than the sons of men:
So shall he sprinkle many nations; các vua shall shut their mouths at him: for that which had not been told them họ sẽ thấy; and that which they had not heard shall they consider.

CHAPTER 53.
Who hath believed our report? Và to whom is the arm of the CHÚA revealed? report: or, doctrine?: Heb. hearing?
For he shall grow up before him as a tender plant, Và as a root out of a dry ground: he hath no form nor comeliness; Và when we sẽ thấy him, there is no beauty that we should desire him.
He is despised Và rejected of men; một người of sorrows, Và acquainted with grief: Và we hid as it were our faces from him; he was despised, Và we esteemed him not. we hid…: or, he hid as it were his face from us: Heb. as an hiding of faces from him, or, from us
Surely he hath borne our griefs, Và carried our sorrows: yet we did esteem him stricken, smitten của ĐCT, Và afflicted.
But he was wounded for our transgressions, he was bruised for our iniquities: the chastisement of our peace was upon him; and with his stripes we are healed. wounded: or, tormented stripes: Heb. bruise
All we like sheep have gone astray; we have turned every one to his own way; Và the CHÚA hath laid on him the iniquity of us all. laid…: Heb. made the iniquity of us all to meet on him
He was oppressed, Và he was afflicted, yet he opened not his mouth: he is brought as a lamb to the slaughter, Và as a sheep before her shearers is dumb, so he openeth not his mouth.
He was taken from prison Và from judgment: Và who shall declare his generation? for he was cut off out of the land of the living: for the transgression of my people was he stricken. from prison…: or, away by distress and judgment: but, etc was he…: Heb. was the stroke upon him
Và he made his grave with the wicked, Và with the rich in his death; because he had done no violence, neither was any deceit in his mouth. death: Heb. deaths
Yet it pleased the CHÚA to bruise him; he hath put him to grief: when ngươi shalt make his soul an offering for sin, he sẽ thấy his hạt giống, he shall prolong his ngày, Và the pleasure of the CHÚA shall prosper in his hand. thou…: or, his soul shall make an offering
He sẽ thấy of the travail of his soul, Và shall be satisfied: by his knowledge shall my righteous đầy tớ justify many; for he shall bear their iniquities.
Therefore will I divide him a portion with the great, Và he shall divide the spoil with the strong; because he hath poured out his soul unto death: Và he was numbered with the transgressors; Và he bare the sin of many, Và made intercession for the transgressors.

CHAPTER 54.
Sing, O barren, thou that didst not bear; break forth into singing, Và cry aloud, thou that didst not travail with child: for more are con cái of the desolate than the children of the married wife, nói the CHÚA.
Enlarge the place of thy tent, Và let them stretch forth the curtains of thine habitations: spare not, lengthen thy cords, Và strengthen thy stakes;
For ngươi shalt break forth on the tay phải Và on the left; Và thy seed shall inherit dân ngoại, Và make the desolate các thành to be inhabited.
Fear not; for ngươi shalt not be ashamed: neither be ngươi confounded; for ngươi shalt not be put to shame: for ngươi shalt forget the shame of thy youth, Và shalt not remember the reproach of thy widowhood any more.
For thy Maker is thine husband; the CHÚA vạn quân is his name; Và thy Redeemer the Holy One của I-sơ-ra-ên; The God of the whole đất shall he be called. Maker: Heb. Makers
For the CHÚA hath called ngươi as một người đờn bà forsaken Và grieved in spirit, Và a wife of youth, when ngươi wast refused, nói thy God.
For a small moment have I forsaken ngươi; but with great mercies will I gather ngươi.
In a little wrath I hid my face from ngươi for a moment; but with đời đời kindness will I have mercy on ngươi, nói the CHÚA thy Redeemer.
For this is as the waters of Nô-ê unto me: for as I have sworn that the waters of Nô-ê should no more go over đất; so have I sworn that I would not be wroth with ngươi, nor rebuke ngươi.
For núis shall depart, Và the hills be removed; but my kindness shall not depart from ngươi, neither shall the covenant of my peace be removed, nói the CHÚA that hath mercy on ngươi.
O ngươi afflicted, tossed with tempest, Và not comforted, kìa, I will lay thy stones with fair colours, Và lay thy foundations with sapphires.
Và I will make thy windows of agates, Và thy gates of carbuncles, Và all thy borders of pleasant stones.
Và all thy children shall be dạy of the CHÚA; Và great shall be sự bình an of thy children.
In righteousness shalt ngươi be established: ngươi shalt be far from oppression; for ngươi shalt not fear: Và from terror; for it shall not come near ngươi.
kìa, they shall surely gather together, but không by me: whosoever shall gather together against ngươi shall fall for thy sake.
kìa, I have created the smith that bloweth the coals in the fire, Và that bringeth forth an instrument for his work; Và I have created the waster to destroy.
No weapon that is formed against ngươi shall prosper; và mãi mãiy tongue that shall rise against ngươi in judgment ngươi shalt kết án. This is the heritage of the servants of the CHÚA, Và their righteousness is of me, nói the CHÚA.

CHAPTER 55.
Ho, every one that thirsteth, đến ye to the waters, Và he that hath no money; đến ye, buy, Và eat; yea, come, buy rượu nho Và milk without money Và without price.
Wherefore do ye spend tiền for that which is not bread? Và your labour for that which satisfieth không? hearken diligently unto me, and eat ye that which is tốt, Và let your soul delight itself in fatness. spend: Heb. weigh
Incline your ear, Và come unto me: hear, Và your soul sẽ sống; Và I will make an đời đời covenant with you, even the sure mercies của Đa-vít.
kìa, I have given him for một nhân chứng to the people, a leader Và commander to the people.
kìa, ngươi shalt call a nation that ngươi knowest not, and nations that knew not ngươi shall run unto ngươi vì cớ the CHÚA thy God, Và for the Holy One của I-sơ-ra-ên; for he hath glorified ngươi.
Seek ye the CHÚA while he may be found, call ye upon him while he is near:
Let the wicked forsake his way, Và the unrighteous man his thoughts: Và let him return unto the CHÚA, Và he will have mercy upon him; and to our God, for he will abundantly pardon. the unrighteous…: Heb. the man of iniquity abundantly…: Heb. multiply to pardon
For my thoughts are not your thoughts, neither are your ways my ways, nói the CHÚA.
For as các tầng trời are higher than đất, so are my ways higher than your ways, Và my thoughts than your thoughts.
For as the rain cometh down, Và the snow from heaven, Và returneth not thither, but watereth đất, Và maketh it bring forth Và bud, that it may give hạt giống to the sower, Và bread to the eater:
So shall my word be that goeth forth out of my mouth: it shall not return unto me void, but it shall accomplish that which I please, Và it shall prosper in the thing whereto I sent it.
For ngươi sẽ go out with joy, Và be led forth with peace: núis Và the hills shall break forth before you into singing, Và all the trees of the field shall clap their hands.
Instead of the thorn shall come up the fir tree, Và instead of the brier shall come up the myrtle tree: Và it shall be to the CHÚA for a name, for an đời đời sign that shall not be cut off.

CHAPTER 56.
Thus nói the CHÚA, Keep ye judgment, Và do justice: for my salvation is gần to come, Và my righteousness to be revealed. judgment: or, equity
phước is the man that làm this, and the son of man that layeth hold on it; that keepeth ngày Sa-bát from polluting it, and keepeth his hand from doing any evil.
Neither let the son of the stranger, that hath joined himself to the CHÚA, nói, nói [rằng], The CHÚA hath utterly separated me from his people: neither let the eunuch say, kìa, I là a dry cây.
For thus nói the CHÚA unto the eunuchs that keep my sabbaths, Và choose the things that please me, and take hold of my covenant;
Even với họ will I give in mine house Và within my walls một chỗ Và a name better than of sons Và of daughters: I will give them an đời đời name, that shall not be cut off.
Also the sons of the stranger, that join themselves to the CHÚA, to serve him, and to love Tên of the CHÚA, to be his servants, every one that keepeth ngày Sa-bát from polluting it, and taketh hold of my covenant;
Even them will I bring to my holy núi, Và make them joyful in my house of prayer: their burnt offerings Và their sacrifices shall be accepted upon mine altar; for mine house shall be called một căn nhà of prayer for all people.
Chúa
God which gathereth the outcasts của I-sơ-ra-ên nói, Yet will I gather Những người khác to him, beside those that are gathered unto him. beside…: Heb. to his gathered
All ye beasts of the field, đến to devour, yea, all ye beasts in the forest.
His watchmen are mù: they are all ignorant, they are all dumb dogs, they cannot bark; sleeping, lying down, loving to slumber. sleeping: or, dreaming, or, talking in their sleep
Yea, họ là greedy dogs which can never have enough, and they are shepherds that cannot understand: they all look to their own way, every one for his gain, from his quarter. greedy: Heb. strong of appetite can…: Heb. know not to be satisfied
đến ye, họ nói, I will fetch rượu nho, Và we will fill ourselves with strong drink; Và to morrow shall be as this day, Và much more abundant.

CHAPTER 57.
The righteous perisheth, Và không ai layeth it to heart: Và merciful men are taken away, none considering that the righteous is taken away từ the evil to come. merciful…: Heb. men of kindness, or, godliness from…: or, from that which is evil
He shall enter into peace: they shall rest in their beds, each one walking trong his uprightness. enter into: or, go in in his…: or, before him
But draw near hither, ye sons of the sorceress, the seed of the adulterer Và the whore.
Against whom do ye sport yourselves? against whom make ye a wide miệng, Và draw out lưỡi? are ye not children of transgression, a seed of falsehood,
Enflaming yourselves with idols under every green cây, slaying con cái in the valleys under the clifts of the rocks? with…: or, among the oaks
Among the smooth stones of the stream is thy portion; they, they are thy lot: even to them hast ngươi poured a uốngfering, ngươi hast offered a meat offering. Should I receive comfort in these?
Upon a lofty Và high núi hast ngươi set thy bed: even thither wentest ngươi up to offer sacrifice.
Behind the doors also and the posts hast ngươi set up thy remembrance: for ngươi hast discovered thyself to another than me, and art gone up; ngươi hast enlarged thy bed, Và made ngươi a covenant with them; ngươi lovedst their bed where ngươi sawest it. made…: or, hewed it for thyself larger than theirs where…: or, ngươi providedst room
Và ngươi wentest to the king with ointment, Và didst increase thy perfumes, Và didst send thy messengers far off, Và didst debase thyself even unto hell. thou…: or, ngươi respectedst
ngươi art wearied in the greatness of thy way; yet nóist ngươi not, There is no hy vọng: ngươi hast found sự sống of thine hand; therefore ngươi wast not grieved. sự sống: or, living
Và of whom hast ngươi been afraid or feared, that ngươi hast lied, Và hast not nhớ lại me, nor laid it to thy heart? have not I held my peace even of old, Và ngươi fearest me not?
I will declare sự công chính của Ngài, Và thy works; for they shall not profit ngươi.
When ngươi criest, let thy companies deliver ngươi; but the wind shall carry them all away; hư không shall take họ: but he that putteth his trust in me shall possess the land, Và shall inherit my holy núi;
Và shall say, Cast ye up, cast ye up, prepare đường, take up the stumblingblock out of the way of my people.
For thus nói the high Và lofty One that inhabiteth eternity, whose name is thánh; I ở in the high Và holy place, with him also that is of a contrite Và humble spirit, to revive the spirit of the humble, Và to revive the heart of the contrite ones.
For I will not contend đến đời đời, neither will I be always wroth: for the spirit should fail before me, and the souls which I have made.
For the iniquity of his covetousness was I wroth, Và smote him: I hid me, and nổi giận, Và he went on frowardly in the way of his heart. frowardly: Heb. turning away
I have seen his ways, Và will heal him: I will lead him also, and restore comforts unto him and to his mourners.
I create the fruit of the lips; Peace, peace to him that is far off, and to him that is gần, nói the CHÚA; Và I will heal him.
But the wicked are like the troubled sea, when it cannot rest, whose waters cast up mire Và dirt.
There is no peace, nói my God, to the wicked.

CHAPTER 58.
Cry aloud, spare not, lift up thy voice like a trumpet, Và shew my people their transgression, Và nhà of Gia-cốp their tội lỗi. aloud: Heb. with the throat
Yet họ thấyk me daily, Và delight to know my ways, as a nation that did righteousness, Và forsook not the ordinance of their God: they ask of me the ordinances of justice; they take delight in approaching to God.
Wherefore have we fasted, họ nói, Và ngươi seest not? wherefore have we afflicted linh hồn chúng tôi, Và ngươi takest no knowledge? kìa, trong ngày of your fast ye find pleasure, Và exact all your labours. labours: or, things wherewith ye grieve others: Heb. griefs
kìa, ye fast for strife Và debate, Và to smite with the fist of wickedness: ngươi sẽ not fast as ye do this ngày, to make your voice to be heard on high. ngươi sẽ…: or, ye fast not as this day
Is it such a fast that I have chosen? a day for a man to afflict his soul? is it to bow down his head as a bulrush, Và to spread vải bố Và ashes under him? wilt ngươi call này a fast, Và an acceptable ngày to the CHÚA? a day…: or, to afflict his soul for a day?
Is not this the fast that I have chosen? to loose the bands of wickedness, to undo the heavy burdens, Và to let the oppressed đi free, Và that ye break every yoke? the heavy…: Heb. the bundles of the yoke oppressed: Heb. broken
Is it not to deal thy bread to the hungry, Và that ngươi bring người nghèo that are cast out to thy house? when ngươi seest the naked, that ngươi cover him; and that ngươi hide not thyself from thine own flesh? cast…: or, afflicted
Then shall thy light break forth as buổi sáng, Và thine health shall spring forth speedily: Và sự công chính của Ngài shall go before ngươi; sự vinh hiển of the CHÚA shall be thy rereward. be…: Heb. gather ngươi up
Then shalt ngươi call, Và the CHÚA shall answer; ngươi shalt cry, Và he shall say, Here I là. If ngươi take away from the midst of ngươi the yoke, the putting forth of the finger, Và speaking hư không;
Và nếu ngươi draw out thy soul to the hungry, Và satisfy the afflicted soul; then shall thy light rise in obscurity, Và thy darkness be as the noonday:
Và the CHÚA shall guide ngươi continually, Và satisfy thy soul in drought, Và make fat thy bones: Và ngươi shalt be like a watered garden, Và like a spring of water, whose waters fail not. drought: Heb. droughts fail: Heb. lie, or, deceive
Và they that shall be of ngươi shall build the old waste places: ngươi shalt raise up the foundations of many generations; Và ngươi shalt be called, The repairer of the breach, The restorer of paths to ở in.
If ngươi turn away thy foot from ngày Sa-bát, từ doing thy pleasure on my holy ngày; Và call ngày Sa-bát a delight, the holy of the CHÚA, honourable; Và shalt honour him, not doing thine own ways, nor finding thine own pleasure, nor speaking thine own những lời:
Then shalt ngươi delight thyself in the CHÚA; Và I will cause ngươi to ride upon the high places đất, Và feed ngươi with the heritage of Gia-cốp thy father: for the mouth of the CHÚA hath spoken it.

CHAPTER 59.
kìa, the Lord's tay is not shortened, that it cannot save; neither his ear heavy, that it cannot hear:
But your iniquities have separated between you and your God, Và your tội lỗi have hid his mặt from you, that he will not hear. have hid: or, have made him hide
For your hands are làm dơ dáyd with blood, Và your fingers with iniquity; your lips have spoken lies, your tongue hath muttered perverseness.
None calleth for justice, nor any pleadeth for truth: they trust vào sự hư không, Và nói dối; they conceive mischief, Và bring forth iniquity.
They hatch cockatrice' eggs, Và giăng màng nhện; he that eateth of their eggs dieth, Và that which is crushed breaketh out into a viper. cockatrice': or, adder's crushed…: or, sprinkled is as if there brake out a viper
Their webs shall not become garments, neither shall they cover themselves with their works: việc làm của chúng [là] việc làm of iniquity, Và the act of violence is in their hands.
Chân chúng chạy đến sự gian ác, Và they make haste để đổ huyết vô tội; their thoughts are thoughts of iniquity; wasting Và destruction are in their paths. destruction: Heb. breaking
con đường hòa bình they know not; and there is no judgment in their goings: they have made them crooked paths: whosoever goeth therein shall not know peace. judgment: or, right
Therefore is judgment far from us, neither doth justice overtake us: we wait for light, but kìa obscurity; for brightness, but we walk in darkness.
We grope for the wall like the blind, Và we grope as if we had no eyes: we stumble at noonday as in the night; we are in desolate places as dead men.
We roar all like bears, Và mourn sore like bồ câu: we look for judgment, but there is none; for salvation, but it is far off from us.
For our transgressions are multiplied before ngươi, and our tội lỗi testify against us: for our transgressions are with us; and as for our iniquities, we know them;
In transgressing Và lying against the CHÚA, Và departing away từ ĐCT chúng tôi, speaking oppression Và revolt, conceiving Và uttering from the heart những lời of falsehood.
Và judgment is turned away backward, Và justice standeth afar off: for truth is fallen in the street, Và equity không thể enter.
Yea, truth faileth; and he that departeth from evil maketh himself a prey: Và the CHÚA nhìn thấy it, Và it displeased him that there was no judgment. maketh…: or, is accounted mad it displeased…: Heb. it was evil in his eyes
Và he saw that there was không ai, Và wondered that there was no intercessor: therefore his arm brought salvation unto him; and his righteousness, it sustained him.
For he put on righteousness as a breastplate, Và an helmet của sự cứu rỗi upon his head; Và he put on the garments of vengeance for clothing, Và was clad with zeal as a cloke.
According to their deeds, accordingly he will repay, fury to his adversaries, recompence to his enemies; to the islands he will repay recompence. deeds: Heb. recompences
So shall they fear Tên of the CHÚA from phương tây, Và his glory from the rising of mặt trời. When the enemy shall come in like a flood, [Thánh] Linh of the CHÚA shall lift up a standard against him. lift…: or, put him to flight
Và the Redeemer shall come to Si-ôn, Và với họ that turn from transgression in Gia-cốp, nói the CHÚA.
As for me, this is my covenant with them, nói the CHÚA; My spirit that is upon ngươi, and my words which I have put in thy mouth, shall not depart out of thy mouth, nor out of the mouth of thy seed, nor out of the mouth of thy seed's hạt giống, nói the CHÚA, from henceforth and for ever.

CHAPTER 60.
Hãy chổi dậy, shine; for thy light is come, Và sự vinh hiển of the CHÚA is risen upon ngươi. shine…: or, be enlightened; for thy light cometh
For, kìa, the darkness shall cover đất, Và gross darkness the people: but the CHÚA shall arise upon ngươi, and his glory shall be seen upon ngươi.
Và the Gentiles shall come to thy light, Và kings to the brightness of thy rising.
Lift up thine eyes round about, Và see: all they gather themselves together, they come to ngươi: thy sons shall come from far, Và thy daughters shall be nursed at thy side.
Then ngươi shalt see, Và flow together, Và thine heart shall fear, Và be enlarged; because the abundance of biển shall be converted unto ngươi, the forces của dân ngoại shall come unto ngươi. abundance…: or, noise of biển shall be turned toward ngươi forces: or, wealth
đám đông of lạc đà shall cover ngươi, the dRô-madaries of Midian Và Ephah; all they from Sheba shall come: they shall bring gold Và incense; Và they shall shew forth the praises of the CHÚA.
All the flocks of Kedar shall be gathered together unto ngươi, the rams of Nebaioth shall minister unto ngươi: they shall come up with acceptance on mine altar, Và I will glorify nhà of my glory.
Who are these that fly as a cloud, Và as the bồ câu to their windows?
Surely the isles shall wait for me, and the ships of Tarshish first, to bring thy sons from far, their silver Và their gold with them, unto Tên of the CHÚA thy God, Và to the Holy One của I-sơ-ra-ên, because he hath glorified ngươi.
Và the sons of strangers shall build up thy walls, Và their kings shall minister unto ngươi: for in my wrath I smote ngươi, but in my favour have I had mercy on ngươi.
Therefore thy gates shall be open continually; they shall not be shut ngày nor night; that men may bring unto ngươi the forces của dân ngoại, and that their kings may be brought. forces: or, wealth
For the nation Và kingdom that will not serve ngươi shall perish; yea, those nations shall be utterly wasted.
The glory of Lebanon shall come unto ngươi, the fir tree, the pine tree, Và the box together, to beautify the place of my sanctuary; Và I will make the place of my feet glorious.
The sons also of them that afflicted ngươi shall come bending unto ngươi; and all they that despised ngươi shall bow themselves down at the soles of thy feet; Và they shall call ngươi, The city of the CHÚA, The Si-ôn of the Holy One của I-sơ-ra-ên.
Whereas ngươi hast been forsaken Và hated, so that không ai went through ngươi, I will make ngươi an đời đời excellency, a joy of many generations.
ngươi shalt also suck the milk của dân ngoại, Và shalt suck the breast of kings: Và ngươi shalt know that I the CHÚA là thy Saviour Và thy Redeemer, the mighty One of Gia-cốp.
For brass I will bring gold, Và for sắt I will bring silver, Và for wood brass, Và for stones sắt: I will also make thy officers peace, Và thine exactors righteousness.
Violence shall no more be heard in thy land, wasting nor destruction within thy borders; but ngươi shalt call thy walls sự cứu rỗi, Và thy gates Praise.
mặt trời shall be no more thy light by day; neither for brightness shall the moon give light unto ngươi: but the CHÚA shall be unto ngươi an đời đời light, Và thy God thy glory.
Thy sun shall no more go down; neither shall thy moon withdraw itself: for the CHÚA shall be thine đời đời light, Và the days of thy than khóc shall be ended.
Thy people also shall be all righteous: they shall inherit the land đến đời đời, the branch of my planting, the work of my hands, that I may be glorified.
A little one shall become a thousand, Và a small one a strong nation: I the CHÚA will hasten it in his time.

CHAPTER 61.
The Spirit của ĐCT
God is upon me; because the CHÚA hath anointed me to preach tin mừng unto the meek; he hath sent me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives, Và the opening of the prison to them that are bound;
To proclaim the acceptable năm of the CHÚA, Và the day of vengeance of our God; to comfort all that mourn;
To appoint với họ that mourn in Si-ôn, để cho với họ beauty for ashes, the oil of joy for than khóc, the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness; that they might be called trees of righteousness, the planting of the CHÚA, that he might be glorified.
Và they shall build the old wastes, they shall raise up the former desolations, Và they shall repair the waste các thành, the desolations of many generations.
Và strangers shall stand Và feed your flocks, Và the sons of the alien shall be your plowmen Và your vinedressers.
But ngươi sẽ be named những thầy tế lễ of the CHÚA: men shall call you the Ministers of our God: ngươi sẽ eat the riches của dân ngoại, Và in their glory shall ye boast yourselves.
For your shame ngươi sẽ have double; and for confusion they shall rejoice in their portion: therefore in their land they shall possess the double: đời đời joy shall be với họ.
For I the CHÚA love judgment, I hate robbery for burnt offering; Và I will direct their work in truth, Và I will make an đời đời covenant with them.
Và their seed shall be known among the Gentiles, Và their offspring among the people: all that see them shall acknowledge them, that they are the seed which the CHÚA đã ban phước.
I will greatly rejoice in the CHÚA, my soul shall be joyful in my God; for he hath clothed me with the garments của sự cứu rỗi, he hath covered me with the robe of righteousness, as a bridegroom decketh himself with ornaments, Và as a bride adorneth herself with her jewels. decketh: Heb. decketh as a priest
For as đất bringeth forth her bud, Và as vườn causeth the things that are sown in it to spring forth; so the Lord
God will cause righteousness Và praise to spring forth before all the nations.

CHAPTER 62.
For Si-ôn's sake will I not hold my peace, Và for Giê-ru-sa-lem's sake I will not rest, until the righteousness thereof go forth as brightness, Và the salvation thereof as a lamp that burneth.
Và the Gentiles sẽ thấy sự công chính của Ngài, Và all kings thy glory: Và ngươi shalt be called by a new name, which the mouth of the CHÚA shall name.
ngươi shalt also be a crown of glory in tay of the CHÚA, Và a royal diadem in tay of thy God.
ngươi shalt no more be termed Forsaken; neither shall thy land any more be termed Desolate: but ngươi shalt be called Hephzi–bah, Và thy land Beulah: for the CHÚA delighteth in ngươi, and thy land shall be married. Hephzi–bah: that is, My delight is in her Beulah: that is, Married
For as a young man cưới một trinh nữ, so shall thy sons marry ngươi: and as chàng rể mừng vui over the bride, so shall thy God rejoice over ngươi. as the…: Heb. with sự vui mừng của chàng rể
I have set watchmen upon thy walls, O Giê-ru-sa-lem, which shall never hold their peace ngày nor night: ye that make mention of the CHÚA, keep not silence,make…: or, are the Lord's remembrancers
Và give him no rest, till he establish, Và till he make Giê-ru-sa-lem a praise in đất. rest: Heb. silence
The CHÚA hath sworn by his tay phải, Và by the arm of his strength, Surely I will no more give thy corn to be meat for thine enemies; Và the sons of the stranger shall not drink thy wine, for the which ngươi hast laboured: Surely…: Heb. If I give, etc
But they that have gathered it shall eat it, and praise the CHÚA; Và they that have brought it together shall drink it in the courts of my holiness.
Go through, go through the gates; prepare ye the way của dân sự; cast up, cast up the highway; gather out the stones; lift up a standard for the people.
kìa, the CHÚA hath proclaimed unto the end of the world, Say ye to con gái of Si-ôn, kìa, sự cứu rỗi của Ngài đến; kìa, his reward is with him, and his work before him. work: or, recompence
Và they shall call them, The holy people, The redeemed of the CHÚA: Và ngươi shalt be called, Sought out, A city not forsaken.

CHAPTER 63.
Who is this that cometh from Edom, with dyed garments from Bozrah? this that is glorious in his apparel, travelling in the greatness of his strength? I that speak in righteousness, mighty to save. glorious: Heb. decked
Wherefore art thou red in thine apparel, Và thy garments like him that treadeth in the winefat?
I have trodden the winepress alone; and của dân sự there was none with me: for I will tread them in mine anger, Và trample them in my fury; Và their blood shall be sprinkled upon my garments, Và I will stain all my raiment.
For the day of vengeance is in mine heart, Và the year of my redeemed is come.
Và I looked, and there was none to help; Và I wondered that there was none to uphold: therefore mine own arm brought salvation unto me; and my fury, it upheld me.
Và I will tread down the people in mine anger, Và make them drunk in my fury, Và I will bring down their strength to đất.
I will mention the lovingkindnesses of the CHÚA, Và the praises of the CHÚA, according to all that the CHÚA hath bestowed on us, and the great goodness toward nhà của I-sơ-ra-ên, which he hath bestowed on them according to his mercies, Và according to đám đông of his lovingkindnesses.
For he nói, Surely they are my people, children that will not lie: so he was their Saviour.
In all their affliction he was afflicted, Và thiên sứ of his presence saved them: in his love Và in his pity he redeemed them; and he bare them, and carried them all the days of old.
But they rebelled, Và vexed his holy Spirit: therefore he was turned to be their enemy, Và he fought against them.
Then he nhớ lại the days of old, Môi-se, Và his people, nói [rằng], Where is he that brought them up out of biển with the shepherd of his flock? where is he that put his holy Spirit within him? shepherd: or, shepherds
That led họ bên tay phải of Môi-se with his glorious arm, dividing nước before them, to make himself an đời đời name?
That led them through the deep, as an horse in the wilderness, that they should not stumble?
As a beast goeth down into the valley, [Thánh] Linh of the CHÚA caused him to rest: so didst ngươi lead thy people, to make thyself a glorious name.
Look down from heaven, Và kìa from the habitation of thy holiness Và of thy glory: where is thy zeal Và thy strength, the sounding of thy bowels Và of thy mercies toward me? are they restrained? the sounding: or, đám đông
Doubtless thou art our father, though Áp-ra-ham be ignorant of us, and I-sơ-ra-ên acknowledge us not: thou, O CHÚA, art our father, our redeemer; Danh Ngài is from đời đời. our redeemer…: or, our redeemer from đời đời is Danh Ngài
O CHÚA, why hast ngươi made us to err from thy ways, Và hardened our heart from thy fear? Return for thy servants' sake, the tribes of thine inheritance.
The people of thy holiness have possessed it but ít lâu: our adversaries have trodden down thy sanctuary.
We are thine: ngươi never barest rule over them; they were not called by Danh Ngài. they…: Heb. Danh Ngài was not called upon them

CHAPTER 64.
Oh that ngươi wouldest rend các tầng trời, that ngươi wouldest come down, that núis might flow down at thy presence,
As khi the melting lửa burneth, lửa causeth the waters to boil, to make Danh Ngài known to thine adversaries, that the nations may tremble at thy presence!the melting…: Heb. the fire of meltings
When ngươi didst terrible things which we looked not for, ngươi camest down, núis flowed down at thy presence.
For since the beginning of the world men have not heard, nor perceived by the ear, neither hath the eye seen, Hỡi ĐCT, beside ngươi, what he hath prepared for him that waiteth for him. seen…: or, seen a God beside ngươi, which doeth so for him, etc
ngươi meetest him that mừng vui Và worketh righteousness, those that nhớ ngươi in thy ways: kìa, ngươi art wroth; for we have sinned: in those is continuance, Và we shall được cứu.
But we are all as an unclean thing, Và all our righteousnesses are as filthy rags; Và we all do fade as a leaf; Và our iniquities, like the wind, have taken us away.
Và there is none that calleth upon Danh Ngài, that stirreth up himself to take hold of ngươi: for ngươi hast hid thy face from us, and hast consumed us, because of our iniquities. consumed: Heb. melted because: Heb. by tay
But now, O CHÚA, thou art our father; we are the clay, Và ngươi our potter; and we all are the work of thy hand.
Be not wroth very sore, O CHÚA, neither remember iniquity đến đời đời: kìa, see, we beseech ngươi, we are all thy people.
Thy holy các thành are a wilderness, Si-ôn is a wilderness, Giê-ru-sa-lem a desolation.
Our holy Và our beautiful nhà, where our fathers praised ngươi, is burned up bằng lửa: Và all our pleasant things are laid waste.
Wilt ngươi refrain thyself for these things, O CHÚA? wilt ngươi hold thy peace, Và afflict us very sore?

CHAPTER 65.
I am sought of them that asked không for me; I am found of them that sought me not: tôi nói, kìa me, kìa me, unto a nation that was not called by my name.
I have spread out my hands all the day unto a rebellious people, which walketh in a way that was không tốt, after their own thoughts;
A people that provoketh me to anger continually to my face; that sacrificeth in gardens, Và burneth incense upon altars of brick; upon…: Heb. upon bricks
Which remain among the graves, Và lodge in the monuments, which eat swine's flesh, Và broth of abominable things is in their vessels; broth: or, pieces
Which say, Stand by thyself, come not near to me; for I am holier than thou. These are a smoke in my nose, a fire that burneth all the day. nose: or, anger
kìa, it is written before me: I will not keep silence, but will recompense, even recompense into their bosom,
Your iniquities, Và the iniquities of your fathers together, nói the CHÚA, which have burned incense upon núis, Và blasphemed me upon the hills: therefore will I measure their former work into their bosom.
Thus nói the CHÚA, As the new wine is found in the cluster, and one nói, Destroy it not; for a blessing is in it: so will I do for my servants' sakes, that I may not destroy them all.
Và I will bring forth a seed out of Gia-cốp, Và out của Giu-đa an inheritor of my mountains: Và mine elect shall inherit it, and my servants shall ở there.
Và Sharon shall be a fold of flocks, Và the valley of Achor một chỗ for the herds to lie down in, for my people that have sought me.
But ye are they that forsake the CHÚA, that forget my holy núi, that prepare a table for that troop, Và that furnish the uốngfering unto that number. troop: or, Gad number: or, Meni, a pagan god
Therefore will I number you to thanh gươm, Và ngươi sẽ all bow down to the slaughter: because when I called, ye did not answer; when I spake, ye did not hear; but did evil before mine eyes, Và did choose that wherein I delighted not.
Therefore thus nói Chúa
God, kìa, my servants shall eat, but ngươi sẽ be hungry: kìa, my servants shall drink, but ngươi sẽ be thirsty: kìa, my servants shall rejoice, but ngươi sẽ be ashamed:
kìa, my servants shall sing for joy of heart, but ngươi sẽ cry for sorrow of heart, Và shall howl for vexation of spirit. vexation: Heb. breaking
Và ngươi sẽ leave your name for a curse unto my chosen: for the Lord
God shall slay ngươi, and call his servants by another name:
That he who blesseth himself in đất shall bless himself in ĐCT of truth; Và he that sweareth in đất shall swear by ĐCT of truth; because the former troubles are forgotten, Và because they are hid from mine eyes.
For, kìa, I create mới heavens Và a new đất: Và the former shall not be nhớ lại, nor come into mind. come…: Heb. come upon the heart
But be ye glad Và rejoice đến đời đời in that which I create: for, kìa, I create Giê-ru-sa-lem a rejoicing, Và her people a joy.
Và I will rejoice in Giê-ru-sa-lem, Và joy in my people: Và the voice of weeping shall be no more heard in her, nor the voice of crying.
There shall be no more thence an infant of days, nor an old man that hath not filled his days: for the child sẽ chết một trăm năm old; but the sinner being một trăm năm old shall be accursed.
Và they shall build houses, Và inhabit họ; Và they shall plant vườn nhos, Và eat the fruit of them.
They shall not build, Và another inhabit; they shall not plant, Và another ăn: for as the days of a tree are the days of my people, Và mine elect shall long enjoy the work of their hands. shall long…: Heb. shall make them continue long, or, shall wear out
They shall not labour vô ích, nor bring forth for trouble; for they are the seed of the blessed of the CHÚA, Và their offspring with them.
Và it shall come to pass, that before they call, I will answer; Và while they are yet speaking, I will hear.
The wolf Và the lamb shall feed together, Và the lion shall eat straw like the bullock: Và dust shall be con rắn's meat. They shall not hurt nor destroy in all my holy núi, nói the CHÚA.

CHAPTER 66.
Thus nói the CHÚA, The heaven is my throne, Và đất is my footstool: where is nhà that ye build unto me? and where is the place of my rest?
For all those things hath mine hand made, and all those things have been, nói the CHÚA: but to this man will I look, even to him that is poor Và of a contrite spirit, Và trembleth at my word.
He that killeth một con bò is as if he slew một người; he that sacrificeth a lamb, as if he cut off a dog's cổ; he that offereth an oblation, as if he offered swine's huyết; he that burneth incense, as if he blessed an idol. Yea, they have chosen their own ways, Và their soul delighteth in their abominations. lamb: or, kid burneth: Heb. maketh a memorial of
I also will choose their delusions, Và will bring their fears upon them; because when I called, none did answer; when I spake, they did not hear: but they did evil before mine eyes, Và chose that in which I delighted not. delusions: or, devices
nghe lời of the CHÚA, ye that tremble at his word; Your brethren that hated you, that cast you out for my name's sake, nói, Let the CHÚA be glorified: but he shall appear to your joy, Và they lấy làm hổ thẹn.
A voice of noise from the city, a voice from đền thờ, a voice of the CHÚA that rendereth recompence to his enemies.
Before she travailed, she brought forth; before her pain đến, she was delivered of a man child.
Who hath heard such a thing? who hath seen such things? Shall đất be made to bring forth in one ngày? or shall a nation be born at once? for as soon as Si-ôn travailed, she brought forth her children.
Shall I bring to the birth, Và not cause to bring forth? nói the CHÚA: shall I cause to bring forth, Và shut the womb? nói thy God. not…: or, not beget?
Rejoice ye with Giê-ru-sa-lem, Và be glad with her, all ye that love her: rejoice for joy with her, all ye that mourn for her:
That ye may suck, Và be satisfied with the breasts of her consolations; that ye may milk out, Và be delighted with the abundance of her glory. abundance: or, brightness
For thus nói the CHÚA, kìa, I will extend peace to her like a river, Và sự vinh hiển của dân ngoại like a flowing stream: then shall ye suck, ngươi sẽ be borne upon her sides, Và be dandled upon her knees.
As one whom his mother comforteth, so will I comfort you; and ngươi sẽ được yên ủi in Giê-ru-sa-lem.
Và when ye see này, your heart shall rejoice, Và your bones shall flourish like an herb: Và tay of the CHÚA shall be known toward his servants, and his indignation toward his enemies.
For, kìa, the CHÚA will come bằng lửa, Và with his chariots like a whirlwind, to render his anger with fury, Và his rebuke with flames lửa.
For by fire Và by his thanh gươm will the CHÚA plead with all flesh: Và the slain of the CHÚA shall be many.
They that sanctify themselves, and purify themselves in vườns behind một cây in the midst, eating swine's flesh, Và the abomination, Và the mouse, shall be consumed together, nói the CHÚA. behind…: or, one after another
For I biết their works Và their thoughts: it shall come, that I will gather all nations Và tongues; Và they shall come, Và see my glory.
Và I will set a sign among them, and I will send those that escape of them unto the nations, to Tarshish, Pul, Và Lud, that draw the bow, to Tubal, Và Javan, to the isles afar off, that have not heard my fame, neither have seen my glory; Và they shall declare my glory among the Gentiles.
Và they shall bring all your brethren for an offering unto the CHÚA out of all nations upon horses, Và in chariots, Và in litters, Và upon mules, Và upon swift beasts, to my holy núi Giê-ru-sa-lem, nói the CHÚA, as the children của I-sơ-ra-ên bring an offering in a clean vessel inđến nhà of the CHÚA. litters: or, coaches
Và I will also take of them for priests Và for Levites, nói the CHÚA.
For as the new heavens Và the new đất, which I will make, shall remain before me, nói the CHÚA, so shall your seed Và your name remain.
Và it shall come to pass, that từ one new moon to another, Và from one sabbath to another, shall all flesh đến để thờ phượng before me, nói the CHÚA. from one new…: Heb. from new moon to his new moon, and from sabbath to his sabbath
Và they shall go forth, Và look upon the carcases of the men that have transgressed against me: for their worm shall not die, neither shall their fire be quenched; Và they shall be an abhorring unto all flesh.

div.title: THE BOOK OF THE PROPHET Giê-rê-mi
div.chapter:
CHAPTER 1.
những lời of Giê-rê-mi con trai of Hilkiah, of the priests that were in Anathoth in the land of Bên-gia-min:
To whom the word of the CHÚA came trong những ngày of Josiah con trai of Amon vua của Giu-đa, in the thirteenth năm of his reign.
It came also trong những ngày of Jehoiakim con trai of Josiah vua của Giu-đa, unto the end of the eleventh năm of Zedekiah con trai of Josiah vua của Giu-đa, unto the carrying away of Giê-ru-sa-lem captive in the fifth month.
Then the word of the CHÚA came unto me, saying,
Before I formed ngươi in the belly I knew ngươi; and before ngươi camest forth out of the womb I sanctified ngươi, Và I ordained ngươi a prophet unto the nations. ordained: Heb. gave
Then nói I, Ah, Lord
God! kìa, I cannot nói: for I là a child.
But the CHÚA nói unto me, Say not, I là a child: for ngươi shalt go to all that I shall send ngươi, and bất cứ điều chi I command ngươi ngươi shalt speak.
Be not afraid of their faces: for I là with ngươi to deliver ngươi, nói the CHÚA.
Then the CHÚA put forth his hand, Và touched my mouth. Và the CHÚA nói unto me, kìa, I have put my words in thy mouth.
thấy, I have this day set ngươi over the nations Và over the kingdoms, to root out, Và to pull down, Và to destroy, Và to throw down, to build, Và to plant.
Moreover the word of the CHÚA came unto me, saying, Giê-rê-mi, what seest thou? And tôi nói, I see a rod of an almond tree.
Then nói the CHÚA unto me, ngươi hast well seen: for I will hasten my word to perform it.
Và the word of the CHÚA came unto me the second time, nói [rằng], What seest thou? And tôi nói, I see a seething pot; Và mặt thereof is toward the north. toward…: Heb. from mặt of the north
Then the CHÚA nói unto me, Out of the north an evil shall break forth upon all the inhabitants of the land. shall…: Heb. sẽ được mở ra
For, lo, I will call all the families of the kingdoms of the north, nói the CHÚA; Và they shall come, Và they shall set every one his throne at the entering of the gates of Giê-ru-sa-lem, Và against all the walls thereof round about, Và against all the cities của Giu-đa.
Và I will utter my judgments against them touching all their wickedness, who have forsaken me, and have burned incense unto other gods, Và worshipped những công việc of their own hands.
ngươi therefore gird up thy loins, Và arise, Và speak với họ all that I command ngươi: be not dismayed at their faces, lest I confound ngươi before them. confound: or, break to pieces
For, kìa, I have made ngươi this day a defenced city, Và an sắt pillar, Và brasen walls against the whole land, against các vua của Giu-đa, against the princes thereof, against the priests thereof, and against the people of the land.
Và they shall fight against ngươi; but they shall not prevail against ngươi; for I là with ngươi, nói the CHÚA, to deliver ngươi.

CHAPTER 2.
Moreover the word of the CHÚA came to me, saying,
đi Và cry in the ears of Giê-ru-sa-lem, nói [rằng], Thus nói the CHÚA; I remember ngươi, the kindness of thy youth, tình yêu of thine espousals, when ngươi wentest after me in the wilderness, in a land that was not sown. ngươi: or, for thy sake
I-sơ-ra-ên was holiness unto the CHÚA, Và the firstfruits of his increase: all that devour him shall offend; evil shall come upon them, nói the CHÚA.
nghe ye the word of the CHÚA, O house of Gia-cốp, Và all the families của nhà của I-sơ-ra-ên:
Thus nói the CHÚA, What iniquity have your fathers found in me, that they are gone far from me, and have walked after hư không, Và are become vain?
Neither nói they, Where is the CHÚA that brought us up out of the land of Ai-Cập, that led us through the wilderness, through a land of deserts Và of pits, through a land of drought, Và of the shadow of death, through a land that không ai passed through, Và where không ai dwelt?
Và I brought you into a plentiful country, to eat the fruit thereof and the goodness thereof; but when ye entered, ye làm dơ dáyd my land, Và made mine heritage an abomination. a plentiful…: or, the land of Carmel
những thầy tế lễ nói not, Where is the CHÚA? Và they that handle luật pháp knew me not: the pastors also transgressed against me, and các tiên tri prophesied by Baal, Và walked after things that do not profit.
Wherefore I will yet plead with you, nói the CHÚA, Và with your children's children will I plead.
For pass over the isles of Chittim, Và see; Và send unto Kedar, Và consider diligently, Và see if there be such a thing. over: or, over to
Hath a nation changed their gods, which are yet no gods? but my people have changed their glory for that which doth not profit.
Be astonished, O ye heavens, at this, and be horribly afraid, be ye very desolate, nói the CHÚA.
For my people have committed hai evils; they have forsaken me the fountain of living waters, Và hewed them out cisterns, broken cisterns, that can hold no water.
Is I-sơ-ra-ên một đầy tớ? is he a homeborn slave? why is he spoiled? spoiled: Heb. become a spoil?
The young lions roared upon him, Và yelled, Và they made his land waste: his cities are burned without inhabitant. yelled: Heb. gave out their voice
Also the children of Noph Và Tahapanes have broken the crown of thy head. have…: or, feed on thy crown
Hast ngươi not procured this unto thyself, in that ngươi hast forsaken the CHÚA thy God, khi he led ngươi by the way?
Và now what hast ngươi to do in the way of Ai-Cập, để uống the waters of Sihor? or what hast ngươi to do in the way of A-si-ri, để uống the waters of the river?
Thine own wickedness shall correct ngươi, and thy backslidings shall reprove ngươi: know therefore and see that it is an evil thing Và bitter, that ngươi hast forsaken the CHÚA thy God, Và that my fear is not in ngươi, nói Chúa
God vạn quân.
For of old time I have broken thy yoke, Và burst thy bands; Và ngươi nóist, I will not transgress; when upon every high đồi Và under every green cây ngươi wanderest, playing the harlot. transgress: or, serve
Yet I had planted ngươi a noble vine, wholly a right hạt giống: how then art ngươi turned into the degenerate plant of a strange vine unto me?
For though ngươi wash ngươi with nitre, Và take ngươi much soap, yet thine iniquity is marked before me, nói Chúa
God.
How canst ngươi say, I am not polluted, I have not gone after Baalim? thấy thy way in the valley, biết what ngươi hast done: ngươi art a swift dRô-madary traversing her ways; ngươi art…: or, O swift dRô-madary
A wild ass used to the wilderness, that snuffeth up gió at her pleasure; in her occasion who can turn her away? all they that seek her will not weary themselves; in her month they shall find her. A wild…: or, O wild ass, etc used: Heb. taught her pleasure: Heb. the desire of her heart turn…: or, reverse it?
Withhold thy foot from being unshod, Và thy throat from thirst: but ngươi nóist, There is no hy vọng: no; for I have loved strangers, Và after them will I go. There…: or, Is the case desperate?
As the thief is ashamed when he is found, so is nhà của I-sơ-ra-ên ashamed; they, their kings, their princes, Và their priests, Và their các tiên tri,
nói [rằng] to a stock, Thou art my father; Và to a stone, ngươi hast brought me forth: for they have turned their back unto me, and not their mặt: but in the time of their trouble they will say, Hãy chổi dậy, Và save us. brought…: or, begotten me their back: Heb. the hinder part of the neck
But where are thy gods that ngươi hast made ngươi? let them arise, if they can save ngươi in the time of thy trouble: for according to the number of thy cities are thy gods, O Giu-đa. trouble: Heb. evil
Wherefore will ye plead with me? ye all have transgressed against me, nói the CHÚA.
vô ích have I smitten your children; they received no correction: your own thanh gươm hath devoured your các tiên tri, like a destroying con sư tử.

Therefore, kìa, the days đến, nói the CHÚA, that it shall no more be called Tophet, nor the valley của Con of Hinnom, but the valley of slaughter: for they shall bury in Tophet, till there be no place.
Và the carcases of this people shall be meat for the fowls of the heaven, Và for the beasts đất; and none shall fray họ away.
Then will I cause to cease from the cities của Giu-đa, Và from the streets of Giê-ru-sa-lem, tiếng of mirth, Và the voice of gladness, tiếng của chàng rể, Và the voice of the bride: for the land shall be desolate.

CHAPTER 8.
At that time, nói the CHÚA, they shall bring out the bones of các vua của Giu-đa, Và the bones of his princes, Và the bones of the priests, Và the bones of các tiên tri, Và the bones of the inhabitants of Giê-ru-sa-lem, out of their graves:
Và they shall spread them before mặt trời, Và the moon, Và all the host of heaven, whom they have loved, Và whom they have served, Và after whom they have walked, Và whom they have sought, Và whom they have worshipped: they shall not be gathered, nor be buried; they shall be for dung upon mặt đất.
Và death shall be chosen rather than sự sống by all the residue of them that remain of this evil gia đình, which remain in all the places whither I have driven them, nói the CHÚA vạn quân.
Moreover ngươi shalt say với họ, Thus nói the CHÚA; Shall they fall, Và not arise? shall he turn away, Và not return?
Tại sao Rồi is this people of Giê-ru-sa-lem slidden back by a perpetual backsliding? they hold fast deceit, they refuse to return.
I hearkened Và heard, but they spake not aright: không ai repented him of his wickedness, nói [rằng], What have I done? every one turned to his course, as the horse rusheth into the battle.
Yea, the stork in the heaven biết her appointed times; Và the turtle Và the crane Và the swallow observe the time of their coming; but my people biết not the judgment of the CHÚA.
How do ye say, We are khôn ngoan, Và the law of the CHÚA is with us? Lo, certainly vô ích made he it; the pen of những thầy chép luật is vô ích. vô ích made…: or, the false pen of những thầy chép luật worketh for falsehood
The wise men are ashamed, they are dismayed Và taken: lo, they have rejected lời of the CHÚA; Và what wisdom is in them? The wise…: or, Have they been ashamed, etc what…: Heb. the wisdom of what thing
Therefore will I give their wives unto others, Và their fields to them that shall inherit họ: for every one from the least even unto the greatest is given to covetousness, from the prophet even unto thầy tế lễ every one dealeth falsely.
For they have healed the hurt of con gái of my people slightly, nói [rằng], Peace, peace; when there is no peace.
Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination? nay, they were not at all ashamed, neither could they blush: therefore shall they fall among them that fall: in the time of their visitation they shall be cast down, nói the CHÚA. I will…: or, In gathering I will consume
I will surely consume them, nói the CHÚA: there shall be no grapes on the vine, nor figs on cây vả, Và the leaf shall fade; and the things that I have given them shall pass away from them.
Tại sao do we sit still? assemble yourselves, and let us enter into the defenced các thành, Và let us be silent there: for the CHÚA ĐCT chúng tôi hath put us to silence, Và given us water of gall để uống, because we have sinned against the CHÚA. gall: or, poison
We looked for peace, but no good came; and for a time of health, Và kìa trouble!
The snorting of his horses was heard from Dan: the whole land trembled at the sound of the neighing of his strong ones; for they are come, Và have devoured the land, Và all that is in it; the city, Và those that ở therein. all…: Heb. the fulness thereof
For, kìa, I will send serpents, cockatrices, among you, which will not be charmed, Và they shall bite you, nói the CHÚA.
khi I would comfort myself against sorrow, my heart is faint in me. in: Heb. upon
kìa the voice of the cry of con gái of my people vì cớ them that ở in a far country: Is not the CHÚA in Si-ôn? is not her king in her? Tại sao have they provoked me to anger with their graven images, Và with strange vanities? them…: Heb. the country of them that are far off
mùa gặt is past, the summer is ended, Và we are not saved.
For the hurt of con gái of my people am I hurt; I am black; astonishment hath taken hold on me.
Is there no balm in Gilead; is there no physician there? why then is not the health of con gái of my people recovered? recovered: Heb. gone up?

CHAPTER 9.
Oh that my head were waters, Và mine eyes a fountain of tears, that I might weep ngày Và night for the slain of con gái of my people!Oh…: Heb. Who will give my head, etc
Oh that I had in the wilderness a lodging place of wayfaring men; that I might leave my people, và đi from them! for they be all adulterers, an assembly of treacherous men.
Và they bend their tongues like their bow for lies: but they are not valiant for the truth trên đất; for they proceed from evil to evil, Và they know not me, nói the CHÚA.
Take ye heed every one of his neighbour, Và trust ye not in any brother: for every brother will utterly supplant, và mãi mãiy neighbour will walk with slanders. neighbour: or, friend
Và they will deceive every one his neighbour, Và will not speak lẽ thật: they have taught their tongue to speak lies, Và weary themselves to commit iniquity. deceive: or, mock
Thine habitation is in the midst of deceit; through deceit they refuse to know me, nói the CHÚA.
Therefore thus nói the CHÚA vạn quân, kìa, I will melt them, and try them; for how shall I do for con gái of my people?
Their tongue is as an arrow shot out; it speaketh deceit: one speaketh peaceably to his neighbour with his mouth, but in heart he layeth his wait. in heart: Heb. in the midst of him his wait: or, wait for him
Shall I not visit them for these things? nói the CHÚA: shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?
For núis will I take up a weeping Và khóc lóc, Và for the habitations of the wilderness a ca thương, because they are burned up, so that none can pass through họ; neither can men nghe tiếng of the cattle; both the fowl of the heavens Và the beast are fled; they are gone. habitations: or, pastures burned up: or, desolate both…: Heb. from the fowl even to, etc
Và I will make Giê-ru-sa-lem heaps, Và a den of dragons; Và I will make the cities của Giu-đa desolate, without an inhabitant. desolate: Heb. desolation
Who is the wise man, that may understand this? and who is he to whom the mouth of the CHÚA hath spoken, that he may declare it, for what the land perisheth Và is burned up like a wilderness, that none passeth through?
Và the CHÚA nói, Because they have forsaken my law which I set before them, and have not obeyed my voice, neither walked therein;
But have walked after the imagination of their own heart, Và after Baalim, which their fathers dạy them: imagination: or, stubbornness
Therefore thus nói the CHÚA vạn quân, ĐCT của I-sơ-ra-ên; kìa, I will feed them, even this people, with wormwood, Và give them water of gall để uống.
I will scatter them also among the heathen, whom neither they nor their fathers have known: Và I will send a thanh gươm after them, till I have consumed them.
Thus nói the CHÚA vạn quân, Consider ye, and call for the than khóc women, that they may come; Và send for cunning women, that they may come:
Và let them make haste, Và take up a khóc lóc for us, that our eyes may run down với nước mắt, Và our eyelids gush out with waters.
For a voice of khóc lóc is heard out of Si-ôn, How are we spoiled! we are greatly confounded, because we have forsaken the land, because our ởings have cast us out.
Yet hear lời of the CHÚA, O ye women, Và let your ear nhận lời of his mouth, Và teach your daughters khóc lóc, và mãi mãiy one her neighbour ca thương.
For death is come up into our windows, Và is entered into our palaces, to cut off con cái from without, Và the young men from the streets.
nói, Thus nói the CHÚA, Even the carcases of men shall fall as dung upon the open field, Và as tayful after mùa gặtman, Và none shall gather họ.
Thus nói the CHÚA, Let not the wise man glory in his wisdom, neither let the mighty man glory in his might, let not the rich man glory in his riches:
But let him that glorieth glory in this, that he understandeth Và knoweth me, that I là the CHÚA which exercise lovingkindness, judgment, Và righteousness, in đất: for in these things I delight, nói the CHÚA.
kìa, the days đến, nói the CHÚA, that I will punish all them which are cắt bì with the uncircumcised; punish: Heb. visit upon
Ai-Cập, Và Giu-đa, Và Edom, Và the children of Ammon, Và Mô-áp, and all that are in the utmost corners, that ở in the wilderness: for all these nations are uncircumcised, Và all nhà của I-sơ-ra-ên are uncircumcised in the heart. in the utmost…: Heb. cut off into corners, or, having the corners of their hair polled

CHAPTER 10.
nghe ye the word which the CHÚA speaketh cùng các ngươi, O house của I-sơ-ra-ên:
Thus nói the CHÚA, Learn not the way of the heathen, Và be not dismayed at the signs of heaven; for the heathen are dismayed at them.
For the customs của dân sự are vain: for one cutteth a tree out of the forest, the work of tays of the workman, with the axe. customs…: Heb. statutes, or, ordinances are hư không
They deck it with silver Và with gold; they fasten it with nails Và with hammers, that it move not.
They are upright as the palm tree, but speak not: they must needs be borne, because they cannot go. Be not afraid of them; for they cannot do evil, neither also is it in them to do good.
Forasmuch as there is none like unto ngươi, O CHÚA; thou art great, Và Danh Ngài is great in might.
Who would not fear ngươi, O King of nations? for to ngươi doth it appertain: forasmuch as among all the wise men of the nations, Và in all their kingdoms, there is none like unto ngươi. to…: or, it liketh ngươi
But they are altogether brutish Và foolish: the stock is a doctrine of vanities. altogether: Heb. in one, or, at once
Silver spread into plates is brought from Tarshish, và vàng from Uphaz, the work of the workman, Và of tays of the founder: blue Và purple is their clothing: they are all the work of cunning men.
But the CHÚA is the true ĐCT, he is the living ĐCT, Và an đời đời vua: at his wrath đất shall tremble, Và the nations shall not be able to abide his indignation. true…: Heb. God of truth living God: Heb. living Gods đời đời…: Heb. king of eternity
Thus shall ye say với họ, The gods that have not made các tầng trời Và đất, even they shall perish from đất, Và from under these heavens.
He hath made đất by his power, he hath established thế gian by his wisdom, Và hath stretched out các tầng trời by his discretion.
