God vạn quân in the land of the Chaldeans.
đến against her from the utmost border, open her storehouses: cast her up as heaps, Và destroy her utterly: let nothing of her be left. from…: Heb. from the end cast…: or, tread her
Slay all her bullocks; let them go down to the slaughter: khốn thay với họ! for their day is come, the time of their visitation.
tiếng of them that flee Và escape out of the land of Ba-by-lôn, to declare in Si-ôn the vengeance of the CHÚA ĐCT chúng tôi, the vengeance of his temple.
Call together the archers against Ba-by-lôn: all ye that bend the bow, camp against it round about; let none thereof escape: recompense her according to her work; according to all that she hath done, do unto her: for she hath been proud against the CHÚA, against the Holy One của I-sơ-ra-ên.
Therefore shall her young men fall in the streets, Và all her men of war shall be cut off trong ngày đó, nói the CHÚA.
kìa, I là against ngươi, O thou most proud, nói Chúa
God vạn quân: for thy day is come, the time that I will visit ngươi. most…: Heb. pride
Và the most proud shall stumble Và fall, Và none shall raise him up: Và I will kindle a fire in his cities, Và it shall devour all round about him. the…: Heb. pride
Thus nói the CHÚA vạn quân; con cái của I-sơ-ra-ên Và the children của Giu-đa were oppressed together: Và all that took them captives held them fast; they refused to let them go.
Their Redeemer is strong; the CHÚA vạn quân is his name: he shall throughly plead their cause, that he may give rest to the land, Và disquiet the inhabitants of Ba-by-lôn.
A thanh gươm is upon the Chaldeans, nói the CHÚA, Và upon the inhabitants of Ba-by-lôn, Và upon her princes, Và upon her wise men.
A thanh gươm is upon the liars; Và they shall dote: a thanh gươm is upon her mighty men; Và they shall be dismayed. liars: or, chief stays: Heb. bars
A thanh gươm is upon their horses, Và upon their chariots, Và upon all the mingled people that are in the midst of her; and they shall become as women: a thanh gươm is upon her treasures; Và they shall be robbed.
A drought is upon her waters; Và they shall be dried up: for it is the land of graven images, Và they are mad upon their idols.
Therefore the wild beasts of the desert with the wild beasts of the islands shall ở there, Và the owls shall ở therein: and it shall be no more inhabited đến đời đời; neither shall it be dwelt in from generation to generation.
As God overthrew Sô-đôm Và Gô-mô-rơ Và the neighbour các thành thereof, nói the CHÚA; so shall không ai abide there, neither shall any son of man ở therein.
kìa, a people shall come from the north, Và a great nation, Và many các vua shall be raised up from the coasts đất.
They shall hold the bow Và the lance: they are cruel, Và will not shew mercy: their voice shall roar like biển, Và they shall ride upon horses, every one put in array, like a man to the battle, against ngươi, O daughter of Ba-by-lôn.
The king of Ba-by-lôn hath heard the report of them, and his hands waxed feeble: anguish took hold of him, Và pangs as of một người đờn bà in travail.
kìa, he shall come up like a lion from the swelling of Giô-đanh unto the habitation of the strong: but I will make them bất chợt run away from her: and who is a chosen man, that I may appoint over her? for who is like me? and who will appoint me the time? and who is that shepherd that will stand before me? appoint me…: or, convent me to plead?
Therefore hear ye the counsel of the CHÚA, that he hath taken against Ba-by-lôn; Và his purposes, that he hath purposed against the land of the Chaldeans: Surely the least of the flock shall draw them out: surely he shall make their habitation desolate with them.
At the noise of the taking of Ba-by-lôn đất is moved, Và the cry is heard among the nations.

CHAPTER 51.
Thus nói the CHÚA; kìa, I will raise up against Ba-by-lôn, Và against them that ở in the midst of them that rise up against me, a destroying wind; midst: Heb. heart
Và will send unto Ba-by-lôn fanners, that shall fan her, and shall empty her land: for trong ngày of trouble they shall be against her round about.
Against him that bendeth let the archer bend his bow, and against him that lifteth himself up in his brigandine: Và spare ye not her young men; destroy ye utterly all her host.
Thus the slain shall fall in the land of the Chaldeans, and they that are thrust through in her streets.
For I-sơ-ra-ên hath not been forsaken, nor Giu-đa of his God, of the CHÚA vạn quân; though their land was filled with sin against the Holy One của I-sơ-ra-ên.
Flee out of the midst of Ba-by-lôn, Và deliver every man his soul: be not cut off in her iniquity; for this is the time of the Lord's vengeance; he will render unto her a recompence.
Ba-by-lôn hath been a golden cup in the Lord's tay, that made all đất drunken: the nations have drunken of her wine; therefore the nations are mad.
Ba-by-lôn is bất chợt fallen Và destroyed: howl for her; take balm for her pain, if so be she may be healed.
We would have healed Ba-by-lôn, but she is not healed: forsake her, and let us go every one into his own country: for her judgment reacheth unto heaven, Và is lifted up even to the skies.
The CHÚA hath brought forth our righteousness: đến, Và let us declare in Si-ôn the work of the CHÚA ĐCT chúng tôi.
Make bright the arrows; gather the shields: the CHÚA hath raised up the spirit of các vua of the Medes: for his device is against Ba-by-lôn, to destroy it; because it is the vengeance of the CHÚA, the vengeance of his temple. bright: Heb. pure
Set up the standard upon the walls of Ba-by-lôn, make the watch strong, set up the watchmen, prepare the ambushes: for the CHÚA hath both devised Và done that which he spake against the inhabitants of Ba-by-lôn. ambushes: Heb. liers in wait
O ngươi that ởest upon many waters, abundant in treasures, thine end is come, Và the measure of thy covetousness.
The CHÚA vạn quân hath sworn by himself, nói [rằng], Surely I will fill ngươi with men, as with caterpillers; Và they shall lift up a shout against ngươi. by himself: Heb. by his soul lift up: Heb. utter
He hath made đất by his power, he hath established thế gian by his wisdom, Và hath stretched out the heaven by his understanding.
When he uttereth his tiếng, there is a multitude of waters in the heavens; Và he causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends đất: he maketh lightnings with rain, Và bringeth forth gió out of his treasures. multitude: or, noise
Every man is brutish by his sự hiểu biết; every founder is confounded by the graven image: for his molten image is falsehood, and there is no breath in them. is brutish…: or, is more brutish than to know
They are hư không, the work of errors: in the time of their visitation they shall perish.
The portion of Gia-cốp is not like them; for he is the former of all things: and I-sơ-ra-ên is the rod of his inheritance: the CHÚA vạn quân is his name.
Thou art my battle axe Và vũ khí of war: for with ngươi will I break in pieces the nations, Và with ngươi will I destroy kingdoms; with ngươi: or, in ngươi, or, by ngươi
Và with ngươi will I break in pieces the horse Và his rider; Và with ngươi will I break in pieces the chariot Và his rider;
With ngươi also will I break in pieces man Và woman; Và with ngươi will I break in pieces old Và young; Và with ngươi will I break in pieces the young man Và the maid;
I will also break in pieces with ngươi the shepherd Và his flock; Và with ngươi will I break in pieces chồngman Và his yoke of oxen; Và with ngươi will I break in pieces captains Và rulers.
Và I will render unto Ba-by-lôn Và to all the inhabitants of Chaldea all their evil that they have done in Si-ôn in your sight, nói the CHÚA.
kìa, I là against ngươi, O destroying núi, nói the CHÚA, which destroyest all đất: Và I will stretch out mine hand upon ngươi, and roll ngươi down from the rocks, Và will make ngươi a burnt núi.
Và they shall not take of ngươi a stone for a corner, nor a stone for foundations; but ngươi shalt be desolate đến đời đời, nói the CHÚA. desolate…: Heb. đời đời desolations
Set ye up a standard in the land, blow the trumpet among the nations, prepare the nations against her, call together against her the kingdoms of Ararat, Minni, Và Ashchenaz; appoint a captain against her; cause the horses to come up as the rough caterpillers.
Prepare against her the nations with các vua of the Medes, the captains thereof, and all the rulers thereof, and all the land of his dominion.
Và the land shall tremble Và sorrow: for every purpose of the CHÚA shall be performed against Ba-by-lôn, to make the land of Ba-by-lôn a desolation without an inhabitant.
The mighty men of Ba-by-lôn have forborn to fight, they have remained in their holds: their might hath failed; they became as women: they have burned her ởingplaces; her bars are broken.
One post shall run to meet another, Và one messenger to meet another, to shew vua of Ba-by-lôn that his city is taken at one end,
Và that the passages are stopped, Và the reeds they have burned bằng lửa, Và the men of war are affrighted.
For thus nói the CHÚA vạn quân, ĐCT của I-sơ-ra-ên; The daughter of Ba-by-lôn is like a threshingfloor, it is time to thresh her: yet ít lâu, Và the time of her harvest shall come. it is…: or, in the time that he thresheth her
Nebuchadrezzar vua of Ba-by-lôn hath devoured me, he hath crushed me, he hath made me an empty vessel, he hath swallowed me up like a dragon, he hath filled his belly with my delicates, he hath cast me out.
The violence done to me and to my flesh be upon Ba-by-lôn, shall the inhabitant of Si-ôn say; Và my blood upon the inhabitants of Chaldea, shall Giê-ru-sa-lem say. The violence…: Heb. My violence flesh: or, remainder inhabitant: Heb. inhabitress
Therefore thus nói the CHÚA; kìa, I will plead thy cause, Và take vengeance for ngươi; Và I will dry up her sea, Và make her springs dry.
Và Ba-by-lôn shall become heaps, a ởingplace for dragons, an astonishment, Và an hissing, without an inhabitant.
They shall roar together like lions: they shall yell as lions' whelps. yell: or, shake themselves
In their heat I will make their feasts, Và I will make them drunken, that they may rejoice, Và sleep a perpetual sleep, Và not wake, nói the CHÚA.
I will bring them down like lambs to the slaughter, like rams with he goats.
How is Sheshach taken! Và how is the praise of the whole đất surprised! how is Ba-by-lôn become an astonishment among the nations!
biển is come up upon Ba-by-lôn: she is covered with đám đông of the waves thereof.
Her cities are a desolation, a dry land, Và a wilderness, a land wherein không ai ởeth, neither doth any son of man pass thereby.
Và I will punish Bel in Ba-by-lôn, Và I will bring forth out of his mouth that which he hath swallowed up: Và the nations shall not flow together any more unto him: yea, the wall of Ba-by-lôn shall fall.
My people, go ye out of the midst of her, and deliver ye every man his soul from the fierce anger of the CHÚA.
Và lest your heart faint, Và ye fear for the rumour that shall be heard in the land; a rumour shall both come one năm, Và after that in another năm shall come a rumour, Và violence in the land, ruler against ruler. lest: or, let not
Therefore, kìa, the days đến, that I will do judgment upon the graven images of Ba-by-lôn: Và her whole land shall be confounded, Và all her slain shall fall in the midst of her. do…: Heb. visit upon
Then the heaven Và đất, and all that is therein, shall sing for Ba-by-lôn: for the spoilers shall come unto her from the north, nói the CHÚA.
As Ba-by-lôn hath caused the slain của I-sơ-ra-ên to fall, so at Ba-by-lôn shall fall the slain of all đất. As…: or, Both Ba-by-lôn is to fall, O ye slain của I-sơ-ra-ên, and with Ba-by-lôn, etc đất: or, the country
Ye that have escaped thanh gươm, go away, stand not still: nhớ the CHÚA afar off, Và let Giê-ru-sa-lem đến into your mind.
We are confounded, because we have heard reproach: shame hath covered our faces: for strangers are come into the sanctuaries of the Lord's nhà.
Wherefore, kìa, the days đến, nói the CHÚA, that I will do judgment upon her graven images: Và through all her land the wounded shall groan.
Though Ba-by-lôn should mount up to heaven, Và though she should fortify the height of her strength,
yet from me shall spoilers đến unto her, nói the CHÚA.
A sound of a cry đến from Ba-by-lôn, Và great destruction from the land of the Chaldeans:
Because the CHÚA hath spoiled Ba-by-lôn, Và destroyed out of her the great tiếng; when her waves do roar like great waters, a noise of their voice is uttered:
Because the spoiler is come upon her, even upon Ba-by-lôn, Và her mighty men are taken, every one of their bows is broken: for the CHÚA ĐCT of recompences shall surely requite.
Và I will make drunk her princes, Và her wise men, her captains, Và her rulers, Và her mighty men: Và they shall sleep a perpetual sleep, Và not wake, nói the King, whose name is the CHÚA vạn quân.
Thus nói the CHÚA vạn quân; The broad walls of Ba-by-lôn shall be utterly broken, Và her high gates shall be burned bằng lửa; Và the people shall labour vô ích, Và the folk trong lửa, Và they shall be weary. The broad…: or, The walls of broad Ba-by-lôn broken: or, made naked
lời which Giê-rê-mi tiên tri truyền lệnh Seraiah con trai of Neriah, con trai of Maaseiah, when he went with Zedekiah vua của Giu-đa into Ba-by-lôn in the fourth năm of his reign. And này Seraiah was a quiet prince. with: or, on the behalf of quiet…: or, prince of Menucha, or, chief chamberlain
So Giê-rê-mi viết in a book all the evil that should come upon Ba-by-lôn, even all these words that are written against Ba-by-lôn.
Và Giê-rê-mi nói to Seraiah, When ngươi comest to Ba-by-lôn, Và shalt see, Và shalt read all these words;
Then shalt ngươi say, O CHÚA, ngươi hast spoken against this place, to cut it off, that none shall remain in it, neither man nor beast, but that it shall be desolate đến đời đời. desolate: Heb. desolations
Và it shall be, when ngươi hast made an end of reading this book, that ngươi shalt bind a stone to it, and cast it into the midst of Euphrates:
Và ngươi shalt say, Thus shall Ba-by-lôn sink, Và shall not rise từ the evil that I will bring upon her: and they shall be weary. Thus far are những lời of Giê-rê-mi.

CHAPTER 52.
Zedekiah was một Và hai mươi năm old when he began to reign, Và he reigned mười một năm in Giê-ru-sa-lem. Và his mother's name was Hamutal con gái of Giê-rê-mi of Libnah. began…: Heb. reigned
Và he did that which was evil in the eyes of the CHÚA, according to all that Jehoiakim had done.
For through the anger of the CHÚA xảy đến in Giê-ru-sa-lem Và Giu-đa, till he had cast them out from his presence, that Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Ba-by-lôn.
Và xảy đến in the ninth năm of his reign, in the tenth month, in the tenth ngày của tháng, that Nebuchadrezzar vua of Ba-by-lôn đến, he and all his army, against Giê-ru-sa-lem, Và pitched against it, and built forts against it round about.
So thành was besieged unto the eleventh năm của vua Zedekiah.
Và in the fourth month, in the ninth ngày của tháng, the famine was sore in the city, so that there was no bread for the people of the land.
Then the city was broken up, Và all the men of war fled, Và went forth out of the city by night by the way of cổng between the two walls, which was by the king's garden; (now the Chaldeans were by the city round about:) Và they went by the way of the plain.
But the army of the Chaldeans pursued after vua, Và overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Giê-ri-cô; Và all his army was scattered from him.
Then they took vua, Và carried him up unto the king of Ba-by-lôn to Riblah in the land of Hamath; where he gave judgment upon him.
và vua of Ba-by-lôn giết the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes: he slew also all the princes của Giu-đa in Riblah.
Then he put out mắt of Zedekiah; và vua of Ba-by-lôn bound him in chains, Và carried him to Ba-by-lôn, Và put him in prison till the day of his death. put out: Heb. blinded chains: or, fetters prison: Heb. house of the wards
Now in the fifth month, in the tenth ngày của tháng, which was the nineteenth năm of Nebuchadrezzar vua of Ba-by-lôn, đến Nebuzar–adan, captain of the guard, which served vua of Ba-by-lôn, into Giê-ru-sa-lem,captain…: or, chief marshal: Heb. chief of the executioners, or, slaughtermen served: Heb. stood before
Và burned nhà of the CHÚA, Và the king's nhà; Và all nhàs of Giê-ru-sa-lem, Và all nhàs of the great men, burned he bằng lửa:
Và all the army of the Chaldeans, that were with the captain of the guard, brake down all the walls of Giê-ru-sa-lem round about.
Then Nebuzar–adan the captain of the guard carried away captive certain of the poor của dân sự, Và the residue của dân sự that remained in the city, Và those that fell away, that fell to the king of Ba-by-lôn, Và the rest of đám đông.
But Nebuzar–adan the captain of the guard left certain of the poor of the land for vinedressers Và for husbandmen.
Also the pillars of brass that were in nhà of the CHÚA, Và the bases, Và the brasen sea that was in nhà of the CHÚA, the Chaldeans brake, Và carried all the brass of them to Ba-by-lôn.
The caldrons also, and the shovels, Và the snuffers, Và the bowls, Và the spoons, Và all the vessels of brass wherewith they ministered, took they away. shovels: or, instruments to remove the ashes bowls: or, basons
Và the basons, Và the firepans, Và the bowls, Và the caldrons, Và the chân đèns, Và the spoons, Và the cups; that which was of gold trong gold, and that which was of silver trong silver, took the captain of the guard away. firepans: or, censers
The two pillars, một sea, Và mười hai brasen bulls that were under the bases, which king Sa-lô-môn had made in nhà of the CHÚA: the brass of all these vessels was without weight. the brass: Heb. their brass
Và concerning the pillars, the height of one pillar was eighteen cubits; Và a fillet of mười hai cubits did compass it; and the thickness thereof was bốn fingers: it was hollow. fillet: Heb. thread
Và a chapiter of brass was upon it; and the height of one chapiter was năm cubits, with network Và pomegranates upon the chapiters round about, all of brass. thứ hai pillar also and the pomegranates were like unto these.
Và there were ninety Và six pomegranates on a side; Và all the pomegranates upon the network were một trăm round about.
Và the captain of the guard took Seraiah the chief priest, Và Zephaniah thứ hai priest, Và the three keepers of the door: door: Heb. threshold
He took also out of the city an eunuch, which had the charge of the men of war; Và bảy men of them that were near the king's person, which were found in the city; Và the principal scribe of the host, who mustered the people of the land; Và sáu mươi men của dân sự of the land, that were found in the midst of the city. were near…: Heb. saw mặt of the king principal…: or, scribe of the captain of the host
So Nebuzar–adan the captain of the guard took them, and brought them to the king of Ba-by-lôn to Riblah.
và vua of Ba-by-lôn smote them, and put them to death in Riblah in the land of Hamath. Thus Giu-đa was carried away captive out of his own land.
This is the people whom Nebuchadrezzar carried away captive: in the seventh năm ba ngàn Jews Và three Và hai mươi:
In the eighteenth năm of Nebuchadrezzar he carried away captive from Giê-ru-sa-lem tám trăm ba mươi Và two persons: persons: Heb. souls
In the three Và twentieth năm of Nebuchadrezzar Nebuzar–adan the captain of the guard carried away captive of the Jews bảy trăm bốn mươi Và five persons: all the persons were bốn ngàn Và six trăm.
Và xảy đến in the bảy Và thirtieth năm of the captivity of Jehoiachin vua của Giu-đa, in the twelfth month, in the five Và twentieth ngày của tháng, that Evil–merodach vua of Ba-by-lôn in the first năm of his reign lifted up the head of Jehoiachin vua của Giu-đa, Và brought him forth out of prison,
Và spake kindly unto him, and set his throne above ngai of các vua that were with him in Ba-by-lôn,kindly…: Heb. good things with him
Và changed his prison garments: Và he did continually ăn bánh before him all the days of his sự sống.
Và for his diet, there was a continual diet given him of the king of Ba-by-lôn, mỗi ngày a portion until the day of his death, all the days of his sự sống. every…: Heb. the matter of the day in his day

div.title: THE ca thươngS OF Giê-rê-mi
div.chapter:
CHAPTER 1.
How doth the city sit solitary, that was full of people! how is she become as a widow! she that was great among the nations, Và princess among the provinces, how is she become tributary!
She weepeth sore in the night, Và her tears are on her cheeks: among all her lovers she hath none to comfort her: all her friends have dealt treacherously with her, they are become her enemies.
Giu-đa is gone into captivity vì cớ affliction, Và vì cớ great servitude: she ởeth among the heathen, she tìm no rest: all her persecutors overtook her between the straits. vì cớ great…: Heb. for the greatness of servitude
The ways of Si-ôn do mourn, because none come to the solemn feasts: all her gates are desolate: her priests sigh, her virgins are afflicted, and she is in bitterness.
Her adversaries are the chief, her enemies prosper; for the CHÚA hath afflicted her for đám đông of her transgressions: her children are gone into captivity before the enemy.
Và from con gái of Si-ôn all her beauty is departed: her princes are become like harts that find no pasture, Và they are gone without strength before the pursuer.
Giê-ru-sa-lem nhớ lại trong những ngày of her affliction Và of her miseries all her pleasant things that she had trong những ngày of old, when her people rơi into tay of the enemy, Và none did help her: the adversaries nhìn thấy her, Và did mock at her sabbaths. pleasant: or, desirable
Giê-ru-sa-lem hath grievously sinned; therefore she is removed: all that honoured her despise her, because they have seen her nakedness: yea, she sigheth, Và turneth backward. is…: Heb. is become a removing, or, wandering
Her filthiness is in her skirts; she remembereth not her last end; therefore she came down wonderfully: she had no comforter. O CHÚA, kìa my affliction: for the enemy hath magnified himself.
The adversary hath spread out his hand upon all her pleasant things: for she hath seen that the heathen entered into her sanctuary, whom ngươi didst command that they should not enter into thy congregation. pleasant: or, desirable
All her people sigh, họ thấyk bánh; they have given their pleasant things for meat to relieve the soul: thấy, O CHÚA, Và consider; for I am become vile. to…: or, to make the soul to come again
Is it nothing to you, all ye that pass by? kìa, Và see if there be any sorrow like unto my sorrow, which is done unto me, wherewith the CHÚA hath afflicted me trong ngày of his fierce anger. Is it…: or, It is nothing pass by: Heb. pass by the way?
From above hath he sent lửa into my bones, Và it prevaileth against them: he hath spread a net for my feet, he hath turned me back: he hath made me desolate Và faint all the day.
The yoke of my transgressions is bound by his hand: they are wreathed, Và come up upon my neck: he hath made my strength to fall, Chúa hath delivered me into their hands, from whom I am not able to rise up.
Chúa hath trodden under foot all my mighty men in the midst of me: he hath called an assembly against me to crush my young men: Chúa hath trodden the virgin, con gái của Giu-đa, as in a winepress. the virgin…: or, the winepress of the virgin, etc
For these things I weep; mine eye, mine eye runneth down with water, because the comforter that should relieve my soul is far from me: my children are desolate, because the enemy prevailed. relieve: Heb. bring back
Si-ôn spreadeth forth her hands, Và there is none to comfort her: the CHÚA hath commanded concerning Gia-cốp, that his adversaries should be round about him: Giê-ru-sa-lem is as a menstruous woman among them.
The CHÚA is righteous; for I have rebelled against his commandment: nghe, I pray you, all people, Và kìa my sorrow: my virgins Và my young men are gone into captivity. commandment: Heb. mouth
I called for my lovers, but they deceived me: my priests Và mine elders gave up the ghost in the city, while they sought their meat to relieve their souls.
kìa, O CHÚA; for I là in distress: my bowels are troubled; mine heart is turned within me; for I have grievously rebelled: abroad thanh gươm bereaveth, at home there is as death.
They have heard that I sigh: there is none to comfort me: all mine enemies have heard of my trouble; they are glad that ngươi hast done it: ngươi wilt bring ngày that ngươi hast called, Và they shall be like unto me. called: or, proclaimed
Let all their wickedness đến before ngươi; and do với họ, as ngươi hast done unto me for all my transgressions: for my sighs are many, Và my heart is faint.

CHAPTER 2.
How hath the Lord covered con gái of Si-ôn with a cloud in his anger, Và cast down from heaven unto đất the beauty của I-sơ-ra-ên, Và nhớ lại not his footstool trong ngày of his anger!
Chúa hath swallowed up all the habitations of Gia-cốp, Và hath not pitied: he hath thrown down in his wrath the strong holds of con gái của Giu-đa; he hath brought họ down to the ground: he hath polluted the kingdom Và the princes thereof. brought…: Heb. made to touch
He hath cut off in his fierce anger all the horn của I-sơ-ra-ên: he hath drawn back his tay phải from before the enemy, Và he burned against Gia-cốp like a flaming lửa, which devoureth round about.
He hath bent his bow like an enemy: he stood with his tay phải as an adversary, Và slew all that were pleasant to the eye in đền tạm of con gái of Si-ôn: he poured out his fury like fire. all…: Heb. all the desirable of the eye
Chúa was as an enemy: he hath swallowed up I-sơ-ra-ên, he hath swallowed up all her palaces: he hath destroyed his strong holds, Và hath increased in con gái của Giu-đa than khóc Và ca thương.
Và he hath violently taken away his tabernacle, as if it were of một cái vườn: he hath destroyed his places of the assembly: the CHÚA hath caused the solemn feasts Và sabbaths to be forgotten in Si-ôn, Và hath despised in the indignation of his anger vua Và thầy tế lễ. tabernacle: or, hedge
Chúa hath cast off his altar, he hath abhorred his sanctuary, he hath given up into tay of the enemy the walls of her palaces; they have made a noise in nhà of the CHÚA, as trong ngày of a solemn feast. given up: Heb. shut up
The CHÚA hath purposed to destroy the wall of con gái of Si-ôn: he hath stretched out a line, he hath not withdrawn his hand from destroying: therefore he made the rampart Và the wall to lament; they languished together. destroying: Heb. swallowing up
Her gates are sunk into the ground; he hath destroyed Và broken her bars: her king Và her princes are among the Gentiles: luật pháp is no more; her các tiên tri also find no vision from the CHÚA.
các trưởng lão of con gái of Si-ôn sit upon the ground, Và keep silence: they have cast up dust upon their heads; they have girded themselves with vải bố: the virgins of Giê-ru-sa-lem hang down their heads to the ground.
Mine eyes do fail với nước mắt, my bowels are troubled, my liver is poured trên đất, for the destruction of con gái of my people; because the children Và the sucklings swoon in the streets of the city. swoon: or, faint
They say to their mothers, Where is bắp Và wine? when they swooned as the wounded in the streets of the city, when their soul was poured out into their mothers' lòng.
What thing shall I take to witness for ngươi? what thing shall I liken to ngươi, O daughter of Giê-ru-sa-lem? what shall I equal to ngươi, that I may comfort ngươi, O virgin con gái of Si-ôn? for thy breach is great like biển: who can heal ngươi?
Thy các tiên tri have seen vain Và foolish things for ngươi: and they have not discovered thine iniquity, to turn away thy captivity; but have seen for ngươi false burdens Và causes of banishment.
All that pass by clap their hands at ngươi; they hiss Và wag their head at con gái of Giê-ru-sa-lem, saying, Is this the city that men call The perfection of beauty, sự vui mừng of the whole đất? by: Heb. by the way
All thine enemies have opened their mouth against ngươi: they hiss Và gnash the teeth: they say, We have swallowed her up: certainly this is ngày that we looked for; we have found, we have seen it.
The CHÚA hath done that which he had devised; he hath fulfilled his word that he had commanded trong những ngày of old: he hath thrown down, Và hath not pitied: and he hath caused thine kẻ thù to rejoice over ngươi, he hath set up the horn of thine adversaries.
Their heart cried unto the Lord, O wall of con gái of Si-ôn, let tears run down like a river ngày Và night: give thyself no rest; let not the apple of thine eye cease.
Hãy chổi dậy, cry out in the night: in the beginning of the watches pour out thine heart like water before mặt của ĐCT: lift up thy hands toward him for the sự sống of thy young children, that faint for hunger in the top of every street.
kìa, O CHÚA, Và consider to whom ngươi hast done này. Shall những người đàn bà ăn their fruit, Và children of a span long? shall thầy tế lễ Và the prophet bị giết in the sanctuary của ĐCT? of a span…: or, swaddled with their hands?
The young Và the old lie on the ground in the streets: my virgins Và my young men are fallen by thanh gươm; ngươi hast slain họ trong ngày of thine anger; ngươi hast killed, Và not pitied.
ngươi hast called as in a solemn ngày my terrors round about, so that trong ngày of the Lord's anger none escaped nor remained: those that I have swaddled Và brought up hath mine enemy consumed.

CHAPTER 3.
I là the man that hath seen affliction by the rod of his wrath.
He hath led me, and brought me into tối tăm, but not into light.
Surely against me is he turned; he turneth his hand against me all the day.
My flesh Và my skin hath he made old; he hath broken my bones.
He hath builded against me, and compassed me with gall Và travail.
He hath set me in dark places, as they that be dead of old.
He hath hedged me about, that I cannot get out: he hath made my chain heavy.
Also when I cry Và shout, he shutteth out my prayer.
He hath inclosed my ways with hewn stone, he hath made my paths crooked.
He was unto me as a bear lying in wait, Và as a lion in secret places.
He hath turned aside my ways, Và pulled me in pieces: he hath made me desolate.
He hath bent his bow, Và set me as a Mác for the arrow.
He hath caused the arrows of his quiver to enter into my reins. arrows: Heb. sons
I was a derision to all my people; Và their song all the day.
He hath filled me with bitterness, he hath made me drunken with wormwood. bitterness: Heb. bitternesses
He hath also broken my teeth with gravel stones, he hath covered me with ashes. covered…: or, rolled me in the ashes
Và ngươi hast removed my soul far off from peace: I forgat prosperity. prosperity: Heb. good
Và tôi nói, My strength Và my hy vọng is perished from the CHÚA:
Remembering mine affliction Và my misery, the wormwood Và the gall. Remembering: or, Remember
My soul hath họ still in remembrance, Và is humbled in me. humbled: Heb. bowed
This I recall to my mind, therefore have I hy vọng. recall…: Heb. make to return to my heart
It is of the Lord's mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not.
họ là mới mỗi buổi sáng: great is thy faithfulness.
The CHÚA is my portion, nói my soul; therefore will I hy vọng in him.
The CHÚA is tốt với họ that wait for him, to the soul that seeketh him.
It is tốt that một người should both hy vọng Và quietly wait for the salvation of the CHÚA.
It is tốt for a man that he bear the yoke in his youth.
He sitteth alone Và keepeth silence, because he hath borne it upon him.
He putteth his mouth in the dust; if so be there may be hy vọng.
He giveth his cheek to him that smiteth him: he is filled full with reproach.
For the Lord will not cast off đến đời đời:
But though he cause grief, yet will he have compassion according to đám đông of his mercies.
For he doth not afflict willingly nor grieve con cái of men. willingly: Heb. from his heart
To crush under his feet all the prisoners đất,
To turn aside the right of a man before mặt of the most High,the most High: or, a superior
To subvert một người in his cause, Chúa approveth not. approveth not: or, seeth not
Who is he that nói, and it cometh to pass, khi Chúa commandeth it not?
Out of the mouth of the most High proceedeth not evil Và good?
Wherefore doth a living man complain, một người for the punishment of his tội lỗi? complain: or, murmur
Let us search Và try our ways, Và turn again to the CHÚA.
Let us lift up our heart with our hands unto God in the heavens.
We have transgressed Và have rebelled: ngươi hast not pardoned.
ngươi hast covered with anger, Và persecuted us: ngươi hast slain, ngươi hast not pitied.
ngươi hast covered thyself with a cloud, that our prayer should not pass through.
ngươi hast made us as the offscouring Và refuse in the midst của dân sự.
All our enemies have opened their mouths against us.
Fear Và a snare is come upon us, desolation Và destruction.
Mine eye runneth down with rivers of water for the destruction of con gái of my people.
Mine eye trickleth down, Và ceaseth not, without any intermission,
Till the CHÚA look down, Và kìa from heaven.
Mine eye affecteth mine heart vì cớ all the daughters of my city. mine heart: Heb. my soul because…: or, more than all
Mine enemies chased me sore, like a bird, without cause.
They have cut off my sự sống in the dungeon, Và cast a stone upon me.
Waters flowed over mine head; Rồi tôi nói, I am cut off.
I called upon Danh Ngài, O CHÚA, out of the low dungeon.
ngươi hast heard my voice: hide not thine ear at my breathing, at my cry.
ngươi drewest near trong ngày that I called upon ngươi: ngươi nóist, Fear not.
O Lord, ngươi hast pleaded the causes of my soul; ngươi hast redeemed my sự sống.
O CHÚA, ngươi hast seen my wrong: judge ngươi my cause.
ngươi hast seen all their vengeance Và all their imaginations against me.
ngươi hast heard their reproach, O CHÚA, Và all their imaginations against me;
The lips of those that rose up against me, and their device against me all the day.
kìa their sitting down, Và their rising up; I là their musick.
Render với họ a recompence, O CHÚA, according to the work of their hands.
Give them sorrow of heart, thy curse với họ. sorrow…: or, obstinacy of heart
bắt bớ Và destroy them in anger from under the heavens of the CHÚA.

CHAPTER 4.
How is the gold become dim! how is the most fine gold changed! the stones of the sanctuary are poured out in the top of every street.
The precious sons of Si-ôn, comparable to fine gold, how are they esteemed as earthen pitchers, the work of tays of the potter!
Even biển monsters draw out the breast, they give suck to their young ones: con gái of my people is become cruel, like the ostriches in the wilderness. sea…: or, sea calves
lưỡi of the sucking child cleaveth to the roof of his mouth for thirst: the young children ask bánh, Và không ai breaketh it với họ.
They that did feed delicately are desolate in the streets: they that were brought up in scarlet embrace dunghills.
For the punishment of the iniquity of con gái of my people is greater than the punishment of the sin of Sô-đôm, that was overthrown as in a moment, Và no hands stayed on her. punishment of the iniquity: or, iniquity
Her Nazarites were purer than snow, they were whiter than milk, they were more ruddy in body than rubies, their polishing was of sapphire:
Their visage is blacker than a coal; they are not known in the streets: their skin cleaveth to their bones; it is withered, it is become like a stick. blacker…: Heb. darker than blackness
They that be slain with thanh gươm are better than they that be slain with hunger: for these pine away, stricken through for want of the fruits of the field. pine…: Heb. flow out
The hands of the pitiful women have sodden their own children: they were their meat in the destruction of con gái of my people.
The CHÚA hath accomplished his fury; he hath poured out his fierce anger, Và hath kindled a fire in Si-ôn, Và it hath devoured the foundations thereof.
các vua đất, Và all the inhabitants of the world, would not have believed that the adversary Và the enemy should have entered into the gates of Giê-ru-sa-lem.
For the tội lỗi of her các tiên tri, Và the iniquities of her priests, that have shed the blood of the just in the midst of her,
They have wandered as mù men in the streets, they have polluted themselves with blood, so that men could không touch their garments. so…: or, in that they could not but touch
They cried với họ, Depart ye; it is unclean; depart, depart, touch not: when they fled away Và wandered, họ nói among the heathen, They shall no more sojourn there. it…: or, ye polluted
The anger of the CHÚA hath divided them; he will no more regard them: they respected not the persons of the priests, they favoured not các trưởng lão. anger: or, face
As for us, our eyes as yet failed for our vain help: in our watching we have watched for a nation that could not save us.
They hunt our steps, that we cannot go in our streets: our end is near, our days được trọn; for our end is come.
Our persecutors are swifter than the eagles of the heaven: they pursued us upon núis, they laid wait for us in the wilderness.
The breath of our nostrils, the anointed of the CHÚA, was taken in their pits, of whom we nói, Under his shadow we shall live among the heathen.
Rejoice Và be glad, O daughter of Edom, that ởest in the land of Uz; the cup also shall pass through unto ngươi: ngươi shalt be drunken, Và shalt make thyself naked.
The punishment of thine iniquity is accomplished, O daughter of Si-ôn; he will no more carry ngươi away into captivity: he will visit thine iniquity, O daughter of Edom; he will discover thy tội lỗi. The…: or, Thine iniquity discover…: or, carry ngươi captive for thy tội lỗi

CHAPTER 5.
nhớ, O CHÚA, what is come upon us: consider, Và kìa our reproach.
Our inheritance is turned to strangers, our houses to aliens.
We are orphans Và fatherless, our mothers are as widows.
We have drunken our water for money; our wood is sold unto us. is…: Heb. cometh for price
Our necks are under persecution: we labour, Và have no rest. Our…: Heb. On our necks are we persecuted
We have given tay to người Ê-díp-tô, Và to the Assyrians, to be satisfied with bread.
Our fathers have sinned, Và are không; Và we have borne their iniquities.
các đầy tớ have ruled over us: there is none that doth deliver us out of their hand.
We gat our bread with the peril of our lives vì of thanh gươm of the wilderness.
Our skin was black like an oven vì of the terrible một cơn hạn hán. terrible: or, terrors, or, storms
They ravished những người đàn bà in Si-ôn, Và the maids in the cities của Giu-đa.
Princes are hanged up by their hand: mặts of elders were not honoured.
They took the young men to grind, Và the children rơi under the wood.
các trưởng lão have ceased from cổng, the young men from their musick.
sự vui mừng of our heart is ceased; our dance is turned into than khóc.
The crown is fallen từ our head: khốn thay unto us, that we have sinned!The…: Heb. The crown of our head is fallen
For this our heart is faint; for these things our eyes are dim.
Vì cớ núi of Si-ôn, which is desolate, the foxes walk upon it.
Thou, O CHÚA, remainest đến đời đời; thy throne from generation to generation.
Wherefore dost ngươi forget us đến đời đời, Và forsake us so long time? so…: Heb. for length of days?
Turn ngươi us unto ngươi, O CHÚA, Và we shall be turned; renew our days as of old.
But ngươi hast utterly rejected us; ngươi art very wroth against us. But…: or, For wilt ngươi utterly reject us?

div.title: THE BOOK OF THE PROPHET EZEKIEL
div.chapter:
CHAPTER 1.
Now xảy đến in the thirtieth năm, in the fourth month, in the fifth ngày của tháng, as I was among the captives by the river of Chebar, that các tầng trời sẽ được mở ra, Và I saw visions của ĐCT. captives: Heb. captivity
In the fifth ngày của tháng, which was the fifth năm của vua Jehoiachin's captivity,
lời of the CHÚA came expressly unto Ezekiel thầy tế lễ, con trai of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans by the river Chebar; Và tay of the CHÚA was there upon him. Ezekiel: Heb. Jehezkel
Và I looked, and, kìa, a whirlwind đến out of the north, a great cloud, Và a fire infolding itself, and a brightness was about it, and out of the midst thereof as the colour of amber, out of the midst of the fire. infolding…: Heb. catching itself
Also out of the midst thereof đến the likeness of four living creatures. And this was their appearance; they had the likeness of a man.
và mãi mãiy one had four faces, và mãi mãiy one had four wings.
Và their feet were thẳng chân; Và the sole of their feet was like the sole of a calf's foot: Và they sparkled like the colour of burnished brass. straight…: Heb. a straight foot
Và they had tay of a man under their wings on their four sides; Và they four had their faces Và their wings.
Their wings were joined một to another; they turned not when they went; they went every one thẳng forward.
As for the likeness of their faces, they four had mặt of a man, Và mặt of a lion, on the right side: Và they four had mặt of một con bò on the left side; they four also had mặt of an eagle.
Thus were their faces: Và their wings were stretched upward; hai wings of every one were joined một to another, Và two covered their bodies. stretched…: or, divided above
Và they went every one thẳng forward: whither the spirit was to go, they went; Và they turned not when they went.
As for the likeness of the living creatures, their appearance was like burning coals lửa, Và like the appearance of lamps: it went up and down among the living creatures; Và the fire was bright, Và out of the fire went forth lightning.
Và the living creatures ran Và returned as the appearance of a flash of lightning.
Now as I beheld the living creatures, kìa one wheel trên đất by the living creatures, with his four faces.
The appearance of the wheels Và their work was like unto the colour of a beryl: Và they four had one likeness: Và their appearance Và their work was as it were a wheel in the middle of a wheel.
When they went, they went upon their four sides: Và they turned not when they went.
As for their rings, they were so high that they were dreadful; Và their rings were full of eyes round about them four. Và their rings: or, and their strakes
Và when the living creatures went, the wheels went by them: Và when the living creatures were lifted up from đất, the wheels were lifted up.
Whithersoever the spirit was to go, they went, thither was their spirit to go; Và the wheels were lifted up đối diện them: for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels. of…: or, của sự sống
When those went, these went; Và when those stood, these đứng; Và when those were lifted up from đất, the wheels were lifted up đối diện them: for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels. of…: or, của sự sống
Và the likeness of the firmament upon the heads of the living creature was as the colour of the terrible crystal, stretched forth over their heads above.
Và under the firmament were their wings thẳng, the one toward the other: every one had two, which covered on this side, và mãi mãiy one had two, which covered on that side, their bodies.
Và when they went, I heard the noise of their wings, like the noise of great waters, as the voice of the Almighty, tiếng of speech, as the noise of an host: when they stood, they let down their wings.
Và there was a voice from the firmament that was over their heads, when they stood, Và had let down their wings.
Và above the firmament that was over their heads was the likeness of a throne, as the appearance of a sapphire stone: Và upon the likeness of the throne was the likeness as the appearance of a man above upon it.
Và I saw as the colour of amber, as the appearance lửa round about within it, from the appearance of his loins even upward, Và from the appearance of his loins even downward, I saw as it were the appearance lửa, Và it had brightness round about.
As the appearance of the bow that is in đám mây trong ngày of rain, so was the appearance of the brightness round about. This was the appearance of the likeness of sự vinh hiển of the CHÚA. Và when I saw it, I fell upon my face, Và I heard a voice of one that spake.

CHAPTER 2.
Và he nói unto me, Son of man, stand upon thy feet, Và I will speak unto ngươi.
Và the spirit entered into me when he spake unto me, and set me upon my feet, that I heard him that spake unto me.
Và he nói unto me, Son of man, I send ngươi to the children của I-sơ-ra-ên, to a rebellious nation that hath rebelled against me: they and their fathers have transgressed against me, even unto this very ngày. nation: Heb. nations
For họ là impudent children Và stiffhearted. I do send ngươi với họ; and ngươi shalt say với họ, Thus nói Chúa
God. impudent: Heb. hard of face
Và they, whether they will hear, or whether they will forbear, (for they are a rebellious nhà,) yet shall know that there hath been a prophet among them.
Và thou, son of man, be not afraid of them, neither be afraid of their words, though briers Và thorns be with ngươi, and ngươi dost ở among bò cạp: be not afraid of their words, nor be dismayed at their looks, though they be a rebellious nhà. briers…: or, rebels
Và ngươi shalt speak my words với họ, whether they will hear, or whether they will forbear: for they are most rebellious. most…: Heb. rebellion
But thou, son of man, nghe what I say unto ngươi; Be not ngươi rebellious like that rebellious nhà: open thy mouth, Và eat that I give ngươi.
Và when I looked, kìa, an hand was sent unto me; and, lo, a roll of a book was therein;
Và he spread it before me; and it was written within Và without: and there was written therein ca thươngs, Và than khóc, Và woe.

CHAPTER 3.
Moreover he nói unto me, Son of man, ăn that ngươi findest; ăn this roll, và đi nói unđến nhà của I-sơ-ra-ên.
So I opened my mouth, Và he caused me to eat that roll.
Và he nói unto me, Son of man, cause thy belly to eat, Và fill thy bowels with this roll that I give ngươi. Then did I eat it; Và it was in my mouth as honey for sweetness.
Và he nói unto me, Son of man, đi, get ngươi unđến nhà của I-sơ-ra-ên, Và speak with my words với họ.
For thou art not sent to a people of a strange speech Và of an hard language, but đến nhà của I-sơ-ra-ên; of a…: Heb. deep of lip, and heavy of tongue
Not to many people of a strange speech Và of an hard language, whose words ngươi canst not understand. Surely, had I sent ngươi to them, they would have hearkened unto ngươi. of a…: Heb. deep of lip, and heavy of language Surely…: or, If I had sent ngươi, etc. would they not have hearkened unto ngươi?
But nhà của I-sơ-ra-ên will not hearken unto ngươi; for they will not hearken unto me: for all nhà của I-sơ-ra-ên are impudent Và hardhearted. impudent…: Heb. stiff of forehead, and hard of heart
kìa, I have made thy face strong against their faces, Và thy forehead strong against their foreheads.
As an adamant harder than flint have I made thy forehead: fear them not, neither be dismayed at their looks, though they be a rebellious nhà.
Moreover he nói unto me, Son of man, all my words that I shall speak unto ngươi receive in thine heart, Và hear with thine ears.
và đi, get ngươi to them of the captivity, unto the children of thy people, Và speak với họ, and tell them, Thus nói Chúa
God; whether they will hear, or whether they will forbear.
Then the spirit took me up, Và I heard behind me a voice of a great rushing, nói [rằng], phước be sự vinh hiển of the CHÚA from his place.
I heard also the noise of the wings of the living creatures that touched một another, Và the noise of the wheels đối diện them, and a noise of a great rushing. touched: Heb. kissed
So the spirit lifted me up, Và took me away, Và I went in bitterness, in the heat of my spirit; but tay of the CHÚA was strong upon me. in bitterness: Heb. bitter heat: Heb. hot anger
Then I came to them of the captivity at Tel–abib, that dwelt by the river of Chebar, Và I sat where they sat, Và remained there astonished among them bảy ngày.
Và xảy đến at the end of bảy ngày, that the word of the CHÚA came unto me, saying,
Son of man, I have made ngươi a watchman unđến nhà của I-sơ-ra-ên: therefore hear lời at my mouth, Và give them warning from me.
When I say unto the wicked, ngươi shalt surely chết; Và ngươi givest him not warning, nor speakest to warn the wicked from his wicked way, to save his sự sống; the same wicked man sẽ chết in his iniquity; but his blood will I require at thine hand.
Yet if ngươi warn the wicked, Và he turn not from his wickedness, nor from his wicked way, he shall die in his iniquity; but ngươi hast delivered thy soul.
Again, When a righteous man doth turn from his righteousness, Và commit iniquity, Và I lay a stumblingblock before him, he shall die: because ngươi hast not given him warning, he shall die in his sin, Và his righteousness which he hath done shall not be nhớ lại; but his blood will I require at thine hand. righteousness which: Heb. righteousnesses
Nevertheless if ngươi warn the righteous man, that the righteous tội lỗi not, and he doth not sin, he shall surely live, because he is warned; also ngươi hast delivered thy soul.
Và tay of the CHÚA was there upon me; and he nói unto me, Arise, go forth into the plain, Và I will there talk with ngươi.
Then I arose, Và went forth into the plain: and, kìa, sự vinh hiển of the CHÚA đứng there, as sự vinh hiển which I saw by the river of Chebar: Và I fell on my face.
Then the spirit entered into me, and set me upon my feet, Và spake with me, and nói unto me, Go, shut thyself within thine house.
But thou, O son of man, kìa, they shall put bands upon ngươi, and shall bind ngươi with them, and ngươi shalt not go out among them:
Và I will make thy tongue cleave to the roof of thy mouth, that ngươi shalt be dumb, Và shalt not be to them a reprover: for they are a rebellious nhà. a reprover: Heb. a man reproving
But when I speak với ngươi, I will open thy mouth, Và ngươi shalt say với họ, Thus nói Chúa
God; He that nghe, let him hear; Và he that forbeareth, let him forbear: for they are a rebellious nhà.

CHAPTER 4.
ngươi also, son of man, take ngươi a tile, Và lay it before ngươi, and pourtray upon it the city, even Giê-ru-sa-lem:
Và lay siege against it, and build a fort against it, and cast a mount against it; set the camp also against it, and set battering rams against it round about. battering…: chief leaders
Moreover take ngươi unto ngươi an sắt pan, Và set it for a wall of sắt between ngươi and the city: Và set thy face against it, and it shall be besieged, Và ngươi shalt lay siege against it. This shall be a sign đến nhà của I-sơ-ra-ên. an…: or, a flat plate, or, slice
Lie ngươi also upon thy left side, Và lay the iniquity của nhà của I-sơ-ra-ên upon it: according to the number of the days that ngươi shalt lie upon it ngươi shalt bear their iniquity.
For I have laid upon ngươi the years of their iniquity, according to the number of the days, ba trăm Và ninety ngày: so shalt ngươi bear the iniquity của nhà của I-sơ-ra-ên.
Và when ngươi hast accomplished họ, lie again on thy right side, Và ngươi shalt bear the iniquity của nhà của Giu-đa bốn mươi ngày: I have appointed ngươi each day for a year. each…: Heb. a day for a year, a day for a year
Therefore ngươi shalt set thy face toward the siege of Giê-ru-sa-lem, Và thine arm shall be uncovered, Và ngươi shalt prophesy against it.
And, kìa, I will lay bands upon ngươi, and ngươi shalt not turn ngươi from one side to another, till ngươi hast ended the days of thy siege. from one…: Heb. from thy side to thy side
Take ngươi also unto ngươi wheat, Và barley, Và beans, Và lentiles, Và millet, Và fitches, Và put them in one vessel, Và make ngươi bread thereof, according to the number of the days that ngươi shalt lie upon thy side, ba trăm Và ninety ngày shalt ngươi eat thereof. fitches: or, spelt
Và thy meat which ngươi shalt eat shall be by weight, hai mươi shekels a day: from time to time shalt ngươi eat it.
ngươi shalt drink also water by measure, thứ sáu part of an hin: from time to time shalt ngươi drink.
Và ngươi shalt eat it as barley cakes, Và ngươi shalt bake it with dung that cometh out of man, in their sight.
Và the CHÚA nói, Even thus shall the children của I-sơ-ra-ên ăn their làm dơ dáyd bánh among the Gentiles, whither I will drive them.
Then nói I, Ah Lord
God! kìa, my soul hath not been polluted: for from my youth up even till now have I not eaten of that which dieth of itself, or is torn in pieces; neither came there abominable flesh into my mouth.
Then he nói unto me, Lo, I have given ngươi cow's dung for man's dung, Và ngươi shalt prepare thy bread therewith.
Moreover he nói unto me, Son of man, kìa, I will break the staff of bread in Giê-ru-sa-lem: Và they shall eat bánh by weight, Và with care; Và they shall drink nước by measure, Và with astonishment:
That they may want bánh Và water, Và be astonied một with another, Và consume away for their iniquity.

CHAPTER 5.
Và thou, son of man, take ngươi a sharp knife, take ngươi a barber's razor, and cause it to pass upon thine head Và upon thy beard: then take ngươi balances to weigh, Và divide the hair.
ngươi shalt burn bằng lửa a third part in the midst of the city, when the days of the siege được trọn: Và ngươi shalt take a third part, Và smite about it with a knife: Và a third part ngươi shalt scatter in the wind; Và I will draw out a thanh gươm after them.
ngươi shalt also take thereof a few in number, Và bind them in thy skirts. skirts: Heb. wings
Then take of them again, Và cast them into the midst of the fire, Và burn them in the fire; for thereof shall a fire come forth into all nhà của I-sơ-ra-ên.
Thus nói Chúa
God; This is Giê-ru-sa-lem: I have set it in the midst of the nations Và countries that are round about her.
Và she hath changed my judgments into wickedness more than the nations, Và my statutes more than the countries that are round about her: for they have refused my judgments Và my statutes, they have not walked in them.
Therefore thus nói Chúa
God; Because ye multiplied more than the nations that are round about you, Và have not walked in my statutes, neither have kept my judgments, neither have done according to the judgments of the nations that are round about you;
Therefore thus nói Chúa
God; kìa, I, even I, là against ngươi, and will execute judgments in the midst of ngươi in the sight of the nations.
Và I will do in ngươi that which I have not done, Và whereunto I will not do any more the like, because of all thine abominations.
Therefore chas shall eat the sons in the midst of ngươi, and the sons shall eat cha ông của họ; Và I will execute judgments in ngươi, and the whole remnant of ngươi will I scatter into all gió.
Wherefore, as I live, nói Chúa
God; Surely, because ngươi hast làm dơ dáyd my sanctuary with all thy detestable things, Và with all thine abominations, therefore will I also diminish ngươi; neither shall mine eye spare, neither will I have any pity.
A third part of ngươi shall die with the pestilence, Và with famine shall they be consumed in the midst of ngươi: and a third part shall fall by thanh gươm round about ngươi; and I will scatter a third part into all gió, Và I will draw out a thanh gươm after them.
Thus shall mine anger be accomplished, Và I will cause my fury to rest upon them, and I will được yên ủi: Và they shall know that I the CHÚA have spoken it in my zeal, when I have accomplished my fury in them.
Moreover I will make ngươi waste, Và a reproach among the nations that are round about ngươi, in the sight of all that pass by.
So it shall be a reproach Và a taunt, an instruction Và an astonishment unto the nations that are round about ngươi, when I shall execute judgments in ngươi in anger Và in fury Và in furious rebukes. I the CHÚA have spoken it.
When I shall send upon them the evil arrows of famine, which shall be for their destruction, Và which I will send to destroy you: and I will increase the famine upon you, and will break your staff of bread:
So will I send upon you famine Và evil beasts, Và they shall bereave ngươi; and pestilence Và blood shall pass through ngươi; and I will bring thanh gươm upon ngươi. I the CHÚA have spoken it.

CHAPTER 6.
Và the word of the CHÚA came unto me, saying,
Son of man, set thy face toward núis của I-sơ-ra-ên, Và prophesy against them,
Và say, Ye mountains của I-sơ-ra-ên, nghe lời của ĐCT
God; Thus nói Chúa
God to núis, Và to the hills, to the rivers, Và to the valleys; kìa, I, even I, will bring a thanh gươm upon you, and I will destroy your high places.
Và your altars shall be desolate, Và your images shall be broken: Và I will cast down your slain men before your idols. images: or, sun images
Và I will lay kẻ chết carcases of the children của I-sơ-ra-ên before their idols; Và I will scatter your bones round about your altars. lay: Heb. give
In all your ởingplaces the cities shall be laid waste, Và the high places shall be desolate; that your altars may be laid waste Và made desolate, Và your idols may be broken Và cease, Và your images may be cut down, Và your works may be abolished. images: or, sun images
Và the slain shall fall in the midst of you, and ngươi sẽ know that I là the CHÚA.
Yet will I leave a remnant, that ye may have some that shall escape thanh gươm among the nations, when ngươi sẽ be scattered through the countries.
Và they that escape of you shall remember me among the nations whither they shall be carried captives, because I am broken with their whorish heart, which hath departed from me, and with their eyes, which go a whoring after their idols: Và they shall lothe themselves for the evils which they have committed in all their abominations.
Và they shall know that I là the CHÚA, Và that I have not nói vô ích that I would do this evil với họ.
Thus nói Chúa
God; Smite with thine hand, Và stamp with thy foot, Và say, Alas for all the evil abominations của nhà của I-sơ-ra-ên! for they shall fall by thanh gươm, by the famine, Và by the pestilence.
He that is far off sẽ chết of the pestilence; Và he that is near shall fall by thanh gươm; Và he that remaineth Và is besieged sẽ chết by the famine: thus will I accomplish my fury upon them.
Then shall ye know that I là the CHÚA, when their slain men shall be among their idols round about their altars, upon every high đồi, in all the tops of núis, Và under every green cây, Và under every thick oak, the place where they did offer sweet savour to all their idols.
So will I stretch out my hand upon them, and make the land desolate, yea, more desolate than the wilderness toward Diblath, in all their habitations: Và they shall know that I là the CHÚA. more…: or, desolate from the wilderness

CHAPTER 7.
Moreover the word of the CHÚA came unto me, saying,
Also, ngươi son of man, thus nói Chúa
God unto the land của I-sơ-ra-ên; An end, the end is come upon the four corners of the land.
Now is the end đến upon ngươi, and I will send mine anger upon ngươi, and will judge ngươi according to thy ways, Và will recompense upon ngươi all thine abominations. recompense: Heb. give
Và mine eye shall not spare ngươi, neither will I have pity: but I will recompense thy ways upon ngươi, and thine abominations shall be in the midst of ngươi: and ngươi sẽ know that I là the CHÚA.
Thus nói Chúa
God; An evil, an only evil, kìa, is come.
An end is come, the end is come: it watcheth for ngươi; kìa, it is come. watcheth for: Heb. awaketh against
buổi sáng is come unto ngươi, O ngươi that ởest in the land: the time is come, ngày of trouble is gần, Và not the sounding again of núis. sounding…: or, echo
Now will I shortly pour out my fury upon ngươi, and accomplish mine anger upon ngươi: and I will judge ngươi according to thy ways, Và will recompense ngươi for all thine abominations.
Và mine eye shall not spare, neither will I have pity: I will recompense ngươi according to thy ways Và thine abominations that are in the midst of ngươi; and ngươi sẽ know that I là the CHÚA that smiteth. ngươi according: Heb. upon ngươi, etc
kìa the day, kìa, it is come: buổi sáng is gone forth; the rod hath blossomed, pride hath budded.
Violence is risen up into a rod of wickedness: none of them shall remain, nor of their multitude, nor of any of theirs: neither shall there be khóc lóc for them. theirs: or, their tumultuous persons: Heb. tumult
The time is come, ngày draweth near: let not the buyer rejoice, nor the seller than khóc: for wrath is upon all đám đông thereof.
For the seller shall not return to that which is sold, although they were yet alive: for the vision is touching the whole multitude thereof, which shall not return; neither shall any strengthen himself in the iniquity of his sự sống. although they…: Heb. though their sự sống were yet among the living in the…: or, whose sự sống is in his iniquity the iniquity: Heb. his iniquity
They have blown the trumpet, even to make all ready; but none goeth to the battle: for my wrath is upon all đám đông thereof.
The thanh gươm is without, Và the pestilence Và the famine within: he that is in the field sẽ chết with thanh gươm; and he that is in the city, một cơn hạn hán Và pestilence shall devour him.
But they that escape of them shall escape, Và shall be on núis like bồ câu of the valleys, all of them than khóc, every one for his iniquity.
All hands shall be feeble, Và all knees shall be weak as nước. be weak…: Heb. go into water
They shall also gird themselves with vải bố, Và horror shall cover them; and shame shall be upon all faces, Và baldness upon all their heads.
They shall cast their silver in the streets, Và their gold shall be removed: their silver Và their gold shall not be able to deliver them trong ngày of cơn thịnh nộ of the CHÚA: they shall not satisfy their souls, neither fill their bowels: because it is the stumblingblock of their iniquity. removed: Heb. for a separation, or, ô uế it is…: or, their iniquity is their stumblingblock
As for the beauty of his ornament, he set it in majesty: but they made the images of their abominations Và of their detestable things therein: therefore have I set it far from them. set it far…: or, made it với họ an unclean thing
Và I will give it into tays of the strangers for a prey, Và to the wicked đất for a spoil; Và they shall pollute it.
My face will I turn also from them, and they shall pollute my secret place: for the robbers shall enter into it, and làm dơ dáy it. robbers: or, burglers
Make a chain: for the land is full of bloody crimes, Và the city is full of violence.
Wherefore I will bring the worst of the heathen, Và they shall possess their houses: I will also make the pomp of the strong to cease; Và their holy places shall be làm dơ dáyd. their holy…: or, they shall inherit their holy places
Destruction đến; Và they sẽ thấy peace, and there shall be none. Destruction: Heb. Cutting off
Mischief shall come upon mischief, Và rumour shall be upon rumour; then họ sẽ thấy a vision of the prophet; but the law shall perish from thầy tế lễ, Và counsel from the ancients.
The king shall mourn, Và the prince shall be clothed with desolation, Và tays của dân sự of the land shall be troubled: I will do với họ after their way, Và according to their deserts will I judge them; and they shall know that I là the CHÚA. according…: Heb. with their judgments

CHAPTER 8.
Và xảy đến in thứ sáu năm, in thứ sáu month, in the fifth ngày của tháng, as I sat in mine house, Và các trưởng lão của Giu-đa sat before me, that tay của ĐCT
God rơi there upon me.
Then I beheld, Và lo a likeness as the appearance lửa: from the appearance of his loins even downward, lửa; Và from his loins even upward, as the appearance of brightness, as the colour of amber.
Và he put forth the form of an hand, Và took me by a lock of mine head; Và the spirit lifted me up between đất Và the heaven, Và brought me in the visions của ĐCT to Giê-ru-sa-lem, to the door of the inner gate that looketh toward the north; where was biểnt of the image of jealousy, which provoketh to jealousy.
And, kìa, sự vinh hiển of ĐCT của I-sơ-ra-ên was there, according to the vision that I saw in the plain.
Then nói he unto me, Son of man, lift up thine eyes now the way toward the north. So I lifted up mine eyes đường toward the north, Và kìa northward at cổng of the altar this image of jealousy in the entry.
He nói furthermore unto me, Son of man, seest ngươi what they do? even the great abominations that nhà của I-sơ-ra-ên committeth here, that I should go far off from my sanctuary? but turn ngươi yet again, Và ngươi shalt see lớn hơn abominations.
Và he brought me to the door of the court; Và when I looked, kìa a hole in the wall.
Then nói he unto me, Son of man, dig now in the wall: Và when I had digged in the wall, kìa a cửa.
Và he nói unto me, Go in, Và kìa the wicked abominations that they do here.
So I went in Và saw; Và kìa every form of creeping things, Và abominable beasts, Và all the idols của nhà của I-sơ-ra-ên, pourtrayed upon the wall round about.
Và there stood before them bảy mươi men of the ancients của nhà của I-sơ-ra-ên, Và in the midst of them stood Jaazaniah con trai of Shaphan, with every man his censer in his hand; Và a thick cloud of incense đi lên.
Then nói he unto me, Son of man, hast ngươi seen what the ancients của nhà của I-sơ-ra-ên do in the dark, every man in the chambers of his imagery? for they say, The CHÚA seeth us not; the CHÚA hath forsaken đất.
He nói also unto me, Turn ngươi yet again, Và ngươi shalt see lớn hơn abominations that they do.
Then he brought me to the door of cổng of the Lord's nhà which was toward the north; and, kìa, there sat women khóc lóc for Tammuz.
Then nói he unto me, Hast ngươi seen này, O son of man? turn ngươi yet again, Và ngươi shalt see lớn hơn abominations than these.
Và he brought me into the inner court of the Lord's nhà, and, kìa, at the door of đền thờ of the CHÚA, between the porch Và the altar, were about five Và hai mươi men, with their backs toward đền thờ of the CHÚA, Và their faces toward the east; Và they worshipped mặt trời toward the east.
Then he nói unto me, Hast ngươi seen này, O son of man? Is it a light thing đến nhà của Giu-đa that they commit the abominations which they commit here? for they have filled the land with violence, Và have returned to provoke me to anger: and, lo, they put the branch to their nose. Is it…: or, Is there any thing lighter than to commit
Therefore will I also deal in fury: mine eye shall not spare, neither will I have pity: Và though they cry in mine ears with a loud tiếng, yet will I not hear them.

CHAPTER 9.
He cried also in mine ears with a loud tiếng, nói [rằng], Cause them that have charge over the city to draw near, even every man với his destroying weapon in his hand.
And, kìa, six men đến from the way of the higher gate, which lieth toward the north, và mãi mãiy man a slaughter weapon in his hand; Và one man among them was mặc with linen, with a writer's inkhorn by his side: Và they went in, Và stood beside the brasen altar. which lieth: Heb. which is turned a slaughter…: Heb. a weapon of his breaking in pieces by his…: Heb. upon his loins
Và sự vinh hiển of ĐCT của I-sơ-ra-ên was gone up from the cherub, whereupon he was, to the threshold của nhà. Và he called to the man mặc with linen, which had the writer's inkhorn by his side;
Và the CHÚA nói unto him, Go through the midst of the city, through the midst of Giê-ru-sa-lem, Và set a Mác upon the foreheads of the men that sigh Và that cry for all the abominations that be done in the midst thereof. set a mark: Heb. mark a mark
Và to the others he nói in mine hearing, đi ye after him through the city, Và smite: let not your eye spare, neither have ye pity: mine hearing: Heb. mine ears
Slay utterly old Và young, both maids, Và little children, Và women: but come not near any man upon whom is the Mác; Và begin at my sanctuary. Then they began at the ancient men which were before nhà. utterly: Heb. to destruction
Và he nói với họ, làm dơ dáy nhà, Và fill the courts with the slain: go ye forth. Và they went forth, Và slew in the city.
Và xảy đến, while they were slaying them, and I was left, that I fell upon my face, Và cried, và nói, Ah Lord
God! wilt ngươi destroy all the residue của I-sơ-ra-ên in thy pouring out of thy fury upon Giê-ru-sa-lem?
Then nói he unto me, The iniquity của nhà của I-sơ-ra-ên Và Giu-đa is exceeding great, Và the land is full of blood, Và the city full of perverseness: for they say, The CHÚA hath forsaken đất, Và the CHÚA seeth not. full of blood: Heb. filled with, etc perverseness: or, wresting of judgment
Và as for me also, mine eye shall not spare, neither will I have pity, but I will recompense their way upon their head.
And, kìa, the man mặc with linen, which had the inkhorn by his side, reported the matter, nói [rằng], I have done as ngươi hast commanded me. reported…: Heb. returned the word

CHAPTER 10.
Then I looked, and, kìa, in the firmament that was above the head of the cherubims there appeared over them as it were a sapphire stone, as the appearance of the likeness of a throne.
Và he spake unto the man mặc with linen, và nói, Go in between the wheels, even under the cherub, Và fill thine hand with coals lửa from between the cherubims, Và scatter họ over the city. Và he went in in my sight. thine hand: Heb. the hollow of thine hand
Now the cherubims đứng on the right side của nhà, when the man went in; Và đám mây filled the inner court.
Then sự vinh hiển of the CHÚA đi lên from the cherub, Và stood over the threshold của nhà; Và nhà was filled with đám mây, Và the court was full of the brightness of the Lord's glory. went up: Heb. was lifted up
Và the sound of the cherubims' wings was heard even to the outer court, as the voice of the Almighty ĐCT when he speaketh.
Và xảy đến, that when he had commanded the man mặc with linen, nói [rằng], Take lửa from between the wheels, from between the cherubims; then he went in, Và stood beside the wheels.
Và one cherub stretched forth his hand from between the cherubims unto the fire that was between the cherubims, Và took thereof, Và put it into tays of him that was mặc with linen: who took it, Và went out. stretched forth: Heb. sent forth
Và there appeared in the cherubims the form of a man's tay under their wings.
Và when I looked, kìa the four wheels by the cherubims, một wheel by một cherub, Và another wheel by another cherub: Và the appearance of the wheels was as the colour of a beryl stone.
Và as for their appearances, they four had one likeness, as if a wheel had been in the midst of a wheel.
When they went, they went upon their four sides; they turned not as they went, but to the place whither the head looked they followed it; they turned not as they went.
Và their whole body, Và their backs, Và their hands, Và their wings, Và the wheels, were full of eyes round about, even the wheels that they four had. body: Heb. flesh
As for the wheels, it was cried với họ in my hearing, O wheel. it was…: or, they were called in my hearing, wheel, or, galgal
và mãi mãiy one had four faces: the first mặt was mặt of a cherub, Và the second mặt was mặt of a man, Và the third mặt of a lion, Và the fourth mặt of an eagle.
Và the cherubims were lifted up. This is the living creature that I saw by the river of Chebar.
Và when the cherubims went, the wheels went by them: Và when the cherubims lifted up their wings to mount up from đất, the same wheels also turned not from beside them.
When they stood, these đứng; Và when they were lifted up, these lifted up themselves also: for the spirit of the living creature was in them. of…: or, của sự sống
Then sự vinh hiển of the CHÚA departed from off the threshold của nhà, Và stood over the cherubims.
Và the cherubims lifted up their wings, Và mounted up from đất in my sight: when they went out, the wheels also were beside them, and every one đứng at the door of the east gate of the Lord's nhà; Và sự vinh hiển of ĐCT của I-sơ-ra-ên was over them above.
This is the living creature that I saw under ĐCT của I-sơ-ra-ên by the river of Chebar; Và I knew that they were the cherubims.
Every one had four faces apiece, và mãi mãiy one bốn wings; Và the likeness of tays of a man was under their wings.
Và the likeness of their faces was the same faces which I saw by the river of Chebar, their appearances Và themselves: they went every one thẳng forward.

CHAPTER 11.
Moreover the spirit lifted me up, Và brought me unto the east gate of the Lord's nhà, which looketh hướng đông: Và kìa at the door of cổng năm Và hai mươi men; among whom I saw Jaazaniah con trai of Azur, Và Pelatiah con trai of Benaiah, princes của dân sự.
Then nói he unto me, Son of man, these are the men that devise mischief, Và give gian ác counsel in this city:
Which say, It is not near; let us build houses: this city is the caldron, and we be xác thịt. It is…: or, It is not for us to build houses near
Therefore prophesy against them, prophesy, O son of man.
Và the Spirit of the CHÚA rơi upon me, and nói unto me, Speak; Thus nói the CHÚA; Thus have ye nói, O house của I-sơ-ra-ên: vì tôi biết the things that come into your mind, every one of them.
Ye have multiplied your slain in this city, Và ye have filled the streets thereof with the slain.
Therefore thus nói Chúa
God; Your slain whom ye have laid in the midst of it, they are xác thịt, and this city is the caldron: but I will bring you forth out of the midst of it.
Ye have feared thanh gươm; Và I will bring a thanh gươm upon you, nói Chúa
God.
Và I will bring you out of the midst thereof, and deliver you into tays of strangers, Và will execute judgments among you.
ngươi sẽ fall by thanh gươm; I will judge you in the border của I-sơ-ra-ên; Và ngươi sẽ know that I là the CHÚA.
This city shall not be your caldron, neither shall ye be xác thịt in the midst thereof; but I will judge you in the border của I-sơ-ra-ên:
Và ngươi sẽ know that I là the CHÚA: for ye have not walked in my statutes, neither executed my judgments, but have done after the manners of the heathen that are round about you. for ye…: or, which have not walked
Và xảy đến, when I prophesied, that Pelatiah con trai of Benaiah chết. Then fell I down upon my face, Và cried with a loud tiếng, và nói, Ah Lord
God! wilt ngươi make a full end of the remnant của I-sơ-ra-ên?
Again the word of the CHÚA came unto me, saying,
Son of man, thy brethren, even thy brethren, the men of thy kindred, Và all nhà của I-sơ-ra-ên wholly, are they unto whom the inhabitants of Giê-ru-sa-lem have nói, Get you far from the CHÚA: unto us is this land given in possession.
Therefore say, Thus nói Chúa
God; Although I have cast them far off among the heathen, Và although I have scattered them among the countries, yet will I be to them as a little sanctuary in the countries where they shall come.
Therefore say, Thus nói Chúa
God; I will even gather you from the people, Và assemble you out of the countries where ye have been scattered, Và I will give you the land của I-sơ-ra-ên.
Và they shall come thither, and they shall take away all the detestable things thereof and all the abominations thereof from thence.
Và I will give them one heart, Và I will put a new spirit within you; and I will take the stony heart out of their flesh, Và will give them an heart of flesh:
That they may walk in my statutes, Và keep mine ordinances, Và do them: and they shall be my people, Và I will be their God.
But as for them whose heart walketh after the heart of their detestable things Và their abominations, I will recompense their way upon their own heads, nói Chúa
God.
Then did the cherubims lift up their wings, Và the wheels beside them; and sự vinh hiển of ĐCT của I-sơ-ra-ên was over them above.
Và sự vinh hiển of the CHÚA đi lên from the midst of the city, Và stood upon núi which is on the east side of the city.
Afterwards the spirit took me up, Và brought me in a vision by the Spirit của ĐCT into Chaldea, to them of the captivity. So the vision that I had seen đi lên from me.
Then I spake với họ of the captivity all the things that the CHÚA had shewed me.

CHAPTER 12.
lời of the CHÚA also came unto me, saying,
Son of man, ngươi ởest in the midst of a rebellious nhà, which have eyes to see, Và see not; they have ears to hear, Và hear not: for they are a rebellious nhà.
Therefore, ngươi son of man, prepare ngươi stuff for removing, Và remove by day in their sight; Và ngươi shalt remove from thy place to another place in their sight: it may be they will consider, though they be a rebellious nhà. stuff: or, instruments
Then shalt ngươi bring forth thy stuff by day in their sight, as stuff for removing: Và ngươi shalt go forth at even in their sight, as they that go forth into captivity. as they…: Heb. as the goings forth of captivity
Dig ngươi through the wall in their sight, Và carry out thereby. Dig…: Heb. Dig for ngươi
In their sight shalt ngươi bear it upon thy shoulders, Và carry it forth in the twilight: ngươi shalt cover thy face, that ngươi see not the ground: for I have set ngươi for a sign unđến nhà của I-sơ-ra-ên.
Và I did so as I was commanded: I brought forth my stuff by day, as stuff for captivity, Và in the even I digged through the wall with mine hand; I brought it forth in the twilight, Và I bare it upon my shoulder in their sight. digged: Heb. digged for me
Và in buổi sáng came the word of the CHÚA unto me, saying,
Son of man, hath not nhà của I-sơ-ra-ên, the rebellious nhà, nói unto ngươi, What doest thou?
Say ngươi với họ, Thus nói Chúa
God; This burden concerneth the prince in Giê-ru-sa-lem, Và all nhà của I-sơ-ra-ên that are among them.
Say, I là your sign: like as I have done, so shall it be done với họ: they shall remove Và đi into captivity. they…: Heb. by removing go into captivity
Và the prince that is among them shall bear upon his shoulder in the twilight, Và shall go forth: they shall dig through the wall to carry out thereby: he shall cover his face, that he see not the ground with his mắt.
My net also will I spread upon him, and he shall be taken in my snare: Và I will bring him to Ba-by-lôn to the land of the Chaldeans; yet shall he not see it, though he shall die there.
Và I will scatter toward every wind all that are about him to help him, and all his bands; Và I will draw out thanh gươm after them.
Và they shall know that I là the CHÚA, when I shall scatter them among the nations, Và disperse them in the countries.
But I will leave a few men of them from thanh gươm, from the famine, Và from the pestilence; that they may declare all their abominations among the heathen whither they come; Và they shall know that I là the CHÚA. a few…: Heb. men of number
Moreover the word of the CHÚA came to me, saying,
Son of man, ăn thy bread with quaking, và uống thy water with trembling Và with carefulness;
Và say unto the people of the land, Thus nói Chúa
God of the inhabitants of Giê-ru-sa-lem, Và of the land của I-sơ-ra-ên; They shall eat their bread with carefulness, và uống their water with astonishment, that her land may be desolate from all that is therein, vì cớ the violence of all them that ở therein. all that…: Heb. the fulness thereof
Và the cities that are inhabited shall be laid waste, Và the land shall be desolate; Và ngươi sẽ know that I là the CHÚA.
Và the word of the CHÚA came unto me, saying,
Son of man, what is that proverb that ye have in the land của I-sơ-ra-ên, nói [rằng], The days are prolonged, và mãi mãiy vision faileth?
Tell them therefore, Thus nói Chúa
God; I will make this proverb to cease, Và they shall no more use it as a proverb in I-sơ-ra-ên; but say với họ, The days are at hand, Và the effect of every vision.
