For there shall be no more any vain vision nor flattering divination within nhà của I-sơ-ra-ên.
For I là the CHÚA: I will speak, Và the word that I shall speak shall come to pass; it shall be no more prolonged: for in your days, O rebellious nhà, will I say lời, Và will perform it, nói Chúa
God.
Again the word of the CHÚA came to me, saying,
Son of man, kìa, they of nhà của I-sơ-ra-ên say, The vision that he seeth is for many ngày to come, Và he prophesieth of the times that are far off.
Therefore say với họ, Thus nói Chúa
God; There shall none of my words be prolonged any more, but the word which I have spoken shall be done, nói Chúa
God.

CHAPTER 13.
Và the word of the CHÚA came unto me, saying,
Son of man, prophesy against các tiên tri của I-sơ-ra-ên that prophesy, Và say ngươi với họ that prophesy out of their own hearts, nghe ye the word of the CHÚA; that prophesy out…: Heb. that are các tiên tri out of their own hearts
Thus nói Chúa
God; Khốn thay unto the foolish các tiên tri, that follow their own spirit, Và have seen nothing!follow: Heb. walk after and…: or, and things which they have not seen
O I-sơ-ra-ên, thy các tiên tri are like the foxes in the deserts.
Ye have not gone up into the gaps, neither made up the hedge for nhà của I-sơ-ra-ên to stand in the battle trong ngày of the CHÚA. gaps: or, breaches made…: Heb. hedged the hedge
They have seen hư không Và lying divination, nói [rằng], The CHÚA nói: Và the CHÚA hath not sent them: and they have made Những người khác to hy vọng that they would confirm lời.
Have ye not seen a vain vision, Và have ye not spoken a lying divination, whereas ye say, The CHÚA nói it; albeit I have not spoken?
Therefore thus nói Chúa
God; Because ye have spoken hư không, Và seen lies, therefore, kìa, I là against you, nói Chúa
God.
Và mine hand shall be upon các tiên tri that see hư không, Và that divine lies: they shall not be in the assembly of my people, neither shall they be written in the writing của nhà của I-sơ-ra-ên, neither shall they enter into the land của I-sơ-ra-ên; Và ngươi sẽ know that I là Chúa
God. assembly: or, secret, or, counsel
Because, even because they have seduced my people, nói [rằng], Peace; and there was no peace; Và one built up a wall, and, lo, others daubed it with untempered morter: a wall: or, a slight wall
Say với họ which daub it with untempered morter, that it shall fall: there shall be an overflowing shower; Và ye, O great hailstones, shall fall; Và a stormy wind shall rend it.
Lo, when the wall is fallen, shall it not be nói cùng các ngươi, Where is the daubing wherewith ye have daubed it?
Therefore thus nói Chúa
God; I will even rend it with a stormy wind in my fury; Và there shall be an overflowing shower in mine anger, Và great hailstones in my fury to consume it.
So will I break down the wall that ye have daubed with untempered morter, Và bring it down to the ground, so that the foundation thereof shall be discovered, Và it shall fall, Và ngươi sẽ be consumed in the midst thereof: and ngươi sẽ know that I là the CHÚA.
Thus will I accomplish my wrath upon the wall, Và upon them that have daubed it with untempered morter, Và will say cùng các ngươi, The wall is no more, neither they that daubed it;
To wit, các tiên tri của I-sơ-ra-ên which prophesy concerning Giê-ru-sa-lem, Và which see visions of peace for her, and there is no peace, nói Chúa
God.
cũng như vậy, ngươi son of man, set thy face against the daughters of thy people, which prophesy out of their own heart; Và prophesy ngươi against them,
Và say, Thus nói Chúa
God; Khốn thay to the women that sew pillows to all armholes, Và make kerchiefs upon the head of every stature to hunt souls! Will ye hunt the souls of my people, Và will ye save the souls alive that come cùng các ngươi? armholes: or, elbows
Và will ye pollute me among my people for handfuls of barley Và for pieces of bread, to slay the souls that should not die, Và to save the souls alive that should not live, by your lying to my people that hear your lies?
Wherefore thus nói Chúa
God; kìa, I là against your pillows, wherewith ye there hunt the souls to make họ fly, Và I will tear them from your arms, Và will let the souls đi, even the souls that ye hunt to make họ fly. to make…: or, into gardens
Your kerchiefs also will I tear, Và deliver my people out of your hand, Và they shall be no more in your hand to be hunted; Và ngươi sẽ know that I là the CHÚA.
Because with lies ye have made the heart of the righteous sad, whom I have not made sad; Và strengthened tay of the wicked, that he should not return from his wicked way, by promising him sự sống: by…: or, that I should save his sự sống: Heb. by quickening him
Therefore các ngươi sẽ thấy no more hư không, nor divine divinations: for I will deliver my people out of your hand: Và ngươi sẽ know that I là the CHÚA.

CHAPTER 14.
Then came certain of các trưởng lão của I-sơ-ra-ên unto me, and sat before me.
Và the word of the CHÚA came unto me, saying,
Son of man, these men have set up their idols in their heart, Và put the stumblingblock of their iniquity before their face: should I be enquired of at all by them?
Therefore speak với họ, and say với họ, Thus nói Chúa
God; Every man của nhà của I-sơ-ra-ên that setteth up his idols in his heart, Và putteth the stumblingblock of his iniquity before his face, Và cometh to the prophet; I the CHÚA will answer him that cometh according to đám đông of his idols;
That I may take nhà của I-sơ-ra-ên in their own heart, because they are all estranged from me through their idols.
Therefore say unđến nhà của I-sơ-ra-ên, Thus nói Chúa
God; Repent, Và turn yourselves from your idols; Và turn away your faces from all your abominations. yourselves: or, others
for every one của nhà của I-sơ-ra-ên, or of the stranger that sojourneth in I-sơ-ra-ên, which separateth himself from me, Và setteth up his idols in his heart, Và putteth the stumblingblock of his iniquity before his face, Và cometh to a prophet to enquire of him concerning me; I the CHÚA will answer him by myself:
Và I will set my face against that man, Và will make him a sign Và a proverb, Và I will cut him off from the midst of my people; Và ngươi sẽ know that I là the CHÚA.
Và if the prophet be deceived when he hath spoken a thing, I the CHÚA have deceived that prophet, Và I will stretch out my hand upon him, and will destroy him from the midst of my people I-sơ-ra-ên.
Và they shall bear the punishment of their iniquity: the punishment of the prophet shall be even as the punishment of him that seeketh unto him;
That nhà của I-sơ-ra-ên may go no more astray from me, neither be polluted any more with all their transgressions; but that they may be my people, Và I may be their God, nói Chúa
God.
lời of the CHÚA came again to me, saying,
Son of man, when the land phạm tội against me by trespassing grievously, then will I stretch out mine hand upon it, and will break the staff of the bread thereof, and will send một cơn hạn hán upon it, and will cut off man Và beast from it:
Though these three men, Nô-ê, Đa-ni-ên, Và Job, were in it, they should deliver but their own souls by their righteousness, nói Chúa
God.
nếu I cause noisome beasts to pass through the land, Và they spoil it, so that it be desolate, that không ai may pass through vì of the beasts: spoil: or, bereave
Though these three men were in it, as I live, nói Chúa
God, they shall deliver neither sons nor daughters; they only shall be delivered, but the land shall be desolate. in it: Heb. in the midst of it
Or nếu I bring a thanh gươm upon that land, Và say, thanh gươm, go through the land; so that I cut off man Và beast from it:
Though these three men were in it, as I live, nói Chúa
God, they shall deliver neither sons nor daughters, but they only shall be delivered themselves.
Or nếu I send a pestilence into that land, Và pour out my fury upon it in blood, to cut off from it man Và beast:
Though Nô-ê, Đa-ni-ên, Và Job, were in it, as I live, nói Chúa
God, they shall deliver neither son cũng không con gái; they shall but deliver their own souls by their righteousness.
For thus nói Chúa
God; How much more when I send my four sore judgments upon Giê-ru-sa-lem, thanh gươm, Và the famine, Và the noisome beast, Và the pestilence, to cut off from it man Và beast? How…: or, Also when
Yet, kìa, therein shall be left a remnant that shall be brought forth, both sons Và daughters: kìa, they shall come forth cùng các ngươi, and các ngươi sẽ thấy their way Và their doings: Và ngươi sẽ được yên ủi concerning the evil that I have brought upon Giê-ru-sa-lem, even concerning all that I have brought upon it.
Và they shall comfort you, when ye see their ways Và their doings: Và ngươi sẽ know that I have not done without cause all that I have done in it, nói Chúa
God.

CHAPTER 15.
Và the word of the CHÚA came unto me, saying,
Son of man, What is the vine cây more than any tree, or than a branch which is among the trees of the forest?
Shall wood be taken thereof to do any work? or will men take a pin of it to hang any vessel thereon?
kìa, it is cast into the fire for fuel; lửa devoureth both the ends of it, and the midst of it is burned. Is it meet for any work? Is it…: Heb. Will it prosper?
kìa, when it was whole, it was meet for no work: how much less shall it be meet yet for any work, when the fire hath devoured it, and it is burned? meet: Heb. made fit
Therefore thus nói Chúa
God; As the vine cây among the trees of the forest, which I have given to the fire for fuel, so will I give the inhabitants of Giê-ru-sa-lem.
Và I will set my face against them; they shall go out from one lửa, and another lửa shall devour them; and ngươi sẽ know that I là the CHÚA, when I set my face against them.
Và I will make the land desolate, because they have committed a trespass, nói Chúa
God. committed…: Heb. trespassed a trespass

CHAPTER 16.
Again the word of the CHÚA came unto me, saying,
Son of man, cause Giê-ru-sa-lem to know her abominations,
Và say, Thus nói Chúa
God unto Giê-ru-sa-lem; Thy birth Và thy nativity is of the land of Canaan; thy father was an Amorite, Và thy mother an Hittite. birth: Heb. cutting out, or, habitation
Và as for thy nativity, trong ngày ngươi wast born thy navel was not cut, neither wast ngươi washed in water to supple ngươi; ngươi wast not salted at all, nor swaddled at all. to supple…: or, when I looked upon ngươi
None eye pitied ngươi, to do any of these unto ngươi, to have compassion upon ngươi; but ngươi wast cast out in the open field, to the lothing of thy person, trong ngày that ngươi wast born.
Và when I passed by ngươi, and saw ngươi polluted in thine own blood, tôi nói unto ngươi when ngươi wast in thy blood, Live; yea, tôi nói unto ngươi when ngươi wast in thy blood, Live. polluted: or, trodden under foot
I have caused ngươi to multiply as the bud of the field, Và ngươi hast increased Và waxen great, Và ngươi art come to excellent ornaments: thy breasts are fashioned, Và thine hair is grown, whereas thou wast lỏa lồ Và bare. caused…: Heb. made ngươi a million excellent…: Heb. ornament of ornaments
Now when I passed by ngươi, and looked upon ngươi, kìa, thy time was the time of love; Và I spread my skirt over ngươi, and covered thy nakedness: yea, I sware unto ngươi, and entered into a covenant with ngươi, nói Chúa
God, and ngươi becamest mine.
Then washed I ngươi with water; yea, I throughly washed away thy blood from ngươi, and I anointed ngươi with oil. blood: Heb. bloods
I clothed ngươi also with broidered work, Và shod ngươi with badgers' skin, Và I girded ngươi about with fine linen, Và I covered ngươi with silk.
I decked ngươi also with ornaments, Và I put bracelets upon thy hands, Và a chain on thy neck.
Và I put a jewel on thy forehead, Và earrings in thine ears, Và a beautiful crown upon thine head. forehead: Heb. nose
Thus wast ngươi decked with gold và bạc; Và thy raiment was of vải mịn, Và silk, Và broidered work; ngươi didst eat fine flour, Và honey, Và oil: Và ngươi wast exceeding beautiful, Và ngươi didst prosper into a kingdom.
Và thy renown went forth among the heathen for thy beauty: for it was trọn vẹn through my comeliness, which I had put upon ngươi, nói Chúa
God.
But ngươi didst trust in thine own beauty, Và playedst the harlot vì cớ thy renown, Và pouredst out thy gian dâms on every one that passed by; his it was.
Và of thy garments ngươi didst take, Và deckedst thy high places with divers colours, Và playedst the harlot thereupon: the like things shall not come, neither shall it be so.
ngươi hast also taken thy fair jewels of my gold Và of my silver, which I had given ngươi, and madest to thyself images of men, Và didst commit whoredom with them,of men: Heb. of a male
Và tookest thy broidered garments, Và coveredst them: and ngươi hast set mine oil Và mine incense before them.
My meat also which I gave ngươi, fine flour, Và oil, Và honey, wherewith I fed ngươi, ngươi hast even set it before them for a sweet savour: and thus it was, nói Chúa
God. a sweet…: Heb. a savour of rest
Moreover ngươi hast taken thy sons Và thy daughters, whom ngươi hast borne unto me, and these hast ngươi sacrificed với họ to be devoured. Is this of thy whoredoms a small matter,to be…: Heb. to devour
That ngươi hast slain my children, Và delivered them to cause them to pass through lửa for them?
Và in all thine abominations Và thy whoredoms ngươi hast not nhớ lại the days of thy youth, when ngươi wast naked Và bare, Và wast polluted in thy blood.
Và xảy đến after all thy wickedness, ( khốn thay, khốn thay unto ngươi! nói Chúa
God;)
That ngươi hast also built unto ngươi an eminent place, Và hast made ngươi an high place in every street. eminent…: or, brothel house
ngươi hast built thy high place at every head of the way, Và hast made thy beauty to be abhorred, Và hast opened thy feet to every one that passed by, Và multiplied thy whoredoms.
ngươi hast also committed gian dâm with người Ê-díp-tô thy neighbours, great of flesh; Và hast increased thy whoredoms, to provoke me to anger.
kìa, therefore I have stretched out my hand over ngươi, and have diminished thine ordinary food, Và delivered ngươi unto the will of them that hate ngươi, the daughters of the Philistines, which are ashamed of thy lewd way. daughters: or, cities
ngươi hast played the whore also with the Assyrians, vì ngươi wast unsatiable; yea, ngươi hast played the harlot with them, and yet couldest not be satisfied.
ngươi hast moreover multiplied thy gian dâm in the land of Canaan unto Chaldea; Và yet ngươi wast not satisfied herewith.
How weak is thine heart, nói Chúa
God, seeing ngươi doest all these things, the work of an imperious whorish woman;
In that ngươi buildest thine eminent place in the head of every way, Và makest thine high place in every street; Và hast not been as an harlot, in that ngươi scornest hire; In that ngươi buildest…: or, In thy daughters is thine, etc
But as a wife that phạm tội ngoại tình, which taketh strangers instead of her husband!
They give gifts to all whores: but ngươi givest thy gifts to all thy lovers, Và hirest them, that they may come unto ngươi on every side for thy whoredom. hirest: Heb. bribest
Và the contrary is in ngươi from other women in thy whoredoms, whereas none followeth ngươi to commit whoredoms: Và in that ngươi givest a reward, Và no reward is given unto ngươi, therefore ngươi art contrary.
Wherefore, O harlot, nghe lời of the CHÚA:
Thus nói Chúa
God; Because thy filthiness was poured out, Và thy nakedness discovered through thy whoredoms with thy lovers, Và with all the idols of thy abominations, Và by the blood of thy children, which ngươi didst give với họ;
kìa, therefore I will gather all thy lovers, with whom ngươi hast taken pleasure, and all họ that ngươi hast loved, with all họ that ngươi hast hated; I will even gather them round about against ngươi, and will discover thy nakedness với họ, that they may see all thy nakedness.
Và I will judge ngươi, as women that break wedlock Và shed huyết are judged; Và I will give ngươi blood in fury Và jealousy. as: Heb. with judgments of
Và I will also give ngươi into their hand, Và they shall throw down thine eminent place, Và shall break down thy high places: they shall strip ngươi also of thy clothes, Và shall take thy fair jewels, Và leave ngươi naked Và bare. thy fair…: Heb. instruments of thine ornament
They shall also bring up a company against ngươi, and they shall stone ngươi with stones, Và thrust ngươi through with their những thanh gươm.
Và they shall burn thine houses bằng lửa, Và execute judgments upon ngươi in the sight of many women: Và I will cause ngươi to cease from playing the harlot, Và ngươi also shalt give no hire any more.
So will I make my fury toward ngươi to rest, Và my jealousy shall depart from ngươi, and I will be quiet, Và will be no more angry.
Because ngươi hast not nhớ lại the days of thy youth, but hast fretted me in all these things; kìa, therefore I also will recompense thy way upon thine đầu, nói Chúa
God: Và ngươi shalt not commit this lewdness above all thine abominations.
kìa, every one that useth proverbs shall use này proverb against ngươi, saying, As is the mother, so is her daughter.
Thou art thy mother's con gái, that lotheth her husband Và her children; and thou art the sister of thy sisters, which lothed their husbands Và their children: your mother was an Hittite, Và your father an Amorite.
Và thine elder sister is Sa-ma-ri, she and her daughters that ở at thy tay trái: Và thy younger sister, that ởeth at thy tay phải, is Sô-đôm Và her daughters. thy younger: Heb. lesser than thou
Yet hast ngươi not walked after their ways, nor done after their abominations: but, as if that were a very little thing, ngươi wast corrupted more than they in all thy ways. as if…: or, that was lothed as a small thing
As I live, nói Chúa
God, Sô-đôm thy sister hath not done, she nor her daughters, as ngươi hast done, ngươi and thy daughters.
kìa, this was the iniquity of thy sister Sô-đôm, pride, fulness of bread, Và abundance of idleness was in her and in her daughters, neither did she strengthen tay of the poor Và needy.
Và they were haughty, Và committed abomination before me: therefore I took them away as I saw tốt.
Neither hath Sa-ma-ri committed half of thy tội lỗi; but ngươi hast multiplied thine abominations more than they, Và hast justified thy sisters in all thine abominations which ngươi hast done.
ngươi also, which hast judged thy sisters, bear thine own shame for thy tội lỗi that ngươi hast committed more abominable than they: they are more righteous than thou: yea, be ngươi confounded also, and bear thy shame, in that ngươi hast justified thy sisters.
When I shall bring again their captivity, the captivity of Sô-đôm Và her daughters, Và the captivity of Sa-ma-ri Và her daughters, then will I bring again the captivity of thy captives in the midst of them:
That ngươi mayest bear thine own shame, Và mayest be confounded in all that ngươi hast done, in that ngươi art a comfort với họ.
When thy sisters, Sô-đôm Và her daughters, shall return to their former estate, Và Sa-ma-ri Và her daughters shall return to their former estate, then ngươi and thy daughters shall return to your former estate.
For thy sister Sô-đôm was not mentioned by thy mouth trong ngày of thy pride,mentioned: Heb. for a report, or, hearing pride: Heb. prides, or, excellencies
Before thy wickedness was discovered, as at the time of thy reproach of the daughters of Si-ri, and all that are round about her, the daughters of the Philistines, which despise ngươi round about. Syria: Heb. Aram despise: or, spoil
ngươi hast borne thy lewdness Và thine abominations, nói the CHÚA. borne: Heb. borne them
For thus nói Chúa
God; I will even deal with ngươi as ngươi hast done, which hast despised the oath in breaking giao ước.
Nevertheless I will remember my covenant with ngươi trong những ngày of thy youth, Và I will establish unto ngươi an đời đời covenant.
Then ngươi shalt remember thy ways, Và be ashamed, when ngươi shalt receive thy sisters, thine elder Và thy younger: Và I will give them unto ngươi for daughters, but not by thy covenant.
Và I will establish my covenant with ngươi; and ngươi shalt know that I là the CHÚA:
That ngươi mayest remember, Và be confounded, Và never open thy mouth any more because of thy shame, when I am pacified toward ngươi for all that ngươi hast done, nói Chúa
God.

CHAPTER 17.
Và the word of the CHÚA came unto me, saying,
Son of man, put forth a riddle, Và speak a parable unđến nhà của I-sơ-ra-ên;
Và say, Thus nói Chúa
God; A great eagle with great wings, longwinged, full of feathers, which had divers colours, đến unto Lebanon, Và took the highest branch of the cedar: divers…: Heb. embroidering
He cropped off the top of his young twigs, Và carried it into a land of traffick; he set it in a city of merchants.
He took also of the seed of the land, Và planted it in a fruitful field; he placed it by great waters, Và set it as a willow tree. planted…: Heb. put it in a field of seed
Và it grew, Và became a spreading vine of low stature, whose branches turned toward him, and the roots thereof were under him: so it became a vine, Và brought forth branches, Và shot forth sprigs.
There was also another great eagle with great wings Và many feathers: and, kìa, this vine did bend her roots toward him, and shot forth her branches toward him, that he might water it by the furrows of her plantation.
It was planted in a good soil by great waters, that it might bring forth branches, Và that it might bear fruit, that it might be a goodly vine. soil: Heb. field
Say thou, Thus nói Chúa
God; Shall it prosper? shall he not pull up the roots thereof, and cut off the fruit thereof, that it wither? it shall wither in all the leaves of her spring, even without great power or many people to pluck it up by the roots thereof.
Yea, kìa, being trồng, shall it prosper? shall it not utterly wither, when the east wind toucheth it? it shall wither in the furrows where it grew.
Moreover the word of the CHÚA came unto me, saying,
Say now to the rebellious nhà, biết ye not what these things mean? tell họ, kìa, the king of Ba-by-lôn is come to Giê-ru-sa-lem, Và hath taken vua thereof, and the princes thereof, and led them with him to Ba-by-lôn;
Và hath taken of the king's hạt giống, Và made a covenant with him, and hath taken an oath of him: he hath also taken the mighty of the land: taken an…: Heb. brought him to an oath
That the kingdom might be base, that it might not lift itself up, but that by keeping of his covenant it might stand. but…: Heb. to keep his covenant, to stand to it
But he rebelled against him in sending his ambassadors into Ai-Cập, that they might give him horses Và much people. Shall he prosper? shall he escape that doeth such things? or shall he break giao ước, Và be delivered?
As I live, nói Chúa
God, surely in the place where vua ởeth that made him king, whose oath he despised, Và whose covenant he brake, even with him in the midst of Ba-by-lôn he shall die.
Neither shall Pha-ra-ôn with his mighty army Và great company make for him in the war, by casting up mounts, Và building forts, to cut off many persons:
Seeing he despised the oath by breaking giao ước, when, lo, he had given his hand, Và hath done all these things, he shall not escape.
Therefore thus nói Chúa
God; As I live, surely mine oath that he hath despised, Và my covenant that he hath broken, even it will I recompense upon his own head.
Và I will spread my net upon him, and he shall be taken in my snare, Và I will bring him to Ba-by-lôn, Và will plead with him there for his trespass that he hath trespassed against me.
Và all his fugitives with all his bands shall fall by thanh gươm, Và they that remain shall be scattered toward all winds: Và ngươi sẽ know that I the CHÚA have spoken it.
Thus nói Chúa
God; I will also take of the highest branch of the high cedar, Và will set it; I will crop off from the top of his young twigs a tender one, Và will plant it upon an high núi Và eminent:
