Và the word of the CHÚA came unto me, saying,
Son of man, say unto her, Thou art the land that is not cleansed, nor rained upon trong ngày of indignation.
There is a conspiracy of her các tiên tri in the midst thereof, like a roaring con sư tử hay cắn xé the prey; they have devoured souls; they have taken the treasure Và precious things; they have made her many widows in the midst thereof.
Her priests have violated my law, Và have profaned mine holy things: they have put no difference between the holy Và profane, neither have they shewed difference between the unclean Và the clean, Và have hid their eyes from my sabbaths, Và I am profaned among them. violated: Heb. offered violence to
Her princes in the midst thereof are like wolves hay cắn xé the prey, to shed huyết, Và to destroy souls, to get dishonest gain.
Và her các tiên tri have daubed them with untempered morter, nhìn thấy hư không, Và divining lies với họ, saying, Thus nói Chúa
God, when the CHÚA hath not spoken.
The people of the land have used oppression, Và exercised robbery, Và have vexed người nghèo Và needy: yea, they have oppressed the stranger wrongfully. oppression: or, deceit wrongfully: Heb. without right
Và I sought for a man among them, that should make up the hedge, Và stand in the gap before me for the land, that I should not destroy it: but I found none.
Therefore have I poured out mine indignation upon them; I have consumed them with the fire of my wrath: their own way have I recompensed upon their heads, nói Chúa
God.

CHAPTER 23.
lời of the CHÚA came again unto me, saying,
Son of man, there were two women, the daughters of one mẹ:
Và they committed whoredoms in Ai-Cập; they committed whoredoms in their youth: there were their breasts pressed, Và there they bruised the teats of their virginity.
Và tên of them were Aholah the elder, Và Aholibah her sister: Và they were mine, and they bare sons Và daughters. Thus were their names; Sa-ma-ri is Aholah, Và Giê-ru-sa-lem Aholibah. Aholah: that is, His tent, or, tabernacle Aholibah: that is, My tabernacle in her
Và Aholah played the harlot when she was mine; Và she doted on her lovers, on the Assyrians her neighbours,
Which were mặc with blue, captains Và rulers, all of them desirable young men, horsemen riding upon horses.
Thus she committed her whoredoms with them, with all them that were the chosen men of A-si-ri, Và with all on whom she doted: with all their idols she làm dơ dáyd herself. committed…: Heb. bestowed her whoredoms upon them the chosen…: Heb. the choice of the children of Asshur
Neither left she her whoredoms brought from Ai-Cập: for in her youth they lay with her, and they bruised the breasts of her virginity, Và poured their whoredom upon her.
Wherefore I have delivered her into tay of her lovers, into tay of the Assyrians, upon whom she doted.
These discovered her nakedness: they took her sons Và her daughters, Và slew her with thanh gươm: Và she became famous among women; for they had executed judgment upon her. famous: Heb. a name
Và when her sister Aholibah nhìn thấy này, she was more corrupt in her inordinate love than she, and in her whoredoms more than her sister in her whoredoms. she was…: Heb. she corrupted her inordinate love more than, etc more than…: Heb. more than the whoredoms of her sister
She doted upon the Assyrians her neighbours, captains Và rulers mặc most gorgeously, horsemen riding upon horses, all of them desirable young men.
Then I saw that she was làm dơ dáyd, that they took both một way,
Và that she increased her whoredoms: for when she saw men pourtrayed upon the wall, the images of the Chaldeans pourtrayed with vermilion,
Girded with girdles upon their loins, exceeding in dyed attire upon their heads, all of them princes to look to, after the manner of the Ba-by-lônians of Chaldea, the land of their nativity:
Và as soon as she saw them with her eyes, she doted upon them, and sent messengers với họ into Chaldea. as soon…: Heb. at the sight of her eyes
Và the Ba-by-lônians đến to her into the bed of love, Và they làm dơ dáyd her with their whoredom, Và she was polluted with them, and her mind was alienated from them. Ba-by-lônians: Heb. children of Babel alienated: Heb. loosed, or, disjointed
So she discovered her whoredoms, Và discovered her nakedness: then my mind was alienated from her, like as my mind was alienated from her sister.
Yet she multiplied her whoredoms, in calling to remembrance the days of her youth, wherein she had played the harlot in the land of Ai-Cập.
For she doted upon their paramours, whose flesh is as xác thịt of asses, Và whose issue is like the issue of horses.
Thus ngươi calledst to remembrance the lewdness of thy youth, in bruising thy teats by người Ê-díp-tô for the paps of thy youth.
Therefore, O Aholibah, thus nói Chúa
God; kìa, I will raise up thy lovers against ngươi, from whom thy mind is alienated, Và I will bring them against ngươi on every side;
The Ba-by-lônians, Và all the Chaldeans, Pekod, Và Shoa, Và Koa, Và all the Assyrians with them: all of them desirable young men, captains Và rulers, great lords Và renowned, all of them riding upon horses.
Và they shall come against ngươi with chariots, wagons, Và wheels, Và with an assembly of people, which shall set against ngươi buckler Và shield Và helmet round about: Và I will set judgment before them, and they shall judge ngươi according to their judgments.
Và I will set my jealousy against ngươi, and they shall deal furiously with ngươi: they shall take away thy nose Và thine ears; Và thy remnant shall fall by thanh gươm: they shall take thy sons Và thy daughters; Và thy residue shall be devoured by the fire.
They shall also strip ngươi out of thy clothes, Và take away thy fair jewels. fair…: Heb. instruments of thy decking
Thus will I make thy lewdness to cease from ngươi, and thy whoredom brought from the land of Ai-Cập: so that ngươi shalt not lift up thine eyes với họ, nor remember Ai-Cập any more.
For thus nói Chúa
God; kìa, I will deliver ngươi into tay of them whom ngươi hatest, into tay of them from whom thy mind is alienated:
Và they shall deal with ngươi hatefully, Và shall take away all thy labour, Và shall leave ngươi naked Và bare: Và the nakedness of thy whoredoms shall be discovered, both thy lewdness Và thy whoredoms.
I will do these things unto ngươi, because ngươi hast gone a whoring after the heathen, Và because ngươi art polluted with their idols.
ngươi hast walked in the way of thy sister; therefore will I give her cup into thine hand.
Thus nói Chúa
God; ngươi shalt drink of thy sister's cup deep Và large: ngươi shalt be laughed to scorn Và had in derision; it containeth much.
ngươi shalt be filled with drunkenness Và sorrow, with the cup of astonishment Và desolation, with the cup of thy sister Sa-ma-ri.
ngươi shalt even drink it and suck it out, Và ngươi shalt break the sherds thereof, and pluck off thine own breasts: for I have spoken it, nói Chúa
God.
Therefore thus nói Chúa
God; Because ngươi hast forgotten me, and cast me behind thy back, therefore bear ngươi also thy lewdness Và thy whoredoms.
The CHÚA nói moreover unto me; Son of man, wilt ngươi judge Aholah Và Aholibah? yea, declare với họ their abominations; judge: or, plead for
That they have committed ngoại tình, Và blood is in their hands, Và with their idols have they committed ngoại tình, Và have also caused their sons, whom they bare unto me, to pass for them through lửa, to devour họ.
Moreover this they have done unto me: they have làm dơ dáyd my sanctuary in the same day, Và have profaned my sabbaths.
For when they had slain their children to their idols, then they came the same day into my sanctuary to profane it; and, lo, thus have they done in the midst of mine house.
Và furthermore, that ye have sent for men to come from far, unto whom a messenger was sent; and, lo, they came: for whom ngươi didst wash thyself, paintedst thy eyes, Và deckedst thyself with ornaments,to come: Heb. coming
Và satest upon a stately bed, Và a table đã chuẩn bị before it, whereupon ngươi hast set mine incense Và mine oil. stately: Heb. honourable
Và a voice of a multitude being at ease was with her: and with the men of the common sort were brought Sabeans from the wilderness, which put bracelets upon their hands, Và beautiful crowns upon their heads. of the…: Heb. of đám đông of men Sabeans: or, drunkards
Then nói I unto her that was old in adulteries, Will they now commit whoredoms with her, and she with them? whoredoms…: Heb. her whoredoms
Yet they went in unto her, as they go in unto một người đờn bà that playeth the harlot: so went they in unto Aholah Và unto Aholibah, the lewd women.
Và the righteous men, they shall judge them after the manner of adulteresses, Và after the manner of women that shed huyết; because they are adulteresses, Và blood is in their hands.
For thus nói Chúa
God; I will bring up a company upon them, and will give them to be removed Và spoiled. to be…: Heb. for a removing and spoil
Và the company shall stone them with stones, Và dispatch them with their những thanh gươm; they shall slay their sons Và their daughters, Và burn up their houses bằng lửa. dispatch…: or, single them out
Thus will I cause lewdness to cease out of the land, that all women may be taught not to do after your lewdness.
Và they shall recompense your lewdness upon you, and ngươi sẽ bear the tội lỗi of your idols: Và ngươi sẽ know that I là Chúa
God.

CHAPTER 24.
Again in the ninth năm, in the tenth month, in the tenth ngày của tháng, lời of the CHÚA came unto me, saying,
Son of man, write ngươi Tên of the day, even of this same ngày: vua of Ba-by-lôn set himself against Giê-ru-sa-lem this same ngày.
Và utter a parable unto the rebellious nhà, Và say với họ, Thus nói Chúa
God; Set on a pot, set it on, Và also pour nước into it:
Gather the pieces thereof into it, even every good piece, the thigh, Và the shoulder; fill it with the choice bones.
Take the choice of the flock, Và burn also the bones under it, Và make it boil well, Và let them seethe the bones of it therein. burn: or, heap
Wherefore thus nói Chúa
God; Khốn thay to the bloody city, to the pot whose scum is therein, and whose scum is not gone out of it! bring it out piece by piece; let no lot fall upon it.
For her blood is in the midst of her; she set it upon the top of a rock; she poured it not upon the ground, to cover it with dust;
That it might cause fury to come up to take vengeance; I have set her blood upon the top of a rock, that it should not be covered.
Therefore thus nói Chúa
God; Khốn thay to the bloody city! I will even make the pile for fire great.
Heap on wood, kindle lửa, consume xác thịt, Và spice it well, Và let the bones be burned.
Then set it empty upon the coals thereof, that the brass of it may be hot, Và may burn, and that the filthiness of it may be molten in it, that the scum of it may be consumed.
She hath wearied herself with lies, Và her great scum went not forth out of her: her scum shall be in the fire.
In thy filthiness is lewdness: because I have purged ngươi, and ngươi wast not purged, ngươi shalt not be purged from thy filthiness any more, till I have caused my fury to rest upon ngươi.
I the CHÚA have spoken it: it shall come to pass, Và I will do it; I will not go back, neither will I spare, neither will I repent; according to thy ways, Và according to thy doings, shall they judge ngươi, nói Chúa
God.
Also the word of the CHÚA came unto me, saying,
Son of man, kìa, I take away from ngươi the desire of thine eyes with a stroke: yet neither shalt ngươi mourn nor weep, neither shall thy tears run down. run down: Heb. go
Forbear to cry, make no than khóc for kẻ chết, cột the tire of thine head upon ngươi, and put on thy shoes upon thy feet, Và cover not thy lips, Và eat not the bread of men. Forbear: Heb. Be silent lips: Heb. upper lip
So I spake unto the people in buổi sáng: Và at even my wife chết; Và I did in buổi sáng as I was commanded.
Và the people nói unto me, Wilt ngươi not tell us what these things are to us, that ngươi doest so?
Then I trả lời them, The word of the CHÚA came unto me, saying,
nói unđến nhà của I-sơ-ra-ên, Thus nói Chúa
God; kìa, I will profane my sanctuary, the excellency of your strength, the desire of your eyes, Và that which your soul pitieth; Và your sons Và your daughters whom ye have left shall fall by thanh gươm. that…: Heb. the pity of your soul
Và ngươi sẽ do as I have done: ngươi sẽ not cover your lips, nor eat the bread of men.
Và your tires shall be upon your heads, Và your shoes upon your feet: ngươi sẽ not mourn nor weep; but ngươi sẽ pine away for your iniquities, Và mourn một toward another.
Thus Ezekiel is cùng các ngươi a sign: according to all that he hath done shall ye do: Và when this cometh, ngươi sẽ know that I là Chúa
God.
Also, ngươi son of man, shall it not be trong ngày when I take from them their strength, sự vui mừng of their glory, the desire of their eyes, Và that whereupon they set their minds, their sons Và their daughters,that…: Heb. the lifting up of their soul
That he that escapeth trong ngày đó shall come unto ngươi, to cause ngươi to hear it with thine ears?
In that day shall thy mouth be opened to him which is escaped, Và ngươi shalt speak, Và be no more dumb: Và ngươi shalt be a sign với họ; and they shall know that I là the CHÚA.

CHAPTER 25.
lời of the CHÚA came again unto me, saying,
Son of man, set thy face against the Ammonites, Và prophesy against them;
Và say unto the Ammonites, nghe lời của ĐCT
God; Thus nói Chúa
God; Because ngươi nóist, Aha, against my sanctuary, when it was profaned; Và against the land của I-sơ-ra-ên, when it was desolate; Và against nhà của Giu-đa, when they went into captivity;
kìa, therefore I will deliver ngươi to the men of the east for a possession, Và they shall set their palaces in ngươi, and make their ởings in ngươi: they shall eat thy fruit, Và they shall drink thy milk. men: Heb. children
Và I will make Rabbah a stable for lạc đà, Và the Ammonites a couchingplace for flocks: Và ngươi sẽ know that I là the CHÚA.
For thus nói Chúa
God; Because ngươi hast clapped thine hands, Và stamped with the feet, Và rejoiced in heart with all thy despite against the land của I-sơ-ra-ên; hands: Heb. hand feet: Heb. foot heart: Heb. soul
kìa, therefore I will stretch out mine hand upon ngươi, and will deliver ngươi for a spoil to the heathen; Và I will cut ngươi off from the people, Và I will cause ngươi to perish out of the countries: I will destroy ngươi; and ngươi shalt know that I là the CHÚA. a spoil: or, meat
Thus nói Chúa
God; Bởi vì that Mô-áp Và Seir do say, kìa, nhà của Giu-đa is like unto all the heathen;
Therefore, kìa, I will open the side of Mô-áp from the cities, from his cities which are on his frontiers, sự vinh hiển of the country, Beth–jeshimoth, Baal–meon, Và Kiriathaim,side…: Heb. shoulder of Mô-áp
Unto the men of the east with the Ammonites, Và will give them in possession, that the Ammonites may not be nhớ lại among the nations. with…: or, against the children of Ammon
Và I will execute judgments upon Mô-áp; Và they shall know that I là the CHÚA.
Thus nói Chúa
God; Because that Edom hath dealt against nhà của Giu-đa by taking vengeance, Và hath greatly offended, Và revenged himself upon them;by…: Heb. by revenging revengement
Therefore thus nói Chúa
God; I will also stretch out mine hand upon Edom, Và will cut off man Và beast from it; and I will make it desolate from Teman; Và they of Dedan shall fall by thanh gươm. they…: or, they shall fall by thanh gươm unto Dedan
Và I will lay my vengeance upon Edom by tay of my people I-sơ-ra-ên: Và they shall do in Edom according to mine anger Và according to my fury; Và they shall know my vengeance, nói Chúa
God.
Thus nói Chúa
God; Because the Philistines have dealt by revenge, Và have taken vengeance with a despiteful heart, to destroy it for the old thù oán; for the…: or, with perpetual thù oán
Therefore thus nói Chúa
God; kìa, I will stretch out mine hand upon the Philistines, Và I will cut off the Cherethims, Và destroy the remnant of biển coast. sea coast: or, haven of biển
Và I will execute great vengeance upon them with furious rebukes; Và they shall know that I là the CHÚA, when I shall lay my vengeance upon them. great vengeance: Heb. great vengeances

CHAPTER 26.
Và xảy đến in the eleventh năm, in the first ngày của tháng, that lời of the CHÚA came unto me, saying,
Son of man, because that Tyrus hath nói against Giê-ru-sa-lem, Aha, she is broken that was the gates của dân sự: she is turned unto me: I shall be replenished, bây giờ she is laid waste:
Therefore thus nói Chúa
God; kìa, I là against ngươi, O Tyrus, Và will cause many nations to come up against ngươi, as biển causeth his waves to come up.
Và they shall destroy the walls of Tyrus, Và break down her towers: I will also scrape her dust from her, and make her like the top of a rock.
It shall be một chỗ for the spreading of nets in the midst of biển: for I have spoken it, nói Chúa
God: Và it shall become a spoil to the nations.
Và her daughters which are in the field shall be slain by thanh gươm; Và they shall know that I là the CHÚA.
For thus nói Chúa
God; kìa, I will bring upon Tyrus Nebuchadrezzar vua of Ba-by-lôn, a king of kings, from the north, with horses, Và with chariots, Và with horsemen, Và companies, Và much people.
He shall slay with thanh gươm thy daughters in the field: Và he shall make a fort against ngươi, and cast a mount against ngươi, and lift up the buckler against ngươi. cast…: or, pour out the engine of shot
Và he shall set engines of war against thy walls, Và with his axes he shall break down thy towers.
By reason of the abundance of his horses their dust shall cover ngươi: thy walls shall shake at the noise of the horsemen, Và of the wheels, Và of the chariots, when he shall enter into thy gates, as men enter into a city wherein is made a breach. as men…: Heb. according to the enterings of a city broken up
With the hoofs of his horses shall he tread down all thy streets: he shall slay thy people by thanh gươm, Và thy strong garrisons shall go down to the ground.
Và they shall make a spoil of thy riches, Và make a prey of thy merchandise: Và they shall break down thy walls, Và destroy thy pleasant houses: Và they shall lay thy stones Và thy timber Và thy dust in the midst of the water. thy pleasant…: Heb. houses of thy desire
Và I will cause the noise of thy songs to cease; Và the sound of thy harps shall be no more heard.
Và I will make ngươi like the top of a rock: ngươi shalt be một chỗ to spread nets trên; ngươi shalt be built no more: for I the CHÚA have spoken it, nói Chúa
God.
Thus nói Chúa
God to Tyrus; Shall not the isles shake at the sound of thy fall, when the wounded cry, when the slaughter is made in the midst of ngươi?
Then all the princes of biển shall come down from their thrones, Và lay away their robes, Và put off their broidered garments: they shall clothe themselves with trembling; they shall sit upon the ground, Và shall tremble at mỗi moment, Và be astonished at ngươi. trembling: Heb. tremblings
Và they shall take up a ca thương for ngươi, and say to ngươi, How art ngươi destroyed, that wast inhabited of seafaring men, the renowned city, which wast strong in biển, she and her inhabitants, which cause their terror to be on all that haunt it!of…: Heb. of biểns
Now shall the isles tremble trong ngày of thy fall; yea, the isles that are in biển shall be troubled at thy departure.
For thus nói Chúa
God; When I shall make ngươi a desolate city, like the cities that are not inhabited; when I shall bring up the deep upon ngươi, and great waters shall cover ngươi;
When I shall bring ngươi down with them that descend into the pit, with the people of old time, Và shall set ngươi in the low parts đất, in places desolate of old, with them that go down to the pit, that ngươi be not inhabited; Và I shall set glory in the land of the living;
I will make ngươi a terror, and thou shalt be no more: though ngươi be sought for, yet shalt ngươi never be found again, nói Chúa
God. a terror: Heb. terrors

CHAPTER 27.
lời of the CHÚA came again unto me, saying,
Now, ngươi son of man, take up a ca thương for Tyrus;
Và say unto Tyrus, O ngươi that art situate at the entry of biển, which art a merchant của dân sự for many isles, Thus nói Chúa
God; O Tyrus, ngươi hast nói, I là of perfect beauty. of perfect…: Heb. perfect of beauty
Thy borders are in the midst of biểns, thy builders have perfected thy beauty. midst: Heb. heart
They have made all thy ship boards of fir trees of Senir: they have taken cedars from Lebanon to make masts for ngươi. made: Heb. built
Of the oaks of Bashan have they made thine oars; the company of the Ashurites have made thy benches of ivory, brought out of the isles of Chittim. the company…: or, they have made thy hatches of ivory well trodden company: Heb. daughter
Fine linen with broidered work from Ai-Cập was that which ngươi spreadest forth to be thy sail; blue Và purple from the isles of Elishah was that which covered ngươi. blue…: or, purple and scarlet
The inhabitants of Zidon Và Arvad were thy mariners: thy wise men, O Tyrus, that were in ngươi, were thy pilots.
The ancients of Gebal Và the wise men thereof were in ngươi thy calkers: all the ships of biển with their mariners were in ngươi to occupy thy merchandise. calkers: or, stoppers of chinks: Heb. strengtheners, etc
They of Persia Và of Lud Và of Phut were in thine army, thy men of war: they hanged the shield Và helmet in ngươi; they set forth thy comeliness.
The men of Arvad with thine army were upon thy walls round about, Và the Gammadims were in thy towers: they hanged their shields upon thy walls round about; they have made thy beauty trọn vẹn.
Tarshish was thy merchant by reason of đám đông of all kind of riches; with silver, sắt, tin, Và lead, they traded in thy fairs.
Javan, Tubal, Và Meshech, they were thy merchants: they traded the persons of men Và vessels of brass in thy market. market: or, merchandise
They of nhà of Togarmah traded in thy fairs with horses Và horsemen Và mules.
The men of Dedan were thy merchants; many isles were the merchandise of thine hand: they brought ngươi for a present horns of ivory Và ebony.
Si-ri was thy merchant by reason of đám đông of the wares of thy making: they occupied in thy fairs with emeralds, purple, Và broidered work, Và fine linen, Và coral, Và agate. the wares…: Heb. thy works agate: or, chrysoprase
Giu-đa, Và the land của I-sơ-ra-ên, they were thy merchants: they traded in thy market wheat of Minnith, Và Pannag, Và honey, Và oil, Và balm. balm: or, rosin
Đa-mách was thy merchant in đám đông of the wares of thy making, for đám đông of all riches; in the wine of Helbon, Và white wool.
Dan also and Javan going to and fro occupied in thy fairs: bright sắt, cassia, Và calamus, were in thy market. going…: or, Meuzal
Dedan was thy merchant in precious clothes for chariots. precious…: Heb. clothes of freedom
Arabia, Và all the princes of Kedar, they occupied with ngươi in lambs, Và rams, Và goats: in these were they thy merchants. they occupied…: Heb. they were the merchants of thy hand
The merchants of Sheba Và Raamah, they were thy merchants: they occupied in thy fairs with chief of all spices, Và with all precious stones, và vàng.
Haran, Và Canneh, Và Ê-đen, the merchants of Sheba, Asshur, Và Chilmad, were thy merchants.
These were thy merchants in all sorts of things, in blue clothes, Và broidered work, Và in chests of rich apparel, bound with cords, Và made of cedar, among thy merchandise. all…: or, excellent things clothes: Heb. foldings
The ships of Tarshish did sing of ngươi in thy market: Và ngươi wast replenished, Và made very glorious in the midst of biểns.
Thy rowers have brought ngươi into great waters: the east wind hath broken ngươi in the midst of biểns. midst: Heb. heart
Thy riches, Và thy fairs, thy merchandise, thy mariners, Và thy pilots, thy calkers, Và the occupiers of thy merchandise, Và all thy men of war, that are in ngươi, and in all thy company which is in the midst of ngươi, shall fall into the midst of biểns trong ngày of thy ruin. Và in…: or, even with all midst of biểns: Heb. heart, etc
The suburbs shall shake at the sound of the cry of thy pilots. suburbs: or, waves
Và all that handle the oar, the mariners, Và all the pilots of biển, shall come down from their ships, they shall stand upon the land;
Và shall cause their voice to be heard against ngươi, and shall cry bitterly, Và shall cast up dust upon their heads, they shall wallow themselves in the ashes:
Và they shall make themselves utterly bald for ngươi, and gird them with vải bố, Và they shall weep for ngươi with bitterness of heart Và bitter khóc lóc.
Và in their khóc lóc they shall take up a ca thương for ngươi, and lament over ngươi, nói [rằng], What city is like Tyrus, like the destroyed in the midst of biển?
When thy wares went forth out of biểns, ngươi filledst many people; ngươi didst enrich các vua đất with đám đông of thy riches Và of thy merchandise.
In the time khi ngươi shalt be broken by biểns in the depths of the waters thy merchandise Và all thy company in the midst of ngươi shall fall.
All the inhabitants of the isles shall be astonished at ngươi, and their kings shall be sore afraid, they shall be troubled in their countenance.
The merchants among the people shall hiss at ngươi; ngươi shalt be a terror, and never shalt be any more. a terror: Heb. terrors never…: Heb. shalt not be đến đời đời

CHAPTER 28.
lời of the CHÚA came again unto me, saying,
Son of man, say unto the prince of Tyrus, Thus nói Chúa
God; Because thine heart is lifted up, Và ngươi hast nói, I là a God, I sit trong biểnt của ĐCT, in the midst of biểns; yet thou art một người, Và not God, though ngươi set thine heart as the heart của ĐCT: midst: Heb. heart
kìa, thou art wiser than Daniel; there is no secret that they can hide from ngươi:
With thy wisdom Và with thine understanding ngươi hast gotten ngươi riches, Và hast gotten gold và bạc into thy treasures:
By thy great sự khôn ngoan Và by thy traffick hast ngươi increased thy riches, Và thine heart is lifted up vì cớ thy riches: thy great…: Heb. the greatness of thy wisdom
Therefore thus nói Chúa
God; Because ngươi hast set thine heart as the heart của ĐCT;
kìa, therefore I will bring strangers upon ngươi, the terrible of the nations: Và they shall draw their những thanh gươm against the beauty of thy wisdom, Và they shall làm dơ dáy thy brightness.
They shall bring ngươi down to the pit, Và ngươi shalt die the deaths of them that are slain in the midst of biểns.
Wilt ngươi yet say before him that slayeth ngươi, I là ĐCT? but thou shalt be một người, Và no God, in tay of him that slayeth ngươi. of him that slayeth: or, of him that woundeth
ngươi shalt die the deaths of the uncircumcised by tay of strangers: for I have spoken it, nói Chúa
God.
Moreover the word of the CHÚA came unto me, saying,
Son of man, take up a ca thương upon the king of Tyrus, Và say unto him, Thus nói Chúa
God; ngươi sealest up the sum, full of wisdom, Và perfect in beauty.
ngươi hast been in Ê-đen vườn của ĐCT; every precious stone was thy covering, the sardius, topaz, Và the diamond, the beryl, the onyx, Và the jasper, the sapphire, the emerald, Và the carbuncle, và vàng: the workmanship of thy tabrets Và of thy pipes was prepared in ngươi trong ngày that ngươi wast created. sardius: or, ruby beryl: or, chrysolite emerald: or, chrysoprase
Thou art the anointed cherub that covereth; Và I have set ngươi so: ngươi wast upon the holy núi của ĐCT; ngươi hast walked up and down in the midst of the stones lửa.
Thou wast trọn vẹn in thy ways from the day that ngươi wast created, till iniquity was found in ngươi.
By đám đông of thy merchandise they have filled the midst of ngươi with violence, Và ngươi hast sinned: therefore I will cast ngươi as profane out of núi của ĐCT: Và I will destroy ngươi, O covering cherub, from the midst of the stones lửa.
Thine heart was lifted up vì cớ thy beauty, ngươi hast corrupted thy wisdom by reason of thy brightness: I will cast ngươi to the ground, I will lay ngươi before các vua, that they may kìa ngươi.
ngươi hast làm dơ dáyd thy sanctuaries by đám đông of thine iniquities, by the iniquity of thy traffick; therefore will I bring forth a fire from the midst of ngươi, it shall devour ngươi, and I will bring ngươi to ashes trên đất in the sight of all them that kìa ngươi.
All they that know ngươi among the people shall be astonished at ngươi: ngươi shalt be a terror, Và never shalt thou be any more. a terror: Heb. terrors
Again the word of the CHÚA came unto me, saying,
Son of man, set thy face against Zidon, Và prophesy against it,
Và say, Thus nói Chúa
God; kìa, I là against ngươi, O Zidon; Và I will be glorified in the midst of ngươi: and they shall know that I là the CHÚA, when I shall have executed judgments in her, and shall be sanctified in her.
For I will send into her pestilence, Và blood into her streets; Và the wounded shall be judged in the midst of her by thanh gươm upon her on every side; Và they shall know that I là the CHÚA.
Và there shall be no more a pricking brier unđến nhà của I-sơ-ra-ên, nor any grieving thorn of all that are round about them, that despised them; and they shall know that I là Chúa
God.
Thus nói Chúa
God; When I shall have gathered nhà của I-sơ-ra-ên from the people among whom they are scattered, Và shall be sanctified in them in the sight of the heathen, then shall they ở in their land that I have given to my servant Gia-cốp.
Và they shall ở safely therein, and shall build houses, Và plant vườn nhos; yea, they shall ở with confidence, when I have executed judgments upon all those that despise them round about them; and they shall know that I là the CHÚA their God. safely: or, with confidence despise: or, spoil

CHAPTER 29.
In the tenth năm, in the tenth month, in the twelfth ngày của tháng, lời of the CHÚA came unto me, saying,
Son of man, set thy face against Pha-ra-ôn vua of Ai-Cập, Và prophesy against him, and against all Ai-Cập:
nói, Và say, Thus nói Chúa
God; kìa, I là against ngươi, Pha-ra-ôn vua of Ai-Cập, the great dragon that lieth in the midst of his rivers, which hath nói, My river is mine own, and I have made it for myself.
But I will put hooks in thy jaws, Và I will cause the fish of thy rivers to stick unto thy scales, Và I will bring ngươi up out of the midst of thy rivers, Và all the fish of thy rivers shall stick unto thy scales.
Và I will leave ngươi thrown into the wilderness, ngươi and all the fish of thy rivers: ngươi shalt fall upon the open fields; ngươi shalt not be brought together, nor gathered: I have given ngươi for meat to the beasts of the field Và to the fowls of the heaven. open…: Heb. face of the field
Và all the inhabitants of Ai-Cập shall know that I là the CHÚA, because they have been a staff of reed đến nhà của I-sơ-ra-ên.
When they took hold of ngươi by thy hand, ngươi didst break, Và rend all their shoulder: Và when they leaned upon ngươi, ngươi brakest, Và madest all their loins to be at a stand.
Therefore thus nói Chúa
God; kìa, I will bring a thanh gươm upon ngươi, and cut off man Và beast out of ngươi.
Và the land of Ai-Cập shall be desolate Và waste; Và they shall know that I là the CHÚA: because he hath nói, The river is mine, and I have made it.
kìa, therefore I là against ngươi, and against thy rivers, Và I will make the land of Ai-Cập utterly waste Và desolate, from the tower of Syene even unto the border of Ethiopia. utterly…: Heb. wastes of waste from…: or, from Migdol to Syene Syene: Heb. Seveneh
No foot of man shall pass through it, nor foot of beast shall pass through it, neither shall it be inhabited bốn mươi năm.
Và I will make the land of Ai-Cập desolate in the midst of the countries that are desolate, Và her cities among the cities that are laid waste shall be desolate bốn mươi năm: Và I will scatter người Ê-díp-tô among the nations, Và will disperse them through the countries.
Yet thus nói Chúa
God; At the end of forty năm will I gather người Ê-díp-tô from the people whither they were scattered:
Và I will bring again the captivity of Ai-Cập, Và will cause them to return into the land of Pathros, into the land of their habitation; Và they shall be there a base kingdom. habitation: or, birth base: Heb. low
It shall be the basest of the kingdoms; neither shall it exalt itself any more above the nations: for I will diminish them, that they shall no more rule over the nations.
Và it shall be no more the confidence của nhà của I-sơ-ra-ên, which bringeth their iniquity to remembrance, when they shall look after them: but they shall know that I là Chúa
God.
Và xảy đến in the bảy Và twentieth năm, in the first month, in the first ngày của tháng, lời of the CHÚA came unto me, saying,
Son of man, Nebuchadrezzar vua of Ba-by-lôn caused his army to serve a great service against Tyrus: every head was made bald, và mãi mãiy shoulder was peeled: yet had he no wages, nor his army, for Tyrus, for the service that he had served against it:
Therefore thus nói Chúa
God; kìa, I will give the land of Ai-Cập unto Nebuchadrezzar vua of Ba-by-lôn; Và he shall take her multitude, Và take her spoil, Và take her prey; Và it shall be the wages for his army. take her spoil…: Heb. spoil her spoil, and prey her prey
I have given him the land of Ai-Cập for his labour wherewith he served against it, because they wrought for me, nói Chúa
God. for his…: or, for his hire
In that day will I cause the horn của nhà của I-sơ-ra-ên to bud forth, Và I will give ngươi the opening of the mouth in the midst of them; and they shall know that I là the CHÚA.

CHAPTER 30.
lời of the CHÚA came again unto me, saying,
Son of man, prophesy Và say, Thus nói Chúa
God; Howl ye, Woe worth ngày!
For the day is gần, even the day of the CHÚA is gần, a cloudy ngày; it shall be the time of the heathen.
Và thanh gươm shall come upon Ai-Cập, Và great pain shall be in Ethiopia, when the slain shall fall in Ai-Cập, Và they shall take away her multitude, Và her foundations shall be broken down. pain: or, fear
Ethiopia, Và Libya, Và Lydia, Và all the mingled people, and Chub, Và the men of the land that is in league, shall fall with them by thanh gươm. Libya: Heb. Phut men: Heb. children
Thus nói the CHÚA; They also that uphold Ai-Cập shall fall; Và the pride of her power shall come down: from the tower of Syene shall they fall in it by thanh gươm, nói Chúa
God. from…: or, from Migdol to Syene
Và they shall be desolate in the midst of the countries that are desolate, Và her cities shall be in the midst of the cities that are wasted.
Và they shall know that I là the CHÚA, when I have set a fire in Ai-Cập, and khi all her helpers sẽ bị hủy diệt. destroyed: Heb. broken
In that day shall messengers go forth from me in ships to make the careless Ethiopians afraid, Và great pain shall come upon them, as trong ngày of Ai-Cập: for, lo, it cometh.
Thus nói Chúa
God; I will also make đám đông of Ai-Cập to cease by tay of Nebuchadrezzar vua of Ba-by-lôn.
He and his people with him, the terrible of the nations, shall be brought to destroy the land: Và they shall draw their những thanh gươm against Ai-Cập, Và fill the land with the slain.
Và I will make the rivers dry, Và sell the land into tay of the wicked: Và I will make the land waste, Và all that is therein, by tay of strangers: I the CHÚA have spoken it. dry: Heb. drought all…: Heb. the fulness thereof
Thus nói Chúa
God; I will also destroy the idols, and I will cause their images to cease out of Noph; Và there shall be no more a prince of the land of Ai-Cập: Và I will put a fear in the land of Ai-Cập.
Và I will make Pathros desolate, Và will set lửa in Zoan, Và will execute judgments in No. Zoan: or, Tanis
Và I will pour my fury upon Sin, the strength of Ai-Cập; Và I will cut off đám đông of No. Sin: or, Pelusium
Và I will set lửa in Ai-Cập: tội lỗi shall have great pain, Và No shall be rent asunder, Và Noph shall have distresses hằng ngày.
The young men of Aven Và of Pi–beseth shall fall by thanh gươm: and these các thành shall go into captivity. Aven: or, Heliopolis Pi–beseth: or, Pubastum
At Tehaphnehes also the day shall be darkened, when I shall break there the yokes of Ai-Cập: Và the pomp of her strength shall cease in her: as for her, a cloud shall cover her, and her daughters shall go into captivity. darkened: or, restrained
Thus will I execute judgments in Ai-Cập: Và they shall know that I là the CHÚA.
Và xảy đến in the eleventh năm, in the first month, in the seventh ngày của tháng, that lời of the CHÚA came unto me, saying,
Son of man, I have broken the arm of Pha-ra-ôn vua of Ai-Cập; and, lo, it shall not be bound up to be healed, to put a roller to bind it, to make it strong to hold thanh gươm.
Therefore thus nói Chúa
God; kìa, I là against Pha-ra-ôn vua of Ai-Cập, Và will break his arms, the strong, Và that which was broken; Và I will cause thanh gươm to fall out of his hand.
Và I will scatter người Ê-díp-tô among the nations, Và will disperse them through the countries.
Và I will strengthen the arms of the king of Ba-by-lôn, Và put my thanh gươm in his hand: but I will break của Pha-ra-ôn arms, Và he shall groan before him with the groanings of a deadly wounded man.
But I will strengthen the arms of the king of Ba-by-lôn, Và the arms of Pha-ra-ôn shall fall down; Và they shall know that I là the CHÚA, when I shall put my thanh gươm into tay of the king of Ba-by-lôn, Và he shall stretch it out upon the land of Ai-Cập.
Và I will scatter người Ê-díp-tô among the nations, Và disperse them among the countries; Và they shall know that I là the CHÚA.

CHAPTER 31.
Và xảy đến in the eleventh năm, in the third month, in the first ngày của tháng, that lời of the CHÚA came unto me, saying,
Son of man, nói unto Pha-ra-ôn vua of Ai-Cập, Và to his multitude; Whom art ngươi like in thy greatness?
kìa, the Assyrian was a cedar in Lebanon with fair branches, Và with a shadowing shroud, Và of an high stature; Và his top was among the thick boughs. with fair branches: Heb. fair of branches
The waters made him great, the deep set him up on high with her rivers running round about his plants, Và sent out her little rivers unto all the trees of the field. made…: or, nourished him set…: or, brought him up little rivers: or, conduits
Therefore his height was exalted above all the trees of the field, Và his boughs were multiplied, Và his branches became long vì cớ đám đông of waters, when he shot forth. when…: or, when it sent them forth
All the fowls of heaven made their nests in his boughs, Và under his branches did all the beasts of the field bring forth their young, Và under his shadow dwelt all great nations.
Thus was he fair in his greatness, in the length of his branches: for his root was by great waters.
The cedars in vườn của ĐCT could not hide him: the fir trees were not like his boughs, Và the chesnut trees were not like his branches; nor any tree in vườn của ĐCT was like unto him in his beauty.
I have made him fair by đám đông of his branches: so that all the trees of Ê-đen, that were in vườn của ĐCT, envied him.
Therefore thus nói Chúa
God; Because ngươi hast lifted up thyself in height, Và he hath shot up his top among the thick boughs, Và his heart is lifted up in his height;
I have therefore delivered him into tay of the mighty one of the heathen; he shall surely deal with him: I have driven him out for his wickedness. he…: Heb. in doing he shall do unto him
Và strangers, the terrible of the nations, have cut him off, Và have left him: upon núis Và in all the valleys his branches are fallen, Và his boughs are broken by all the rivers of the land; Và all the people đất are gone down from his shadow, Và have left him.
Upon his ruin shall all the fowls of the heaven remain, Và all the beasts of the field shall be upon his branches:
To the end that none of all the trees by the waters exalt themselves for their height, neither shoot up their top among the thick boughs, neither their trees stand up in their height, all that drink nước: for they are all delivered unto death, to the nether parts đất, in the midst of the children of men, with them that go down to the pit. their trees…: or, stand upon themselves for their height
Thus nói Chúa
God; trong ngày when he went down to the grave I caused a than khóc: I covered the deep for him, and I restrained the floods thereof, and the great waters were stayed: Và I caused Lebanon to mourn for him, and all the trees of the field fainted for him. to mourn: Heb. to be black
I made the nations to shake at the sound of his fall, when I cast him down to hell with them that descend into the pit: Và all the trees of Ê-đen, the choice Và best of Lebanon, all that drink nước, shall được yên ủi in the nether parts đất.
They also went down into hell with him unto them that be slain with thanh gươm; and they that were his arm, that dwelt under his shadow in the midst of the heathen.
To whom art ngươi thus like in glory Và in greatness among the trees of Ê-đen? yet shalt ngươi be brought down with the trees of Ê-đen unto the nether parts đất: ngươi shalt lie in the midst of the uncircumcised with them that be slain by thanh gươm. This is Pha-ra-ôn Và all his multitude, nói Chúa
God.

CHAPTER 32.
Và xảy đến in the twelfth năm, in the twelfth month, in the first ngày của tháng, that lời of the CHÚA
came unto me, saying,
Son of man, take up a ca thương for Pha-ra-ôn vua of Ai-Cập, Và say unto him, ngươi art like a young lion of the nations, and thou art as a whale in biểns: Và ngươi camest forth with thy rivers, Và troubledst the waters with thy feet, Và fouledst their rivers. whale: or, dragon
Thus nói Chúa
God; I will therefore spread out my net over ngươi with a company of many people; Và they shall bring ngươi up in my net.
Then will I leave ngươi upon the land, I will cast ngươi forth upon the open field, Và will cause all the fowls of the heaven to remain upon ngươi, and I will fill the beasts of the whole đất with ngươi.
Và I will lay thy flesh upon núis, Và fill the valleys with thy height.
I will also water with thy blood the land wherein ngươi swimmest, even to núis; Và the rivers shall be full of ngươi. the land wherein…: or, the land of thy swimming
Và when I shall put ngươi out, I will cover the heaven, Và make ngôi saos thereof dark; I will cover mặt trời with a cloud, Và the moon shall not give her light. put…: or, extinguish ngươi
All the bright lights of heaven will I make dark over ngươi, and set tối tăm upon thy land, nói Chúa
God. bright…: Heb. lights of the light in heaven dark: Heb. them dark
I will also vex the hearts of many people, when I shall bring thy destruction among the nations, into the countries which ngươi hast not known. vex: Heb. provoke to anger, or, grief
Yea, I will make many people amazed at ngươi, and their kings shall be horribly afraid for ngươi, when I shall brandish my thanh gươm before them; Và they shall tremble at mỗi moment, every man for his own sự sống, trong ngày of thy fall.
For thus nói Chúa
God; The thanh gươm of the king of Ba-by-lôn shall come upon ngươi.
By những thanh gươm of the mighty will I cause thy multitude to fall, the terrible of the nations, all of them: and they shall spoil the pomp of Ai-Cập, Và all đám đông thereof shall be destroyed.
I will destroy also all the beasts thereof from beside the great waters; neither shall the foot of man trouble them any more, nor the hoofs of beasts trouble them.
Then will I make their waters deep, Và cause their rivers to run like oil, nói Chúa
God.
<verse osisID="Ezek.32.15" sID="Ezek.32.15"/ When I shall make the land of Ai-Cập desolate, Và the country shall be destitute of that whereof it was full, when I shall smite all them that ở therein, then shall they know that I là the CHÚA. destitute…: Heb. desolate from the fulness thereof
This is the ca thương wherewith they shall lament her: the daughters of the nations shall lament her: they shall lament for her, even for Ai-Cập, Và for all her multitude, nói Chúa
God.
xảy đến also in the twelfth năm, in the fifteenth ngày của tháng, that lời of the CHÚA came unto me, saying,
Son of man, wail for đám đông of Ai-Cập, Và cast them down, even her, and the daughters of the famous nations, unto the nether parts đất, with them that go down into the pit.
Whom dost ngươi pass in beauty? go down, Và be ngươi laid with the uncircumcised.
They shall fall in the midst of them that are slain by thanh gươm: she is delivered to thanh gươm: draw her and all her multitudes. she…: or, thanh gươm is laid
The strong among the mighty shall speak to him out of the midst of hell with them that help him: they are gone down, they lie uncircumcised, slain by thanh gươm.
Asshur is there and all her company: his graves are about him: all of them slain, fallen by thanh gươm:
Whose graves are set in the sides of the pit, Và her company is round about her grave: all of them slain, fallen by thanh gươm, which caused terror in the land of the living. terror: or, dismaying
There is Elam Và all her multitude round about her grave, all of them slain, fallen by thanh gươm, which are gone down uncircumcised into the nether parts đất, which caused their terror in the land of the living; yet have they borne their shame with them that go down to the pit.
They have set her a bed in the midst of the slain with all her multitude: her graves are round about him: all of them uncircumcised, slain by thanh gươm: though their terror was caused in the land of the living, yet have they borne their shame with them that go down to the pit: he is put in the midst of them that be slain.
There is Meshech, Tubal, Và all her multitude: her graves are round about him: all of them uncircumcised, slain by thanh gươm, though they caused their terror in the land of the living.
Và they shall not lie with the mighty that are fallen of the uncircumcised, which are gone down to hell with their weapons of war: Và they have laid their những thanh gươm under their heads, but their iniquities shall be upon their bones, though they were the terror of the mighty in the land of the living. with their…: Heb. with weapons of their war
Yea, ngươi shalt be broken in the midst of the uncircumcised, Và shalt lie with them that are slain with thanh gươm.
There is Edom, her kings, Và all her princes, which with their might are laid by them that were slain by thanh gươm: they shall lie with the uncircumcised, Và with them that go down to the pit. laid: Heb. given, or, put
There be the princes of the north, all of them, and all the Zidonians, which are gone down with the slain; with their terror they are ashamed of their might; Và they lie uncircumcised with them that be slain by thanh gươm, Và bear their shame with them that go down to the pit.
Pha-ra-ôn sẽ thấy them, and shall được yên ủi over all his multitude, even Pha-ra-ôn Và all his army slain by thanh gươm, nói Chúa
God.
For I have caused my terror in the land of the living: Và he shall be laid in the midst of the uncircumcised with them that are slain with thanh gươm, even Pha-ra-ôn Và all his multitude, nói Chúa
ĐCT.

CHAPTER 33.
Again the word of the CHÚA came unto me, saying,
Son of man, nói to the children of thy people, Và say với họ, When I bring thanh gươm upon a land, if the people of the land take a man of their coasts, Và set him for their watchman: When…: Heb. A land when I bring a thanh gươm upon her
If when he seeth thanh gươm đến upon the land, he blow the trumpet, Và warn the people;
Then whosoever nghe tiếng of the trumpet, Và taketh not warning; if thanh gươm đến, Và take him away, his blood shall be upon his own head. whosoever…: Heb. he that hearing nghe
He heard tiếng of the trumpet, Và took not warning; his blood shall be upon him. But he that taketh warning shall deliver his soul.
But if the watchman thấy thanh gươm đến, Và blow not the trumpet, Và the people be not warned; if thanh gươm đến, Và take any person from among them, he is taken away in his iniquity; but his blood will I require at the watchman's tay.
So thou, O son of man, I have set ngươi a watchman unđến nhà của I-sơ-ra-ên; therefore ngươi shalt hear lời at my mouth, Và warn them from me.
When I say unto the wicked, O wicked man, ngươi shalt surely chết; if ngươi dost not speak to warn the wicked from his way, that wicked man sẽ chết in his iniquity; but his blood will I require at thine hand.
Nevertheless, if ngươi warn the wicked of his way to turn from it; if he do not turn from his way, he shall die in his iniquity; but ngươi hast delivered thy soul.
Therefore, O ngươi son of man, nói unđến nhà của I-sơ-ra-ên; Thus ye speak, nói [rằng], If our transgressions Và our tội lỗi be upon us, and we pine away in them, how should we then live?
Say với họ, As I live, nói Chúa
God, I have no pleasure in the death of the wicked; but that the wicked turn from his way Và live: turn ye, turn ye from your evil ways; for why will ye die, O house của I-sơ-ra-ên?
Therefore, ngươi son of man, say unto the children of thy people, The righteousness of the righteous shall not deliver him trong ngày of his transgression: as for the wickedness of the wicked, he shall not fall thereby trong ngày that he turneth from his wickedness; neither shall the righteous be able to live for his righteousness trong ngày that he sinneth.
When I shall say to the righteous, that he shall surely live; if he trust to his own righteousness, Và commit iniquity, all his righteousnesses shall not be nhớ lại; but for his iniquity that he hath committed, he shall die for it.
Again, when I say unto the wicked, ngươi shalt surely chết; if he turn from his sin, Và do that which is lawful Và right; that…: Heb. judgment and justice
nếu the wicked phục hồi the pledge, give again that he had robbed, walk in the statutes của sự sống, without committing iniquity; he shall surely live, he shall not die.
None of his tội lỗi that he hath committed shall be mentioned unto him: he hath done that which is lawful Và right; he shall surely live.
Yet the children of thy people say, đường của ĐCT is not equal: but as for them, their way is not equal.
When the righteous turneth from his righteousness, Và committeth iniquity, he shall even die thereby.
But if the wicked turn from his wickedness, Và do that which is lawful Và right, he shall live thereby.
Yet ye say, đường của ĐCT is not equal. O ye house của I-sơ-ra-ên, I will judge you every one after his ways.
Và xảy đến in the twelfth năm of our captivity, in the tenth month, in the fifth ngày của tháng, that one that had escaped out of Giê-ru-sa-lem đến unto me, saying, thành is smitten.
Now tay of the CHÚA was upon me in buổi chiều, afore he that was escaped đến; Và had opened my mouth, until he came to me in buổi sáng; Và my mouth was opened, Và I was no more dumb.
Then the word of the CHÚA came unto me, saying,
Son of man, they that inhabit those wastes of the land của I-sơ-ra-ên nói, nói [rằng], Áp-ra-ham was one, Và he inherited the land: but we are many; the land is given us for inheritance.
Wherefore say với họ, Thus nói Chúa
God; Ye eat with the blood, Và lift up your eyes toward your idols, Và shed huyết: Và shall ye possess the land?
Ye stand upon your thanh gươm, ye work abomination, Và ye làm dơ dáy every one his neighbour's vợ: Và shall ye possess the land?
Say ngươi thus với họ, Thus nói Chúa
God; As I live, surely they that are in the wastes shall fall by thanh gươm, and him that is in the open field will I give to the beasts to be devoured, and they that be in the forts Và in the caves sẽ chết of the pestilence. to be…: Heb. to devour him
For I will lay the land most desolate, Và the pomp of her strength shall cease; Và núis của I-sơ-ra-ên shall be desolate, that none shall pass through. most…: Heb. desolation and desolation
Then shall they know that I là the CHÚA, when I have laid the land most desolate vì cớ all their abominations which they have committed.
Also, ngươi son of man, con cái of thy people still are talking against ngươi by the walls Và in the doors of nhàs, Và speak một to another, every one to his brother, nói [rằng], đến, I pray you, and hear what is the word that cometh forth from the CHÚA. against ngươi: of, of ngươi
Và they come unto ngươi as the people đến, Và they sit before ngươi as my people, Và they hear thy words, but they will not do them: for with their mouth they shew much love, but their heart goeth after their covetousness. as the…: Heb. according to the coming của dân sự they sit…: or, my people sit before ngươi they shew…: Heb. they make loves, or, jests
And, lo, thou art với họ as a very lovely song of one that hath a pleasant tiếng, Và can play well on an instrument: for they hear thy words, but they do them not. a very…: Heb. Bài hát of loves
Và when this cometh to pass, ( lo, it will come,) then shall they know that a prophet hath been among them.

CHAPTER 34.
Và the word of the CHÚA came unto me, saying,
Son of man, prophesy against những người chăn chiên của I-sơ-ra-ên, prophesy, Và say với họ, Thus nói Chúa
God unto những người chăn chiên; Khốn thay be to những người chăn chiên của I-sơ-ra-ên that do feed themselves! should not những người chăn chiên feed the flocks?
Ye eat the fat, Và ye clothe you with the wool, ye kill them that are fed: but ye feed not the flock.
The diseased have ye not strengthened, neither have ye healed that which was sick, neither have ye bound up that which was broken, neither have ye brought again that which was driven away, neither have ye sought that which was lost; but with force Và with cruelty have ye ruled them.
Và they were scattered, because there is no shepherd: Và they became meat to all the beasts of the field, when they were scattered. because…: or, without a shepherd
My sheep wandered through all núis, Và upon every high đồi: yea, my flock was scattered upon all mặt đất, Và none did search or seek after them.
Therefore, ye shepherds, nghe lời of the CHÚA;
As I live, nói Chúa
God, surely because my flock became a prey, Và my flock became meat to every beast of the field, because there was no shepherd, neither did my shepherds search for my flock, but những người chăn chiên fed themselves, and fed not my flock; because…: or, without a shepherd
Therefore, O ye shepherds, nghe lời of the CHÚA;
Thus nói Chúa
God; kìa, I là against những người chăn chiên; Và I will require my flock at their hand, Và cause them to cease from feeding the flock; neither shall những người chăn chiên feed themselves any more; for I will deliver my flock from their mouth, that they may not be meat for them.
For thus nói Chúa
God; kìa, I, even I, will both search my sheep, Và seek them out.
As a shepherd seeketh out his flock trong ngày that he is among his sheep that are scattered; so will I seek out my sheep, Và will deliver them out of all places where they have been scattered in đám mâyy Và dark ngày. As…: Heb. According to the seeking
Và I will bring them out from the people, Và gather them from the countries, Và will bring them to their own land, Và feed them upon núis của I-sơ-ra-ên by the rivers, Và in all the inhabited places of the country.
I will feed them in a good pasture, Và upon the high mountains của I-sơ-ra-ên shall their fold be: there shall they lie in a good fold, and trong a fat pasture shall they feed upon núis của I-sơ-ra-ên.
I will feed my flock, Và I will cause them to lie down, nói Chúa
God.
I will seek that which was lost, Và bring again that which was driven away, Và will bind up that which was broken, Và will strengthen that which was sick: but I will destroy the fat Và the strong; I will feed them with judgment.
Và as for you, O my flock, thus nói Chúa
God; kìa, I judge between cattle Và cattle, between the rams Và the he goats. cattle: Heb. small cattle of lambs and kids he goats: Heb. great he goats
Seemeth it a small thing cùng các ngươi to have eaten up the good pasture, but ye must tread down with your feet the residue of your pastures? Và to have drunk of the deep waters, but ye must foul the residue with your feet?
Và as for my flock, they eat that which ye have trodden with your feet; Và they drink that which ye have fouled with your feet.
Therefore thus nói Chúa
God với họ; kìa, I, even I, will judge between the fat cattle Và between the lean cattle.
Because ye have thrust with side Và with shoulder, Và pushed all the diseased with your horns, till ye have scattered them abroad;
Therefore will I save my flock, Và they shall no more be a prey; Và I will judge between cattle Và cattle.
Và I will set up một shepherd over them, and he shall feed them, even my servant Đa-vít; he shall feed them, and he shall be their shepherd.
Và I the CHÚA will be their God, Và my servant Đa-vít a prince among them; I the CHÚA have spoken it.
Và I will make with them a covenant of peace, Và will cause the evil beasts to cease out of the land: Và they shall ở safely in the wilderness, Và sleep in the woods.
Và I will make them and the places round about my hill a blessing; Và I will cause the shower to come down in his season; there shall be showers of blessing.
Và the tree of the field shall yield her fruit, Và đất shall yield her increase, Và they shall be safe in their land, Và shall know that I là the CHÚA, when I have broken the bands of their yoke, Và delivered them out of tay of those that served themselves of them.
Và they shall no more be a prey to the heathen, neither shall the beast of the land devour them; but they shall ở safely, and none shall make họ afraid.
Và I will raise up for them a plant of renown, Và they shall be no more consumed with hunger in the land, neither bear the shame of the heathen any more. of renown: or, for renown consumed: Heb. taken away
Thus shall they know that I the CHÚA their God là with them, and that they, even nhà của I-sơ-ra-ên, are my people, nói Chúa
God.
Và ye my flock, the flock of my pasture, are men, Và I là your God, nói Chúa
God.

CHAPTER 35.
Moreover the word of the CHÚA came unto me, saying,
Son of man, set thy face against mount Seir, Và prophesy against it,
Và say unto it, Thus nói Chúa
God; kìa, O mount Seir, I là against ngươi, and I will stretch out mine hand against ngươi, and I will make ngươi most desolate. most…: Heb. desolation and desolation
I will lay thy cities waste, Và ngươi shalt be desolate, Và ngươi shalt know that I là the CHÚA.
Because ngươi hast had a perpetual thù oán, Và hast shed the blood of con cái của I-sơ-ra-ên by the force of thanh gươm in the time of their calamity, in the time that their iniquity had an end: perpetual…: or, thù oán of old shed…: Heb. poured out the children force: Heb. hands
Therefore, as I live, nói Chúa
God, I will prepare ngươi unto blood, Và blood shall pursue ngươi: sith ngươi hast not hated huyết, even blood shall pursue ngươi.
Thus will I make mount Seir most desolate, Và cut off from it him that passeth out Và him that returneth. most…: Heb. desolation and desolation
Và I will fill his mountains with his slain men: in thy hills, Và in thy valleys, Và in all thy rivers, shall they fall that are slain with thanh gươm.
I will make ngươi perpetual desolations, Và thy cities shall not return: Và ngươi sẽ know that I là the CHÚA.
Because ngươi hast nói, These two nations Và these two countries shall be mine, and we will possess it; whereas the CHÚA was there: whereas…: or, though the CHÚA was there
Therefore, as I live, nói Chúa
God, I will even do according to thine anger, Và according to thine envy which ngươi hast used out of thy thù oán against them; and I will make myself known among them, when I have judged ngươi.
Và ngươi shalt know that I là the CHÚA, Và that I have heard all thy blasphemies which ngươi hast spoken against núis của I-sơ-ra-ên, nói [rằng], They are laid desolate, they are given us to consume. to consume: Heb. to devour
Thus with your mouth ye have boasted against me, and have multiplied your words against me: I have heard họ. boasted: Heb. magnified
Thus nói Chúa
God; When the whole đất mừng vui, I will make ngươi desolate.
As ngươi didst rejoice at the inheritance của nhà của I-sơ-ra-ên, because it was desolate, so will I do unto ngươi: ngươi shalt be desolate, O mount Seir, Và all Idumea, even all of it: and they shall know that I là the CHÚA.

CHAPTER 36.
Also, ngươi son of man, prophesy unto núis của I-sơ-ra-ên, Và say, Ye mountains của I-sơ-ra-ên, nghe lời of the CHÚA:
Thus nói Chúa
God; Because the enemy hath nói against you, Aha, even the ancient high places are ours in possession:
Therefore prophesy Và say, Thus nói Chúa
God; Because they have made you desolate, Và swallowed you up on every side, that ye might be a possession unto the residue of the heathen, Và ye are taken up in the lips of talkers, and are an infamy của dân sự: Because: Heb. Because for because are…: or, ye are made to come up on the lip of the tongue
Therefore, ye mountains của I-sơ-ra-ên, nghe lời của ĐCT
God; Thus nói Chúa
God to núis, Và to the hills, to the rivers, Và to the valleys, to the desolate wastes, Và to the cities that are forsaken, which became a prey Và derision to the residue of the heathen that are round about; rivers: or, bottoms, or, dales
Therefore thus nói Chúa
God; Surely in the fire of my jealousy have I spoken against the residue of the heathen, Và against all Idumea, which have appointed my land into their possession with sự vui mừng of all their heart, with despiteful minds, to cast it out for a prey.
Prophesy therefore concerning the land của I-sơ-ra-ên, Và say unto núis, Và to the hills, to the rivers, Và to the valleys, Thus nói Chúa
God; kìa, I have spoken in my jealousy Và in my fury, because ye have borne the shame of the heathen:
Therefore thus nói Chúa
God; I have lifted up mine hand, Surely the heathen that are about you, they shall bear their shame.
But ye, O mountains của I-sơ-ra-ên, ngươi sẽ shoot forth your branches, Và yield your fruit to my people của I-sơ-ra-ên; for they are at hand to come.
For, kìa, I là for you, and I will turn cùng các ngươi, and ngươi sẽ be tilled Và sown:
Và I will multiply men upon you, all nhà của I-sơ-ra-ên, even all of it: and the cities shall be inhabited, Và the wastes shall be builded:
Và I will multiply upon you man Và beast; Và they shall increase Và bring fruit: Và I will settle you after your old estates, Và will do better cùng các ngươi than at your beginnings: Và ngươi sẽ know that I là the CHÚA.
Yea, I will cause men to walk upon you, even my people I-sơ-ra-ên; Và they shall possess ngươi, and ngươi shalt be their inheritance, Và ngươi shalt no more henceforth bereave them of men.
Thus nói Chúa
God; Because they say cùng các ngươi, Thou land devourest up men, Và hast bereaved thy nations;
Therefore ngươi shalt devour men no more, neither bereave thy nations any more, nói Chúa
God. bereave: or, cause to fall
Neither will I cause men to hear in ngươi the shame of the heathen any more, neither shalt ngươi bear the reproach của dân sự any more, neither shalt ngươi cause thy nations to fall any more, nói Chúa
God.
Moreover the word of the CHÚA came unto me, saying,
Son of man, when nhà của I-sơ-ra-ên dwelt in their own land, they làm dơ dáyd it by their own way Và by their doings: their way was before me as the ô uế of a removed woman.
Wherefore I poured my fury upon them for the blood that they had shed upon the land, Và for their idols wherewith they had polluted it:
Và I scattered them among the heathen, Và they were dispersed through the countries: according to their way Và according to their doings I judged them.
Và when they entered unto the heathen, whither they went, they profaned my holy name, when họ nói to them, These are the people of the CHÚA, Và are gone forth out of his land.
But I had pity for mine holy name, which nhà của I-sơ-ra-ên had profaned among the heathen, whither they went.
Therefore say unđến nhà của I-sơ-ra-ên, Thus nói Chúa
God; I do not này for your sakes, O house của I-sơ-ra-ên, but for mine holy name's sake, which ye have profaned among the heathen, whither ye went.
Và I will sanctify my great name, which was profaned among the heathen, which ye have profaned in the midst of them; and the heathen shall know that I là the CHÚA, nói Chúa
God, when I shall be sanctified in you before their eyes. their: or, your
For I will take you from among the heathen, Và gather you out of all countries, Và will bring you into your own land.
Rồi Ta sẽ rưới nước trong trên các ngươi, và các ngươi sẽ được sạch: Ta sẽ dẹp sạch mọi ô uế các ngươi, [và] mọi hình tượng các ngươi
Rồi Ta sẽ ban cho các ngươi một tấm lòng mới, và một linh thần mới Ta sẽ ban trong các ngươi; và Ta sẽ cất đi tấm lòng bằng đá ra khỏi thân xác các ngươi, Và Ta sẽ ban cho các ngươi một tấm lòng bằng thịt.
Và Ta sẽ ban Thần của Ta ở trong các ngươi và Ta sẽ khiến các ngươi bước đi itrong giềng mối Ta, Và các ngươi sẽ giữ các mạng lệnh Ta, và làm [theo].
Và ngươi sẽ ở trong xứ sở mà Ta đã ban cho tổ phụ các ngươi; và ngươi sẽ là dân sự Ta, và Ta sẽ là ĐCT của các ngươi.
Ta cũng sẽ giải cứu các ngươi khỏi mọi ô uế các ngươi: Và I will call for the corn, Và will increase it, and lay no famine upon you.
Và I will multiply the fruit of the tree, Và the increase of the field, ngươi sẽ nhận [không còn] sự trách phạt với đói kém trong các dân tộc [khác].
Rồi các ngươi sẽ nhớ lại đường lối gian ác [của các ngươi] và việc làm của các ngươi [thật] không tốt, và các ngươi sẽ tự ghê tởm trong mắt mình về những tội lỗi các ngươi và về những sự ghê tởm của các ngươi.
Not for your sakes do I này, nói Chúa
God, be it known cùng các ngươi: be ashamed Và confounded for your own ways, Hỡi nhà I-sơ-ra-ên.
Thus nói Chúa
God; trong ngày that I shall have cleansed you from all your iniquities I will also cause you to ở in the cities, Và the wastes shall be builded.
Và the desolate land shall be tilled, whereas it lay desolate in the sight of all that passed by.
Và they shall say, này land that was desolate is become like vườn of Ê-đen; Và the waste Và desolate Và ruined các thành are become fenced, Và are inhabited.
Then the heathen that are left round about you shall know that I the CHÚA build the ruined places, and plant that that was desolate: I the CHÚA have spoken it, Và I will do it.
Thus nói Chúa
God; I will yet for this be enquired of by nhà của I-sơ-ra-ên, to do it for them; I will increase them with men like a flock.
As the holy flock, as the flock of Giê-ru-sa-lem in her solemn feasts; so shall the waste các thành be filled with flocks of men: Và they shall know that I là the CHÚA. holy…: Heb. flock of holy things

CHAPTER 37.
Tay của CHÚA was upon me, and carried me out bởi Thần của CHÚA, và Ngài đặt tôi xuống trong giữa thung lũng và nó đầy những xương [người],
Và Ngài dẫn tôi đi qua vòng quanh chúng: and, kìa, there were very many in the open thung lũng; and, lo, they were very dry. valley: or, champaign
Và he nói unto me, Son of man, can these bones live? Và I trả lời, O Lord
God, ngươi knowest.
Again he nói unto me, Prophesy upon these bones, Và say với họ, O ye dry bones, nghe lời of the CHÚA.
Thus nói Chúa
God unto these bones; kìa, I will cause breath to enter into you, and ngươi sẽ live:
Và I will lay sinews upon you, and will bring up flesh upon you, and cover you with skin, Và put breath in you, and ngươi sẽ live; Và ngươi sẽ know that I là the CHÚA.
So I prophesied as I was commanded: Và as I prophesied, there was a noise, Và kìa a shaking, Và the bones came together, bone to his bone.
Và when I beheld, lo, the sinews Và xác thịt came up upon them, and the skin covered them above: but there was no breath in them.
Then nói he unto me, Prophesy unto the wind, prophesy, son of man, Và say to the wind, Thus nói Chúa
God; đến from the four winds, O breath, Và breathe upon these slain, that they may live. wind: or, breath
So I prophesied as he commanded me, and the breath đến into them, and they lived, Và stood up upon their feet, an exceeding great army.
Then he nói unto me, Son of man, these bones are the whole house của I-sơ-ra-ên: kìa, they say, Our bones are dried, Và our hy vọng is lost: we are cut off for our parts.
Therefore prophesy Và say với họ, Thus nói Chúa
God; kìa, O my people, I will open your graves, Và cause you to come up out of your graves, Và bring you into the land của I-sơ-ra-ên.
Và ngươi sẽ know that I là the CHÚA, when I have opened your graves, O my people, Và brought you up out of your graves,
Và shall put my spirit in you, and ngươi sẽ live, Và I shall place you in your own land: then shall ye know that I the CHÚA have spoken it, Và performed it, nói the CHÚA.
lời of the CHÚA came again unto me, saying,
Moreover, ngươi son of man, take ngươi one stick, Và write upon it, For Giu-đa, Và for the children của I-sơ-ra-ên his companions: then take another stick, Và write upon it, For Giô-sép, the stick of Ephraim, and for all nhà của I-sơ-ra-ên his companions:
Và join them one to another into one stick; Và they shall become one in thine hand.
Và when the children of thy people shall speak unto ngươi, saying, Wilt ngươi not shew us what thou meanest by these?
Say với họ, Thus nói Chúa
God; kìa, I will take the stick of Giô-sép, which is in tay of Ephraim, Và the tribes của I-sơ-ra-ên his fellows, Và will put them with him, even with the stick của Giu-đa, Và make them one stick, Và they shall be one in mine hand.
Và the sticks whereon ngươi writest shall be in thine hand before their eyes.
Và say với họ, Thus nói Chúa
God; kìa, I will take con cái của I-sơ-ra-ên from among the heathen, whither they be gone, Và will gather them on every side, Và bring them into their own land:
Và I will make them one nation in the land upon núis của I-sơ-ra-ên; Và one vua shall be king to them all: and they shall be no more two nations, neither shall they be divided into two kingdoms any more at all:
Neither shall they làm dơ dáy themselves any more with their idols, nor with their detestable things, nor with any of their transgressions: but I will save them out of all their ởingplaces, wherein they have sinned, Và will cleanse them: so shall they be my people, Và I will be their God.
Và Đa-vít my servant shall be vua over them; and they all shall have one shepherd: they shall also walk in my judgments, Và observe my statutes, Và do them.
Và they shall ở in the land that I have given unto Gia-cốp my servant, wherein your fathers have dwelt; Và they shall ở therein, even they, and their children, Và their children's children đến đời đời: Và my servant Đa-vít shall be their prince for ever.
Moreover I will make a covenant of peace with them; it shall be an đời đời covenant with them: and I will place them, and multiply them, and will set my sanctuary in the midst of them for evermore.
My tabernacle also shall be with them: yea, I will be their God, Và they shall be my people.
Và the heathen shall know that I the CHÚA do sanctify I-sơ-ra-ên, when my sanctuary shall be in the midst of them for evermore.

CHAPTER 38.
Và the word of the CHÚA came unto me, saying,
Son of man, set thy face against Gog, the land of Magog, the chief prince of Meshech Và Tubal, Và prophesy against him,the chief…: or, prince of the chief
Và say, Thus nói Chúa
God; kìa, I là against ngươi, O Gog, the chief prince of Meshech Và Tubal:
Và I will turn ngươi back, Và put hooks into thy jaws, Và I will bring ngươi forth, Và all thine army, horses Và horsemen, all of them clothed with all sorts of armour, even a great company với bucklers Và shields, all of them handling những thanh gươm:
Persia, Ethiopia, Và Libya with them; all of them with shield Và helmet: Libya: or, Phut
Gomer, Và all his bands; nhà of Togarmah of the north quarters, Và all his bands: Và many people with ngươi.
Be ngươi prepared, Và prepare for thyself, thou, and all thy company that are assembled unto ngươi, and be ngươi a guard với họ.
After many ngày ngươi shalt be visited: in the latter năm ngươi shalt come into the land that is brought back from thanh gươm, Và is gathered out of many people, against núis của I-sơ-ra-ên, which have been always waste: but it is brought forth out of the nations, Và they shall ở safely all of them.
ngươi shalt ascend Và come like a storm, ngươi shalt be like a cloud to cover the land, thou, and all thy bands, Và many people with ngươi.
Thus nói Chúa
God; It shall also come to pass, that at the same time shall things đến into thy mind, Và ngươi shalt think an evil thought: think…: or, conceive a mischievous purpose
