Và these shall be the measures thereof; the north side bốn ngàn Và five trăm, Và the south side bốn ngàn Và five trăm, Và on the east side bốn ngàn Và five trăm, Và phương tây side bốn ngàn Và five trăm.
Và the suburbs of the city shall be toward the north hai trăm Và fifty, Và toward the south hai trăm Và fifty, Và toward the east hai trăm Và fifty, Và toward phương tây hai trăm Và fifty.
Và the residue in length đối diện the oblation of the holy portion shall be mười ngàn hướng đông, và mười ngàn westward: Và it shall be over against the oblation of the holy portion; Và the increase thereof shall be for food với họ that serve thành.
Và they that serve thành shall serve it out of all the tribes của I-sơ-ra-ên.
All the oblation shall be năm Và hai mươi ngàn by five Và hai mươi ngàn: ngươi sẽ offer the holy oblation foursquare, with the possession of the city.
Và the residue shall be for the prince, on the one side and on the other of the holy oblation, Và of the possession of the city, đối diện the five Và hai mươi ngàn of the oblation toward the east border, Và westward đối diện the five Và hai mươi ngàn toward phương tây border, đối diện the portions for the prince: Và it shall be the holy oblation; Và the sanctuary của nhà shall be in the midst thereof.
Moreover from the possession of the Levites, Và from the possession of the city, being in the midst of that which is the prince's, between the border của Giu-đa Và the border of Bên-gia-min, shall be for the prince.
As for the rest of the tribes, from the east side unto phương tây side, Bên-gia-min shall have a portion. a portion: Heb. one portion
Và by the border of Bên-gia-min, from the east side unto phương tây side, Si-mê-ôn shall have a portion.
Và by the border of Si-mê-ôn, from the east side unto phương tây side, Issachar a portion.
Và by the border of Issachar, from the east side unto phương tây side, Zebulun a portion.
Và by the border of Zebulun, from the east side unto phương tây side, Gad a portion.
Và by the border of Gad, at the south side southward, the border shall be even from Tamar unto the waters of strife trong Kadesh, Và to the river toward the great sea. strife…: or, Meribah–kadesh
This is the land which ngươi sẽ divide by lot unto the tribes của I-sơ-ra-ên for inheritance, and these are their portions, nói Chúa
God.
Và these are the goings out of the city on the north side, bốn ngàn Và five trăm measures.
Và the gates of the city shall be after tên of the tribes của I-sơ-ra-ên: ba gates northward; một gate of Reuben, một gate của Giu-đa, một gate of Levi.
Và at the east side bốn ngàn Và five trăm: Và three gates; Và one gate of Giô-sép, một gate of Bên-gia-min, một gate of Dan.
Và at the south side bốn ngàn Và five trăm measures: Và three gates; một gate of Si-mê-ôn, một gate of Issachar, một gate of Zebulun.
At phương tây side bốn ngàn Và five trăm, với their three gates; một gate of Gad, một gate of Asher, một gate of Naphtali.
It was round about eighteen ngàn measures: Và Tên of the city from that ngày shall be, The CHÚA is there. The CHÚA…: Heb. Jehovah–shammah

div.title: THE BOOK OF DANIEL
div.chapter:
CHAPTER 1.
In the third năm of the reign of Jehoiakim vua của Giu-đa đến Nebuchadnezzar vua of Ba-by-lôn unto Giê-ru-sa-lem, Và besieged it.
Và the Lord gave Jehoiakim vua của Giu-đa into his hand, with part of the vessels của nhà của ĐCT: which he carried into the land of Shinar đến nhà of his god; Và he brought the vessels into the treasure nhà of his god.
và vua nói unto Ashpenaz the master of his eunuchs, that he should bring certain of the children của I-sơ-ra-ên, Và of the king's hạt giống, Và of the princes;
Children in whom was no blemish, but well favoured, Và skilful in all wisdom, Và cunning in knowledge, Và understanding science, and such as had ability in them to stand in the king's palace, Và whom they might teach the learning Và the tongue of the Chaldeans.
và vua appointed them a daily provision of the king's meat, Và of the wine which he drank: so nourishing them three năm, that at the end thereof they might stand before vua. the wine…: Heb. the wine of his drink
Now among these were of the children của Giu-đa, Đa-ni-ên, Hananiah, Mishael, Và Azariah:
Unto whom the prince of the eunuchs gave names: for he gave unto Daniel Tên of Belteshazzar; Và to Hananiah, of Shadrach; Và to Mishael, of Meshach; Và to Azariah, of Abed–nego.
But Daniel purposed in his heart that he would not làm dơ dáy himself with the portion of the king's meat, nor with the wine which he drank: therefore he requested of the prince of the eunuchs that he might not làm dơ dáy himself.
Now God had brought Đa-ni-ên into favour và mườider love với the prince of the eunuchs.
Và the prince of the eunuchs nói unto Daniel, I fear chúa tôi vua, who hath appointed your meat Và your drink: for why should he see your faces worse liking than the children which are of your sort? then shall ye make me endanger my head to the king. worse…: Heb. sadder sort: or, term, or, continuance?
Then nói Đa-ni-ên to Melzar, whom the prince of the eunuchs had set over Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, Và Azariah,Melzar: or, quản gia
Prove thy servants, tôi nài khuyên ngươi, ten ngày; Và let them give us pulse to eat, Và water để uống. pulse: Heb. of pulse to eat…: Heb. that we may eat, etc
Then let our countenances be looked upon before ngươi, and the countenance of the children that eat of the portion of the king's meat: Và as ngươi seest, deal with thy servants.
So he consented to them in this matter, Và proved them ten ngày.
Và at the end of ten ngày their countenances appeared fairer Và fatter in flesh than all the children which did eat the portion of the king's meat.
Thus Melzar took away the portion of their meat, Và the wine that they should drink; Và gave them pulse.
As for these four children, ĐCT gave them knowledge Và skill in all learning Và wisdom: Và Daniel had understanding in all visions Và dreams. Daniel…: or, he made Daniel understand
Now at the end of the days that the king had nói he should bring them in, then the prince of the eunuchs brought them in before Nebuchadnezzar.
và vua communed with them; and among them all was found none like Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, Và Azariah: therefore stood they before vua.
Và in all matters of wisdom Và understanding, that the king enquired of them, he found them ten times better than all the magicians Và astrologers that were in all his realm. wisdom…: Heb. wisdom of understanding
Và Daniel continued even unto the first năm của vua Cyrus.

CHAPTER 2.
Và in the second năm of the reign of Nebuchadnezzar Nebuchadnezzar dreamed dreams, wherewith his spirit was troubled, Và his sleep brake from him.
Then the king truyền lệnh to call the magicians, Và the astrologers, Và the sorcerers, Và the Chaldeans, for to shew vua his dreams. So they came Và stood before vua.
và vua nói với họ, I have dreamed một giấc chiêm bao, Và my spirit was troubled to know the dream.
Then spake the Chaldeans to the king in Syriack, O king, live đến đời đời: tell thy servants the dream, Và we will shew the interpretation. O king…: (Chaldee, to the end of chapter seven)
The king trả lời và nói to the Chaldeans, The thing is gone from me: nếu ye will not make known unto me the dream, with the interpretation thereof, ngươi sẽ be cut in pieces, Và your houses shall be made a dunghill. cut…: Chaldee, made pieces
But if ye shew the dream, Và the interpretation thereof, ngươi sẽ receive of me gifts Và rewards Và great honour: Vậy shew me the dream, Và the interpretation thereof. rewards: or, fee
Họ trả lời again và nói, Let the king tell his servants the dream, Và we will shew the interpretation of it.
The king trả lời và nói, I biết of certainty that ye would gain the time, vì ye see the thing is gone từ me. gain: Chaldee, buy
But if ye will not make known unto me the dream, there is but một decree for you: for ye have prepared lying Và corrupt những lời to speak before me, till the time be changed: Vậy tell me the dream, Và I shall know that ye can shew me the interpretation thereof.
The Chaldeans trả lời before vua, và nói, There is không một người trên đất that can shew the king's matter: Vậy there is no vua, lord, nor ruler, that asked such things at any magician, or astrologer, or Chaldean.
Và it is a rare thing that the king requireth, Và there is none other that can shew it before vua, except the gods, whose ởing is không với flesh.
For này cause vua was angry Và very furious, Và commanded to destroy all the wise men of Ba-by-lôn.
Và the decree went forth that the wise men should be slain; Và they sought Đa-ni-ên Và his fellows to be slain.
Rồi Đa-ni-ên trả lời with counsel Và wisdom to Arioch the captain of the king's guard, which was gone forth to slay the wise men of Ba-by-lôn: trả lời…: Chaldee, returned captain…: or, chief marshal: Chaldee, chief of the executioners, or, slaughtermen
He trả lời và nói to Arioch the king's captain, Tại sao is the decree so hasty từ vua? Rồi Arioch made the thing known to Daniel.
Then Daniel went in, Và desired of vua that he would give him time, Và that he would shew vua the interpretation.
Rồi Đa-ni-ên went to his house, Và made the thing known to Hananiah, Mishael, Và Azariah, his companions:
That they would desire mercies of ĐCT of heaven concerning này secret; that Daniel Và his fellows should not perish với the rest of the wise men of Ba-by-lôn. of the God: Chaldee, from before God that Daniel…: or, that they should not destroy Daniel, etc
Rồi was the secret revealed unto Daniel in a night vision. Rồi Đa-ni-ên phước ĐCT of heaven.
Đa-ni-ên trả lời và nói, phước be Tên của ĐCT for ever và mãi mãi: for wisdom Và might are his:
Và he changeth the times Và mùas: he removeth các vua, Và setteth up các vua: he giveth sự khôn ngoan unto the wise, Và knowledge to them that know understanding:
He revealeth the deep Và secret things: he knoweth what is in the darkness, Và the light ởeth with him.
I thank ngươi, and praise ngươi, O ngươi God of my fathers, who hast given me wisdom Và might, Và hast made known unto me now what we desired of ngươi: for ngươi hast bây giờ made known unto us the king's matter.
Vậy Đa-ni-ên went in unto Arioch, whom the king had ordained to destroy the wise men of Ba-by-lôn: he went và nói thus unto him; Destroy không the wise men of Ba-by-lôn: bring me in before vua, Và I will shew unto the king the interpretation.
Rồi Arioch brought in Đa-ni-ên before vua in haste, và nói thus unto him, I have found một người of the captives of Giu-đa, that will make known unto the king the interpretation. I have…: Chaldee, That I have found captives…: Chaldee, children of the captivity của Giu-đa
The king trả lời và nói to Daniel, whose name was Belteshazzar, Art ngươi able to make known unto me the dream which I have seen, Và the interpretation thereof?
Đa-ni-ên trả lời in the presence of the king, và nói, The secret which the king hath demanded không thể the wise men, the astrologers, the magicians, the soothsayers, shew unto the king;
Nhưng there is a God in heaven that revealeth secrets, Và maketh known to the king Nebuchadnezzar what shall be in the latter ngày. Thy dream, Và the visions of thy head trên thy bed, are these; maketh…: Chaldee, hath made known
As for ngươi, O king, thy thoughts đến into thy mind trên thy bed, what should come to pass hereafter: Và he that revealeth secrets maketh known to ngươi what shall come to pass. came: Chaldee, came up
But as for me, này secret is not revealed to me for any sự khôn ngoan that I have more than any living, Nhưng for their sakes that shall make known the interpretation to the king, Và that ngươi mightest know the thoughts of thy heart. but for…: or, but for the intent that the interpretation may be made known to the king
Thou, O king, sawest, Và kìa a great image. này great image, whose brightness was excellent, đứng before ngươi; and the form thereof was terrible. sawest: Chaldee, wast seeing
This image's đầu was of fine gold, his breast Và his arms of silver, his belly Và his thighs of brass,thighs: or, sides
His legs of sắt, his feet part of sắt Và part of clay.
ngươi sawest till that a stone was cut out without hands, which smote the image trên his feet that were of sắt Và clay, Và brake họ to pieces. without…: or, which was not in hands
Rồi was the sắt, the clay, the brass, the silver, Và the gold, broken to pieces together, Và became like the chaff of the summer threshingfloors; Và the wind carried họ away, that no place was found for them: and the stone that smote the image became a great núi, Và filled the whole đất.
này is the dream; Và we will tell the interpretation thereof before vua.
Thou, O king, art a king of kings: for ĐCT of heaven hath given ngươi a kingdom, power, Và strength, Và glory.
Và wheresoever con cái of men ở, the beasts of the field Và the fowls of the heaven hath he given into thine hand, Và hath made ngươi ruler over them all. Thou art this head of gold.
Và after ngươi shall arise another kingdom inferior to ngươi, Và another third kingdom of brass, which shall bear rule over all đất.
Và the fourth kingdom shall be strong as sắt: forasmuch as sắt breaketh in pieces Và subdueth all things: Và as sắt that breaketh all these, shall it break in pieces Và bruise.
Và whereas ngươi sawest the feet Và toes, part of potters' clay, Và part of sắt, the kingdom shall be divided; Nhưng there shall be in it of the strength of the sắt, forasmuch as ngươi sawest the sắt mixed with miry clay.
Và as the toes of the feet were part of sắt, Và part of clay, so the kingdom shall be partly strong, Và partly broken. broken: or, brittle
Và whereas ngươi sawest sắt mixed with miry clay, they shall mingle themselves with the seed of men: but they shall không cleave một to another, even as sắt is not mixed with clay. one…: Chaldee, this with this
Và trong những ngày of these các vua shall ĐCT of heaven set up một vương quốc, which shall never be destroyed: Và the kingdom shall not be left to other people, but it shall break in pieces Và consume all these kingdoms, Và it shall stand đến đời đời. the days: Chaldee, their days the kingdom: Chaldee, the kingdom thereof
Forasmuch as ngươi sawest that the stone was cut out of núi without hands, Và that it brake in pieces the sắt, the brass, the clay, the silver, Và the gold; the great ĐCT hath made known to the king what shall come to pass hereafter: Và the dream is certain, Và the interpretation thereof sure. without…: or, which was not in hands hereafter: Chaldee, after this
Rồi vua Nebuchadnezzar rơi trên his face, Và worshipped Đa-ni-ên, Và commanded that they should offer an oblation Và sweet odours unto him.
The king trả lời unto Daniel, và nói, Of a truth it is, that your God is a God of gods, Và a Lord of kings, Và a revealer of secrets, seeing ngươi couldest reveal này secret.
Rồi vua made Đa-ni-ên a great man, Và gave him many great gifts, Và made him ruler over the whole province of Ba-by-lôn, Và chief of the governors over all the wise men of Ba-by-lôn.
Then Daniel requested of vua, Và he set Shadrach, Meshach, Và Abed–nego, over the affairs of the province of Ba-by-lôn: but Daniel sat in cổng of the king.

CHAPTER 3.
Nebuchadnezzar vua made an image of gold, whose height was sáu mươi cubits, Và the breadth thereof six cubits: he set it up in the plain of Dura, in the province of Ba-by-lôn.
Then Nebuchadnezzar vua sent to gather together the princes, the governors, Và the captains, the judges, the treasurers, the counsellors, the sheriffs, Và all the rulers of the provinces, to come to the dedication of the image which Nebuchadnezzar vua had set up.
Rồi the princes, the governors, Và captains, the judges, the treasurers, the counsellors, the sheriffs, Và all the rulers of the provinces, were gathered together unto the dedication of the image that Nebuchadnezzar vua had set up; Và they stood before the image that Nebuchadnezzar had set up.
Then an herald cried aloud, To you it is commanded, O people, nations, Và languages,aloud: Chaldee, with might it…: Chaldee, they command
That at what time ye hear tiếng of the cornet, flute, harp, sackbut, psaltery, dulcimer, Và all kinds of musick, ye fall down Và worship the golden image that Nebuchadnezzar vua hath set up: dulcimer: or, singing: Chaldee, symphony
Và whoso falleth không down Và worshippeth shall the same hour be cast into the midst of a burning fiery furnace.
Vậy at that time, khi all the people nghe tiếng of the cornet, flute, harp, sackbut, psaltery, Và all kinds of musick, all the people, the nations, Và the languages, fell down Và thờ phượng the golden image that Nebuchadnezzar vua had set up.
Wherefore at that time certain Chaldeans came near, Và accused những người Do Thái.
They spake và nói to the king Nebuchadnezzar, O king, live đến đời đời.
Thou, O king, hast made a decree, that every man that shall hear tiếng of the cornet, flute, harp, sackbut, psaltery, Và dulcimer, Và all kinds of musick, shall fall down Và worship the golden image: dulcimer: or, singing: Chaldee, symphony
Và whoso falleth không down Và worshippeth, that he should be cast into the midst of a burning fiery furnace.
There are certain Jews whom ngươi hast set over the affairs of the province of Ba-by-lôn, Shadrach, Meshach, Và Abed–nego; these men, O king, have không regarded ngươi: they serve không thy gods, cũng không worship the golden image which ngươi hast set up. have…: Chaldee, have set no regard upon ngươi
Rồi Nebuchadnezzar in his rage Và fury truyền lệnh to bring Shadrach, Meshach, Và Abed–nego. Rồi they brought these men before vua.
Nebuchadnezzar nói và nói với họ, Is it true, O Shadrach, Meshach, Và Abed–nego, do not ye serve my gods, cũng không worship the golden image which I have set up? true: or, of purpose
bây giờ nếu ye be ready that at what time ye hear tiếng of the cornet, flute, harp, sackbut, psaltery, Và dulcimer, Và all kinds of musick, ye fall down Và worship the image which I have made; well: but if ye worship không, ngươi sẽ be cast the same hour into the midst of a burning fiery furnace; Và who is that God that shall deliver you out of my hands? dulcimer: or, singing: Chaldee, symphony
Shadrach, Meshach, Và Abed–nego, trả lời và nói to the king, O Nebuchadnezzar, we are không careful to answer ngươi in này matter.
nếu it be so, ĐCT chúng tôi whom we serve is able to deliver us from the burning fiery furnace, Và he will deliver us out of thine hand, O king.
But if không, be it known unto ngươi, O king, that we will không serve thy gods, cũng không worship the golden image which ngươi hast set up.
Rồi was Nebuchadnezzar full of fury, Và the form of his visage was changed against Shadrach, Meshach, Và Abed–nego: Vậy he spake, Và commanded that they should heat the furnace một bảy lần more than it was wont to be heated. full: Chaldee, filled
Và he commanded the most mighty men that were in his army to bind Shadrach, Meshach, Và Abed–nego, Và to cast họ into the burning fiery furnace. most…: Chaldee, mighty of strength
Rồi these men were bound in their coats, their hosen, Và their hats, and their other garments, Và were cast into the midst of the burning fiery furnace. coats: or, mantles hats: or, turbans
Vậy vì the king's mạng lệnh was urgent, Và the furnace exceeding hot, the flame of the fire giết those men that took up Shadrach, Meshach, Và Abed–nego. commandment: Chaldee, word flame: or, spark
Và these ba men, Shadrach, Meshach, Và Abed–nego, fell down bound into the midst of the burning fiery furnace.
Rồi Nebuchadnezzar vua was astonied, Và rose up in haste, Và nói, và nói unto his counsellors, Did not we cast ba men bound into the midst of the fire? Họ trả lời và nói unto the king, True, O king. counsellors: or, governors
He trả lời và nói, Lo, I thấy bốn men loose, walking in the midst of the fire, Và they have no hurt; Và the form of the fourth is like Con của ĐCT. they…: Chaldee, there is no hurt in them
Rồi Nebuchadnezzar came near to the mouth of the burning fiery furnace, Và nói, và nói, Shadrach, Meshach, Và Abed–nego, ye servants of the most high ĐCT, come forth, Và come hither. Rồi Shadrach, Meshach, Và Abed–nego, came forth of the midst of the fire. mouth: Chaldee, door
Và the princes, governors, Và captains, Và the king's counsellors, being gathered together, nhìn thấy these men, upon whose bodies lửa had no power, cũng không was an hair of their head singed, neither were their coats changed, cũng không the smell lửa had passed on them.
Rồi Nebuchadnezzar nói, và nói, phước be ĐCT of Shadrach, Meshach, Và Abed–nego, who hath sent his angel, Và delivered his servants that trusted in him, Và have changed the king's word, Và yielded their bodies, that they might not serve cũng không worship any ĐCT, except their own God.
Therefore I make a decree, That every people, nation, Và language, which speak any thing amiss against ĐCT of Shadrach, Meshach, Và Abed–nego, shall be cut in pieces, Và their houses shall be made a dunghill: vì there is no other ĐCT that can deliver after this sort. I make…: Chaldee, a decree is made by me any…: Chaldee, error cut…: Chaldee, made pieces
Rồi vua promoted Shadrach, Meshach, Và Abed–nego, in the province of Ba-by-lôn. promoted: Chaldee, made to prosper

CHAPTER 4.
Nebuchadnezzar vua, unto all people, nations, Và languages, that ở in all đất; Peace be multiplied cùng các ngươi.
I thought it good to shew the signs Và wonders that the high ĐCT hath wrought toward me. I thought…: Chaldee, It was seemly before me
How great are his signs! Và how mighty are his wonders! his kingdom is an đời đời kingdom, Và his dominion is từ dòng dõi to generation.
I Nebuchadnezzar was at rest in mine house, Và flourishing in my palace:
I saw một giấc chiêm bao which made me afraid, Và the thoughts trên my bed Và the visions of my head troubled me.
Vậy made I a decree to bring in all the wise men of Ba-by-lôn before me, that they might make known unto me the interpretation of the dream.
Rồi đến in the magicians, the astrologers, the Chaldeans, Và the soothsayers: Và I told the dream before them; but they did not make known unto me the interpretation thereof.
But at cuối cùng Đa-ni-ên came in before me, whose name was Belteshazzar, according to Tên of my god, and in whom is the spirit of the holy gods: Và before him I told the dream, nói [rằng],
O Belteshazzar, master of the magicians, because I biết that the spirit of the holy gods is in ngươi, and no secret troubleth ngươi, tell me the visions of my dream that I have seen, Và the interpretation thereof.
Thus were the visions of mine head trong my bed; I saw, Và kìa a tree in the midst đất, Và the height thereof was great. I saw: Chaldee, I was seeing
The tree grew, Và was strong, Và the height thereof reached unto heaven, Và the sight thereof to the end of all đất:
The leaves thereof were fair, Và the fruit thereof much, and in it was meat for all: the beasts of the field had shadow under it, and the fowls of the heaven dwelt in the boughs thereof, and all flesh was fed of it.
I saw in the visions of my head trên my bed, and, kìa, a watcher Và an holy one came down từ trời;
He cried aloud, và nói thus, Hew down the tree, Và cut off his branches, shake off his leaves, Và scatter his fruit: let the beasts get away từ under it, Và the fowls từ his branches: aloud: Chaldee, with might
Nevertheless leave the stump of his roots in đất, even with a band of sắt Và brass, in the tender grass of the field; Và let it be wet with the dew of heaven, and let his portion be với the beasts in the grass đất:
Let his heart be changed từ man's, Và let a beast's heart be given unto him; and let bảy times pass over him.
This matter is by the decree of the watchers, Và the demand by the word of the holy ones: to the intent that the living may know that the most High ruleth in the kingdom of men, Và giveth it to whomsoever he will, Và setteth up over it the basest of men.
này dream I vua Nebuchadnezzar have seen. Now thou, O Belteshazzar, declare the interpretation thereof, forasmuch as all the wise men of my kingdom are not able to make known unto me the interpretation: but thou art able; for the spirit of the holy gods is in ngươi.
Rồi Đa-ni-ên, whose name was Belteshazzar, was astonied for one giờ, Và his thoughts troubled him. The king nói, và nói, Belteshazzar, let not the dream, or the interpretation thereof, trouble ngươi. Belteshazzar trả lời và nói, My lord, the dream be to them that hate ngươi, and the interpretation thereof to thine enemies.

We have sinned, Và have committed iniquity, Và have done wickedly, Và have rebelled, even by departing from thy precepts Và from thy judgments:
Neither have we hearkened unto thy servants các tiên tri, which spake in Danh Ngài to our kings, our princes, Và our fathers, Và to all the people of the land.
O Lord, righteousness belongeth unto ngươi, but unto us confusion of faces, as at this day; to the men của Giu-đa, Và to the inhabitants of Giê-ru-sa-lem, Và unto all I-sơ-ra-ên, that are gần, and that are far off, through all the countries whither ngươi hast driven them, vì cớ their trespass that they have trespassed against ngươi. belongeth…: or, ngươi hast
O Lord, to us belongeth confusion of face, to our kings, to our princes, Và to our fathers, because we have sinned against ngươi.
To the Lord ĐCT chúng tôi belong mercies Và forgivenesses, though we have rebelled against him;
Neither have we obeyed tiếng of the CHÚA ĐCT chúng tôi, to walk in his laws, which he set before us by his servants các tiên tri.
Yea, all I-sơ-ra-ên have transgressed thy law, even by departing, that they might not obey thy voice; therefore the curse is poured upon us, and the oath that is written in the law of Môi-se the servant của ĐCT, because we have sinned against him.
Và he hath confirmed his words, which he spake against us, and against our judges that judged us, by bringing upon us a great evil: for under the whole heaven hath not been done as hath been done upon Giê-ru-sa-lem.
As it is written in the law of Môi-se, all this evil is come upon us: yet made we not our prayer before the CHÚA ĐCT chúng tôi, that we might turn from our iniquities, Và understand thy truth. made…: Heb. intreated we not mặt of the, etc
Therefore hath the CHÚA watched upon the evil, Và brought it upon us: for the CHÚA ĐCT chúng tôi is công chính in all his works which he doeth: for we obeyed not his voice.
Và now, O Lord ĐCT chúng tôi, that hast brought thy people forth out of the land of Ai-Cập with a mighty tay, Và hast gotten ngươi renown, as at this day; we have sinned, we have done wickedly. gotten…: Heb. made ngươi a name
O Lord, according to all sự công chính của Ngài, tôi nài khuyên ngươi, let thine anger Và thy fury be turned away from thy city Giê-ru-sa-lem, thy holy núi: because for our tội lỗi, Và for the iniquities of our fathers, Giê-ru-sa-lem Và thy people are become a reproach to all that are about us.
Now therefore, O our God, nghe the prayer of thy servant, Và his supplications, Và cause thy face to shine upon thy sanctuary that is desolate, for the Lord's sake.
Hỡi ĐCT tôi, incline thine ear, Và hear; open thine eyes, Và kìa our desolations, Và the city which is called by Danh Ngài: for we do not present our supplications before ngươi for our righteousnesses, but for thy great mercies. which…: Heb. whereupon Danh Ngài is called present: Heb. cause to fall
O Lord, nghe; O Lord, tha thứ; O Lord, hearken Và do; defer không, for thine own sake, Hỡi ĐCT tôi: for thy city Và thy people are called by Danh Ngài.
Và whiles I was speaking, Và praying, Và confessing my sin Và the sin of my people I-sơ-ra-ên, Và presenting my supplication before the CHÚA my God for the holy núi of my God;
Yea, whiles I was speaking in prayer, even the man Gáp-ri-ên, whom I had seen in the vision at the beginning, being caused to fly swiftly, touched me about the time of buổi chiều oblation. swiftly: Heb. with weariness, or, flight
Và he informed me, Và talked with me, and nói, O Daniel, I am now come forth để cho ngươi skill Và understanding. to…: Heb. to make ngươi skilful of
At the beginning of thy supplications the commandment came forth, Và I am come to shew ngươi; for thou art greatly beloved: therefore understand the matter, Và consider the vision. commandment: Heb. word greatly…: Heb. a man of desires
bảy mươi weeks are determined upon thy people Và upon thy holy city, to finish the transgression, Và to make an end of tội lỗi, Và to make reconciliation for iniquity, Và to bring in đời đời righteousness, Và to seal up the vision Và prophecy, Và to anoint the most thánh. finish: or, restrain make an…: or, seal up prophecy: Heb. prophet
biết therefore and understand, that from the going forth of the commandment to restore Và to build Giê-ru-sa-lem unto Đấng Mê-si the Prince shall be bảy weeks, Và sáu mươi Và two weeks: the street shall be built again, Và the wall, even in troublous times. be built…: Heb. return and be built wall: or, breach, or, ditch troublous: Heb. strait of
Và after sáu mươi Và two weeks shall Đấng Mê-si be cut off, but not for himself: and the people of the prince that shall come shall destroy thành Và the sanctuary; Và the end thereof shall be with a flood, Và unto the end of the war desolations are determined. but…: or, and shall have nothing desolations…: or, it shall be cut off by desolations
Và he shall confirm giao ước with many for one week: Và in the midst của tuần lễ he shall cause the sacrifice Và the oblation to cease, Và for the overspreading of abominations he shall make it desolate, even until the consummation, Và that determined shall be poured upon the desolate. the covenant: or, a covenant for the…: or, with the abominable armies the desolate: or, the desolator

CHAPTER 10.
In the third năm of Cyrus vua of Persia a thing was revealed unto Daniel, whose name was called Belteshazzar; Và the thing was true, but the time appointed was long: Và he understood the thing, Và had understanding of the vision. long: Heb. great
In those days I Daniel was than khóc ba full weeks. full…: Heb. weeks of days
I ate no pleasant bánh, neither came flesh nor wine in my mouth, neither did I anoint myself at all, till three whole weeks were fulfilled. pleasant…: Heb. bread of desires
Và in the four Và twentieth ngày of the first month, as I was by the side of the great sông, which is Hiddekel;
Then I lifted up mine eyes, Và looked, Và kìa a certain man mặc in linen, whose loins were girded with fine gold of Uphaz: a…: Heb. one man
His body also was like the beryl, Và his face as the appearance of lightning, Và his eyes as lamps lửa, Và his arms Và his feet like in colour to polished brass, Và the voice of his words like the voice of a multitude.
Và I Daniel alone saw the vision: for the men that were with me saw not the vision; Nhưng a great quaking rơi upon them, so that they fled to hide themselves.
Therefore I was left alone, Và saw this great vision, Và there remained no strength in me: for my comeliness was turned in me into corruption, Và I retained no strength. comeliness: or, vigour
Yet heard I the voice of his words: Và when I heard tiếng of his words, then was I in a deep sleep on my face, Và my face toward the ground.
And, kìa, an hand touched me, which set me upon my knees and trên the palms of my hands. set: Heb. moved
Và he nói unto me, O Daniel, một người greatly beloved, understand những lời that I speak unto ngươi, and stand upright: for unto ngươi am I now sent. Và when he had spoken this word unto me, I stood trembling. greatly…: Heb. of desires upright: Heb. upon thy standing
Then nói he unto me, Fear not, Daniel: for from the first ngày that ngươi didst set thine heart to understand, Và to chasten thyself before thy God, thy words were heard, Và I am come for thy words.
But the prince of the kingdom of Persia withstood me one Và hai mươi ngày: but, lo, Michael, một of the chief princes, đến to help me; and I remained there with các vua of Persia. chief: or, first
Now I am come to make ngươi understand what shall befall thy people in the latter ngày: for yet the vision is for many ngày.
Và when he had spoken such words unto me, I set my face toward the ground, Và I became dumb.
And, kìa, one like the similitude của các con of men touched my lips: then I opened my mouth, Và spake, và nói unto him that stood before me, O my lord, by the vision my sorrows are turned upon me, and I have retained no strength.
For how can the servant of this my lord talk with this my lord? for as for me, straightway there remained no strength in me, neither is there breath left in me. the…: or, this servant of my lord
Then there came again Và touched me one like the appearance of a man, Và he strengthened me,
và nói, O man greatly beloved, fear not: peace be unto ngươi, be strong, yea, be strong. Và when he had spoken unto me, I was strengthened, và nói, Let my lord nói; for ngươi hast strengthened me.
Then nói he, Knowest ngươi wherefore I come unto ngươi? and now will I return to fight with the prince of Persia: Và when I am gone forth, lo, the prince of Grecia shall come.
Nhưng I will shew ngươi that which is noted in the scripture of truth: and there is none that holdeth with me in these things, but Michael your prince. holdeth: Heb. strengtheneth himself

CHAPTER 11.
Also I in the first năm of Darius the Mede, even I, stood to confirm Và to strengthen him.
Và now will I shew ngươi the truth. kìa, there shall stand up yet three các vua in Persia; Và the fourth shall be far richer than they all: Và by his strength through his riches he shall stir up all against the realm of Grecia.
Và a mighty vua shall stand up, that shall rule with great dominion, Và do according to his will.
Và when he shall stand up, his kingdom shall be broken, Và shall be divided toward the four winds of heaven; Và not to his posterity, nor according to his dominion which he ruled: for his kingdom shall be plucked up, even for others beside those.
và vua of the south shall be strong, and one of his princes; Và he shall be strong above him, and have dominion; his dominion shall be a great dominion.
Và in the end of years they shall join themselves together; for the king's con gái of the south shall come to the king of the north to make an agreement: but she shall not retain quyền năng of the arm; neither shall he stand, nor his arm: but she shall be given up, Và they that brought her, and he that begat her, and he that strengthened her in these times. join…: Heb. associate themselves an…: Heb. rights he that begat…: or, whom she brought forth
But out of a branch of her roots shall one stand up in his estate, which shall come with an army, Và shall enter into the fortress of the king of the north, Và shall deal against them, and shall prevail: in…: or, in his place, or, office
Và shall also carry captives into Ai-Cập their gods, with their princes, Và with their precious vessels of silver Và of gold; Và he shall continue more năm than the king of the north. their precious…: Heb. vessels of their desire
So the king of the south shall come into his kingdom, Và shall return into his own land.
But his sons shall be stirred up, Và shall assemble a multitude of great forces: and one shall certainly đến, Và overflow, Và pass through: then shall he return, Và be stirred up, even to his fortress. shall be…: or, shall war return…: or, be stirred up again
và vua of the south shall be moved with choler, Và shall come forth Và fight with him, even with the king of the north: Và he shall set forth a great multitude; đám đông shall be given into his hand.
Và when he hath taken away đám đông, his heart shall bị treo lên; Và he shall cast down many ten thousands: but he shall not be strengthened by it.
For the king of the north shall return, Và shall set forth a multitude lớn hơn than the former, Và shall certainly đến after certain năm with a great army Và with much riches. after…: Heb. at the end of times, even years
Và in those times there shall many stand up against the king of the south: also the robbers of thy people shall exalt themselves to establish the vision; but they shall fall. the robbers: Heb. the children of robbers
So the king of the north shall come, Và cast up a mount, Và take the most fenced các thành: Và the arms of the south shall not withstand, neither his chosen people, neither shall there be any strength to withstand. the most…: Heb. the city of munitions his…: Heb. the people of his choices
But he that cometh against him shall do according to his own will, Và none shall stand before him: and he shall stand in the glorious land, which by his hand shall be consumed. glorious…: or, goodly, etc.: Heb. land of ornament
He shall also set his face to enter with the strength of his whole kingdom, Và upright ones with him; thus shall he do: Và he shall give him con gái of women, corrupting her: but she shall not stand on his side, neither be for him. upright…: or, much uprightness: or, equal conditions corrupting: Heb. to corrupt
After this shall he turn his face unto the isles, Và shall take many: but a prince for his own behalf shall cause the reproach offered by him to cease; without his own reproach he shall cause it to turn upon him. for…: Heb. for him the reproach…: Heb. his reproach
Then he shall turn his face toward the fort of his own land: but he shall stumble Và fall, Và not be found.
Then shall stand up in his estate a raiser of taxes trong sự vinh hiển of the kingdom: but within few ngày he shall be destroyed, neither in anger, nor in battle. estate: or, place a…: Heb. one that causeth an exacter to pass over anger: Heb. angers
Và in his estate shall stand up a vile person, to whom they shall not give the honour of the kingdom: but he shall come trong bình anably, Và obtain the kingdom by flatteries. estate: or, place
Và with the arms of a flood shall they be overflown from before him, and shall be broken; yea, also the prince of the covenant.
Và after the league made with him he shall work deceitfully: for he shall come up, Và shall become strong with a small people.
He shall enter peaceably even upon the fattest places of the province; Và he shall do that which his fathers have not done, nor his fathers' fathers; he shall scatter among them the prey, Và spoil, Và riches: yea, Và he shall forecast his devices against the strong holds, even for a time. peaceably…: or, into the peaceable and fat, etc forecast…: Heb. think his thoughts
Và he shall stir up his power Và his courage against the king of the south with a great army; và vua of the south shall be stirred up to battle with a very great Và mighty army; but he shall not stand: for they shall forecast devices against him.
Yea, they that feed of the portion of his meat shall destroy him, and his army shall overflow: Và many shall fall down slain.
Và both these kings' hearts shall be to do mischief, Và they shall speak lies at one table; but it shall not prosper: for yet the end shall be at the time appointed. hearts: Heb. their hearts
Then shall he return into his land with great riches; Và his heart shall be against the holy covenant; Và he shall do exploits, Và return to his own land.
At the time appointed he shall return, Và come toward the south; but it shall not be as the former, or as the latter.
For the ships of Chittim shall come against him: therefore he shall be grieved, Và return, Và have indignation against the holy covenant: so shall he do; he shall even return, Và have intelligence with them that forsake the holy covenant.
Và arms shall stand on his part, and they shall pollute the sanctuary of strength, Và shall take away the daily sacrifice, Và they shall place sự gớm ghiếc that maketh desolate. maketh…: or, astonisheth
Và such as do wickedly against the covenant shall he corrupt by flatteries: but the people that do know their God shall be strong, Và do exploits. corrupt: or, cause to dissemble
Và they that understand among the people shall instruct many: yet they shall fall by thanh gươm, Và by flame, by captivity, Và by spoil, many ngày.
Now when they shall fall, they shall be holpen with a little help: but many shall cleave to them with flatteries.
Và some of them of understanding shall fall, to try them, and to purge, and to make họ trắng, even to the time of the end: because it is yet for a time appointed. try them: or, try by them
và vua shall do according to his will; Và he shall exalt himself, and magnify himself above every god, Và shall speak marvellous things against ĐCT of gods, Và shall prosper till the indignation be accomplished: for that that is determined shall be done.
Neither shall he regard ĐCT of his fathers, nor the desire of women, nor regard any god: for he shall magnify himself above all.
But in his estate shall he honour ĐCT of forces: Và a god whom his fathers knew not shall he honour with gold, và bạc, Và with precious stones, Và pleasant things. in…: or, as for the Almighty God, in his seat he shall honour yea, he shall honour a god, whom, etc estate: or, stead forces: or, munitions: Heb. Mauzzim, or, God's protectors pleasant: Heb. things desired
Thus shall he do in the most strong holds with a strange ĐCT, whom he shall acknowledge Và increase with glory: Và he shall cause them to rule over many, Và shall divide the land for gain. most…: Heb. fortresses of munitions gain: Heb. a price
Và at the time of the end shall the king of the south push at him: and the king of the north shall come against him like a whirlwind, with chariots, Và with horsemen, Và with many ships; Và he shall enter into the countries, Và shall overflow Và pass over.
He shall enter also into the glorious land, Và many countries shall be overthrown: but these shall escape out of his hand, even Edom, Và Mô-áp, Và the chief of the children of Ammon. glorious…: or, goodly, etc.: Heb. land of delight, or, ornament
He shall stretch forth his hand also upon the countries: Và the land of Ai-Cập shall not escape. stretch…: Heb. send forth
But he shall have power over the treasures of gold Và of silver, Và over all the precious things of Ai-Cập: Và the Libyans Và the Ethiopians shall be at his steps.
But tidings out of the east Và out of the north shall trouble him: therefore he shall go forth with great fury to destroy, Và utterly to make away many.
Và he shall plant đền tạms of his palace between biểns in the glorious thánh núi; yet he shall come to his end, Và none shall help him. glorious…: or, goodly, etc.: Heb. mountain of delight of holiness

CHAPTER 12.
Và at that time shall Michael stand up, the great prince which standeth for the children of thy people: Và there shall be a time of trouble, such as never was since there was a nation even to that same time: Và at that time thy people shall be delivered, every one that shall be found written in the book.
Và many of them that sleep in the dust đất shall awake, some to đời đời sự sống, Và some to shame Và đời đời contempt.
Và they that be wise shall shine as the brightness of the firmament; Và they that turn many to righteousness as ngôi saos đến đời đời và mãi mãi. wise: or, teachers
But thou, O Daniel, shut up những lời, Và seal quyển sách, even to the time of the end: many shall run to and fro, Và knowledge shall be increased.
Then I Daniel looked, and, kìa, there stood other hai, the one on this side of the bank of the river, Và the other on that side of the bank of the river. bank: Heb. lip bank: Heb. lip
Và one nói to the man mặc in linen, which was trên the waters of the river, How long shall it be to the end of these wonders? upon…: or, from above
Và I heard the man mặc in linen, which was trên the waters of the river, when he held up his tay phải Và his tay trái unto heaven, Và sware by him that liveth đến đời đời that it shall be for a time, times, Và an half; Và when he shall have accomplished to scatter quyền năng of the holy people, all these things shall be finished. a time…: or, part
Và I heard, but I understood not: then nói I, O my Lord, what shall be the end of these things?
Và he nói, Go thy way, Đa-ni-ên: for the words are closed up Và sealed till the time of the end.
Many shall be purified, Và made white, Và tried; but the wicked shall do wickedly: Và none of the wicked shall understand; but the wise shall understand.
Và from the time that the daily sacrifice shall be taken away, Và the abomination that maketh desolate set up, there shall be một ngàn hai trăm Và ninety ngày. the abomination: Heb. to set up the abomination maketh…: or, astonisheth
phước is he that waiteth, Và cometh to the thousand ba trăm Và five Và ba mươi ngày.
But go ngươi thy way till the end be: for ngươi shalt rest, Và stand in thy lot at the end of the days. for thou: or, and thou, etc

div.title: HOSEA
div.chapter:
CHAPTER 1.
lời of the CHÚA that came unto Hosea, con trai of Beeri, trong những ngày of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, Và Hezekiah, các vua của Giu-đa, Và trong những ngày of Jeroboam con trai of Joash, vua của I-sơ-ra-ên.
ban đầu of the word of the CHÚA by Hosea. Và the CHÚA nói to Hosea, đi, take unto ngươi a wife of whoredoms Và children of whoredoms: for the land hath committed great whoredom, departing từ the CHÚA.
So he went Và took Gomer con gái of Diblaim; which conceived, Và bare him một con trai.
Và the CHÚA nói unto him, Call his name Jezreel; for yet a little while, Và I will avenge the blood of Jezreel upon nhà of Jehu, Và will cause to cease the kingdom của nhà của I-sơ-ra-ên. avenge: Heb. visit
Và it shall come to pass at that day, that I will break the bow của I-sơ-ra-ên in the valley of Jezreel.
Và she conceived again, Và bare a daughter. And God nói unto him, Call her name Lo–ruhamah: for I will no more have mercy upon nhà của I-sơ-ra-ên; but I will utterly take them away. Lo–ruhamah: that is, Not having obtained mercy no…: Heb. not add any more to but…: or, that I should altogether pardon them
But I will have mercy upon nhà của Giu-đa, Và will save them by the CHÚA their God, Và will not save them by bow, nor by thanh gươm, nor by battle, by horses, nor by horsemen.
Now when she had weaned Lo–ruhamah, she conceived, Và bare một con trai.
Then nói God, Call his name Lo–ammi: for ye are not my people, and I will not be your God. Lo–ammi: that is, Not my people
Yet the number of the children của I-sơ-ra-ên shall be as the sand of biển, which cannot be measured nor numbered; and it shall come to pass, that in the place where it was nói với họ, Ye are not my people, there it shall be nói với họ, Ye are the sons of the living ĐCT. in…: or, instead of that
Then shall the children của Giu-đa Và the children của I-sơ-ra-ên be gathered together, Và appoint themselves one đầu, Và they shall come up out of the land: for great shall be ngày of Jezreel.

CHAPTER 2.
Say ye cùng các ngươir brethren, Ammi; Và to your sisters, Ru–hamah. Ammi: that is, My people Ru–hamah: that is, Having obtained mercy
Plead with your mother, plead: for she is not my wife, neither là I her husband: let her therefore put away her whoredoms out of her sight, Và her adulteries from between her breasts;
Lest I strip her naked, Và set her as trong ngày that she was born, Và make her as a wilderness, Và set her like a dry land, Và slay her with thirst.
Và I will not have mercy upon her children; for they be con cái of whoredoms.
For their mother hath played the harlot: she that conceived them hath done shamefully: for she nói, I will go after my lovers, that give me my bread Và my water, my wool Và my flax, mine oil Và my drink. drink: Heb. drinks
Therefore, kìa, I will hedge up thy way with thorns, Và make a wall, that she shall not find her paths. make…: Heb. wall a wall
Và she shall follow after her lovers, but she shall not overtake them; and she sẽ thấy them, but shall not find họ: then shall she say, I will go Và return to my first chồng; for then was it better with me than now.
For she did not know that I gave her corn, Và wine, Và oil, Và multiplied her silver và vàng, which they prepared for Baal. wine: Heb. new wine which…: or, wherewith they made Baal
Therefore will I return, Và take away my corn in the time thereof, and my wine in mùa thereof, and will recover my wool Và my flax given to cover her nakedness. recover: or, take away
Và now will I discover her lewdness in the sight of her lovers, Và none shall deliver her out of mine hand. lewdness: Heb. folly, or, villany
I will also cause all her mirth to cease, her feast days, her new moons, Và her sabbaths, Và all her solemn feasts.
Và I will destroy her vines Và her cây vảs, whereof she hath nói, These are my rewards that my lovers have given me: and I will make them a forest, Và the beasts of the field shall eat them. destroy: Heb. make desolate
Và I will visit upon her the days of Baalim, wherein she burned incense to them, and she decked herself with her earrings Và her jewels, Và she went after her lovers, Và forgat me, nói the CHÚA.
Therefore, kìa, I will allure her, and bring her into the wilderness, Và speak comfortably unto her. comfortably: or, friendly: Heb. to her heart
Và I will give her her vườn nhos from thence, and the valley of Achor for a door of hy vọng: Và she shall sing there, as trong những ngày of her youth, Và as trong ngày when she came up out of the land of Ai-Cập.
Và it shall be at that day, nói the CHÚA, that ngươi shalt call me Ishi; Và shalt call me no more Baali. Ishi: that is, My husband Baali: that is, My lord
For I will take away tên of Baalim out of her mouth, Và they shall no more be nhớ lại by their name.
Và in that day will I make a covenant for them with the beasts of the field, Và with the fowls of heaven, and với the creeping things of the ground: Và I will break the bow Và thanh gươm Và the battle out đất, Và will make them to lie down safely.
Và I will betroth ngươi unto me đến đời đời; yea, I will betroth ngươi unto me in righteousness, Và in judgment, Và in lovingkindness, Và in mercies.
I will even betroth ngươi unto me in faithfulness: Và ngươi shalt know the CHÚA.
Và it shall come to pass in that day, I will hear, nói the CHÚA, I will hear các tầng trời, Và they shall hear đất;
Và đất shall hear the corn, Và the wine, Và the oil; Và they shall hear Jezreel.
Và I will sow her unto me in đất; Và I will have mercy upon her that had not obtained mercy; Và I will say to them which were not my people, Thou art my people; Và they shall say, ngươi art my God.

CHAPTER 3.
Then nói the CHÚA unto me, Go yet, love một người đờn bà beloved of her friend, yet an adulteress, according to tình yêu of the CHÚA toward the children của I-sơ-ra-ên, who look to other gods, Và love flagons of wine. of wine: Heb. of grapes
So I bought her to me for fifteen pieces of silver, and for an homer of barley, Và an half homer of barley: half…: Heb. lethech
Và tôi nói unto her, ngươi shalt abide for me many ngày; ngươi shalt not play the harlot, Và ngươi shalt not be for another man: so will I also be for ngươi.
For the children của I-sơ-ra-ên shall abide many ngày without a king, Và without a prince, Và without a sacrifice, Và without an image, Và without an ephod, and without teraphim: image: Heb. a standing, or, statue, or, pillar
Afterward shall the children của I-sơ-ra-ên return, Và seek the CHÚA their God, Và Đa-vít their king; Và shall fear the CHÚA Và his goodness in the latter ngày.

CHAPTER 4.
nghe lời of the CHÚA, ye children của I-sơ-ra-ên: for the CHÚA hath a controversy with the inhabitants of the land, because there is no truth, nor mercy, nor knowledge của ĐCT in the land.
By swearing, Và lying, Và killing, Và stealing, Và committing ngoại tình, they break out, Và blood toucheth huyết. blood: Heb. bloods
Therefore shall the land than khóc, và mãi mãiy one that ởeth therein shall languish, with the beasts of the field, Và with the fowls of heaven; yea, the fishes of biển also shall be taken away.
Yet let không ai strive, nor reprove another: for thy people are as they that strive with thầy tế lễ.
Therefore shalt ngươi fall trong ngày, Và the prophet also shall fall with ngươi in the night, Và I will destroy thy mother. destroy: Heb. cut off
My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge: because ngươi hast rejected sự hiểu biết, I will also reject ngươi, that ngươi shalt be no priest to me: seeing ngươi hast forgotten luật pháp of thy God, I will also forget thy children. destroyed: Heb. cut off
As they were increased, so they sinned against me: Vậy will I change their glory into shame.
They eat up the sin of my people, Và they set their heart on their iniquity. set…: Heb. lift up their soul to
Và there shall be, like people, like priest: Và I will punish them for their ways, Và reward them their doings. punish: Heb. visit upon reward: Heb. cause to return
For they shall eat, Và not have enough: they shall commit whoredom, Và shall not increase: because they have left off to take heed to the CHÚA.
Whoredom Và wine Và new wine take away the heart.
My people ask counsel at their stocks, Và their staff declareth với họ: for the spirit of whoredoms hath caused họ to err, Và they have gone a whoring from under their God.
They sacrifice upon the tops of núis, Và burn incense upon the hills, under oaks Và poplars Và elms, because the shadow thereof is tốt: therefore your daughters shall commit whoredom, Và your spouses shall commit ngoại tình.
I will not punish your daughters when they commit whoredom, nor your spouses when they commit ngoại tình: for themselves are separated with whores, Và they sacrifice with harlots: therefore the people that doth not understand shall fall. I will not: or, Shall I not fall: or, be punished
Though thou, I-sơ-ra-ên, play the harlot, yet let not Giu-đa offend; Và come not ye unto Gilgal, neither go ye up to Beth–aven, nor swear, The CHÚA liveth.
For I-sơ-ra-ên slideth back as a backsliding heifer: now the CHÚA will feed them as a lamb in a large place.
Ép-ra-im is joined to idols: let him alone.
Their drink is sour: they have committed whoredom continually: her rulers với shame do love, Give ye. sour: Heb. gone rulers: Heb. shields
gió hath bound her up in her wings, Và they lấy làm hổ thẹn vì cớ their sacrifices.

CHAPTER 5.
nghe ye this, O priests; Và hearken, ye house của I-sơ-ra-ên; Và give ye ear, O house of the king; for judgment is toward you, because ye have been a snare on Mizpah, Và a net spread upon Tabor.
Và the revolters are profound to make slaughter, though I have been a rebuker of them all. though: or, and a rebuker: Heb. a correction
I know Ép-ra-im, Và I-sơ-ra-ên is not hid from me: for now, O Ephraim, ngươi committest whoredom, Và I-sơ-ra-ên is làm dơ dáyd.
They will not frame their doings to turn unto their God: for the spirit of whoredoms is in the midst of them, and they have not known the CHÚA. They will…: or, Their doings will not suffer them frame: Heb. give
Và the pride của I-sơ-ra-ên doth testify to his face: therefore shall I-sơ-ra-ên Và Ephraim fall in their iniquity; Giu-đa also shall fall with them.
They shall go with their flocks Và with their herds to seek the CHÚA; but they shall not find him; he hath withdrawn himself from them.
They have dealt treacherously against the CHÚA: for they have begotten strange children: now shall a month devour them with their portions.
Blow ye the cornet in Gibeah, Và the trumpet in Ramah: cry aloud at Beth–aven, after ngươi, O Bên-gia-min.
Ép-ra-im shall be desolate trong ngày of rebuke: among the tribes của I-sơ-ra-ên have I made known that which shall surely be.
The princes của Giu-đa were like them that remove the bound: Vậy I will pour out my wrath upon them like water.
Ép-ra-im is oppressed Và broken in judgment, because he willingly walked after the commandment.
Therefore will I be unto Ephraim as a moth, Và đến nhà của Giu-đa as rottenness. rottenness: or, a worm
When Ephraim nhìn thấy his sickness, Và Giu-đa nhìn thấy his wound, then went Ép-ra-im to the Assyrian, Và sent to king Jareb: yet could he not heal you, nor cure you of your wound. king Jareb: or, the king of Jareb: or, the king that should plead
For I will be unto Ephraim as a lion, Và as a young lion đến nhà của Giu-đa: I, even I, will tear Và go away; I will take away, Và none shall rescue him.
I will go Và return to my place, till they acknowledge their offence, Và seek my face: in their affliction they will seek me early. acknowledge…: Heb. be guilty

CHAPTER 6.
đến, Và let us return unto the CHÚA: for he hath torn, Và he will heal us; he hath smitten, Và he will bind us up.
After two days will he revive us: in the third ngày he will raise us up, Và we shall live in his sight.
Then shall we know, nếu we follow on to know the CHÚA: his going forth is prepared as buổi sáng; Và he shall come unto us as the rain, as the latter Và former rain unto đất.
O Ephraim, what shall I do unto ngươi? O Giu-đa, what shall I do unto ngươi? for your goodness is as a morning cloud, Và as the early dew it goeth away. goodness: or, mercy, or, kindness
Therefore have I hewed họ by các tiên tri; I have slain them by the words of my mouth: Và thy judgments are as the light that goeth forth. and…: or, that thy judgments might be, etc
For I desired mercy, Và not sacrifice; Và the knowledge của ĐCT more than burnt offerings.
But they like men have transgressed giao ước: there have they dealt treacherously against me. men: or, Adam
Gilead is a city of them that work iniquity, Và is polluted with blood. polluted: or, cunning for
Và as troops of robbers wait for a man, so the company of priests murder in the way by consent: for they commit lewdness. by…: Heb. with one shoulder, or, to Shechem lewdness: or, enormity
I have seen an horrible thing in nhà của I-sơ-ra-ên: there is the whoredom of Ephraim, I-sơ-ra-ên is làm dơ dáyd.
Also, O Giu-đa, he hath set an harvest for ngươi, when I returned the captivity of my people.

CHAPTER 7.
When I would have healed I-sơ-ra-ên, then the iniquity of Ephraim was discovered, Và the wickedness of Sa-ma-ri: for they commit falsehood; Và the thief cometh in, Và the troop of robbers spoileth without. wickedness: Heb. evils spoileth: Heb. strippeth
Và they consider not in their hearts that I remember all their wickedness: now their own doings have beset them about; they are before my face. consider…: Heb. say not to
They make the king glad with their wickedness, Và the princes with their lies.
They are all adulterers, as an oven heated by the baker, ai ceaseth from raising after he hath kneaded the dough, until it be leavened. who…: or, the raiser will cease raising: or, waking
trong ngày of our king the princes have made him sick with bottles of wine; he stretched out his hand with scorners. bottles…: or, heat through wine
For they have made ready their heart like an oven, whiles they lie in wait: their baker sleepeth all the night; in buổi sáng it burneth as a flaming lửa. made…: or, applied
They are all hot as an oven, Và have devoured their judges; all their kings are fallen: there is none among them that calleth unto me.
Ép-ra-im, he hath mixed himself among the people; Ép-ra-im is a cake not turned.
Strangers have devoured his strength, Và he knoweth it not: yea, gray hairs are here and there upon him, yet he knoweth not. here…: Heb. sprinkled
Và the pride của I-sơ-ra-ên testifieth to his face: Và they do not return to the CHÚA their God, nor seek him for all this.
Ép-ra-im also is like a silly dove without heart: they call to Ai-Cập, they go to A-si-ri.
When they shall go, I will spread my net upon them; I will bring them down as the fowls of the heaven; I will chastise them, as their congregation hath heard.
Khốn thay với họ! for they have fled from me: destruction với họ! because they have transgressed against me: though I have redeemed them, yet they have spoken lies against me. destruction: Heb. spoil
Và they have not cried unto me with their heart, when they howled upon their beds: they assemble themselves for corn Và wine, Và they rebel against me.
Though I have bound Và strengthened their arms, yet do they imagine mischief against me. have…: or, chastened
They return, but not to the most High: they are like a deceitful bow: their princes shall fall by thanh gươm for the rage of their tongue: này shall be their derision in the land of Ai-Cập.

CHAPTER 8.
Set the trumpet to thy mouth. He shall come as an eagle against nhà of the CHÚA, because they have transgressed my covenant, Và trespassed against my law. thy: Heb. the roof of thy
I-sơ-ra-ên shall cry unto me, My God, we know ngươi.
I-sơ-ra-ên hath cast off the thing that is tốt: the enemy shall pursue him.
They have set up kings, but not by me: they have made princes, Và I knew it not: of their silver Và their gold have they made them idols, that they may be cut off.
Thy calf, O Sa-ma-ri, hath cast ngươi off; mine anger is kindled against them: how long will it be ere they attain to innocency?
For from I-sơ-ra-ên was it also: the workman made it; therefore it is not God: but the calf of Sa-ma-ri shall be broken in pieces.
For they have sown gió, Và they shall reap the whirlwind: it hath no stalk: the bud shall yield no meal: nếu so be it yield, the strangers shall swallow it up. stalk: or, standing corn
I-sơ-ra-ên is swallowed up: now shall they be among the Gentiles as a vessel wherein is no pleasure.
For they are gone up to A-si-ri, a wild ass alone by himself: Ephraim hath hired lovers. lovers: Heb. loves
Yea, though they have hired among the nations, now will I gather them, and they shall sorrow a little for the burden of the king of princes. sorrow: or, begin a…: or, in ít lâu
Because Ephraim hath made many những bàn thờ to sin, những bàn thờ shall be unto him to sin.
I have written to him the great things of my law, but they were counted as a strange thing.
They sacrifice flesh for the sacrifices of mine offerings, Và eat it; but the CHÚA accepteth them not; now will he remember their iniquity, Và visit their tội lỗi: they shall return to Ai-Cập. They sacrifice…: or, In the sacrifices of mine offerings they, etc
For I-sơ-ra-ên hath forgotten his Maker, Và buildeth temples; Và Giu-đa hath multiplied fenced các thành: but I will send a fire upon his cities, Và it shall devour the palaces thereof.

CHAPTER 9.
Rejoice not, O I-sơ-ra-ên, for joy, as other people: for ngươi hast gone a whoring from thy God, ngươi hast loved a reward upon every cornfloor. upon: or, in, etc
The floor Và the winepress shall not feed them, and the new wine shall fail in her. winepress: or, winefat
They shall not ở in the Lord's land; but Ephraim shall return to Ai-Cập, Và they shall eat unclean things in A-si-ri.
They shall not offer rượu nho offerings to the CHÚA, neither shall they be pleasing unto him: their sacrifices shall be với họ as the bread of mourners; all that eat thereof shall be polluted: for their bread for their soul shall not come inđến nhà of the CHÚA.
What will ye do in the solemn ngày, Và trong ngày of the feast of the CHÚA?
For, lo, they are gone vì cớ destruction: Ai-Cập shall gather them up, Memphis shall bury them: the pleasant places for their silver, nettles shall possess them: thorns shall be in their tabernacles. destruction: Heb. spoil the…: or, their silver shall be desired, the nettle, etc.: Heb. the desire
The days of visitation are come, the days of recompence are come; I-sơ-ra-ên shall know it: tiên tri is a fool, the spiritual man is mad, for đám đông of thine iniquity, Và the great thù oán. spiritual…: Heb. man of the spirit
The watchman of Ephraim was with my God: but tiên tri is a snare of a fowler in all his ways, Và thù oán in nhà of his God. in the: or, against the
They have deeply corrupted themselves, as trong những ngày of Gibeah: Vậy he will remember their iniquity, he will visit their tội lỗi.
I found I-sơ-ra-ên like grapes in the wilderness; I saw your fathers as the firstripe in cây vả at her first time: but they went to Baal–peor, Và separated themselves unto that shame; and their abominations were according as they loved.
As for Ép-ra-im, their glory shall fly away like a bird, from the birth, Và from the womb, Và from the conception.
Though they bring up their children, yet will I bereave them, that there shall not be một người left: yea, woe also to them when I depart from them!
Ép-ra-im, as I saw Tyrus, is trồng in a pleasant place: but Ephraim shall bring forth his children to the murderer.
Give them, O CHÚA: what wilt ngươi give? give them a miscarrying womb Và dry breasts. miscarrying: Heb. that casteth the fruit
All their wickedness is in Gilgal: for there I hated them: for the wickedness of their doings I will drive them out of mine house, I will love them no more: all their princes are revolters.
Ép-ra-im is smitten, their root is dried up, they shall bear no fruit: yea, though they bring forth, yet will I slay even the beloved fruit of their womb. the…: Heb. the desires
My God will cast them away, because they did not hearken unto him: and they shall be wanderers among the nations.

CHAPTER 10.
I-sơ-ra-ên is an empty vine, he bringeth forth fruit unto himself: according to đám đông of his fruit he hath increased the altars; according to the goodness of his land they have made goodly images. an…: or, a vine emptying the fruit which it giveth images: Heb. statues, or, standing images
Their heart is divided; now shall they be found faulty: he shall break down their altars, he shall spoil their images. Their heart…: or, He hath divided their heart break…: Heb. behead images: Heb. statues, or, standing images
For now they shall say, We have no king, because we feared not the CHÚA; what then should a king do to us?
They have spoken những lời, swearing falsely in making a covenant: thus judgment springeth up as hemlock in the furrows of the field.
The inhabitants of Sa-ma-ri shall fear vì cớ the calves of Beth–aven: for the people thereof shall mourn over it, and the priests thereof that rejoiced on it, for sự vinh hiển thereof, because it is departed from it. the priests…: or, Chemarim
It shall be also carried unto A-si-ri for a present to king Jareb: Ép-ra-im shall receive shame, Và I-sơ-ra-ên lấy làm hổ thẹn of his own counsel.
As for Sa-ma-ri, her king is cut off as the foam trên nước. the water: Heb. mặt of the water
The high places also of Aven, the sin của I-sơ-ra-ên, sẽ bị hủy diệt: the thorn Và the thistle shall come up on their altars; Và they shall say to núis, Cover us; and to the hills, Fall on us.
O I-sơ-ra-ên, ngươi hast sinned from the days of Gibeah: there they stood: the battle in Gibeah against the children of iniquity did not overtake them.
It is in my desire that I should chastise them; and the people shall be gathered against them, when they shall bind themselves in their two furrows. when…: or, when I shall bind them for their two transgressions, or, in their two habitations
Và Ephraim is as an heifer that is dạy, Và loveth to tread out the corn; but I passed over upon her fair cổ: I will make Ephraim to ride; Giu-đa shall plow, Và Gia-cốp shall break his clods. her…: Heb. the beauty of her neck
Sow to yourselves in righteousness, reap trong mercy; break up your fallow ground: for it is time to seek the CHÚA, till he come Và rain righteousness upon you.
Ye have plowed wickedness, ye have reaped iniquity; ye have eaten the fruit of lies: because ngươi didst trust in thy way, in đám đông of thy mighty men.
Therefore shall a tumult Hãy chổi dậy among thy people, Và all thy fortresses shall be spoiled, as Shalman spoiled Beth–arbel trong ngày of battle: the mother was dashed in pieces upon her children.
So shall Beth–el do cùng các ngươi because of your great wickedness: in a morning shall the king của I-sơ-ra-ên utterly be cut off. your…: Heb. the evil of your evil

CHAPTER 11.
When I-sơ-ra-ên was a child, then I loved him, and called my son out of Ai-Cập.
As they called them, so they went from them: they sacrificed unto Baalim, Và burned incense to graven images.
I taught Ép-ra-im also to go, taking them by their arms; but they knew not that I healed them.
I drew them with cords of a man, with bands of love: Và I was to them as they that take off the yoke on their jaws, Và I laid meat với họ. take off: Heb. lift up
He shall not return into the land of Ai-Cập, but the Assyrian shall be his king, because they refused to return.
Và thanh gươm shall abide on his cities, Và shall consume his branches, Và devour họ, vì cớ their own counsels.
Và my people are bent to backsliding from me: though they called them to the most High, none at all would exalt him. none…: Heb. together they exalted not
How shall I give ngươi up, Ép-ra-im? how shall I deliver ngươi, I-sơ-ra-ên? how shall I make ngươi as Admah? how shall I set ngươi as Zeboim? mine heart is turned within me, my repentings are kindled together.
I will not execute the fierceness of mine anger, I will not return to destroy Ép-ra-im: for I là ĐCT, Và not man; the Holy One in the midst of ngươi: and I will not enter into the city.
They shall walk after the CHÚA: he shall roar like a lion: when he shall roar, then the children shall tremble from phương tây.
They shall tremble as a bird out of Ai-Cập, Và as a dove out of the land of A-si-ri: Và I will place them in their houses, nói the CHÚA.
Ép-ra-im compasseth me about with lies, Và nhà của I-sơ-ra-ên with deceit: but Giu-đa yet ruleth with God, Và is faithful với các thánh. saints: or, most holy

CHAPTER 12.
Ép-ra-im feedeth on wind, Và followeth after the east wind: he daily increaseth lies Và desolation; Và they do make a covenant with the Assyrians, Và oil is carried into Ai-Cập.
The CHÚA hath also a controversy with Giu-đa, Và will punish Gia-cốp according to his ways; according to his doings will he recompense him. punish: Heb. visit upon
He took his brother by the heel in the womb, Và by his strength he had power with God: had…: Heb. was a prince, or, behaved himself princely
Yea, he had power over thiên sứ, Và prevailed: he khóc, Và made supplication unto him: he found him trong Beth–el, Và there he spake with us;
Even the CHÚA ĐCT vạn quân; the CHÚA is his memorial.
Therefore turn ngươi to thy God: keep mercy Và judgment, Và wait on thy God continually.
He is a merchant, the balances of deceit are in his hand: he loveth to oppress. a merchant: or, Canaan oppress: or, deceive
Và Ephraim nói, Yet I am become rich, I have found me out substance: trong all my labours they shall find none iniquity in me that were tội lỗi. in all…: or, all my labours suffice me not: he shall have punishment of iniquity in whom is sin that: Heb. which
Và I that am the CHÚA thy God from the land of Ai-Cập will yet make ngươi to ở in tabernacles, as trong những ngày of the solemn feast.
I have also spoken by các tiên tri, Và I have multiplied visions, Và used similitudes, by the ministry of các tiên tri. ministry: Heb. hand
Is there iniquity trong Gilead? surely they are hư không: they sacrifice bullocks in Gilgal; yea, their altars are as heaps in the furrows of the fields.
Và Gia-cốp fled into the country of Si-ri, Và I-sơ-ra-ên served for a wife, Và for a wife he kept chiên.
Và by a prophet the CHÚA brought I-sơ-ra-ên out of Ai-Cập, Và by a prophet was he preserved.
Ép-ra-im provoked him to anger most bitterly: therefore shall he leave his blood upon him, and his reproach shall his Lord return unto him. most…: Heb. with bitternesses blood: Heb. bloods

CHAPTER 13.
When Ephraim nói trembling, he exalted himself in I-sơ-ra-ên; but when he offended in Baal, he died.
Và now they sin more and more, Và have made them molten images of their silver, Và idols according to their own understanding, all of it the work of the craftsmen: they say of them, Let the men that sacrifice kiss the calves. they sin…: Heb. they add to sin the men…: or, the sacrificers of men
Therefore they shall be as buổi sáng cloud, Và as the early dew that passeth away, as the chaff that is driven with the whirlwind out of the floor, Và as the smoke out of the chimney.
Yet I là the CHÚA thy God from the land of Ai-Cập, Và ngươi shalt know no god but me: for there is no saviour beside me.
I did know ngươi in the wilderness, in the land of great drought. great…: Heb. droughts
According to their pasture, so were they filled; they were filled, Và their heart was exalted; therefore have they forgotten me.
Therefore I will be với họ as a lion: as a leopard by the way will I observe họ:
I will meet them as a bear that is bereaved of her whelps, Và will rend the caul of their heart, Và there will I devour them like a lion: the wild beast shall tear them. wild…: Heb. beast of the field
O I-sơ-ra-ên, ngươi hast destroyed thyself; but in me is thine help. is…: Heb. in thy help
I will be thy king: where is any other that may save ngươi in all thy cities? Và thy judges of whom ngươi nóist, Give me a king Và princes? I will…: rather, Where is thy king?
I gave ngươi a king in mine anger, Và took him away in my wrath.
The iniquity of Ephraim is bound up; his sin is hid.
The sorrows of a travailing woman shall come upon him: he is an unwise son; for he should not stay long in the place of the breaking forth of children. long: Heb. a time
I will ransom them from quyền năng of the grave; I will redeem them from death: O death, I will be thy plagues; O grave, I will be thy destruction: repentance shall be hid from mine eyes. power: Heb. hand
Though he be fruitful among his anh em, an east wind shall come, gió of the CHÚA shall come up from the wilderness, Và his spring shall become dry, Và his fountain shall be dried up: he shall spoil the treasure of all pleasant vessels. pleasant…: Heb. vessels of desire
Sa-ma-ri shall become desolate; for she hath rebelled against her God: they shall fall by thanh gươm: their infants shall be dashed in pieces, Và their women with child shall be ripped up.

CHAPTER 14.
O I-sơ-ra-ên, return unto the CHÚA thy God; for ngươi hast fallen by thine iniquity.
Take with you words, Và turn to the CHÚA: say unto him, Take away all iniquity, Và receive us graciously: so will we render the calves of our lips. receive…: or, give good
Asshur shall not save us; we will not ride upon horses: neither will we say any more to the work of our hands, Ye are our gods: for in ngươi chaless tìm mercy.
I will heal their backsliding, I will love them freely: for mine anger is turned away from him.
I will be as the dew unto I-sơ-ra-ên: he shall grow as the lily, Và cast forth his roots as Lebanon. grow: or, blossom cast…: Heb. strike
His branches shall spread, Và his beauty shall be as the olive tree, Và his smell as Lebanon. spread: Heb. go
They that ở under his shadow shall return; they shall revive as the corn, Và grow as the vine: the scent thereof shall be as the wine of Lebanon. grow: or, blossom scent: or, memorial
Ép-ra-im shall say, What have I to do any more with idols? I have heard him, Và observed him: I là like a green fir tree. From me is thy fruit found.
Who is khôn ngoan, Và he shall understand these things? prudent, Và he shall know them? for the ways of the CHÚA are right, Và the just shall walk in them: but the transgressors shall fall therein.

div.title: JOEL
div.chapter:
CHAPTER 1.
lời of the CHÚA that came to Joel con trai of Pethuel.
nghe this, ye old men, Và give ear, all ye inhabitants of the land. Hath this been in your days, or even trong những ngày of your fathers?
Tell ye your children of it, and let your children tell their children, Và their children another dòng dõi.
That which the palmerworm hath left hath the locust eaten; Và that which the locust hath left hath the cankerworm eaten; Và that which the cankerworm hath left hath the caterpiller eaten. That which the palmerworm…: Heb. The residue of the palmerworm
Awake, ye drunkards, Và weep; Và howl, all ye drinkers of wine, vì cớ the new wine; for it is cut off from your mouth.
For a nation is come up upon my land, strong, Và without number, whose teeth are the teeth of a lion, Và he hath the cheek teeth of a great lion.
He hath laid my vine waste, Và barked my cây vả: he hath made it clean bare, and cast it away; the branches thereof are made white. barked…: Heb. laid my cây vả for a barking
Lament like một trinh nữ girded with vải bố for chồng of her youth.
The meat offering Và the uốngfering is cut off from nhà of the CHÚA; những thầy tế lễ, the Lord's ministers, than khóc.
cánh đồng is wasted, the land mourneth; for the corn is wasted: the new wine is dried up, the oil languisheth.
Be ye ashamed, O ye husbandmen; howl, O ye vinedressers, for the wheat Và for the barley; because mùa gặt of the field is perished.
The vine is dried up, Và cây vả languisheth; the pomegranate tree, the palm tree also, and the apple tree, even all the trees of the field, are withered: because joy is withered away from the sons of men.
Gird yourselves, and lament, ye priests: howl, ye ministers of the altar: đến, lie all night in vải bố, ye ministers of my God: for the meat offering Và the uốngfering is withholden from nhà of your God.
Sanctify ye a fast, call a solemn assembly, gather các trưởng lão Và all the inhabitants of the land into nhà of the CHÚA your God, Và cry unto the CHÚA,solemn…: or, day of restraint
Alas for the day! for the day of the CHÚA is at hand, Và as a destruction from the Almighty shall it come.
Is not the meat cut off before our eyes, yea, joy Và gladness from nhà of our God?
The seed is rotten under their clods, the garners are laid desolate, the barns are broken down; for the corn is withered. seed: Heb. grains
How do the beasts groan! the herds of cattle are perplexed, because they have no pasture; yea, the flocks of sheep are made desolate.
O CHÚA, to ngươi will I cry: for the fire hath devoured the pastures of the wilderness, Và the flame hath burned all the trees of the field. pastures: or, habitations
The beasts of the field cry also unto ngươi: for the rivers of waters are dried up, Và the fire hath devoured the pastures of the wilderness.

CHAPTER 2.
Blow ye the trumpet in Si-ôn, Và sound an alarm in my holy núi: let all the inhabitants of the land tremble: for the day of the CHÚA đến, for it is nigh at hand; trumpet: or, cornet
A day của sự tối tăm Và of gloominess, a day of clouds Và of thick darkness, as buổi sáng spread upon núis: a great people Và a strong; there hath not been ever the like, neither shall be any more after it, even to the years of many generations. of many…: Heb. of generation and generation
A fire devoureth before them; and behind them a flame burneth: the land is as vườn of Ê-đen before them, and behind them a desolate wilderness; yea, and nothing shall escape them.
The appearance of them is as the appearance of horses; Và as horsemen, so shall they run.
Like the noise of chariots on the tops of mountains shall they leap, like the noise of a flame lửa that devoureth the stubble, as a strong people set in battle array.
Before their face the people shall be much pained: all faces shall gather blackness. blackness: Heb. pot
They shall run like mighty men; they shall climb the wall like men of war; Và they shall march every one on his ways, Và they shall not break their ranks:
Neither shall one thrust another; they shall walk every one in his path: and khi they fall upon thanh gươm, they shall not be wounded. thanh gươm: or, dart
They shall run to and fro in the city; they shall run upon the wall, they shall climb up upon nhàs; they shall enter in at the windows like a thief.
đất shall quake before them; the heavens shall tremble: mặt trời Và the moon shall be dark, Và ngôi saos shall withdraw their shining:
Và the CHÚA shall utter his voice before his army: for his camp is very great: for he is strong that executeth his word: for the day of the CHÚA is great Và very terrible; Và who can abide it?
Therefore also now, nói the CHÚA, turn ye even to me with all your heart, Và with fasting, Và with weeping, Và with than khóc:
