Và rend your heart, Và not your garments, Và turn unto the CHÚA your God: for he is gracious Và merciful, slow to anger, Và of great kindness, Và repenteth him of the evil.
Who knoweth nếu he will return Và repent, Và leave a blessing behind him; even a meat offering Và a uốngfering unto the CHÚA your God?
Blow the trumpet in Si-ôn, sanctify a fast, call a solemn assembly:
Gather the people, sanctify the congregation, assemble các trưởng lão, gather con cái, Và those that suck the breasts: let chàng rể go forth of his chamber, Và the bride out of her closet.
Let the priests, the ministers of the CHÚA, weep between the porch Và the altar, Và let them say, Spare thy people, O CHÚA, Và give not thine heritage to reproach, that the heathen should rule over them: wherefore should they say among the people, Where is their God? rule over: or, use a byword against
Then will the CHÚA be jealous for his land, Và pity his people.
Yea, the CHÚA will answer Và say unto his people, kìa, I will send you corn, Và wine, Và oil, Và ngươi sẽ be satisfied therewith: and I will no more make you a reproach among the heathen:
But I will remove far off from you the northern army, Và will drive him into a land barren Và desolate, with his face toward the east sea, Và his hinder part toward the utmost sea, Và his stink shall come up, Và his ill savour shall come up, because he hath done great things. hath…: Heb. hath magnified to do
Fear not, O land; be glad Và rejoice: for the CHÚA will do great things. will…: Heb. hath magnified to do
Be not afraid, ye beasts of the field: for the pastures of the wilderness do spring, for the tree beareth her fruit, cây vả Và the vine do yield their strength.
Be glad then, ye children of Si-ôn, Và rejoice in the CHÚA your God: for he hath given you the former rain moderately, Và he will cause to come down for you the rain, the former rain, Và the latter rain in the first month. the former rain moderately: or, a teacher of righteousness moderately: Heb. according to righteousness
Và the floors shall be full of wheat, Và the fats shall overflow with wine Và oil.
Và I will restore to you the years that the locust hath eaten, the cankerworm, Và the caterpiller, Và the palmerworm, my great army which I sent among you.
Và ngươi sẽ eat in plenty, Và be satisfied, Và praise Tên of the CHÚA your God, that hath dealt wondrously with you: and my people shall never bị hổ thẹn.
Và ngươi sẽ know that I là in the midst của I-sơ-ra-ên, and that I là the CHÚA your God, Và none else: and my people shall never bị hổ thẹn.
Và it shall come to pass afterward, that I will pour out my spirit upon all flesh; Và your sons Và your daughters shall prophesy, your old men shall dream dreams, your young men sẽ thấy visions:
Và also upon the servants Và upon taymaids in those days will I pour out my spirit.
Và I will shew wonders in the heavens Và in đất, huyết, Và fire, Và pillars of smoke.
mặt trời shall be turned into darkness, Và the moon into blood, before the great Và the terrible ngày of the CHÚA đến.
Và it shall come to pass, that whosoever shall call on Tên of the CHÚA shall be delivered: for in mount Si-ôn Và in Giê-ru-sa-lem shall be deliverance, as the CHÚA hath nói, Và in the remnant whom the CHÚA shall call.

CHAPTER 3.
For, kìa, in those days, Và in that time, when I shall bring again the captivity của Giu-đa Và Giê-ru-sa-lem,
I will also gather all nations, Và will bring them down into the valley of Jehoshaphat, Và will plead with them there for my people and for my heritage I-sơ-ra-ên, whom they have scattered among the nations, Và parted my land.
Và they have cast lots for my people; Và have given a boy for an harlot, Và sold a girl for wine, that they might drink.
Yea, and what have ye to do with me, O Ti-rơ, Và Zidon, Và all the coasts of Palestine? will ye render me a recompence? Và if ye recompense me, swiftly Và speedily will I return your recompence upon your own head;
Because ye have taken my silver Và my gold, Và have carried into your temples my goodly pleasant things: pleasant: Heb. desirable
con cái also của Giu-đa Và the children of Giê-ru-sa-lem have ye sold unto the Grecians, that ye might remove them far from their border. the Grecians: Heb. the sons of the Grecians
kìa, I will raise them out of the place whither ye have sold them, and will return your recompence upon your own head:
Và I will sell your sons Và your daughters into tay of the children của Giu-đa, Và they shall sell them to the Sabeans, to a people far off: for the CHÚA hath spoken it.
Proclaim ye this among the Gentiles; Prepare war, wake up the mighty men, let all the men of war draw near; let them come up: Prepare: Heb. Sanctify
Beat your plowshares into những thanh gươm, Và your pruninghooks into spears: let the weak say, I là strong. pruninghooks: or, scythes
Assemble yourselves, and come, all ye heathen, Và gather yourselves together round about: thither cause thy mighty ones to come down, O CHÚA. cause…: or, the CHÚA shall bring down
Let the heathen be wakened, Và come up to the valley of Jehoshaphat: for there will I sit to judge all the heathen round about.
Put ye in the sickle, for mùa gặt is ripe: đến, get you down; for the press is full, the fats overflow; for their wickedness is great.
Multitudes, multitudes in the valley of decision: for the day of the CHÚA is gần in the valley of decision. decision: or, concision, or, threshing
mặt trời Và the moon shall be darkened, Và ngôi saos shall withdraw their shining.
The CHÚA also shall roar out of Si-ôn, Và utter his voice from Giê-ru-sa-lem; Và the heavens Và đất shall shake: but the CHÚA will be the hy vọng of his people, Và the strength of the children của I-sơ-ra-ên. hy vọng: Heb. place of repair, or, harbour
So shall ye know that I là the CHÚA your God ởing in Si-ôn, my holy núi: then shall Giê-ru-sa-lem be holy, Và there shall no strangers pass through her any more. holy: Heb. holiness
Và it shall come to pass in that day, that núis shall drop down new wine, Và the hills shall flow with milk, Và all the rivers của Giu-đa shall flow with waters, Và a fountain shall come forth của nhà of the CHÚA, Và shall water the valley of Shittim. flow: Heb. go
Ai-Cập shall be a desolation, Và Edom shall be a desolate wilderness, for the violence against con cái của Giu-đa, because they have shed innocent huyết in their land.
But Giu-đa shall ở đến đời đời, Và Giê-ru-sa-lem from generation to generation. ở: or, abide
For I will cleanse their blood that I have not cleansed: for the CHÚA ởeth in Si-ôn. for the…: or, even I the CHÚA that

div.title: AMOS
div.chapter:
CHAPTER 1.
những lời of A-mốt, who was among the herdmen of Tekoa, which he saw concerning I-sơ-ra-ên trong những ngày of Uzziah vua của Giu-đa, Và trong những ngày of Jeroboam con trai of Joash vua của I-sơ-ra-ên, two years before the earthquake.
Và he nói, The CHÚA will roar from Si-ôn, Và utter his voice from Giê-ru-sa-lem; Và the habitations of những người chăn chiên shall mourn, Và the top of Carmel shall wither.
Thus nói the CHÚA; For three transgressions of Đa-mách, Và for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they have threshed Gilead with threshing instruments of sắt: and…: or, yea, for four turn…: or, convert it, or, let it be quiet
But I will send a fire inđến nhà of Hazael, which shall devour the palaces of Ben–hadad.
I will break also the bar of Đa-mách, Và cut off the inhabitant from the plain of Aven, Và him that holdeth the sceptre from nhà of Ê-đen: Và the people of Si-ri shall go into captivity unto Kir, nói the CHÚA. the plain…: or, Bikathaven nhà…: or, Beth–eden
Thus nói the CHÚA; For three transgressions of Gaza, Và for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they carried away captive the whole captivity, to deliver họ up to Edom: away captive…: or, them away with an entire
But I will send a fire on the wall of Gaza, which shall devour the palaces thereof:
Và I will cut off the inhabitant from Ashdod, Và him that holdeth the sceptre from Ashkelon, Và I will turn mine hand against Ekron: Và the remnant of the Philistines shall perish, nói Chúa
God.
Thus nói the CHÚA; For three transgressions of Tyrus, Và for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they delivered up the whole captivity to Edom, Và nhớ lại not the brotherly covenant: the brotherly…: Heb. the covenant of brethren
But I will send a fire on the wall of Tyrus, which shall devour the palaces thereof.
Thus nói the CHÚA; For three transgressions of Edom, Và for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because he did pursue his brother with thanh gươm, Và did cast off all pity, Và his anger did tear perpetually, Và he kept his wrath đến đời đời: did cast…: Heb. corrupted his compassions
But I will send a fire upon Teman, which shall devour the palaces of Bozrah.
Thus nói the CHÚA; For three transgressions of the children of Ammon, Và for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they have ripped up những người đàn bà with child of Gilead, that they might enlarge their border: ripped…: or, divided núis
But I will kindle a fire in the wall of Rabbah, Và it shall devour the palaces thereof, with shouting trong ngày of battle, with a tempest trong ngày of the whirlwind:
Và their king shall go into captivity, he and his princes together, nói the CHÚA.

CHAPTER 2.
Thus nói the CHÚA; For three transgressions of Mô-áp, Và for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because he burned the bones of the king of Edom into lime:
But I will send a fire upon Mô-áp, Và it shall devour the palaces of Kerioth: Và Mô-áp sẽ chết with tumult, with shouting, Và with the sound of the trumpet:
Và I will cut off the judge from the midst thereof, and will slay all the princes thereof with him, nói the CHÚA.
Thus nói the CHÚA; For three transgressions của Giu-đa, Và for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they have despised luật pháp of the CHÚA, Và have not kept his commandments, Và their lies caused them to err, after the which their fathers have walked:
But I will send a fire upon Giu-đa, Và it shall devour the palaces of Giê-ru-sa-lem.
Thus nói the CHÚA; For three transgressions của I-sơ-ra-ên, Và for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they sold the righteous for silver, Và the poor for a pair of shoes;
That pant after the dust đất on the head of the poor, Và turn aside đường of the meek: Và a man Và his father will go in unto the same maid, to profane my holy name: maid: or, young woman
Và they lay themselves down upon clothes laid to pledge by every altar, Và they drink the wine of the kết án trong nhà of their god. the kết án: or, such as have fined, or, mulcted
Yet destroyed I the Amorite before them, whose height was like the height of the cedars, and he was strong as the oaks; yet I destroyed his fruit from above, Và his roots from beneath.
Also I brought you up from the land of Ai-Cập, Và led you forty năm through the wilderness, to possess the land of the Amorite.
Và I raised up of your sons for các tiên tri, Và of your young men for Nazarites. Is it not even thus, O ye children của I-sơ-ra-ên? nói the CHÚA.
But ye gave the Nazarites rượu nho để uống; Và commanded các tiên tri, nói [rằng], Prophesy not.
kìa, I am pressed under you, as a cart is pressed that is full of sheaves. I am…: or, I will press your place, as a cart full of sheaves presseth
Therefore the flight shall perish from the swift, Và the strong shall not strengthen his force, neither shall the mighty deliver himself: himself: Heb. his soul, or, sự sống
Neither shall he stand that handleth the bow; and he that is swift of foot shall not deliver himself: neither shall he that rideth the horse deliver himself.
Và he that is courageous among the mighty shall flee away lỏa lồ trong ngày đó, nói the CHÚA. courageous: Heb. strong of his heart

CHAPTER 3.
nghe this word that the CHÚA hath spoken against you, O children của I-sơ-ra-ên, against the whole gia đình which I brought up from the land of Ai-Cập, nói [rằng],
You only have I known of all the families đất: therefore I will punish you for all your iniquities. punish: Heb. visit upon
Can two walk together, except they be agreed?
Will a lion roar in the forest, when he hath no prey? will a young lion cry out of his den, if he have taken nothing? cry: Heb. give forth his voice
Can a bird fall in a snare trên đất, where no gin is for him? shall one take up a snare from đất, Và have taken nothing at all?
Shall a trumpet be blown in the city, Và the people not be afraid? shall there be evil in a city, Và the CHÚA hath not done it? be afraid: or, run together?
the CHÚA…: or, shall not the CHÚA do somewhat?
Surely the Lord
God will do nothing, but he revealeth his secret unto his servants các tiên tri.
The lion hath roared, who will not fear? Chúa
God hath spoken, who can but prophesy?
Publish in the palaces at Ashdod, Và in the palaces in the land of Ai-Cập, Và say, Assemble yourselves upon núis of Sa-ma-ri, Và kìa the great tumults in the midst thereof, and the oppressed in the midst thereof. oppressed: or, oppressions
For they know not to do right, nói the CHÚA, who store up violence Và robbery in their palaces. robbery: or, spoil
Therefore thus nói Chúa
God; An adversary there shall be even round about the land; Và he shall bring down thy strength from ngươi, and thy palaces shall be spoiled.
Thus nói the CHÚA; As the shepherd taketh out of the mouth of the lion hai legs, or a piece of an ear; so shall the children của I-sơ-ra-ên be taken out that ở in Sa-ma-ri in the corner of a bed, Và in Đa-mách trong a couch. taketh: Heb. delivereth in Đa-mách…: or, on the bed's feet
nghe ye, and testify in nhà of Gia-cốp, nói Chúa
God, ĐCT vạn quân,
That trong ngày that I shall visit the transgressions của I-sơ-ra-ên upon him I will also visit the altars of Beth–el: Và the horns of the altar shall be cut off, Và fall to the ground. visit: or, punish I-sơ-ra-ên for
Và Ta sẽ đánh the winter nhà with the summer nhà; Và nhàs of ivory shall perish, Và the great houses shall have an end, nói the CHÚA.

CHAPTER 4.
nghe this word, ye kine of Bashan, that are in núi of Sa-ma-ri, which oppress người nghèo, which crush the needy, which say to their masters, Bring, Và let us drink.
Chúa
God hath sworn by his holiness, that, lo, the days shall come upon you, that he will take you away with hooks, Và your posterity with fishhooks.
Và ngươi sẽ go out at the breaches, mỗi cow at that which is before her; and ngươi sẽ cast họ into the palace, nói the CHÚA. cast…: or, cast away the things of the palace
đến to Beth–el, Và transgress; at Gilgal multiply transgression; Và bring your sacrifices mỗi buổi sáng, Và your tithes after three năm: three…: Heb. three years of days
Và offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving with leaven, Và proclaim Và publish the free offerings: for this liketh you, O ye children của I-sơ-ra-ên, nói Chúa
God. offer: Heb. offer by burning this…: Heb. so ye love
Và I also have given you cleanness răng in all your cities, Và want of bread in all your places: yet have ye not returned unto me, nói the CHÚA.
Và also I have withholden mưa from you, when there were yet three months to mùa gặt: Và I caused it to rain upon one city, Và caused it not to rain upon another city: một piece was rained upon, and the piece whereupon it rained not withered.
So two or ba các thành wandered unto one city, để uống nước; but they were not satisfied: yet have ye not returned unto me, nói the CHÚA.
I have smitten you with blasting Và mildew: when your gardens Và your vườn nhos Và your cây vảs Và your olive trees increased, the palmerworm devoured họ: yet have ye not returned unto me, nói the CHÚA. when…: or, đám đông of your gardens, etc. did the palmerworm
I have sent among you the pestilence after the manner of Ai-Cập: your young men have I slain with thanh gươm, Và have taken away your horses; Và I have made the stink of your camps to come up cùng các ngươir nostrils: yet have ye not returned unto me, nói the CHÚA. after…: or, in the way Và have…: Heb. with the captivity of your horses
I have overthrown some of you, as God overthrew Sô-đôm Và Gô-mô-rơ, Và ye were as a firebrand plucked out of the burning: yet have ye not returned unto me, nói the CHÚA.
Therefore thus will I do unto ngươi, O I-sơ-ra-ên: Và vì I will do this unto ngươi, prepare to meet thy God, O I-sơ-ra-ên.
For, lo, he that formeth núis, Và createth gió, Và declareth unto man what is his thought, that maketh buổi sáng tối tăm, Và treadeth upon the high places đất, The CHÚA, The God vạn quân, is his name. wind: or, spirit

CHAPTER 5.
nghe ye this word which I take up against you, even a ca thương, O house của I-sơ-ra-ên.
The virgin của I-sơ-ra-ên is fallen; she shall no more rise: she is forsaken upon her land; there is none to raise her up.
For thus nói Chúa
God; thành that went out by một ngàn shall leave một trăm, Và that which went forth by một trăm shall leave mười, đến nhà của I-sơ-ra-ên.
For thus nói the CHÚA unđến nhà của I-sơ-ra-ên, Seek ye me, and ngươi sẽ live:
But seek not Beth–el, nor enter into Gilgal, Và pass not to Beer–sheba: for Gilgal shall surely go into captivity, Và Beth–el shall come to nought.
Seek the CHÚA, Và ngươi sẽ live; lest he break out like fire in nhà of Giô-sép, Và devour it, and there be none to quench it in Beth–el.
Ye who turn judgment to wormwood, Và leave off righteousness in đất,
Seek him that maketh the bảy stars Và Orion, Và turneth the shadow of death into buổi sáng, Và maketh the day dark with night: that calleth for the waters of biển, Và poureth them out upon mặt đất: The CHÚA is his name:
That strengtheneth the spoiled against the strong, so that the spoiled shall come against the fortress. spoiled: Heb. spoil
They hate him that rebuketh in cổng, Và they abhor him that speaketh uprightly.
Forasmuch therefore as your treading is upon the poor, Và ye take from him burdens of wheat: ye have built houses of hewn stone, but ngươi sẽ not ở in them; ye have planted pleasant vườn nhos, but ngươi sẽ not drink rượu nho of them. pleasant…: Heb. vườn nhos of desire
Vì tôi biết your manifold transgressions Và your mighty tội lỗi: they afflict the just, they take a bribe, Và they turn aside người nghèo in cổng from their right. a bribe: or, a ransom
Therefore the prudent shall keep silence in that time; for it is an evil time.
Seek tốt, Và not evil, that ye may live: Và so the CHÚA, ĐCT vạn quân, shall be with you, as ye have spoken.
Hate the evil, Và love the good, Và establish judgment in cổng: it may be that the CHÚA ĐCT vạn quân will be gracious unto the remnant of Giô-sép.
Therefore the CHÚA, ĐCT vạn quân, Chúa, nói thus; Wailing shall be in all streets; Và they shall say in all the highways, Alas! alas! Và they shall call chồngman to than khóc, Và such as are skilful of ca thương to khóc lóc.
Và in all vườn nhos shall be khóc lóc: for I will pass through ngươi, nói the CHÚA.
Khốn thay cùng các ngươi that desire ngày of the CHÚA! to what end is it for you? the day of the CHÚA is tối tăm, Và not light.
As if a man did flee từ a lion, Và a bear met him; or went inđến nhà, Và leaned his hand on the wall, Và a serpent bit him.
Shall not the day of the CHÚA be tối tăm, Và not light? even very dark, Và no brightness in it?
I hate, I despise your feast days, Và I will not smell in your solemn assemblies. in…: or, your holy days
Though ye offer me burnt offerings Và your meat offerings, I will not accept họ: neither will I regard the peace offerings of your fat beasts. peace…: or, thank offerings
Take ngươi away from me the noise of thy songs; for I will not hear the melody of thy viols.
But let judgment run down as waters, Và righteousness as a mighty stream. run: Heb. roll
Have ye offered unto me sacrifices Và offerings in the wilderness bốn mươi năm, O house của I-sơ-ra-ên?
But ye have borne đền tạm of your Moloch Và Chiun your images, ngôi sao of your god, which ye made to yourselves. đền tạm…: or, Siccuth your king
Therefore will I cause you to go into captivity bên kia Đa-mách, nói the CHÚA, whose name is The God vạn quân.

CHAPTER 6.
Khốn thay to them that are at ease in Si-ôn, Và trust in núi of Sa-ma-ri, which are named chief of the nations, to whom nhà của I-sơ-ra-ên đến!are at…: or, are secure chief: or, firstfruits
Pass ye unto Calneh, Và see; Và from thence go ye to Hamath the great: then go down to Gath of the Philistines: be they better than these kingdoms? or their border lớn hơn than your border?
Ye that put far away the evil ngày, Và cause biểnt of violence to come near; seat: or, habitation
That lie upon beds of ivory, Và stretch themselves upon their couches, Và eat the lambs out of the flock, Và the calves out of the midst of the stall; stretch…: or, abound with superfluities
That chant to the sound of the viol, Và invent to themselves instruments of musick, like Đa-vít; chant: or, quaver
That drink rượu nho in bowls, Và anoint themselves with the chief ointments: but they are not grieved for the affliction of Giô-sép. wine…: or, in bowls of wine affliction: Heb. breach
Therefore now shall they go captive with the first that go captive, Và the banquet of them that stretched themselves shall be removed.
Chúa
God hath sworn by himself, nói the CHÚA ĐCT vạn quân, I abhor the excellency of Gia-cốp, Và hate his palaces: therefore will I deliver up thành with all that is therein. that…: Heb. the fulness thereof
Và it shall come to pass, if there remain mười men in one nhà, that they shall die.
Và a man's uncle shall take him up, Và he that burneth him, to bring out the bones out of nhà, Và shall say unto him that is by the sides của nhà, Is there yet any with ngươi? and he shall say, No. Then shall he say, Hold thy tongue: for we may not make mention of Tên of the CHÚA. we…: or, they will not, or, have not
For, kìa, the CHÚA commandeth, Và he will smite the great nhà with breaches, Và the little nhà with clefts. breaches: or, droppings
Shall horses run upon the rock? will one plow there with oxen? for ye have turned judgment into gall, Và the fruit of righteousness into hemlock:
Ye which rejoice in a thing of nought, which say, Have we not taken to us horns by our own strength?
But, kìa, I will raise up against you a nation, O house của I-sơ-ra-ên, nói the CHÚA ĐCT vạn quân; Và they shall afflict you from the entering in of Hemath unto the river of the wilderness. river: or, valley

CHAPTER 7.
Thus hath the Lord
God đã bày tỏ unto me; and, kìa, he formed grasshoppers in the beginning of the shooting up of the latter growth; and, lo, it was the latter growth after the king's mowings. grasshoppers: or, green worms
Và xảy đến, that when they had made an end of eating the grass of the land, then tôi nói, O Lord
God, tha thứ, tôi nài khuyên ngươi: by whom shall Gia-cốp Hãy chổi dậy? for he is small. by…: or, who of (or, for,) Gia-cốp shall stand?
The CHÚA repented for this: It shall not be, nói the CHÚA.
Thus hath the Lord
God đã bày tỏ unto me: and, kìa, the Lord
God called to contend by fire, Và it devoured the great deep, Và did eat up a part.
Then nói I, O Lord
God, cease, tôi nài khuyên ngươi: by whom shall Gia-cốp Hãy chổi dậy? for he is small. by…: or, who of (or, for,) Gia-cốp shall stand?
The CHÚA repented for this: This also shall not be, nói Chúa
God.
Thus he shewed me: and, kìa, the Lord đứng upon a wall made by a plumbline, with a plumbline in his hand.
Và the CHÚA nói unto me, A-mốt, what seest thou? And tôi nói, A plumbline. Then nói Chúa, kìa, I will set a plumbline in the midst of my people I-sơ-ra-ên: I will not again pass by them any more:
Và the high places of Y-sác shall be desolate, Và the sanctuaries của I-sơ-ra-ên shall be laid waste; Và I will rise against nhà of Jeroboam with thanh gươm.
Then Amaziah thầy tế lễ of Beth–el sent to Jeroboam vua của I-sơ-ra-ên, nói [rằng], A-mốt hath conspired against ngươi in the midst của nhà của I-sơ-ra-ên: the land is not able to bear all his words.
For thus A-mốt nói, Jeroboam sẽ chết by thanh gươm, Và I-sơ-ra-ên shall surely be led away captive out of their own land.
Also Amaziah nói unto A-mốt, O ngươi seer, đi, flee ngươi away into the land của Giu-đa, Và there eat bánh, Và prophesy there:
But prophesy not again any more at Beth–el: for it is the king's chapel, and it is the king's court. chapel: or, sanctuary king's court: Heb. house of the kingdom
Then trả lời A-mốt, và nói to Amaziah, I was no prophet, neither was I a prophet's son; but I was an herdman, Và a gatherer of sycomore fruit: sycomore…: or, wild figs
Và the CHÚA took me as I followed the flock, Và the CHÚA nói unto me, Go, prophesy unto my people I-sơ-ra-ên. as…: Heb. from behind
Now therefore hear ngươi the word of the CHÚA: ngươi sayest, Prophesy not against I-sơ-ra-ên, Và drop not thy word against nhà of Y-sác.
Therefore thus nói the CHÚA; Thy wife shall be an harlot in the city, Và thy sons Và thy daughters shall fall by thanh gươm, Và thy land shall be divided by line; Và ngươi shalt die trong a polluted land: Và I-sơ-ra-ên shall surely go into captivity forth of his land.

CHAPTER 8.
Thus hath the Lord
God đã bày tỏ cho tôi: và kìa a basket of summer fruit.
Và Ngài nói, A-mốt, what seest thou? And tôi nói, A basket of summer fruit. Then nói the CHÚA unto me, The end is come upon my people của I-sơ-ra-ên; I will not again pass by them any more.
Và the songs of đền thờ shall be howlings trong ngày đó, nói Chúa
God: there shall be many dead bodies in every place; they shall cast họ forth with silence. shall be howlings: Heb. shall howl with…: Heb. be silent
nghe đây, O ye that swallow up the needy, even to make người nghèo of the land to fail,
nói [rằng], When will the new moon be gone, that we may sell bắp? Và ngày Sa-bát, that we may set forth wheat, making the ephah small, Và the shekel great, Và falsifying the balances by deceit? new…: or, month set…: Heb. open falsifying…: Heb. perverting the balances of deceit
That we may buy người nghèo for silver, Và the needy for a pair of shoes; yea, Và sell the refuse of the wheat?
The CHÚA hath sworn by the excellency of Gia-cốp, Surely I will never forget any of their works.
Shall not the land tremble for this, and every one mourn that ởeth therein? and it sẽ chổi dậy wholly as a flood; Và it shall be cast out Và drowned, as by the flood of Ai-Cập.
Và it shall come to pass in that day, nói Chúa
God, that I will cause mặt trời to go down at noon, Và I will darken đất in the clear ngày:
Và I will turn your feasts into than khóc, Và all your songs into ca thương; Và I will bring up vải bố upon all loins, Và baldness upon every head; Và I will make it as the than khóc of an only son, Và the end thereof as a bitter ngày.
kìa, the days đến, nói Chúa
God, that I will send a famine in the land, not a famine of bread, nor a thirst for water, but of hearing những lời of the CHÚA:
Và they shall wander from sea to sea, Và from the north even to the east, they shall run to and fro to seek lời of the CHÚA, Và shall not find it.
In that day shall the fair virgins Và young men faint for thirst.
They that swear by the sin of Sa-ma-ri, Và say, Thy god, O Dan, liveth; and, The manner of Beer–sheba liveth; even they shall fall, Và never rise up again. manner: Heb. way

CHAPTER 9.
I saw Chúa standing upon the altar: Và he nói, Smite the lintel of the door, that the posts may shake: Và cut them in the head, all of them; and I will slay cuối cùng of them with thanh gươm: he that fleeth of them shall not flee away, Và he that escapeth of them shall not be delivered. lintel: or, chapiter, or, knop cut…: or, wound them
Though they dig into hell, thence shall mine hand take them; though they climb up to heaven, thence will I bring them down:
Và though they hide themselves in the top of Carmel, I will search Và take them out thence; and though they be hid from my sight in the bottom of biển, thence will I command con rắn, Và he shall bite them:
Và though they go into captivity before their enemies, thence will I command thanh gươm, Và it shall slay them: and I will set mine eyes upon them for evil, Và not for good.
Và the Lord
God vạn quân is he that toucheth the land, Và it shall melt, Và all that ở therein shall mourn: Và it sẽ chổi dậy wholly like a flood; Và shall be drowned, as by the flood of Ai-Cập.
It is he that buildeth his stories in the heaven, Và hath founded his troop in đất; he that calleth for the waters of biển, Và poureth them out upon mặt đất: The CHÚA is his name. stories: or, spheres: Heb. ascensions troop: or, bundle
Are ye not as children of the Ethiopians unto me, O children của I-sơ-ra-ên? nói the CHÚA. Have not I brought up I-sơ-ra-ên out of the land of Ai-Cập? Và the Philistines from Caphtor, Và the Syrians from Kir?
kìa, the eyes của ĐCT
God are upon the sinful kingdom, Và I will destroy it from off mặt đất; saving that I will not utterly destroy nhà of Gia-cốp, nói the CHÚA.
For, lo, I will command, Và I will sift nhà của I-sơ-ra-ên among all nations, like as bắp is sifted in a sieve, yet shall not the least grain fall trên đất. sift: Heb. cause to move grain: Heb. stone
All the sinners of my people sẽ chết by thanh gươm, which say, The evil shall not overtake nor prevent us.
In that day will I raise up đền tạm của Đa-vít that is fallen, Và close up the breaches thereof; and I will raise up his ruins, Và I will build it as trong những ngày of old: close: Heb. hedge, or, wall
That they may possess the remnant of Edom, Và of all the heathen, which are called by my name, nói the CHÚA that doeth this. which…: Heb. upon whom my name is called
kìa, the days đến, nói the CHÚA, that the plowman shall overtake the reaper, Và the treader of grapes him that soweth hạt giống; Và núis shall drop sweet wine, Và all the hills shall melt. soweth: Heb. draweth forth sweet: or, new
Và I will bring again the captivity of my people của I-sơ-ra-ên, Và they shall build the waste các thành, Và inhabit họ; Và they shall plant vườn nhos, và uống the wine thereof; they shall also make gardens, Và eat the fruit of them.
Và I will plant them upon their land, Và they shall no more be pulled up out of their land which I have given them, nói the CHÚA thy God.

div.title: OBADIAH
div.chapter:
The vision of Obadiah. Thus nói Chúa
God concerning Edom; We have heard a rumour from the CHÚA, Và an ambassador is sent among the heathen, Hãy chổi dậy ye, and let us rise up against her in battle.
kìa, I have made ngươi small among the heathen: ngươi art greatly despised.
The pride of thine heart hath deceived ngươi, ngươi that ởest in the clefts of the rock, whose habitation is high; that nói in his heart, Who shall bring me down to the ground?
Though ngươi exalt thyself as the eagle, Và though ngươi set thy nest among ngôi saos, thence will I bring ngươi down, nói the CHÚA.
If thieves đến to ngươi, if robbers by night, ( how art ngươi cut off!) would they not have stolen till they had enough? if the grapegatherers đến to ngươi, would they not leave some grapes? some…: or, gleanings?
How are the things of Esau searched out! how are his hidden things sought up!
All the men of thy confederacy have brought ngươi even to the border: the men that were at peace with ngươi have deceived ngươi, Và prevailed against ngươi; they that eat thy bread have laid a wound under ngươi: there is none understanding in him. that were…: Heb. of thy peace they…: Heb. the men of thy bread in him: or, of it
Shall I not in that day, nói the CHÚA, even destroy the wise men out of Edom, Và understanding out of the mount of Esau?
Và thy mighty men, O Teman, shall be dismayed, to the end that every one of the mount of Esau may be cut off by slaughter.
For thy violence against thy brother Gia-cốp shame shall cover ngươi, and ngươi shalt be cut off đến đời đời.
trong ngày that ngươi stoodest on the other side, trong ngày that the strangers carried away captive his forces, Và foreigners entered into his gates, Và cast lots upon Giê-ru-sa-lem, even thou wast as one of them. captive…: or, his substance
But ngươi shouldest not have looked on the day of thy brother trong ngày that he became a stranger; neither shouldest ngươi have rejoiced over the children của Giu-đa trong ngày of their destruction; neither shouldest ngươi have spoken proudly trong ngày of distress. spoken…: Heb. magnified thy mouth
ngươi shouldest not have entered into cổng of my people trong ngày of their calamity; yea, ngươi shouldest not have looked on their affliction trong ngày of their calamity, nor have laid hands on their substance trong ngày of their calamity; substance: or, forces
Neither shouldest ngươi have stood in the crossway, to cut off those of his that did escape; neither shouldest ngươi have delivered up those of his that did remain trong ngày of distress. delivered up: or, shut up
For the day of the CHÚA is gần upon all the heathen: as ngươi hast done, it shall be done unto ngươi: thy reward shall return upon thine own head.
For as ye have drunk upon my holy núi, so shall all the heathen uống continually, yea, they shall drink, Và they shall swallow down, Và they shall be as though they had not been. swallow…: or, sup up
But upon mount Si-ôn shall be deliverance, Và there shall be holiness; Và nhà of Gia-cốp shall possess their possessions. deliverance: or, they that escape there…: or, it shall be holy
Và nhà of Gia-cốp shall be a fire, Và nhà of Giô-sép a flame, Và nhà of Esau for stubble, Và they shall kindle in them, and devour them; and there shall not be any remaining của nhà of Esau; for the CHÚA hath spoken it.
Và they of the south shall possess the mount of Esau; and they of the plain the Philistines: Và they shall possess the fields of Ephraim, Và the fields of Sa-ma-ri: Và Bên-gia-min shall possess Gilead.
Và the captivity of this host of the children của I-sơ-ra-ên shall possess that của người Ca-na-an, even unto Zarephath; Và the captivity of Giê-ru-sa-lem, which is in Sepharad, shall possess the cities of the south. which…: or, shall possess that which is in
Và saviours shall come up on mount Si-ôn to judge the mount of Esau; Và the kingdom shall be the Lord's.

div.title: Giô-na
div.chapter:
CHAPTER 1.
Now the word of the CHÚA came unto Jonah con trai of Amittai, nói [rằng],Jonah: Gr. Giô-na
Hãy chổi dậy, đi to Nineveh, that great city, Và cry against it; for their wickedness is come up before me.
But Jonah rose up to flee unto Tarshish from the presence of the CHÚA, Và went down to Joppa; Và he found một chiếc thuyền going to Tarshish: so he paid the fare thereof, and went down into it, to go with them unto Tarshish from the presence of the CHÚA.
But the CHÚA sent out a great wind into biển, Và there was a mighty tempest in biển, so that the ship was like to be broken. sent out: Heb. cast forth was like…: Heb. thought to be broken
Then the mariners were afraid, Và cried every man unto his god, Và cast forth the wares that were in the ship into biển, to lighten it of them. But Jonah was gone down into the sides of the ship; Và he lay, Và was fast asleep.
So the shipmaster đến to him, and nói unto him, What meanest thou, O sleeper? Hãy chổi dậy, call upon thy God, if so be that God will think upon us, that we perish not.
Và họ nói every one to his fellow, đến, Và let us cast lots, that we may know for whose cause this evil is upon us. So they cast lots, Và the lot rơi upon Jonah.
Then nói they unto him, Tell us, we pray ngươi, for whose cause this evil is upon us; What is thine occupation? Và whence comest thou? what is thy country? Và of what people art thou?
Và he nói với họ, I là an Hebrew; Và I fear the CHÚA, ĐCT of heaven, which hath made biển Và the dry land. the CHÚA: or, Jehovah
Then were the men exceedingly afraid, và nói unto him, Tại sao hast ngươi done this? For the men knew that he fled from the presence of the CHÚA, because he had told them. exceedingly…: Heb. with great fear
Then nói they unto him, What shall we do unto ngươi, that biển may be calm unto us? for biển wrought, Và was tempestuous. may…: Heb. may be silent from us wrought…: or, grew more and more tempestuous: Heb. went
Và he nói với họ, Take me up, Và cast me forth into biển; so shall biển be calm cùng các ngươi: vì tôi biết that for my sake this great tempest is upon you.
Nevertheless the men rowed hard to bring it to the land; but they could not: for biển wrought, Và was tempestuous against them. rowed: Heb. digged wrought…: or, grew more and more tempestuous: Heb. went
Wherefore they cried unto the CHÚA, và nói, We beseech ngươi, O CHÚA, we beseech ngươi, let us not perish for this man's sự sống, Và lay not upon us innocent huyết: for thou, O CHÚA, hast done as it pleased ngươi.
So they took up Giô-na, Và cast him forth into biển: Và biển ceased from her raging. ceased: Heb. stood
Then the men feared the CHÚA exceedingly, Và offered a sacrifice unto the CHÚA, Và made vows. offered…: Heb. sacrifice unto the CHÚA, and vowed vows
Now the CHÚA had prepared a great fish to swallow up Giô-na. Và Jonah was in the belly of the fish ba ngày Và three nights. belly: Heb. bowels

CHAPTER 2.
Then Jonah cầu nguyện unto the CHÚA his God out of the fish's bụng,
và nói, I cried by reason of mine affliction unto the CHÚA, Và he heard me; out of the belly of hell cried I, Và ngươi heardest my voice. by…: or, out of mine affliction hell: or, the grave
For ngươi hadst cast me into the deep, in the midst of biểns; Và the floods compassed me about: all thy billows Và thy waves passed over me. midst: Heb. heart
Then tôi nói, I am cast out of thy sight; yet I will look again toward thy holy đền thờ.
The waters compassed me about, even to the soul: the depth closed me round about, the weeds were wrapped about my head.
I went down to the bottoms of núis; đất with her bars was about me đến đời đời: yet hast ngươi brought up my sự sống from corruption, O CHÚA my God. bottoms: Heb. cuttings off corruption: or, the pit
When my soul fainted within me I nhớ lại the CHÚA: Và my prayer came in unto ngươi, into thine holy đền thờ.
They that observe lying vanities forsake their own mercy.
But I will sacrifice unto ngươi with the voice of thanksgiving; I will pay that that I have vowed. sự cứu rỗi is of the CHÚA.
Và the CHÚA nói unto the fish, Và it vomited out Giô-na upon the dry land.

CHAPTER 3.
Và the word of the CHÚA came unto Jonah thứ hai time, saying,
Hãy chổi dậy, đi unto Nineveh, that great city, Và preach unto it the preaching that I bid ngươi.
So Jonah arose, Và went unto Nineveh, according to the word of the CHÚA. Now Nineveh was an exceeding great city of three days' hành trình. exceeding: Heb. của ĐCT
Và Jonah bắt đầu to enter into the city a day's hành trình, Và he cried, và nói, Yet forty ngày, Và Nineveh shall be overthrown.
So the people of Nineveh tin ĐCT, Và proclaimed a fast, Và put on vải bố, from the greatest of them even to the least of them.
For word đến unto the king of Nineveh, Và he arose from his throne, Và he laid his robe from him, and covered him with vải bố, Và sat in ashes.
Và he caused it to be proclaimed Và published through Nineveh by the decree of the king Và his nobles, nói [rằng], Let neither man nor beast, herd nor flock, taste any thing: let them not feed, nor drink nước: published: Heb. nói nobles: Heb. great men
But let man Và beast be covered with vải bố, Và cry mightily unto God: yea, let them turn every one from his evil way, Và from the violence that is in their hands.
Who can tell nếu ĐCT will turn Và repent, Và turn away from his fierce anger, that we perish not?
Và ĐCT nhìn thấy their works, that they turned from their evil way; Và ĐCT repented of the evil, that he had nói that he would do với họ; and he did it not.

CHAPTER 4.
But it displeased Giô-na exceedingly, Và he was very angry.
Và he cầu nguyện unto the CHÚA, và nói, I pray ngươi, O CHÚA, was not this my saying, when I was yet in my country? Therefore I fled before unto Tarshish: for I knew that thou art a gracious ĐCT, Và merciful, slow to anger, Và of great kindness, Và repentest ngươi of the evil.
Therefore now, O CHÚA, take, tôi nài khuyên ngươi, my sự sống from me; for it is better for me to die than to live.
Then nói the CHÚA, Doest ngươi well to be angry? Doest…: or, Art ngươi greatly angry?
So Jonah went out of the city, Và sat on the east side of the city, Và there made him a booth, Và sat under it in the shadow, till he might see what would become of the city.
Và the CHÚA ĐCT đã chuẩn bị a gourd, and made it to come up over Jonah, that it might be a shadow over his head, to deliver him from his grief. So Jonah was exceeding glad of the gourd. gourd: or, palmcrist: Heb. Kikajon was…: Heb. rejoiced with great joy
But God đã chuẩn bị a worm when buổi sáng rose the next day, Và it smote the gourd that it withered.
Và xảy đến, when mặt trời did arise, that God đã chuẩn bị a vehement east wind; Và mặt trời beat upon the head của Giô-nah, that he fainted, Và wished in himself to die, và nói, It is better for me to die than to live. vehement: or, silent
Và ĐCT nói to Jonah, Doest ngươi well to be angry for the gourd? Và he nói, I do well to be angry, even unto death. Doest…: or, Art ngươi greatly angry?
I do well…: or, I am greatly angry
Then nói the CHÚA, ngươi hast had pity on the gourd, for the which ngươi hast not laboured, neither madest it grow; which came up in a night, Và perished in a night: had pity: or, spared came…: Heb. was the son of the night
Và should not I spare Nineveh, that great city, wherein are more than sixscore ngàn persons that cannot discern between their tay phải Và their tay trái; and also much cattle?

div.title: MICAH
div.chapter:
CHAPTER 1.
lời of the CHÚA that came to Micah the Morasthite trong những ngày of Jotham, Ahaz, Và Hezekiah, các vua của Giu-đa, which he saw concerning Sa-ma-ri Và Giê-ru-sa-lem.
nghe, all ye people; hearken, O đất, Và all that therein is: and let the Lord
God be witness against you, the Lord from his holy đền thờ. all ye…: Heb. ye people, all of them all that…: Heb. the fulness thereof
For, kìa, the CHÚA cometh forth out of his place, Và will come down, Và tread upon the high places đất.
Và núis shall be molten under him, and the valleys shall be cleft, as wax before lửa, Và as the waters that are poured down a steep place. a steep…: Heb. a descent
For the transgression of Gia-cốp is all this, and for the tội lỗi của nhà của I-sơ-ra-ên. What is the transgression of Gia-cốp? is it not Sa-ma-ri? and what are the high places của Giu-đa? are they not Giê-ru-sa-lem?
Therefore I will make Sa-ma-ri as an heap of the field, Và as plantings of a vườn nho: Và I will pour down the stones thereof into the valley, Và I will discover the foundations thereof.
Và all the graven images thereof shall be beaten to pieces, Và all the hires thereof shall be burned with the fire, Và all the idols thereof will I lay desolate: for she gathered it of the hire of an harlot, Và they shall return to the hire of an harlot.
Therefore I will wail Và howl, I will go stripped Và naked: I will make a khóc lóc like the dragons, Và than khóc as the owls. owls: Heb. daughters of the owl
For her wound is incurable; for it is come unto Giu-đa; he is come unto cổng of my people, even to Giê-ru-sa-lem. her…: or, she is grievously sick of her wounds
Declare ye it not at Gath, weep ye not at all: in nhà of Aphrah roll thyself in the dust. Aphrah: that is, Dust
Pass ye away, ngươi inhabitant of Saphir, having thy shame lỏa lồ: the inhabitant of Zaanan came not forth in the than khóc of Beth–ezel; he shall receive of you his standing. thou…: or, ngươi that ởest fairly inhabitant: Heb. inhabitress Zaanan: or, The country of flocks Beth–ezel: or, một chỗ near
For the inhabitant of Maroth waited carefully for good: but evil came down from the CHÚA unto cổng of Giê-ru-sa-lem. inhabitant: Heb. inhabitress waited…: or, was grieved
O ngươi inhabitant of Lachish, cột the chariot to the swift beast: she is ban đầu of the sin to con gái of Si-ôn: for the transgressions của I-sơ-ra-ên were found in ngươi. inhabitant: Heb. inhabitress
Therefore shalt ngươi give presents to Moresheth–gath: nhàs of Achzib shall be a lie to các vua của I-sơ-ra-ên. to…: or, for Moresheth–gath Achzib: that is, A lie
Yet will I bring an heir unto ngươi, O inhabitant of Mareshah: he shall come unto Adullam sự vinh hiển của I-sơ-ra-ên. inhabitant: Heb. inhabitress he…: or, sự vinh hiển của I-sơ-ra-ên shall, etc
Make ngươi bald, Và poll ngươi for thy delicate children; enlarge thy baldness as the eagle; for they are gone into captivity from ngươi.

CHAPTER 2.
Khốn thay to them that devise iniquity, Và work evil upon their beds! when buổi sáng is light, they practise it, because it is in quyền năng of their hand.
Và they covet fields, and take họ by violence; Và houses, and take họ away: so they oppress một người Và his house, even a man Và his heritage. oppress: or, defraud
Therefore thus nói the CHÚA; kìa, against this gia đình do I devise an evil, from which ngươi sẽ not remove your necks; neither shall ye go haughtily: for this time is evil.
In that day shall one take up a parable against you, and lament with a doleful ca thương, Và say, We be utterly spoiled: he hath changed the portion of my people: how hath he removed it from me! turning away he hath divided our fields. a doleful…: Heb. a ca thương of ca thươngs turning…: or, instead of restoring
Therefore ngươi shalt have none that shall cast a cord by lot in the congregation of the CHÚA.
Prophesy ye not, họ nói to them that prophesy: they shall not prophesy to them, that they shall not take shame. Prophesy ye…: or, Prophesy not as they prophesy: Heb. Drop, etc
O ngươi that art named nhà of Gia-cốp, is the spirit of the CHÚA straitened? are these his doings? do not my words do good to him that walketh uprightly? straitened: or, shortened?
uprightly: Heb. upright?
Even of late my people is risen up as an enemy: ye pull off the robe với the garment from them that pass by securely as men averse from war. of late: Heb. yesterday with the: Heb. over against a
những người đàn bà of my people have ye cast out from their pleasant houses; from their children have ye taken away my glory đến đời đời. women: or, wives
Hãy chổi dậy ye, and depart; for this is not your rest: because it is polluted, it shall destroy you, even with a sore destruction.
nếu một người walking in the spirit Và falsehood do lie, nói [rằng], I will prophesy unto ngươi of wine Và of strong drink; he shall even be the prophet of this people. walking…: or, walk with the wind, and lie falsely
I will surely assemble, O Gia-cốp, all of ngươi; I will surely gather the remnant của I-sơ-ra-ên; I will put them together as the sheep of Bozrah, as the flock in the midst of their fold: they shall make great noise by reason of đám đông of men.
The breaker is come up before them: they have broken up, Và have passed through cổng, Và are gone out by it: and their king shall pass before them, and the CHÚA on the head of them.

CHAPTER 3.
Và tôi nói, nghe, I pray you, O heads of Gia-cốp, Và ye princes của nhà của I-sơ-ra-ên; Is it not for you to know judgment?
Who hate the good, Và love the evil; who pluck off their skin from off them, and their flesh from off their bones;
Who also eat xác thịt of my people, Và flay their skin from off them; and they break their bones, Và chop them in pieces, as for the pot, Và as flesh within the caldron.
Then shall they cry unto the CHÚA, but he will not hear them: he will even hide his face from them at that time, as they have behaved themselves ill in their doings.
Thus nói the CHÚA concerning các tiên tri that make my people err, that bite with their teeth, Và cry, Peace; Và he that putteth not into their mouths, they even prepare war against him.
Therefore night shall be cùng các ngươi, that ngươi sẽ not have a vision; Và it shall be dark cùng các ngươi, that ngươi sẽ not divine; Và mặt trời shall go down over các tiên tri, Và the day shall be dark over them. that…: vision: Heb. from a vision that…: divine: Heb. from divining
Then shall the seers bị hổ thẹn, Và the diviners confounded: yea, they shall all cover their lips; for there is no answer của ĐCT. lips: Heb. upper lip
But truly I am full of power by the spirit of the CHÚA, Và of judgment, Và of might, to declare unto Gia-cốp his transgression, Và to I-sơ-ra-ên his sin.
nghe this, I pray you, ye heads của nhà of Gia-cốp, Và princes của nhà của I-sơ-ra-ên, that abhor judgment, Và pervert all equity.
They build up Si-ôn with blood, Và Giê-ru-sa-lem with iniquity. blood: Heb. bloods
The heads thereof judge for reward, Và the priests thereof teach for hire, Và các tiên tri thereof divine for money: yet will they lean upon the CHÚA, Và say, Is not the CHÚA among us? none evil can come upon us. Và say: Heb. saying
Therefore shall Si-ôn for your sake be plowed as a field, Và Giê-ru-sa-lem shall become heaps, Và núi của nhà as the high places of the forest.

CHAPTER 4.
But in cuối cùng ngày it shall come to pass, that núi của nhà of the CHÚA shall be established in the top of núis, Và it shall be exalted above the hills; Và people shall flow unto it.
Và many nations shall come, Và say, đến, Và let us go up to núi of the CHÚA, Và đến nhà of ĐCT of Gia-cốp; Và he will teach us of his ways, Và we will walk in his paths: for the law shall go forth of Si-ôn, Và the word of the CHÚA from Giê-ru-sa-lem.
Và he shall judge among many people, Và rebuke strong nations afar off; Và they shall beat their những thanh gươm into plowshares, Và their spears into pruninghooks: nation shall not lift up a thanh gươm against nation, neither shall they learn war any more. pruninghooks: or, scythes
But they shall sit every man under his vine Và under his cây vả; and none shall make họ afraid: for the mouth of the CHÚA vạn quân hath spoken it.
For all people will walk every one in Tên of his god, Và we will walk in Tên of the CHÚA ĐCT chúng tôi đến đời đời và mãi mãi.
In that day, nói the CHÚA, will I assemble her that halteth, Và I will gather her that is driven out, Và her that I have afflicted;
Và I will make her that halted a remnant, Và her that was cast far off a strong nation: Và the CHÚA shall reign over them in mount Si-ôn from henceforth, even for ever.
Và thou, O tower of the flock, the strong hold of con gái of Si-ôn, unto ngươi shall it come, even the first dominion; the kingdom shall come to con gái of Giê-ru-sa-lem.
Now why dost ngươi cry out aloud? is there no king in ngươi? is thy counsellor perished? for pangs have taken ngươi as một người đờn bà in travail.
Be in pain, Và labour to bring forth, O daughter of Si-ôn, like một người đờn bà in travail: for now shalt ngươi go forth out of the city, Và ngươi shalt ở in the field, Và ngươi shalt go even to Ba-by-lôn; there shalt ngươi be delivered; there the CHÚA shall redeem ngươi from tay of thine enemies.
Now also many nations are gathered against ngươi, that say, Let her be làm dơ dáyd, Và let our eye look upon Si-ôn.
But they know not the thoughts of the CHÚA, neither understand they his counsel: for he shall gather them as the sheaves into the floor.
Hãy chổi dậy Và thresh, O daughter of Si-ôn: for I will make thine horn sắt, Và I will make thy hoofs brass: Và ngươi shalt beat in pieces many people: Và I will consecrate their gain unto the CHÚA, Và their substance unto the Lord of the whole đất.

CHAPTER 5.
Now gather thyself in troops, O daughter of troops: he hath laid siege against us: they shall smite the judge của I-sơ-ra-ên with a rod upon the cheek.
But thou, Bết-lê-hem Ép-ra-ta, though ngươi be little among the thousands của Giu-đa, yet out of ngươi shall he come forth unto me that is to be ruler in I-sơ-ra-ên; whose goings forth have been from of old, from đời đời. đời đời: Heb. the days of eternity
Therefore will he give them up, until the time that she which travaileth hath brought forth: then the remnant of anh em người shall return unto the children của I-sơ-ra-ên.
Và he shall stand Và feed in the strength of the CHÚA, in the majesty of Tên of the CHÚA his God; Và they shall abide: for now shall he be great unto the ends đất. feed: or, rule
Và this man shall be the peace, when the Assyrian shall come into our land: Và when he shall tread in our palaces, then shall we raise against him bảy shepherds, Và eight principal men. principal: Heb. princes of
Và they shall waste the land of A-si-ri with thanh gươm, Và the land of Nimrod in the entrances thereof: thus shall he deliver us from the Assyrian, when he cometh into our land, Và when he treadeth within our borders. waste: Heb. eat up in the…: or, with her own naked những thanh gươm
Và the remnant of Gia-cốp shall be in the midst of many people as a dew from the CHÚA, as the showers upon the grass, that tarrieth not for man, nor waiteth for the sons of men.
Và the remnant of Gia-cốp shall be among the Gentiles in the midst of many people as a lion among the beasts of the forest, as a young lion among the flocks of sheep: who, if he go through, both treadeth down, Và teareth in pieces, Và none can deliver. sheep: or, goats
Thine hand shall bị treo lên upon thine adversaries, Và all thine enemies shall be cut off.
Và it shall come to pass in that day, nói the CHÚA, that I will cut off thy horses out of the midst of ngươi, and I will destroy thy chariots:
Và I will cut off the cities of thy land, Và throw down all thy strong holds:
Và I will cut off phù phéps out of thine hand; and ngươi shalt have no more soothsayers:
Thy graven images also will I cut off, Và thy standing images out of the midst of ngươi; and ngươi shalt no more worship the work of thine hands. standing…: or, statues
Và I will pluck up thy groves out of the midst of ngươi: so will I destroy thy cities. cities: or, enemies
Và I will execute vengeance in anger Và fury upon the heathen, such as they have not heard.

CHAPTER 6.
nghe ye now what the CHÚA nói; Hãy chổi dậy, contend ngươi before núis, Và let the hills nghe thy voice. before: or, with
nghe ye, O mountains, the Lord's controversy, Và ye strong foundations đất: for the CHÚA hath a controversy with his people, Và he will plead with I-sơ-ra-ên.
O my people, what have I done unto ngươi? and wherein have I wearied ngươi? testify against me.
For I brought ngươi up out of the land of Ai-Cập, Và redeemed ngươi out of nhà of servants; Và I sent before ngươi Môi-se, A-rôn, Và Miriam.
O my people, nhớ now what Balak vua of Mô-áp consulted, Và what Balaam con trai of Beor trả lời him from Shittim unto Gilgal; that ye may know the righteousness of the CHÚA.
Wherewith shall I come before the CHÚA, Và bow myself before the high ĐCT? shall I come before him with burnt offerings, with calves of a year old? of a…: Heb. sons of a year?
Will the CHÚA be pleased with thousands of rams, or with ten thousands of rivers of oil? shall I give my firstborn for my transgression, the fruit of my body for the sin of my soul? body: Heb. belly
He hath shewed ngươi, O man, what is tốt; Và what doth the CHÚA require of ngươi, but to do justly, Và to love mercy, Và to walk humbly with thy God? walk…: Heb. humble thyself to walk
The Lord's tiếng crieth unto the city, and the man of sự khôn ngoan sẽ thấy Danh Ngài: nghe ye the rod, Và who hath appointed it. the man…: or, Danh Ngài sẽ thấy that which is
Are there yet the treasures of wickedness in nhà of the wicked, Và the scant measure that is abominable? Are…: or, Is there yet unto every man một căn nhà of the, etc scant…: Heb. measure of leanness
Shall I count họ pure with the wicked balances, Và with the bag of deceitful weights? count…: or, be pure with, etc
For the rich men thereof are full of violence, Và the inhabitants thereof have spoken lies, Và their tongue is deceitful in their mouth.
Therefore also will I make ngươi sick in smiting ngươi, in making ngươi desolate vì cớ thy tội lỗi.
ngươi shalt eat, but not be satisfied; Và thy casting down shall be in the midst of ngươi; and ngươi shalt take hold, but shalt not deliver; and that which ngươi deliverest will I give up to thanh gươm.
ngươi shalt sow, but ngươi shalt not reap; ngươi shalt tread the olives, but ngươi shalt not anoint ngươi with oil; Và sweet wine, but shalt not drink rượu nho.
For the statutes of Omri are kept, Và all the works của nhà of Ahab, Và ye walk in their counsels; that I should make ngươi a desolation, Và the inhabitants thereof an hissing: therefore ngươi sẽ bear the reproach of my people. For the…: or, For he doth much keep the, etc desolation: or, astonishment

CHAPTER 7.
Khốn thay is me! for I am as when they have gathered the summer fruits, as the grapegleanings of the vintage: there is no cluster to eat: my soul desired the firstripe fruit. when…: Heb. the gatherings of summer
The good man is perished out đất: and there is none upright among men: they all lie in wait for blood; they hunt every man his brother with a net. good: or, godly, or, merciful
That they may do evil with both hands earnestly, the prince asketh, Và the judge asketh for a reward; Và the great man, he uttereth his mischievous desire: so they wrap it up. his…: Heb. the mischief of his soul
The best of them is as a brier: the most upright is sharper than a thorn hedge: ngày of thy watchmen Và thy visitation đến; now shall be their perplexity.
Trust ye not in a friend, put ye not confidence in a guide: keep the doors of thy mouth from her that lieth in thy bosom.
For the son dishonoureth cha, con gái riseth up against her mother, con gái in law against her mother in law; a man's enemies are the men of his own house.
Therefore I will look unto the CHÚA; I will wait for ĐCT of my salvation: my God will hear me.
Rejoice not against me, O mine enemy: when I fall, I shall arise; when I sit in darkness, the CHÚA shall be a light unto me.
I will bear the indignation of the CHÚA, because I have sinned against him, until he plead my cause, Và execute judgment for me: he will bring me forth to the light, Và I shall kìa his righteousness.
Then she that is mine enemy sẽ thấy it, Và shame shall cover her which nói unto me, Where is the CHÚA thy God? mine eyes shall kìa her: now shall she be trodden down as the mire of the streets. Then…: or, And ngươi wilt see her that is mine enemy, and cover her with shame shall she…: Heb. she shall be for a treading down
trong ngày that thy walls are to be built, trong that day shall the decree be far removed.
trong that day also he shall come even to ngươi from A-si-ri, and từ the fortified các thành, Và from the fortress even to the river, Và from sea to sea, and từ núi to mountain. Và từ the fortified cities: or, even to the fortified cities
Notwithstanding the land shall be desolate vì cớ them that ở therein, for the fruit of their doings. Notwithstanding: or, Sau đó it hath been
Feed thy people with thy rod, the flock of thine heritage, which ở solitarily trong the wood, in the midst of Carmel: let them feed trong Bashan Và Gilead, as trong những ngày of old. Feed: or, Rule
According to the days of thy coming out of the land of Ai-Cập will I shew unto him marvellous things.
The nations sẽ thấy Và be confounded at all their might: they shall lay their tay upon their miệng, their ears shall be deaf.
They shall lick the dust like a serpent, they shall move out of their holes like worms đất: they shall be afraid of the CHÚA ĐCT chúng tôi, Và shall fear vì cớ ngươi. worms: or, creeping things
Who is a God like unto ngươi, that pardoneth iniquity, Và passeth by the transgression of the remnant of his heritage? he retaineth not his anger đến đời đời, because he delighteth trong mercy.
He will turn again, he will have compassion upon us; he will subdue our iniquities; Và ngươi wilt cast all their tội lỗi into the depths of biển.
ngươi wilt perform lẽ thật to Gia-cốp, Và the mercy to Áp-ra-ham, which ngươi hast sworn unto our fathers from the days of old.

div.title: NAHUM
div.chapter:
CHAPTER 1.
The burden of Nineveh. quyển sách of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite.
ĐCT is jealous, Và the CHÚA revengeth; the CHÚA revengeth, and is furious; the CHÚA will take vengeance on his adversaries, Và he reserveth wrath for his enemies. God…: or, The CHÚA is a jealous God, and a revenger, etc is furious: Heb. that hath fury
The CHÚA is slow to anger, Và great in power, Và will not at all acquit the wicked: the CHÚA hath his way in the whirlwind Và in the storm, Và đám mâys are the dust of his feet.
He rebuketh biển, Và maketh it dry, Và drieth up all the rivers: Bashan languisheth, Và Carmel, Và the flower of Lebanon languisheth.
núis quake at him, and the hills melt, Và đất is burned at his presence, yea, the world, Và all that ở therein.
Who can stand before his indignation? Và who can abide in the fierceness of his anger? his fury is poured out like fire, Và the rocks are thrown down by him. abide: Heb. stand up
The CHÚA is tốt, a strong hold trong ngày of trouble; Và he knoweth them that trust in him. strong hold: or, strength
But with an overrunning flood he will make an utter end of the place thereof, and darkness shall pursue his enemies.
What do ye imagine against the CHÚA? he will make an utter end: affliction shall not rise up the second time.
For while they be folden together as thorns, Và while they are drunken as drunkards, they shall be devoured as stubble fully dry.
There is one come out of ngươi, that imagineth evil against the CHÚA, a wicked counsellor. a wicked…: Heb. a counsellor of Belial
Thus nói the CHÚA; Though they be quiet, Và cũng như vậy many, yet thus shall they be cut down, when he shall pass through. Though I have afflicted ngươi, I will afflict ngươi no more. Though…: or, If they would have been at peace, so should they have been many, and so should they have been shorn, and he should have passed away cut down: Heb. shorn
For now will I break his yoke from off ngươi, and will burst thy bonds in sunder.
Và the CHÚA hath given a commandment concerning ngươi, that no more of Danh Ngài be sown: out of nhà of thy gods will I cut off the graven image Và the molten image: I will make thy grave; for ngươi art vile.
kìa upon núis the feet of him that bringeth tin mừng, that publisheth peace! O Giu-đa, keep thy solemn feasts, perform thy vows: for the wicked shall no more pass through ngươi; he is utterly cut off. keep…: Heb. feast the wicked: Heb. Belial

CHAPTER 2.
He that dasheth in pieces is come up before thy face: keep the munition, watch đường, make thy loins strong, fortify thy power mightily. He…: or, The disperser, or, hammer
For the CHÚA hath turned away the excellency of Gia-cốp, as the excellency của I-sơ-ra-ên: for the emptiers have emptied them out, Và marred their vine branches. the excellency of Gia-cốp…: or, the pride of Gia-cốp as the pride, etc
The shield of his mighty men is made red, the valiant men are in scarlet: the chariots shall be with flaming torches trong ngày of his preparation, Và the fir trees shall be terribly shaken. in scarlet: or, dyed scarlet flaming: or, fiery
The chariots shall rage in the streets, they shall justle one against another in the broad ways: they sẽ thấym like torches, they shall run like the lightnings. they: Heb. their show
He shall recount his worthies: they shall stumble in their walk; they shall make haste to the wall thereof, and the defence shall be prepared. worthies: or, gallants defence: Heb. covering, or, coverer
The gates of the rivers sẽ được mở ra, Và the palace shall be dissolved. dissolved: or, molten
Và Huzzab shall be led away captive, she shall be brought up, Và her maids shall lead her as with the voice of bồ câu, tabering upon their breasts. Huzzab: or, that which was established, or, there was a stand made led…: or, discovered
But Nineveh is of old like a pool of water: yet they shall flee away. Stand, stand, shall they cry; but none shall look back. of old: or, from the days that she hath been look back: or, cause them to turn
Take ye the spoil of silver, take the spoil of gold: for there is none end of the store Và glory out of all the pleasant furniture. for…: or, and their infinite store, etc pleasant…: Heb. vessels of desire
She is empty, Và void, Và waste: Và the heart melteth, Và the knees smite together, Và much pain is in all loins, Và mặts of them all gather blackness.
Where is the ởing of the lions, Và the feedingplace of the young lions, where the lion, even the old lion, walked, Và the lion's whelp, and none made họ afraid?
The lion did tear in pieces enough for his whelps, Và strangled for his lionesses, Và filled his holes with prey, Và his dens with ravin.
kìa, I là against ngươi, nói the CHÚA vạn quân, Và I will burn her chariots in the smoke, Và thanh gươm shall devour thy young lions: Và I will cut off thy prey from đất, Và the voice of thy messengers shall no more be heard.

CHAPTER 3.
Khốn thay to the bloody city! it is all full of lies Và robbery; the prey departeth not;bloody…: Heb. city of bloods
The noise of a whip, Và the noise of the rattling of the wheels, Và of the pransing horses, Và of the jumping chariots.
The horseman lifteth up both the bright thanh gươm Và the glittering spear: and there is a multitude of slain, Và a great number of carcases; and there is none end of their corpses; they stumble upon their corpses: the bright…: Heb. the flame of thanh gươm, and the lightning of the spear
Vì cớ đám đông of the whoredoms of the wellfavoured harlot, the mistress of phù phéps, that selleth nations through her whoredoms, Và families through her phù phéps.
kìa, I là against ngươi, nói the CHÚA vạn quân; Và I will discover thy skirts upon thy face, Và I will shew the nations thy nakedness, Và the kingdoms thy shame.
Và I will cast abominable filth upon ngươi, and make ngươi vile, Và will set ngươi as a gazingstock.
Và it shall come to pass, that all they that look upon ngươi shall flee from ngươi, and say, Nineveh is laid waste: who will bemoan her? whence shall I seek comforters for ngươi?
Art ngươi better than populous No, that was situate among the rivers, that had the waters round about it, whose rampart was biển, Và her wall was from biển? populous…: or, nourishing, etc: Heb. No Amon
Ethiopia Và Ai-Cập were her strength, and it was infinite; Put Và Lubim were thy helpers. thy helpers: Heb. in thy help
Yet was she carried away, she went into captivity: her young children also were dashed in pieces at the top of all the streets: Và they cast lots for her honourable men, Và all her great men were bound in chains.
ngươi also shalt be drunken: ngươi shalt be hid, ngươi also shalt seek strength vì cớ the enemy.
All thy strong holds shall be like cây vảs with the firstripe figs: if they be shaken, they shall even fall into the mouth of the eater.
kìa, thy people in the midst of ngươi are women: the gates of thy land shall be set wide open unto thine enemies: lửa shall devour thy bars.
Draw ngươi waters for the siege, fortify thy strong holds: đi into clay, Và tread the morter, make strong the brickkiln.
There shall the fire devour ngươi; thanh gươm shall cut ngươi off, it shall eat ngươi up like the cankerworm: make thyself many as the cankerworm, make thyself many as the châu chấu.
ngươi hast multiplied thy merchants above ngôi saos of heaven: the cankerworm spoileth, Và flieth away. spoileth: or, spreadeth himself
Thy crowned are as the châu chấu, Và thy captains as the great grasshoppers, which camp in the hedges in the cold ngày, but when mặt trời ariseth they flee away, Và their place is not known where they are.
Thy shepherds slumber, O king of A-si-ri: thy nobles shall ở in the dust: thy people is scattered upon núis, Và không ai gathereth họ. nobles: or, valiant ones
There is no healing of thy bruise; thy wound is grievous: all that hear the bruit of ngươi shall clap tay over ngươi: for upon whom hath not thy wickedness passed continually? healing: Heb. wrinkling

div.title: HABAKKUK
div.chapter:
CHAPTER 1.
The burden which Habakkuk tiên tri did see.
O CHÚA, how long shall I cry, Và ngươi wilt not hear! even cry out unto ngươi of violence, Và ngươi wilt not save!
Tại sao dost ngươi shew me iniquity, and cause me to kìa grievance? for spoiling Và violence are before me: and there are that raise up strife Và contention.
Therefore the law is slacked, Và judgment doth never go forth: for the wicked doth compass about the righteous; therefore wrong judgment proceedeth. wrong: or, wrested
kìa ye among the heathen, Và regard, Và wonder marvellously: for I will work a work in your days, which ye will not believe, though it be told you.
For, lo, I raise up the Chaldeans, that bitter Và hasty nation, which shall march through the breadth of the land, to possess the ởingplaces that are not theirs. breadth: Heb. breadths
They are terrible Và dreadful: their judgment Và their dignity shall proceed of themselves. their judgment…: or, from them shall proceed the judgment of these, and the captivity of these
Their horses also are swifter than the leopards, Và are more fierce than buổi chiều muôn sói: Và their horsemen shall spread themselves, and their horsemen shall come from far; they shall fly as the eagle that hasteth to eat. fierce: Heb. sharp
They shall come all for violence: their faces shall sup up as the east wind, Và they shall gather the captivity as the sand. their…: or, the supping up of their faces, etc: or, their faces shall look (Heb. the opposition of their faces) toward the east
Và they shall scoff at các vua, Và the princes shall be a scorn với họ: they shall deride every strong hold; for they shall heap dust, Và take it.
Then shall his mind change, Và he shall pass over, Và offend, imputing này his power unto his god.
Art ngươi not from đời đời, O CHÚA my God, mine Holy One? we shall not die. O CHÚA, ngươi hast ordained them for judgment; and, O mighty God, ngươi hast established them for correction. mighty…: Heb. rock established: Heb. founded
ngươi art of purer mắt than to kìa evil, Và canst not look on iniquity: wherefore lookest ngươi upon them that deal treacherously, Và holdest thy tongue when the wicked devoureth the man that is more righteous than he? iniquity: or, grievance
Và makest men as the fishes of biển, as the creeping things, that have no ruler over them? creeping: or, moving
They take up all of them with the angle, they catch them in their net, Và gather them in their drag: therefore they rejoice Và are glad. drag: or, flue net
Therefore they sacrifice unto their net, Và burn incense unto their drag; because by them their portion is fat, Và their meat plenteous. plenteous: or, dainty: Heb. fat
Shall they therefore empty their net, Và not spare continually to slay the nations?

CHAPTER 2.
I will stand upon my watch, Và set me upon the tower, Và will watch để xemwhat he will say unto me, and what I shall answer when I am reproved. tower: Heb. fenced place unto me: or, in me when…: or, when I am argued with: Heb. upon my reproof, or, arguing
Và the CHÚA trả lời me, and nói, Write the vision, and make it plain upon tables, that he may run that readeth it.
For the vision is yet for an appointed time, but at the end it shall speak, Và not lie: though it tarry, wait for it; because it will surely đến, it will not tarry.
kìa, his soul which is lifted up is not upright in him: but the just sẽ sống by his faith.
Yea also, because he transgresseth by wine, he is a proud man, neither keepeth at home, who enlargeth his desire as hell, and is as death, Và cannot be satisfied, but gathereth unto him all nations, Và heapeth unto him all people: Yea…: or, How much more
Shall not all these take up a parable against him, and a taunting proverb against him, and say, Khốn thay to him that increaseth that which is not his! how long? and to him that ladeth himself with thick clay!Woe…: or, Ho, he
Shall they not rise up bất chợt that shall bite ngươi, and awake that shall vex ngươi, and ngươi shalt be for booties với họ?
Because ngươi hast spoiled many nations, all the remnant của dân sự shall spoil ngươi; vì cớ men's huyết, and for the violence of the land, of the city, Và of all that ở therein. blood: Heb. bloods
Khốn thay to him that coveteth an evil covetousness to his house, that he may set his nest on high, that he may be delivered from quyền năng of evil!coveteth…: or, gaineth and evil gain power…: Heb. palm of tay
ngươi hast consulted shame to thy house by cutting off many people, Và hast sinned against thy soul.
For the stone shall cry out of the wall, Và the beam out of the timber shall answer it. beam: or, piece, or, fastening answer it: or, witness against it
Khốn thay to him that buildeth a town with blood, Và stablisheth a city by iniquity!blood: Heb. bloods
kìa, is it not of the CHÚA vạn quân that the people shall labour in the very lửa, Và the people shall weary themselves for very hư không? for…: or, vô ích?
For đất shall be filled with the knowledge of sự vinh hiển of the CHÚA, as the waters cover biển. with…: or, by knowing sự vinh hiển
Khốn thay unto him that giveth his neighbour uống, that puttest thy bottle to him, and makest him drunken also, that ngươi mayest look on their nakedness!
ngươi art filled with shame for glory: uống ngươi also, and let thy foreskin be uncovered: the cup of the Lord's tay phải shall be turned unto ngươi, and shameful spewing shall be on thy glory. with…: or, more with shame than with glory
For the violence of Lebanon shall cover ngươi, and the spoil of beasts, which made them afraid, vì cớ men's huyết, Và for the violence of the land, of the city, Và of all that ở therein.
What profiteth the graven image that the maker thereof hath graven it; the molten image, Và a teacher of lies, that the maker of his work trusteth therein, to make câm idols? maker of…: Heb. fashioner of his fashion
Khốn thay unto him that nói to the wood, Awake; to the dumb stone, Hãy chổi dậy, it shall teach! kìa, it is laid over with gold và bạc, and there is no breath at all in the midst of it.
But the CHÚA is in his holy đền thờ: let all đất keep silence before him. let…: Heb. be silent all đất before him

CHAPTER 3.
A prayer of Habakkuk tiên tri upon Shigionoth. upon…: or, according to variable songs, or, tunes, called in Hebrew, Shigionoth
O CHÚA, I have heard thy speech, Và was afraid: O CHÚA, revive thy work in the midst of the years, in the midst of the years make known; in wrath nhớ mercy. speech: Heb. report, or, hearing revive: or, preserve alive
ĐCT đến from Teman, Và the Holy One from mount Paran. Selah. His glory covered các tầng trời, Và đất was full of his praise. Teman: or, the south
Và his brightness was as the light; he had horns coming out of his hand: and there was the hiding of his power. horns…: or, bright beams out of his side
Before him went the pestilence, Và burning coals went forth at his feet. coals: or, diseases
He stood, Và measured đất: he beheld, Và drove asunder the nations; Và the đời đời mountains were scattered, the perpetual hills did bow: his ways are đời đời.
I saw the tents of Cushan in affliction: Và the curtains of the land of Midian did tremble. Cushan: or, Ethiopia in…: or, under affliction, or, hư không
Was the CHÚA displeased against the rivers? was thine anger against the rivers? was thy wrath against biển, that ngươi didst ride upon thine horses Và thy chariots của sự cứu rỗi? of…: or, were salvation?
Thy bow was made quite lỏa lồ, according to the oaths of the tribes, even thy word. Selah. ngươi didst cleave đất with rivers. đất…: or, rivers đất
núis nhìn thấy ngươi, Và they trembled: the overflowing of the water passed by: the deep uttered his voice, Và lifted up his hands on high.
mặt trời Và mặt trăng stood still in their habitation: at the light of thine arrows they went, Và at the shining of thy glittering spear. at the light…: or, thine arrows walked in the light
ngươi didst march through the land in indignation, ngươi didst thresh the heathen in anger.
ngươi wentest forth for the salvation of thy people, even for salvation with thine anointed; ngươi woundedst the head out of nhà of the wicked, by discovering the foundation unto the neck. Selah. by…: Heb. making naked
ngươi didst strike through with his staves the head of his villages: they came out as a whirlwind to scatter me: their rejoicing was as to devour người nghèo secretly. came…: Heb. were tempestuous
ngươi didst walk through biển with thine horses, through the heap of great waters. heap: or, mud
When I heard, my belly trembled; my lips quivered at the voice: rottenness entered into my bones, Và I trembled in myself, that I might rest trong ngày of trouble: when he cometh up unto the people, he will invade them with his troops. invade…: or, cut them in pieces
Although cây vả shall not blossom, neither shall fruit be in the vines; the labour of the olive shall fail, Và the fields shall yield no meat; the flock shall be cut off from the fold, and there shall be no herd in the stalls: fail: Heb. lie
Yet I will rejoice in the CHÚA, I will joy in ĐCT of my salvation.
The CHÚA ĐCT is my strength, Và he will make my feet like hinds' chân, Và he will make me to walk upon mine high places. To the chief singer on my stringed instruments. chief…: or, overseer stringed…: Heb. Neginoth

div.title: ZEPHANIAH
div.chapter:
CHAPTER 1.
lời of the CHÚA which came unto Zephaniah con trai of Cushi, con trai of Gedaliah, con trai of Amariah, con trai of Hizkiah, trong những ngày of Josiah con trai of Amon, vua của Giu-đa.
I will utterly consume all things from off the land, nói the CHÚA. I will…: Heb. By taking away I will make an end the land: Heb. mặt of the land
I will consume man Và beast; I will consume the fowls of the heaven, Và the fishes of biển, Và the stumblingblocks with the wicked; Và I will cut off man from off the land, nói the CHÚA. stumblingblocks: or, idols
I will also stretch out mine hand upon Giu-đa, Và upon all the inhabitants of Giê-ru-sa-lem; Và I will cut off the remnant of Baal from this place, Và Tên of the Chemarims with the priests;
Và them that worship the host of heaven upon mái nhà; Và them that worship Và that swear by the CHÚA, Và that swear by Malcham; by the…: or, to the CHÚA
Và them that are turned back từ the CHÚA; and those that have not sought the CHÚA, nor enquired for him.
Hold thy peace at the presence của ĐCT
God: for the day of the CHÚA is at hand: for the CHÚA hath prepared a sacrifice, he hath bid his guests. bid: Heb. sanctified, or, prepared
Và it shall come to pass trong ngày of the Lord's sacrifice, that I will punish the princes, Và the king's children, Và all such as are clothed with strange apparel. punish: Heb. visit upon
In the same day also will I punish all those that leap on the threshold, which fill their masters' houses with violence Và deceit.
Và it shall come to pass in that day, nói the CHÚA, that there shall be the noise of a cry from the fish gate, Và an howling from the second, Và a great crashing from the hills.
Howl, ye inhabitants of Maktesh, for all the merchant people are cut down; all they that bear silver are cut off.
Và it shall come to pass at that time, that I will search Giê-ru-sa-lem with candles, Và punish the men that are settled on their lees: that say in their heart, The CHÚA will not do good, neither will he do evil. settled: Heb. curded, or, thickened
Therefore their goods shall become a booty, Và their houses a desolation: they shall also build houses, but not inhabit họ; Và they shall plant vườn nhos, but not drink the wine thereof.
The great ngày of the CHÚA is gần, it is gần, Và hasteth greatly, even tiếng of the day of the CHÚA: the mighty man shall cry there bitterly.
That day is a day of wrath, a day of trouble Và distress, a day of wasteness Và desolation, a day của sự tối tăm Và gloominess, a day of clouds Và thick darkness,
A day of the trumpet Và alarm against the fenced các thành, Và against the high towers.
